paragraphs: Revolucija 14. julija, znana tudi kot iraški vojaški udar leta 1958, je bila vojaški udar 14. julija 1958 v Iraku, ki je strmoglavil kralja Fejsala II. in hašemitsko Kraljevino Irak. Iraška republika, ki je nastala po njem, je končala hašemitsko arabsko federacijo Iraka in Jordanije, ustanovljeno komaj šest mesecev prej.

source.title: 14 July Revolution
paragraphs: The 14 July Revolution, also known as the 1958 Iraqi military coup, was a military coup that took place on 14 July 1958 in Iraq, resulting in the toppling of King Faisal II and the overthrow of the Hashemite-led Kingdom of Iraq. The Iraqi Republic established in its wake ended the Hashemite Arab Federation between Iraq and Jordan that had been established just six months earlier.

Revolucija 17. julija (arabsko: inqilāb 17 Tammūz) je bila nekrvav državni udar v Iraku leta 1968, ki so ga vodili Ahmed Hasan al Bakr, Abd ar Razak an Naif in Abd ar Rahman al Davud. Odstavil je predsednika Abdula Rahmana Arifa in predsednika vlade Tahirja Jahjo ter na oblast pripeljal iraško regionalno vejo Arabske socialistične stranke Baath. Med baatisti, ki so sodelovali v udaru in poznejši čistki zmerne frakcije pod vodstvom Naifa, so bili Hardan al Tikriti, Salih Mahdi Amaš in poznejši iraški predsednik Sadam Husein. Udar je bil uperjen predvsem proti Jahji, odkritemu naseristu, ki je politično krizo po šestdnevni vojni junija 1967 izkoristil, da bi Arifovo zmerno vlado prisilil k nacionalizaciji družbe Iraq Petroleum Company (IPC) v zahodni lasti, da bi Irak lahko »nafto uporabil kot orožje v boju proti Izraelu«. Do popolne nacionalizacije IPC je prišlo šele leta 1972, pod baatistično oblastjo. Po udaru je nova iraška vlada utrdila oblast z obtožbami o domnevnih ameriških in izraelskih spletkah, med širšo čistko je zaradi izmišljenih obtožb vohunjenja javno usmrtila 14 ljudi, med njimi 9 iraških Judov, in krepila tradicionalno tesne odnose s Sovjetsko zvezo.

source.title: 17 July Revolution
paragraphs: The 17 July Revolution (Arabic: انقلاب 17 تموز, romanized: inqilāb 17 Tammūz) was a bloodless coup in Iraq in 1968 led by Ahmed Hassan al-Bakr, Abd ar-Razzaq an-Naif, and Abd ar-Rahman al-Dawud that ousted President Abdul Rahman Arif and Prime Minister Tahir Yahya and brought the Iraqi Regional Branch of the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party to power. Ba'athists involved in the coup as well as the subsequent purge of the moderate faction led by Naif included Hardan al-Tikriti, Salih Mahdi Ammash, and Saddam Hussein, the future President of Iraq. The coup was primarily directed against Yahya, an outspoken Nasserist who exploited the political crisis created by the June 1967 Six-Day War to push Arif's moderate government to nationalize the Western-owned Iraq Petroleum Company (IPC) in order to use Iraq's "oil as a weapon in the battle against Israel." Full nationalization of the IPC did not occur until 1972, under the Ba'athist administration. In the aftermath of the coup, the new Iraqi government consolidated power by denouncing alleged American and Israeli machinations, publicly executing 14 people including 9 Iraqi Jews on fabricated espionage charges amidst a broader purge, and working to expand Iraq's traditionally close relations with the Soviet Union.

1860 civil conflict in Mount Lebanon and.headline: Državljanski spopad v Libanonskem gorovju in Damasku leta 1860
paragraphs: Državljanski spopad v Libanonskem gorovju in Damasku leta 1860, znan tudi kot krščansko-druzovska vojna leta 1860, je bil državljanski spopad v Libanonskem gorovju v času osmanske oblasti v letih 1860–1861, v katerem so se bojevali predvsem tamkajšnji Druzi in kristjani.

Po odločilnih zmagah Druzov in pokolih kristjanov se je spopad razširil v druge dele osmanske Sirije, zlasti v Damask, kjer so druzovski borci in krajevne muslimanske skupine pobili na tisoče kristjanov. Boji so sprožili mednarodno vojaško posredovanje pod francoskim vodstvom.

source.title: 1860 civil conflict in Mount Lebanon and Damascus
paragraphs: The 1860 civil conflict in Mount Lebanon and Damascus, also known as the 1860 Christian–Druze war, was a civil conflict in Mount Lebanon during Ottoman rule in 1860–1861 fought mainly between the local Druze and Christians.

Following decisive Druze victories and massacres of the Christians, the conflict spilled over into other parts of Ottoman Syria, particularly Damascus, where thousands of Christian residents were killed by Druze fighters and local Muslim groups. The fighting precipitated a French-led international military intervention.

1894 Sasun rebellion.headline: Upor v Sasunu leta 1894
paragraphs: Upor v Sasunu leta 1894, znan tudi kot prvi odpor v Sasunu (armensko: Սասնոյ առաջին ապստամբութիւն), je bil spopad v pokrajini Sasun med hamidijskimi silami Osmanskega cesarstva in armenskimi fedaji iz stranke Hnčak, dela armenskega narodnega gibanja.

source.title: 1894 Sasun rebellion
paragraphs: The Sasun rebellion of 1894, also known as the First Sasun resistance (Armenian: Սասնոյ առաջին ապստամբութիւն), was the conflict between Ottoman Empire's Hamidiye forces and the Armenian fedayi belonging to the Armenian national movement's Hunchakian party in the Sasun region.

1919 Egyptian revolution.headline: Egiptovska revolucija leta 1919
paragraphs: Egiptovska revolucija leta 1919 (arabsko: ثورة 1919, Thawra 1919) je bila vsedržavna revolucija v Egiptovskem sultanatu proti britanski zasedbi, ki je trajala od novembra 1918 do julija 1919. Izbruhnila je takoj po koncu prve svetovne vojne in je bila vrhunec desetletij nasprotovanja egiptovskih nacionalistov zasedbi, neposredno pa jo je sprožilo izgnanstvo voditelja stranke Vafd Saada Zaglula in več drugih članov stranke, ki so ga ukazali Britanci.

source.title: 1919 Egyptian revolution
paragraphs: The 1919 Egyptian revolution (Arabic: ثورة 1919, Thawra 1919) was a nation-wide revolution in the Sultanate of Egypt against British occupation that lasted from November 1918 to July 1919. Occurring right after the end of World War I, the revolution served as the culmination of successive decades of opposition by Egyptian nationalists to occupation, and was directly sparked by the British-ordered exile of Wafd Party leader Saad Zaghloul and several other party members.

1920 capture of Damascus.headline: Zavzetje Damaska leta 1920
paragraphs: Zavzetje Damaska leta 1920 je bilo zadnja faza francosko-sirske vojne, v kateri so francoske sile skoraj brez odpora zavzele Damask. Arabsko kraljestvo Sirija je bilo konec, začel je veljati francoski mandat za Sirijo. Kmalu zatem, septembra 1920, je Damask postal prestolnica države Damask pod francoskim mandatom.

Vojna Hašemitov proti Francozom, ki je izbruhnila januarja 1920, se je za novo razglašeno Arabsko kraljestvo Sirija kmalu sprevrgla v uničujoč pohod. Kralj Fejsal se je v skrbeh zaradi posledic dolgega krvavega boja s Francozi 14. julija 1920 sam vdal, a njegovo sporočilo ni prišlo do vojnega ministra Jusufa al Azme, ki je kralja prezrl in povedel vojsko k Majsalunu, da bi Sirijo branil pred francoskim prodorom. Bitka pri Majsalunu se je končala s porazom Sircev. Francoske čete so nato krenile nad Damask in ga 24. julija 1920 zavzele.

source.title: 1920 capture of Damascus
paragraphs: The 1920 capture of Damascus was the final stage of the Franco-Syrian War in which French forces captured Damascus with little resistance. The Arab Kingdom of Syria was brought to an end, and the French mandate of Syria was put into effect. Shortly afterward, in September 1920, Damascus was established as the capital of the State of Damascus under a French mandate.

The war of the Hashemites against the French, which erupted in January 1920, shortly became a devastating campaign for the newly-proclaimed Arab Kingdom of Syria. Worried about the results of a long bloody fight with the French, King Faisal himself surrendered on 14 July 1920, but his message would not reach War minister Yusuf al-'Azma, who, ignoring the King, led an army to Maysalun to defend Syria from the French advance. The Battle of Maysalun resulted in a crushing Syrian defeat. The French troops later marched on Damascus and captured it on 24 July 1920.

1921 Persian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Perziji leta 1921
paragraphs: Iranski državni udar leta 1921, v Iranu znan kot državni udar 3. esfanda 1299 (po perzijskem sončnem koledarju), označuje več velikih dogodkov v kadžarskem Iranu leta 1921, ki so nazadnje pripeljali do odstavitve dinastije Kadžarov in do tega, da je leta 1925 vladajoča rodbina Irana postala dinastija Pahlavijev.

Dogodki so se začeli 22. februarja 1921 z udarom perzijske kozaške brigade pod vodstvom Reze kana. Natančen obseg britanske vpletenosti v udar je še vedno predmet zgodovinske razprave, skoraj gotovo pa je Edmund Ironside zarotnikom svetoval. Z udarom je oblast prevzel Zia ol Din Tabatabai, ki je postal predsednik vlade. Udar je bil večinoma nekrvav in je naletel na malo odpora. Reza kan je z okrepljenimi silami in kozaško brigado uspešno vojaško odpravil separatistična in uporniška gibanja v Tabrizu, Mašhadu in gibanje Džangali v Gilanu. Pohod proti Simku in Kurdom je bil manj uspešen in je trajal globoko v leto 1922, čeprav se je nazadnje končal z iranskim uspehom.

source.title: 1921 Persian coup d'état
paragraphs: 1921 Iranian coup d'état, known in Iran as 3 Esfand 1299 coup d'état (Persian: کودتای ۳ اسفند ۱۲۹۹ with the Solar Persian date), refers to several major events in Qajar Iran in 1921, which eventually led to the deposition of the Qajar dynasty and the establishment of the Pahlavi dynasty as the ruling house of Iran in 1925.

The events began with a coup by the Persian Cossack Brigade headed by Reza Khan on 22 February 1921. The precise level of British involvement in the coup remains a matter of historical debate, but it is almost certain that Edmund Ironside provided advice to the plotters. With this coup Zia ol Din Tabatabaee took over power and became prime minister. The coup was largely bloodless and faced little resistance. With his expanded forces and the Cossack Brigade, Reza Khan launched successful military actions to eliminate separatist and dissident movements in Tabriz, Mashhad and the Jangalis in Gilan. The campaign against Simko and the Kurds was less successful and lasted well into 1922, though it eventually concluded with Iranian success.

1941 Iraqi coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Iraku leta 1941
paragraphs: Iraški državni udar leta 1941 (arabsko: Thawrah Rašīd ʿAlī al-Kaylānī), imenovan tudi udar Rašida Alija al Gajlanija ali udar zlatega kvadrata, je bil nacionalistični državni udar v Iraku 1. aprila 1941, ki je strmoglavil probritanski režim regenta Abd al Ilaha in njegovega predsednika vlade Nurija al Saida ter za regenta postavil Šarafa bin Radžeha, za predsednika vlade pa Rašida Alija al Gajlanija.

Udar so vodili štirje iraški nacionalistični generali, znani kot »zlati kvadrat«, ki so hoteli vojno izkoristiti za pritisk za popolno neodvisnost Iraka po omejeni neodvisnosti, pridobljeni leta 1932. Zato so sodelovali z nemško obveščevalno službo in sprejeli vojaško pomoč nacistične Nemčije in fašistične Italije. Menjava vlade je pripeljala do britanske invazije na Irak in zasedbe, ki je trajala do leta 1947.

source.title: 1941 Iraqi coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1941 Iraqi coup d'état (Arabic: ثورة رشيد علي الكيلاني, Thawrah Rašīd ʿAlī al-Kaylānī), also called the Rashid Ali Al-Gaylani coup or the Golden Square coup, was a nationalist coup d'état in Iraq on 1 April 1941 that overthrew the pro-British regime of Regent 'Abd al-Ilah and his Prime Minister Nuri al-Said and installed Sharaf bin Rajeh as Regent and Rashid Ali al-Gaylani as Prime Minister.

The coup was led by four Iraqi nationalist army generals, known as "the Golden Square", who intended to use the war to press for full Iraqi independence following the limited independence granted in 1932. To that end, they worked with German intelligence and accepted military assistance from Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy. The change in government led to the British invasion of Iraq and subsequent occupation until 1947.

1953 Iranian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Iranu leta 1953
paragraphs: Z državnim udarom 19. avgusta 1953 so strmoglavili iranskega predsednika vlade Mohameda Mosadeka in okrepili oblast iranskega šaha Mohameda Reze Pahlavija. Udar sta spodbudila Združeno kraljestvo (MI6) z operacijo Boot in Združene države (CIA) s projektom TP-AJAX oziroma operacijo Ajax. Ključni motiv je bila zaščita britanskih naftnih interesov v Iranu, potem ko je Mosadek leta 1951 nacionaliziral državno naftno industrijo.

source.title: 1953 Iranian coup d'état
paragraphs: On 19 August 1953 a coup d'état overthrew the Prime Minister of Iran, Mohammad Mosaddegh, strengthening the rule of Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, the Shah of Iran. It was instigated by the United Kingdom (MI6), under the name Operation Boot and by the United States (CIA), under the name TP-AJAX Project or Operation Ajax. A key motive was to protect British oil-interests in Iran after Mosaddegh had nationalized the country's oil industry in 1951.

1959 Mosul uprising.headline: Vstaja v Mosulu leta 1959
paragraphs: Vstaja v Mosulu leta 1959 se je začela s poskusom državnega udara arabskih nacionalistov v Mosulu, ki so hoteli odstaviti tedanjega iraškega predsednika vlade Abdula Karima Kasima in postaviti arabsko nacionalistično vlado, ki bi Republiko Irak pridružila Združeni arabski republiki. Ko je udar spodletel, sta se v Mosulu sesula red in zakon: več dni so potekali nasilni ulični boji med skupinami, ki so skušale izkoristiti kaos za poravnavo političnih in osebnih računov.

source.title: 1959 Mosul uprising
paragraphs: The 1959 Mosul Uprising started with an attempted coup by Arab nationalists in Mosul who wished to depose the then Iraqi Prime Minister Abdul-Karim Qasim, and install an Arab nationalist government which would then join the Republic of Iraq with the United Arab Republic. Following the failure of the coup, law and order broke down in Mosul, which witnessed several days of violent street battles between various groups attempting to use the chaos to settle political and personal scores.

1960 Ethiopian coup attempt.headline: Poskus državnega udara v Etiopiji leta 1960
paragraphs: Revolucionarni svet, klika štirih zarotnikov pod vodstvom bratov Germameja Nevaja in brigadnega generala Mengistuja Nevaja, poveljnika Kebur Zabagne (cesarske garde), je 13. decembra 1960 skušal z državnim udarom strmoglaviti etiopskega cesarja Haileja Selasieja. Cesarja so hoteli strmoglaviti med njegovim državniškim obiskom v Braziliji in na oblast postaviti napredno vlado.

Voditelji udara so nameravali postaviti novo vlado, ki bi formalno vladala pod najstarejšim sinom Haileja Selasieja, prestolonaslednikom Asfo Vosenom, in bi se lotila naraščajočih gospodarskih in družbenih težav Etiopskega cesarstva. Uporniki so prevzeli nadzor nad večino prestolnice Adis Abebe in zajeli več ministrov in drugih pomembnih oseb kot talce.

Udar so zatrli po nasilnem spopadu s cesarsko vojsko in letalstvom. Po začetnem uspehu se je večina vojske in prebivalstva hitro postavila proti udaru in do 17. decembra so cesarju zvesti znova prevzeli nadzor nad Adis Abebo. Med udarom je umrlo najmanj 300 ljudi, med njimi večina zarotnikov.

source.title: 1960 Ethiopian coup attempt
paragraphs: A coup d'état was attempted against Emperor Haile Selassie of Ethiopia on 13 December 1960 by the Council of the Revolution, a cabal of four conspirators led by brothers Germame Neway and Brigadier General Mengistu Neway, commander of the Kebur Zabagna (Imperial Guard). They sought to overthrow the emperor during a state visit to Brazil in order to install a progressive government.

The coup leaders aimed to install a new government to be nominally under the rule of Haile Selassie's eldest son, Crown Prince Asfaw Wossen, which would address the increasing economic and social problems the Ethiopian Empire was facing. Rebels gained control of most of the capital city, Addis Ababa, and took several ministers and other important people hostage.

The coup was put down following a violent confrontation with the imperial army and air force. After its initial success, the majority of the military and populace quickly aligned against the coup, and by 17 December loyalists had regained control of Addis Ababa. At least 300 people were killed during the coup, including most of the conspirators.

1960 Turkish coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Turčiji leta 1960
paragraphs: Državni udar v Turčiji leta 1960 (turško: 27 Mayıs Darbesi), znan tudi kot revolucija 27. maja (turško: 27 Mayıs İhtilali ali 27 Mayıs Devrimi), je bil prvi državni udar v Republiki Turčiji. Zgodil se je 27. maja 1960. Izvedla ga je skupina 38 mladih turških častnikov mimo vojaške poveljniške verige. Do dneva udara jih je dejansko vodil Cemal Madanoğlu. Ko je Ragıp Gümüşpala zagrozil, da bo udar zatrl, če ga ne bo vodil nekdo z višjim vojaškim činom od njega, so častniki za svojega voditelja pripeljali generala Cemala Gürsela. Udar je bil uperjen proti demokratično izvoljeni vladi Demokratske stranke in se je nazadnje končal z usmrtitvijo predsednika vlade Adnana Menderesa in dveh njegovih ministrov, Fatina Rüştüja Zorluja in Hasana Polatkana.

source.title: 1960 Turkish coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1960 Turkish coup d'état (Turkish: 27 Mayıs Darbesi), also known as the 27 May Revolution (Turkish: 27 Mayıs İhtilali or 27 Mayıs Devrimi), was the first coup d'état in the Republic of Turkey. It took place on 27 May 1960. The coup was staged by a group of 38 young Turkish military officers, acting outside the military chain of command. The officers were de facto led by Cemal Madanoğlu until the actual coup date. After a threat by Ragıp Gümüşpala that he would move to quell the coup unless it was led by someone with a higher military rank than himself, the officers brought in General Cemal Gürsel as their leader. The coup was carried out against the democratically elected government of the Democrat Party, and ultimately resulted in the execution of its prime minister, Adnan Menderes, alongside two of his ministers, Fatin Rüştü Zorlu and Hasan Polatkan.

Sirski državni udar leta 1963, ki ga baatistično zgodovinopisje imenuje revolucija 8. marca (arabsko: ثورة الثامن من آذار), je bil prevzem oblasti v Siriji, ki ga je izvedel vojaški odbor sirske regionalne veje Arabske socialistične stranke Baath. Načrtovanje in izvedbo zarote sirskih baatistov je spodbudil prevzem oblasti stranke Baath v Iraku februarja 1963.

source.title: 1963 Syrian coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1963 Syrian coup d'état, labelled in Ba'athist historiography as the March 8 Revolution (Arabic: ثورة الثامن من آذار), was the seizure of power in Syria by the military committee of the Syrian Regional Branch of the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party. The planning and the unfolding conspiracy of the Syrian Ba'athist operatives were prompted by the Ba'ath party's seizure of power in Iraq in February 1963.

1966 Nigerian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Nigeriji leta 1966
paragraphs: Vojaki pod vodstvom Kadune Nzeogvuja in štirih drugih so 15. januarja 1966 izvedli vojaški puč, v katerem so ubili 22 ljudi, med njimi predsednika vlade Abubakarja Tafawo Balewo in premierja Severne regije Ahmaduja Bella, številne visoke politike, visoke častnike in njihove žene ter stražarje na varovanju. Zarotniki so v dveh dneh napadli mesta Kaduna, Ibadan in Lagos ter zaprli reki Niger in Benue, nato pa so jih premagale vladi zveste sile.

Čeprav je udar veljal za neuspešnega, je izvoljeno vlado vseeno nadomestila vojaška, čeprav pod vodstvom drugih visokih častnikov. Z njim se je začela tudi vrsta vojaških udarov v Nigeriji. Vsedržavnih volitev v Nigeriji ni bilo do leta 1979.

source.title: 1966 Nigerian coup d'état
paragraphs: On 15 January 1966, soldiers led by Kaduna Nzeogwu and four others carried out a military putsch, killing 22 people, including Prime Minister Abubakar Tafawa Balewa and Northern Premier Ahmadu Bello, many senior politicians, senior Army officers and their wives, and sentinels on protective duty. The coup plotters attacked the cities of Kaduna, Ibadan, and Lagos while blockading the Niger and Benue River within a two-day timespan, before being overcome by loyalist forces.

Although the coup was considered a failure, it still resulted in a change from an elected government to a military government, albeit led by a different set of senior officers. It also marked the start of a series of military coups in Nigeria. There were no national elections in Nigeria until 1979.

1966 Syrian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Siriji leta 1966
paragraphs: V sirskem državnem udaru leta 1966 (21.–23. februarja) so vlado Sirske arabske republike strmoglavili in zamenjali. Vladajoče narodno poveljstvo Arabske socialistične stranke Baath je z oblasti odstranila zveza strankinega vojaškega odbora in sirske regionalne veje pod vodstvom Salaha Džadida.

Udar je sprožil zaostreni boj za oblast med staro gardo stranke, ki so jo zastopali Michel Aflaq, Salah al Din al Bitar in Munif al Razaz, ter radikalnimi levičarskimi frakcijami, privrženkami neobaatističnega stališča. Privrženci stare garde v vojski so 21. februarja ukazali premestitev tekmecev. Dva dni pozneje je vojaški odbor, ki je podpiral radikalne levičarske frakcije, sprožil udar z nasilnimi boji v Alepu, Damasku, Dejr ez Zorju in Latakiji. Zgodovinski ustanovitelji stranke so po udaru pobegnili iz države in preostanek življenja preživeli v izgnanstvu.

source.title: 1966 Syrian coup d'état
paragraphs: In the 1966 Syrian coup d'état (21–23 February) the government of the Syrian Arab Republic was overthrown and replaced. The ruling National Command of the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party were removed from power by a union of the party's Military Committee and the Syrian Regional Branch, under the leadership of Salah Jadid.

The coup was precipitated by a heightening in the power struggle between the party's old guard, represented by Michel Aflaq, Salah al-Din al-Bitar, and Munif al-Razzaz, and the radical leftist factions adhering to a Neo-Ba'athist position. On 21 February, supporters of the old guard in the army ordered the transfer of their rivals. Two days later, the Military Committee, backing the radical leftist factions, launched a coup that involved violent fighting in Aleppo, Damascus, Deir ez-Zor, and Latakia. As a result of the coup, the party's historical founders fled the country and spent the rest of their lives in exile.

Libijska revolucija ali državni udar leta 1969, znan tudi kot revolucija Al Fateh ali revolucija 1. septembra, je bila državni udar in revolucija, ki jo je izvedlo gibanje Svobodnih častnikov, skupina arabskih nacionalističnih in naserističnih častnikov libijske vojske; strmoglavilo je senusijsko monarhijo kralja Idrisa I. in pripeljalo do nastanka Libijske arabske republike. Gibanje Svobodnih častnikov je vodil polkovnik Moamer Gadafi.

source.title: 1969 Libyan revolution
paragraphs: The 1969 Libyan revolution or coup d'état, also known as al-Fateh Revolution or 1 September Revolution, was a coup d'état and revolution carried out by the Free Officers movement, a group of Arab nationalist and Nasserist officers in the Libyan Army, which overthrew the Senussi monarchy of King Idris I and resulted in the formation of the Libyan Arab Republic. The Free Officers movement was led by Colonel Muammar Gaddafi.

1970 Syrian coup d'etat.headline: Državni udar v Siriji leta 1970
paragraphs: Sirski državni udar leta 1970, imenovan tudi popravna revolucija (arabsko: Thawrat al-Tashih) ali popravno gibanje (al-Ḥarakah at-Taṣḥīḥīyya), je bil nekrvav vojaški državni udar, ki ga je 13. novembra 1970 v Siriji vodil general Hafez al Asad. Asad je obljubil, da bo ohranil in izboljšal »nacionalno socialistično linijo« države in stranke Baath. Stranka je ideološko revidirala svoja stališča in se odrekla nauku Salaha Džadida o izvažanju revolucij. Nova doktrina je poudarjala poraz Izraela z razvojem sirske vojske ob podpori Sovjetske zveze.
Asad je baatistični Siriji vladal do smrti leta 2000, nasledil pa ga je sin Bašar al Asad, ki je vladal do propada svojega režima decembra 2024.

source.title: 1970 Syrian coup d'etat
paragraphs: The 1970 Syrian coup d'etat, also called the Corrective Revolution (Arabic: ثورة التصحيح, romanized: Thawrat al-Tashih) or the Corrective Movement (Arabic: الحركة التصحيحية, romanized: al-Ḥarakah at-Taṣḥīḥīyya), was a bloodless military coup d'état led by General Hafez al-Assad on 13 November 1970 in Syria. Assad promised to sustain and improve the "nationalist socialist line" of the state and the Ba'ath Party. The Ba'ath party adopted an ideological revision, absolving itself of Salah Jadid's doctrine of exporting revolutions. The new doctrine placed emphasis on defeating Israel, by developing the Syrian military with the support of the Soviet Union.
Assad would rule Ba'athist Syria until his death in 2000, after which he was succeeded by his son Bashar al-Assad who in turn ruled until the collapse of his regime in December 2024.

1971 Turkish military memorandum.headline: Turški vojaški memorandum leta 1971
paragraphs: Turški vojaški memorandum leta 1971 (turško: 12 Mart Muhtırası), izdan 12. marca tistega leta, je bil drugi vojaški poseg v Republiki Turčiji, 11 let po udaru leta 1960. Znan je kot »udar z memorandumom«, saj ga je vojska namesto s tanki, kot prej, izvedla z memorandumom. Do njega je prišlo sredi zaostrovanja notranjih spopadov, ki pa jih nazadnje ni kaj dosti zajezil.

source.title: 1971 Turkish military memorandum
paragraphs: The 1971 Turkish military memorandum (Turkish: 12 Mart Muhtırası), issued on 12 March that year, was the second military intervention to take place in the Republic of Turkey, coming 11 years after its 1960 predecessor. It is known as the "coup by memorandum", which the military delivered in lieu of sending out tanks, as it had done previously. The event came amid worsening domestic strife, but ultimately did little to halt this phenomenon.

1971 Ugandan coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Ugandi leta 1971
paragraphs: Vojaški udar je 25. januarja 1971 strmoglavil ugandskega predsednika Miltona Oboteja. Zgodil se je, ko je bil Obote na srečanju voditeljev vlad Skupnosti narodov v Singapurju, izvedel pa ga je Idi Amin, tedanji poveljnik ugandske vojske. Odnosi med Obotejem in njegovim poveljnikom vojske Aminom so se iz različnih razlogov zahrbtno zaostrili. Aminovo zaroto (domnevno pod izraelskim okriljem) je poganjala predvsem skrb, da ohrani oblast nad vojsko in si tako zagotovi osebno preživetje. Po uspelem udaru se je Amin postavil za predsednika in do leta 1979 z odloki vladal obubožani državi. Pogosto ga omenjajo kot enega najbolj krutih diktatorjev sodobne politične zgodovine.

source.title: 1971 Ugandan coup d'état
paragraphs: A military coup d'état overthrew the president of Uganda, Milton Obote, on 25 January 1971. It took place while Obote was attending the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting in Singapore, and was staged by Idi Amin, the commander of the Uganda Army at the time. For various reasons, relations between Obote and Amin—his army commander—had become insidiously strained. Amin's plot (allegedly under Israeli auspices) was primarily driven by a concern to retain power over the military, hence guaranteeing his own personal survival. After the coup's success, Amin installed himself as president; ruling—until 1979—by decree over an impoverished nation. He is often referred to as one of the most brutal dictators in modern political history.

1972 Moroccan coup attempt.headline: Poskus državnega udara v Maroku leta 1972
paragraphs: Poskus državnega udara v Maroku leta 1972 je bil neuspeli poskus atentata na maroškega kralja Hasana II. 16. avgusta 1972. Uporniška frakcija v maroški vojski je skušala sestreliti letalo, s katerim je letel maroški kralj. Poskus sta pripravila general Mohamed Ufkir, kraljev tesni svetovalec, in polkovnik Mohamed Amekran, poveljnik letalskega oporišča Kenitra. Šest lovcev Northrop F-5 je 16. avgusta po Ufkirjevem ukazu prestreglo kraljevi Boeing 727, ko se je vračal iz Francije. Kralj Hasan naj bi zgrabil radijsko postajo in uporniškim pilotom dejal: »Nehajte streljati! Tiran je mrtev!« Uporniški piloti so nasedli in prekinili napad, prepričani, da so nalogo opravili.
Na kraljevem letalu je umrlo osem potnikov, štirideset jih je bilo ranjenih, a je letalo varno pristalo na letališču Rabat-Salé.

source.title: 1972 Moroccan coup attempt
paragraphs: The 1972 Moroccan coup attempt was an unsuccessful attempt to assassinate King Hassan II of Morocco on 16 August 1972. The attempted coup d'état occurred in Morocco when a rebel faction within the Moroccan military attempted to shoot down an aircraft carrying the King of Morocco. The attempt was orchestrated by General Mohamed Oufkir, a close advisor to King Hassan, and Colonel Mohamed Amekrane, commander of the Kenitra Air Base. On the 16th August, 6 Northrop F-5 jets, acting on General Oufkir's orders, intercepted King Hassan's Boeing 727 as it returned from France. Reportedly, King Hassan grabbed the radio and told the rebel pilots, "Stop firing! The tyrant is dead!" Fooled, the rebel pilots broke off their attack, believing that their mission had been accomplished.
Eight passengers on the royal jet were killed and forty injured, but the jet was able to land safely at Rabat–Salé Airport.

1973 Israeli raid in Lebanon.headline: Izraelski napad v Libanonu leta 1973
paragraphs: V noči z 9. na 10. april 1973 so enote za posebne naloge izraelskih obrambnih sil napadle več ciljev Palestinske osvobodilne organizacije (PLO) v Bejrutu in Sidonu v Libanonu. Napad, znan kot operacija Pomlad mladosti, na splošno šteje za del operacije Božja jeza, izraelskega povračila za pokol v Münchnu na poletnih olimpijskih igrah leta 1972.

Izraelski vojaki so na libanonske plaže prispeli z gliserji, spuščenimi z raketnih čolnov na odprtem morju. Agenti Mosada so jih na plažah pričakali z avtomobili, najetimi prejšnji dan, jih odpeljali do ciljev in pozneje nazaj na plaže, od koder so se umaknili.
Med operacijo so bili ubiti trije najvišji voditelji PLO, ki so jih presenetili doma, in drugi člani PLO. Umrlo je tudi več libanonskih varnostnikov in civilnih sosedov ter dva izraelska vojaka.

source.title: 1973 Israeli raid in Lebanon
paragraphs: On the night of April 9 and early morning of April 10, 1973, Israel Defense Forces special forces units attacked several Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) targets in Beirut and Sidon, Lebanon. The attack, known as Operation Spring of Youth, is generally considered to have been part of Operation Wrath of God, Israel's retaliation for the Munich massacre at the 1972 Summer Olympics.

The Israeli troops arrived at the Lebanese beaches on speedboats launched from missile boats offshore. Mossad agents awaited the forces on the beaches with cars rented the previous day, and then drove them to their targets and later back to the beaches for extraction.

During the operation, three of the highest-level PLO leaders, surprised at home, were killed, along with other PLO members. Several Lebanese security people and civilian neighbors were also killed, as were two of the Israeli soldiers.

1974 Cypriot coup d'état.headline: Državni udar na Cipru leta 1974
paragraphs: Ciprska narodna garda je 15. julija 1974 z grško podporo izvedla vojaški državni udar. Zarotniki so odstavili ciprskega predsednika, nadškofa Makariosa III., in na oblast postavili nacionalista Nikosa Sampsona, zagovornika enosisa (združitve z Grčijo). Sampsonov režim so opisovali kot marionetno državo, katere končni cilj je bila priključitev otoka Grčiji; kratkoročno so zarotniki razglasili ustanovitev »Helenske republike Ciper«. Združeni narodi so udar razglasili za nezakonit, takoj pa je sledila turška invazija, ki je pripeljala do nastanka Severnega Cipra na ozemlju Republike Ciper.

source.title: 1974 Cypriot coup d'état
paragraphs: A military coup d'état was executed by the Cypriot National Guard on 15 July 1974 with Greek support. The coup plotters removed the sitting President of Cyprus, Archbishop Makarios III, from office and installed pro-Enosis nationalist Nikos Sampson. The Sampson regime was described as a puppet state, whose ultimate aim was the annexation of the island by Greece; in the short term, the coupists proclaimed the establishment of the "Hellenic Republic of Cyprus". The coup was viewed as illegal by the United Nations and led immediately to the Turkish invasion and formation of Northern Cyprus as part of the Republic of Cyprus.

1975 Algiers Agreement.headline: Alžirski sporazum leta 1975
paragraphs: Alžirski sporazum leta 1975, znan tudi kot alžirski sporazumi ali alžirska deklaracija, sta podpisala Iran in Irak, da bi rešila vse odprte ozemeljske spore ob iransko-iraški meji. Posredovala je Alžirija, sporazum pa je bil podlaga za nadaljnji dvostranski pogodbi, podpisani 13. junija 1975 in 26. decembra 1975. Ozemeljski spori so zadevali iraški Šat al Arab in iransko provinco Huzestan; Irak se je hotel pogajati, da bi končal iransko podporo tedanjemu kurdskemu uporu v Iraku, potem ko je bil v spopadu za Šat al Arab v letih 1974–1975 vojaško poražen. Iraška vlada je pogodbo 17. septembra 1980, kmalu po iranski revoluciji, zaradi nove vrste obmejnih spopadov med državama razveljavila. Z iraško invazijo na Iran 22. septembra 1980, ki je sprožila osemletno iransko-iraško vojno, je pogodba povsem prenehala veljati.

source.title: 1975 Algiers Agreement
paragraphs: The 1975 Algiers Agreement, also known as the Algiers Accords and the Algiers Declaration, was signed between Iran and Iraq to settle any outstanding territorial disputes along the Iran–Iraq border. Mediated by Algeria, it served as the basis for additional bilateral treaties signed on 13 June 1975 and 26 December 1975. The territorial disputes in question concerned Iraq's Shatt al-Arab and Iran's Khuzestan Province, and Iraq had wished to negotiate to end Iran's support for the then-ongoing Iraqi Kurdish rebellion after suffering a military defeat in the 1974–1975 Shatt al-Arab conflict. On 17 September 1980, shortly after the Iranian Revolution, the Iraqi government abrogated the treaty in light of another series of cross-border clashes between the two countries. On 22 September 1980, the treaty was completely voided with the Iraqi invasion of Iran, which triggered the eight-year-long Iran–Iraq War.

Južnolibanonski konflikt leta 1978, znan tudi kot prva izraelska invazija na Libanon, z izraelskim kodnim imenom operacija Litani, se je začel, ko je Izrael marca 1978 vdrl v južni Libanon do reke Litani. To je bil odgovor na pokol na obalni cesti pri Tel Avivu, ki so ga zagrešili palestinski borci s sedežem v Libanonu. V spopadu je umrlo od 1100 do 2000 Libanoncev in Palestincev ter 20 Izraelcev, od 100.000 do 250.000 ljudi pa je bilo v Libanonu notranje razseljenih. Izraelske obrambne sile so vojaško zmagale nad Palestinsko osvobodilno organizacijo (PLO), ki se je morala umakniti iz južnega Libanona, kar ji je onemogočilo napade na Izrael čez kopensko mejo z Libanonom. Varnostni svet Združenih narodov je po izbruhu sovražnosti 19. marca 1978 sprejel resoluciji 425 in 426, ki sta Izrael pozvali k takojšnjemu umiku čet iz Libanona in ustanovili začasne sile Združenih narodov v Libanonu (UNIFIL).
Izrael je leta 1982 drugič vdrl v Libanon.

source.title: 1978 South Lebanon conflict
paragraphs: The 1978 South Lebanon conflict, also known as the First Israeli invasion of Lebanon and codenamed Operation Litani by Israel, began when Israel invaded southern Lebanon up to the Litani River in March 1978. It was in response to the Coastal Road massacre near Tel Aviv by Palestinian militants based in Lebanon. The conflict resulted in the deaths of 1,100–2,000 Lebanese and Palestinians, 20 Israelis, and the internal displacement of 100,000 to 250,000 people in Lebanon. The Israel Defense Forces gained a military victory against the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) as the latter was forced to withdraw from southern Lebanon, preventing it from launching attacks on Israel from across its land border with Lebanon. In response to the outbreak of hostilities, the United Nations Security Council adopted Resolution 425 and Resolution 426 on 19 March 1978, which called on Israel to immediately withdraw its troops from Lebanon and established the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL).
Israel launched a second invasion of Lebanon in 1982.

1980 Turkish coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Turčiji leta 1980
paragraphs: Državni udar v Turčiji leta 1980 (turško: 12 Eylül darbesi, dobesedno »udar 12. septembra«), ki ga je vodil načelnik generalštaba general Kenan Evren, je bil tretji državni udar v zgodovini Republike Turčije; pred njim sta bila udar leta 1960 in udar z memorandumom leta 1971.

V času hladne vojne je Turčija doživela politično nasilje (1976–1980) med skrajno levico, skrajno desnico (Sivi volkovi), islamističnimi borbenimi skupinami in državo. Po udaru je nasilje za nekaj časa močno upadlo, kar so nekateri pozdravili kot vzpostavitev reda, ki so ga dosegli s hitro usmrtitvijo 50 ljudi in aretacijo 500.000, od katerih jih je na stotine umrlo v zaporu.

source.title: 1980 Turkish coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1980 Turkish coup d'état (Turkish: 12 Eylül darbesi, lit. '12 September coup d'état'), headed by Chief of the General Staff General Kenan Evren, was the third coup d'état in the history of the Republic of Turkey, the previous having been the 1960 coup and the 1971 coup by memorandum.

During the Cold War era, Turkey saw political violence (1976–1980) between the far-left, the far-right (Grey Wolves), the Islamist militant groups, and the state. The violence saw a sharp downturn for a period after the coup, which was welcomed by some for restoring order by quickly executing 50 people and arresting 500,000, of which hundreds would die in prison.

1982 Ethiopian–Somali Border War.headline: Etiopsko-somalska mejna vojna leta 1982
paragraphs: Etiopsko-somalska mejna vojna je potekala od junija 1982 do avgusta 1983, ko je Etiopija začela obsežen vdor v osrednjo Somalijo. Etiopija je ob podpori bojnih letal in oklepnih enot poslala vojsko z 10.000 možmi skupaj s tisoči upornikov Somalske demokratične fronte odrešitve (SSDF).

Operacija je sprva merila na prodor vse do somalske obale in nazadnje na strmoglavljenje Barrejevega režima. Kljub prizadevanjem etiopske enote in gverilci SSDF niso zavzeli ključnih mest Galkajo in Beledvejne, saj je somalska vojska uspešno odbila glavni napad. Spopad pa se je kmalu sprevrgel v vojaški zastoj okoli obmejnih mest Galdogob in Balanbale.

Do konca leta 1982 so etiopske enote vzpostavile vkopane položaje 30 km globoko na somalskem ozemlju. Vdor je nazadnje koristil somalskemu predsedniku Siadu Barreju, katerega režim je doma doživel porast podpore.

source.title: 1982 Ethiopian–Somali Border War
paragraphs: The Ethiopian–Somali Border War took place from June 1982 to August 1983, when Ethiopia launched a large-scale invasion of central Somalia. Backed by warplanes and armored units, Ethiopia deployed a 10,000-man force alongside thousands of Somali Salvation Democratic Front (SSDF) rebels.

The operation initially aimed to advance all the way to the Somali coastline and ultimately overthrow the Barre regime. Despite their efforts, Ethiopian troops and SSDF guerrillas failed to capture the key cities of Galkayo and Beledweyne, as the Somali army successfully repelled the main assault. However, the conflict soon devolved into a military stalemate around the border towns of Galdogob and Balanbale.

By late 1982, Ethiopian troops had established entrenched positions 30 km inside Somali territory. The invasion ultimately played to the advantage of Somali President Siad Barre, whose regime saw a surge in domestic support.

Libanonska vojna leta 1982, imenovana tudi druga izraelska invazija na Libanon, se je začela 6. junija 1982, ko je Izrael vdrl v južni Libanon. Invaziji je sledila vrsta napadov in protinapadov med Palestinsko osvobodilno organizacijo (PLO), ki je delovala v južnem Libanonu, in izraelskimi obrambnimi silami (IDF), ki so zahtevali civilne žrtve na obeh straneh meje. Izraelska vojaška operacija s kodnim imenom Mir za Galilejo se je začela, potem ko so oboroženci Organizacije Abu Nidal poskušali umoriti Šloma Argova, izraelskega veleposlanika v Združenem kraljestvu. Izraelski premier Menahem Begin je za napad okrivil PLO in ga uporabil kot casus belli. Bila je druga izraelska invazija na Libanon, za južnolibanonskim konfliktom leta 1978.

source.title: 1982 Lebanon War
paragraphs: The 1982 Lebanon War, also called the Second Israeli invasion of Lebanon, began on 6 June 1982, when Israel invaded southern Lebanon. The invasion followed a series of attacks and counter-attacks between the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) operating in southern Lebanon and the Israel Defense Forces (IDF), which had caused civilian casualties on both sides of the border. The Israeli military operation, codenamed Operation Peace for Galilee, was launched after gunmen from the Abu Nidal Organization attempted to assassinate Shlomo Argov, Israel's ambassador to the United Kingdom. Israeli prime minister Menachem Begin blamed the PLO, using the incident as a casus belli. It was the second invasion of Lebanon by Israel, following the 1978 South Lebanon conflict.

Iraške vstaje leta 1991 so bile etnične in verske vstaje proti baatističnemu režimu Sadama Huseina, ki so jih vodili predvsem šiitski uporniki in Kurdi. Trajale so od marca do aprila 1991, po premirju ob koncu zalivske vojne. Večinoma neusklajeni upor je spodbujal vtis, da je iraški predsednik Sadam Husein postal ranljiv in da je zamenjava režima mogoča. Ta vtis šibkosti je bil v veliki meri posledica izida iransko-iraške in zalivske vojne, ki sta se zvrstili v enem samem desetletju in opustošili prebivalstvo in gospodarstvo Iraka.

source.title: 1991 Iraqi uprisings
paragraphs: The 1991 Iraqi uprisings were ethnic and religious uprisings against Saddam Hussein's Ba'athist regime that were mainly led by Shia rebels and Kurds. The uprisings lasted from March to April 1991 after a ceasefire following the end of the Gulf War. The mostly uncoordinated insurgency was fueled by the perception that Iraqi President Saddam Hussein had become vulnerable to regime change. This perception of weakness was largely the result of the outcome of the Iran–Iraq War and the Gulf War, both of which occurred within a single decade and devastated the population and economy of Iraq.

Invazija na Irak leta 2003 je bila prva faza iraške vojne. Začela se je 20. marca 2003 in trajala nekaj več kot mesec dni, od tega 26 dni velikih bojnih operacij. Izvedla jo je koalicija pod vodstvom Združenih držav, ki so jo sestavljali predvsem ameriški, britanski, avstralski in poljski vojaki.

Po besedah ameriškega predsednika Georgea W. Busha in britanskega premiera Tonyja Blaira je koalicija hotela Irak razorožiti orožja za množično uničevanje – jedrskega, kemičnega in biološkega – in »osvoboditi iraško ljudstvo« z odstavitvijo predsednika Sadama Huseina ter s tem končati njegovo »podporo terorizmu«. Inšpektorji Združenih narodov (OZN) pred invazijo v Iraku niso našli nobenih dokazov o iraškem orožju za množično uničevanje; ameriški in britanski uradniki so trdili, da je še vedno skrito in da neposredno ogroža svetovni mir.

source.title: 2003 invasion of Iraq
paragraphs: The 2003 invasion of Iraq was the first stage of the Iraq War. The invasion began on 20 March 2003 and lasted just over one month, including 26 days of major combat operations. The invasion was conducted by a United States–led coalition of mainly American, British, Australian, and Polish troops.

According to US president George W. Bush and UK prime minister Tony Blair, the coalition aimed to disarm Iraq of weapons of mass destruction (WMDs)—nuclear, chemical, and biological weapons—and "free the Iraqi people" by deposing president Saddam Hussein, in turn ending his "support for terrorism". Before the invasion, United Nations (UN) inspectors in Iraq had found no evidence of Iraqi WMDs; US and British officials claimed they were still hidden, and posed an immediate threat to world peace.

Libanonska vojna leta 2006 je bila 34-dnevni oboroženi spopad v Libanonu med Hezbolahom in Izraelom. Začela se je 12. julija 2006 in trajala, dokler ni zjutraj 14. avgusta 2006 začelo veljati premirje, ki so ga posredovali Združeni narodi; formalno se je končala 8. septembra 2006, ko je Izrael odpravil pomorsko blokado Libanona. Bila je tretja izraelska invazija na Libanon po letu 1978.

source.title: 2006 Lebanon War
paragraphs: The 2006 Lebanon War was a 34-day armed conflict in Lebanon, fought between Hezbollah and Israel. The war started on 12 July 2006 and continued until a United Nations-brokered ceasefire went into effect in the morning on 14 August 2006, though it formally ended on 8 September 2006 when Israel lifted its naval blockade of Lebanon. It marked the third Israeli invasion into Lebanon since 1978.

2008 Guinean coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Gvineji leta 2008
paragraphs: V Gvineji je 23. decembra 2008, kmalu po smrti dolgoletnega predsednika Lansane Contéja, prišlo do državnega udara. Hunta z imenom Narodni svet za demokracijo in razvoj (francosko: Conseil National de la Démocratie et du Development, CNDD) pod vodstvom stotnika Moussaja Dadisa Camare je prevzela oblast in napovedala, da bo državi vladala dve leti, nato pa bodo nove predsedniške volitve. Camara je res odstopil, ko je bil na volitvah leta 2010 izvoljen Alpha Condé.

source.title: 2008 Guinean coup d'état
paragraphs: On 23 December 2008, a coup d'état occurred in Guinea, shortly after the death of long-time president Lansana Conté. A junta called the National Council for Democracy and Development (French: Conseil National de la Démocratie et du Development, CNDD), headed by Captain Moussa Dadis Camara, seized power and announced that it planned to rule the country for two years prior to a new presidential election. Camara did indeed step down after Alpha Condé was elected in the 2010 election.

2008 Mauritanian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Mavretaniji leta 2008
paragraphs: Državni udar v Mavretaniji leta 2008 je bil vojaški udar, ki se je zgodil 6. avgusta 2008, ko so mavretanske oborožene sile pod vodstvom skupine visokih generalov, ki jih je predsednik Sidi Ould Cheikh Abdallahi tistega dne razrešil, predsednika odstavile z oblasti.

source.title: 2008 Mauritanian coup d'état
paragraphs: The 2008 Mauritanian coup d'état was a military coup that took place in Mauritania on August 6, 2008, when President Sidi Ould Cheikh Abdallahi was ousted from power by the Armed Forces of Mauritania, led by a group of high-ranking generals he had dismissed from office earlier that day.

2010 Nigerien coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Nigru leta 2010
paragraphs: V Nigru je 18. februarja 2010 prišlo do državnega udara. Vojaki so opoldne ob streljanju napadli predsedniško palačo v Niameyju in zajeli predsednika Mamaduja Tandjo, ki je tedaj vodil sejo vlade. Pozneje tistega dne so uporniki na televiziji razglasili ustanovitev Vrhovnega sveta za obnovo demokracije (CSRD), ki ga je vodil chef d'escadron Salou Djibo.

source.title: 2010 Nigerien coup d'état
paragraphs: A coup d'état occurred in Niger on 18 February 2010. Soldiers attacked the presidential palace in Niamey under weapons fire at midday and captured President Mamadou Tandja, who was chairing a government meeting at the time. Later in the day, the rebels announced on television the formation of the Supreme Council for the Restoration of Democracy (CSRD), headed by chef d'escadron Salou Djibo.

2010–2011 Ivorian crisis.headline: Kriza v Slonokoščeni obali 2010–2011
paragraphs: Kriza v Slonokoščeni obali 2010–2011 je bila politična kriza, ki se je začela, potem ko so Laurenta Gbagboja, predsednika Slonokoščene obale od leta 2000, razglasili za zmagovalca volitev leta 2010, prvih volitev v državi po 10 letih. Opozicijski kandidat Alassane Ouattara ter več držav, organizacij in voditeljev po svetu so trdili, da je volitve dobil Ouattara. Po mesecih poskusov pogajanj in občasnega nasilja je kriza vstopila v odločilno fazo, ko so Ouattarove sile začele vojaško ofenzivo, v kateri so hitro prevzele nadzor nad večino države in obkolile ključne cilje v Abidžanu, največjem mestu države. Mednarodne organizacije so tedaj poročale o številnih kršitvah človekovih pravic, ZN pa so začeli lastno vojaško akcijo z navedenim ciljem, da zaščitijo sebe in civiliste.
Pomemben korak h koncu krize je bil 11. aprila 2011, ko so Ouattaru naklonjene sile ob podpori francoskih sil v Abidžanu zajele in aretirale Gbagboja.

source.title: 2010–2011 Ivorian crisis
paragraphs: The 2010–11 Ivorian crisis was a political crisis in Ivory Coast which began after Laurent Gbagbo, the President of Ivory Coast since 2000, was proclaimed the winner of the Ivorian election of 2010, the first election in the country in 10 years. The opposition candidate, Alassane Ouattara, and a number of countries, organisations and leaders worldwide claimed Ouattara had won the election. After months of attempted negotiation and sporadic violence, the crisis entered a decisive stage as Ouattara's forces began a military offensive in which they quickly gained control of most of the country and besieged key targets in Abidjan, the country's largest city. At the time, international organizations reported numerous human rights violations, and the UN undertook its own military action with the stated objective to protect itself and civilians.
A significant step in bringing an end to the crisis occurred on 11 April 2011 upon the capture and arrest of Gbagbo in Abidjan by pro-Ouattara forces backed by French forces.

2011 Bahraini uprising.headline: Vstaja v Bahrajnu leta 2011
paragraphs: Bahrajnska vstaja leta 2011 je bila vrsta protivladnih protestov v Bahrajnu, ki jih je od leta 2011 do 2014 vodila večinoma šiitska bahrajnska opozicija z nekaj pripadniki sunitske manjšine. Proteste so navdihnili nemiri arabske pomladi leta 2011 ter protesti v Tuniziji in Egiptu, v vsakodnevne spopade pa so prerasli, ko je bahrajnska vlada upor zatrla s pomočjo sil Ščit polotoka Sveta za sodelovanje v Zalivu. Bahrajnski protesti so bili vrsta demonstracij, ki so prerasle v dolgotrajno kampanjo nenasilne državljanske nepokorščine in deloma nasilnega odpora v državi ob Perzijskem zalivu. Kot del revolucionarnega vala protestov na Bližnjem vzhodu in v severni Afriki, ki je sledil samosežigu Mohameda Buazizija v Tuniziji, so bili sprva namenjeni večji politični svobodi in enakopravnosti za šiitsko prebivalstvo, ki obsega 70 % prebivalcev.

source.title: 2011 Bahraini uprising
paragraphs: The 2011 Bahraini uprising was a series of anti-government protests in Bahrain led by the Shia-dominant and some Sunni minority Bahraini opposition from 2011 until 2014. The protests were inspired by the unrest of the 2011 Arab Spring and protests in Tunisia and Egypt and escalated to daily clashes after the Bahraini government repressed the revolt with the support of the Gulf Cooperation Council's Peninsula Shield Force. The Bahraini protests were a series of demonstrations, amounting to a sustained campaign of non-violent civil disobedience and some violent resistance in the Persian Gulf country of Bahrain. As part of the revolutionary wave of protests in the Middle East and North Africa following the self-immolation of Mohamed Bouazizi in Tunisia, the Bahraini protests were initially aimed at achieving greater political freedom and equality for the 70% Shia population.

2011 southern Israel cross-border attack.headline: Napadi na jugu Izraela leta 2011
paragraphs: Skupina domnevno dvanajstih borcev v štirih skupinah je 18. avgusta 2011 na jugu Izraela, na cesti 12 blizu egiptovske meje, izvedla vrsto čezmejnih napadov, ki so potekali vzporedno in so se medsebojno krili. Napadi so se zgodili, potem ko je izraelska notranja varnostna služba Šin Bet opozorila na napad borcev v pokrajini in so na območje napotili izraelske vojake. Borci so najprej streljali na avtobus družbe Egged številka 392, ki je vozil po cesti 12 v Negevu blizu Ejlata. Nekaj minut pozneje je ob izraelski vojaški patrulji na meji z Egiptom eksplodirala bomba. V tretjem napadu je protitankovski izstrelek zadel zasebno vozilo in ubil štiri civiliste. V večstopenjskem napadu je umrlo osem Izraelcev – šest civilistov, policijski ostrostrelec posebne enote Jamam in vojak brigade Golani. Izraelske obrambne sile so sporočile, da so ubile osem napadalcev, egiptovske varnostne sile pa še dva.

source.title: 2011 southern Israel cross-border attacks
paragraphs: On August 18, 2011, a series of cross-border attacks with parallel attacks and mutual cover was carried out in southern Israel on Highway 12 near the Egyptian border by a squad of presumably twelve militants in four groups. The attacks occurred after Israel's interior security service Shin Bet had warned of an attack by militants in the region and Israeli troops had been stationed in the area. The militants first opened fire at an Egged No. 392 bus as it was traveling on Highway 12 in the Negev near Eilat. Several minutes later, a bomb was detonated next to an Israeli army patrol along Israel's border with Egypt. In a third attack, an anti-tank missile hit a private vehicle, killing four civilians. Eight Israelis – six civilians, one Yamam special unit police sniper and one Golani Brigade soldier—were killed in the multiple-stage attack. The Israel Defense Forces reported eight attackers killed, and Egyptian security forces reported killing another two.

2012 Guinea-Bissau coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Gvineji Bissau leta 2012
paragraphs: Deli oboroženih sil so 12. aprila 2012 v Gvineji Bissau izvedli državni udar, približno dva tedna pred drugim krogom predsedniških volitev med Carlosom Gomesom Júniorjem in Kumbo Ialá. Udar se je začel zvečer, ko so na ulice prišli vojaki in oprema, nato pa so državne medije izklopili.

source.title: 2012 Guinea-Bissau coup d'état
paragraphs: On 12 April 2012, a coup d'état in Guinea-Bissau was staged by elements of the armed forces about two weeks before the second round of a presidential election between Carlos Gomes Júnior and Kumba Ialá. The coup started in the evening with military personnel and equipment making its way onto the streets, followed by the state-owned media being taken off-air.

2012 Malian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Maliju leta 2012
paragraphs: Državni udar v Maliju leta 2012 se je začel 21. marca, ko so uporni malijski vojaki, nezadovoljni z obvladovanjem tuareškega upora, napadli več krajev v prestolnici Bamako, med njimi predsedniško palačo, državno televizijo in vojašnice. Vojaki, ki so dejali, da so ustanovili Narodni odbor za obnovo demokracije in države, so naslednji dan razglasili, da so strmoglavili vlado Amaduja Toumanija Touréja, ki se je moral skriti. Udaru so sledile »soglasna« mednarodna obsodba, ostre sankcije malijskih sosed in hitra izguba severnega Malija v korist tuareških sil, zato je Reuters udar opisal kot »spektakularen avtogol«. Hunta se je 6. aprila s pogajalci Gospodarske skupnosti zahodnoafriških držav (ECOWAS) dogovorila, da bo v zameno za konec sankcij odstopila z oblasti in jo predala prehodni vladi pod vodstvom predsednika parlamenta Dioncounde Traoréja. V naslednjih dneh sta Touré in vodja udara Amadou Sanogo uradno odstopila, vendar je 16. maja še vedno veljalo, da je hunta »po splošnem prepričanju ohranila splošni nadzor«. V Diagu so 3. decembra 2013 odkrili množično grobišče s posmrtnimi ostanki 21 vojakov, zvestih odstavljenemu predsedniku, ki so izginili leto prej.

source.title: 2012 Malian coup d'état
paragraphs: The 2012 Malian coup d'état began on 21 March that year, when mutinying Malian soldiers, displeased with the management of the Tuareg rebellion, attacked several locations in the capital Bamako, including the presidential palace, state television, and military barracks. The soldiers, who said they had formed the National Committee for the Restoration of Democracy and State, declared the following day that they had overthrown the government of Amadou Toumani Touré, forcing him into hiding. The coup was followed by "unanimous" international condemnation, harsh sanctions by Mali's neighbors, and the swift loss of northern Mali to Tuareg forces, leading Reuters to describe the coup as "a spectacular own-goal". On 6 April, the junta agreed with Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) negotiators that they would step down from power in return for the end of sanctions, giving power to a transitional government led by parliament speaker Dioncounda Traoré. In the following days, both Touré and coup leader Amadou Sanogo formally resigned; however, as of 16 May, the junta was still "widely thought to have maintained overall control". On 3 December 2013, a mass grave was discovered in Diago holding the remains of 21 soldiers that had gone missing the year before, loyal to the ousted president.

2013 Egyptian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Egiptu leta 2013
paragraphs: Takratnega egiptovskega predsednika Mohameda Morsija je 3. julija 2013 strmoglavil državni udar, ki ga je vodil načelnik egiptovske vojske general Abdel Fatah al Sisi; ta je vodil koalicijo, ki je Morsija odstavila in razveljavila egiptovsko ustavo iz leta 2012. Do tega je prišlo po ultimatu, naj vlada med obsežnimi vsedržavnimi protesti »razreši nesoglasja« s protestniki. Morsija in voditelje Muslimanske bratovščine so postavili v hišni pripor, predsednika Vrhovnega ustavnega sodišča Adlija Mansurja pa razglasili za začasnega predsednika Egipta. Razglasitvi so po vsem Egiptu sledile demonstracije in spopadi med podporniki in nasprotniki udara.

source.title: 2013 Egyptian coup d'état
paragraphs: On July 3, 2013, then-President of Egypt Mohamed Morsi was overthrown by a coup d'etat led by Egyptian army chief General Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, who led a coalition to remove Morsi from power and suspend the Egyptian constitution of 2012. The move came after an ultimatum that the government "resolve its differences" with protesters during widespread national protests. Morsi and Muslim Brotherhood leaders, were placed under house arrest and Chief Justice of the Supreme Constitutional Court Adly Mansour was declared interim president of Egypt. The announcement was followed by demonstrations and clashes between supporters and opponents of the move throughout Egypt.

2014 Burkina Faso uprising.headline: Vstaja v Burkini Faso leta 2014
paragraphs: Vstaja v Burkini Faso leta 2014 je bila vrsta demonstracij in nemirov v Burkini Faso oktobra 2014, ki so se hitro razširili v več mest. Začeli so se kot odziv na poskuse spremembe ustave, ki bi predsedniku Blaiseu Compaoréju omogočila, da znova kandidira in podaljša svojih 27 let na oblasti. Pritisk za politične spremembe je prihajal iz civilne družbe, zlasti od mladih. Po burnem dnevu 30. oktobra, ko se je vmešal tudi nekdanji obrambni minister Kouamé Lougué in so zažgali narodno skupščino, druge vladne stavbe ter sedež vladajoče stranke Kongres za demokracijo in napredek, je Compaoré razpustil vlado in razglasil izredne razmere, nazadnje pa ob podpori slonokoščenega predsednika Alassana Ouattare pobegnil v Slonokoščeno obalo.

source.title: 2014 Burkina Faso uprising
paragraphs: The 2014 Burkina Faso uprising was a series of demonstrations and riots in Burkina Faso in October 2014 that quickly spread to multiple cities. They began in response to attempts at changing the constitution to allow President Blaise Compaoré to run again and extend his 27 years in office. Pressure for political change came from civil society and in particular from the country's youth. Following a tumultuous day on 30 October, which included the involvement of former Defence Minister Kouamé Lougué and the burning of the National Assembly and other government buildings as well as the ruling Congress for Democracy and Progress party's headquarters, Compaoré dissolved the government and declared a state of emergency before eventually fleeing to Côte d'Ivoire with the support of Ivorian President Alassane Ouattara.

2015 Burkina Faso coup attempt.headline: Poskus državnega udara v Burkini Faso leta 2015
paragraphs: Poskus državnega udara v Burkini Faso leta 2015 je bil spodleteli udar, ki se je začel 16. septembra 2015, ko so pripadniki polka predsedniške varnosti (RSP) – sporne samostojne vojaške enote, ustanovljene v času predsednika Blaisea Compaoréja – pridržali vlado. Med pridržanimi so bili prehodni predsednik Michel Kafando, predsednik vlade Yacouba Isaac Zida (nekdanji namestnik poveljnika RSP) in številni člani vlade. Prehodna vlada je nastala po vstaji v Burkini Faso leta 2014, ko je ljudsko gibanje strmoglavilo dolgoletnega predsednika Compaoréja, ki je sam prišel na oblast z udarom leta 1987 proti levičarskemu voditelju Thomasu Sankari. Nove splošne volitve so bile načrtovane za 11. oktober 2015.

source.title: 2015 Burkina Faso coup attempt
paragraphs: The 2015 Burkina Faso coup attempt was a failed coup d'état launched on 16 September 2015 in Burkina Faso, when members of the Regiment of Presidential Security (RSP) – a controversial autonomous military unit, formed under President Blaise Compaoré – detained the country's government. Among those detained were the transitional President Michel Kafando, Prime Minister Yacouba Isaac Zida (who was also the former deputy commander of the RSP), and numerous members of the cabinet. This transitional government was formed in the wake of the 2014 Burkinabé uprising, when a popular movement overthrew the long-time president Compaoré, who himself had come to power in a 1987 coup against the left-wing leader Thomas Sankara. New general elections were planned for 11 October 2015.

Zvečer 15. julija 2016 je v Turčiji prišlo do poskusa vojaškega udara, ki ga je pripravila frakcija v turških oboroženih silah z 8500 vojaki in vojaškimi kadeti, ki se je imenovala »Svet za mir doma«. Oborožene enote so skušale prevzeti nadzor nad več ključnimi točkami v Ankari, Istanbulu in Marmarisu, a so jih premagali vojaki, zvesti vladi, in civilni protestniki.

source.title: 2016 Turkish coup d'état attempt
paragraphs: On the evening of 15 July 2016, an attempted military coup occurred in Turkey, orchestrated by a faction within the Turkish Armed Forces of 8,500 soldiers and military cadets, identifying themselves as the "Peace at Home Council". Armed troops attempted to seize control of several key locations in Ankara, Istanbul, and Marmaris but were defeated by a mix of loyalist soldiers and civilian protestors.

2017 Zimbabwean coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Zimbabveju leta 2017
paragraphs: Državni udar v Zimbabveju leta 2017 je bil nekrvav vojaški udar, ki je od 14. do 21. novembra 2017 potekal v Zimbabveju, ko so zimbabvejskega predsednika Roberta Mugabeja odstavili s položaja predsednika države in vodje stranke ZANU–PF ter ga nadomestili z Emmersonom Mnangagwo.

Zvečer 14. novembra 2017 so se deli zimbabvejskih obrambnih sil (ZDF) zbrali okoli prestolnice Harare in prevzeli nadzor nad Zimbabvejsko radiotelevizijo in ključnimi deli mesta. Naslednji dan so ZDF izdale izjavo, da ne gre za državni udar in da je predsednik Mugabe na varnem, razmere pa se bodo normalizirale šele, ko bodo ZDF obračunale s »kriminalci« okoli Mugabeja, odgovornimi za družbenogospodarske težave Zimbabveja. Tedanji južnoafriški predsednik Jacob Zuma je poklical Mugabeja in izvedel, da je v hišnem priporu, sicer pa »v redu«.

source.title: 2017 Zimbabwean coup d'état
paragraphs: The 2017 Zimbabwean coup d'état was a bloodless military coup that took place in Zimbabwe on 14 to 21 November 2017, when Zimbabwean president Robert Mugabe was removed as president and party leader of ZANU–PF and was replaced by Emmerson Mnangagwa.

On the evening of 14 November 2017, elements of the Zimbabwe Defence Forces (ZDF) gathered around Harare, the capital of Zimbabwe, and seized control of the Zimbabwe Broadcasting Corporation and key areas of the city. The next day, the ZDF issued a statement saying that it was not a coup d'état and that President Mugabe was safe, although the situation would return to normal only after the ZDF had dealt with the "criminals" around Mugabe responsible for the socio-economic problems of Zimbabwe. Jacob Zuma, the then president of South Africa, phoned Mugabe and was told that Mugabe was under house arrest but otherwise "fine".

Pripadniki gabonskih oboroženih sil so 7. januarja 2019 razglasili državni udar v Gabonu. Častniki so trdili, da so odstavili predsednika Alija Bonga, ki je bil leta 2016 ponovno izvoljen po spornih volitvah in protestih. Med odsotnostjo Alija Bonga, ki se je zdravil v Maroku, so oboroženi uporniki v prestolnici Libreville zajeli talce in razglasili, da so ustanovili »Narodni svet za obnovo«, ki naj bi »obnovil demokracijo v Gabonu«. Po vsej državi je prišlo do obsežnih izpadov interneta, ni pa znano, ali so ga izklopili uporniki sami ali civilisti. Gabonska vlada je pozneje razglasila, da je znova prevzela nadzor.

source.title: 2019 Gabonese coup attempt
paragraphs: On 7 January 2019, members of the Armed Forces of Gabon announced a coup d'état in Gabon. Military officers claimed that they had ousted President Ali Bongo, who was re-elected in 2016 after a controversial election and protests. During the absence of Ali Bongo, who was receiving medical treatment in Morocco, armed rebels in the capital city Libreville took hostages and declared that they had established a "National Restoration Council" to "restore democracy in Gabon". Widespread internet outages occurred throughout the country, though it is unknown whether the internet was shut down by the rebels themselves or by civilians. Gabon's government later declared that it had reasserted control.

Državni udar je 11. aprila 2019, po mesecih obsežnih ljudskih protestov, ki so zahtevali njegov odhod, strmoglavil predsednika Omarja al Bašira in njegov tri desetletja dolgi avtoritarni režim v Sudanu. Vrhovno poveljstvo sudanskih oboroženih sil pod vodstvom obrambnega ministra generalpodpolkovnika Ahmeda Avada Ibn Aufa je razpustilo narodno zakonodajno skupščino, razveljavilo ustavo in razglasilo trimesečne izredne razmere, nazadnje pa se je s civilnimi silami dogovorilo o delitvi oblasti, ki je pripravila pot prehodni vladi.

source.title: 2019 Sudanese coup d'état
paragraphs: A coup d'état overthrew President Omar al-Bashir and his three-decade authoritarian regime in Sudan on 11 April 2019, after months of widespread popular protests demanding his departure. Led by Defense Minister Lieutenant General Ahmed Awad Ibn Auf, the high command of the Sudanese Armed Forces dissolved the National Legislature, suspended the constitution, and declared a three-month state of emergency, before ultimately agreeing to a power-sharing arrangement with civilian forces that paved the way for a transitional government.

Deli malijskih oboroženih sil so 18. avgusta 2020 začeli upor in nato izvedli državni udar. Vojaki so s poltovornjaki vdrli v vojaško oporišče Soundiata v mestu Kati, kjer je prišlo do streljanja, nato pa so razdelili orožje iz skladišča in aretirali visoke častnike. Na mestnih ulicah so bili tanki in oklepna vozila, vojaški tovornjaki pa so se odpravili proti prestolnici Bamako. Vojaki so pridržali več vladnih uradnikov, med njimi predsednika Ibrahima Boubacarja Keïto, ki je odstopil in razpustil vlado. To je bil drugi udar v državi v manj kot 10 letih, po državnem udaru leta 2012. Na subregionalni ravni je udar končal skoraj šestletno obdobje od vstaje v Burkini Faso leta 2014 in strmoglavljenja predsednika Burkine Faso Blaisea Compaoréja, v katerem v zahodni Afriki ni bilo niti ene nedemokratične menjave oblasti. Za to subregijo, kjer imajo mnoge države za sabo državljanske vojne in nasilne spopade, so bila leta od 2014 do 2020 obdobje izjemne stabilnosti, v katerem je ECOWAS mirno razrešil gambijsko ustavno krizo 2016–2017.

source.title: 2020 Malian coup d'état
paragraphs: On 18 August 2020, elements of the Malian Armed Forces began a mutiny, and subsequently undertook a coup d'état. Soldiers on pick-up trucks stormed the Soundiata military base in the town of Kati, where gunfire was exchanged before weapons were distributed from the armory and senior officers arrested. Tanks and armoured vehicles were seen on the town's streets, as well as military trucks heading for the capital, Bamako. The soldiers detained several government officials including President Ibrahim Boubacar Keïta, who resigned and dissolved the government. This was the country's second coup in less than 10 years, following the 2012 coup d'état. On a subregional level, the coup also marked an end to a period of nearly six years, since the 2014 Burkina Faso uprising and the ousting of Burkina Faso's president Blaise Compaoré, during which there was not a single undemocratic change of government in West Africa. For this subregion, where many countries have a history of civil war and violent conflict, 2014 to 2020 was a period of remarkable stability, during which ECOWAS found a peaceful resolution to the 2016–2017 Gambian constitutional crisis.

2021 Armenian political crisis.headline: Armenska politična kriza leta 2021
paragraphs: Armenska politična kriza leta 2021 je bila domnevni poskus vojaškega udara armenskih oboroženih sil pod vodstvom načelnika generalštaba Onika Gasparjana proti vladi armenskega predsednika vlade Nikola Pašinjana. Pašinjan je Gasparjana in 40 drugih visokih častnikov obtožil poskusa udara, potem ko so 25. februarja 2021 objavili izjavo, v kateri so zahtevali njegov odstop.

source.title: 2021 Armenian political crisis
paragraphs: The 2021 Armenian political crisis was an alleged military coup attempt by the Armed Forces of Armenia led by the Chief of the General Staff of the Armenian Armed Forces Onik Gasparyan against the government of Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan. Pashinyan accused Gasparyan and 40 other high-ranking military officers of attempting a coup after they published a statement calling for Pashinyan's resignation on 25 February 2021.

2021 Guinean coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Gvineji leta 2021
paragraphs: Gvinejske oborožene sile so 5. septembra 2021 po streljanju v prestolnici Konakri v državnem udaru zajele gvinejskega predsednika Alpho Condéja. Poveljnik specialnih enot Mamady Doumbouya je na državni televiziji objavil razpustitev ustave in vlade.

source.title: 2021 Guinean coup d'état
paragraphs: On 5 September 2021, President of Guinea Alpha Condé was captured by the country's armed forces in a coup d'état after gunfire in the capital, Conakry. Special forces commander Mamady Doumbouya released a broadcast on state television announcing the dissolution of the constitution and government.

2021 Malian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Maliju leta 2021
paragraphs: V noči na 24. maj 2021 je malijska vojska pod vodstvom podpredsednika Assimija Goïte zajela predsednika Baha N'dawa, predsednika vlade Moctarja Ouana in obrambnega ministra Souleymana Doucouréja. Assimi Goïta, vodja hunte, ki je izvedla državni udar v Maliju leta 2020, je razglasil, da sta N'daw in Ouane izgubila pooblastila in da bodo leta 2022 nove volitve. To je bil tretji državni udar v državi v desetih letih, po vojaških prevzemih oblasti v letih 2012 in 2020; zadnji se je zgodil le devet mesecev prej.

source.title: 2021 Malian coup d'état
paragraphs: On the night of 24 May 2021, the Malian Army led by Vice President Assimi Goïta captured President Bah N'daw, Prime Minister Moctar Ouane and Minister of Defence Souleymane Doucouré. Assimi Goïta, the head of the junta that led the 2020 Malian coup d'état, announced that N'daw and Ouane were stripped of their powers and that new elections would be held in 2022. It is the country's third coup d'état in ten years, following the 2012 and 2020 military takeovers, with the latter having happened only nine months earlier.

2021 Nigerien coup attempt.headline: Poskus državnega udara v Nigru leta 2021
paragraphs: Poskus državnega udara v Nigru leta 2021 se je zgodil 31. marca okoli 3. ure po zahodnoafriškem času (2. ure UTC), ko je na ulicah nigrske prestolnice Niamey izbruhnilo streljanje, dva dni pred umestitvijo novoizvoljenega predsednika Mohameda Bazouma.

Poskus udara so izvedli deli vojske, pripisali pa so ga enoti vojnega letalstva z oporiščem na območju letališča v Niameyju. Domnevni vodja zarote je bil stotnik Sani Saley Gourouza, ki je skrbel za varnost v oporišču enote. Ko so poskus udara preprečili, so storilce aretirali.

source.title: 2021 Nigerien coup attempt
paragraphs: The 2021 Nigerien coup d'etat attempt occurred on 31 March at around 3 am WAT (2 am UTC) after gunfire erupted in the streets of Niamey, the capital of Niger, two days before the inauguration of president-elect Mohamed Bazoum.

The coup attempt was staged by elements within the military, and was attributed to an Air Force unit based in the area of the Niamey Airport. The alleged leader of the plot was Captain Sani Saley Gourouza, who was in charge of security at the unit's base. After the coup attempt was foiled, the perpetrators were arrested.

2021 Sudanese coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Sudanu leta 2021
paragraphs: Sudanska vojska pod vodstvom generala Abdela Fataha al Burhana je 25. oktobra 2021 z vojaškim udarom prevzela nadzor nad sudansko vlado. Sprva so pridržali najmanj pet visokih vladnih osebnosti. Civilni predsednik vlade Abdala Hamdok udara ni hotel podpreti in je 25. oktobra pozval k ljudskemu odporu; 26. oktobra so ga postavili v hišni pripor. Poročali so o izpadih interneta. Pozneje istega dne so razpustili Suvereni svet, razglasili izredne razmere ter aretirali večino Hamdokove vlade in več vladnih podpornikov. Do 5. novembra 2021 so bili na seznamu pridržanih »vladni ministri, člani političnih strank, odvetniki, aktivisti civilne družbe, novinarji, zagovorniki človekovih pravic in voditelji protestov«, ki so jih zadrževali na skrivnih krajih brez dostopa do družin ali odvetnikov.

source.title: 2021 Sudanese coup d'état
paragraphs: On 25 October 2021, the Sudanese military, led by General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, took control of the Government of Sudan in a military coup. At least five senior government figures were initially detained. Civilian Prime Minister Abdalla Hamdok refused to declare support for the coup and on 25 October called for popular resistance; he was confined to house arrest on 26 October. Internet outages were reported. Later the same day, the Sovereignty Council was dissolved, a state of emergency was put in place, and a majority of the Hamdok Cabinet and a number of pro-government supporters were arrested. As of 5 November 2021, the list of those detained included "government ministers, members of political parties, lawyers, civil society activists, journalists, human rights defenders, and protest leaders", who were held in secret locations, without access to their families or lawyers.

2022 Guinea-Bissau coup attempt.headline: Poskus državnega udara v Gvineji Bissau leta 2022
paragraphs: V Gvineji Bissau so 1. februarja 2022 poskusili izvesti državni udar. Nekaj ur pozneje je predsednik Umaro Sissoco Embaló razglasil, da je udar končan, in dejal, da je bilo v »spodletelem napadu na demokracijo« ubitih »veliko« pripadnikov varnostnih sil.

Predsednik Umaro Sissoco Embaló je tiskovni agenciji AFP po telefonu povedal, da je »vse v redu«, in dodal, da so razmere »pod nadzorom«. Dejal je, da je bil spodleteli poskus udara morda povezan s trgovino z mamili in da je šlo tudi za poskus atentata: »To ni bil le udar. Bil je poskus umora predsednika, predsednika vlade in vse vlade.« Izjavil je tudi, da vojska v spodletelem udaru ni sodelovala.

source.title: 2022 Guinea-Bissau coup attempt
paragraphs: A coup d'état was attempted in Guinea-Bissau on 1 February 2022. A few hours later, president Umaro Sissoco Embaló declared the coup over, he said that "many" members of the security forces had been killed in a "failed attack against democracy".

The president Umaro Sissoco Embaló told the AFP news agency in a telephone call that "All is well", and added that the situation is "under control". He said that the failed coup attempt may have been linked to drug trade and was also an assassination attempt, "It wasn't just a coup. It was an attempt to kill the president, the prime minister and all the cabinet." He also stated that the army was not involved in the failed coup.

V Gabonu je 30. avgusta 2023 prišlo do državnega udara, kmalu po razglasitvi, da je dosedanji predsednik Ali Bongo zmagal na splošnih volitvah 26. avgusta. Bil je osmi uspešni udar v zahodni in osrednji Afriki od leta 2020.

Vodja udara Brice Oligui Nguema je član družine Bongo in je strmoglavil svojega bratranca Alija Bonga. Udar je končal 56 let dolgo vladavino očeta in sina, Omarja in Alija Bonga, nad Gabonom. Nekateri so ga opisali kot dvorni udar.

source.title: 2023 Gabonese coup d'état
paragraphs: On 30 August 2023, a coup d'état occurred in Gabon shortly after the announcement that incumbent president Ali Bongo had won the general election held on 26 August. It was the eighth successful coup to occur in West and Central Africa since 2020.

The coup's leader Brice Oligui Nguema is part of the Bongo family and overthrew his cousin Ali Bongo. The coup brought an end to the 56-year-long rule of the father-and-son duo Omar and Ali Bongo over Gabon. It has been described by some as a palace coup.

V Nigru je 26. julija 2023 prišlo do državnega udara, ko je predsedniška garda pridržala predsednika Mohameda Bazouma, poveljnik predsedniške garde general Abdourahamane Tiani pa se je kmalu po potrditvi uspeha udara razglasil za vodjo vojaške hunte.

To je bil peti vojaški udar, odkar je država leta 1960 dobila neodvisnost od Francije, in prvi po letu 2010. Udar so obsodile ZDA in Francija ter zahodnoafriški regionalni blok ECOWAS, ki je hunti zagrozil z vojaškim posredovanjem, kar je pripeljalo do nigrske krize 2023–2024.

source.title: 2023 Nigerien coup d'état
paragraphs: On 26 July 2023, a coup d'état occurred in Niger when the presidential guard detained President Mohamed Bazoum, and presidential guard commander General Abdourahamane Tiani proclaimed himself the leader of a military junta shortly after confirming the coup a success.

This was the fifth military coup d'état since the country gained independence from France in 1960, and the first since 2010. The coup was condemned by the United States and France, and by the West African regional bloc ECOWAS, the latter of which threatened military intervention against the junta, leading to the 2023–2024 Niger crisis.

2024 Democratic Republic of the Congo co.headline: Poskus državnega udara v DR Kongo leta 2024
paragraphs: V Demokratični republiki Kongo so 19. maja 2024 poskusili izvesti državni udar.

Napadalci so imeli za tarči predsednika Félixa Tshisekedija in njegovega ministra za gospodarstvo Vitala Kamerheja, napadli pa so Palais de la Nation in Kamerhejevo rezidenco. Bili so težko oboroženi in so se pri Kamerhejevem domu silovito bojevali. Najmanj ena granata iz bojev je eksplodirala v bližnji prestolnici Republike Kongo Brazzavillu in ranila več ljudi.

source.title: 2024 Democratic Republic of the Congo coup attempt
paragraphs: On 19 May 2024, an attempted coup d'état took place in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
