Targeting President Félix Tshisekedi and his Economy Minister Vital Kamerhe, the assailants attacked both the Palais de la Nation and Kamerhe's residence. They were heavily armed and put up an intense fight at the Kamerhe home. At least one shell from the fighting detonated in the nearby capital of the Republic of the Congo, Brazzaville, causing several injuries.

Med Izraelom in Hezbolahom je med bližnjevzhodno krizo leta 2024 v Libanonu potekala vojna. Začela se je septembra 2024, po skoraj 12 mesecih spopadov med njima, ko je Izrael začel velike napade v Libanonu, med drugim napad na pozivnike in elektronske naprave, umor voditelja Hezbolaha Hasana Nasralaha in letalsko bombardiranje po vsej državi. Vojna se je zaostrila 1. oktobra, ko je Izrael prestopil modro črto in šestič po letu 1978 vdrl v Libanon. Izrael in Libanon sta 26. novembra podpisala sporazum o premirju, ki sta ga posredovali Francija in Združene države. Premirje je začelo veljati 27. novembra, čeprav so se nekateri napadi v okviru širšega spopada nadaljevali.

source.title: 2024 Lebanon war
paragraphs: A war between Israel and Hezbollah took place in Lebanon during 2024 amid the Middle Eastern crisis. The war began in September 2024 following nearly 12 months of conflict between Israel and Hezbollah, when the former initiated major attacks in Lebanon including an attack on pagers and electronic devices, the assassination of Hezbollah leader Hassan Nasrallah, and an aerial bombing campaign throughout the country. The war escalated on 1 October, when Israel crossed the Blue Line in its sixth invasion of Lebanon since 1978. On 26 November, Israel and Lebanon signed a ceasefire agreement, mediated by France and the United States. The ceasefire went into effect on 27 November, though some attacks continued as part of the broader conflict.

31 March incident.headline: Incident 31. marca
paragraphs: Incident 31. marca (turško: 31 Mart Vakası) je bil upor v Osmanskem cesarstvu aprila 1909, v drugem ustavnem obdobju. Izbruhnil je v noči s 30. na 31. mart 1325 po rumijskem koledarju (12.–13. aprila 1909 po gregorijanskem koledarju), zato se imenuje po 31. marcu, saj marcu ustreza rumijski mesec mart. Zgodil se je kmalu po mladoturški revoluciji leta 1908, v kateri je Odbor za enotnost in napredek (CUP) uspešno obnovil ustavo in končal absolutno vladavino sultana Abdulhamida II. (vladal 1876–1909), zato ga včasih imenujejo poskus protiudara ali kontrarevolucije. Šlo je za splošen upor proti CUP v Carigradu, ki so ga večinoma vodile reakcionarne skupine, zlasti islamisti, ki so nasprotovali posvetnemu vplivu CUP, in privrženci absolutizma, manjšo vlogo pa so imeli tudi liberalni nasprotniki CUP v Stranki svobode. Enajst dni pozneje so upor zatrli in obnovili prejšnjo vlado, ko so deli osmanske vojske, naklonjeni CUP, oblikovali priložnostno vojaško silo, znano kot Vojska akcije (Hareket Ordusu). Ko je ta 24. aprila vkorakala v Carigrad, so sultana Abdulhamida II., ki ga je CUP obtožil sokrivde za upor, odstavili, osmanska narodna skupščina pa je na prestol postavila njegovega polbrata Mehmeda V. Mahmud Ševket paša, general, ki je organiziral in vodil Vojsko akcije, je postal najvplivnejša osebnost obnovljenega ustavnega sistema vse do atentata nanj leta 1913.

source.title: 31 March incident
paragraphs: The 31 March incident (Turkish: 31 Mart Vakası) was an uprising in the Ottoman Empire in April 1909, during the Second Constitutional Era. The incident broke out during the night of 30–31 Mart 1325 in Rumi calendar (GC 12–13 April 1909), thus named after 31 March where March is the equivalent to Rumi month Mart. Occurring soon after the 1908 Young Turk Revolution, in which the Committee of Union and Progress (CUP) had successfully restored the Constitution and ended the absolute rule of Sultan Abdul Hamid II (r. 1876–1909), it is sometimes referred to as an attempted countercoup or counterrevolution. It consisted of a general uprising against the CUP within Constantinople, largely led by reactionary groups, particularly Islamists opposed to the secularising influence of the CUP and supporters of absolutism, although liberal opponents of the CUP within the Liberty Party also played a lesser role. Eleven days later the uprising was suppressed and the former government restored when elements of the Ottoman Army sympathetic to the CUP formed an impromptu military force known as the Action Army (Hareket Ordusu). Upon entering Constantinople on 24 April Sultan Abdul Hamid II, accused by the CUP of complicity in the uprising, was deposed and the Ottoman National Assembly elevated his half-brother, Mehmed V, to the throne. Mahmud Shevket Pasha, the military general who had organised and led the Action Army, became the most influential figure in the restored constitutional system until his assassination in 1913.

Abbasid invasion of Asia Minor (782).headline: Abasidski vdor v Malo Azijo (782)
paragraphs: Abasidski vdor v Malo Azijo leta 782 je bil ena največjih operacij Abasidskega kalifata proti Bizantinskemu cesarstvu. Kalifat jo je sprožil, da bi po vrsti bizantinskih uspehov pokazal svojo vojaško moč. Abasidska vojska pod poveljstvom prestolonaslednika, poznejšega Haruna al Rašida, je prodrla vse do Hrizopolisa na drugi strani Bospora nasproti bizantinske prestolnice Carigrada, druge enote pa so plenile po zahodni Mali Aziji in tam premagale bizantinske sile. Harun Carigrada ni nameraval napasti in tudi ni imel ladij za to, zato se je obrnil nazaj.

source.title: Abbasid invasion of Asia Minor (782)
paragraphs: The Abbasid invasion of Asia Minor in 782 was one of the largest operations launched by the Abbasid Caliphate against the Byzantine Empire. The invasion was launched as a display of Abbasid military might in the aftermath of a series of Byzantine successes. Commanded by the Abbasid heir-apparent, the future Harun al-Rashid, the Abbasid army reached as far as Chrysopolis, across the Bosporus from the Byzantine capital, Constantinople, while secondary forces raided western Asia Minor and defeated the Byzantine forces there. As Harun did not intend to assault Constantinople and lacked ships to do so, he turned back.

Abbasid invasion of Asia Minor (806).headline: Abasidski vdor v Malo Azijo (806)
paragraphs: Vdor v Malo Azijo leta 806 je bil največji v dolgi vrsti vojaških operacij Abasidskega kalifata proti Bizantinskemu cesarstvu. Pohod je potekal v jugovzhodni in osrednji Mali Aziji, kjer sta imeli državi dolgo kopensko mejo.

Bizantinski cesar Nikefor I. (vladal 802–811) je ob prihodu na prestol prenehal plačevati davek, o katerem so se s kalifatom dogovorili njegovi predhodniki, in začel napadati abasidska obmejna območja. Abasidski kalif Harun al Rašid (vladal 786–809), ki se je hotel uveljaviti kot zagovornik džihada, se je odločil, da bo osebno vodil povračilni napad, da bi Bizantince kaznoval in njihovemu cesarju vtisnil abasidski vpliv.

source.title: Abbasid invasion of Asia Minor (806)
paragraphs: The 806 invasion of Asia Minor was the largest of a long series of military operations launched by the Abbasid Caliphate against the Byzantine Empire. The expedition took place in southeastern and central Asia Minor, where the two states shared a long land border.

Upon coming to the throne, the Byzantine emperor Nikephoros I (r. 802–811) ceased paying the tribute agreed to by his predecessors with the Caliphate, and launched attacks on the Abbasid frontier regions. The Abbasid caliph, Harun al-Rashid (r. 786–809), who sought to promote himself as a champion of jihad, decided to lead in person a retaliatory attack with the objective of punishing the Byzantines and impressing Abbasid influence upon their emperor.

Adal Sultanate.headline: Adalski sultanat
paragraphs: Adalski sultanat, znan tudi kot Adalski imperij ali Barr Saʿad dīn, je bil srednjeveški sunitski muslimanski imperij na Afriškem rogu. Ustanovil ga je Sabr ad Din III. na planoti Harar v Adalu po padcu Ifatskega sultanata. Kraljestvo je cvetelo ok. od leta 1415 do 1577. Na vrhuncu je država pod sultanom Badlajem nadzorovala ozemlje od rta Guardafui v Somaliji do pristaniškega mesta Suakin v Sudanu.

source.title: Adal Sultanate
paragraphs: The Adal Sultanate, also known as the Adal Empire or Barr Saʿad dīn, was a medieval Sunni Muslim empire which was located in the Horn of Africa. It was founded by Sabr ad-Din III on the Harar plateau in Adal after the fall of the Sultanate of Ifat. The kingdom flourished c. 1415 to 1577. At its height, the polity under Sultan Badlay controlled the territory stretching from Cape Guardafui in Somalia to the port city of Suakin in Sudan.

Aden Emergency.headline: Izredne razmere v Adnu
paragraphs: Izredne razmere v Adnu, znane tudi kot revolucija 14. oktobra ali upor v Adnu, so bile oborožen upor, ki sta ga vodili predvsem Narodnoosvobodilna fronta (NLF) in Fronta za osvoboditev zasedenega Južnega Jemna (FLOSY) proti britanskemu protektoratu in Federaciji Južne Arabije. Začel se je 14. oktobra 1963, ko so plemena iz Radfana napadla britanske vojake, končal pa se je z razglasitvijo neodvisnosti Ljudske republike Južni Jemen.

Britanci so izredne razmere razglasili, potem ko je 10. decembra 1963 v letalskem oporišču RAF Khormaksar nekdo vrgel granato med zbrane britanske uradnike. Izredne razmere so nato razglasili v britanski kronski koloniji Aden in njenem zaledju, protektoratu Aden. Leta 1967 so se razmere zaostrile, kar je pospešilo konec britanske oblasti na tem ozemlju, ki se je začela leta 1839.

source.title: Aden Emergency
paragraphs: The Aden Emergency, also known as the 14 October Revolution or the Aden Insurgency, was an armed rebellion led mainly by the National Liberation Front (NLF) and the Front for the Liberation of Occupied South Yemen (FLOSY) against the British Protectorate and Federation of South Arabia. It began on 14 October 1963 when tribes from Radfan attacked British troops and ended with the proclamation of independence of the People's Republic of Southern Yemen.

The British had declared a state of emergency following the throwing of a grenade at a gathering of British officials on 10 December 1963 at RAF Khormaksar. A state of emergency was then declared in the British Crown colony of Aden and its hinterland, the Aden Protectorate. The emergency escalated in 1967, which hastened the end of British rule in the territory, which had begun in 1839.

Aden Revolt.headline: Upor v Adnu leta 1548
paragraphs: Upor v Adnu leta 1548 je bil upor proti osmanski oblasti v Jemnu, ki so ga zatrli, ko so 26. februarja 1548 prispele osmanske sile pod vodstvom Pirija Reisa.

source.title: Aden Revolt
paragraphs: The Aden revolt of 1548 was a rebellion against Ottoman rule in Yemen, that was suppressed after Ottoman forces under Piri Reis arrived on 26 February 1548.

African Charter on Human and Peoples' Ri.headline: Afriška listina o človekovih pravicah in pravicah ljudstev
paragraphs: Afriška listina o človekovih pravicah in pravicah ljudstev (znana tudi kot Banjulska listina) je mednarodni instrument za človekove pravice, katerega namen je spodbujati in varovati človekove pravice in temeljne svoboščine na afriški celini.

source.title: African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights
paragraphs: The African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights (also known as the Banjul Charter) is an international human rights instrument that is intended to promote and protect human rights and basic freedoms in the African continent.

Pogodba o afriški coni brez jedrskega orožja, znana tudi kot pogodba iz Pelindabe, vzpostavlja območje brez jedrskega orožja v Afriki. Pogodbo so podpisali leta 1996, veljati pa je začela z 28. ratifikacijo 15. julija 2009.

Neuradno ime pogodbe Pelindaba se nanaša na kraj, kjer jo je 2. junija 1995 sprejela Organizacija afriške enotnosti; tam je glavna južnoafriška jedrska raziskovalna ustanova, kjer so zgodovinsko razvijali, izdelovali in hranili južnoafriško jedrsko orožje, dokler ga leta 1989 niso odpravili.

source.title: African Nuclear-Weapon-Free Zone Treaty
paragraphs: The African Nuclear-Weapon-Free Zone Treaty, also known as the Treaty of Pelindaba establishes a Nuclear-Weapon-Free Zone in Africa. The treaty was signed in 1996 and came into effect with the 28th ratification on 15 July 2009.

The treaty's informal name of Pelindaba refers to the location where it was adopted by the Organization of African Unity on June 2, 1995, which is the site of South Africa's main nuclear research facility, historically the location where South Africa's nuclear weapons were developed, produced, and stored, until they were eliminated in 1989.

Zavarovane dežele Irana, splošno znane kot afšaridski Iran, afšaridska Perzija ali Afšaridski imperij, so bile iranski imperij, ki ga je ustanovilo turkmensko pleme Afšar v severovzhodni iranski provinci Horasan; dinastija Afšaridov je Iranu vladala sredi 18. stoletja. Njen ustanovitelj Nader šah je bil uspešen vojskovodja, ki je leta 1736 odstavil zadnjega pripadnika dinastije Safavidov in se razglasil za šaha.

Pod Nader šahom je Iran dosegel največji obseg od časov Sasanidskega imperija. Na vrhuncu je vladal današnjemu Iranu, Kavkazu, Afganistanu, Uzbekistanu in drugim delom Srednje Azije ter delom Arabije, indijske podceline, Iraka in Turčije. Po njegovi smrti so si večino imperija razdelili Zandi, Durani in Kalatski kanat, oblast Afšaridov pa se je skrčila na majhno krajevno državo v Horasanu. Dinastijo je leta 1796 dokončno strmoglavil Aga Mohamed kan Kadžar, ki je ustanovil Kadžarski imperij in znova vzpostavil iransko nadoblast nad prej izgubljenimi območji.

source.title: Afsharid Iran
paragraphs: The Guarded Domains of Iran, commonly referred to as Afsharid Iran, Afsharid Persia or the Afsharid Empire, was an Iranian empire established by the Turkoman Afshar tribe in Iran's north-eastern province of Khorasan, the Afsharid dynasty would rule over Iran during the mid 18th century. The dynasty's founder, Nader Shah, was a successful military commander who deposed the last member of the Safavid dynasty in 1736, and proclaimed himself Shah.

During Nader Shah's reign, Iran reached its greatest extent since the time of the Sasanian Empire. At its height it ruled modern-day Iran, the Caucasus, Afghanistan, Uzbekistan and other parts of Central Asia, as well as parts of Arabia, the Indian subcontinent, Iraq and Turkey. After his death, most of his empire was divided between the Zands, Durranis, and Khanate of Kalat, with Afsharid rule being confined to a small local state in Khorasan. The Afsharid dynasty was finally overthrown in 1796 by Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar, who founded the Qajar Empire and reestablished Iranian suzerainty over the previously lost regions.

Agacher Strip War.headline: Vojna za pas Agacher
paragraphs: Vojna za pas Agacher (francosko: Guerre de la Bande d’Agacher), znana tudi kot božična vojna (francosko: Guerre de Noël), je bila kratek spopad med Burkino Faso in Malijem za 160 kilometrov dolg pas ozemlja ob meji na severu Burkine Faso, ki je potekal od 25. do 30. decembra 1985. Vojna se je končala s premirjem. Za pas Agacher sta se Mali in Burkina Faso v mejnem sporu prepirala že od 1960. let. Po oboroženih spopadih leta 1974 sta se državi dogovorili za posredovanje, ki naj bi razrešilo nesoglasja. Iskanje rešitve je zastalo, zato sta se leta 1983 predsednik Burkine Faso Thomas Sankara in malijski predsednik Moussa Traoré odločila, da mejni spor predata Meddržavnemu sodišču, in ga nato zaprosila za razsodbo.
notes: The miles conversion (100 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Agacher Strip War
paragraphs: The Agacher Strip War (French: Guerre de la Bande d’Agacher), also known as the Christmas War (French: Guerre de Noël), was a brief conflict fought by Burkina Faso and Mali over a 160-kilometre-long (100 mi) strip of land along the border in northern Burkina Faso from 25 to 30 December 1985. The war ended in a ceasefire. The Agacher Strip had been subject to a border dispute between Mali and Burkina Faso since the 1960s. Following armed clashes in 1974, both countries agreed to mediation to resolve their differences. Progress on a solution stalled, and in 1983 Burkinabé President Thomas Sankara and Malian President Moussa Traoré decided to have the border dispute settled by the International Court of Justice and subsequently petitioned the body to resolve the issue.

Ahis.headline: Ahijsko bratstvo
paragraphs: Ahijsko bratstvo (turško: Ahî, mn. Ahîler), ki ga sodobno zgodovinopisje imenuje Ahijska republika, je bila bratovščina, ki jo je v 13. in 14. stoletju v Anatoliji (na območju današnje Ankare) ustanovil Ahi Evran.

source.title: Ahis
paragraphs: The Ahi Brotherhood (Turkish: Ahî, pl. Ahîler), referred to as Ahi Republic in modern historiography, was a brotherhood union by Ahi Evran in Anatolia (around present-day Ankara) in the 13th and 14th centuries.

Oaza Al Ahsa (arabsko: al-Ahsā), znana tudi kot al Hasa ali Hadžar, je oaza in zgodovinska pokrajina na vzhodu Savdske Arabije. Po njej se imenuje guvernorat Al Ahsa, ki obsega velik del Vzhodne province države. Oaza leži okoli 60 km v notranjosti od obale Perzijskega zaliva in jo sestavljajo štiri glavna mesta in 22 vasi. Med mesti sta Al Mubaraz in Al Hufuf, dve največji mesti v Savdski Arabiji.

source.title: Al-Ahsa Oasis
paragraphs: Al-Ahsa Oasis (Arabic: الْأَحْسَاء, al-ʾAhsā), also known as al-Ḥasāʾ (الْحَسَا) or Hajar (هَجَر), is an oasis and historical region in eastern Saudi Arabia. Al-Ahsa Governorate, which makes up much of the country's Eastern Province, is named after it. The oasis is located about 60 km (37 miles) inland from the coast of the Persian Gulf. Al-Ahsa Oasis comprises four main cities and 22 villages. The cities include Al-Mubarraz and Al-Hofuf, two of the largest cities in Saudi Arabia.

Alexandrian Crusade.headline: Aleksandrijska križarska vojna
paragraphs: Kratka aleksandrijska križarska vojna, imenovana tudi plenjenje Aleksandrije, je potekala oktobra 1365, vodil pa jo je ciprski kralj Peter I. proti Aleksandriji v Egiptu. Na prošnjo Petra I. jo je odobril papež Urban V. Čeprav jo pogosto imenujejo križarska vojna in jo štejejo med križarske vojne, ji je verski zagon razmeroma manjkal in se od bolj znanih križarskih vojn razlikuje po tem, da so jo očitno poganjali predvsem gospodarski interesi.

source.title: Alexandrian Crusade
paragraphs: The brief Alexandrian Crusade, also called the sack of Alexandria, occurred in October 1365 and was led by King Peter I of Cyprus against Alexandria in Egypt. The Crusade was sanctioned by Pope Urban V at the request of Peter I. Although often referred to as and counted among the Crusades, it was relatively devoid of religious impetus and differs from the more prominent Crusades in that it seems to have been motivated largely by economic interests.

Alžirska državljanska vojna (arabsko: الحرب الأهلية الجزائرية, al-Ḥarb al-Ahlīyah al-Jazāʼirīyah), v Alžiriji znana kot črno desetletje (arabsko: العشرية السوداء, al-ʻAshrīyah al-Sawdāʼ; francosko: La décennie noire), je bila državljanska vojna med alžirsko vlado in različnimi islamističnimi uporniškimi skupinami od 11. januarja 1992 (po državnem udaru, ki je razveljavil volilno zmago islamistov) do 8. februarja 2002. Vojna se je začela počasi: sprva se je zdelo, da je vladi uspelo zatreti islamistično gibanje, nato pa so se pojavile oborožene skupine, ki so razglasile nasilni džihad, in do leta 1994 je nasilje doseglo takšno raven, da se je zdelo, da mu vlada morda ne bo kos. Do let 1996–1997 je postalo jasno, da je islamistični odpor izgubil podporo ljudstva, čeprav so se boji nadaljevali še več let.

source.title: Algerian Civil War
paragraphs: The Algerian Civil War (Arabic: الحرب الأهلية الجزائرية, romanized: al-Ḥarb al-Ahlīyah al-Jazāʼirīyah), known in Algeria as the Black Decade (Arabic: العشرية السوداء, romanized: al-ʻAshrīyah al-Sawdāʼ; French: La décennie noire), was a civil war fought between the Algerian government and various Islamist rebel groups from 11 January 1992 (following a coup negating an Islamist electoral victory) to 8 February 2002. The war began slowly; it initially appeared that the government had succeeded in crushing the Islamist movement, but armed groups emerged to declare violent jihad, and by 1994 violence reached such a level that it appeared the government might not be able to withstand it. By 1996–97 it had become clear that the Islamist resistance had lost its popular support, although fighting continued for several years after this.

Algiers putsch of 1961.headline: Alžirski puč leta 1961
paragraphs: Alžirski puč (arabsko: انقلاب 1961 في الجزائر; francosko: Putsch d'Alger ali Coup d'État d'Alger), znan tudi kot puč generalov (Putsch des généraux), je bil spodleteli državni udar, s katerim so hoteli francoskega predsednika Charlesa de Gaulla prisiliti, da ne bi zapustil francoske Alžirije, tamkajšnje evropske skupnosti in Francozom naklonjenih Alžircev. V francoski Alžiriji so ga organizirali upokojeni generali francoske vojske Maurice Challe (nekdanji vrhovni poveljnik v francoski Alžiriji), Edmond Jouhaud (nekdanji generalni inšpektor francoskega vojnega letalstva), André Zeller (nekdanji načelnik generalštaba francoske vojske) in Raoul Salan (nekdanji vrhovni poveljnik v francoski Alžiriji). Potekal je od popoldneva 21. do 26. aprila 1961, sredi alžirske vojne (1954–1962), in je državo pripeljal na rob državljanske vojne.

source.title: Algiers putsch of 1961
paragraphs: The Algiers putsch (Arabic: انقلاب 1961 في الجزائر; French: Putsch d'Alger or Coup d'État d'Alger), also known as the putsch of the generals (Putsch des généraux), was a failed coup d'état intended to force French President Charles de Gaulle not to abandon French Algeria, the resident European community and pro-French Algerians. Organised in French Algeria by retired French Army generals Maurice Challe (former commander-in-chief in French Algeria), Edmond Jouhaud (former Inspector General of the French Air Force), André Zeller (former Chief of Staff of the French Army) and Raoul Salan (former commander-in-chief in French Algeria), it took place from the afternoon of 21 to 26 April 1961 in the midst of the Algerian War (1954–1962) and brought the nation to the brink of a civil war.

Alid dynasties of northern Iran.headline: Alidske dinastije severnega Irana
paragraphs: Alidske dinastije severnega Irana ali Alavidi (perzijsko: علویان طبرستان). V 9. in 10. stoletju so severnoiranske pokrajine Tabaristan, Dajlam in Gilan, stisnjene med Kaspijsko jezero in gorovje Alborz, prišle pod oblast več alidskih dinastij, privrženk zajdijske veje šiitskega islama.
Prvi in najmogočnejši zajdijski emirat so ustanovili v Tabaristanu leta 864 in je trajal do leta 928. Leta 900 ga je prekinila samanidska zasedba, leta 914 pa ga je obnovila druga alidska veja.

Drugo obdobje alidskega emirata so pestili notranji spori in boji za oblast med vejama, končalo pa se je leta 928 z drugo samanidsko osvojitvijo pokrajine. Nekateri alavidski vojaki in generali so nato prestopili k Samanidom, med njimi Mardavidž, ustanovitelj dinastije Zijaridov, in trije Bujini sinovi (Ali, Hasan in Ahmad), ustanovitelji dinastije Bujidov.

source.title: Alid dynasties of northern Iran
paragraphs: Alid dynasties of northern Iran or Alavids (Persian: علویان طبرستان). In the 9th–10th centuries, the northern Iranian regions of Tabaristan, Daylam and Gilan, sandwiched between the Caspian Sea and the Alborz range, came under the rule of a number of Alid dynasties, espousing the Zaydi branch of Shia Islam.
The first and most powerful Zaydi emirate was established in Tabaristan in 864 and lasted until 928. It was interrupted by Samanid occupation in 900, but restored in 914 by another Alid branch.

The second period of the Alid emirate was plagued by internal dissensions and power struggles between the two branches, and ended in the second conquest of the region by the Samanids in 928. Subsequently, some of the soldiers and generals of the Alavids joined the Samanids, among them Mardavij, founder of the Ziyarid dynasty, and the three sons of Buya (Ali, Hassan and Ahmad), founders of the Buyid dynasty.

Alid revolt of 762–763.headline: Alidski upor v letih 762–763
paragraphs: Alidski upor v letih 762–763 ali upor Mohameda Čiste duše je bil vstaja hasanidske veje Alidov proti novoustanovljenemu Abasidskemu kalifatu. Hasanidi pod vodstvom bratov Mohameda (imenovanega »Čista duša«) in Ibrahima niso priznavali zakonitosti abasidske zahteve po oblasti. Ko jih je abasidski režim vse bolj preganjal, so leta 762 sprožili upor: Mohamed se je septembra uprl v Medini, Ibrahim pa mu je novembra sledil v Basri.

source.title: Alid revolt of 762–763
paragraphs: The Alid revolt of 762–763 or Revolt of Muhammad the Pure Soul was an uprising by the Hasanid branch of the Alids against the newly established Abbasid Caliphate. The Hasanids, led by the brothers Muhammad (called "the Pure Soul") and Ibrahim, rejected the legitimacy of the Abbasid family's claim to power. Reacting to mounting persecution by the Abbasid regime, in 762 they launched a rebellion, with Muhammad rising in revolt at Medina in September and Ibrahim following in Basra in November.

Alodia.headline: Alodija
paragraphs: Alodija, znana tudi kot Alva (staronubijsko: ⲁⲣⲟⲩⲁ, Aroua; bizantinsko grško: Ἀρούα, Arouá; arabsko: علوة, ʿAlwa), je bila srednjeveško kraljestvo na ozemlju današnjega osrednjega Sudana. Prestolnica je bila mesto Soba blizu današnjega Kartuma, ob sotočju Modrega in Belega Nila.

source.title: Alodia
paragraphs: Alodia, also known as Alwa (Old Nubian: ⲁⲣⲟⲩⲁ, Aroua; Byzantine Greek: Ἀρούα, Arouá; Arabic: علوة, ʿAlwa), was a medieval kingdom in what is now central Sudan. Its capital was the city of Soba, located near modern-day Khartoum at the confluence of the Blue and White Nile rivers.

Amhara Region coup attempt.headline: Poskus državnega udara v regiji Amhara
paragraphs: Poskus državnega udara v regiji Amhara leta 2019 je bil poskus udara proti regionalni vladi Amhare 22. junija 2019, med katerim so frakcije amharskega regionalnega urada za mir in varnost umorile predsednika regije Amhara Ambačeva Mekonena. Telesni stražar, ki je stopil na stran nacionalističnih frakcij, je umoril tudi generala Seareja Mekonena, načelnika generalštaba etiopskih narodnih obrambnih sil, in njegovega pomočnika generalmajorja Gizaeja Abero.
Urad predsednika vlade je obtožil brigadnega generala Asaminewa Cigeja, vodjo amharskega regionalnega urada za mir in varnost, da je vodil zaroto. Asaminewa so pozneje, ko je pobegnil, ustrelili.

source.title: Amhara Region coup attempt
paragraphs: The 2019 Amhara Region coup d'état attempt was an attempted coup d'état against the Amhara Regional government on 22 June 2019, during which factions of the Amhara Region's Peace and Security Bureau assassinated the Amhara Regional President Ambachew Mekonnen. A bodyguard siding with the nationalist factions also assassinated General Se'are Mekonnen, the Chief of General Staff of the Ethiopian National Defense Force, as well as his aide Major General Gizae Aberra.
The prime minister's office accused Brigadier General Asaminew Tsige, head of the Amhara Region's Peace and Security Bureau, of leading the plot. Asaminew was later shot dead after escaping.

Anbar campaign (2003–2011).headline: Kampanja v Anbarju (2003–2011)
paragraphs: Kampanjo v Anbarju so sestavljali boji med vojsko Združenih držav skupaj z iraškimi varnostnimi silami in sunitskimi uporniki v zahodnem iraškem guvernoratu Al Anbar. Iraška vojna je trajala od leta 2003 do 2011, večina bojev in protiuporniške kampanje v Anbarju pa je potekala med aprilom 2004 in septembrom 2007. Sprva so med uporniki in ameriškimi marinci potekali predvsem hudi ulični boji, v poznejših letih pa so se uporniki osredotočili na zasede ameriškim in iraškim varnostnim silam z improviziranimi eksplozivnimi napravami, obsežne napade na bojne postojanke in avtomobile bombe. V kampanji je umrlo skoraj 9000 Iračanov in 1335 Američanov, mnogi v dolini Evfrata in v sunitskem trikotniku okoli mest Faludža in Ramadi.

source.title: Anbar campaign (2003–2011)
paragraphs: The Anbar campaign consisted of fighting between the United States military, together with Iraqi security forces, and Sunni insurgents in the western Iraqi governorate of Al Anbar. The Iraq War lasted from 2003 to 2011, but the majority of the fighting and counterinsurgency campaign in Anbar took place between April 2004 and September 2007. Although the fighting initially featured heavy urban warfare primarily between insurgents and U.S. Marines, insurgents in later years focused on ambushing the American and Iraqi security forces with improvised explosive devices (IEDs), large scale attacks on combat outposts, and car bombings. Almost 9,000 Iraqis and 1,335 Americans were killed in the campaign, many in the Euphrates River Valley and the Sunni Triangle around the cities of Fallujah and Ramadi.

Suniti v Iraku so od decembra 2012 protestirali proti Malikijevi vladi. Sunitskega poslanca Ahmeda al Alvanija, vidnega podpornika protivladnih protestov, so 28. decembra 2013 aretirali v racijah na njegov dom v Ramadiju. Incident je v guvernoratu Al Anbar sprožil nasilje med iraško vojsko in ohlapnim zavezništvom plemenskih milic in drugih skupin, ki so se bojevale ob strani Islamske države Iraka in Levanta (ISIL).

Januarja 2014 so protivladne sile zavzele Faludžo, v Ramadiju pa so potekali hudi boji. Marca je iraška vojska zavarovala Ramadi in skušala znova zavzeti Faludžo. Junija je ISIL skupaj z napadom na severni Irak začel veliko ofenzivo v Anbarju in do 23. junija nadzoroval najmanj 70 % province.

source.title: Anbar campaign (2013–2014)
paragraphs: Beginning in December 2012, Sunnis in Iraq protested against the Maliki government. On 28 December 2013, a Sunni MP named Ahmed al-Alwani was arrested in a raid on his home in Ramadi. Alwani was a prominent supporter of the anti-government protests. This incident led to violence in Al Anbar Governorate between the Iraqi Army and a loose alliance of tribal militias and other groups fighting alongside the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL).

In January 2014, the anti-government forces took control of Fallujah, and there was heavy fighting in Ramadi. In March, the Iraqi army secured Ramadi and attempted to regain Fallujah. In June, ISIL launched a major offensive in Anbar in conjunction with their assault on northern Iraq. By 23 June, they controlled at least 70% of Anbar.

Anfal campaign.headline: Kampanja Anfal
paragraphs: Kampanja Anfal je bila protiuporniška operacija, ki jo mnogi raziskovalci in organizacije za človekove pravice označujejo za genocid ali etnično čiščenje; izvajal jo je baatistični Irak od februarja do septembra 1988 med iraško-kurdskim spopadom ob koncu iransko-iraške vojne. Uperjena je bila proti podeželskim Kurdom, saj je hotela odpraviti kurdske uporniške skupine in arabizirati strateške dele guvernorata Kirkuk. Baatistični režim je nad krajevnim kurdskim prebivalstvom, večinoma civilisti, zagrešil grozodejstva. Glavna tarča so bili Kurdi, žrtve kampanje pa so postale tudi druge manjšine na severu, kot so Asirci in Turkmeni.
Iraške sile je po ukazu predsednika Sadama Huseina vodil Ali Hasan al Madžid. Ime kampanje izvira iz naslova osme sure Korana (al ʾanfāl).

source.title: Anfal campaign
paragraphs: The Anfal campaign, was a counterinsurgency operation, described by many scholars and human rights groups as a genocide or ethnic cleansing, which was carried out by Ba'athist Iraq from February to September 1988 during the Iraqi–Kurdish conflict at the end of the Iran–Iraq War. The campaign targeted rural Kurds because its purpose was to eliminate Kurdish rebel groups and Arabize strategic parts of the Kirkuk Governorate. The Ba'athist regime committed atrocities on the local Kurdish population, mostly civilians. While the primary targets were Kurds, other minorities in the north such as Assyrians and Turkmen also fell victim to the Anfal campaign.
The Iraqi forces were led by Ali Hassan al-Majid, on the orders of President Saddam Hussein. The campaign's name was taken from the title of the eighth chapter of the Qur'an (al-ʾanfāl).

Anglo-Ashanti wars.headline: Angleško-ašantske vojne
paragraphs: Angleško-ašantske vojne so bile vrsta petih spopadov, ki so med letoma 1824 in 1900 potekali med Ašantskim imperijem v akanski notranjosti Zlate obale ter Britanskim imperijem in njegovimi afriškimi zavezniki. Kljub začetnim ašantskim zmagam so Britanci v spopadih nazadnje zmagali, zato je bil Ašantski imperij do leta 1900 v celoti priključen.

source.title: Anglo-Ashanti wars
paragraphs: The Anglo-Ashanti wars were a series of five conflicts that took place between 1824 and 1900 between the Ashanti Empire—in the Akan interior of the Gold Coast—and the British Empire and its African allies. Despite initial Ashanti victories, the British ultimately prevailed in the conflicts, resulting in the complete annexation of the Ashanti Empire by 1900.

Anglo-Egyptian War.headline: Angleško-egiptovska vojna
paragraphs: Britanska osvojitev Egipta, znana tudi kot druga angleško-egiptovska vojna (arabsko: الحرب الإنجليزية المصرية, al-Ḥarb al-Injlīzīyah al-Miṣrīyah), je potekala leta 1882 med večinoma egiptovskimi in sudanskimi silami pod vodstvom Ahmeda Urabija ter Združenim kraljestvom.

Egipt je bil v 19. stoletju država pod vse večjim tujim vplivom svetovnih sil. V začetku 1880. let so razmere postale eksplozivne, potem ko se je vojaški častnik Ahmed Urabi uprl Tevfiku paši, hkrati pa je v državi raslo število anarhistov. Britanci so s podporo drugih kolonialnih sil posredovali, da bi Egipt kolonizirali, in jim je uspelo strti egiptovsko-sudanske sile. Anarhisti, ki so se skušali pridružiti uporu, so bili odrezani od uporniških enot in se jim niso mogli pridružiti.

source.title: Anglo-Egyptian War
paragraphs: The British conquest of Egypt, also known as the 2nd Anglo-Egyptian War (Arabic: الحرب الإنجليزية المصرية, romanised: al-Ḥarb al-Injlīzīyah al-Miṣrīyah), occurred in 1882 between mostly Egyptian and Sudanese forces under Ahmed ‘Urabi and the United Kingdom.

Egypt was a country under growing foreign influence from global powers during the 19th century. In the early 1880s, the situation became explosive following the revolt of an army officer, Ahmed 'Urabi, against Tewfik Pasha, alongside the growth of anarchist numbers in the country. The British intervened with the support of other colonial powers to colonise Egypt and succeeded in crushing the Egyptian-Sudanese forces. The anarchists who attempted to join the revolt were cut off from the insurgent troops and were unable to do so.

Angleško-iraška vojna je bila zavezniški vojaški pohod pod britanskim vodstvom med drugo svetovno vojno proti Kraljevini Irak, ki ji je tedaj vladal Rašid Ali al Gajlani; ta je z nemško in italijansko pomočjo prevzel oblast v iraškem državnem udaru leta 1941. Pohod je strmoglavil Gajlanijevo vlado, Britanci so Irak znova zasedli, na oblast pa se je vrnil iraški regent, princ Abd al Ilah, britanski zaveznik.

source.title: Anglo-Iraqi War
paragraphs: The Anglo-Iraqi War was a British-led Allied military campaign during the Second World War against the Kingdom of Iraq, then ruled by Rashid Ali al-Gaylani who had seized power in the 1941 Iraqi coup d'état with assistance from Germany and Italy. The campaign resulted in the downfall of Gaylani's government, the re-occupation of Iraq by the British, and the return to power of the Regent of Iraq, Prince 'Abd al-Ilah, a British ally.
Angleško-turška vojna v letih 1807–1809 je bila del napoleonskih vojn, bojevala sta jo Združeno kraljestvo Velike Britanije in Irske ter Osmansko cesarstvo.

source.title: Anglo-Turkish War (1807–1809)
paragraphs: The Anglo-Turkish War of 1807–1809 was a part of the Napoleonic Wars, was fought between the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland and the Ottoman Empire.

Angolska državljanska vojna (portugalsko: Guerra Civil Angolana) je bila državljanska vojna v Angoli, ki se je začela leta 1975 in s premori trajala do leta 2002. Vojna se je začela takoj, ko je Angola novembra 1975 dobila neodvisnost od Portugalske. Bila je boj za oblast med nekdanjima protikolonialnima gverilskima gibanjema, komunističnim Ljudskim gibanjem za osvoboditev Angole (MPLA) in protikomunistično Narodno zvezo za popolno neodvisnost Angole (UNITA).

source.title: Angolan Civil War
paragraphs: The Angolan Civil War (Portuguese: Guerra Civil Angolana) was a civil war in Angola, beginning in 1975 and continuing, with interludes, until 2002. The war began immediately after Angola became independent from Portugal in November 1975. It was a power struggle between two former anti-colonial guerrilla movements, the communist People's Movement for the Liberation of Angola (MPLA) and the anti-communist National Union for the Total Independence of Angola (UNITA).

Angolska vojna za neodvisnost (portugalsko: Guerra de Independência de Angola; 1961–1974), v Angoli znana kot oboroženi boj za narodno osvoboditev (portugalsko: Luta Armada de Libertação Nacional), je bila osamosvojitvena vojna, ki so jo angolske nacionalistične sile MPLA, UNITA in FNLA bojevale proti Portugalski. Začela se je kot upor Angolcev proti portugalskemu vsiljevanju prisilnega gojenja bombaža kot edine tržne rastline. Ko se je odpor proti kolonialnim oblastem širil, je nastalo več frakcij, ki so se borile za nadzor nad portugalsko čezmorsko provinco Angolo. Obstajala so tri nacionalistična gibanja in še separatistično gibanje.

Ko je mirni državni udar v Lizboni aprila 1974 strmoglavil portugalsko diktaturo Estado Novo, je novi režim takoj ustavil vse vojaške operacije v afriških kolonijah in razglasil, da jim namerava brez odlašanja podeliti neodvisnost.
Spopad navadno obravnavajo kot vejo ali bojišče širše portugalske kolonialne vojne, ki je vključevala tudi osamosvojitveni vojni Gvineje Bissau in Mozambika.

source.title: Angolan War of Independence
paragraphs: The Angolan War of Independence (Portuguese: Guerra de Independência de Angola; 1961–1974), known as the Armed Struggle of National Liberation (Portuguese: Luta Armada de Libertação Nacional) in Angola, was a war of independence fought by the Angolan nationalist forces of the MPLA, UNITA and FNLA against Portugal. It began as an uprising by Angolans against the Portuguese imposition of forced cultivation of only cotton as a commodity crop. As the resistance spread against colonial authorities, multiple factions developed that struggled for control of Portugal's overseas province of Angola. There were three nationalist movements and also a separatist movement.

When a peaceful coup in Lisbon in April 1974 overthrew Portugal's Estado Novo dictatorship, the new regime immediately stopped all military action in the African colonies, declaring its intention to grant them independence without delay.
The conflict is usually approached as a branch or a theater of the wider Portuguese Colonial War. This included the independence wars of Guinea-Bissau and Mozambique.

Ankara Agreement.headline: Ankarski sporazum
paragraphs: Sporazum o ustanovitvi pridružitve med Republiko Turčijo in Evropsko gospodarsko skupnostjo, splošno znan kot ankarski sporazum (turško: Ankara Anlaşması), je pogodba, podpisana leta 1963, ki določa okvir sodelovanja med Turčijo in Evropsko unijo (EU).

source.title: Ankara Agreement
paragraphs: The Agreement Creating An Association Between The Republic of Turkey and the European Economic Community, commonly known as the Ankara Agreement (Turkish: Ankara Anlaşması), is a treaty signed in 1963 that provides for the framework for the co-operation between Turkey and the European Union (EU).

Antony's Atropatene campaign.headline: Antonijev pohod v Atropateno
paragraphs: Antonijev pohod v Atropateno, znan tudi kot Antonijev partski pohod, je bil vojaški pohod Marka Antonija, vzhodnega triumvira Rimske republike, proti Partskemu imperiju pod Fraatom IV.

Julij Cezar je načrtoval vdor v Partijo, a je umrl, preden ga je lahko izvedel. Leta 40 pr. n. št. so se Partom pridružile Pompejeve sile in za kratek čas zavzele velik del rimskega vzhoda, a jih je vojska, ki jo je poslal Antonij, porazila in jim odvzela pridobljeno.

Antonij se je povezal z več kraljestvi, med njimi z Armenijo, in leta 36 pr. n. št. z ogromno vojsko začel pohod proti Partiji. Ker se je evfratska fronta izkazala za močno, je izbral pot prek Armenije. Ko je vstopil v Atropateno, je partska konjenica uničila rimsko prtljago in oblegovalne stroje, ki so potovali po drugi poti. Antonij je pot nadaljeval in oblegal prestolnico Atropatene, a brez uspeha. Naporni umik v Armenijo in nato v Sirijo je njegovi vojski prizadejal nove izgube, zato je bila vojna za Rimljane taktična katastrofa in strateški neuspeh. Mir je pozneje izpogajal Avgust.

source.title: Antony's Atropatene campaign
paragraphs: Antony's Atropatene campaign, also known as Antony's Parthian campaign, was a military campaign by Mark Antony, the eastern triumvir of the Roman Republic, against the Parthian Empire under Phraates IV.

Julius Caesar had planned an invasion of Parthia but died before he could implement it. In 40 BC, the Parthians were joined by Pompeian forces and briefly captured much of the Roman East, but a force sent by Antony defeated them and reversed their gains.

Allying with several kingdoms, including Armenia, Antony began a campaign against Parthia with a massive force in 36 BC. Since the Euphrates front was found to be strong, Antony chose the route via Armenia. Upon entering Atropatene, the Roman baggage train and siege engines, which had taken a different route, were destroyed by a Parthian cavalry force. Antony moved on and besieged the Atropatene capital but was unsuccessful. The arduous journey of retreat to Armenia and then Syria further inflicted losses on his force, making the war a tactical Roman disaster and a strategic failure. Peace was later negotiated by Augustus.

Hašemitska arabska federacija je bila kratkotrajna konfederacija hašemitskih kraljevin Irak in Jordanija, ki je trajala od 14. februarja do 2. avgusta 1958. Čeprav ime nakazuje zvezno ureditev, je bila dejansko konfederacija.

Federacijo sta 14. februarja 1958 ustanovila iraški kralj Fejsal II. in njegov bratranec, jordanski kralj Husein, ki sta hotela kraljevini združiti v odgovor na nastanek Združene arabske republike Egipta in Sirije. Zveza je trajala le šest mesecev: Fejsala II. je 14. julija odstavil vojaški udar, nova iraška vlada pa je federacijo 2. avgusta 1958 uradno razpustila.

source.title: Arab Federation
paragraphs: The Hashemite Arab Federation was a short-lived confederation that lasted from 14 February to 2 August 1958, between the Hashemite kingdoms of Iraq and Jordan. Although the name implies a federal structure, it was de facto a confederation.

The Federation was formed on 14 February 1958, when King Faisal II of Iraq and his cousin, King Hussein of Jordan, sought to unite their two Hashemite kingdoms as a response to the formation of the United Arab Republic between Egypt and Syria. The union lasted only six months. Faisal II was deposed by a military coup on 14 July, and the new Iraqi government officially dissolved the Federation on 2 August 1958.

Arabski Irak (arabsko: ‘Irāq ul-‘Arab, dobesedno »Irak Arabcev«) je bil zgodovinski zemljepisni izraz, s katerim so srednjeveški in zgodnjenovoveški pisci označevali pokrajino Irak v Mezopotamiji, pogosto s središčem v spodnji Mezopotamiji. Njegov natančni obseg se je razlikoval glede na pisca in obdobje, nekateri viri pa ga opisujejo kot ozemlje, ki se v grobem ujema z velikim delom današnjega Iraka.

Izraz »arabski Irak« (perzijsko: Irâq-e Arab) se je razširil v seldžuškem obdobju (11.–12. stoletje), da bi zgodovinsko pokrajino Mezopotamijo (pravi Irak) ločili od »perzijskega Iraka« (Irâq-e Ajam), pokrajine, ki so jo prej imenovali al Džibal in je bila povezana z zgodovinsko pokrajino Medijo. Perzijski in arabski Irak so skupaj pogosto imenovali »al Irakajn«, »oba Iraka«. Gorata ozemlja med njima, Kurdistan, Luristan in Bahtiari, so glede na vojaške razmere lahko pripadala enemu ali drugemu, a so ne glede na to pogosto ohranjala veliko samostojnost.

source.title: Arab Iraq
paragraphs: Arab Iraq or Arabian Iraq (Arabic: عراق العرب, romanized: ‘Irāq ul-‘Arab, lit. 'Iraq of the Arabs') was a historical geographical term used by medieval and early modern writers for the region of Iraq in Mesopotamia, often centered in Lower Mesopotamia. Its precise extent varied by author and period, and some sources describe Arab Iraq as corresponding roughly to much of modern Iraq.

The term "Arab Iraq" (Persian: عراق عرب, romanized: Irâq-e Arab) became commonly used in the Seljuk period (11th–12th centuries) as a way to distinguish the historical region of Mesopotamia (Iraq proper) from "Persian Iraq" (Persian: عراق عجم, romanized: Irâq-e Ajam), a region previously referred to as al-Jibal, associated with the historical region of Media. Persian Iraq and Arab Iraq were often referred to as "al-Iraqayn" (Arabic: العراقين) meaning "the two Iraqs" collectively. The mountainous territories between them, comprising Kurdistan, Luristan, and Bakhtiyari, could have fell under either region depending on the military situation, but often maintained a high degree of autonomy regardless.

Arabski upor (arabsko: al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya), znan tudi kot veliki arabski upor (al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya al-Kubrā), je bil oborožena vstaja Arabcev iz Hedžasa pod hašemitskim vodstvom proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu na bližnjevzhodnem bojišču prve svetovne vojne.

Na podlagi dopisovanja med Henryjem McMahonom iz Združenega kraljestva in Huseinom bin Alijem iz Kraljevine Hedžas se je upor proti vladajočim Turkom uradno začel 10. junija 1916 v Meki. Glavni cilj arabskih upornikov je bila neodvisna in enotna arabska država od Alepa do Adna, ki jo je britanska vlada obljubila priznati.

Šarifska vojska pod vodstvom Huseina in Hašemitov je ob podpori britanskih egiptovskih ekspedicijskih sil uspešno pregnala osmansko vojsko iz večjega dela Hedžasa in Transjordanije. Do leta 1918 so uporniki zavzeli Damask in razglasili Arabsko kraljestvo Sirija, kratkotrajno monarhijo, ki jo je vodil Huseinov sin Fejsal I.

source.title: Arab Revolt
paragraphs: The Arab Revolt (Arabic: الثورة العربية al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya), also known as the Great Arab Revolt (الثورة العربية الكبرى al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya al-Kubrā), was an armed uprising by the Hashemite-led Arabs of the Hejaz against the Ottoman Empire amidst the Middle Eastern theatre of World War I.

On the basis of the McMahon–Hussein Correspondence, exchanged between Henry McMahon of the United Kingdom and Hussein bin Ali of the Kingdom of Hejaz, the rebellion against the ruling Turks was officially initiated at Mecca on 10 June 1916. The primary goal of the Arab rebels was to establish an independent and unified Arab state stretching from Aleppo to Aden, which the British government had promised to recognize.

The Sharifian Army, led by Hussein and the Hashemites with backing from the British military's Egyptian Expeditionary Force, successfully fought and expelled the Ottoman military presence from much of the Hejaz and Transjordan. By 1918, the rebels had captured Damascus and proclaimed the Arab Kingdom of Syria, a short-lived monarchy that was led by Hussein's son Faisal I.

Arabska socialistična stranka Baath – regija Sirija (arabsko: Ḥizb al-Ba'th al-'Arabī al-Ishtirākī – Quṭr Sūriyā), uradno sirska regionalna veja, je bila baatistična organizacija, ki so jo 7. aprila 1947 ustanovili Michel Aflaq, Salah al Din al Bitar in privrženci Zakija al Arsuzija. Stranka je Sirijo vodila od državnega udara leta 1963, ki je baatiste pripeljal na oblast, do 8. decembra 2024, ko je Bašar al Asad pred uporniško ofenzivo, ki je končala sirsko državljansko vojno, pobegnil iz Damaska. Formalno so jo razpustili januarja 2025.

source.title: Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party – Syria Region
paragraphs: The Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party – Syria Region (Arabic: حزب البعث العربي الاشتراكي – قطر سوريا Ḥizb al-Ba'th al-'Arabī al-Ishtirākī – Quṭr Sūriyā), officially the Syrian Regional Branch (Arabic: الفرع القطري السوري), was a Ba'athist organisation founded on 7 April 1947 by Michel Aflaq, Salah al-Din al-Bitar and followers of Zaki al-Arsuzi. The party ruled Syria from the 1963 coup d'état, which brought the Ba'athists to power, until 8 December 2024, when Bashar al-Assad fled Damascus in the face of a rebel offensive which concluded the Syrian civil war. It was formally disbanded in January 2025.

Ararat rebellion.headline: Upor na Araratu
paragraphs: Upor na Araratu, znan tudi kot upor v Ağrıju (turško: Ağrı ayaklanmaları ali Ağrı isyanı), je bil upor Kurdov v provinci Ağrı na vzhodu Turčije proti turški vladi leta 1930. Gverilske sile je med uporom vodil Ihsan Nuri iz veje Džibran plemena Džalali.

source.title: Ararat rebellion
paragraphs: The Ararat rebellion, also known as the Ağrı rebellion (Turkish: Ağrı ayaklanmaları or Ağrı isyanı), was a 1930 uprising by the Kurds of Ağrı Province, in eastern Turkey, against the Turkish government. The leader of the guerrilla forces during the rebellion was Ihsan Nuri of the Jibran branch of the Jalali tribe.

Armistice of Erzincan.headline: Premirje v Erzincanu
paragraphs: Premirje v Erzincanu (zapisano tudi Erzindžan) je bilo sporazum o prekinitvi sovražnosti med prvo svetovno vojno, ki sta ga Osmansko cesarstvo in Zakavkaški komisariat podpisala v Erzincanu 18. decembra 1917 (5. decembra po starem koledarju). Premirje je na kavkaškem in perzijskem bojišču prineslo začasen mir do 12. februarja, ko so se boji znova začeli.

source.title: Armistice of Erzincan
paragraphs: The Armistice of Erzincan (also spelled Erzindzhan or Erzinjan) was an agreement to suspend hostilities during World War I signed by the Ottoman Empire and Transcaucasian Commissariat in Erzincan on 18 December 1917 (5 December O.S.). The armistice brought temporary peace to the Caucasian and Persian Fronts until 12 February, when the fighting was resumed.

Armistice of Mudanya.headline: Premirje v Mudanyi
paragraphs: Premirje v Mudanyi (turško: Mudanya Mütarekesi) je bilo sporazum med Turčijo (Veliko narodno skupščino Turčije) ter Italijo, Francijo in Veliko Britanijo, podpisan 11. oktobra 1922 v mestu Mudanya v provinci Bursa. Kraljevina Grčija je k premirju pristopila 14. oktobra 1922.

source.title: Armistice of Mudanya
paragraphs: The Armistice of Mudanya (Turkish: Mudanya Mütarekesi) was an agreement between Turkey (the Grand National Assembly of Turkey) and Italy, France, and Britain, signed in the town of Mudanya, in the province of Bursa, on 11 October 1922. The Kingdom of Greece acceded to the armistice on 14 October 1922.

Arusha Accords (Rwanda).headline: Sporazumi iz Arushe (Ruanda)
paragraphs: Sporazumi iz Arushe, uradno Mirovni sporazum med vlado Republike Ruande in Ruandsko domoljubno fronto, znani tudi kot mirovni sporazum iz Arushe ali pogajanja v Arushi, so bili sklop petih sporazumov (ali protokolov), ki sta jih ruandska vlada in uporniška Ruandska domoljubna fronta (RPF) ob posredovanju podpisali 4. avgusta 1993 v Arushi v Tanzaniji, da bi končali triletno ruandsko državljansko vojno. Pogovori, ki so jih organizirali predvsem Organizacija afriške enotnosti in voditelji držav regije afriških Velikih jezer, so se začeli 12. julija 1992 in končali 4. avgusta 1993, ko so sporazume končno podpisali.

source.title: Arusha Accords (Rwanda)
paragraphs: The Arusha Accords, officially the Peace Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Rwanda and the Rwandan Patriotic Front, also known as the Arusha Peace Agreement or Arusha negotiations, were a set of five accords (or protocols) signed in Arusha, Tanzania, on 4 August 1993, by the government of Rwanda and the rebel Rwandan Patriotic Front (RPF), under mediation, to end a three-year Rwandan Civil War. Primarily organized by the Organisation of African Unity and the heads of state in the African Great Lakes region, the talks began on 12 July 1992, and ended on 4 August 1993, when the accords were finally signed.

Ašantski imperij (asante twi: Asanteman), znan tudi kot Asante, je bil akanska država, ki je od leta 1701 do 1902 obstajala na ozemlju današnje Gane. Iz pokrajine Ašanti se je razširil na večji del Gane ter dele Slonokoščene obale in Toga. Zaradi vojaške moči, bogastva, arhitekture, prefinjene hierarhije, trgovskih mrež in kulture so Ašantski imperij obsežno preučevali in o njem je evropskih, predvsem britanskih, zgodovinskih zapisov več kot o kateri koli drugi domorodni kulturi podsaharske Afrike.

source.title: Asante Empire
paragraphs: The Asante Empire (Asante Twi: Asanteman), also known as the Ashanti Empire, was an Akan state that lasted from 1701 to 1902, in what is now modern-day Ghana. It expanded from the Ashanti Region to include most of Ghana and also parts of Ivory Coast and Togo. Due to the empire's military prowess, wealth, architecture, sophisticated hierarchy, trade networks and culture, the Asante Empire has been extensively studied and has more historic records written by European, primarily British, authors than any other indigenous culture of sub-Saharan Africa.

Assassination of Uthman.headline: Umor kalifa Osmana
paragraphs: Osman ibn Afan, tretji pravoverni kalif, ki je vladal od leta 644 do 656, je bil leta 656 umorjen ob koncu obleganja svoje hiše. Sprva je šlo za protest, ki pa je po smrti enega od protestnikov prerasel v obleganje. Protestniki, ki so postali uporniki, so zahtevali novega kalifa, kar je Osman zavrnil. Protestniki so 17. junija 656 (35 po hidžri) hišo zažgali, vdrli vanjo in ga ubili.

Osmanov umor je tedanjo umo razklal. Odprl je vprašanja ne le o njegovem značaju in politiki, temveč tudi o odnosu med muslimani in državo, o verskih pogledih na upor in vladanje ter o pogojih za vladanje v islamu.

source.title: Assassination of Uthman
paragraphs: Uthman ibn Affan, the third Rashidun caliph, who ruled from 644 to 656, was assassinated at the end of a siege upon his house in 656. This was initially a protest but escalated into a siege following the death of a protester. The protesters-turned-rebels had demanded a new caliph, which Uthman refused. On 17 June 656 (35 AH) protestors set the house on fire, made their way inside, and killed him.

The assassination of Uthman had a polarizing effect on the Ummah at the time. Questions were raised not only regarding his character and policies but also the relationship between Muslims and the state, religious beliefs regarding rebellion and governance, and the qualifications of rulership in Islam.

Assyrian conquest of Egypt.headline: Asirska osvojitev Egipta
paragraphs: Asirska osvojitev Egipta je zajela razmeroma kratko obdobje Novoasirskega cesarstva, od leta 673 do 663 pr. n. št. Asirci si niso le podredili dežele z velikim kulturnim ugledom, temveč so z osvojitvijo Egipta cesarstvu dali tudi največji obseg.

source.title: Assyrian conquest of Egypt
paragraphs: The Assyrian conquest of Egypt covered a relatively short period of the Neo-Assyrian Empire from 673 to 663 BCE. The conquest of Egypt not only placed a land of great cultural prestige under Assyrian rule but also brought the Neo-Assyrian Empire to its greatest extent.

Asirsko obleganje Jeruzalema (ok. 701 pr. n. št.) je bilo prekinjeno obleganje Jeruzalema, tedanje prestolnice Kraljestva Juda, ki ga je izvedel Senaherib, kralj Novoasirskega cesarstva. Obleganje je sklenilo Senaheribov pohod v Levant, v katerem je v pohodu podjarmljanja napadal judovska utrjena mesta in pustošil podeželje. Senaherib je Jeruzalem oblegal, a ga ni zavzel.

Senaheribovi anali opisujejo, kako je kralj judovskega kralja Ezekija zaprl v Jeruzalem »kakor ptico v kletko« in se pozneje, ko je od Jude prejel davek, vrnil v Asirijo. Po hebrejski Bibliji je Ezekija Asiriji plačal 300 talentov srebra in 30 talentov zlata. Svetopisemska zgodba trdi, da je Senaherib z vojsko krenil nad Jeruzalem, a jo je pred mestnimi vrati pokončal angel, zato se je umaknil v Ninive.
Po teoriji svetopisemske arheologije je Ezekija v pripravah na grozeče obleganje zgradil predor Siloam in široki zid v Jeruzalemu.

source.title: Assyrian siege of Jerusalem
paragraphs: The Assyrian siege of Jerusalem (c. 701 BC) was an aborted siege of Jerusalem, then capital of the Kingdom of Judah, carried out by Sennacherib, king of the Neo-Assyrian Empire. The siege concluded Sennacharib's campaign in the Levant, in which he attacked the fortified cities and devastated the countryside of Judah in a campaign of subjugation. Sennacherib besieged Jerusalem, but did not capture it.

Sennacherib's Annals describe how the king trapped Hezekiah of Judah in Jerusalem "like a caged bird" and later returned to Assyria when he received tribute from Judah. In the Hebrew Bible, Hezekiah is described as paying 300 talents of silver and 30 talents of gold to Assyria. The biblical story claims that Sennacherib marched on Jerusalem with his army only to have it struck down near the gates of Jerusalem by an angel, prompting his retreat to Nineveh.
According to biblical archaeological theory, Siloam tunnel and the Broad Wall in Jerusalem were built by Hezekiah in preparation for the impending siege.

Napad na Mers-el-Kébir (bitka pri Mers-el-Kébirju) 3. julija 1940, med drugo svetovno vojno, je bil britanski pomorski napad na ladje francoske vojne mornarice v pomorskem oporišču Mers El Kébir pri Oranu na obali francoske Alžirije. Napad je bil glavni del operacije Katapult, britanskega načrta, da bi francoske ladje onesposobili ali uničili, preden bi po porazu zaveznikov v bitki za Francijo padle v nemške roke. Britansko obstreljevanje oporišča je ubilo 1297 francoskih vojakov, potopilo bojno ladjo in poškodovalo pet drugih ladij, Britanci pa so izgubili pet sestreljenih letal in dva člana posadke. Napad z zraka in morja je izvedla britanska kraljeva vojna mornarica, potem ko je Francija podpisala premirji z Nemčijo in Italijo, ki sta začeli veljati 25. junija.

source.title: Attack on Mers-el-Kébir
paragraphs: The attack on Mers-el-Kébir (Battle of Mers-el-Kébir) on 3 July 1940, during the Second World War, was a British naval attack on French Navy ships at the naval base at Mers El Kébir, near Oran, on the coast of French Algeria. The attack was the main part of Operation Catapult, a British plan to neutralise or destroy French ships to prevent them from falling into German hands after the Allied defeat in the Battle of France. The British bombardment of the base killed 1,297 French servicemen, sank a battleship and damaged five other ships, for a British loss of five aircraft shot down and two crewmen killed. The attack by air and sea was conducted by the Royal Navy, after France had signed armistices with Germany and Italy, coming into effect on 25 June.

Balkan Pact (1953).headline: Balkanski pakt (1953)
paragraphs: Balkanski pakt (grško: Βαλκανικό Σύμφωνο; makedonsko: Балкански пакт; srbohrvaško: Balkanski pakt / Балкански пакт; turško: Balkan Paktı) iz leta 1953, uradno Sporazum o prijateljstvu in sodelovanju, je bil pogodba, ki so jo 28. februarja 1953 podpisale Grčija, Turčija in Jugoslavija. Podpisali so jo v Ankari. Pogodba je bila namenjena odvračanju sovjetskega širjenja na Balkanu in je predvidevala, da bodo tri države sčasoma ustanovile skupni vojaški štab. Ko so pakt sklenili in podpisali, sta bili Turčija in Grčija že leto dni članici Organizacije Severnoatlantske pogodbe (Nato), saj sta se ji obe pridružili 18. februarja 1952, Jugoslavija pa je bila socialistična neuvrščena država, ki je pozneje postala ustanovna članica Gibanja neuvrščenih. Balkanski pakt je Jugoslaviji omogočil, da se je v geopolitičnih zadevah dejansko povezala z Natom, uradno pa ostala nevtralna. Oktobra 1954 je izraelska vlada izrazila zanimanje za pristop k zavezništvu, saj je pričakovala, da bi Jugoslavija lahko posredovala pri razvoju egiptovsko-izraelskih odnosov; jugoslovanske oblasti so bile predlogu naklonjene. Izrael pa se zavezništvu nazadnje ni pridružil.
notes: The Slovene name in the list of names (Balkanski pakt) is dropped, since the text itself is Slovenian.

source.title: Balkan Pact (1953)
paragraphs: The Balkan Pact (Greek: Βαλκανικό Σύμφωνο, Macedonian: Балкански пакт, Serbo-Croatian: Balkanski pakt / Балкански пакт, Slovene: Balkanski pakt, Turkish: Balkan Paktı) of 1953, officially known as the Agreement of Friendship and Cooperation, was a treaty signed by Greece, Turkey and Yugoslavia on 28 February 1953. It was signed in Ankara. The treaty was to act as a deterrence against Soviet expansion in the Balkans and provided for the eventual creation of a joint military staff for the three countries. When the pact was created and signed, Turkey and Greece had been members of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) for a year, having both joined on 18 February 1952, while Yugoslavia was a socialist non-aligned state that later became a founding member of the Non-Aligned Movement. The Balkan Pact allowed Yugoslavia to de facto associate itself with NATO on geopolitical affairs while remaining officially neutral. In October 1954, Israeli government expressed their interest in joining the alliance in expectation that Yugoslavia would act as a mediator in development of the Egypt–Israel relations; Yugoslav authorities were open to the proposal. However, Israel never ended up joining the alliance.

Bamanski imperij ali imperij Ségou (tudi Bambara; bambarsko: ߓߊ߲ߓߊߙߊ߲߫ ߝߊ߯ߡߟߊ, Banbaran Fāmala) je bil ena največjih držav zahodne Afrike v 18. stoletju. Skupaj s Kaarto je bil eden najpomembnejših naslednikov Songajskega imperija. Iz starejšega kraljestva, ustanovljenega leta 1640, je v začetku 18. stoletja pod Bitònom Coulibalyjem zrasel v mogočen imperij. Kot centralizirana država je obstajal od leta 1712 do vdora tukulerskega osvajalca El Hadža Umarja Tala leta 1861.

source.title: Ségou Empire
paragraphs: The Ségou Empire (also Bambara or Bamana Empire, Bambara: ߓߊ߲ߓߊߙߊ߲߫ ߝߊ߯ߡߟߊ, romanized: Banbaran Fāmala) was one of the largest states of West Africa in the 18th century. Along with Kaarta it was one of the most important successors of the Songhai Empire. Based on an earlier kingdom established in 1640, it grew into a powerful empire in the early 18th century under Bitòn Coulibaly. The empire existed as a centralized state from 1712 until the 1861 invasion by the Toucouleur conqueror El Hadj Umar Tall.

Bambatha Rebellion.headline: Bambathov upor
paragraphs: Bambathov upor (znan tudi kot zulujski upor) je bil upor proti kolonialni oblasti v britanski koloniji Natal leta 1906, ki ga je vodil zulujski poglavar Bhambatha iz doline Mpanza (danes okrožja blizu Greytowna). Sprožila ga je nepriljubljena davčna politika natalske kolonialne uprave, ki je še zaostrila gospodarske krize. Kolonialne sile so upor zatrle, pri čemer je umrlo 3000–4000 zulujskih mož in 36 kolonialnih vojakov, med belimi kolonisti v južni Afriki pa je zato narasla podpora združitvi kolonij v regiji, ki naj bi ohranila belsko nadvlado. Leta 1910 so nato ustanovili Južnoafriško unijo.

source.title: Bambatha Rebellion
paragraphs: The Bambatha Rebellion (also known as the Zulu Rebellion) was a 1906 uprising against colonial rule in the British colony of Natal led by the Zulu chief Bhambatha, who lived in the Mpanza Valley (now a district near Greytown). It was sparked by unpopular taxation policies levied by the Natal colonial administration, which exacerbated ongoing economic crises. The suppression of the rebellion by colonial forces resulted in the deaths of 3,000-4,000 AmaZulu men and 36 colonial soldiers, and led to an uptick in support among white colonists in Southern Africa for uniting the various colonies in the region in order to maintain white supremacy. The Union of South Africa was subsequently formed in 1910.

Barbary Crusade.headline: Berberska križarska vojna
paragraphs: Berberska križarska vojna, imenovana tudi križarska vojna proti Mahdiji, je bila francosko-genovska vojaška odprava leta 1390, ki je pripeljala do obleganja Mahdije, tedaj oporišča berberskih piratov v hafsidski Ifrikiji (zemljepisno ustreza današnji Tuniziji). Glavni opis te ene zadnjih križarskih vojn so Froissartove Kronike.

source.title: Barbary Crusade
paragraphs: The Barbary Crusade, also called the Mahdia Crusade, was a Franco-Genoese military expedition in 1390 that led to the siege of Mahdia, then a stronghold of the Barbary pirates in Hafsidi Ifriqiya (geographically corresponding to modern Tunisia). Froissart's Chronicles is the chief account of what was one of the last crusades.

Basus War.headline: Vojna Basus
paragraphs: Vojna Basus (pogosto pisano vojna al Basus; arabsko: ḥarb al-basūs) je slavna pripoved o spopadu iz zbirke ajjām al-ʿarab (»dnevi Arabcev«), po izročilu datirana v pozno predislamsko Arabijo, ki prikazuje rivalstvo plemen Taglib in Bakr. Arabsko zgodovinsko in literarno izročilo jo opisuje kot štiridesetletno plemensko vojno, ki jo je sprožil uboj kamele, ki je pripadala ženski po imenu Basus. Zgodba ima pomembno mesto v arabski literarni kulturi kot slaven svarilni rek pred krvnim maščevanjem, nasiljem med sorodniki in stopnjevanjem spora.

source.title: Basus War
paragraphs: The Basus War (often written al-Basus War; Arabic: حرب البسوس ḥarb al-basūs) is a famous conflict narrative from the corpus of the ayyām al-ʿarab (Days of the Arabs), traditionally dated to late pre-Islamic Arabia and showcasing the rivalry of the tribes of Taghlib and Bakr. In Arabic historical and literary tradition, it is portrayed as a forty-year tribal war triggered by the killing of a camel belonging to a woman named Basus. The story occupies an important place in Arabic literary culture as a famous aphorism warning against vendetta, kin-violence, and escalation.

Basuto Gun War.headline: Basutska vojna za orožje
paragraphs: Basutska vojna za orožje, znana tudi kot basutolandski upor, je bila spopad med Basuti in britansko Kapsko kolonijo. Trajala je od 13. septembra 1880 do 29. aprila 1881 in se končala z basutsko zmago.

Ko je Basutoland 12. marca 1868 postal britansko gospostvo, se je Kapska kolonija lotila njegovega hitrega pozahodenja. Leta 1879 je kapski parlament zakon o ohranjanju miru razširil na Basutoland, da bi razorožil Basute. Zaradi izjemnega pomena orožja v basutski družbi in starih zamer je 13. septembra 1880 izbruhnil upor pod vodstvom poglavarjev Lerotholija in Masophe. Kapske kolonialne sile, ki so bile številčno močno v manjšini in razpršene zaradi hkratnih drugih uporov, niso dosegle odločilne vojaške zmage.

source.title: Basuto Gun War
paragraphs: The Basuto Gun War, also known as the Basutoland Rebellion, was a conflict between the Basuto and the British Cape Colony. It lasted from 13 September 1880 to 29 April 1881 and ended in a Basuto victory.

Following Basutoland's transformation into a British dominion on 12 March 1868, it became the target of rapid westernization efforts by the Cape Colony administration. In 1879, the Cape Parliament extended the Peace Preservation Act to Basutoland, with the aim of disarming the Basuto people. The immense significance of guns in Basuto society, compounded with past grievances, resulted in a rebellion led by chiefs Lerotholi and Masopha, which erupted on 13 September 1880. Heavily outnumbered and stretched thin by the simultaneous outbreak of other revolts, the Cape Colonial Forces failed to achieve a decisive military victory.

Battle for Jerusalem.headline: Bitka za Jeruzalem
paragraphs: Bitka za Jeruzalem je potekala v fazi državljanske vojne v letih 1947–1948, med palestinsko vojno v letih 1947–1949. Judovske in arabske milice v mandatni Palestini, pozneje pa vojski Izraela in Transjordanije, so se bojevale za nadzor nad Jeruzalemom. Po načrtu Združenih narodov za razdelitev Palestine iz leta 1947 naj bi bil Jeruzalem corpus separatum (»ločeno telo«), ki bi ga upravljal mednarodni organ. Kljub temu so v mestu takoj izbruhnili boji med judovskimi in arabskimi milicami, obe strani pa sta izvajali bombne in druge napade.

source.title: Battle for Jerusalem
paragraphs: The Battle for Jerusalem took place during the 1947–1948 civil war phase of the 1947–1949 Palestine war. It saw Jewish and Arab militias in Mandatory Palestine, and later the militaries of Israel and Transjordan, fight for control over the city of Jerusalem. Under the 1947 United Nations Partition Plan for Palestine, Jerusalem was to be a corpus separatum (lit. 'separated body') administered by an international body. Fighting nevertheless immediately broke out in the city between Jewish and Arab militias, with bombings and other attacks being carried out by both sides.

Battle of 73 Easting.headline: Bitka pri 73 Eastingu
paragraphs: Bitka pri 73 Eastingu je 26. februarja 1991, med zalivsko vojno, potekala med koalicijskimi oklepnimi silami (VII. korpus ZDA in britanska 1. oklepna divizija) in iraškimi oklepnimi silami (republikanska garda in divizija Tavakalna). Ime je dobila po koordinatni črti UTM v smeri sever–jug (»easting«, merjen v kilometrih in berljiv na sprejemnikih GPS), ki so jo koalicijske sile uporabljale kot črto faze za merjenje napredovanja po puščavi. Udeleženec bitke poročnik John Mecca jo je pozneje opisal kot »zadnjo veliko tankovsko bitko 20. stoletja«. Potekala je nekaj ur po drugi, manjši tankovski bitki pri Al Busajji.

source.title: Battle of 73 Easting
paragraphs: The Battle of 73 Easting was fought on 26 February 1991, during the Gulf War, between Coalition armored forces (US VII Corps and UK 1st Armoured Division) and Iraqi armored forces (Republican Guard and Tawakalna Division). It was named for a UTM north–south coordinate line (an "Easting", measured in kilometers and readable on GPS receivers) that was used as a phase line by Coalition forces to measure their progress through the desert. The battle was later described by Lt. John Mecca, a participant, as "the last great tank battle of the 20th century." This battle took place several hours after another, smaller, tank battle at Al Busayyah.

Battle of Abu Klea.headline: Bitka pri Abu Klei
paragraphs: Bitka pri Abu Klei, znana tudi kot bitka pri Abu Tulaju, je potekala med 16. in 18. januarjem 1885 pri Abu Klei v Sudanu med britansko puščavsko kolono in mahdističnimi silami, utaborjenimi blizu Abu Klee. Puščavska kolona z okoli 1400 vojaki je iz Kortija v Sudanu krenila 30. decembra 1884; njena naloga v okviru skupne »odprave za rešitev Gordona« je bila prečkati puščavo Bajuda in priskočiti na pomoč generalu Charlesu Georgeu Gordonu v Kartumu v Sudanu, ki so ga tam oblegale mahdistične sile.

Kraj je v britanskih vojaških zapisih splošno znan kot Abu Klea, kar je tedanji britanski zapis njegovega arabskega imena Abu Tulejh (أَبُو طُلَيْح). Britanski poveljnik sir Herbert Stewart je bil v bitki smrtno ranjen.

source.title: Battle of Abu Klea
paragraphs: The Battle of Abu Klea, also known as the Battle of Abu Tulayh, took place between 16 and 18 January 1885, at Abu Klea, Sudan, between the British Desert Column and Mahdist forces encamped near Abu Klea. The Desert Column, a force of approximately 1,400 soldiers, started from Korti, Sudan on 30 December 1884; the Desert Column's mission, in a joint effort titled the "Gordon Relief Expedition", was to march across the Bayuda Desert to the aid of General Charles George Gordon at Khartoum, Sudan, who was besieged there by Mahdist forces.

The place is generally known in British military records as Abu Klea, which arose as a contemporary British spelling of its Arabic name, 'Abu Tͅuleiħ (أَبُو طُلَيْح). The British commander Sir Herbert Stewart was mortally wounded during the battle.

Battle of Abydos.headline: Bitka pri Abidosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Abidosu je bila atenska pomorska zmaga v peloponeški vojni. Špartansko ladjevje pod Mindarjevim poveljstvom je v bitki skušalo rešiti manjše zavezniško ladjevje, ki so ga pregnali na obalo pri Dardanu, a ga je napadlo atensko ladjevje pod Trasibulovim poveljstvom. Boj je bil dolgo izenačen, proti večeru pa je prihod Alkibiada z atenskimi okrepitvami prevesil tehtnico v prid Atencem in Peloponežani so morali pobegniti nazaj v svoje oporišče v Abidosu, pri čemer so med potjo utrpeli hude izgube.

source.title: Battle of Abydos
paragraphs: The Battle of Abydos was an Athenian naval victory in the Peloponnesian War. In the battle, the Spartan fleet, under Mindarus, attempted to rescue a small allied fleet that had been driven ashore at Dardanus, but was attacked by the Athenian fleet, under Thrasybulus. The fighting was evenly contested for a great length of time, but towards evening, the arrival of Alcibiades with Athenian reinforcements tipped the balance in favor of the Athenians, and the Peloponnesians were forced to flee back to their base at Abydos, suffering heavy losses along the way.

Battle of Ad Decimum.headline: Bitka pri Ad Decimum
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ad Decimum je potekala 13. septembra 533 med vojskama Vandalov pod poveljstvom kralja Gelimerja in Bizantinskega cesarstva pod poveljstvom vojskovodje Belizarja.

Vandalsko kraljestvo je pod kraljem Hilderikom ohranjalo tesne vezi s cesarjem Justinijanom I., ker pa je Hilderik namesto arijanstva sprejel kalcedonsko krščanstvo, ga je leta 531 strmoglavil bratranec Gelimer. Justinijan Gelimerjeve oblasti ni hotel priznati in je leta 533 pod Belizarjevim poveljstvom poslal odpravo, da bi obnovil cesarski nadzor nad severno Afriko. Ko se je bizantinska vojska izkrcala pri Caputvadi, je napredovala proti Kartagini, Gelimer pa je v soteski pri Ad Decimum pripravil zasedo z usklajenimi napadi svojega brata Amatasa, nečaka Gibamunda in lastnih sil.

source.title: Battle of Ad Decimum
paragraphs: The Battle of Ad Decimum took place on 13 September 533 between the armies of the Vandals, commanded by King Gelimer, and the Byzantine Empire, under the command of General Belisarius.

The Vandal Kingdom under King Hilderic maintained close ties with Emperor Justinian I, but Hilderic's acceptance of Chalcedonian Christianity over Arianism led to his overthrow by his cousin Gelimer in 531. Refusing to recognize Gelimer's rule, Justinian launched an expedition in 533 under the command of Belisarius to restore imperial control over North Africa. After landing at Caputvada, the Byzantine army advanced toward Carthage, while Gelimer prepared an ambush at the narrows of Ad Decimum using coordinated attacks by his brother Ammatas, his nephew Gibamundus, and his own forces.

Battle of Adrianople (1205).headline: Bitka pri Odrinu (1205)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Odrinu je potekala 14. aprila 1205 v okolici Odrina med Bolgari, Kumani in Vlahi pod poveljstvom bolgarskega carja Kalojana ter križarji pod Balduinom I., ki so ga le nekaj mesecev prej kronali za carigrajskega cesarja, in njihovimi zavezniki Benečani pod dožem Enricom Dandolom. Bitko je po uspešni zasedi dobilo Bolgarsko cesarstvo.

source.title: Battle of Adrianople (1205)
paragraphs: The Battle of Adrianople occurred around Adrianople on April 14, 1205, between Bulgarians, Cumans and Vlachs under the command of Tsar Kaloyan of Bulgaria, and Crusaders under Baldwin I, who only months before had been crowned Emperor of Constantinople, allied with Venetians under Doge Enrico Dandolo. The battle was won by the Bulgarian Empire after a successful ambush.

Battle of Adwa.headline: Bitka pri Advi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Advi je bila odločilna bitka prve italijansko-etiopske vojne. Potekala je 1. marca 1896 blizu mesta Adva med Etiopskim cesarstvom pod cesarjem Menelikom II. in italijanskimi kolonialnimi silami pod vodstvom generala Oresteja Baratierija.

Po sporu o razlagi pogodbe iz Učaleja je Italija skušala Etiopijo prisiliti, da bi spoštovala italijansko različico pogodbe, in ji vsiliti protektorat. Cesar Menelik II. je v odgovor zbral ogromno vojsko, po ocenah od 73.000 do več kot 100.000 mož, večinoma oboroženih s sodobnimi puškami, uvoženimi iz Francije in Rusije. Nasproti so stale precej manjše italijanske kolonialne sile pod generalom Orestejem Baratierijem, ki niso poznale terena in so jih ovirale slabe izvidnice.

source.title: Battle of Adwa
paragraphs: The Battle of Adwa was the climactic battle of the First Italo-Ethiopian War. It was fought on 1 March 1896, near the town of Adwa between the Ethiopian Empire under Emperor Menelik II and an Italian colonial force led by General Oreste Baratieri.

Following a dispute over the interpretation of the Treaty of Wuchale, Italy attempted to force Ethiopia to abide by the Italian version of the treaty and impose a protectorate over Ethiopia. In response, Emperor Menelik II mobilized a massive army, with estimates ranging from 73,000 to over 100,000 men, mostly equipped with modern rifles imported from France and Russia. Facing them was a much smaller Italian colonial force under General Oreste Baratieri, which was unfamiliar with the terrain and hampered by poor reconnaissance.

Battle of Adys.headline: Bitka pri Adisu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Adisu je potekala konec leta 256 pr. n. št. med prvo punsko vojno med kartažansko vojsko, ki so ji skupaj poveljevali Bostar, Hamilkar in Hasdrubal, ter rimsko vojsko pod vodstvom Marka Atilija Regula. Prej tistega leta si je nova rimska vojna mornarica zagotovila premoč na morju in jo izkoristila za vdor v kartažansko domovino, ki je približno ustrezala današnji Tuniziji v severni Afriki. Ko se je ladjevje izkrcalo na polotoku Cap Bon in izvedlo uspešen pohod, se je vrnilo na Sicilijo, Regulu pa je pustilo 15.500 mož, da bi čez zimo obdržal mostišče v Afriki.

source.title: Battle of Adys
paragraphs: The battle of Adys (or Adis) took place in late 256 BC during the First Punic War between a Carthaginian army jointly commanded by Bostar, Hamilcar and Hasdrubal and a Roman army led by Marcus Atilius Regulus. Earlier in the year, the new Roman navy had established naval superiority and used this advantage to invade the Carthaginian homeland, which roughly aligned with modern Tunisia in North Africa. After landing on the Cape Bon Peninsula and conducting a successful campaign, the fleet returned to Sicily, leaving Regulus with 15,500 men to hold the lodgement in Africa over the winter.

Battle of Ajnadayn.headline: Bitka pri Adžnadajnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Adžnadajnu (arabsko: معركة أجنادين) je potekala julija ali avgusta 634 (džumada I ali II leta 13 po hidžri) blizu kraja Bajt Džibrin; bila je prva velika bitka med Bizantinskim (Rimskim) cesarstvom in vojsko arabskega pravovernega kalifata. Končala se je z odločilno muslimansko zmago. Podrobnosti bitke so znane predvsem iz muslimanskih virov, kot je zgodovinar al Vakidi iz 9. stoletja.

source.title: Battle of Ajnadayn
paragraphs: The Battle of Ajnadayn (Arabic: معركة أجنادين) was fought in July or August 634 (Jumada I or II, 13 AH), in a location close to Bayt Jibrin; it was the first major pitched battle between the Byzantine (Roman) Empire and the army of the Arab Rashidun Caliphate. The result of the battle was a decisive Muslim victory. The details of this battle are mostly known through Muslim sources, such as the ninth-century historian al-Waqidi.

Battle of Akroinon.headline: Bitka pri Akroinonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Akroinonu je potekala leta 740 pri Akroinonu ali Akroinosu (blizu današnjega Afyona) v Frigiji, na zahodnem robu anatolske planote, med omajadsko arabsko vojsko in bizantinskimi silami. Arabci so že stoletje redno vpadali v Anatolijo, pohod leta 740 pa je bil največji v zadnjih desetletjih in je obsegal tri ločene divizije.
