Bila je prva bitka pravovernega kalifata, v kateri se je muslimanska vojska odločila razširiti meje zunaj Arabije, s čimer so se začela arabska osvajanja.

source.title: Battle of Chains
paragraphs: The Battle of Sallasil (Arabic: معركة ذات السلاسل Dhat al-Salasil), often referred to as the Battle of Chains, was the first battle fought between the Rashidun Caliphate and the Sasanian Persian Empire in April 633. The battle was fought in Kazima (present day Kuwait) by the forces of Khalid ibn al-Walid and the Persians under Hormozd. It was fought soon after the Ridda Wars were over and the Arabian Peninsula was united under the authority of the Caliph Abu Bakr. Indeed, it was the first battle of the Rashidun Caliphate in which the Muslim army elected to extend its frontiers outside of Arabia, thus initiating the Arab conquests.

Battle of Chaldiran.headline: Bitka pri Čaldiranu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Čaldiranu (perzijsko: جنگ چالدران; turško: Çaldıran Savaşı) je potekala 23. avgusta 1514 in se je končala z odločilno zmago Osmanskega cesarstva nad Safavidskim imperijem. Osmani so safavidskemu Iranu odvzeli vzhodno Anatolijo in gornjo Mezopotamijo. Bitka je pomenila prvo osmansko širitev v vzhodno Anatolijo in ustavila safavidsko širjenje proti zahodu. Bila je šele začetek 41 let uničujoče vojne med Safavidi in Osmani, ki se je končala šele leta 1555 z amasijskim mirom. Safavidi so Mezopotamijo in vzhodno Anatolijo sicer znova osvojili med vladavino Abasa Velikega (vladal 1588–1629), a so ju z zuhabsko pogodbo leta 1639 za vedno prepustili Osmanom.

source.title: Battle of Chaldiran
paragraphs: The Battle of Chaldiran (Persian: جنگ چالدران; Turkish: Çaldıran Savaşı) took place on 23 August 1514 and ended with a decisive victory for the Ottoman Empire over the Safavid Empire. As a result, the Ottomans annexed Eastern Anatolia and Upper Mesopotamia from Safavid Iran. It marked the first Ottoman expansion into Eastern Anatolia, and the halt of the Safavid expansion to the west. The Battle of Chaldiran was just the beginning of 41 years of destructive war between the Safavids and Ottomans, which only ended in 1555 with the Peace of Amasya. Though the Safavids eventually reconquered Mesopotamia and Eastern Anatolia during the reign of Abbas the Great (r. 1588–1629), they would be permanently ceded to the Ottomans by the 1639 Treaty of Zuhab.

Battle of Chios (201 BC).headline: Bitka pri Hiosu (201 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hiosu je potekala leta 201 pr. n. št. med ladjevjem makedonskega kralja Filipa V. in združenim ladjevjem Rodosa, Pergamona, Bizanca in Kizika.

Kretska vojna se je začela leta 205 pr. n. št., ko so Makedonci s svojimi piratskimi in kretskimi zavezniki začeli napadati rodoške ladje, saj je imel Rodos najbogatejše trgovsko ladjevje v Egejskem morju. Mornarice rodoških zaveznikov Pergamona, Bizanca in Kizika so se pridružile rodoškemu ladjevju in nato pred Hiosom premagale makedonsko ladjevje.

source.title: Battle of Chios (201 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Chios was fought in 201 BC between the fleet of Philip V of Macedon and the combined fleet of Rhodes, Pergamum, Byzantium and Cyzicus.

The Cretan War had started in 205 BC when the Macedonians and their pirate and Cretan allies had started attacking Rhodian ships as Rhodes had the richest merchant fleet in the Aegean. The navies of Rhodes' allies Pergamum, Byzantium and Cyzicus joined the Rhodian fleet and then defeated the Macedonian fleet off Chios.

Battle of Chrysopolis.headline: Bitka pri Hrizopolisu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hrizopolisu je potekala 18. septembra 324 med rimskima cesarjema Konstantinom I. in Licinijem blizu Hrizopolisa (današnjega Üsküdarja), nasproti Bizanca (današnjega Istanbula) na azijski obali Bospora. Sledila je Konstantinovi zmagi v bitki v Helespontu, kjer je njegov sin Krisp uničil Licinijevo ladjevje. Licinij je svoje sile iz Bizanca umaknil v Kalcedon (današnji Kadıköy) in zbral ostanke svoje vojske, okrepljene z vizigotskimi pomožnimi enotami in četami sovladarja Martinijana.

Konstantin je prečkal Bospor v Malo Azijo in krenil proti Hrizopolisu. Licinij je postavil svojo vojsko pod tradicionalnimi poganskimi prapori, Konstantin pa je napredoval pod labarumom. Konstantin je neposredno napadel in Licinijeve čete pognal v beg. Antični viri poročajo o hudih Licinijevih izgubah; s preživelimi se je umaknil v Nikomedijo (današnji Izmit).

source.title: Battle of Chrysopolis
paragraphs: The Battle of Chrysopolis was fought on 18 September 324 between the Roman emperors Constantine I and Licinius near Chrysopolis (modern Üsküdar), opposite Byzantium (modern Istanbul) on the Asiatic shore of the Bosphorus. The battle followed Constantine's victory at the Battle of the Hellespont, where his son Crispus destroyed the Licinian fleet. Licinius withdrew his forces from Byzantium to Chalcedon (modern Kadıköy) and gathered the remnants of his army, reinforced by Visigothic auxiliaries and the troops of the co-emperor Martinian.

Constantine crossed the Bosphorus into Asia Minor and marched on Chrysopolis. Licinius drew up his army with the traditional pagan standards, while Constantine advanced under the labarum. Constantine launched a direct attack that routed Licinius' troops. Ancient sources report heavy losses for Licinius, and he retreated with the survivors to Nicomedia (modern Izmit).

Battle of Civetot.headline: Bitka pri Civetotu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Civetotu je potekala 21. oktobra 1096 med silami ljudske križarske vojne in seldžuškimi Turki iz Anatolije. Z bitko se je ljudska križarska vojna končala; nekateri preživeli so se pridružili prvi križarski vojni.

source.title: Battle of Civetot
paragraphs: The Battle of Civetot was fought between the forces of the People's Crusade and of the Seljuk Turks of Anatolia on 21 October 1096. The battle brought an end to the People's Crusade; some of the survivors joined the First Crusade.

Battle of Cnidus.headline: Bitka pri Knidu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Knidu (grško: Ναυμαχία της Κνίδου) je bila vojaška operacija Ahemenidskega imperija proti špartanskemu ladjevju leta 394 pr. n. št. med korintsko vojno. Ladjevje, ki sta mu skupaj poveljevala Farnabaz in nekdanji atenski admiral Konon, je uničilo špartansko ladjevje pod neizkušenim Pisandrom in končalo kratkotrajno špartansko prizadevanje za prevlado na morju.
Izid bitke je močno okrepil protišpartansko koalicijo, ki se je med korintsko vojno upirala špartanski hegemoniji.

source.title: Battle of Cnidus
paragraphs: The Battle of Cnidus (Greek: Ναυμαχία της Κνίδου) was a military operation conducted in 394 BC by the Achaemenid Empire against the Spartan fleet during the Corinthian War. A fleet under the joint command of Pharnabazus and former Athenian admiral, Conon, destroyed the Spartan fleet led by the inexperienced Peisander, ending Sparta's brief bid for naval supremacy.
The battle outcome was a significant boost for the anti-Spartan coalition that resisted Spartan hegemony in the course of the Corinthian War.

Bitka pri Korupediju, imenovana tudi Korupedion ali Kurupedion (starogrško: Κύρου πεδίον ali Κόρου πεδίον, »Kirovo ali Korovo polje«), je bila zadnja bitka med diadohi, tekmujočimi nasledniki Aleksandra Velikega. Potekala je leta 281 pr. n. št. med vojskama Lizimaha in Selevka I. Nikatorja. Lizimah je desetletja vladal Trakiji, od bitke pri Ipsusu pa tudi delom zahodne Male Azije. Nedavno je končno prevzel tudi nadzor nad Makedonijo. Selevk je vladal Selevkidskemu cesarstvu, ki je obsegalo tudi ozemlja današnje vzhodne Turčije, Sirije, Libanona, Izraela, Iraka in Irana. O sami bitki ni znano skoraj nič, razen da jo je dobil Selevk. Lizimah je med boji padel. Po Zgodovini Herakleje Pontske Memnona iz Herakleje ga je ubilo kopje, ki ga je vrgel Malakon, vojak iz Herakleje v Selevkovi službi.

source.title: Battle of Corupedium
paragraphs: The Battle of Corupedium, also called Koroupedion, Corupedion or Curupedion (Ancient Greek: Κύρου πεδίον or Κόρου πεδίον, "the plain of Kyros or Koros") was the last battle between the Diadochi, the rival successors to Alexander the Great. It was fought in 281 BC between the armies of Lysimachus and Seleucus I Nicator. Lysimachus had ruled Thrace for decades and parts of western Asia Minor ever since the Battle of Ipsus. Recently he had finally gained control over Macedon. Seleucus ruled the Seleucid Empire, including lands currently covered by modern eastern Turkey, Syria, Lebanon, Israel, Iraq, and Iran. Almost nothing is known about the battle itself save that Seleucus won the battle. Lysimachus died during the fighting. According to Memnon of Heraclea's History of Heraclea Pontica, Lysimachus was killed by a javelin thrown by Malacon, a Heracleian soldier serving under Seleucus.

Battle of Cos.headline: Bitka pri Kosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kosu je potekala ok. leta 261 pr. n. št. ali celo šele leta 255 pr. n. št. med antigonidskim in ptolemajskim ladjevjem. Antigon II. Gonatas je svoje sile popeljal do zmage, morda nad Patroklom, admiralom Ptolemaja II. Splošno so domnevali, da je bitka močno okrnila ptolemajski nadzor nad Egejskim morjem, a so to izpodbijali. Po bitki je Antigon svojo poveljniško ladjo posvetil Apolonu.
Datum bitke ni gotov, čeprav mora spadati v obdobje 262–256 pr. n. št. Hammond jo datira šele v leto 255 pr. n. št., vse pogosteje pa jo postavljajo v leto 261 pr. n. št.

Sodobni raziskovalci bitko pri Kosu predlagajo kot eno od treh mogočih pomorskih bitk – poleg bitke pri Amorgosu (322 pr. n. št.) in bitke pri Salamini (306 pr. n. št.) –, ob katerih so postavili kip Nike s Samotrake.

source.title: Battle of Cos
paragraphs: The Battle of Cos was fought in c. 261 BC, or as late as 255 BC, between an Antigonid fleet and a Ptolemaic fleet. Antigonus II Gonatas led his forces to victory, possibly over Patroclus, admiral of Ptolemy II. It has been widely assumed that the battle severely damaged Ptolemaic control of the Aegean, but this has been contested After the battle, Antigonus dedicated his flagship to Apollo.
The date of the battle is uncertain, although it must fall within the period 262–256 BC. Hammond dates it as late as 255 BC, but it is now increasingly placed in 261 BC.

The Battle of Cos is proposed by modern scholars as one of three possible naval battles—along with the Battle of Amorgos (322 BC) and the Battle of Salamis (306 BC)—that provided the occasion for the erection of the statue of the Nike of Samothrace.

Battle of Cresson.headline: Bitka pri Cressonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cressonu je bila manjša bitka med frankovskimi in egiptovskimi ajubidskimi silami 1. maja 1187 pri »studencu Cresson«. Natančna lega studenca ni znana, ležal pa je v okolici Nazareta. Spopad je bil uvod v odločilni poraz Jeruzalemskega kraljestva v bitki pri Hattinu dva meseca pozneje.

source.title: Battle of Cresson
paragraphs: The Battle of Cresson was a small battle between Frankish and Egyptian Ayyubid forces on 1 May 1187 at the "Spring of the Cresson." While the exact location of the spring is unknown, it is located in the environs of Nazareth. The conflict was a prelude to the decisive defeat of the Kingdom of Jerusalem at the Battle of Hattin two months later.

Battle of Ctesiphon (1915).headline: Bitka pri Ktezifonu (1915)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ktezifonu (turško: Selman-ı Pak Muharebesi) je potekala novembra 1915 med Britanskim imperijem in Osmanskim cesarstvom v okviru mezopotamske kampanje prve svetovne vojne.

Indijske ekspedicijske sile D, sestavljene večinoma iz indijskih enot pod poveljstvom generala sira Johna Nixona, so bile v osmanskem Iraku uspešne, odkar so se 5. novembra 1914, ko je Osmansko cesarstvo napovedalo vojno, izkrcale na polotoku Al Fav.

Eden glavnih razlogov za mezopotamsko kampanjo je bila obramba rafinerije v Abadanu ob ustju Šat al Araba. Britanska vojska pod vodstvom generala Townshenda je po politiki prednje obrambe odbila vrsto manjših osmanskih sil. Po letu zaporednih porazov pa so osmanske sile v dveh dneh hudih bojev pri Ktezifonu ustavile britansko napredovanje.

source.title: Battle of Ctesiphon (1915)
paragraphs: The Battle of Ctesiphon (Turkish: Selman-ı Pak Muharebesi) was fought in November 1915 by the British Empire, against the Ottoman Empire, within the Mesopotamian Campaign of World War I.

Indian Expeditionary Force D, mostly made up of Indian units and under the command of Gen. Sir John Nixon, had met with success in Ottoman Iraq since it had landed at Al-Faw Peninsula upon the Ottoman Empire's declaration of war on 5 November 1914.

One of the primary reasons for initiating the campaign in Mesopotamia was to defend the oil refinery at Abadan at the mouth of the Shatt al-Arab. Adopting a forward defence policy, the British army under General Townshend fought off a series of small Ottoman forces. Then after a year of a string of defeats, the Ottoman forces were able to halt the British advance in two days of hard fighting at Ctesiphon.

Battle of Ctesiphon (363).headline: Bitka pri Ktezifonu (363)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ktezifonu je potekala 29. maja 363 med vojskami rimskega cesarja Julijana in vojsko Sasanidskega imperija (med vladavino Šapurja II.) pred obzidjem perzijske prestolnice Ktezifon. Rimljani so zmagali, a pohoda nazadnje niso mogli nadaljevati, ker so bili predaleč od oskrbovalnih poti.

source.title: Battle of Ctesiphon (363)
paragraphs: The Battle of Ctesiphon took place on 29 May 363 between the armies of Roman Emperor Julian and an army of the Sasanian Empire (during Shapur II's reign) outside the walls of the Persian capital Ctesiphon. The battle resulted in a Roman victory, but eventually the Roman forces found themselves unable to continue their campaign as they were too far from their supply lines.

Battle of Cuito Cuanavale.headline: Bitka pri Cuito Cuanavaleju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cuito Cuanavaleju je s presledki potekala med 14. avgustom 1987 in 23. marcem 1988 južno in vzhodno od Cuito Cuanavaleja v Angoli, med angolsko državljansko vojno in južnoafriško mejno vojno, med Ljudskimi oboroženimi silami za osvoboditev Angole (FAPLA) in Kubo na eni strani ter Južno Afriko in Narodno zvezo za popolno neodvisnost Angole (UNITA) na drugi. Bila je največji spopad angolskega konflikta in največja konvencionalna bitka na afriški celini po drugi svetovni vojni. UNITA in njeni južnoafriški zavezniki so premagali veliko ofenzivo FAPLA proti Mavingi in ohranili nadzor UNITA nad južno Angolo. Poznejša protiofenziva okoli reke Tumpo vzhodno od Cuito Cuanavaleja je ustavila prodiranje FAPLA, ni pa odstranila vseh preostalih položajev FAPLA.

source.title: Battle of Cuito Cuanavale
paragraphs: The Battle of Cuito Cuanavale was fought intermittently between 14 August 1987 and 23 March 1988, south and east of Cuito Cuanavale, Angola, by the People's Armed Forces for the Liberation of Angola (FAPLA) and Cuba against South Africa and the National Union for the Total Independence of Angola (UNITA) during the Angolan Civil War and South African Border War. The battle was the largest engagement of the Angolan conflict and the biggest conventional battle on the African continent since World War II. UNITA and its South African allies defeated a major FAPLA offensive towards Mavinga, preserving UNITA's control of southern Angola. A subsequent counteroffensive was launched around the Tumpo River east of Cuito Cuanavale, and succeeded in ending FAPLA advances but failed to eliminate all remaining FAPLA positions.

Bitka pri Kunaksi je pozno poleti leta 401 pr. n. št. potekala med perzijskim kraljem Artakserksom II. in njegovim bratom Kirom Mlajšim za ahemenidski prestol. Velika bitka Kirovega upora je potekala 70 km severno od Babilona, pri Kunaksi (grško: Κούναξα) na levem bregu Evfrata. Glavni vir je Ksenofont, grški vojak, ki je sodeloval v bojih. Čeprav so grški najemniki in Kirove perzijske čete s skupnim delovanjem v bitki uspeli, sta izid bitke in smrt pretendenta na prestol pomenila poraz vsega upora, Grki pa so se morali podati na Anabazo, umik v domovino.

source.title: Battle of Cunaxa
paragraphs: The Battle of Cunaxa was fought in the late summer of 401 BC between the Persian king Artaxerxes II and his brother Cyrus the Younger for control of the Achaemenid throne. The great battle of the revolt of Cyrus took place 70 km north of Babylon, at Cunaxa (Greek: Κούναξα), on the left bank of the Euphrates. The main source is Xenophon, a Greek soldier who participated in the fighting. Despite the success in the battle achieved by the interaction of the Greek mercenaries and the Persian troops of Cyrus, the outcome of the battle and the death of the pretender to the throne led to the defeat of the entire uprising and forced Greeks to commit Anabasis.

Battle of Cynossema.headline: Bitka pri Kinosemi
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Kinosemi (starogrško: Κυνὸς σῆμα) je potekala leta 411 pr. n. št. med drugo peloponeško vojno. Atensko ladjevje pod poveljstvom Trasibula in Trasila je v bitki tesno zmagalo, čeprav ga je številčno močnejše špartansko ladjevje sprva potisnilo v obrambo. Zmaga je imela učinek, ki je daleč presegal njen taktični pomen, saj je prišla v času, ko je tradicionalno atensko demokratično vlado nadomestila oligarhija in bi atenski poraz lahko končal vojno. Atensko ladjevje je z novo samozavestjo v Helespontu v hitrem zaporedju doseglo še dve zmagi, druga je bila silovit poraz Špartancev pri Kiziku, ki je odpravil neposredno špartansko grožnjo atenski življenjski povezavi s Črnim morjem.

source.title: Battle of Cynossema
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Cynossema (Ancient Greek: Κυνὸς σῆμα) took place in 411 BC during the Second Peloponnesian War. In the battle, an Athenian fleet commanded by Thrasybulus and Thrasyllus, although initially thrown on the defensive by a numerically superior Spartan fleet, won a narrow victory. This victory had an impact out of proportion to its tactical significance, coming when Athens' traditional democratic government had been replaced by an oligarchy and an Athenian defeat could have ended the war. The newly confident Athenian fleet proceeded to win two more victories in the Hellespont in quick succession, the second being the dramatic rout at Cyzicus, which ended the immediate Spartan threat to Athens' Black Sea lifeline.

Battle of Cyzicus.headline: Bitka pri Kiziku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kiziku (grško: Kyzikos) je potekala maja ali junija 410 pr. n. št. med peloponeško vojno. Atensko ladjevje pod poveljstvom Alkibiada, Trasibula in Teramena je v bitki pognalo v beg in uničilo špartansko ladjevje pod Mindarjevim poveljstvom. Zmaga je Atenam v naslednjem letu omogočila, da so znova prevzele nadzor nad več mesti v Helespontu. Po porazu so Špartanci ponudili mir, ki so ga Atenci zavrnili.

source.title: Battle of Cyzicus
paragraphs: The Battle of Cyzicus (Greek: Kyzikos) took place in May or June 410 BC during the Peloponnesian War. During the battle, an Athenian fleet commanded by Alcibiades, Thrasybulus, and Theramenes routed and destroyed a Spartan fleet commanded by Mindarus. The victory allowed Athens to recover control over a number of cities in the Hellespont over the next year. In the wake of their defeat, the Spartans made a peace offer, which the Athenians rejected.

Battle of Dakar.headline: Bitka pri Dakarju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dakarju, znana tudi kot operacija Menace, je bila neuspešen poskus zaveznikov septembra 1940, da bi zavzeli strateško pristanišče Dakar v Francoski Zahodni Afriki (današnjem Senegalu). Upali so, da bi uspeh operacije strmoglavil Nemčiji naklonjeno vichyjsko upravo v koloniji, ki bi jo nadomestila zaveznikom naklonjena uprava Svobodne Francije pod generalom Charlesom de Gaullom.

source.title: Battle of Dakar
paragraphs: The Battle of Dakar, also known as Operation Menace, was an unsuccessful attempt in September 1940 by the Allies to capture the strategic port of Dakar in French West Africa (modern-day Senegal). It was hoped that the success of the operation could overthrow the pro-German Vichy French administration in the colony, and be replaced by a pro-Allied Free French one under General Charles de Gaulle.

Battle of Damascus (2012).headline: Bitka za Damask (2012)
paragraphs: Bitka za Damask (arabsko: معركة دمشق), znana tudi kot operacija Damaški vulkan, se je začela 15. julija 2012 med sirsko državljansko vojno. Na tisoče upornikov se je z okoliškega podeželja prikradlo v Damask. Po nekaterih poročilih so opozicijske sile nato sprožile operacijo za zavzetje prestolnice, po drugih pa je vojska za obsežno uporniško operacijo izvedela vnaprej in udarila preventivno. Po nekaterih poročilih naj bi uporniki operacijo začeli prezgodaj, ker so varnostne sile odkrile njihove načrte.

Uporniki so sprva zavzeli pol ducata četrti in v bombnem napadu ubili štiri visoke vladne ministre, po vojaškem protinapadu pa so se morali umakniti; vojska je po treh tednih bojev obdržala nadzor nad prestolnico. V središču Damaska so tedaj prvič uporabili tanke in helikopterje, deli mesta pa so ostali bojišče.

source.title: Battle of Damascus (2012)
paragraphs: The Battle of Damascus (Arabic: معركة دمشق), also known as Operation Damascus Volcano (Arabic: عملية بركان دمشق), started on 15 July 2012 during the Syrian civil war. Thousands of rebels infiltrated Damascus from the surrounding countryside. Following this, according to some reports, the opposition forces launched an operation to capture the capital, while according to other reports, the military learned of the large-scale rebel operation beforehand and made a preemptive strike. Some reports even suggested the rebels launched the operation prematurely due to their plans being discovered by the security forces.

After the rebels initially captured half a dozen districts and killed four high-ranking government ministers in a bombing, opposition forces were forced to retreat following a military counter-attack, leaving the army in control of the capital after three weeks of fighting. It was the first time tanks and helicopters had been deployed in central Damascus and left parts of the city as a warzone.

Battle of Damghan (1729).headline: Bitka pri Damganu (1729)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Damganu (perzijsko: نبرد دامغان) ali bitka pri Mehmandustu je potekala od 29. septembra do 5. oktobra 1729 blizu mesta Damgan. Končala se je s prepričljivo zmago Naderja in safavidske stvari, za katero se je zavzel. Sama po sebi Ašrafove oblasti v Iranu ni končala, bila pa je pomemben uspeh, ki je pripeljal do nadaljnjih zmag v pohodu za vrnitev Tahmaspa II. na prestol. Bitki je sledila še bitka pri Murče Hortu, vasi blizu Isfahana. Naderjeve sile so zmagale v obeh, zato je lahko gildžajsko afganistansko dinastijo odstranil s perzijskega prestola, na katerem je bila le kratek čas. Hotaki so se morali umakniti na svoje ozemlje na jugu današnjega Afganistana.

source.title: Battle of Damghan (1729)
paragraphs: The Battle of Damghan (Persian: نبرد دامغان) or Battle of Mehmandoost (Persian: نبرد مهماندوست) was fought on 29 September to 5 October 1729, near the city of Damghan. It resulted in an overwhelming victory for Nader and the Safavid cause he had taken up. Although it by itself did not end Ashraf's rule in Iran, it was a significant triumph which led to further successes in the following engagements of the campaign to restore Tahmasp II to the throne. The battle was followed by another one in Murcheh-Khort, a village near Isfahan. Nader's forces were victorious in both battles, which led him to remove the Ghilzai Afghan dynasty from their short stay on the Persian throne. The Hotakis were forced back to their territory in what is now southern Afghanistan.

Battle of Dara.headline: Bitka pri Dari
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dari je potekala junija 530 n. št. med Bizantinskim cesarstvom in Sasanidskim imperijem v iberski vojni.

Ko so diplomatska prizadevanja bizantinskega cesarja Justinijana I. in šaha Kavada I. propadla, je sasanidska vojska krenila nad utrjeno mesto Daro, kjer jo je pričakala manjša bizantinska vojska pod poveljstvom Belizarja. Čeprav je bil v manjšini, je Belizar pred obzidjem trdnjave pripravil obrambni položaj z jarki, ki so ščitili pehoto in določali, kje bodo potekali spopadi, da bi izravnal sasanidsko številčno premoč. Po dveh dneh praske in neuspešnih pogajanj se je glavna bitka končala z bizantinsko zmago. Disciplinirano razporejena konjenica na krilih je skupaj z usklajenimi protinapadi razbila sasanidski krili in Sasanide pognala v beg.

Kljub porazu so Sasanidi naslednje leto znova začeli napadati, kar se je končalo z bizantinskim porazom v bitki pri Kaliniku. Poleti 532 so podpisali pogodbo o večnem miru, s katero so Bizantinci Sasanidom plačevali davek.

source.title: Battle of Dara
paragraphs: The Battle of Dara was fought between the Byzantine Empire and the Sasanian Empire in June 530 AD during the Iberian War.

Following the collapse of diplomatic efforts between the Byzantine Emperor Justinian I and Shah Kavadh I, a Sasanian army advanced on the fortified city of Dara, where it was met by a smaller Byzantine force commanded by Belisarius. Despite being outnumbered, Belisarius prepared a defensive position outside the fort's walls, using trenches to protect the infantry and control the locations of engagements to offset the Sasanian numerical advantage. After two days of skirmishing and unsuccessful negotiations, the main battle ended in a Byzantine victory. Disciplined cavalry deployments on the flanks, combined with coordinated counterattacks, shattered the Sasanian wings and triggered a Sasanian rout.

Despite the defeat, the Sasanians resumed offensive operations the following year, culminating in the Byzantine defeat at the Battle of Callinicum. The Perpetual Peace treaty was signed in the summer of 532, where the Byzantines paid tribute to the Sasanians.

Battle of Derna (1805).headline: Bitka pri Derni (1805)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Derni v Kirenajki je bila vojaški spopad aprila in maja 1805, v katerem je sodelovala najemniška vojska, ki so jo zbrali in vodili ameriški marinci pod poveljstvom poročnika ameriške kopenske vojske Williama Eatona, diplomatskega konzula v Tripoliju, in nadporočnika ameriškega marinskega korpusa Presleyja O'Bannona. Del operacije je bil 839 km dolg pohod prek libijske puščave od Aleksandrije v Egiptu do vzhodnega pristaniškega mesta Derna, ki ga je branila precej večja vojska.

Bitka pri Derni in širša prva berberska vojna sta pokazali, s kakšnimi težavami so se Združene države Amerike v prvih letih obstoja kot država spopadale pri boju proti piratstvu in uveljavljanju svojih interesov v Sredozemlju. To je bilo tudi prvo tuje vojaško posredovanje v zgodovini ZDA.
notes: The miles (521 mi) are dropped.

source.title: Battle of Derna (1805)
paragraphs: The Battle of Derna at Derna, Cyrenaica, was a military engagement in April–May 1805 of a mercenary army recruited and led by United States Marines under the command of U.S. Army Lieutenant William Eaton, diplomatic Consul to Tripoli, and U.S. Marine Corps First Lieutenant Presley O'Bannon. The battle involved a 521-mile (839-km) march through the Libyan Desert from Alexandria, Egypt, to the eastern port city of Derna, which was defended by a much larger force.

The Battle of Derna and the broader First Barbary War highlighted the challenges faced by the United States in dealing with piracy and asserting its interests in the Mediterranean during the early years of its existence as a nation. It was also the first foreign military intervention in U.S. history.

Battle of Djahy.headline: Bitka pri Džahiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Džahiju je bila velika kopenska bitka med silami faraona Ramzesa III. in morskimi ljudstvi, ki so hotela vdreti v Egipt in ga osvojiti. Spopad je potekal na skrajni vzhodni meji Egiptovskega imperija v Džahiju, današnjem južnem Libanonu, v osmem letu Ramzesa III. oziroma ok. 1178 pr. n. št.

Egipčani pod vodstvom Ramzesa III. so v bitki porazili morska ljudstva, ki so skušala vdreti v Egipt po kopnem in morju. Skoraj vse, kar o bitki vemo, izvira iz Ramzesovega pogrebnega templja v Medinet Habuju. Opis bitke in ujetnikov je podrobno zapisan na zidovih templja, kjer je tudi najdaljši znani hieroglifski napis. Reliefi v templju prikazujejo številne zvezane ujetnike, poražene v bitki.

source.title: Battle of Djahy
paragraphs: The Battle of Djahy was a major land battle between the forces of Pharaoh Ramesses III and the Sea Peoples who intended to invade and conquer Egypt. The conflict occurred on the Egyptian Empire's easternmost frontier in Djahy, or modern-day southern Lebanon, in the eighth year of Ramesses III or about c. 1178 BC.

In this battle the Egyptians, led by Ramesses III, defeated the Sea Peoples, who were attempting to invade Egypt by land and sea. Almost all that is known about the battle comes from the mortuary temple of Ramesses III in Medinet Habu. The description of the battle and prisoners is documented in detail on the temple's walls, which also contain the longest hieroglyphic inscription known. Temple reliefs feature many bound prisoners defeated in battle.

Bitka pri Džerbi (turško: Cerbe Deniz Muharebesi; arabsko: معركة جربة) je potekala maja 1560 blizu otoka Džerba v Tuniziji. Osmani pod poveljstvom Pialija paše so premagali veliko skupno ladjevje krščanskega zavezništva, ki so ga sestavljale predvsem španske, papeške, genovske, malteške in neapeljske sile. Zavezniki so izgubili 27 galej in nekaj manjših plovil ter utrjeni otok Džerbo. Zmaga je bila morda vrhunec osmanske moči v Sredozemskem morju.

Do okoli leta 1573 je bilo Sredozemlje na vrhu španskih prednostnih nalog pod španskim kraljem Filipom II. (1556–1598); pod njegovim vodstvom se je habsburško ladjevje galej povečalo na okoli 100 ladij, v vojni pa še več. Španija je leta 1560 proti Turkom poslala veliko ladjevje, katerega cilj je bil otok Džerba pred obalo zahodno od Tripolija. Ladjevje je zavzelo obalo in po dolgih nesoglasjih med poveljniki zgradilo trdnjavo, ki naj bi pozneje služila za ponovno osvojitev Tripolija za viteze hospitalce, ki so mu od leta 1530 do 1551 vladali, preden so ga izgubili v korist Osmanov.

source.title: Battle of Djerba
paragraphs: The Battle of Djerba (Turkish: Cerbe Deniz Muharebesi, Arabic: معركة جربة) took place in May 1560 near the island of Djerba, Tunisia. The Ottomans under Piali Pasha's command overwhelmed a large joint Christian alliance fleet, composed chiefly of Spanish, Papal, Genoese, Maltese, and Neapolitan forces. The allies lost 27 galleys and some smaller vessels as well as the fortified island of Djerba. This victory marked perhaps the high point of Ottoman power in the Mediterranean Sea.

Until about 1573 the Mediterranean headed the list of Spanish priorities under Philip II of Spain (1556–98); under his leadership the Habsburg galley fleet increased to about 100 ships, and more in wartime. Spain sent a major fleet against the Turks in 1560, aiming for the island of Djerba off the coast west of Tripoli. The fleet took the coast and, after much division between their commanders, built a fortress, hoping to use it to later reconquer Tripoli for the Knights Hospitaller, who had ruled it from 1530 and 1551 before their fall to the Ottomans.

Battle of Dogali.headline: Bitka pri Dogaliju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dogaliju je potekala 26. januarja 1887 med Italijo in Etiopijo pri Dogaliju blizu Masave v Medri Bahriju, drugače znanem kot Eritreja.

source.title: Battle of Dogali
paragraphs: The Battle of Dogali was fought on 26 January 1887 between Italy and Ethiopia in Dogali near Massawa, in Medri Bahri otherwise known as Eritrea.

Battle of Dorylaeum (1147).headline: Bitka pri Dorileju (1147)
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Dorileju je potekala blizu Dorileja oktobra 1147 med drugo križarsko vojno. Sestavljala jo je vrsta spopadov v več dneh. Seldžuški Turki pod vodstvom sultana Mesuda I. so premagali nemške križarske sile Konrada III.

source.title: Battle of Dorylaeum (1147)
paragraphs: The second Battle of Dorylaeum took place near Dorylaeum in October 1147 during the Second Crusade. The battle consisted of a series of encounters over several days. The German Crusader forces of Conrad III were defeated by the Seljuk Turks led by Sultan Mesud I.

Battle of Dumlupınar.headline: Bitka pri Dumlupınarju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dumlupınarju (grško: Μάχη του Τουμλού Μπουνάρ, Máchi tou Toumloú Bounár; turško: Dumlupınar (Meydan) Muharebesi, dobesedno »(poljska) bitka pri Dumlupınarju«), v Turčiji znana tudi kot poljska bitka vrhovnega poveljnika (turško: Başkumandanlık Meydan Muharebesi), je bila ena pomembnih bitk grško-turške vojne (1919–1922), dela turške osamosvojitvene vojne. Potekala je od 26. do 30. avgusta 1922 blizu Dumlupınarja v provinci Kütahya v Turčiji.

source.title: Battle of Dumlupınar
paragraphs: The Battle of Dumlupınar (Greek: Μάχη του Τουμλού Μπουνάρ, romanized: Máchi tou Toumloú Bounár, Turkish: Dumlupınar (Meydan) Muharebesi, lit. 'Dumlupınar (Field) Battle'), also known as the Field Battle of the Commander-in-Chief (Turkish: Başkumandanlık Meydan Muharebesi) in Turkey, was one of the important battles in the Greco-Turkish War (1919–1922) (part of the Turkish War of Independence). The battle was fought from 26 to 30 August 1922 near Dumlupınar, Kütahya in Turkey.

Battle of El Agheila.headline: Bitka pri El Agheili
paragraphs: Bitka pri El Agheili je bila kratek spopad kampanje v Zahodni puščavi v drugi svetovni vojni. Potekala je decembra 1942 med zavezniškimi silami osme armade (general Bernard Montgomery) in silami osi nemško-italijanske oklepne armade (generalfeldmaršal Erwin Rommel), med dolgim umikom sil osi od El Alameina proti Tunisu. Osma armada je nameravala sile osi med umikom proti Tunisu obiti in ujeti v past.

Načrt osme armade se je izjalovil, ko je italijanska zaščitnica odbila čelni napad britanske 7. oklepne divizije, novozelandske enote, ki so obhajale sovražnika, pa so se v puščavi razkropile. Spopad se je končal z umikom nemško-italijanske oklepne armade v Tripolitanijo proti Tuniziji, kjer se je z operacijo Torch, zavezniško invazijo na francosko severno Afriko (8.–16. novembra 1942), začela tunizijska kampanja.

source.title: Battle of El Agheila
paragraphs: The Battle of El Agheila was a brief engagement of the Western Desert Campaign of the Second World War. It took place in December 1942 between Allied forces of the Eighth Army (General Bernard Montgomery) and the Axis forces of the German-Italian Panzer Army (Generalfeldmarschall Erwin Rommel), during the long Axis withdrawal from El Alamein to Tunis. The Eighth Army planned to outflank and trap the Axis forces as they withdrew to Tunis.

The Eighth Army plan was thwarted when a frontal attack by the British 7th Armoured Division was repulsed by an Italian rearguard action and the outflanking New Zealand units became dispersed in the desert. The engagement ended with the German-Italian Panzer Army withdrawing into Tripolitana towards Tunisia, where the Tunisia Campaign had begun with the Operation Torch the Allied invasion of French North Africa (8–16 November 1942).

Battle of El Guettar.headline: Bitka pri El Guettarju
paragraphs: Bitka pri El Guettarju je potekala od 23. marca do 3. aprila 1943 v južni osrednji Tuniziji med tunizijsko kampanjo druge svetovne vojne. V njej so se deli armadne skupine Afrika pod poveljstvom generala Hansa-Jürgena von Arnima skupaj z italijansko 1. armado pod generalom Giovannijem Messejem bojevali proti ameriškemu II. korpusu pod generalpodpolkovnikom Georgeom Pattonom. Bila je prva bitka, v kateri so ameriške sile premagale izkušene italijanske in nemške tankovske enote, vendar je bilo nadaljevanje po bitki neodločeno.

source.title: Battle of El Guettar
paragraphs: The Battle of El Guettar took place from 23 March – 3 April 1943, in south-central Tunisia during the Tunisia Campaign of World War II. It was fought by elements of the Army Group Africa under General Hans-Jürgen von Arnim, along with Italian First Army under General Giovanni Messe, against the U.S. II Corps under Lieutenant General George Patton. It was the first battle in which U.S. forces were able to defeat the experienced Italian and German tank units, but the followup to the battle was inconclusive.

Battle of Elbistan.headline: Bitka pri Elbistanu
paragraphs: Egiptovski sultan Bajbars je 15. aprila 1277 iz Sirije vkorakal v Rumski sultanat Seldžukov, ki je bil pod mongolsko prevlado, in v bitki pri Elbistanu (Abulustajnu) napadel mongolske zasedbene sile. Mongolske sile so sprva prevladovale, bitko pa je odločila verjetno številčna premoč egiptovskih mameluških sil. Zmaga je omejila mongolski vpliv v Mali Aziji in pripeljala do odprtih sovražnosti med mameluškim sultanatom v Egiptu in mongolskim Ilkanatom.

source.title: Battle of Elbistan
paragraphs: On April 15, 1277, the Sultan of Egypt Baybars marched from Syria into the Mongol-dominated Seljuk Sultanate of Rûm and attacked the Mongol occupation force in the Battle of Elbistan (Abulustayn). While the Mongol forces initially gained the upper hand, the likely superior numbers of the Egyptian Mamluk forces decided the battle. The victory limited Mongol influence in Asia Minor and led to open hostilities between the Mamluk Sultanate of Egypt and the Mongol Ilkhanate.

Battle of Elli.headline: Bitka pri Elli
paragraphs: Bitka pri Elli (grško: Ναυμαχία της Έλλης; turško: İmroz Deniz Muharebesi) ali bitka v Dardanelah je potekala blizu ustja Dardanel 16. decembra (po starem koledarju 3. decembra) 1912 v prvi balkanski vojni med ladjevjema Kraljevine Grčije in Osmanskega cesarstva. Bila je največja pomorska bitka balkanskih vojn.

source.title: Battle of Elli
paragraphs: The Battle of Elli (Greek: Ναυμαχία της Έλλης, Turkish: İmroz Deniz Muharebesi) or the Battle of the Dardanelles took place near the mouth of the Dardanelles on 16 December [O.S. 3 December] 1912 as part of the First Balkan War between the fleets of the Kingdom of Greece and the Ottoman Empire. It was the largest sea battle of the Balkan Wars.

Battle of Emesa.headline: Bitka pri Emesi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Emesi je potekala leta 272 med rimskimi vojskami pod vodstvom cesarja Avrelijana ter palmirskimi silami pod vodstvom cesarice Zenobije in generala Zabde.

source.title: Battle of Emesa
paragraphs: The Battle of Emesa was fought in 272 between the Roman armies led by their emperor Aurelian and the Palmyrene forces led by their empress, Zenobia and general Zabdas.

Battle of Erzincan (1916).headline: Bitka pri Erzincanu (1916)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Erzincanu (rusko: Эрзинджанское сражение; turško: Erzincan Muharebesi) je bila ruska zmaga nad Osmanskim cesarstvom med prvo svetovno vojno.

Nikolaj Judenič je februarja 1916 zavzel mesti Erzurum in Trabzon. Trabzon je Rusom dal pristanišče, kamor so lahko prihajale okrepitve na Kavkazu. Enver paša je tretji armadi, ki ji je tedaj poveljeval Vehip paša, ukazal, naj znova zavzame Trabzon. Vehipov napad ni uspel in general Judenič je 2. julija sprožil protinapad. Ruski napad je zadel turško komunikacijsko središče Erzincan, zato so se morale Vehipove enote umakniti, izgubile pa so 34.000 mož, polovico kot ujetnike. Tretja armada je bila zato do konca leta onesposobljena, Erzincan pa so zavzeli Rusi.

source.title: Battle of Erzincan (1916)
paragraphs: The Battle of Erzincan (Russian: Эрзинджанское сражение, Turkish: Erzincan Muharebesi) was a Russian victory over the Ottoman Empire during the First World War.

In February 1916, Nikolai Yudenich had taken the cities of Erzurum and Trabzon. Trabzon had provided the Russians with a port to receive reinforcements in the Caucasus. Enver Pasha ordered the Third Army, now under Vehip Pasha, to retake Trabzon. Vehip's attack failed and General Yudenich counterattacked on July 2. The Russian attack hit the Turkish communications center of Erzincan forcing Vehip's troops to retreat as well as losing 34,000 men, half taken as POWs. As a result, the Third Army was rendered ineffective for the rest of the year and Erzincan was captured by the Russians.

Battle of Fahl.headline: Bitka pri Fahlu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Fahlu (arabsko: Yawm Faḥl), znana tudi kot bitka v močvirjih (Yawm al-Radagha) in bitka pri Bejsanu (Yawm Baysān), je bila velika bitka muslimanske osvojitve bizantinske Sirije, v kateri so se arabske čete pravovernega kalifata decembra 634 ali januarja 635 spopadle z bizantinskimi silami pri Peli (Fahl) in bližnjem Skitopolisu (Bejsan) v dolini Jordana ali v njuni bližini.

Bizantinske čete, ki jih je še bolel poraz v bitki pri Adžnadajnu, so se znova zbrale v Peli ali Skitopolisu, muslimani pa so jim sledili. Muslimanska konjenica je le s težavo prečkala razmočena tla okoli Bejsana, saj so Bizantinci prekopali namakalne jarke, da bi območje poplavili in zaustavili muslimansko napredovanje. Muslimani so Bizantince nazadnje premagali, ti pa naj bi utrpeli ogromne izgube. Pela je nato padla, Bejsan in bližnja Tiberija pa sta se po kratkih obleganjih vdala odredom muslimanskih čet.

source.title: Battle of Fahl
paragraphs: The Battle of Fahl (Arabic: يوم فحل, romanized: Yawm Faḥl), also known as the Battle of the Marshes (Yawm al-Radagha) and the Battle of Beisan (Yawm Baysān), was a major battle in the Muslim conquest of Byzantine Syria fought by the Arab troops of the Rashidun Caliphate and Byzantine forces at or near Pella (Fahl) and nearby Scythopolis (Beisan), both in the Jordan Valley, in December 634 or January 635.

Byzantine troops smarting from their rout by the Muslims at the battle of Ajnadayn had regrouped in Pella or Scythopolis and the Muslims pursued them there. The Muslim cavalry faced difficulty traversing the muddied grounds around Beisan as the Byzantines cut irrigation ditches to flood the area and stave off the Muslim advance. The Muslims ultimately defeated the Byzantines, who are said to have suffered enormous casualties. Pella was subsequently captured, while Beisan and nearby Tiberias capitulated after short sieges by detachments of Muslim troops.

Battle of Fakhkh.headline: Bitka pri Fahu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Fahu (arabsko: yawm Fakhkh, dobesedno »dan Faha«) je potekala 11. junija 786 med silami Abasidskega kalifata in privrženci alidskega upora v Meki pod vodstvom al Huseina ibn Alija al Abida, potomca Hasana ibn Alija.

Husein in njegovi privrženci so načrtovali vstajo v Medini med vsakoletnim romanjem hadž leta 786, a jih je k prehitremu ukrepanju prisilil spor s tamkajšnjim guvernerjem al Umarijem. Zarotniki so se uprli zjutraj 16. maja in zasedli Prerokovo mošejo, kjer so mu privrženci prisegli zvestobo. Upor med prebivalstvom ni dobil podpore, odziv abasidske posadke pa je upornikom preprečil, da bi prevzeli nadzor nad mestom, in jih nazadnje zaprl v samo mošejo. Po enajstih dneh so Alidi in njihovi privrženci, okoli 300 mož, zapustili Medino in krenili proti Meki.

source.title: Battle of Fakhkh
paragraphs: The Battle of Fakhkh (Arabic: يوم فخ, romanized: yawm Fakhkh, lit. 'Day of Fakhkh') was fought on 11 June 786 between the forces of the Abbasid Caliphate and the supporters of an Alid rebellion in Mecca under al-Husayn ibn Ali al-Abid, a descendant of Hasan ibn Ali.

Husayn and his supporters planned an uprising at Medina during the annual Hajj pilgrimage of 786, but their hand was forced by a confrontation with the local governor, al-Umari. The conspirators rose in revolt on the morning of 16 May, and seized the Prophet's Mosque, where Husayn's supporters swore allegiance to him. The revolt failed to gather support among the populace, and the reaction of the Abbasid garrison prevented the rebels from establishing control over the city, and eventually confined them to the Mosque itself. After eleven days, the Alids and their supporters, some 300 strong, abandoned Medina and headed to Mecca.

Battle of Firaz.headline: Bitka pri Firazu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Firazu (arabsko: مَعْرَكَة الْفِرَاض), znana tudi kot bitka pri Firadu, je potekala okoli januarja 634 med pravovernim kalifatom in, kot pravijo viri, združenimi silami Bizantinskega in Sasanidskega cesarstva.

source.title: Battle of Firaz
paragraphs: The Battle of Firaz (Arabic: مَعْرَكَة الْفِرَاض) also known as Battle of Firad, took place around January 634 between the Rashidun Caliphate and, reportedly, a combined force from the Byzantine Empire and Sasanian Empire.

Battle of Forbie.headline: Bitka pri La Forbieju
paragraphs: Bitka pri La Forbieju, znana tudi kot bitka pri Forbieju ali bitka pri Hiribji, je potekala 17. in 18. oktobra 1244 med zavezniškimi vojskami (iz Jeruzalemskega kraljestva, križarskih redov in odpadlih Ajubidov iz Damaska, Homsa in Keraka) in egiptovsko vojsko ajubidskega sultana as Saliha Ajuba, okrepljeno s horezmijskimi najemniki. Zmaga Ajubidov je sprožila poziv k sedmi križarski vojni in pomenila zlom krščanske moči v Sveti deželi.

source.title: Battle of Forbie
paragraphs: The Battle of Forbie, also known as the Battle of La Forbie or the Battle of Hiribya, was fought on October 17–18, 1244 between the allied armies (drawn from the Kingdom of Jerusalem, the Crusading orders, the breakaway Ayyubids of Damascus, Homs, and Kerak) and the Egyptian army of the Ayyubid Sultan as-Salih Ayyub, reinforced with Khwarezmian mercenaries. The resulting Ayyubid victory led to the call for the Seventh Crusade and marked the collapse of Christian power in the Holy Land.

Bitka pri Gabieni je bila druga velika bitka med Antigonom Enookim in Evmenom, dvema naslednikoma Aleksandra Velikega (t. i. diadohoma). Potekala je blizu Gabiene v Perziji pozimi 316–315 pr. n. št. in končala drugo diadoško vojno. Antigona je uveljavila kot najmočnejšega med nasledniki.

Ker edino poročilo o bitki izvira od Evmenovega osebnega pomočnika Hieronima iz Kardije (pozneje ga je posredoval zgodovinar Diodor), ki je pozneje prestopil k Antigonu, ponuja edinstven pogled z obeh strani.

source.title: Battle of Gabiene
paragraphs: Battle of Gabiene was the second great battle between Antigonus Monophthalmus and Eumenes, two of Alexander the Great's successors (the so-called Diadochi). The battle was fought near Gabiene in Persia in the winter of 316-315 BC and ended the Second War of the Diadochi. It established Antigonus as the most powerful of the successors.

Since the sole reference of this battle is ultimately from Eumenes' personal aide Hieronymus of Cardia (later transmitted through the historian Diodorus), who later switched his allegiance to Antigonus, he provides a unique perspective from both sides' point of view.

Battle of Gabon.headline: Bitka za Gabon
paragraphs: Bitka za Gabon (francosko: Bataille du Gabon), imenovana tudi gabonska kampanja (Campagne du Gabon), je potekala novembra 1940 med drugo svetovno vojno. Sile pod poveljstvom generala Charlesa de Gaulla so v njej vichyjski Franciji iztrgale kolonijo Gabon in njeno prestolnico Libreville, Francoska Ekvatorialna Afrika pa se je pridružila Svobodni Franciji.

source.title: Battle of Gabon
paragraphs: The Battle of Gabon (French: Bataille du Gabon), also called the Gabon Campaign (Campagne du Gabon), occurred in November 1940 during World War II. The battle resulted in forces under the orders of General Charles de Gaulle taking the colony of Gabon and its capital, Libreville, from Vichy France, and the rallying of French Equatorial Africa to Free France.

Battle of Gallipoli (1416).headline: Bitka pri Galipoliju (1416)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Galipoliju je potekala 29. maja 1416 med ladjevjema Beneške republike in Osmanskega cesarstva pred pristaniškim mestom Galipoli, glavnim osmanskim pomorskim oporiščem. Bitka je bila osrednji dogodek kratkega spopada med silama, do katerega je prišlo zaradi osmanskih napadov na posesti in ladje Benečanov in njihovih zaveznikov v Egejskem morju v letih 1414–1415. Beneško ladjevje pod poveljstvom Pietra Loredana je imelo nalogo, da k osmanskemu sultanu prepelje beneško poslanstvo, smelo pa je napasti, če bi Osmani zavrnili pogajanja. Poznejši dogodki so znani predvsem iz podrobnega pisma, ki ga je Loredan napisal po bitki.

source.title: Battle of Gallipoli (1416)
paragraphs: The Battle of Gallipoli occurred on 29 May 1416 between the fleets of the Republic of Venice and the Ottoman Empire off the port city of Gallipoli, the main Ottoman naval base. The battle was the main episode of a brief conflict between the two powers, resulting from Ottoman attacks against possessions and shipping of the Venetians and their allies in the Aegean Sea in 1414–1415. The Venetian fleet, under Pietro Loredan, was charged with transporting a Venetian embassy to the Ottoman sultan, but was authorized to attack if the Ottomans refused to negotiate. The subsequent events are known chiefly from a detailed letter written by Loredan after the battle.

Battle of Garni.headline: Bitka pri Garniju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Garniju (gruzijsko: გარნისის ბრძოლა; armensko: Գառնիի ճակատամարտ) je potekala leta 1225 blizu Garnija na ozemlju današnje Armenije, tedaj dela Kraljestva Gruzije. Napadalno Horezmijsko cesarstvo je vodil njegov zadnji sultan Džalal ad Din Mangburni, ki ga je Mongolski imperij pregnal iz njegovega kraljestva in je skušal znova osvojiti izgubljena ozemlja. Bitka se je končala s horezmijsko zmago in zaradi izdaje velja za katastrofo v gruzijski zgodovini. Dvor gruzijske kraljice Rusudan (1223–1245) se je zato preselil v Kutaisi, država pa je bila med poznejšimi mongolskimi vpadi v Gruzijo izpostavljena plenjenju.

source.title: Battle of Garni
paragraphs: The Battle of Garni (Georgian: გარნისის ბრძოლა, Armenian: Գառնիի ճակատամարտ) was fought in 1225 near Garni, in modern day Armenia, then part of the Kingdom of Georgia. The invading Khwarazmian Empire was led by Jalal al-Din Mangburni, its last sultan, who had been driven from his realm by the Mongol Empire and was trying to recapture lost territories. The battle ended with a Khwarezmid victory and is marked as a disastrous event in Georgian history due to betrayal. As a result, the royal court of Georgian Queen Rusudan (1223–1245) moved to Kutaisi and the country was exposed to subsequent looting during the Mongol invasions of Georgia.

Battle of Gaza (2007).headline: Bitka za Gazo (2007)
paragraphs: Bitka za Gazo, znana tudi kot državljanska vojna v Gazi, je bila kratka državljanska vojna med Fatahom in Hamasom, ki je od 7. do 15. junija 2007 potekala v Gazi. Bila je vidni dogodek spora med Fatahom in Hamasom, osredotočen na boj za oblast po padcu vlade narodne enotnosti Hamasa in Fataha, ki so jo kmalu zatem razpustili. Tako so se palestinska ozemlja dejansko razdelila na dve tvorbi: Zahodni breg, ki ga upravlja Palestinska narodna oblast (PNA), in Gazo, ki jo upravlja Hamas. Hamasovi borci so prevzeli nadzor nad Gazo, uradnike Fataha pa so zajeli, usmrtili ali izgnali. Palestinski center za človekove pravice je poročal, da je bilo v bojih ubitih najmanj 161 ljudi, ranjenih pa več kot 700.

source.title: Battle of Gaza (2007)
paragraphs: The Battle of Gaza, also known as the Gaza civil war, was a brief civil war between Fatah and Hamas that took place in the Gaza Strip from 7 to 15 June 2007. It was a prominent event in the Fatah–Hamas conflict, centered on the struggle for power after the fall of the National Unity Government between Hamas and Fatah, which was dissolved shortly afterwards. This led to the de facto division of the Palestinian territories into two entities: the West Bank governed by the Palestinian National Authority (PNA), and the Gaza Strip governed by Hamas. Hamas fighters took control of the Gaza Strip, while Fatah officials were either taken as prisoners, executed, or expelled. The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported that at least 161 people were killed and more than 700 were wounded during the fighting.

Battle of Gaza (312 BC).headline: Bitka pri Gazi (312 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gazi leta 312 pr. n. št. je potekala med napadalno vojsko Ptolemaja I. Soterja in njegovega zaveznika Selevka I. Nikatorja ter branilsko vojsko Demetrija I. Makedonskega, sina Antigona I. Enookega. Bila je del tretje diadoške vojne in je potekala blizu mesta Gaza.

Konec leta 312 pr. n. št. je Ptolemaj iz Egipta vdrl v Levant: z 18.000 pešci in 4000 konjeniki je krenil ob severnem robu Sinajskega polotoka. Demetrij je pravočasno dobil obveščevalne podatke, vojake odpoklical iz zimskih taborov in jih zbral pri Gazi. Svetovalci so mu, kot kaže, svetovali, naj se izogne spopadu z vojaško izkušenejšima Ptolemajem in Selevkom, a je nasvet prezrl; spopad se je končal z njegovim odločilnim porazom, Ptolemaj in Selevk pa sta nato lahko prevzela ozemlje, ki ga je nadzoroval.

source.title: Battle of Gaza (312 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Gaza of 312 BC, was fought between the invading army of Ptolemy I Soter and his ally Seleucus I Nicator and the defending army of Demetrius I of Macedon, son of Antigonus I Monophthalmus. The battle was part of the Third War of the Diadochi and was fought near the city of Gaza.

In late 312 BC, Ptolemy launched an invasion into the Levant from Egypt, he marched with 18,000 infantry and 4,000 cavalry along the northern edge of the Sinai Peninsula. Receiving timely intelligence, Demetrius recalled his troops from their winter quarters and concentrated them at Gaza. Demetrius' advisors had apparently told him to avoid a military confrontation with Ptolemy and Seleucus, who had more military experience, but he ignored their advice; the conflict ended in a decisive defeat for Demetrius, subsequently enabling the absorption of his controlled territory by Ptolemy and Seleucus.

Bitka pri Gazali, imenovana tudi ofenziva pri Gazali (italijansko: Battaglia di Ain el-Gazala; nemško: Schlacht von Gazala), je potekala od 26. maja do 21. junija 1942 blizu vasi Gazala zahodno od pristanišča Tobruk v Libiji, med kampanjo v Zahodni puščavi v drugi svetovni vojni. Enote sil osi, nemške (Panzerarmee Afrika; generalpolkovnik Erwin Rommel) in italijanske, so se bojevale proti britanski osmi armadi (general sir Claude Auchinleck, tudi vrhovni poveljnik za Bližnji vzhod), ki so jo sestavljale predvsem enote britanske Skupnosti narodov, indijske enote in enote Svobodne Francije.

source.title: Battle of Gazala
paragraphs: The Battle of Gazala, also the Gazala Offensive (Italian: Battaglia di Ain el-Gazala; German: Schlacht von Gazala), was fought near the village of Gazala during the Western Desert Campaign of the Second World War, west of the port of Tobruk in Libya, from 26 May to 21 June 1942. Axis troops consisting of German (Panzerarmee Afrika; Generaloberst Erwin Rommel) and Italian units fought the British Eighth Army (General Sir Claude Auchinleck, also Commander-in-Chief Middle East) composed mainly of British Commonwealth, Indian and Free French troops.

Battle of Gibraltar (1607).headline: Bitka pri Gibraltarju (1607)
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Gibraltarju je potekala 25. aprila 1607 med osemdesetletno vojno, ko je nizozemsko ladjevje presenetilo in napadlo špansko ladjevje, zasidrano v Gibraltarskem zalivu. V štirih urah boja je bila večina španskih ladij uničena.

source.title: Battle of Gibraltar (1607)
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Gibraltar took place on 25 April 1607, during the Eighty Years' War, when a Dutch fleet surprised and engaged a Spanish fleet anchored at the Bay of Gibraltar. During the four hours of action, most of the Spanish ships were destroyed.

Battle of Gondar.headline: Bitka pri Gondarju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gondarju ali zavzetje Gondarja je bila zadnji odpor italijanskih sil v Italijanski Vzhodni Afriki med drugo svetovno vojno. Potekala je novembra 1941, med vzhodnoafriško kampanjo. Gondar je bil glavno mesto Amhare v gorah severno od jezera Tana v Etiopiji, na nadmorski višini 2100 m, v njem pa je bila italijanska posadka s 40.000 možmi pod poveljstvom generala Guglielma Nasija.
notes: The feet conversion (7,000 ft) is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Gondar
paragraphs: The Battle of Gondar or Capture of Gondar was the last stand of the Italian forces in Italian East Africa during the Second World War. The battle took place in November 1941, during the East African Campaign. Gondar was the main town of Amhara in the mountains north of Lake Tana in Ethiopia, at an elevation of 7,000 ft (2,100 m) and had an Italian garrison of 40,000 men, commanded by Generale Guglielmo Nasi.

Battle of Grand Port.headline: Bitka pri Grand Portu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Grand Portu je potekala od 20. do 27. avgusta 1810 v pristanišču Grand Port med britansko in francosko vojno mornarico za to pristanišče, v okviru mavricijske kampanje v letih 1809–1811. Britanska eskadra štirih fregat pod poveljstvom kapitana Samuela Pyma je skušala blokirati Grand Port v francoski koloniji Isle de France tako, da bi zavzela utrjeni otoček Île de la Passe pri vhodu v pristanišče. Britanska desantna skupina je položaj zavzela 13. avgusta, ko pa se je devet dni pozneje zalivu približala francoska eskadra pod poveljstvom fregatnega kapitana Guy-Victorja Duperréja, se je Pym odločil, da jo zvabi v obalne vode, kjer bi jo njegove sile lahko napadle iz zasede.

source.title: Battle of Grand Port
paragraphs: The Battle of Grand Port was fought on 20–27 August 1810 in the harbour of Grand Port between the British and French navies over the harbour of Grand Port as part of the Mauritius campaign of 1809–1811. A British squadron of four frigates under Captain Samuel Pym sought to blockade Grand Port in the French colony of Isle de France by capturing the fortified Île de la Passe at the port's entrance. The position was seized by a British landing party on 13 August, and when a French squadron under Frigate Captain Guy-Victor Duperré approached the bay nine days later, Pym decided to lure them into coastal waters where his forces could ambush them.

Battle of Gulnabad.headline: Bitka pri Gulnabadu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gulnabadu (paštunsko: Dh Gulonābād Jaghrha; perzijsko: Nabard-e Golūnābād) je potekala v nedeljo, 8. marca 1722, med vojaškimi silami dinastije Hotaki in vojsko Safavidskega imperija. Še bolj je zapečatila propad safavidske dinastije, ki je zatonila že desetletja.

source.title: Battle of Gulnabad
paragraphs: The Battle of Gulnabad (Pashto: د ګلون اباد جګړه, romanized: Dh Gulonābād Jaghrha; Persian: نبرد گلون‌آباد, romanized: Nabard-e Golūnābād) was fought between the military forces from the Hotak dynasty and the army of the Safavid Empire on Sunday, March 8, 1722. It further cemented the eventual fall of the Safavid dynasty, which had been declining for decades.

Battle of Hab.headline: Bitka pri Habu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Habu (arabsko: معركة هاب), znana tudi kot druga bitka pri Tel Danitu, je potekala 14. avgusta 1119, ko je križarska vojska pod poveljstvom jeruzalemskega kralja Balduina II. dosegla sporno zmago nad muslimansko vojsko Ilgazija iz Mardina, saj si je zmago pripisala tudi muslimanska vojska. Bitka je stabilizirala Antiohijsko kneževino, ki je le nekaj tednov prej doživela katastrofalen poraz. Balduin je znova zavzel vse gradove, ki jih je osvojil Ilgazi, in mu preprečil pohod nad Antiohijo.

source.title: Battle of Hab
paragraphs: The Battle of Hab (Arabic: معركة هاب), also known as the Second Battle of Tell Danith, occurred on 14 August 1119, where a Crusader army commanded by King Baldwin II of Jerusalem won a disputed victory over a Muslim army led by Ilghazi of Mardin since the Muslim army claimed it as a victory also. The battle stabilised the Principality of Antioch, which had suffered a disastrous defeat only weeks before. Baldwin managed to re-take all of the castles conquered by Ilghazi and prevented him from marching on Antioch.

Battle of Harim.headline: Bitka pri Harimu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Harimu (Harenc) je potekala 12. avgusta 1164 pri Harimu v Siriji med silami Nur ad Dina in združeno vojsko Tripolitanske grofije, Antiohijske kneževine, Bizantinskega cesarstva in Armenije. Nur ad Din je prepričljivo zmagal in zajel večino voditeljev nasprotne vojske.

source.title: Battle of Harim
paragraphs: The Battle of Harim (Harenc) was fought on 12 August 1164 at Harim, Syria, between the forces of Nur ad-Din, and a combined army from the County of Tripoli, the Principality of Antioch, the Byzantine Empire, and Armenia. Nur ad-Din won a crushing victory, capturing most of the leaders of the opposing army.

Battle of Hazir.headline: Bitka pri Haziru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Haziru ali Maarakah al Hadhir (arabsko: معركة الحاضر) je potekala med bizantinsko vojsko in elitno konjenico pravovernega kalifata, premično gardo. Potekala je junija 637, tri milje vzhodno od Kinasrina pri Al Hadhirju v današnji Siriji.

source.title: Battle of Hazir
paragraphs: The Battle of Hazir or Ma'arakah al-Haadhir (Arabic: معركة الحاضر) took place between the Byzantine army and the Rashidun army's elite cavalry, the Mobile guard. It took place in June 637, three miles east of Qinnasrin at Al-Hadher in present-day Syria.

Bitka za Heliopolis ali Ajn Šams je bila odločilna bitka leta 640 med arabskimi muslimanskimi vojskami in silami Bizantinskega cesarstva za nadzor nad Egiptom. Čeprav je po njej prišlo še do več večjih spopadov, je dejansko odločila usodo bizantinske oblasti v Egiptu in odprla pot muslimanski osvojitvi rimskega afriškega eksarhata.

source.title: Battle of Heliopolis
paragraphs: The Battle of Heliopolis or Ayn Shams was a decisive battle in 640 between Arab Muslim armies and Byzantine Empire forces for the control of Egypt. Though there were several major skirmishes after this battle, it effectively decided the fate of the Byzantine rule in Egypt, and opened the door for the Muslim conquest of the Roman Exarchate of Africa.

Battle of Heliopolis (1800).headline: Bitka pri Heliopolisu (1800)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Heliopolisu je potekala 20. marca 1800 pri Heliopolisu med francosko Vzhodno armado pod poveljstvom generala Jean-Baptista Kléberja in osmansko vojsko. Zmagali so Francozi, ki so Osmanom prizadejali več kot 9000 žrtev, sami pa so imeli le 600 mrtvih ali ranjenih.

source.title: Battle of Heliopolis (1800)
paragraphs: The Battle of Heliopolis was fought between the French Army of the Orient under the command of General Jean-Baptiste Kléber and an Ottoman army at Heliopolis on 20 March 1800. The French were victorious, inflicting over 9,000 casualties on the Ottomans while suffering only 600 killed or wounded.

Battle of Hira.headline: Bitka pri Hiri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hiri (arabsko: معركة الحيرة) je potekala med Sasanidskim imperijem in pravovernim kalifatom leta 633. Bila je ena zgodnjih bitk muslimanske osvojitve Perzije. Izguba obmejnega mesta ob Evfratu je odprla pot do sasanidske prestolnice Ktezifon ob Tigrisu.

source.title: Battle of Hira
paragraphs: The Battle of Hira (Arabic: معركة الحيرة) was fought between the Sasanian Empire and the Rashidun Caliphate in 633. It was one of the early battles of the Muslim conquest of Persia. The loss of the frontier city on the Euphrates River opened the way to the Sasanian capital, Ctesiphon, on the Tigris River.

Battle of Holy Apostles Monastery.headline: Bitka pri samostanu Svetih apostolov
paragraphs: Bitka pri samostanu Svetih apostolov je bila oborožen spopad med silami Osmanskega cesarstva in armensko milico pri samostanu Svetih apostolov (Arakelots) blizu Muša v Osmanskem cesarstvu novembra 1901.

source.title: Battle of Holy Apostles Monastery
paragraphs: The Battle of Holy Apostles Monastery was an armed conflict between Ottoman Empire forces and Armenian militia at the Holy Apostles (Arakhelots) Monastery near Mush, Ottoman Empire in November 1901.

Battle of Hormozdgan.headline: Bitka pri Hormozdganu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hormozdganu (pisano tudi Hormizdagan in Hormozgan) je bila odločilna bitka med dinastijama Arsakidov in Sasanidov, ki je potekala 28. aprila 224. Sasanidska zmaga je zlomila moč partske dinastije, dejansko končala skoraj pet stoletij partske vladavine v Iranu in uradno začela sasanidsko dobo.

source.title: Battle of Hormozdgan
paragraphs: The Battle of Hormozdgan (also spelled Hormizdagan and Hormozgan) was the climactic battle between the Arsacid and the Sasanian dynasties that took place on 28 April 224. The Sasanian victory broke the power of the Parthian dynasty, effectively ending almost five centuries of Parthian rule in Iran, and marking the official start of the Sasanian era.

Bitka pri Hunajnu (arabsko: Ġazwat Ḥunayn) je bila spopad med muslimani islamskega preroka Mohameda in plemeni Kajs po osvojitvi Meke. Potekala je leta 8 po hidžri (ok. 630) v dolini Hunajn na poti od Meke do Taifa. Končala se je z odločilno zmago muslimanov in je ena redkih bitk, ki jih Koran omenja po imenu, in sicer v suri at Tauba.

source.title: Battle of Hunayn
paragraphs: The Battle of Hunayn (Arabic: غَزْوَة حُنَيْن, romanized: Ġazwat Ḥunayn) was a conflict between the Muslims of the Islamic prophet Muhammad and the tribes of Qays in the aftermath of the conquest of Mecca. The battle took place in 8 AH (c. 630) in the Hunayn valley on the route from Mecca to Taif. The battle ultimately ended in a decisive victory for the Muslims, and it is one of the few battles mentioned by name in the Quran, where it appears in Surat at-Tawbah.

Battle of Iconium (1190).headline: Bitka pri Ikoniju (1190)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ikoniju (včasih imenovana bitka pri Konyi) je potekala 18. maja 1190 med tretjo križarsko vojno, na pohodu Friderika Barbarosse v Sveto deželo. Ikonij, prestolnica Rumskega sultanata pod Kilidž Arslanom II., je zato padel v roke cesarskih sil.

source.title: Battle of Iconium (1190)
paragraphs: The Battle of Iconium (sometimes referred as the Battle of Konya) took place on May 18, 1190, during the Third Crusade, in the expedition of Frederick Barbarossa to the Holy Land. As a result, Iconium, the capital city of the Sultanate of Rûm under Kilij Arslan II, fell to the Imperial forces.

Battle of Imbros.headline: Bitka pri Imbrosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Imbrosu je bila pomorski spopad med prvo svetovno vojno. Zgodila se je 20. januarja 1918, ko je osmanska eskadra pred otokom Imbros v Egejskem morju napadla flotiljo britanske kraljeve vojne mornarice. Ker na tem območju ni bilo težkih zavezniških vojnih ladij, sta se osmanska bojna križarka Yavuz Sultan Selim in lahka križarka Midilli lahko podali v Sredozemsko morje ter pri Imbrosu napadli monitorje in rušilce kraljeve mornarice, nato pa še pomorsko oporišče v Mudrosu.

Čeprav so osmanske sile dosegle cilj in uničile monitorje pri Imbrosu, se je bitka zanje slabo končala, saj sta ladji med umikom zapluli v minsko polje. Midilli se je potopila, Yavuz Sultan Selim pa je bila hudo poškodovana. Yavûz Sultân Selîm se je sicer uspela nasesti v Dardanelah, a je bila več dni izpostavljena zračnim napadom, dokler je niso odvlekli na varno. Ker je bila najsodobnejša križarka osmanske vojne mornarice potopljena, edina bojna križarka pa onesposobljena, je bitka do konca vojne dejansko okrnila napadalne zmogljivosti osmanske mornarice.

source.title: Battle of Imbros
paragraphs: The Battle of Imbros was a naval action that took place during the First World War. The battle occurred on 20 January 1918 when an Ottoman squadron engaged a flotilla of the British Royal Navy off the island of Imbros in the Aegean Sea. A lack of heavy Allied warships in the area allowed the Ottoman battlecruiser Yavuz Sultan Selim and light cruiser Midilli to sortie into the Mediterranean and attack the Royal Navy monitors and destroyers at Imbros before assaulting the naval base at Mudros.

Although the Ottoman forces managed to complete their objective of destroying the monitors located at Imbros, the battle turned sour for them as they sailed through a minefield while withdrawing. Midilli was sunk and Yavuz Sultan Selim heavily damaged. Although Yavûz Sultân Selîm managed to beach herself within the Dardanelles, she was subjected to days of air attacks until she was towed to safety. With the most modern cruiser of the Ottoman Navy sunk, and its only battlecruiser out of action, the battle effectively curtailed the Ottoman Navy's offensive capability until the end of the war.

Battle of Immae.headline: Bitka pri Imah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Imah je potekala leta 272 med rimsko vojsko cesarja Avrelijana in vojskami Palmirskega cesarstva, katerega voditeljica, cesarica Zenobija, si je prisvojila rimski nadzor nad vzhodnimi provincami.

source.title: Battle of Immae
paragraphs: The Battle of Immae was fought in 272 between the Roman army of Emperor Aurelian, and the armies of the Palmyrene Empire, whose leader, Empress Zenobia, had usurped Roman control over the eastern provinces.

Battle of Inab.headline: Bitka pri Inabu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Inabu, imenovana tudi bitka pri Ard al Hatimu ali Fons Muratus, je potekala 29. junija 1149, med drugo križarsko vojno. Zengidska vojska atabega Nur ad Dina Zengija je uničila združeno vojsko antiohijskega kneza Rajmonda in asasinov Alija ibn Vafe. Knez je padel, Antiohijsko kneževino pa so nato izropali in zmanjšali, saj se je njena vzhodna meja pomaknila proti zahodu.

source.title: Battle of Inab
paragraphs: The Battle of Inab, also called Battle of Ard al-Hâtim or Fons Muratus, was fought on 29 June 1149, during the Second Crusade. The Zengid army of the atabeg Nur al-Din Zengi destroyed the combined army of Prince Raymond of Antioch and the Assassins of Ali ibn-Wafa. The prince was killed, and the Principality of Antioch was subsequently pillaged and reduced in size as its eastern border was pushed west.
Bitka pri Ipsusu (starogrško: Ἱψός) je potekala leta 301 pr. n. št. blizu mesta Ipsus v Frigiji med nasledniki Aleksandra Velikega (imenovanimi diadohi).

Antigon I. Monoftalmos, grško-makedonski vladar velikih delov Azije, in njegov sin Demetrij sta se spopadla s koalicijo treh drugih Aleksandrovih naslednikov: Kasandra, vladarja Makedonije, Lizimaha, vladarja Trakije, in Selevka I. Nikatorja, vladarja Babilonije in Perzije.

source.title: Battle of Ipsus
paragraphs: The Battle of Ipsus (Ancient Greek: Ἱψός) was fought between the successors of Alexander the Great (referred to as the Diadochi) in 301 BC near the town of Ipsus in Phrygia.

Antigonus I Monophthalmus, the Greek Macedonian ruler of large parts of Asia, and his son Demetrius were pitted against the coalition of three other successors of Alexander: Cassander, ruler of Macedon; Lysimachus, ruler of Thrace; and Seleucus I Nicator, ruler of Babylonia and Persia.

Battle of Isandlwana.headline: Bitka pri Isandlwani
paragraphs: Bitka pri Isandlwani (tudi Isandhlwana) 22. januarja 1879 je bila drugi večji spopad angleško-zulujske vojne med Britanskim imperijem in Kraljestvom Zulujev – bitko pri Nyezaneju je prej istega dne izbojevala in dobila obalna kolona polkovnika Pearsona. Enajst dni po britanskem vdoru v Kraljestvo Zulujev v južni Afriki je zulujska vojska z okoli 20.000 bojevniki napadla del glavne britanske kolone, ki ga je sestavljalo okoli 1800 britanskih, kolonialnih in domačih vojakov ter okoli 350 civilistov. Zuluji so bili oboroženi predvsem s tradicionalnimi železnimi sulicami asegaji in ščiti iz kravje kože, imeli pa so tudi nekaj mušket in zastarelih pušk.

source.title: Battle of Isandlwana
paragraphs: The Battle of Isandlwana (alternative spelling: Isandhlwana) on 22 January 1879 was the second major encounter in the Anglo-Zulu War between the British Empire and the Zulu Kingdom – the Battle of Nyezane having been fought and won earlier on the same day by Colonel Pearson's Coastal Column. Eleven days after the British invaded the Zulu Kingdom in Southern Africa, a Zulu force of some 20,000 warriors attacked a portion of the British main column consisting of approximately 1,800 British, colonial and native troops with approximately 350 civilians. The Zulus were equipped mainly with the traditional assegai iron spears and cow-hide shields, but also had a number of muskets and antiquated rifles.

Battle of Isly.headline: Bitka pri Isliju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Isliju (arabsko: معركة إيسلي) je potekala 14. avgusta 1844 med Francijo in Marokom blizu reke Isly. Francoske sile pod poveljstvom maršala Thomasa Roberta Bugeauda so pognale v beg veliko večjo, a slabo organizirano maroško vojsko, večinoma bojevnike iz plemen Beni Snasen, pa tudi Beni Angad in Beni Ukil, ki ji je poveljeval Mohamed, sin maroškega sultana Abd ar Rahmana. Bugeaud, ki je hotel dokončati francosko osvojitev Alžirije, je bitko sprožil brez vojne napovedi, da bi pogajanja o maroški podpori vodji alžirskega odpora Abd el Kadru izsilil pod pogoji, ugodnimi za Francoze, ki so od maroškega sultana zahtevali, naj Abd el Kadru odtegne podporo.
Bugeaud, ki je zaplenil šotor in dežnik maroškega poveljnika (kar je ustrezalo zaplembi vojaškega prapora v evropskem vojskovanju), je za zmago dobil naziv vojvoda Islyjski.
Dan po bitki se je začelo bombardiranje Mogadorja.

source.title: Battle of Isly
paragraphs: The Battle of Isly (Arabic: معركة إيسلي) was fought on August 14, 1844, between France and Morocco, near the Isly River. French forces under Marshal Thomas Robert Bugeaud routed a much larger, but poorly organized, Moroccan force, mainly fighters from the tribes of Beni Snassen, but also from the Beni Angad and Beni Oukil; under Muhammad, son of the Sultan of Morocco, Abd al-Rahman. Bugeaud, attempting to complete the French conquest of Algeria, instigated the battle without a declaration of war in order to force negotiations concerning Moroccan support for the Algerian resistance leader Abd el-Kader to conclude on terms favorable to the French who demanded the Sultan of Morocco to withdraw support for Abd el-Kader.
Bugeaud, who recovered the Moroccan commander's tent and umbrella (equivalent to capturing a military standard in European warfare), was made Duke of Isly for his victory.
The day following the battle, the Bombardment of Mogador started.

Battle of Jaffa (1192).headline: Bitka pri Jafi (1192)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Jafi je potekala med križarskimi vojnami kot eden od vrste pohodov med vojsko sultana Saladina (Ṣalāḥ al-Dīn Yūsuf ibn Ayyūb) in križarskimi silami pod vodstvom angleškega kralja Riharda I. (znanega kot Rihard Levjesrčni). Bila je zadnja bitka tretje križarske vojne, po kateri sta se Saladin in kralj Rihard lahko dogovorila o premirju. Križarji Jeruzalema sicer niso znova dobili v posest, krščanski romarji pa so smeli v mesto, križarji pa so obdržali nadzor nad precejšnjim pasom ozemlja od Bejruta do Jafe.

source.title: Battle of Jaffa (1192)
paragraphs: The Battle of Jaffa took place during the Crusades, as one of a series of campaigns between the army of Sultan Saladin (Ṣalāḥ al-Dīn Yūsuf ibn Ayyūb) and the Crusader forces led by King Richard I of England (known as Richard the Lionheart). It was the final battle of the Third Crusade, after which Saladin and King Richard were able to negotiate a truce. Although the Crusaders did not regain possession of Jerusalem, Christian pilgrims were permitted entry into the city, and the Crusaders were able to retain control of a sizable strip of land stretching from Beirut to Jaffa.

Battle of Jalula.headline: Bitka pri Džaluli
paragraphs: Bitka pri Džaluli je potekala med Sasanidskim imperijem in pravovernim kalifatom kmalu potem, ko je kalifat osvojil Ktezifon.

source.title: Battle of Jalula
paragraphs: The Battle of Jalula was fought between the Sasanian Empire and the Rashidun Caliphate soon after the conquest of Ctesiphon by the latter.

Battle of Jassin.headline: Bitka pri Jassinu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Jassinu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Yasinu, Jasinu, Jasiniju ali Jassiniju) je bila bitka prve svetovne vojne, ki je potekala 18. in 19. januarja 1915 pri Jassinu na nemški vzhodnoafriški strani meje z Britansko Vzhodno Afriko med nemško Schutztruppe ter britanskimi in indijskimi enotami.

Jassin so Britanci zasedli, da bi zavarovali mejo med Britansko Vzhodno Afriko in nemškim ozemljem, vendar ga je šibko branila posadka štirih čet indijskih vojakov pod poveljstvom polkovnika Raghbirja Singha, ki je štela malo več kot 300 mož. Polkovnik Singh je v bitki padel.

Nemški poveljnik Paul Emil von Lettow-Vorbeck se je odločil napasti Jassin, da bi preprečil nadaljnjo nevarnost za Tango, ki je ležala več kot 50 kilometrov južneje in so jo prej uspešno ubranili pred britanskim napadom. Za napad so zbrali devet čet Schutztruppe z evropskimi častniki.
notes: The English source breaks its first sentence across two paragraphs; the Slovenian keeps the sentence whole in the first paragraph.

source.title: Battle of Jassin
paragraphs: The Battle of Jassin (also known as the Battle of Yasin, the Battle of Jasin, the Battle of Jasini or the Battle of Jassini)

was a World War I battle that took place on 18– 19 January 1915 at Jassin on the German East African side of the border with British East Africa between a German Schutztruppe force and British and Indian troops. Jassin had been occupied by the British in order to secure the border between British East Africa and German territory, but was weakly defended by a garrison of four companies of Indian troops, commanded by Colonel Raghbir Singh and numbering a little over 300 men. Colonel Singh was killed during the battle.

The German commander, Paul Emil von Lettow-Vorbeck, decided to attack Jassin in order to prevent further danger to Tanga, which lay more than 50 kilometres to the south and had previously been successfully defended against a British attack. Nine companies of Schutztruppe with European officers were gathered for the assault.

Battle of Jenin (2002).headline: Bitka za Džanin (2002)
paragraphs: Bitka za Džanin je od 1. do 11. aprila 2002 potekala v begunskem taborišču Džanin na Zahodnem bregu, ki ga zaseda Izrael. Izraelska vojska je med drugo intifado v okviru operacije Obrambni ščit vdrla v taborišče in na druga območja pod upravo palestinske oblasti.

Izraelske sile so uporabile pehoto, komandose in jurišne helikopterje. Palestinski borci so se na boj pripravili in po vsem taborišču nastavili pasti, in ko je izraelska kolona naletela na zasedo, se je vojska začela bolj zanašati na oklepne buldožerje. Palestinski borci so se 11. aprila začeli predajati, izraelske čete pa so se iz taborišča začele umikati 18. aprila.

source.title: Battle of Jenin (2002)
paragraphs: The Battle of Jenin, took place in the Jenin refugee camp in the Israeli-occupied West Bank on April 1–11, 2002. The Israeli military invaded the camp, and other areas under the administration of the Palestinian Authority, during the Second Intifada, as part of Operation Defensive Shield.

Israeli forces employed infantry, commando forces, and assault helicopters. Palestinian militants had prepared for a fight, booby trapping locations throughout the camp, and after an Israeli column walked into an ambush, the army began to rely more heavily on the use of armored bulldozers. On April 11, Palestinian militants began to surrender. Israeli troops began withdrawing from the camp on April 18.

Battle of Jerusalem.headline: Bitka za Jeruzalem (1917)
paragraphs: Bitka za Jeruzalem, znana tudi kot padec Jeruzalema, je potekala med »jeruzalemskimi operacijami« Britanskega imperija proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu v prvi svetovni vojni, ko so se boji za mesto razvili od 17. novembra in se po predaji nadaljevali do 30. decembra 1917, da bi zavarovali končni cilj južnopalestinske ofenzive v sinajsko-palestinski kampanji. Preden je bil Jeruzalem zavarovan, so Britanci priznali dve bitki v hebronskem gričevju severno in vzhodno od črte Hebron–Junction Station: bitko pri Nebi Samvilu od 17. do 24. novembra in obrambo Jeruzalema od 26. do 30. decembra 1917.
