paragraphs: Bitka v Helespontu, sestavljena iz dveh ločenih pomorskih spopadov, je potekala leta 324 med Konstantinovim ladjevjem, ki ga je vodil najstarejši sin Konstantina I., Krisp, in večjim ladjevjem pod Licinijevim admiralom Abantom (ali Amandom). Čeprav je bil v manjšini, je Krisp dosegel popolno zmago.

source.title: Battle of the Hellespont
paragraphs: The Battle of the Hellespont, consisting of two separate naval clashes, was fought in 324 between a Constantinian fleet, led by the eldest son of Constantine I, Crispus; and a larger fleet under Licinius' admiral, Abantus (or Amandus). Despite being outnumbered, Crispus won a very complete victory.

Battle of the Hellespont (321 BC).headline: Bitka ob Helespontu (321 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka ob Helespontu je potekala leta 321 ali 320 pr. n. št. med vojskama Kratera in Neoptolema na eni strani ter Evmenom na drugi. Bila je del vojn med Aleksandrovimi nasledniki. Evmena in Neoptolema je Perdika poslal, da bi Kratru preprečila prehod čez Helespont v Azijo, a je Neoptolem prestopil h Kratru. Evmen je bitko dobil, Krater in Neoptolem pa sta padla.

source.title: Battle of the Hellespont (321 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of the Hellespont took place in 321 or 320 BC between the armies of Craterus and Neoptolemus against Eumenes. It was part of the wars between Alexander's successors. Eumenes and Neoptolemus were sent by Perdiccas to prevent Craterus crossing the Hellespont into Asia, but Neoptolemus deserted to join Craterus. Eumenes won the battle, and both Craterus and Neoptolemus were killed.

Battle of the Iron Bridge.headline: Bitka pri Železnem mostu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Železnem mostu je potekala leta 637 n. št. med muslimansko vojsko pravovernega kalifata in bizantinsko vojsko. Bitka, v kateri so zmagali muslimani, je dobila ime po bližnjem kamnitem mostu z devetimi loki čez reko Oront (znanem tudi kot Džisr al Hadid), katerega vrata so bila obložena z železnimi rezili. Bila je ena zadnjih bitk med Bizantinci in pravovernim kalifatom v provinci Siriji. Po bitki je padla prestolnica province Antiohija, s čimer je bila provinca skoraj v celoti priključena pravovernemu kalifatu.

source.title: Battle of the Iron Bridge
paragraphs: The Battle of the Iron Bridge was fought between the Muslim Rashidun army and the Byzantine army in 637 AD. The battle, which the Muslims won, took its name from a nearby nine-arch stone bridge over the Orontes River (also known as Jisr al-Hadid), which had gates trimmed with iron blades. It was one of the last battles fought between the Byzantines and Rashidun Caliphate in the province of Syria. In the aftermath of the battle, the province's capital, Antioch, fell, marking the near-complete annexation of the province into the Rashidun Caliphate.

Battle of the Mareth Line.headline: Bitka na Marethski črti
paragraphs: Bitka na Marethski črti ali bitka pri Marethu je bila napad britanske osme armade (general Bernard Montgomery) v drugi svetovni vojni v Tuniziji na Marethsko črto, ki jo je držala italijansko-nemška 1. armada (general Giovanni Messe). Bila je prva velika operacija osme armade od druge bitke pri El Alameinu 4 mesece in pol prej. Operacija Pugilist, prvi britanski napad, je 19. marca 1943 vzpostavila mostišče, poskus preboja pa so odbili protinapadi sil osi. Pugilist je odprl drugo smer napada in načrtovali so operacijo Supercharge II, obhodni manever prek prelaza Tebaga. Montgomery je okrepil napad s boka, ki je od 26. do 31. marca 1. armado prisilil k umiku na Vadi Akarit, 64 km globlje v Tunizijo.
notes: "4+1⁄2 months" is written as 4 mesece in pol; the miles (40 mi) are dropped.

source.title: Battle of the Mareth Line
paragraphs: The Battle of the Mareth Line or the Battle of Mareth was an attack in the Second World War by the British Eighth Army (General Bernard Montgomery) in Tunisia, against the Mareth Line held by the Italo–German 1st Army (General Giovanni Messe). It was the first big operation by the Eighth Army since the Second Battle of El Alamein 4+1⁄2 months earlier. On 19 March 1943, Operation Pugilist, the first British attack, established a bridgehead but a break-out attempt was defeated by Axis counter-attacks. Pugilist established an alternative route of attack and Operation Supercharge II, an outflanking manoeuvre via the Tebaga Gap was planned. Montgomery reinforced the flanking attack, which from 26 to 31 March, forced the 1st Army to retreat to Wadi Akarit, another 40 mi (64 km) back in Tunisia.

Bitka na Nilu (znana tudi kot bitka v zalivu Abukir; francosko: Bataille d'Aboukir) je potekala med 1. in 3. avgustom 1798 v zalivu Abukir v Egiptu med britansko kraljevo vojno mornarico in francosko vojno mornarico. Bila je vrhunec sredozemske kampanje leta 1798, ki se je začela tri mesece prej, ko je veliko francosko ladjevje z odpravo pod Napoleonovim poveljstvom odplulo iz Toulona v Aleksandrijo. Britansko ladjevje pod vodstvom kontraadmirala modre eskadre sira Horatia Nelsona je odločilno premagalo francosko ladjevje pod viceadmiralom François-Paulom Brueysom d'Aigalliersom, ki je Napoleonovo vojsko pospremilo v Egipt.

source.title: Battle of the Nile
paragraphs: The Battle of the Nile (also known as the Battle of Aboukir Bay; French: Bataille d'Aboukir) was fought between the Royal Navy and the French Navy at Aboukir Bay in Egypt between 1 and 3 August 1798. It was the climax of the Mediterranean campaign of 1798, which had started three months earlier after a large French fleet sailed from Toulon to Alexandria carrying an expeditionary force under Napoleon. A British fleet, led by Rear-Admiral of the Blue Sir Horatio Nelson, decisively defeated a French fleet under Vice-admiral François-Paul Brueys d'Aigalliers, which had escorted Napoleon's army to Egypt.

Battle of the Nile (47 BC).headline: Bitka na Nilu (47 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: V bitki na Nilu v začetku leta 47 pr. n. št. sta združeni rimsko-egiptovski vojski Julija Cezarja in Kleopatre VII. premagali vojski tekmecev, kraljice Arsinoje IV. in kralja Ptolemaja XIII., ter si zagotovili egiptovski prestol.

source.title: Battle of the Nile (47 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of the Nile in early 47 BC saw the combined Roman–Egyptian armies of Julius Caesar and Cleopatra VII defeat those of the rival Queen Arsinoe IV and King Ptolemy XIII and secure the throne of Egypt.

Battle of the Orontes.headline: Bitka ob Orontu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Orontu je potekala 15. septembra 994 med Bizantinci in njihovimi hamdanidskimi zavezniki pod vodstvom Mihaela Burtza ter silami fatimidskega vezirja Damaska, turškega generala Mandžutakina. Bitka se je končala s fatimidsko zmago.

source.title: Battle of the Orontes
paragraphs: The Battle of the Orontes was fought on 15 September 994 between the Byzantines and their Hamdanid allies under Michael Bourtzes against the forces of the Fatimid vizier of Damascus, the Turkish general Manjutakin. The battle was a Fatimid victory.

Battle of the Persian Gate.headline: Bitka pri Perzijskih vratih
paragraphs: Bitka pri Perzijskih vratih je bila del vojn Aleksandra Velikega. Pozimi leta 330 pr. n. št. se je Ariobarzan iz Perside s številčno šibkejšo perzijsko vojsko zadnjič postavil po robu pri Perzijskih vratih blizu Perzepolisa in makedonsko vojsko zadrževal približno mesec dni. S pomočjo ujetnikov ali krajevnega pastirja pa je Aleksander našel pot, po kateri je perzijske čete obšel in jih napadel v hrbet, ter v novi odločilni zmagi nad Ahemenidskim imperijem zavzel polovico prave Perzije.

source.title: Battle of the Persian Gate
paragraphs: The Battle of the Persian Gate took place as part of the Wars of Alexander the Great. In the winter of 330 BC, Ariobarzanes of Persis led a last stand with his outnumbered Persian army at the Persian Gate, near Persepolis, and held back the Macedonian army for approximately a month. However, through captured prisoners of war or a local shepherd, Alexander found a path around to flank the Persian troops from the rear, allowing him to capture half of Persia proper in another decisive victory against the Achaemenid Empire.

Bitka pri piramidah (francosko: Bataille des Pyramides), znana tudi kot bitka pri Embabi (bataille d'Embabech), je potekala 21. julija 1798 med francosko invazijo na Egipt in Sirijo. Bitka je potekala blizu vasi Embaba v osmanskem Egiptu, Napoleon pa jo je poimenoval po oddaljeni Keopsovi piramidi v Gizi.

Ko je Napoleonova vojska zavzela Aleksandrijo in prodirala proti Kairu, se je spopadla s silami pod mameluškim vodstvom Murad bega. Francozi so se razporedili v velike divizijske kvadrate, ki so zdržali ponavljajoče se konjeniške napade, nato pa so naskočili utrjeno vas Embaba. Francoske izgube naj bi znašale okoli 300 mož, ocene mameluško-osmanskih izgub pa se zelo razlikujejo, od več tisoč do kar 10.000. Poraz je strl Muradovo vojsko na bojišču in ga prisilil k umiku v Gornji Egipt.

source.title: Battle of the Pyramids
paragraphs: The Battle of the Pyramids (French: Bataille des Pyramides), also known as the Battle of Embabeh (bataille d'Embabech), was fought on 21 July 1798 during the French invasion of Egypt and Syria. Occurring near the village of Embabeh, Ottoman Egypt, the battle was named by Napoleon after the distant Great Pyramid of Giza.

After capturing Alexandria and advancing toward Cairo, Napoleon's army confronted Murad Bey's Mamluk-led forces. The French deployed into large divisional squares that withstood repeated cavalry charges before storming the fortified village of Embabeh. French losses were reported at about 300, while estimates for Mamluk–Ottoman casualties vary widely, from several thousand to as many as 10,000. The defeat shattered Murad's field army, forcing him to retreat to Upper Egypt.

Battle of the River.headline: Bitka ob reki
paragraphs: Bitka ob reki, znana tudi kot bitka pri Al Madharju, je potekala v Mezopotamiji (provinca Asoristan) med silami pravovernega kalifata in Sasanidskim imperijem. Muslimani pod poveljstvom Halida ibn al Valida so premagali številčnejšo sasanidsko vojsko.

source.title: Battle of the River
paragraphs: The Battle of the River, also known as Battle of Al Madhar, took place in Mesopotamia (Asoristan Province) between the forces of the Rashidun Caliphate and the Sasanian Empire. Muslims, under Khalid ibn al-Walid's command, defeated the numerically superior Sasanian army.

Battle of the Rufiji Delta.headline: Bitka v delti Rufidžija
paragraphs: Bitka v delti Rufidžija je med prvo svetovno vojno od oktobra 1914 do julija 1915 potekala v Nemški Vzhodni Afriki (današnji Tanzaniji) med lahko križarko nemške vojne mornarice SMS Königsberg in močno skupino britanskih vojnih ladij. Bitka je bila vrsta poskusov, nazadnje uspešnih, da bi blokirano nemško lahko križarko potopili.

source.title: Battle of the Rufiji Delta
paragraphs: The Battle of the Rufiji Delta was fought in German East Africa (modern Tanzania) from October 1914–July 1915 during the First World War, between the German Navy's light cruiser SMS Königsberg, and a powerful group of British warships. The battle was a series of attempts, ultimately successful, to sink the blockaded German light cruiser.

Battle of the Sakarya.headline: Bitka pri Sakarji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sakarji (turško: Sakarya Meydan Muharebesi, dobesedno »poljska bitka pri Sakarji«), znana tudi kot bitka pri Sangariju (grško: Μάχη του Σαγγαρίου, Máchi tou Sangaríou), je bila odločilni spopad grško-turške vojne (1919–1922): ustavila je grško prodiranje proti Ankari in ustvarila razmere za poznejšo turško protiofenzivo.
Bitka je trajala 21 dni, od 23. avgusta do 13. septembra 1921, ob bregovih reke Sakarje v neposredni bližini Polatlıja, ki je danes okrožje province Ankara. Bojna črta se je raztezala na 100 km.
notes: The miles (62 mi) are dropped.

source.title: Battle of the Sakarya
paragraphs: The Battle of the Sakarya (Turkish: Sakarya Meydan Muharebesi, lit. 'Sakarya Field Battle'), also known as the Battle of the Sangarios (Greek: Μάχη του Σαγγαρίου, romanized: Máchi tou Sangaríou), was the decisive engagement in the Greco-Turkish War (1919–1922), halting Greek advance towards Ankara and creating the circumstances for an upcoming Turkish counter offensive.

The battle went on for 21 days from August 23 to September 13, 1921, close to the banks of the Sakarya River in the immediate vicinity of Polatlı, which is today a district of the Ankara Province. The battle line stretched over 62 miles (100 km).

Battle of the Saw.headline: Bitka pri Žagi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Žagi je bila zaključna bitka pohoda, ki je leta 238 pr. n. št. na ozemlju današnje severne Tunizije potekal med kartažansko vojsko pod vodstvom Hamilkarja Barke in uporniško vojsko pod vodstvom Spendija. Kartagina se je v najemniški vojni, ki se je začela leta 241 pr. n. št., bojevala proti koaliciji uporniških vojakov in upornih afriških mest. Uporniki so oblegali Kartagino, Hamilkarjeva kartažanska vojska na bojišču pa je napadala njihove oskrbovalne poti. Pod tem pritiskom so se uporniki umaknili v svoje oporišče v Tunisu in poslali svojo vojsko, da bi Hamilkarja ustavila in po možnosti uničila njegovo vojsko.

source.title: Battle of the Saw
paragraphs: The Battle of the Saw was the culminating battle of a campaign fought between a Carthaginian army led by Hamilcar Barca and a rebel force led by Spendius in 238 BC in what is now northern Tunisia. Carthage was fighting a coalition of mutinous soldiers and rebellious African cities in the Mercenary War which had started in 241 BC. The rebels had been besieging Carthage while the Carthaginian field army under Hamilcar raided their supply lines. Under this pressure the rebels pulled back to their base at Tunis and despatched their own army to prevent Hamilcar's activities and, ideally, destroy his army.

Bitka pri jarku (arabsko: Ghazwat al-Khandaq), znana tudi kot bitka na Hendeku (Ma’rakah al-Khandaq) in bitka zaveznikov (Ghazwat al-Ahzab), je bila del spopada med muslimani in Kurajšiti. Kurajšiti so napredovali proti muslimanom, ti pa so se v Medini ubranili tako, da so na predlog Salmana Perzijca okoli naselbine izkopali jarek. Bitka je potekala leta 627 in je trajala okoli dva tedna; muslimani so poročali o petih ali šestih žrtvah, Kurajšiti pa o treh.

source.title: Battle of the Trench
paragraphs: The Battle of the Trench (Arabic: غزوة الخندق, romanized: Ghazwat al-Khandaq), also known as the Battle of Khandaq (Arabic: معركة الخندق, romanized: Ma’rakah al-Khandaq) and the Battle of the Confederates (Arabic: غزوة الاحزاب, romanized: Ghazwat al-Ahzab), was part of the conflict between the Muslims and the Quraysh. The Quraysh advanced towards the Muslims, who defended themselves in Medina by digging a trench around their settlement at the suggestion of Salman the Persian. The battle took place in 627 and lasted around two weeks, resulting in five to six casualties reported by the Muslim, and three casualties amongst the Quraysh.

Battle of the Zab.headline: Bitka ob Zabu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Zabu (arabsko: معركة الزاب), v strokovni literaturi imenovana tudi bitka ob reki Veliki Zab, je potekala 25. januarja 750 na bregovih Velikega Zaba na ozemlju današnjega Iraka. Pomenila je konec Omajadskega kalifata in vzpon Abasidskega kalifata, ki je obstajal od leta 750 do 1258.

source.title: Battle of the Zab
paragraphs: The Battle of the Zab (Arabic: معركة الزاب), also referred to in scholarly contexts as Battle of the Great Zāb River, took place on January 25, 750, on the banks of the Great Zab in what is now the modern country of Iraq. It spelled the end of the Umayyad Caliphate and the rise of the Abbasid Caliphate, which would last from 750 to 1258.

Battle of Thyatira.headline: Bitka pri Tiatiri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tiatiri je potekala leta 366 pri Tiatiri v Lidiji (današnja Turčija) med vojsko rimskega cesarja Valensa in vojsko uzurpatorja Prokopija, ki jo je vodil njegov vojskovodja Gomoarij.

source.title: Battle of Thyatira
paragraphs: The Battle of Thyatira was fought in 366 at Thyatira, Lydia (modern Turkey), between the army of the Roman Emperor Valens and the army of the usurper Procopius, led by his general Gomoarius.

Battle of Tigranocerta.headline: Bitka pri Tigranokerti
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tigranokerti (armensko: Տիգրանակերտի ճակատամարտ, Tigranakerti tchakatamart) je potekala 6. oktobra 69 pr. n. št. med silami Rimske republike in vojsko Kraljevine Armenije pod vodstvom kralja Tigrana Velikega. Rimska vojska pod vodstvom konzula Lucija Licinija Lukula je premagala Tigrana in nato zavzela njegovo prestolnico Tigranokerto.

Do bitke je prišlo v tretji mitridatski vojni, ki sta jo bojevala Rimska republika in pontski kralj Mitridat VI., čigar hči Kleopatra je bila Tigranova žena. Mitridat se je zatekel k zetu, Rim pa je vdrl v Kraljevino Armenijo. Rimske sile so oblegale Tigranokerto, ko pa se je približala velika armenska vojska, so se umaknile za bližnjo reko. Rimljani so se navidezno umaknili, prečkali reko pri gazu in napadli desno krilo armenske vojske. Ko so Rimljani premagali armenske katafrakte, se je preostanek Tigranove vojske, sestavljen večinoma iz neizurjenih nabornikov in kmečkih čet iz njegovega obsežnega imperija, v paniki razbežal, bojišče pa je ostalo v rimskih rokah.

source.title: Battle of Tigranocerta
paragraphs: The Battle of Tigranocerta (Armenian: Տիգրանակերտի ճակատամարտ, Tigranakerti tchakatamart) was fought on 6 October 69 BC between the forces of the Roman Republic and the army of the Kingdom of Armenia led by King Tigranes the Great. The Roman force, led by Consul Lucius Licinius Lucullus, defeated Tigranes, and as a result, captured Tigranes' capital city of Tigranocerta.

The battle arose from the Third Mithridatic War being fought between the Roman Republic and Mithridates VI of Pontus, whose daughter Cleopatra was married to Tigranes. Mithridates fled to seek shelter with his son-in-law, and Rome invaded the Kingdom of Armenia. Having laid siege to Tigranocerta, the Roman forces fell back behind a nearby river when the large Armenian army approached. Feigning retreat, the Romans crossed at a ford and fell on the right flank of the Armenian army. After the Romans defeated the Armenian cataphracts, the balance of Tigranes' army, which was mostly made up of raw levies and peasant troops from his extensive empire, panicked and fled, and the Romans remained in charge of the field.

Battle of Tricamarum.headline: Bitka pri Trikamarju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Trikamarju je potekala 15. decembra 533 med vojskama Bizantinskega cesarstva pod Belizarjem in Vandalskega kraljestva pod poveljstvom kralja Gelimerja in njegovega brata Tzaza.

source.title: Battle of Tricamarum
paragraphs: The Battle of Tricamarum took place on 15 December 533 between the armies of the Byzantine Empire, under Belisarius, and the Vandal Kingdom, commanded by King Gelimer and his brother Tzazo.

Bitka za Tripoli (arabsko: ﻣﻌﺮﻛﺔ ﻃﺮﺍﺑﻠﺲ, ma'arakat Ṭarābulis), včasih imenovana padec Tripolija (arabsko: سقوط طرابلس, suqūt Ṭarābulis), je bila vojaški spopad v Tripoliju v Libiji med privrženci dolgoletnega libijskega voditelja Moamerja Gadafija in Nacionalnim prehodnim svetom, ki je skušal strmoglaviti Gadafija in prevzeti nadzor nad prestolnico. Bitka se je začela 20. avgusta 2011, šest mesecev po začetku prve libijske državljanske vojne, z vstajo v mestu; uporniške sile zunaj mesta so pripravile ofenzivo, da bi se povezale z enotami v Tripoliju in nazadnje prevzele nadzor nad prestolnico.

Uporniki so napadu dali kodno ime »operacija Zora sirene« (arabsko: ﻋﻤﻠﻴﺔ ﻓﺠﺮ ﻋﺮﻭﺳﺔ ﺍﻟﺒﺤﺮ, ʻamaliyyat fajr ʻarūsat el-baḥr). Vzdevek Tripolija je namreč »Sirena« (arabsko: ﻋﺮﻭﺳﺔ ﺍﻟﺒﺤﺮ, ʻarūsat el-baḥr), dobesedno »morska nevesta«.

source.title: Battle of Tripoli (2011)
paragraphs: The Battle of Tripoli (Arabic: ﻣﻌﺮﻛﺔ ﻃﺮﺍﺑﻠﺲ ma'arakat Ṭarābulis), sometimes referred to as the Fall of Tripoli (Arabic: سقوط طرابلس suqūt Ṭarābulis), was a military confrontation in Tripoli, Libya, between loyalists of Muammar Gaddafi, the longtime leader of Libya, and the National Transitional Council, which was attempting to overthrow Gaddafi and take control of the capital. The battle began on 20 August 2011, six months after the First Libyan Civil War started, with an uprising within the city; rebel forces outside the city planned an offensive to link up with elements within Tripoli, and eventually take control of the nation's capital.

The rebels codenamed the assault "Operation Mermaid Dawn"(Arabic: ﻋﻤﻠﻴﺔ ﻓﺠﺮ ﻋﺮﻭﺳﺔ ﺍﻟﺒﺤﺮ ʻamaliyyat fajr ʻarūsat el-baḥr). Tripoli's nickname is "The Mermaid" (Arabic: ﻋﺮﻭﺳﺔ ﺍﻟﺒﺤﺮ ʻarūsat el-baḥr) (literally "bride of the sea").

Battle of Tzirallum.headline: Bitka pri Ciralu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ciralu je bila del državljanskih vojn tetrarhije in je potekala 30. aprila 313 med rimskima vojskama cesarjev Licinija in Maksimina. Bojišče je bilo na »Campus Serenus« pri Ciralu, ki ga istovetijo z današnjim mestom Çorlu v provinci Tekirdağ v turški Vzhodni Trakiji. Viri postavljajo bitko 18 do 36 rimskih milj od Herakleje Perint, današnjega mesta Marmara Ereğlisi.

source.title: Battle of Tzirallum
paragraphs: The Battle of Tzirallum was part of the civil wars of the Tetrarchy fought on 30 April 313 between the Roman armies of emperors Licinius and Maximinus. The battle location was on the "Campus Serenus" at Tzirallum, identified as the modern-day town of Çorlu, in Tekirdağ Province, in the Turkish region of Eastern Thrace. Sources put the battle between 18 and 36 Roman miles from Heraclea Perinthus, the modern-day town of Marmara Ereğlisi.

Bitka pri Uhudu (arabsko: Ghazwat ʾUḥud) je med muslimansko-kurajšitskimi vojnami potekala med zgodnjimi muslimani in Kurajšiti v dolini severno od Medine blizu gore Uhud v soboto, 23. marca 625 n. št. (7. šavala leta 3 po hidžri).

source.title: Battle of Uhud
paragraphs: The Battle of Uhud (Arabic: غزوة أحد, romanized: Ghazwat ʾUḥud) was fought between the early Muslims and the Quraysh during the Muslim–Quraysh wars in a valley north of Medina near Mount Uhud on Saturday, 23 March 625 AD (7 Shawwal, 3 AH).

Battle of Ullais.headline: Bitka pri Ulaisu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ulaisu (arabsko: معركة أليس) je sredi junija 633 n. št. v Iraku potekala med silami pravovernega kalifata in Sasanidskim perzijskim imperijem; včasih jo imenujejo bitka pri Krvavi reki, saj je v njej padlo ogromno perzijskih sasanidskih vojakov in krščanskih Arabcev.

Bila je zadnja od štirih zaporednih bitk med muslimanskimi napadalci in perzijsko vojsko. Po vsaki bitki so se Perzijci in njihovi zavezniki znova zbrali in se spet spopadli. Bitke so se končale z umikom sasanidske perzijske vojske iz Iraka, ki so ga muslimani pravovernega kalifata osvojili.

source.title: Battle of Ullais
paragraphs: The Battle of Ullais (Arabic: معركة أليس) was fought between the forces of the Rashidun Caliphate and the Sasanian Persian Empire in the middle of June 633 AD in Iraq, and is sometimes referred to as the Battle of Blood River since, as a result of the battle, there were enormous amounts of Persian Sasanian and Arab Christian casualties.

This was now the last of four consecutive battles that were fought between invading Muslims and the Persian army. After each battle the Persians and their allies regrouped and fought again. These battles resulted in the retreat of the Sasanian Persian army from Iraq and its capture by Muslims under the Rashidun Caliphate.

Battle of Ulundi.headline: Bitka pri Ulundiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ulundiju (znana tudi kot bitka pri kwaNodwenguju ali oCwecweniju) je potekala 4. julija 1879 pri zulujski prestolnici Ulundi (zulujsko: oNdini) in je bila zadnja bitka angleško-zulujske vojne. Britanska vojska je strla vojaško moč Kraljestva Zulujev, ko je premagala glavno zulujsko vojsko ter zavzela in požgala kraljevi kraal oNdini.

source.title: Battle of Ulundi
paragraphs: The Battle of Ulundi (also known as the Battle of kwaNodwengu or the Battle of oCwecweni) took place at the Zulu capital of Ulundi (Zulu: oNdini) on 4 July 1879 and was the last battle of the Anglo-Zulu War. The British Army broke the military power of the Zulu Kingdom by defeating the main Zulu army and capturing and burning the royal kraal of oNdini.

Battle of Umm Qasr.headline: Bitka za Um Kasr
paragraphs: Bitka za Um Kasr je bila prvi vojaški spopad iraške vojne. Na začetku vojne je bilo pristanišče Um Kasr eden prvih ciljev. Ko so zavezniške sile 21. marca 2003 napredovale po južnem Iraku, so amfibijske sile zavzele novo pristaniško območje Um Kasra. Napad so vodili kraljevi marinci britanske 3. brigade komandosov, okrepljeni z ameriškimi marinci 15. ekspedicijske enote (MEU) in poljskimi vojaki enote JW GROM. Iraške sile v starem mestu Um Kasr so se nepričakovano močno upirale, zato so območje šele po več dneh bojev očistili branilcev. Pristanišče so 25. marca 2003 razglasili za varno in ga znova odprli.

source.title: Battle of Umm Qasr
paragraphs: The Battle of Umm Qasr was the first military confrontation in the Iraq War. At the start of the war, one of the first objectives was the port of Umm Qasr. On 21 March 2003, as allied forces advanced across Southern Iraq, an amphibious landing force captured the new port area of Umm Qasr. The assault was spearheaded by Royal Marines of the British 3 Commando Brigade, augmented by U.S. Marines of the American 15th MEU and Polish JW GROM troops. Iraqi forces in the old town of Umm Qasr put up unexpectedly strong resistance, requiring several days' fighting before the area was cleared of defenders. The port was finally declared safe and reopened on 25 March 2003.

Battle of Utica (203 BC).headline: Bitka pri Utiki (203 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Utiki je potekala leta 203 pr. n. št. med rimsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Publija Kornelija Scipiona ter zavezniškima vojskama Kartagine in Numidije, ki sta jima poveljevala Hasdrubal Giskon oziroma Sifaks. Bitka je bila del druge punske vojne in se je končala s hudim porazom Kartagine.

Po porazu v prvi punski vojni (264–241 pr. n. št.) je Kartagina razširila svoje ozemlje na jugovzhodu Iberskega polotoka (današnja Španija in Portugalska). Ko je leta 218 pr. n. št. izbruhnila druga punska vojna, se je rimska vojska izkrcala na severovzhodu Iberskega polotoka. Po hudem rimskem porazu leta 210 pr. n. št. je poveljstvo prevzel Scipion in v petih letih pregnal Kartažane s polotoka. Vrnil se je v Rim, odločen, da vojno prenese v kartažansko domovino v severni Afriki. Leta 205 pr. n. št. so ga izvolili za konzula in leto dni je na Siciliji uril vojsko in zbiral zaloge.
Leta 204 pr. n. št. so se Rimljani s štirimi legijami izkrcali blizu kartažanskega pristanišča Utika. Premagali so dva velika kartažanska izvidniška oddelka, oblegali Utiko in postavili utrjen tabor.

source.title: Battle of Utica (203 BC)
paragraphs: The battle of Utica was fought in 203 BC between a Roman army commanded by Publius Cornelius Scipio and the allied armies of Carthage and Numidia, commanded by Hasdrubal Gisgo and Syphax respectively. The battle was part of the Second Punic War and resulted in a heavy defeat for Carthage.

In the wake of its defeat in the First Punic War (264–241 BC) Carthage expanded its territory in south-east Iberia (modern Spain and Portugal). When the Second Punic War broke out in 218 BC a Roman army landed in north-east Iberia. After a disastrous Roman setback in 210 BC Scipio took command and cleared the peninsula of Carthaginians in five years. He returned to Rome determined to carry the war to the Carthaginian homeland in North Africa. Appointed consul in 205 BC Scipio spent a year in Sicily training his army and accumulating supplies.
In 204 BC the Romans landed near the Carthaginian port of Utica with four legions. The Romans defeated two large Carthaginian scouting parties, besieged Utica and set up a fortified camp.

Battle of Versinikia.headline: Bitka pri Versinikiji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Versinikiji (bolgarsko: Битката при Версиникия; grško: Μάχη της Βερσινικίας) je bila bitka, ki je leta 813 n. št. potekala med Bizantinskim cesarstvom in Bolgarskim cesarstvom blizu mesta Odrin (Edirne) na ozemlju današnje Turčije.

source.title: Battle of Versinikia
paragraphs: Bulgarian Battle of Versinikia (Bulgarian: Битката при Версиникия; Greek: Μάχη της Βερσινικίας) was a battle fought in 813 AD between the Byzantine Empire and the Bulgarian Empire, near the city of Adrianople (Edirne), in modern-day Turkey.

Battle of Vescera.headline: Bitka pri Vesceri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Vesceri (današnja Biskra v Alžiriji) je potekala leta 682 ali 683 med romaniziranimi Berberi kralja Kusajle in njihovimi bizantinskimi zavezniki iz Afriškega eksarhata na eni strani ter omajadsko arabsko vojsko pod Ukbo ibn Nafijem (ustanoviteljem Kajruana) na drugi. Ukba ibn Nafi je svoje može vodil na pohodu čez severno Afriko, dosegel Atlantski ocean in prodrl na jug vse do rek Draa in Sus. Ob vrnitvi ga je berbersko-bizantinska koalicija iz zasede napadla pri Tehudi (Tabudeosu) južno od Vescere, ga premagala in ubila.

source.title: Battle of Vescera
paragraphs: The Battle of Vescera (modern Biskra in Algeria) was fought in 682 or 683 between the Romano-Berbers of King Kusaila and their Byzantine allies from the Exarchate of Africa against an Umayyad Arab army under Uqba ibn Nafi (the founder of Kairouan). Uqba ibn Nafi had led his men in an expedition across north Africa, eventually reaching the Atlantic Ocean and marching as far south as the Draa and Sous rivers. On his return, he was ambushed by the Berber-Byzantine coalition at Tehouda (Thabudeos) south Vescera, defeated, and killed.

Battle of Wadi (1916).headline: Bitka ob Vadiju (1916)
paragraphs: Bitka ob Vadiju 13. januarja 1916 je bila neuspešen poskus britanskih sil v osmanskem Iraku med prvo svetovno vojno, da bi rešile obkoljene sile sira Charlesa Townshenda, ki jih je osmanska šesta armada oblegala v Kut al Amari.

General Fenton Aylmer je na pritisk britanskega vrhovnega poveljnika v regiji sira Johna Nixona napadel osmanske obrambne položaje na bregovih reke Vadi. Vadi je bila strma dolina potoka, ki je s severa tekel v Tigris, okoli 9,7 km nad Šejk Saadom proti Kut al Amari. Napad na splošno velja za neuspeh: Aylmer je Vadi sicer zavzel, a ga je to stalo 1600 mož. Zaradi britanskega neuspeha se je Townshend vdal skupaj z 10.000 možmi, kar je bila tedaj največja posamična vdaja britanskih čet. Britanci so Kut znova zavzeli februarja 1917, na poti do zavzetja Bagdada šestnajst dni pozneje, 11. marca 1917.

source.title: Battle of Wadi (1916)
paragraphs: The Battle of Wadi, occurring on 13 January 1916, was an unsuccessful attempt by British forces fighting in Ottoman Iraq during World War I to relieve beleaguered forces under Sir Charles Townshend then under siege by the Ottoman Sixth Army at Kut-al-Amara.

Pushed by regional British Commander-in-Chief Sir John Nixon, General Fenton Aylmer launched an attack against Ottoman defensive positions on the banks of the Wadi River. The Wadi was a steep valley of a stream that ran from the north into the River Tigris, some 6 miles (9.7 km) upstream towards Kut-al-Amara from Sheikh Sa'ad. The attack is generally considered as a failure, as although Aylmer managed to capture the Wadi, it cost him 1,600 men. The British failure led to Townshend's surrender, along with 10,000 of his men, in the largest single surrender of British troops up to that time. However, the British recaptured Kut in February 1917, on their way to the capture of Baghdad sixteen days later on 11 March 1917.

Battle of Wadi al-Khaznadar.headline: Bitka v Vadi al Haznadarju
paragraphs: Bitka v Vadi al Haznadarju, znana tudi kot tretja bitka pri Homsu, je bila zmaga Mongolov nad mameluki leta 1299.

source.title: Battle of Wadi al-Khaznadar
paragraphs: The Battle of Wadi al-Khaznadar, also known as the Third Battle of Homs, was a Mongol victory over the Mamluks in 1299.

Battle of Walaja.headline: Bitka pri Valadži
paragraphs: Bitka pri Valadži (arabsko: معركة الولجة) je potekala maja 633 v Mezopotamiji med vojsko pravovernega kalifata pod vodstvom Halida ibn al Valida in Al Mutane ibn Harite ter Sasanidskim imperijem in njegovimi arabskimi zavezniki.
Halid je sasanidske sile premagal z različico taktike dvojnega obkoljevanja, podobne manevru, s katerim je Hanibal porazil rimske sile v bitki pri Kanah.

source.title: Battle of Walaja
paragraphs: The Battle of Walaja (Arabic: معركة الولجة) was fought in Mesopotamia in May 633 between the Rashidun Caliphate army under Khalid ibn al-Walid and Al-Muthanna ibn Haritha against the Sassanid Empire and its Arab allies.

Khalid defeated the Sasanian forces by using a variation of the double envelopment tactical manoeuvre, similar to the manoeuvre that Hannibal had used to defeat the Roman forces at the Battle of Cannae.

Battle of Waterberg.headline: Bitka pri Waterbergu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Waterbergu (bitka pri Ohamakariju) je potekala 11. avgusta 1904 pri Waterbergu v Nemški Jugozahodni Afriki (današnji Namibiji) in je bila odločilna bitka hererskega upora.

source.title: Battle of Waterberg
paragraphs: The Battle of Waterberg (Battle of Ohamakari) took place on August 11, 1904, at the Waterberg, German South West Africa (modern day Namibia), and was the decisive battle in the Herero uprising.

Battle of Yibneh.headline: Bitka pri Jibni
paragraphs: V bitki pri Jibni leta 1123 so križarske sile pod vodstvom Evstahija Grenierja med Aškelonom in Jafo strle fatimidsko vojsko iz Egipta, ki jo je poslal vezir Al Mamun.

source.title: Battle of Yibneh
paragraphs: In the Battle of Yibneh (Yibna) in 1123, a Crusader force led by Eustace Grenier crushed a Fatimid army from Egypt sent by vizier Al-Ma'mun between Ascalon and Jaffa.

Battle of Zafar.headline: Bitka pri Zafarju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Zafarju je leta 632 potekala med Halidom ibn al Validom, tovarišem islamskega preroka Mohameda, in plemensko poglavarko Salmo. Halid jo je premagal, ona pa je umrla na bojišču. Bitka je bila del vojn Ride.
Voditeljica odpadnikov je jahala kamelo, obdana z zvesto telesno stražo.
V tretjem tednu oktobra 632 n. št. se ji je Halid ibn al Valid približal s skupino mudžahedinov ter pobil njo in njeno telesno stražo. V bitki je umrlo več sto odpadnikov.

source.title: Battle of Zafar
paragraphs: The Battle of Zafar took place in 632 between Khalid ibn al-Walid, a companion of the Islamic prophet Muhammad, and a tribal chieftess called Salma. Khalid defeated her and she died on the battlefield. The battle was part of the Ridda Wars.
The apostate leader was riding on a camel, surrounded by her loyal bodyguards.
In third week of October 632 CE Khalid ibn al-Walid approached her with a group of mujahideen and slaughtered her and her bodyguards. Several hundred apostates died in this battle.

Belgijski Kongo (francosko: Congo belge; nizozemsko: Belgisch-Congo) je bil belgijska kolonija v osrednji Afriki od leta 1908 do osamosvojitve leta 1960. Danes je to Demokratična republika Kongo (DR Kongo).

Kolonialna vladavina v Kongu se je začela konec 19. stoletja. Belgijski kralj Leopold II. je skušal belgijsko vlado prepričati, naj podpre kolonialno širitev v tedaj še večinoma neizkoriščenem kongovskem porečju. Ker je bila vlada neodločna, je Leopold kolonijo ustanovil sam. S podporo več zahodnih držav je leta 1885 dosegel mednarodno priznanje Svobodne države Kongo. Do konca 19. stoletja sta nasilje uradnikov Svobodne države nad domačimi Kongovci in brezobziren sistem gospodarskega izkoriščanja pripeljala do močnega diplomatskega pritiska na Belgijo, naj državo uradno prevzame, kar je storila leta 1908 z ustanovitvijo Belgijskega Konga.
notes: The French pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Belgian Congo
paragraphs: The Belgian Congo (French: Congo belge, pronounced [kɔ̃ɡo bɛlʒ]; Dutch: Belgisch-Congo) was a Belgian colony in Central Africa from 1908 until independence in 1960. It is today the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).

Colonial rule in the Congo began in the late 19th century. King Leopold II of Belgium attempted to persuade the Belgian government to support colonial expansion around the then-largely unexploited Congo Basin. Their ambivalence resulted in Leopold establishing a colony himself. With support from a number of Western countries, Leopold achieved international recognition of the Congo Free State in 1885. By the end of the 19th century, the violence used by Free State officials against indigenous Congolese and a ruthless system of economic exploitation led to intense diplomatic pressure on Belgium to take official control of the country, which it did by creating the Belgian Congo in 1908.

Beylik of Dulkadir.headline: Beglik Dulkadir
paragraphs: Beglik Dulkadir (turško: Dulkadiroğulları Beyliği) je bil eden od turških anatolskih beglikov (kneževin), ki so jih po zatonu Rumskega sultanata Seldžukov ustanovili oguški turški klani Bajat, Afšar in Begdili.

source.title: Beylik of Dulkadir
paragraphs: The Beylik of Dulkadir (Turkish: Dulkadiroğulları Beyliği) was one of the Turkish Anatolian beyliks (principality) established by the Oghuz Turk clans Bayat, Afshar, and Begdili after the decline of Seljuk Sultanate of Rûm.

Beylik of Teke.headline: Beglik Teke
paragraphs: Anatolski beglik Teke (turško: Tekeoğulları Beyliği) je bil ena od obmejnih kneževin, ki so jih po zatonu Rumskega sultanata Seldžukov ustanovili oguški turški klani. Prestolnica je bila Antalya na južni obali današnje Turčije. Beglik je leta 1321 ustanovila veja dinastije Hamididov, obstajal pa je do leta 1423, ko si ga je dokončno priključilo Osmansko cesarstvo.

source.title: Beylik of Teke
paragraphs: The Anatolian beylik of Teke (Turkish: Tekeoğulları Beyliği), was one of the frontier principalities established by Oghuz Turkish clans after the decline of the Seljuk Sultanate of Rûm. Its capital was Antalya, on the southern coast of modern Turkey. The beylik was established by a branch of the Hamidid dynasty in 1321 and lasted until 1423, when it was permanently annexed by the Ottoman Empire.

Beglik Tunis (arabsko: بايلك تونس) je bil pravna oblika Tunizije med letoma 1705 in 1881. Vladala mu je dinastija Husainidov, dokler niso ustanovili francoskega protektorata Tunizija. Izraz beglik se nanaša na vladarja, imenovanega tuniški beg. Ta je v času protektorata ostal formalni poglavar države, Husainidi pa so bili večinoma le simbolni vladarji.

Begi so ostali zvesti Visoki porti, vendar so vladali kot monarhi, saj so se postopno osamosvojili od Osmanskega cesarstva. Med letoma 1861 in 1864 je Beglik Tunis postal ustavna monarhija, saj je sprejel prvo ustavo v Afriki in arabskem svetu. Država je imela svojo valuto in samostojno vojsko, leta 1831 pa je sprejela zastavo, ki jo uporablja še danes.
Dinastija Husainidov je Tuniziji vladala tudi po ustanovitvi francoskega protektorata leta 1881 in je obstajala vse do razglasitve republike 25. julija 1957, leto dni po osamosvojitvi.

source.title: Beylik of Tunis
paragraphs: The Beylik of Tunis (Arabic: بايلك تونس) was the legal form of Tunisia, between 1705 and 1881. It was ruled by the Husainid dynasty until the establishment of the French protectorate of Tunisia. The term beylik refers to the monarch, who was called the Bey of Tunis. Under the protectorate, the latter remained nominally the head of state, with the Husainids remaining as largely symbolic sovereigns.

The Beys remained faithful to the Sublime Porte, but reigned as monarchs after gradually gaining independence from the Ottoman Empire. Between 1861 and 1864, the Beylik of Tunis became a constitutional monarchy after adopting the first constitution in Africa and the Arab world. The country had its own currency and an independent army, and in 1831 it adopted its flag, which is still in use today.

The Husainid dynasty continued to rule Tunisia, even after the establishment of the French protectorate in 1881, and remained in existence until the republic was declared on 25 July 1957, one year after independence.

Black Sea Grain Initiative.headline: Črnomorska žitna pobuda
paragraphs: Črnomorska žitna pobuda (ali Pobuda za varen prevoz žita in živil iz ukrajinskih pristanišč, v medijih navadno imenovana žitni dogovor) je bila sporazum med Rusijo, Ukrajino, Turčijo in Združenimi narodi (ZN). Sklenili so ga med rusko invazijo na Ukrajino. Invazija februarja 2022 je povsem ustavila pomorske pošiljke žita iz Ukrajine, ki je bila prej velika izvoznica prek Črnega morja. Poleg tega je Rusija začasno ustavila svoj izvoz žita, kar je razmere še poslabšalo. Posledice so bile rast svetovnih cen hrane, grožnja lakote v državah z nižjimi dohodki in obtožbe, da Rusija oskrbo s hrano uporablja kot orožje. Da bi težavo rešili, so se aprila začeli pogovori, ki jih je gostila Turčija (ki nadzoruje pomorske poti iz Črnega morja) ob podpori ZN. Sporazum, ki je iz njih nastal, so 22. julija podpisali v Istanbulu in je veljal 120 dni. Julijski sporazum je določil postopke za varen izvoz žita iz izbranih pristanišč, s katerimi naj bi blažili svetovno prehransko krizo. V Turčiji so ustanovili skupni center za usklajevanje in nadzor, ZN pa so opravljali naloge sekretariata.

source.title: Black Sea Grain Initiative
paragraphs: The Black Sea Grain Initiative (or the Initiative on the Safe Transportation of Grain and Foodstuffs from Ukrainian ports commonly called the grain deal in the media) was an agreement between Russia, Ukraine, Turkey, and the United Nations (UN). It took place during the Russian invasion of Ukraine. The February 2022 invasion led to a complete halt of maritime grain shipments from Ukraine, previously a major exporter via the Black Sea. Additionally, Russia temporarily halted its grain exports, further exacerbating the situation. This resulted in a rise in world food prices, the threat of famine in lower-income countries, and accusations that Russia was weaponizing food supplies. To address the issue, discussions began in April, hosted by Turkey (which controls the maritime routes from the Black Sea) and supported by the UN. The resulting agreement was signed in Istanbul on 22 July, valid for a period of 120 days. The July agreement created procedures to safely export grain from certain ports to attempt to address a worldwide food crisis. A joint coordination and inspection center was set up in Turkey, with the UN serving as secretariat.

Black September.headline: Črni september
paragraphs: Črni september (arabsko: Aylūl al-ʾAswad), znan tudi kot jordanska državljanska vojna, je bil oborožen spopad med Jordanijo pod vodstvom kralja Huseina in Palestinsko osvobodilno organizacijo (PLO) pod vodstvom predsednika Jaserja Arafata. Glavna faza bojev je potekala med 16. in 27. septembrom 1970, nekateri vidiki spopada pa so se nadaljevali do 17. julija 1971.

source.title: Black September
paragraphs: Black September (Arabic: أيلول الأسود, romanized: Aylūl al-ʾAswad), also known as the Jordanian Civil War, was an armed conflict between Jordan, led by King Hussein, and the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO), led by chairman Yasser Arafat. The main phase of the fighting took place between 16 and 27 September 1970, though certain aspects of the conflict continued until 17 July 1971.

Vojaška zgodovina Južne Afrike zajema dolgo obdobje in zapletene dogodke od začetkov zgodovine do danes: državljanske vojne ter napadalne in obrambne vojne znotraj Južne Afrike in proti njej. Vključuje bitke na ozemlju današnje Južne Afrike in na sosednjih ozemljih, v obeh svetovnih vojnah in v sodobnih mednarodnih spopadih.
notes: The key Boer Wars resolves to the English article Military history of South Africa; the summary is translated as it stands.

source.title: Military history of South Africa
paragraphs: The military history of South Africa chronicles a vast time period and complex events from the dawn of history until the present time. It covers civil wars and wars of aggression and of self-defense both within South Africa and against it. It includes the history of battles fought in the territories of modern South Africa in neighbouring territories, in both world wars and in modern international conflicts.

Uporništvo Boko Harama se je začelo julija 2009, ko je militantna islamistična in džihadistična uporniška skupina Boko Haram sprožila oborožen upor proti nigerijski vladi. Boko Haram napada muslimane in kristjane. Napadi so pogosto usmerjeni proti posameznikom, za katere menijo, da podpirajo nigerijsko vlado ali – po razkolu med skupinama – Islamsko državo, med njimi proti državnim uslužbencem, lokalnim obrambnim skupinam, muslimanskim voditeljem, ki skupini nasprotujejo, in drugim upornikom, kot sta Al Kaida in Islamska država. Večina napadov ni povezana z vero žrtev.

source.title: Boko Haram insurgency
paragraphs: The Boko Haram insurgency began in July 2009, when the militant Islamist and jihadist rebel group Boko Haram started an armed rebellion against the government of Nigeria. Boko Haram targets both Muslims and Christians. Attacks are often directed at individuals perceived as supporting the Nigerian government or Islamic State after the split between them, including civil servants, local defense groups, Muslim leaders who oppose the group and other rebels like al-Qaeda and Islamic State. Most attacks are not based on the religion of the victims.

Buganda.headline: Buganda
paragraphs: Buganda je bantujsko kraljestvo v Ugandi. Buganda, kraljestvo ljudstva Baganda, je največje tradicionalno kraljestvo v današnji vzhodni Afriki in obsega osrednjo regijo Ugande z ugandsko prestolnico Kampalo. Bagandov (ednina Muganda; pogosto jih imenujejo kar s korenom in pridevnikom Ganda) je 14 milijonov in so največja skupina v Ugandi, saj predstavljajo približno 16 % prebivalstva države.
notes: "the largest Ugandan region" is read as the largest group of Uganda's population.

source.title: Buganda
paragraphs: Buganda is a Bantu kingdom within Uganda. The kingdom of the Baganda people, Buganda is the largest of the traditional kingdoms in present-day East Africa, consisting of Uganda's Central Region, including the Ugandan capital Kampala. The 14 million Baganda (singular Muganda; often referred to simply by the root word and adjective, Ganda) make up the largest Ugandan region, representing approximately 16% of Uganda's population.

Bunyoro.headline: Bunyoro
paragraphs: Bunyoro, uradno Kraljestvo Bunyoro-Kitara, je tradicionalna bantujska monarhija v zahodni Ugandi. Od 16. do 19. stoletja je bilo eno najmočnejših kraljestev v osrednji in vzhodni Afriki. Vlada mu kralj (omukama) Bunyoro-Kitare. Sedanji vladar je Solomon Iguru I., 27. omukama.

source.title: Bunyoro
paragraphs: Bunyoro, formally called the Kingdom of Bunyoro-Kitara, is a Bantu traditional monarchy in Western Uganda. It was one of the most powerful kingdoms in Central and East Africa from the 16th century to the 19th century. It is ruled by the King (Omukama) of Bunyoro-Kitara. The current ruler is Solomon Iguru I, the 27th Omukama.

Burundian Civil War.headline: Burundijska državljanska vojna
paragraphs: Burundijska državljanska vojna je bila državljanska vojna v Burundiju, ki je trajala od leta 1993 do 2005. Izhajala je iz dolgotrajnih etničnih razlik med Hutujci in Tutsiji. Spopad se je začel po prvih večstrankarskih volitvah v državi po osamosvojitvi od Belgije leta 1962, za njegov formalni konec pa velja prisega predsednika Pierra Nkurunzize avgusta 2005. Obe strani sta v vojni množično uporabljali otroke. Po ocenah je umrlo 300.000 ljudi.

source.title: Burundian Civil War
paragraphs: The Burundian Civil War was a civil war in Burundi lasting from 1993 to 2005. The civil war was the result of longstanding ethnic divisions between the Hutu and the Tutsi ethnic groups. The conflict began following the first multi-party elections in the country since its independence from Belgium in 1962, and is seen as formally ending with the swearing-in of President Pierre Nkurunziza in August 2005. Children were widely used by both sides in the war. The estimated death toll stands at 300,000.

Byzantine civil war of 1373–1379.headline: Bizantinska državljanska vojna v letih 1373–1379
paragraphs: Bizantinska državljanska vojna v letih 1373–1379 je bila vojaški spopad v Bizantinskem cesarstvu med bizantinskim cesarjem Ivanom V. Paleologom in njegovim sinom Andronikom IV. Paleologom, ki je prerasel tudi v osmansko državljansko vojno, ko se je Savcı beg, sin osmanskega vladarja Murada I., pridružil Androniku v skupnem uporu proti očetoma. Začel se je, ko je Andronik leta 1373 skušal strmoglaviti očeta. Poskus mu ni uspel, a je z genovsko pomočjo leta 1376 nazadnje strmoglavil in zaprl Ivana V. Leta 1379 pa je Ivan V. pobegnil in z osmansko pomočjo znova prevzel prestol. Državljanska vojna je še bolj oslabila propadajoče Bizantinsko cesarstvo, ki je že v prejšnjih desetletjih tega stoletja doživelo več uničujočih državljanskih vojn. Glavni dobitniki vojne so bili Osmani, saj so Bizantinci postali njihovi vazali.

source.title: Byzantine civil war of 1373–1379
paragraphs: The Byzantine civil war of 1373–1379 was a military conflict fought in the Byzantine Empire between Byzantine Emperor John V Palaiologos and his son, Andronikos IV Palaiologos, also growing into an Ottoman civil war as well, when Savcı Bey, the son of Ottoman Emperor Murad I joined Andronikos in a joint rebellion against their fathers. It began when Andronikos sought to overthrow his father in 1373. Although he failed, with Genoese aid, Andronikos was eventually able to overthrow and imprison John V in 1376. In 1379 however, John V escaped and, with Ottoman help, regained his throne. The civil war further weakened the declining Byzantine Empire, which had already suffered several devastating civil wars earlier in the century. The primary beneficiary of the war were the Ottomans, as the Byzantines became their vassals.

Byzantine–Sasanian War of 572–591.headline: Bizantinsko-sasanidska vojna v letih 572–591
paragraphs: Bizantinsko-sasanidska vojna v letih 572–591 je potekala med perzijskim Sasanidskim imperijem in Bizantinskim cesarstvom. Sprožili so jo probizantinski upori na območjih Kavkaza pod perzijsko prevlado, k izbruhu pa so prispevali tudi drugi dogodki. Boji so bili večinoma omejeni na južni Kavkaz in Mezopotamijo, segli pa so tudi v vzhodno Anatolijo, Sirijo in severni Iran. Vojna je bila del silovitega zaporedja vojn med imperijema, ki je zajelo večji del 6. in začetek 7. stoletja. Bila je tudi zadnja od mnogih vojn med njima po vzorcu, v katerem so boji potekali večinoma v obmejnih provincah in nobena stran ni trajno zasedla sovražnikovega ozemlja zunaj tega obmejnega pasu. Sledil ji je precej obsežnejši in silovitejši sklepni spopad v začetku 7. stoletja.

source.title: Byzantine–Sasanian War of 572–591
paragraphs: The Byzantine–Sasanian War of 572–591 was a war fought between the Sasanian Empire of Persia and the Byzantine Empire. It was triggered by pro-Byzantine revolts in areas of the Caucasus under Persian hegemony, although other events also contributed to its outbreak. The fighting was largely confined to the southern Caucasus and Mesopotamia, although it also extended into eastern Anatolia, Syria, and northern Iran. It was part of an intense sequence of wars between these two empires which occupied the majority of the 6th and early 7th centuries. It was also the last of the many wars between them to follow a pattern in which fighting was largely confined to frontier provinces and neither side achieved any lasting occupation of enemy territory beyond this border zone. It preceded a much more wide-ranging and dramatic final conflict in the early 7th century.

Byzantine–Seljuk wars.headline: Bizantinsko-seldžuške vojne
paragraphs: Bizantinsko-seldžuške vojne so bile vrsta srednjeveških spopadov med Bizantinskim cesarstvom in Seldžuškim cesarstvom. Spremenile so razmerje moči v Mali Aziji, Armeniji in Siriji ter sprožile več vojn za nadzor nad temi območji, med njimi tudi križarske vojne. Spopadi so trajali do propada Rumskega sultanata leta 1308.

Bitka pri Manzikertu leta 1071 splošno velja za prelomnico vojn. Odprla je Anatolijo nadaljnjim turkmenskim vpadom, preseljevanju in naseljevanju. Bizantinska vojska je že pred letom 1071 izgubljala moštvo in opremo, nenehni turkmenski vpadi pa so preplavljali propadajoči tematski sistem. Po Manzikertu bizantinska oblast nad Malo Azijo ni takoj prenehala, prav tako Seldžuki od nasprotnikov niso izsilili velikih koncesij. Trajalo je še dve desetletji, preden so Seldžuki, Turkmeni, Danišmendidi in Čaka nadzorovali večji del Anatolije, nato pa so jih odbili z obal.

source.title: Byzantine–Seljuk wars
paragraphs: The Byzantine–Seljuk wars were a series of conflicts in the Middle Ages between the Byzantine Empire and the Seljuk Empire. They shifted the balance of power in Asia Minor, Armenia and Syria, sparking multiple wars for control over these regions, including the Crusades. These conflicts lasted until the collapse of the Sultanate of Rum in 1308.

The Battle of Manzikert of 1071 is widely regarded as the turning point of the wars. The battle opened up Anatolia for further Turkoman raids, migrations and settlements. The Byzantine military had declined in manpower and equipment prior to 1071, with constant Turkoman incursions overrunning the failing Thematic System. After Manzikert, Byzantine rule over Asia Minor did not end immediately, nor were any heavy concessions levied by the Seljuks on their opponents. It took another two decades before the Seljuks, Turkomans, Danishmendids and Chaka were in control of most of the Anatolian peninsula, before they were repulsed from the coastlines.

Candar dynasty.headline: Dinastija Candar
paragraphs: Dinastija Candar ali hiša Candar (sodobno turško: Candaroğulları), beglik Candar, kneževina Candar (Candaroğulları Beyliği, Candar Beyliği), znana tudi kot dinastija Isfendiyar (İsfendiyaroğulları), je bila oguška turška knežja anatolska dinastija, ki je od leta 1291 do 1461 vladala ozemljem, ki ustrezajo provincam Eflani, Kastamonu, Sinop, Zonguldak, Bartın, Karabük, Samsun, Bolu, Ankara in Çankırı v današnji Republiki Turčiji. V zahodni literaturi je pokrajina znana kot Paflagonija, ime, ki so ga za isto zemljepisno območje uporabljali v rimskem obdobju.
Dinastijo in kneževino, ki ju je ustanovil Şemseddin Yaman Candar beg, je sultan Mehmed II. leta 1461 vključil v Osmansko cesarstvo.
notes: The pronunciation /ˈdʒandar/ is dropped; Turkish names keep their Turkish spelling.

source.title: Candar dynasty
paragraphs: The Candar dynasty (/ˈdʒandar/) or the House of Candar (Modern Turkish: Candaroğulları), Beylik of Candar, Principality of Candar (Candaroğulları Beyliği, Candar Beyliği), also known as the Isfendiyar dynasty (İsfendiyaroğulları), was an Oghuz Turkic princely Anatolian dynasty that reigned in the territories corresponding to the provinces of Eflani, Kastamonu, Sinop, Zonguldak, Bartın, Karabük, Samsun, Bolu, Ankara and Çankırı in the present-day Republic of Turkey from the year 1291 to 1461. The region is known in Western literature as Paphlagonia, a name applied to the same geographical area during the Roman period.
The dynasty and principality, founded by Şemseddin Yaman Candar Bey, were incorporated into the Ottoman Empire by Sultan Mehmed II in 1461.

Cape Town Treaty.headline: Konvencija iz Cape Towna
paragraphs: Konvencija iz Cape Towna o mednarodnih jamstvih na premični opremi ali pogodba iz Cape Towna je mednarodna pogodba, katere namen je poenotiti posle s premičnim premoženjem. Pogodba določa mednarodne standarde za registracijo prodajnih pogodb (tudi s posebnimi registracijskimi agencijami), zavarovanj (zastavnih pravic), zakupov in pogodb o pogojni prodaji ter različna pravna sredstva ob neizpolnjevanju obveznosti iz pogodb o financiranju, med njimi ponovni prevzem in učinek stečajnih zakonov posameznih držav.

Štirje protokoli h konvenciji veljajo za štiri vrste premične opreme: opremo zrakoplovov (zrakoplovi in letalski motorji; podpisan leta 2001), železniška vozna sredstva (podpisan leta 2007), vesoljska sredstva (podpisan leta 2012) ter »rudarsko, kmetijsko in gradbeno opremo« (podpisan leta 2019). Protokol o zrakoplovih je začel veljati leta 2006, protokol o železniških voznih sredstvih pa leta 2024. Druga dva še ne veljata.

source.title: Cape Town Treaty
paragraphs: The Cape Town Convention on International Interests in Mobile Equipment, or Cape Town Treaty, is an international treaty intended to standardize transactions involving movable property. The treaty creates international standards for registration of contracts of sale (including dedicated registration agencies), security interests (liens), leases and conditional sales contracts, and various legal remedies for default in financing agreements, including repossession and the effect of particular states' bankruptcy laws.

Four protocols to the convention are specific to four types of movable equipment: Aircraft Equipment (aircraft and aircraft engines; signed in 2001), railway rolling stock (signed in 2007), space assets (signed in 2012) and "Mining, Agricultural and Construction Equipment" (signed in 2019). The aircraft Protocol entered into force in 2006, and the railway rolling stock Protocol entered into force in 2024. The others are not yet in effect.

Capture of Algiers (1516).headline: Zavzetje Alžira (1516)
paragraphs: Alžir sta leta 1516 zavzela brata Oruč in Hajredin Barbarossa, ki sta premagala vladarja mesta Salima at Tumija; sledil je neuspešen vojaški pohod Španskega imperija in šejka Tenesa, ki sta skušala strmoglaviti novi Alžirski sultanat.

source.title: Capture of Algiers (1516)
paragraphs: The capture of Algiers in 1516 was accomplished by the brothers Oruç and Hayreddin Barbarossa against Sālim al-Tūmī, the ruler of the city of Algiers, which was followed by an unsuccessful military campaign by the Spanish Empire and the Sheikh of Ténès to overthrow the newly formed Sultanate of Algiers.

Zavzetje Bagdada leta 1534, ko je osmanski sultan Sulejman Veličastni mesto iztrgal safavidskemu šahu Tahmaspu I., je bilo del njegovega pohoda na oba Iraka med osmansko-safavidsko vojno (1532–1555). Mesto je padlo brez odpora, saj je safavidska oblast pobegnila in ga pustila nebranjenega.

Zavzetje Bagdada je bilo pomemben dosežek, saj je mesto obvladovalo Tigris in Evfrat ter mednarodno in regionalno trgovino na njiju. Skupaj s padcem Basre leta 1546 je pomenilo pomemben korak k osmanski zmagi in pridobitvi spodnje Mezopotamije ter ustij Evfrata in Tigrisa, kar je odprlo trgovski izhod v Perzijski zaliv.

source.title: Capture of Baghdad (1534)
paragraphs: The 1534 capture of Baghdad by the Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent from the Safavid Shah Tahmasp I was part of his Campaign of the Two Iraqs during the Ottoman–Safavid War (1532–1555). The city was taken without resistance, the Safavid government having fled and leaving the city undefended.

Baghdad's capture was a significant achievement given its mastery of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers and their international and regional trade. It represented, along with the fall of Basra in 1546, a significant step towards eventual Ottoman victory and the procurement of the lower Mesopotamia, the mouths of the Euphrates and Tigris rivers, opening a trading outlet into the Persian Gulf.

Capture of Baghdad (1917).headline: Zavzetje Bagdada (1917)
paragraphs: Zavzetje Bagdada (11. marca 1917) se je zgodilo med mezopotamsko kampanjo, v kateri so se v prvi svetovni vojni bojevale sile Britanskega imperija in Osmanskega cesarstva.

source.title: Capture of Baghdad (1917)
paragraphs: The capture of Baghdad (11 March 1917) occurred during the Mesopotamian campaign, fought between the forces of the British Empire and the Ottoman Empire in World War I.

Capture of Damascus (1918).headline: Zavzetje Damaska (1918)
paragraphs: Zavzetje Damaska je pomenilo zmago britanske in arabske vojske v pohodu proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu na bližnjevzhodnem bojišču prve svetovne vojne. Mesto so zavzeli 1. oktobra 1918, po zavzetju Haife in zmagi v bitki pri Samahu, ki je odprla pot za zasledovanje proti severu od Galilejskega jezera, ter po tretjem transjordanskem napadu, ki je odprl pot do Deraje in zasledovanje v notranjosti, vse to po odločilni zmagi egiptovskih ekspedicijskih sil (EEF) v bitki pri Megidu v sinajsko-palestinski kampanji. Damask je padel, ko so mesto obkolili indijsko-britanske čete pod vodstvom generala Barrowa, puščavski konjeniški korpus generala Chauvela, šarifska hedžaška vojska princa Fejsala in arabska vojska šarifa Nasirja iz Medine. Nemške in turške čete v mestu so se tej premoči zelo hitro vdale.

source.title: Capture of Damascus (1918)
paragraphs: The Capture of Damascus marked a victory of the British and Arab armies in their campaign against the Ottoman empire in the Middle Eastern theatre of World War I. The capture took place on 1 October 1918 after the capture of Haifa and the victory at the Battle of Samakh which opened the way for the pursuit north from the Sea of Galilee and the Third Transjordan attack which opened the way to Deraa and the inland pursuit, after the decisive Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) victory at the Battle of Megiddo during the Sinai and Palestine campaign of World War I. Damascus was captured when Indian British troops under general Barrow, the Desert Mounted Corps under general Chauvel, Prince Faisal's Sharifial Hejaz Army and an Arab army under Sharif Nasir of Medina encircled the city. Faced with this superior force, the German and Turkish troops in the city surrendered very quickly.

Capture of Erivan.headline: Zavzetje Erivana
paragraphs: Zavzetje Erivana (ali Erevana; perzijsko: فتح ایروان, Fath e Iravān; rusko: Взятие Эривани, Vzyatie Ėrivani) se je zgodilo 1. oktobra 1827 med rusko-perzijsko vojno v letih 1826–1828. Mesto je po tednu dni obleganja padlo v ruske roke, kar je odprlo pot poznejšemu zavzetju Tabriza, drugega največjega mesta v Iranu in pomembnega trgovskega središča.

source.title: Capture of Erivan
paragraphs: The capture of Erivan (or Erevan/Yerevan; Persian: فتح ایروان, romanized: Fath e Iravān; Russian: Взятие Эривани, romanized: Vzyatie Ėrivani) took place on 1 October 1827, during the Russo-Persian War of 1826–1828. The city fell to the Russians after being besieged for a week and opened up the path for the eventual capture of Tabriz, the second largest city in Iran and an important trading post.

Capture of Gallipoli (1354).headline: Zavzetje Galipolija (1354)
paragraphs: Padec Galipolija (turško: Gelibolu'nun Fethi, dobesedno »osvojitev Gelibolu«) je bil obleganje in zavzetje trdnjave in polotoka Galipoli, ki so ju marca 1354 zavzeli osmanski Turki. Po pol stoletja porazov v boju z Osmani je Bizantinsko cesarstvo izgubilo skoraj vse svoje posesti v Anatoliji razen Filadelfije. Z dostopom do Egejskega in Marmarskega morja so lahko Osmani zdaj začeli osvajati južni Balkan in prodirati naprej proti severu, v Srbsko cesarstvo in na Ogrsko.

source.title: Capture of Gallipoli (1354)
paragraphs: The fall of Gallipoli (Turkish: Gelibolu'nun Fethi, lit. 'Conquest of Gelibolu') was the siege and capture of the Gallipoli fortress and peninsula, by the Ottoman Turks, in March 1354. After suffering a half-century of defeats at the hands of the Ottomans, the Byzantine Empire had lost nearly all of its possessions in Anatolia, except Philadelphia. Access to the Aegean and Marmara seas meant that the Ottomans could now implement the conquest of the southern Balkans, and could advance further north into the Serbian Empire and Hungary.

Angleško-nizozemske sile Velike alianse so Gibraltar zavzele med 1. in 4. avgustom 1704 med špansko nasledstveno vojno. Aliansa je že od začetka vojne iskala pristanišče na Iberskem polotoku, s katerim bi nadzorovala Gibraltarsko ožino in si olajšala pomorske operacije proti francoskemu ladjevju v zahodnem Sredozemlju. Poskus zavzetja Cádiza se je septembra 1702 končal neuspešno, po uspešnem napadu ladjevja alianse v zalivu Vigo oktobra istega leta pa sta združeni ladjevji »pomorskih sil«, Nizozemske in Anglije, postali prevladujoča pomorska sila v regiji. Ta moč je pomagala prepričati portugalskega kralja Petra II., da je leta 1703 prekinil zavezništvo s Francijo in Španijo pod Burboni ter se povezal z Veliko alianso, saj so lahko ladjevja alianse z dostopom do lizbonskega pristanišča delovala v Sredozemlju in podpirala avstrijskega habsburškega kandidata za španski prestol, nadvojvodo Karla, ki so ga njegovi privrženci imenovali španski kralj Karel III.
notes: The editorial note "(see All dates in the annotations)" is dropped.

source.title: Capture of Gibraltar
paragraphs: The capture of Gibraltar by Anglo-Dutch forces of the Grand Alliance occurred between 1 and 4 August 1704 during the War of the Spanish Succession. (see All dates in the annotations) Since the beginning of the war the Alliance had been looking for a harbour in the Iberian Peninsula to control the Strait of Gibraltar and facilitate naval operations against the French fleet in the western Mediterranean Sea. An attempt to seize Cádiz had ended in failure in September 1702, but following the Alliance fleet's successful raid in Vigo Bay in October that year, the combined fleets of the "Maritime Powers", the Netherlands and England, had emerged as the dominant naval force in the region. This strength helped persuade King Peter II of Portugal to sever his alliance with France and Bourbon-controlled Spain, and ally himself with the Grand Alliance in 1703 as the Alliance fleets could campaign in the Mediterranean using access to the port of Lisbon and conduct operations in support of the Austrian Habsburg candidate to the Spanish throne, the Archduke Charles, known to his supporters as Charles III of Spain.

Capture of Mecca (1813).headline: Zavzetje Meke (1813)
paragraphs: Zavzetje Meke leta 1813 se je zgodilo nekaj dni po tem, ko so Osmani v prvem pohodu osmansko-vahabitske vojne zavzeli Džido.

source.title: Capture of Mecca (1813)
paragraphs: The Capture of Mecca in 1813 took place several days after the Ottoman Capture of Jeddah in the First Campaign of the Ottoman–Wahhabi war.

Capture of Mecca (1924).headline: Zavzetje Meke (1924)
paragraphs: Zavzetje Meke je 5. decembra 1924 v Meki potekalo v okviru savdske osvojitve Kraljevine Hedžas, ki jo je izvedel kralj Sultanata Nedžd Abdulaziz ibn Saud. Pokrajini Hedžas je kot kraljestvu vladal kralj Husein bin Ali iz hašemitske rodbine.

source.title: Capture of Mecca (1924)
paragraphs: The Capture of Mecca took place on 5 December 1924 in Mecca, as part of the Saudi conquest of the Kingdom of Hejaz by King Abdulaziz Ibn Saud of the Sultanate of Nejd. The Hejaz region was ruled as a kingdom under King Hussein bin Ali of the Hashemite family.

Capture of Peñón of Algiers (1529).headline: Zavzetje Peñóna v Alžiru (1529)
paragraphs: Alžirski beglerbeg Hajredin Barbarossa je habsburškim Špancem iztrgal trdnjavo Peñón v Alžiru, ki je stala na majhnem otočku nasproti alžirskega mesta Alžir.

source.title: Capture of Peñón of Algiers (1529)
paragraphs: The capture of Peñón of Algiers was accomplished when the beylerbey of Algiers, Hayreddin Barbarossa, captured the fortress called Peñón of Algiers, on a small islet facing the Algerian city of Algiers from the Habsburg Spaniards.

Casamance conflict.headline: Spopad v Casamanceu
paragraphs: Spopad v Casamanceu (francosko: Conflit en Casamance) je dolgotrajen spopad nizke intenzivnosti, ki od leta 1982 poteka med senegalsko vlado in Gibanjem demokratičnih sil Casamancea (MFDC). Vodja MFDC je 1. maja 2014 zaprosil za mir in razglasil enostransko premirje.

MFDC zahteva neodvisnost regije Casamance, katere prebivalstvo se po veri in etnični pripadnosti razlikuje od preostalega Senegala. Najbolj krvava so bila leta 1992–2001, ko je v bojih umrlo več kot tisoč ljudi.

MFDC in vlada sta 30. decembra 2004 sklenila sporazum, ki je obljubljal prostovoljno vključitev borcev MFDC v paravojaške sile države, programe gospodarske obnove Casamancea, razminiranje in pomoč beguncem, ki so se vračali. Nekatere skrajne frakcije MFDC so se kmalu odcepile od delov gibanja, ki so sporazum podpisali, po propadu pogovorov v Foundiougneju 2. februarja 2005 pa pogajanj ni bilo več.

source.title: Casamance conflict
paragraphs: The Casamance conflict (French: Conflit en Casamance) is an ongoing low-level conflict that has been waged between the Government of Senegal and the Movement of Democratic Forces of Casamance (MFDC) since 1982. On 1 May 2014, the leader of the MFDC sued for peace and declared a unilateral ceasefire.

The MFDC has called for the independence of the Casamance region, whose population is religiously and ethnically distinct from the rest of Senegal. The bloodiest years of the conflict were during the 1992–2001 period and resulted in over a thousand battle related deaths.

On 30 December 2004, an agreement was reached between the MFDC and the government which promised to provide the voluntary integration of MFDC fighters into the country's paramilitary forces, economic recovery programmes for Casamance, de-mining and aid to returning refugees. Nevertheless, some hard-line factions of the MFDC soon defected from elements of the MFDC who had signed the agreement and no negotiations took place following the breakdown of talks in Foundiougne on 2 February 2005.

Cedar Revolution.headline: Cedrina revolucija
paragraphs: Cedrina revolucija (arabsko: thawrat al-arz), v Libanonu znana kot intifada za neodvisnost (intifadat al-istiqlal), je bila vrsta demonstracij v Libanonu (zlasti v prestolnici Bejrut), ki jih je sprožil umor nekdanjega libanonskega predsednika vlade Rafika Haririja. Ljudsko gibanje je bilo izjemno, ker se je izogibalo nasilju, ravnalo mirno in se v celoti zanašalo na metode državljanskega odpora.

Glavni cilji aktivistov so bili umik sirskih čet, ki so Libanon zasedale od leta 1976, zamenjava vlade, na katero so močno vplivali sirski interesi, z bolj neodvisnim vodstvom, ustanovitev mednarodne komisije za preiskavo umora predsednika vlade Haririja, odstop varnostnih uradnikov, ki naj bi zagotovil uspeh načrta, in svobodne parlamentarne volitve. Na splošno so demonstranti zahtevali konec sirskega vpliva na libanonsko politiko.

source.title: Cedar Revolution
paragraphs: The Cedar Revolution (Arabic: ثورة الأرز, romanized: thawrat al-arz), known in Lebanon as the Independence intifada (انتفاضة الاستقلال, intifadat al-istiqlal), was a chain of demonstrations in Lebanon (especially in the capital Beirut) triggered by the assassination of former Lebanese Prime Minister Rafic Hariri. The popular movement was remarkable for its avoidance of violence, peaceful approach, and its total reliance on methods of civil resistance.

The primary goals of the activists were the withdrawal of the Syrian troops which had occupied Lebanon since 1976, the replacement of a government heavily influenced by Syrian interests by more independent leadership, the establishment of an international commission to investigate the assassination of Prime Minister Hariri, the resignation of security officials to ensure the success of the plan, and the organization of free parliamentary elections. More generally, the demonstrators demanded the end of the Syrian influence in Lebanese politics.

Celali rebellions.headline: Dželalijski upori
paragraphs: Dželalijski upori (turško: Celalî ayaklanmaları) so bili vrsta uporov neregularnih enot v Anatoliji, ki so jih vodili razbojniški poglavarji in pokrajinski uradniki, imenovani celalî, celâli ali jelālī, proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu od konca 16. do sredine 17. stoletja.

source.title: Celali rebellions
paragraphs: The Celali rebellions (Turkish: Celalî ayaklanmaları) were a series of rebellions in Anatolia of irregular troops led by bandit chiefs and provincial officials known as celalî, celâli, or jelālī, against the Ottoman Empire in the late 16th and early to mid-17th centuries.

Central African Bush War.headline: Srednjeafriška vojna v grmovju
paragraphs: Srednjeafriška vojna v grmovju je bila državljanska vojna v Srednjeafriški republiki, ki je med letoma 2004 in 2007 potekala med uporniki Zveze demokratičnih sil za enotnost (UFDR) in vladnimi silami. Upor se je začel, potem ko si je François Bozizé leta 2003 prilastil predsedniški položaj, pravi boji pa so izbruhnili leta 2004. Zaradi nemirov je bilo razseljenih okoli 10.000 ljudi.

Upor je sestavljalo več uporniških skupin, med katerimi so bile nekatere zelo majhne in ustanovljene šele proti koncu spopada. Poleg UFDR so v spopadu sodelovali še Ljudska vojska za obnovo demokracije (APRD), Groupe d'action patriotique pour la libération de Centrafrique (GAPLC), Gibanje srednjeafriških osvoboditeljev za pravičnost (MLCJ), Front démocratique centrafricain (FDC) in Zveza republikanskih sil (UFR).

source.title: Central African Bush War
paragraphs: The Central African Bush War was a civil war in the Central African Republic which lasted from 2004 to 2007 between Union of Democratic Forces for Unity (UFDR) rebels and government forces. The rebellion began after François Bozizé seized the nation's presidency in 2003. Actual fighting began in 2004. Around 10,000 people were displaced because of the civil unrest.

The rebellion consisted of multiple rebel groups, several of which were of very small size and founded only towards the end of the conflict. Apart from the UFDR, the conflict included the People's Army for the Restoration of Democracy (CAR) (APRD), Groupe d'action patriotique pour la liberation de Centrafrique (GAPLC), the Movement of Central African Liberators for Justice (MLCJ), the Front démocratique Centrafricain (FDC), and Union of Republican Forces (UFR).

Državljanska vojna v Srednjeafriški republiki je še trajajoča državljanska vojna v Srednjeafriški republiki (SAR), v kateri sodelujejo zaporedne vlade, uporniki iz nekdanje koalicije Séléka, milice anti-balaka ter različne tuje in mednarodne sile.

source.title: Central African Republic Civil War
paragraphs: The Central African Republic Civil War is an ongoing civil war in the Central African Republic (CAR) involving the successive governments, rebels from the former Séléka coalition, the Anti-balaka militias, and various foreign and international forces.

Chadian Civil War (1965–1979).headline: Čadska državljanska vojna (1965–1979)
paragraphs: Čadska državljanska vojna v letih 1965–1979 (francosko: Guerre civile tchadienne de 1965–1979) je bila vojna več uporniških frakcij proti dvema čadskima vladama. Prvi upor je izbruhnil kot odpor proti predsedniku Françoisu Tombalbayeju, katerega režim so zaznamovali avtoritarnost, skrajna korupcija in protekcija. Leta 1975 je Tombalbayeja umorila lastna vojska, oblast pa je prevzela vojaška vlada pod vodstvom Félixa Mallouma, ki je vojno proti upornikom nadaljevala. Po tujih posredovanjih Libije in Francije, razcepu upornikov na tekmujoče frakcije in stopnjevanju bojev je Malloum marca 1979 odstopil. S tem je bila odprta pot novi narodni vladi, znani kot »prehodna vlada narodne enotnosti« (GUNT).
Z vzponom GUNT se je v Čadu začela nova faza državljanske vojne in mednarodnega spopada.

source.title: Chadian Civil War (1965–1979)
paragraphs: The Chadian Civil War of 1965–1979 (French: Guerre civile tchadienne de 1965–1979) was waged by several rebel factions against two Chadian governments. The initial rebellion erupted in opposition to Chadian President François Tombalbaye, whose regime was marked by authoritarianism, extreme corruption, and favoritism. In 1975 Tombalbaye was murdered by his own army, and a military government headed by Félix Malloum emerged and continued the war against the insurgents. Following foreign interventions by Libya and France, the fracturing of the rebels into rival factions, and an escalation of the fighting, Malloum stepped down in March 1979. This paved the way for a new national government, known as "Transitional Government of National Unity" (GUNT).
Following the rise of GUNT, a new phase of civil war and international conflict broke out in Chad.

Državljanska vojna v Čadu v letih 2005–2010 se je začela 18. decembra 2005. Čad so od osamosvojitve izpod Francije leta 1960 pretresale državljanske vojne med arabskimi muslimani na severu in podsaharskimi kristjani na jugu. Vodstvo in predsedniški položaj sta zato prehajala med krščanskimi južnjaki in muslimanskimi severnjaki. Ko je bila na oblasti ena stran, je druga navadno začela revolucionarno vojno proti njej.

source.title: Chadian Civil War (2005–2010)
paragraphs: The Chadian Civil War of 2005–2010 began on 18 December 2005. Since its independence from France in 1960, Chad has been swamped by civil wars between the Arab-Muslims of the north and the Sub-Saharan-Christians of the south. As a result, leadership and presidency in Chad drifted back and forth between the Christian southerners and Muslim northerners. When one side was in power, the other side usually started a revolutionary war to counter it.

Čadsko-libijska vojna je bila vrsta vojaških pohodov v Čadu med letoma 1978 in 1987, v katerih so se Libija in njeni čadski zavezniki bojevali proti protilibijskim čadskim skupinam, ki jih je podpirala Francija, občasno pa so se vmešale še druge tuje države in frakcije.

Libija se je v notranje zadeve Čada vmešavala že pred letom 1978 in pred vzponom Moamerja Gadafija na oblast v Libiji leta 1969, začenši z razširitvijo čadske državljanske vojne na sever Čada leta 1968. Spopad so zaznamovala štiri ločena libijska posredovanja v Čadu, v letih 1978, 1979, 1980–1981 in 1983–1987. Gadafija je vselej podpiralo več frakcij, udeleženih v državljanski vojni, nasprotniki Libije pa so dobili podporo francoske vlade, ki je v podporo čadski vladi vojaško posredovala v letih 1978, 1983 in 1986.

source.title: Chadian–Libyan War
paragraphs: The Chadian–Libyan War was a series of military campaigns in Chad between 1978 and 1987, fought between Libya and its Chadian allies, and anti-Libyan Chadian groups supported by France, with the occasional involvement of other foreign countries and factions.

Libya had been involved in Chad's internal affairs prior to 1978 and before Muammar Gaddafi's rise to power in Libya in 1969, beginning with the extension of the Chadian Civil War to northern Chad in 1968. The conflict was marked by a series of four separate Libyan interventions in Chad, taking place in 1978, 1979, 1980–1981 and 1983–1987. On all of these occasions, Gaddafi had the support of a number of factions participating in the civil war, while Libya's opponents found the support of the French government, which intervened militarily to support the Chadian government in 1978, 1983 and 1986.

Chobanids.headline: Čobanidi
paragraphs: Čobanidi ali Čupanidi (perzijsko: چوپانیان) so bili potomci mongolske družine iz klana Suldus, ki se je v Perziji uveljavila v 14. stoletju. Sprva so služili Ilkanom, po padcu Ilkanata pa so dejansko prevzeli oblast nad ozemljem. Vladali so Azerbajdžanu (kjer so imeli sedež), Aranu, delom Male Azije, Mezopotamiji in zahodni osrednji Perziji, Bagdad pa so prevzeli Džalairidi.

source.title: Chobanids
paragraphs: The Chobanids or the Chupanids (Persian: چوپانیان) were descendants of a Mongol family of the Suldus clan that came to prominence in 14th century Persia. At first serving under the Ilkhans, they took de facto control of the territory after the fall of the Ilkhanate. The Chobanids ruled over Azerbaijan (where they were based), Arrān, parts of Asia Minor, Mesopotamia, and west central Persia, while the Jalayirids took control in Baghdad.

Colonies in antiquity.headline: Kolonije v antiki
