paragraphs: Kolonije v antiki so bile mestne države iz časa po železni dobi, ki jih je ustanovilo matično mesto ali metropola, ne pa širše ozemlje. Vezi med kolonijo in njeno metropolo so pogosto ostale tesne in so v klasični antiki dobile posebne oblike. Kolonije, ki so jih ustanovili stari Feničani, Kartagina, Rim, Aleksander Veliki in njegovi nasledniki, so na splošno ostale povezane s svojo metropolo, grške kolonije iz arhaične in klasične dobe pa so bile že od ustanovitve suverene in samoupravne. Starejše grške kolonije so pogosto ustanavljali zato, da bi z izselitvijo dela prebivalstva odpravili družbene nemire v matičnem mestu, helenistične, rimske, kartažanske in kitajske kolonije iz dinastije Han pa so bile središča trgovine (tranzitna skladišča), širjenja in gradnje imperija.

source.title: Colonies in antiquity
paragraphs: Colonies in antiquity were post-Iron Age city-states founded from a mother-city or metropolis rather than from a territory-at-large. Bonds between a colony and its metropolis often remained close, and took specific forms during the period of classical antiquity. Generally, colonies founded by the ancient Phoenicians, Carthage, Rome, Alexander the Great and his successors remained tied to their metropolis, though Greek colonies of the Archaic and Classical eras were sovereign and self-governing from their inception. While earlier Greek colonies were often founded to solve social unrest in the mother-city by expelling a part of the population, Hellenistic, Roman, Carthaginian, and Han Chinese colonies served as centres for trade (entrepôts), expansion and empire-building.

Comprehensive Peace Agreement.headline: Celoviti mirovni sporazum
paragraphs: Celoviti mirovni sporazum (CPA, arabsko: اتفاقية السلام الشامل), znan tudi kot sporazum iz Naivashe, je bil sporazum, ki sta ga 9. januarja 2005 podpisala Sudansko ljudsko osvobodilno gibanje (SPLM) in sudanska vlada. Njegov namen je bil končati drugo sudansko državljansko vojno, razviti demokratično upravljanje v vsej državi in razdeliti prihodke od nafte. Določil je tudi časovnico za referendum o neodvisnosti Južnega Sudana.
Mirovni proces sta spodbujala Medvladna oblast za razvoj (IGAD) in »trojka« držav donatoric, ki so jo sestavljale Združene države, Združeno kraljestvo in Norveška.
notes: The romanization of the Arabic name is dropped.

source.title: Comprehensive Peace Agreement
paragraphs: The Comprehensive Peace Agreement (CPA, Arabic: اتفاقية السلام الشامل, romanized: Ittifāqiyyah al-salām al-šāmil), also known as the Naivasha Agreement, was an accord signed on 9 January 2005, by the Sudan People's Liberation Movement (SPLM) and the Government of Sudan. The CPA was meant to end the Second Sudanese Civil War, develop democratic governance countrywide, and share oil revenues. It also set a timetable for a Southern Sudanese independence referendum.
The peace process was encouraged by the Intergovernmental Authority on Development (IGAD), in addition to a "troika" of donor countries comprising the United States, United Kingdom, and Norway.

Congo Arab war.headline: Kongovsko-arabska vojna
paragraphs: Kongovsko-arabska vojna je bila kolonialna vojna, ki je med letoma 1892 in 1894 na vzhodu porečja Konga potekala med Svobodno državo Kongo in arabsko-svahilskimi vojskovodji, povezanimi s trgovino s sužnji v Indijskem oceanu.

Vojna je izbruhnila, ker sta se Svobodna država in Arabci potegovala za nadzor nad regionalnimi viri. Končala se je januarja 1894 z zmago Leopoldove Force Publique. Svobodna država je sprva sodelovala z Arabci, vendar se je razvilo tekmovanje za nadzor nad slonovino, sporne pa so postale tudi humanitarne zaveze, ki jih je Leopold II., kralj-suveren Svobodne države Kongo, dal berlinski konferenci, da bo odpravil suženjstvo. Leopold II. se je proti nekdanjim zaveznikom postavil po robu. Vojno proti svahilsko-arabski gospodarski in politični moči so predstavljali kot krščanski protisuženjski križarski pohod.

source.title: Congo Arab war
paragraphs: The Congo Arab war was a colonial war between the Congo Free State and Arab-Swahili warlords associated with the Indian Ocean slave trade in the eastern regions of the Congo Basin between 1892 and 1894.

The war was caused by the Free State and the Arabs contending for the control of regional resources. The war ended in January 1894 with a victory of Leopold's Force Publique. Initially, the Free State collaborated with the Arabs. Still, competition struck over the control of ivory and the topic of the humanitarian pledges given by Leopold II, King-Sovereign of the Congo Free State, to the Berlin Conference to end slavery. Leopold II's stance turned confrontational against his once-allies. The war against the Swahili-Arab economic and political power was presented as a Christian anti-slavery crusade.

Zavzetje Meke (arabsko: Fatḥ Makka) je bilo vojaški pohod, ki so ga izvedli Mohamed in njegovi tovariši med muslimansko-kurajšitsko vojno. Zgodnje muslimane so decembra 629 ali januarja 630 (10.–20. ramadana leta 8 po hidžri) povedli nad Meko, ki so jo nadzorovali Kurajšiti. Padec mesta v Mohamedove roke je formalno končal spopad med njegovimi privrženci in kurajšitsko plemensko zvezo.

source.title: Conquest of Mecca
paragraphs: The conquest of Mecca (Arabic: فتح مكة Fatḥ Makka) was a military campaign undertaken by Muhammad and his companions during the Muslim–Quraysh War. They led the early Muslims in an advance on the Quraysh-controlled city of Mecca in December 629 or January 630 (10–20 Ramadan, 8 AH). The fall of the city to Muhammad formally marked the end of the conflict between his followers and the Quraysh tribal confederation.

Conquest of Tunis (1534).headline: Zavzetje Tunisa (1534)
paragraphs: Hajredin Barbarossa je 16. avgusta 1534 zavzel Tunis in ga iztrgal hafsidskemu vladarju Mulaju Hasanu.

Leta 1533 je Sulejman Veličastni Hajredinu Barbarossi, ki ga je poklical iz Alžira, ukazal, naj v carigrajskem arzenalu zgradi veliko vojno ladjevje. Pozimi 1533–1534 so zgradili 70 galej, na katerih so veslali sužnji, med njimi 1200 kristjanov. S tem ladjevjem je Barbarossa napadalno plenil ob italijanski obali, dokler se ni 16. avgusta 1534 izkrcal v Tunisu in odstavil tamkajšnjega vladarja, hafsidskega regenta Mulaja Hasana, ki je bil dotlej podrejen Špancem.

Barbarossa je tako v Tunisu vzpostavil močno pomorsko oporišče, iz katerega je lahko napadal po regiji in na bližnjo Malto. Tunis je imel zelo strateško lego, saj je nadzoroval prehod iz zahodnega v vzhodni del Sredozemlja.

source.title: Conquest of Tunis (1534)
paragraphs: The conquest of Tunis occurred on 16 August 1534 when Hayreddin Barbarossa captured the city from the Hafsid ruler Muley Hasan.

In 1533, Suleiman the Magnificent ordered Hayreddin Barbarossa, whom he had summoned from Algiers, to build a large war fleet in the arsenal of Constantinople. Altogether 70 galleys were built during the winter of 1533–34, manned by slave oarsmen, including 1,200 Christian ones. With this fleet, Barbarossa conducted aggressive raids along the coast of Italy, until he landed in Tunis on 16 August 1534, ousting the local ruler, theretofore subservient to the Spanish, the Hafsid Regent Muley Hasan.

Barbarossa thus established a strong naval base in Tunis, which could be used for raids in the region, and on nearby Malta. Tunis was a highly strategic location, controlling the passage from the west to the eastern basin of the Mediterranean.

Do zavzetja Tunisa (v španskih virih imenovanega Jornada de Túnez) leta 1535 je prišlo, ko so cesar Svetega rimskega cesarstva Karel V. in njegovi zavezniki iztrgali mesto Tunis izpod oblasti Osmanskega cesarstva. Katoliško ladjevje, v katerem sta bila tudi admirala Andrea Doria in Álvaro de Bazán starejši, je zajelo ladjevje velikega osmanskega admirala Hajredina Barbarosse, ki je Tunis spremenil v svoje pomorsko oporišče za poznejše vdore v Italijo in Španijo. Barbarossa je sicer ušel, zmaga pa je zagotovila, da so se osmanske sile v severni Afriki omejile na običajne akcije berberskih korzarjev. Tunis je ostal pod špansko oblastjo, dokler ga Osmani leta 1569 niso znova zavzeli.

source.title: Conquest of Tunis (1535)
paragraphs: The Conquest of Tunis (called Jornada de Túnez in Spanish sources) in 1535 occurred when the Holy Roman Emperor Charles V and his allies captured the city of Tunis from the control of the Ottoman Empire. The Catholic fleet, which included admirals Andrea Doria and Bazán the Elder, captured the fleet of grand Ottoman admiral Hayreddin Barbarossa, who had turned Tunis into his naval base for future invasions of Italy and Spain. Although Barbarossa managed to escape, the victory ensured Ottoman forces in North Africa remained limited to the usual actions of the Barbary corsairs. Tunis remained under Spanish control until its Ottoman recapture in 1569.

Conquest of Tunis (1574).headline: Zavzetje Tunisa (1574)
paragraphs: Z zavzetjem Tunisa leta 1574 je Osmansko cesarstvo mesto iztrgalo Španskemu imperiju, ki ga je zasedel leto prej. Dogodek je boj obeh imperijev za prevlado v severni Afriki tako rekoč odločil v korist Osmanov in zapečatil osmansko prevlado nad vzhodnim in osrednjim Magrebom; osmanske odvisne države v Alžiru, Tunisu in Tripoliju so nato kot korzarske države doživele zlato dobo.

source.title: Conquest of Tunis (1574)
paragraphs: The conquest of Tunis in 1574 marked the conquest of Tunis by the Ottoman Empire over the Spanish Empire, which had seized the place a year earlier. The event virtually determined the supremacy in North Africa vied between both empires in favour of the former, sealing the Ottoman domination over eastern and central Maghreb, with the Ottoman dependencies in Algiers, Tunis and Tripoli ensuing coming to experience a golden age as corsair states.

Perzijska ustavna revolucija je bila kratkotrajno prizadevanje za demokratično vladavino v obliki ustavne monarhije v zelo elitistični, a decentralizirani družbi pod Kadžari. Naraščajoči odpor duhovščine, trgovcev z bazarjev, kmetov, izobražencev in drugih slojev do šaha in njegove politike konec 19. in v začetku 20. stoletja je klasičen primer okolja, zrelega za protest, saj je vse več ljudi v družbi čutilo potrebo izraziti nezadovoljstvo z zatiralsko in večinoma avtokratsko vlado.

source.title: Constitutionalization attempts in Iran
paragraphs: The Iranian Constitutional Revolution was a short-lived push for democratic rule in the form of a constitutional monarchy within a highly elitist yet decentralized society under the Qajars. The mounting disgust amidst the clergy, bazaaris, farmers, intellectuals, and other segments of the populace with respect to the Shah, policies during the end of the 19th and beginning of the 20th century illustrates a classic example of an environment ripe for protest, as a wide array of people in society felt an increasing need to express their grievances with an oppressive and largely autocratic government.

Convention of Constantinople.headline: Carigrajska konvencija
paragraphs: Carigrajska konvencija je pogodba o uporabi Sueškega prekopa v Egiptovskem kedivatu pod osmansko oblastjo. Podpisali so jo 29. oktobra 1888 Združeno kraljestvo, Nemško cesarstvo, Avstro-Ogrska, Španija, Francija, Italija, Nizozemska, Rusko cesarstvo in Osmansko cesarstvo. Egiptovskega kedivata, prek katerega ozemlja je tekel prekop in na katerega naj bi po izteku 99-letnega zakupa za upravljanje prekopa prešle vse delnice Družbe Sueškega prekopa, niso povabili k pogajanjem in pogodbe ni podpisal.

Podpisnice so bile vse velike evropske sile tistega časa, pogodbo pa so razlagali kot zajamčeno pravico vseh ladij do prehoda skozi Sueški prekop v vojni in miru. V 74 letih britanske vojaške navzočnosti v Egiptu, od leta 1882 do 1956, je imela britanska vlada dejanski nadzor nad prekopom. Leta 1956 je egiptovska vlada podržavila Družbo Sueškega prekopa. V poznejših vojnah med Egiptom in Izraelom je bil prekop dolga obdobja zaprt in neuporaben.

source.title: Convention of Constantinople
paragraphs: The Convention of Constantinople is a treaty concerning the use of the Suez Canal in the Ottoman-ruled Khedivate of Egypt. It was signed on 29 October 1888 by the United Kingdom, the German Empire, Austria-Hungary, Spain, France, Italy, the Netherlands, the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire. The Khedivate of Egypt, through whose territory the Canal ran and to which all shares in the Suez Canal Company were due to revert when the company's 99-year lease to manage the canal expired, was not invited to participate in the negotiations and did not sign the treaty.

The signatories comprised all the great European powers of the era, and the treaty was interpreted as a guaranteed right of passage of all ships through the Suez Canal during war and peace. During the 74 years of the United Kingdom's military presence in Egypt, from 1882 to 1956, the British government was in effective control of the Canal. In 1956, the Egyptian government nationalised the Suez Canal Company. Future wars between Egypt and Israel would see the canal blocked and unusable for extended periods of time.

Cotonou Agreement.headline: Sporazum iz Cotonouja
paragraphs: Sporazum iz Cotonouja (francosko: Accord de Cotonou) je pogodba med Evropsko unijo (EU) in skupino afriških, karibskih in pacifiških držav (AKP). Junija 2000 ga je v Cotonouju, največjem mestu Benina, podpisalo 78 držav AKP (razen Kube) in tedanjih petnajst držav članic EU. Veljati je začel leta 2003, revidirali pa so ga v letih 2005 in 2010.
Po reviziji leta 2010 bi moral sporazum prenehati veljati 29. februarja 2020, vendar so ga do sprejetja novega sporazuma (sporazuma iz Samoe) začasno podaljšali, najpozneje do 31. oktobra 2023.

source.title: Cotonou Agreement
paragraphs: The Cotonou Agreement (French: Accord de Cotonou) is a treaty between the European Union (EU) and the African, Caribbean and Pacific Group of States (ACP). It was signed in June 2000 in Cotonou, Benin's largest city, by 78 ACP countries (except Cuba) and the then fifteen EU member states. It entered into force in 2003 and was subsequently revised in 2005 and 2010.

Following the 2010 revision, the agreement was due to expire on 29 February 2020, but it was extended temporarily to no later than 31 October 2023, pending adoption of a new agreement (the Samoa Agreement).

Crusade of 1101.headline: Križarska vojna leta 1101
paragraphs: Križarska vojna leta 1101, znana tudi kot križarska vojna bojazljivcev, se je začela po prvi križarski vojni, ko je novoustanovljeno Jeruzalemsko kraljestvo pozvalo k okrepitvam in ko so hoteli iz muslimanskega ujetništva rešiti slavnega Bohemonda Tarantskega. Papež Pashal II., naslednik Urbana II. (ta je umrl, preden je izvedel za izid križarske vojne, ki jo je razglasil), je spodbujal novo odpravo. Posebej je spodbujal tiste, ki so se zaobljubili za križarsko vojno, a niso nikoli odšli, in tiste, ki so se med pohodom obrnili nazaj. Križarska vojna se je končala z odmevnim porazom Zahoda proti seldžuškim Turkom.

source.title: Crusade of 1101
paragraphs: The Crusade of 1101, also known as the Crusade of the Faint-Hearted, was launched in the aftermath of the First Crusade with calls for reinforcements from the newly established Kingdom of Jerusalem and to rescue the famous Bohemond of Taranto from Muslim captivity. Pope Paschal II, successor to Urban II (who died before learning of the outcome of the crusade that he had called), urged a new expedition. He especially urged those who had taken the crusade vow but had never departed and those who had turned back while on the march. The crusade was a resounding defeat of the West by the Seljuk Turks.

Križarske invazije na Egipt so bili ponavljajoči se vdori jeruzalemskega kralja Amalrika v fatimidski Egipt od leta 1163 do 1169, s katerimi je hotel izkoristiti šibkost Fatimidov in okrepiti položaj križarskega Jeruzalemskega kraljestva v Levantu.

source.title: Crusader invasions of Egypt
paragraphs: The Crusader invasions of Egypt were the repeated invasions of Fatimid Egypt from 1163 to 1169 by King Amalric of Jerusalem, who wished to strengthen the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem's position in the Levant by taking advantage of the weakness of the Fatimids.

Cyprus Convention.headline: Ciprska konvencija
paragraphs: Ciprska konvencija s 4. junija 1878 je bila tajni sporazum med Združenim kraljestvom in Osmanskim cesarstvom, ki je Veliki Britaniji podelil upravni nadzor nad Ciprom (gl. britanski Ciper) v zameno za britansko podporo Osmanom na berlinskem kongresu. Določbe konvencije so Osmanom ohranile pravice na ozemlju Cipra.

Sporazum je bil plod tajnih pogajanj, ki so potekala prej v letu 1878. Britanci so konvencijo razveljavili 5. novembra 1914, ko sta bila Velika Britanija in Osmansko cesarstvo po osmanskem vstopu v prvo svetovno vojno med seboj v vojni.

source.title: Cyprus Convention
paragraphs: The Cyprus Convention of 4 June 1878 was a secret agreement reached between the United Kingdom and the Ottoman Empire which granted administrative control of Cyprus to Britain (see British Cyprus), in exchange for its support of the Ottomans during the Congress of Berlin. Provisions in the Convention retained Ottoman rights over the territory of Cyprus.

This agreement was the result of secret negotiations that took place earlier in 1878. The Convention was abrogated by the British on 5 November 1914, when Britain and the Ottoman Empire found themselves at war with each other following the Ottoman entry into World War I.
Ciprska vstaja je bila spopad na britanskem Cipru med aprilom 1955 in marcem 1959.

Nacionalna organizacija ciprskih borcev (EOKA), grškociprska gverilska organizacija, ki se je bojevala za združitev z Grčijo, je leta 1955 začela oboroženo kampanjo za konec britanske kolonialne vladavine in za združitev Cipra z Grčijo (enosis). Nasprotovanje ciprskih Turkov enosisu je pripeljalo do ustanovitve Turške odporniške organizacije (TMT), ki se je zavzemala za razdelitev Cipra. Ciprska vstaja se je končala leta 1959 s podpisom londonsko-züriških sporazumov, s katerimi je Republika Ciper postala neodvisna država.

source.title: Cyprus Emergency
paragraphs: The Cyprus Emergency was a conflict fought in British Cyprus between April 1955 and March 1959.

The National Organisation of Cypriot Fighters (EOKA), a Greek Cypriot guerrilla organisation fighting for unification with Greece, began an armed campaign in support of the end of British colonial rule and the unification of Cyprus and Greece (Enosis) in 1955. Opposition to Enosis from Turkish Cypriots led to the formation of the Turkish Resistance Organisation (TMT) in support of the partition of Cyprus. The Cyprus Emergency ended in 1959 with the signature of the London-Zürich Agreements, establishing the Republic of Cyprus as an independent state.

Kraljestvo Dahomej (fonsko: Danhɔmɛ, dobesedno »v trebuhu poglavarja Dana«) je bilo zahodnoafriško kraljestvo na ozemlju današnje Republike Benin, ki je obstajalo od približno leta 1600 do 1904. Razvilo se je v začetku 17. stoletja na planoti Abomey med ljudstvom Fon, v 18. stoletju pa je postalo regionalna sila, ko se je razširilo proti jugu in osvojilo pomembna mesta, kot je Uida, ki je pripadala Kraljestvu Uida na atlantski obali; to mu je zagotovilo neoviran dostop do atlantske trgovine s sužnji.

source.title: Dahomey
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Dahomey (Fon: Danhɔmɛ, lit. 'In the Belly of Chief Dan') was a West African kingdom located within the present-day Republic of Benin that existed from approximately 1600 until 1904. It developed on the Abomey Plateau among the Fon people in the early 17th century and became a regional power in the 18th century by expanding south to conquer key cities like Whydah belonging to the Kingdom of Whydah on the Atlantic coast, which granted it unhindered access to the Atlantic Slave Trade.

Danska Zlata obala (dansko: Danske Guldkyst ali Dansk Guinea) je obsegala kolonije, ki jih je Danska-Norveška nadzorovala v Afriki kot del Zlate obale (približno današnje jugovzhodne Gane) ob Gvinejskem zalivu. Kolonizirala jo je dansko-norveška mornarica, sprva pod posredno upravo Danske zahodnoindijske družbe (pooblaščene družbe), pozneje pa je bila kronska kolonija kraljestva Danske-Norveške. Območje pod danskim vplivom je obsegalo več kot 10.000 kvadratnih kilometrov in je imelo leta 1837 po ocenah približno 40.000 prebivalcev.

Pet danskih utrdb so leta 1850 prodali Združenemu kraljestvu. Danska je kolonije že nekaj časa hotela prodati, saj so se stroški za njihovo upravljanje po odpravi suženjstva povečali. Čeprav se je tudi Velika Britanija spopadala z naraščajočimi stroški, jih je hotela kupiti, da bi zmanjšala francoski in belgijski vpliv v regiji ter še bolj omejila trgovino s sužnji, ki je tam še potekala. Kupljene naselbine in utrdbe so pozneje vključili v britansko Zlato obalo.

source.title: Danish Gold Coast
paragraphs: The Danish Gold Coast (Danish: Danske Guldkyst or Dansk Guinea) comprised the colonies that Denmark–Norway controlled in Africa as a part of the Gold Coast (roughly present-day southeast Ghana), which is on the Gulf of Guinea. It was colonized by the Dano-Norwegian fleet, first under indirect rule by the Danish West India Company (a chartered company), later as a crown colony of the kingdom of Denmark-Norway. The area under Danish influence was over 10,000 square kilometres, with an estimated population of approximately 40,000 in 1837.

The five Danish forts were sold to the United Kingdom in 1850. Denmark had wanted to sell these colonies for some time as the expenses required to run the colonies had increased following the abolition of slavery. Although Britain was also struggling with rising costs, it sought to purchase them to reduce French and Belgian influence in the region, as well as to further curtail the slave trade that still operated there. The purchased settlements and forts were later incorporated into the British Gold Coast.

Defense of Van (1915).headline: Obramba Vana (1915)
paragraphs: Obramba Vana (armensko: Վանի հերոսամարտ, Vani herosamart), v ruščini vanska operacija (rusko: Ванская операция, Vanskaya operatsia), je bila oborožen odpor armenskega prebivalstva Vana in ruske vojske proti poskusom Osmanskega cesarstva, da bi med armenskim genocidom leta 1915 pobilo osmanske Armence v vilajetu Van. Več sodobnih opazovalcev in poznejših zgodovinarjev je sklenilo, da je osmanska vlada namenoma izzvala oborožen armenski odpor v mestu in ta upor nato uporabila kot glavno pretvezo za začetek deportacij in pobijanja Armencev po vsem cesarstvu. Poročila prič se ujemajo, da je bila drža Armencev v Vanu obrambna in dejanje odpora proti pokolu. Na samoobrambo se pogosto sklicuje literatura, ki zanika armenski genocid; postala je »alfa in omega sklicevanja na ›vojaško nujnost‹«, s katerim opravičujejo genocid in preganjanje Armencev prikazujejo kot upravičeno.

source.title: Defense of Van (1915)
paragraphs: The defense of Van (Armenian: Վանի հերոսամարտ, romanized: Vani herosamart) and in Russian Van operation (Russian: Ванская операция, romanized: Vanskaya operatsia) was the armed resistance of the Armenian population of Van and Russian army against the Ottoman Empire's attempts to massacre the Ottoman Armenian population of the Van Vilayet in the 1915 Armenian genocide. Several contemporaneous observers and later historians have concluded that the Ottoman government deliberately instigated an armed Armenian resistance in the city and then used this insurgency as the main pretext to justify beginning the deportation and slaughter of Armenians throughout the empire. Witness reports agree that the Armenian posture at Van was defensive and an act of resistance to massacre. The self-defense action is frequently cited in Armenian genocide denial literature; it has become "the alpha and omega of the plea of 'military necessity'" to excuse the genocide and portray the persecution of Armenians as justified.

Dersim massacre.headline: Pokol v Dersimu
paragraphs: Pokol v Dersimu, znan tudi kot genocid v Dersimu, je v letih 1937 in 1938 v treh operacijah v provinci Dersim (preimenovani v Tunceli) izvedla turška vojska proti kurdskim upornikom alevitske vere in civilistom. Čeprav je večina Kurdov v Dersimu ostala v domačih vaseh, je bilo na tisoče ljudi ubitih, mnogi drugi pa izgnani v druge dele Turčije. Za pokol so naročili in uporabili dvajset ton »kloracetofenona, iperita in drugega«. Po besedah generala turške vojske Osmana Pamukoğluja v 1990. letih je bil pokol v Dersimu izveden po operativnem ukazu Mustafe Kemala Atatürka.

source.title: Dersim massacre
paragraphs: The Dersim massacre, also known as the Dersim genocide, was carried out by the Turkish military over the course of three operations in the Dersim Province (renamed Tunceli) against Kurdish rebels of Alevi faith, and civilians in 1937 and 1938. Although most Kurds in Dersim remained in their home villages, thousands were killed and many others were expelled to other parts of Turkey. Twenty tons of "Chloracetophenon, Iperit and so on" were ordered and used in the massacre. According to Turkish Army general Osman Pamukoğlu in the 1990s, the Dersim massacre was carried on the operational order of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk.

Dervish War.headline: Derviška vojna
paragraphs: Derviška vojna je bila spopad na Afriškem rogu med Derviško državo ter imperialnimi silami, Abesinijo, Britanijo in Italijo. Sprva je potekala od leta 1900 do 1904, od leta 1905 je sledilo obdobje mirovne pogodbe in protektorata pod Italijani, v naslednjih letih drugi diplomatski ukrepi, od leta 1913 do 1920 pa so se spopadi s kolonialnimi silami obnovili.

V prvi bitki upora so derviši marca 1900 napadli etiopsko posadko v Džidžigi in prevzeli nadzor nad deli vzhodnega Ogadena. Nato so napovedali vojno britanski kolonialni upravi v Somalilandu. Proti dervišem so se bojevali tudi Etiopsko cesarstvo, Kraljevina Italija in nekateri somalijski klani. Britanci so med letoma 1900 in 1920 proti dervišem poslali pet vojaških odprav, predvsem v dolino Nugaal, derviši pa so pogosto napadali dele Somalilanda pod britanskim ali italijanskim nadzorom. Spopad je uničil gospodarstvo regije: po ocenah je med derviškim uporom umrla okoli tretjina prebivalstva Somalilanda.

source.title: Dervish War
paragraphs: The Dervish War was a conflict in the Horn of Africa, between the Dervish State, and the imperial powers of Abyssinia, Britain and Italy, initially from 1900 to 1904, which was followed by a peace treaty-protectorate period with the Italians from 1905, other diplomatic measures in the following years, and a resumption of conflict with the colonial powers from 1913 to 1920.

The opening battle of the rebellion saw the Dervish attack the Ethiopian garrison at Jigjiga in March 1900 and take control of parts of the eastern Ogaden region. The Dervish then declared war on the British colonial administration in Somaliland. The Ethiopian Empire, the Kingdom of Italy and some Somali clans also fought against the Dervish. The British launched five military expeditions, mainly in the Nugaal Valley, between 1900 and 1920 against the Dervish, while the Dervishes often attacked the British or Italian controlled parts of Somaliland. The conflict ravaged the region's economy. It has been estimated that around one-third of the population of Somaliland died during the Dervish rebellion.

Dhofar rebellion.headline: Upor v Dofarju
paragraphs: Upor v Dofarju, znan tudi kot dofarska vojna ali revolucija 9. junija, je bil revolucija, ki se je leta 1965 začela v pokrajini Dofar na Arabskem polotoku proti britanskemu imperializmu in sultanoma Saidu ibn Tajmurju in Kabusu bin Saidu iz omanske dinastije Al Bu Said. Spopad se je začel z ustanovitvijo Fronte za osvoboditev Dofarja, marksistično-leninistične skupine, ki je hotela v Perzijskem zalivu ustvariti ljudsko demokratično državo. Uporniki so imeli tudi širše cilje arabskega nacionalizma, med drugim konec britanskega vpliva v regiji. Cilj sultana in Britancev pa je bil v okviru širše hladne vojne zaustaviti »širjenje komunizma«.

Vojna je bila sprva upor nizke intenzivnosti, v katerem so uporniki z gverilskim bojevanjem napadali britansko-sultanske sile in tujo navzočnost v državi. Več dejavnikov, kot sta britanski umik iz Adna ter podpora Južnega Jemna in Kitajske, je upornikom prineslo večje uspehe, tako da so komunisti do konca 1960. let nadzorovali vso pokrajino.

source.title: Dhofar rebellion
paragraphs: The Dhofar rebellion, also known as the Dhofar War, or the 9 June revolution, was a revolution that began in 1965 in the Dhofar region of the Arabian Peninsula against British imperialism and Sultans Said ibn Taimur and Qaboos bin Said of the Al Bu Said dynasty in Oman. The conflict began with the formation of the Dhofar Liberation Front, a Marxist–Leninist group which aimed to create a people's democratic state in the Persian Gulf region. The rebels also held the broader goals of Arab nationalism, which included ending British influence in the region. Sultanic and British goals, on the other hand, were to halt "the spread of communism" as part of the broader Cold War.

The war initially took the form of a low-level insurgency, with guerrilla warfare being used against Anglo-Sultanic forces and the foreign presence in the country. Several factors, such as the British withdrawal from Aden and support from South Yemen and China, brought the rebels increased success, with the communists controlling the entirety of the region by the late 1960s.

Djiboutian–Eritrean border conflict.headline: Džibutijsko-eritrejski mejni spopad
paragraphs: Džibutijsko-eritrejski mejni spopad je bil spopad med silami Džibutija in Eritreje, ki je potekal od 10. do 13. junija 2008. Sprožile so ga napetosti, ki so se začele 16. aprila 2008, ko je Džibuti sporočil, da so eritrejske oborožene sile vdrle na njegovo ozemlje in izkopale jarke na obeh straneh meje. Kriza se je poglobila, ko so 10. junija 2008 na obmejnem območju izbruhnili oboroženi spopadi med obema vojskama. Francija je Džibutiju med spopadom pomagala logistično, zdravstveno in obveščevalno, v neposrednih bojih pa ni sodelovala.

source.title: Djiboutian–Eritrean border conflict
paragraphs: The Djiboutian–Eritrean border conflict was a border conflict between the forces of Djibouti and Eritrea that occurred between June 10 and June 13, 2008. It was triggered by tension which began on April 16, 2008, when Djibouti reported that Eritrean armed forces had penetrated into Djibouti and dug trenches on both sides of the border. The crisis deepened when armed clashes broke out between the two armed forces in the border area on June 10, 2008. During the conflict, France provided logistical, medical and intelligence support to Djibouti, but did not participate in direct combat.

Dutch Cape Colony.headline: Nizozemska Kapska kolonija
paragraphs: Nizozemska Kapska kolonija (nizozemsko: Nederlandse Kaapkolonie), uradno postojanka Rt dobrega upanja (nizozemsko: Tussenstation Kaap de Goede Hoop), je bila kolonija Nizozemske vzhodnoindijske družbe (VOC) in Batavske republike v južni Afriki. Imela je središče na Rtu dobrega upanja, po katerem je dobila ime, ustanovila pa jo je leta 1652 odprava VOC pod vodstvom Jana van Riebeecka kot oskrbovalno in postankovno pristanišče za ladje VOC, ki so trgovale z Azijo. Rt je bil od leta 1652 do 1795 pod oblastjo VOC, od leta 1803 do 1806 pa pod batavsko oblastjo. Na veliko razočaranje delničarjev VOC, ki so se osredotočali predvsem na dobiček iz azijske trgovine, je Kapska kolonija v letih po ustanovitvi hitro prerasla v naseljensko kolonijo.

source.title: Dutch Cape Colony
paragraphs: The Dutch Cape Colony (Dutch: Nederlandse Kaapkolonie), officially known as the Cape of Good Hope Waystation (Dutch: Tussenstation Kaap de Goede Hoop), was a colony of the Dutch East India Company (VOC) and Batavian Republic in Southern Africa. Centered on the Cape of Good Hope, from where it derived its name, it was founded in 1652 by a VOC expedition under Jan van Riebeeck to serve as a re-supply and layover port for VOC vessels trading with Asia. The Cape was under VOC rule from 1652 to 1795 and Batavian rule from 1803 to 1806. Much to the dismay of the VOC's shareholders, who focused primarily on making profits from the Asian trade, the Cape Colony rapidly expanded into a settler colony in the years after its founding.

Protektorat Vzhodna Afrika (znan tudi kot Britanska Vzhodna Afrika) je bil britanski protektorat ob afriških Velikih jezerih, ki je obsegal približno isto ozemlje kot današnja Kenija, od Indijskega oceana v notranjost do meje z Ugando na zahodu. Pod nadzor Združenega kraljestva je prišel konec 19. stoletja, nastal pa je iz britanskih trgovskih interesov na tem območju v 1880. letih. Protektorat je ostal do leta 1920, ko je postal kolonija Kenija, razen samostojnega 16 km širokega obalnega pasu, ki je postal protektorat Kenija.
notes: The miles conversion (10 mi) is dropped.

source.title: East Africa Protectorate
paragraphs: East Africa Protectorate (also known as British East Africa) was a British protectorate in the African Great Lakes, occupying roughly the same area as present-day Kenya, from the Indian Ocean inland to the border with Uganda in the west part. Controlled by the United Kingdom in the late 19th century, it grew out of British commercial interests in the area in the 1880s and remained a protectorate until 1920 when it became the Colony of Kenya, save for an independent 16-kilometre-wide (10 mi) coastal strip that became the Kenya Protectorate.

Egyptian revolution of 1952.headline: Egiptovska revolucija leta 1952
paragraphs: Revolucija v Egiptu se je začela 23. julija 1952, ko je gibanje Svobodnih častnikov, skupina vojaških častnikov pod vodstvom Mohameda Nagiba in Gamala Abdela Naserja, z državnim udarom strmoglavilo kralja Faruka. Sprožila je val revolucionarne politike v Egiptu in arabskem svetu ter prispevala k pospešeni dekolonizaciji in razvoju solidarnosti tretjega sveta med hladno vojno.

Čeprav se je gibanje sprva osredotočalo na zamere do kralja Faruka, je imelo širše politične cilje. V prvih treh letih revolucije so Svobodni častniki odpravili ustavno monarhijo in aristokracijo Egipta in Sudana, ustanovili republiko, končali britanski vpliv v državi in zagotovili neodvisnost Sudana (ki je bil prej kondominij Egipta in Združenega kraljestva). Revolucionarna vlada je sprejela odločno nacionalističen in protiimperialističen program, ki se je izražal predvsem v arabskem nacionalizmu in mednarodni neuvrščenosti.

source.title: Egyptian revolution of 1952
paragraphs: On 23 July 1952, a revolution began in Egypt with the toppling of King Farouk in a coup d'état by the Free Officers Movement, a group of army officers led by Mohamed Naguib and Gamal Abdel Nasser. It ushered in a wave of revolutionary politics in Egypt and the Arab world, contributing to the escalation of decolonization and the development of Third World solidarity during the Cold War.

Though initially focused on grievances against King Farouk, the movement had more wide-ranging political ambitions. In the first three years of the Revolution, the Free Officers moved to abolish the constitutional monarchy and aristocracy of Egypt and Sudan, establish a republic, end the British influence in the country, and secure the independence of Sudan (previously governed as a condominium of Egypt and the United Kingdom). The revolutionary government adopted a staunchly nationalist, anti-imperialist agenda, which came to be expressed chiefly through Arab nationalism, and the international non-alignment.

Egyptian–Ottoman War (1831–1833).headline: Egiptovsko-osmanska vojna (1831–1833)
paragraphs: Prva egiptovsko-osmanska vojna ali prva sirska vojna (1831–1833) je bila vojaški spopad med Osmanskim cesarstvom in Egiptom, ki ga je sprožila zahteva Mohameda Ali paše, naj mu Visoka porta v zahvalo za pomoč sultanu v grški osamosvojitveni vojni prepusti oblast nad Veliko Sirijo. Egiptovske sile so tako za nekaj časa prevzele nadzor nad Sirijo in prodrle vse do Kütahye na severu.

source.title: Egyptian–Ottoman War (1831–1833)
paragraphs: The First Egyptian–Ottoman War or First Syrian War (1831–1833) was a military conflict between the Ottoman Empire and Egypt brought about by Muhammad Ali Pasha's demand to the Sublime Porte for control of Greater Syria, as reward for aiding the Sultan during the Greek War of Independence. As a result, Egyptian forces temporarily gained control of Syria, advancing as far north as Kütahya.

Prva savdska država (arabsko: ad-dawla as-suʿūdiyya al-ʾūlā), uradno Emirat Dirija (ʾimāra ad-dirʿiyya), je bila politična tvorba na Arabskem polotoku, ki je obstajala med letoma 1744 in 1818. Emir nedždskega mesta Dirija Mohamed bin Saud Al Mukrin in verski voditelj Mohamed ibn Abd al Vahab sta podpisala pakt, s katerim sta ustanovila družbeno-versko reformno gibanje, ki je pod političnim vodstvom rodbine Saud širilo vahabitski verski nauk.

Državo so nato razširili po Arabskem polotoku, Levantu, do obale iranskega mesta Bandar Abas in do ožine Bab el Mandeb. Prva savdska država se je končala leta 1818, ko so egiptovske sile po večmesečnem obleganju zavzele in porušile prestolnico Dirijo.

source.title: First Saudi state
paragraphs: The first Saudi state (Arabic: الدَّوْلَةُ السُّعُودِيَّةُ الْأُولَىٰ, romanized: ad-dawla as-suʿūdiyya al-ʾūlā), officially the Emirate of Diriyah (Arabic: إمارة الدرعية, romanized: ʾimāra ad-dirʿiyya), was a polity that existed on the Arabian Peninsula between 1744 and 1818. The emir of a Najdi town called Diriyah, Muhammad bin Saud Al Muqrin, and the religious leader Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab signed a pact founding a socio-religious reform movement that propagated the Wahhabi religious doctrine under the political leadership of the House of Saud.

They then proceeded to expand their state throughout the Arabian Peninsula, the Levant, the coast of the Iranian city of Bandar Abbas, and the Bab al-Mandab Strait. The first Saudi state ended in 1818 after the Egyptian forces captured and destroyed the Capital town of Diriyah following a siege that lasted for several months.

Emirate of Jabal Shammar.headline: Emirat Džabal Šamar
paragraphs: Emirat Džabal Šamar (arabsko: Imārah Jabal Shammar), znan tudi kot Emirat Hail ali Rašidski emirat, je bil država na severu Arabskega polotoka, vključno z Nedždom, ki je obstajala od sredine 19. stoletja do leta 1921. Šamar je bil zveza plemen na Arabskem polotoku, ime Džabal Šamar pa pomeni »Šamarjeva gora«. Prestolnica je bil Hail, vladala pa je monarhija dinastije Rašidov. Obsegal je dele današnje Savdske Arabije, Iraka in Jordanije.

source.title: Emirate of Jabal Shammar
paragraphs: The Emirate of Jabal Shammar (Arabic: إِمَارَة جَبَل شَمَّر, romanized: Imārah Jabal Shammar), also known as the Emirate of Haʾil (إِمَارَة حَائِل) or the Rashidi Emirate (إِمَارَة آل رَشِيْد), was a state in the northern part of the Arabian Peninsula, including Najd, existing from the mid-nineteenth century to 1921. Shammar had been a confederation in the Arabian Peninsula. Jabal Shammar in English is translated as the "Mountain of Shammar". Jabal Shammar's capital was Ha'il. It was led by the monarchy of the Rashidi dynasty. It included parts of modern-day Saudi Arabia, Iraq, and Jordan.

Druga savdska država (arabsko: ad-Dawla as-Suʿūdiyya ath-Thāniyya), uradno Emirat Nedžd, je bila država, ki je med letoma 1824 in 1891 obstajala v pokrajini Nedžd na ozemlju današnje Savdske Arabije. Savdska oblast se je vrnila v osrednjo (Nedžd) in vzhodno Arabijo, potem ko je prvo savdsko državo v osmansko-vahabitski vojni strmoglavil egiptovski ejalet Osmanskega cesarstva.

Za drugo savdsko obdobje so bili značilni manjše ozemeljsko širjenje in manjša verska vnema, čeprav so se savdski voditelji še naprej imenovali imami in so še vedno zaposlovali vahabitske verske učenjake. Za začetek druge savdske države navadno velja Turki bin Abdulah, ki je leta 1824 osmansko-egiptovskim silam znova odvzel Rijad. Hudi notranji spori v rodbini Saud so dinastijo nazadnje pokopali v bitki pri Mulajdi leta 1891 med silami, zvestimi zadnjemu savdskemu imamu Abdulu Rahmanu bin Fejsalu, in dinastijo Rašidov iz Haila.

source.title: Second Saudi state
paragraphs: The second Saudi state (Arabic: الدَّوْلَةُ السُّعُودِيَّةُ الثَّانِيَةُ, romanized: ad-Dawla as-Suʿūdiyya ath-Thāniyya), officially known as the Emirate of Najd, was a state that existed between 1824 and 1891 in the Najd region of what is now Saudi Arabia. Saudi rule was restored to central (Najd) and Eastern Arabia after the first Saudi state having previously been brought down by the Ottoman Empire's Egypt Eyalet in the Ottoman–Wahhabi War.

The second Saudi period was marked by less territorial expansion and less religious zeal, although the Saudi leaders continued to be called Imam and still employed Wahhabist religious scholars. Turki bin Abdullah's reconquest of Riyadh from Ottoman-Egyptians forces in 1824 is generally regarded as the beginning of the second Saudi state. Severe internal conflicts within the House of Saud eventually led to the dynasty's downfall at the Battle of Mulayda in 1891, between the forces loyal to the last Saudi imam, Abdul Rahman bin Faisal, and the Rashidi dynasty of Hail.

Nekorski emirat ali Salihidski emirat (arabsko: إمارة بني صالح, ʾImārat Banī Ṣāliḥ) je bil emirat s središčem v pokrajini Rif na ozemlju današnjega Maroka. Prestolnica je bila sprva v Temsamanu, nato so jo preselili v Nekor. Vladajoči dinastiji pripisujejo bodisi himjaritski arabski bodisi berberski izvor iz plemena Nafza. Emirat je leta 710 n. št. na podlagi kalifove podelitve ustanovil Salih I. ibn Mansur. Pod njegovim vodstvom so krajevna berberska (amaziška) plemena sprejela islam, pozneje pa so ga odstavila in na njegovo mesto postavila nekega Davuda al Rundija iz plemena Nafza (ki verjetno ni bil doma iz Ronde). Nato so si premislila in Saliha ibn Mansurja znova postavila za vladarja. Njegova dinastija, Banu Salih, je nato pokrajini vladala do okoli leta 1015.

source.title: Emirate of Nekor
paragraphs: The Emirate of Nekor or Salihid Emirate (Arabic: إمارة بني صالح, romanized: ʾImārat Banī Ṣāliḥ) was an emirate centered in the Rif area of present-day Morocco. Its capital was initially located at Temsamane, and then moved to Nekor. The ruling dynasty has been described as either of Himyarite Arab descent or of Nafza Berber descent. The emirate was founded in 710 CE by Salih I ibn Mansur through a Caliphate grant. Under his guidance, the local Berber (Amazigh) tribes adopted Islam, but later deposed him in favor of one Dawud al-Rundi (unlikely to have been a native of Ronda) from the Nafza tribe. They subsequently changed their mind and reappointed Salih ibn Mansur. His dynasty, the Banu Salih, thereafter ruled the region until about 1015.

Eritrean War of Independence.headline: Eritrejska osamosvojitvena vojna
paragraphs: Eritrejska osamosvojitvena vojna (tigrinjsko: ውግእ ሰውራ ኤርትራ) je bila oborožen spopad in upor, katerega cilj sta bila samoodločba in neodvisnost Eritreje izpod etiopske oblasti. Eritrejski uporniki so od leta 1961 vodili gverilsko vojno, da bi provinco Eritrejo osvobodili oblasti Etiopskega cesarstva pod Hailejem Selasiejem in pozneje Derga pod Mengistujem Hailejem Mariamom. Njihova prizadevanja so bila nazadnje uspešna leta 1991, ko je režim Derga padel.

Eritreja je bila italijanska kolonija od 1880. let, dokler zavezniki leta 1941 v drugi svetovni vojni niso premagali Italijanov. Nato je bila do leta 1951 za kratek čas pod britansko vojaško upravo. Združeni narodi so se po vojni sestali, da bi odločili o prihodnosti Eritreje, in glasovali za federacijo med Eritrejo in Etiopijo. Eritreja je tako postala zvezna enota Federacije Etiopije in Eritreje.

source.title: Eritrean War of Independence
paragraphs: The Eritrean War of Independence (Tigrinya: ውግእ ሰውራ ኤርትራ) was an armed conflict and insurgency aimed at achieving self-determination and independence for Eritrea from Ethiopian rule. Starting in 1961, Eritrean insurgents engaged in guerrilla warfare to liberate Eritrea Province from the rule of the Ethiopian Empire under Haile Selassie and later the Derg under Mengistu Haile Mariam. Their efforts ultimately succeeded in 1991 with the fall of the Derg regime.

Eritrea was an Italian colony from the 1880s until the Italians were defeated by the Allies in World War II in 1941. Afterward, Eritrea briefly became a British Military Administration until 1951. The United Nations convened after the war to decide Eritrea's future, voting in favor of a federation between Eritrea and Ethiopia. As a result, Eritrea became a constituent state of the Federation of Ethiopia and Eritrea.

Eritrean–Ethiopian War.headline: Eritrejsko-etiopska vojna
paragraphs: Eritrejsko-etiopska vojna, znana tudi kot vojna za Badme, je bila velik oborožen spopad med Etiopijo in Eritrejo, ki je potekal od 6. maja 1998 do 18. junija 2000.

Ko je Eritreja leta 1993 dobila neodvisnost od Etiopije, so bili odnosi sprva prijateljski. Nesoglasja o poteku nove mednarodne meje pa so jih močno poslabšala in nazadnje pripeljala do vojne v polnem obsegu. Spopad je bil tedaj največja vojna na svetu, v bojih je na obeh straneh sodelovalo več kot 500.000 vojakov.

Eritreja in Etiopija sta pred vojno veliko vlagali v oborožitev, zato naj bi v spopadu skupaj izgubili med 70.000 in 300.000 ljudi, še 600.000 pa jih je bilo razseljenih. Spopad je nazadnje prinesel manjše spremembe meje z dokončno zavezujočo razmejitvijo pod nadzorom Stalnega arbitražnega sodišča. Vojna se je uradno končala s podpisom alžirskega sporazuma 12. decembra 2000, mejni spopad, ki je sledil, pa se je nadaljeval še skoraj dve desetletji.

source.title: Eritrean–Ethiopian War
paragraphs: The Eritrean–Ethiopian War, also known as the Badme War, was a major armed conflict between Ethiopia and Eritrea that took place from May 6, 1998 to June 18, 2000.

After Eritrea gained independence from Ethiopia in 1993, relations were initially friendly. However, disagreements about where the newly created international border should be caused relations to deteriorate significantly, eventually leading to full-scale war. The conflict was the biggest war in the world at the time, with over 500,000 troops partaking in the fighting on both sides.

Eritrea and Ethiopia both invested heavily in armaments prior to the war, and reportedly suffered between 70,000 and 300,000 deaths combined throughout the conflict as a result, with a further 600,000 people displaced. The conflict ultimately led to minor border changes through final binding border delimitation overseen by the Permanent Court of Arbitration. The war officially came to an end with the signing of the Algiers Agreement on 12 December 2000; however, the ensuing border conflict would continue on for nearly two decades.

Eshrefids.headline: Ešrefidi
paragraphs: Ešrefidi ali Ašrafidi (sodobno turško: Eşrefoğulları ali Eşrefoğulları Beyliği) so bili turški anatolski beglik iz 13. in 14. stoletja.

source.title: Eshrefids
paragraphs: The Eshrefids or Ashrafids (Modern Turkish: Eşrefoğulları or Eşrefoğulları Beyliği ) was a 13th-14th century Turkish Anatolian beylik.

Estado Novo (Portugal).headline: Estado Novo (Portugalska)
paragraphs: Estado Novo (dobesedno »nova država«) je bila korporativistična portugalska država, vzpostavljena leta 1933. Razvila se je iz Ditadura Nacional (»narodna diktatura«), ki je nastala po državnem udaru 28. maja 1926 proti nestabilni prvi republiki. Zgodovinarji Ditadura Nacional in Estado Novo skupaj štejejo za drugo portugalsko republiko (portugalsko: Segunda República Portuguesa). Estado Novo, ki se je močno zgledovala po konservativnih in avtokratskih ideologijah, je razvil António de Oliveira Salazar, ki je bil predsednik ministrskega sveta od leta 1932, dokler ga bolezen leta 1968 ni prisilila k odstopu.
notes: The Portuguese pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Estado Novo (Portugal)
paragraphs: The Estado Novo (European Portuguese pronunciation: [(ɨ)ʃˈtaðu ˈnovu], lit. 'New State') was the corporatist Portuguese state installed in 1933. It evolved from the Ditadura Nacional ("National Dictatorship") formed after the coup d'état of 28 May 1926 against the unstable First Republic. Together, the Ditadura Nacional and the Estado Novo are recognised by historians as the Second Portuguese Republic (Portuguese: Segunda República Portuguesa). The Estado Novo, greatly inspired by conservative and autocratic ideologies, was developed by António de Oliveira Salazar, who was President of the Council of Ministers from 1932 until illness forced him out of office in 1968.

Ethiopia–Tigray peace agreement.headline: Mirovni sporazum med Etiopijo in Tigrajem
paragraphs: Mirovni sporazum med Etiopijo in Tigrajem, imenovan tudi sporazum iz Pretorie ali sporazum o prekinitvi sovražnosti (CoHA), je mirovna pogodba med etiopsko vlado in Tigrajsko ljudsko osvobodilno fronto (TPLF), podpisana 2. novembra 2022, v kateri sta se strani dogovorili za »trajno prekinitev sovražnosti«, da bi končali vojno v Tigraju. Sporazum je začel veljati naslednji dan, 3. novembra, na drugo obletnico začetka vojne.

Ker so se napetosti med TPLF in etiopskimi zveznimi silami od leta 2026 zaostrile, je sporazum iz Pretorie dejansko izgubil veljavo; tiskovni predstavnik TPLF Michael Asgedom je septembra 2026 izjavil, da sporazum »ne velja več«.

source.title: Ethiopia–Tigray peace agreement
paragraphs: The Ethiopia–Tigray peace agreement, also called the Pretoria Agreement or the Cessation of Hostilities Agreement (CoHA), is a peace treaty between the government of Ethiopia and the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) that was signed 2 November 2022, wherein both parties agreed to a "permanent cessation of hostilities" to end the Tigray war. The agreement was made effective the next day on 3 November, marking the second anniversary of the war.

Since 2026, with the intensification of tensions between the TPLF and Ethiopian federal forces, the Pretoria Agreement was effectively rendered invalid, with TPLF spokesman Michael Asgedom stating in September 2026 that the agreement was "no longer valid."

Etiopska državljanska vojna je bila državljanska vojna v Etiopiji in današnji Eritreji, ki je od 12. septembra 1974 do 28. maja 1991 potekala med etiopsko vojaško hunto, znano kot Derg, ter etiopsko-eritrejskimi protivladnimi uporniki.

Derg je 12. septembra 1974 z državnim udarom strmoglavil Etiopsko cesarstvo in cesarja Haileja Selasieja ter v Etiopiji vzpostavil komunistično državo pod vojaško hunto in začasno vlado. Oborožen odpor proti Dergu, ki ga je podpirala Sovjetska zveza, so vodile različne nacionalistične opozicijske skupine, ideološko od komunističnih do protikomunističnih, ki so pogosto izhajale iz posamezne etnične skupnosti.

source.title: Ethiopian Civil War
paragraphs: The Ethiopian Civil War was a civil war in Ethiopia and present-day Eritrea, fought between the Ethiopian military junta known as the Derg and Ethiopian-Eritrean anti-government rebels from 12 September 1974 to 28 May 1991.

The Derg overthrew the Ethiopian Empire and Emperor Haile Selassie in a coup d'état on 12 September 1974, establishing Ethiopia as a communist state under a military junta and provisional government. Various nationalist opposition groups of ideological affiliations ranging from communist to anti-communist, often drawn from a specific ethnic background, carried out armed resistance to the Soviet-backed Derg.

Ethiopian–Adal War.headline: Etiopsko-adalska vojna
paragraphs: Etiopsko-adalska vojna, znana tudi kot abesinsko-adalska vojna in Futuh al Habaša (arabsko: فتوح الحبش, dobesedno »osvojitev Abesinije«), je bila vojna med krščanskim Etiopskim cesarstvom in muslimanskim Adalskim sultanatom, ki je potekala od leta 1529 do 1543. Krščanske etiopske čete so prihajale predvsem iz Tigraja, Amhare, Godžama, Begemderja, Angota, Kede, Gana, Medri Bahrija in Gafata, nekaj pa je bilo tudi agavskih čet. Ob koncu vojne je krščanske sile podpiralo Portugalsko cesarstvo z najmanj 400 mušketirji. Adalske sile so sestavljali Harla oziroma Hararci, Somalci, Afarji ter arabski in turški strelci. Obema stranema so se občasno pridružili plačanci Maja. Spopadu je kmalu sledila osmansko-etiopska vojna v 16. stoletju.

source.title: Ethiopian–Adal War
paragraphs: The Ethiopian–Adal War, also known as the Abyssinian–Adal War and Futūḥ Al-Ḥabaša (Arabic: فتوح الحبش, lit. 'Conquest of Abyssinia'), was a war fought between the Christian Ethiopian Empire and the Muslim Adal Sultanate from 1529 to 1543. The Christian Ethiopian troops were drawn mainly from Tigray, Amhara, Gojjam, Begemder, Angot, Qeda, Gan, Medri Bahri, Gafat, and a certain numbers of Agaw troops At the closing of the war, the Christian forces were supported by the Portuguese Empire with no less than 400 musketeers. The Adal forces were composed of Harla/Harari, Somali, Afar as well as Arab and Turkish gunmen. Both sides would see the Maya mercenaries at times join their ranks. The conflict was followed shortly by the 16th century Ottoman–Ethiopian War.

Expansion of Macedonia under Philip II.headline: Širitev Makedonije pod Filipom II.
paragraphs: Pod vladavino Filipa II. (359–336 pr. n. št.) je argeadsko kraljestvo Makedonija, sprva na obrobju klasičnih grških zadev, v manj kot 25 letih zavladalo stari Grčiji, predvsem zaradi značaja in politike svojega kralja. Filip II. je za dosego političnih ciljev spretno uporabljal diplomacijo in poročna zavezništva, poleg tega pa je staro makedonsko vojsko preoblikoval v učinkovito bojno silo. Makedonska falanga je v njegovem času postala znak makedonske vojske, skupaj s konjenico hetajrov, hipaspisti in lahko pehoto. Njegova vojska in inženirji so obsežno uporabljali tudi oblegovalne stroje. Glavni Filipov trački sovražnik je bil vladar Kersoblept, ki je morda sklenil začasno zavezništvo z Atenami. V vrsti pohodov od leta 356 do 340 pr. n. št. je Filip II. Kersoblepta nazadnje podjarmil kot tributarnega vazala in pri tem osvojil velik del Trakije. Bojeval se je tudi proti ilirskemu kralju Bardilisu, ki je ogrožal osrednjo Makedonijo, ter proti Grabu II. in Pleuratu v Iliriji (s središčem v današnji Albaniji). Na novo osvojenih ozemljih je ustanovil nova mesta, kot so Filipi (današnji Filippoi v Grčiji), Filipopolis (današnji Plovdiv v Bolgariji), Herakleja Sintika (današnji Rupite v Bolgariji) in Herakleja Linkestis (današnja Bitola v Severni Makedoniji).

source.title: Expansion of Macedonia under Philip II
paragraphs: Under the reign of Philip II (359–336 BC), the Argead kingdom of Macedonia, initially at the periphery of classical Greek affairs, came to dominate Ancient Greece in the span of less than 25 years, largely thanks to the character and policies of its king. In addition to utilising effective diplomacy and marriage alliances to achieve his political aims, Philip II was responsible for reforming the ancient Macedonian army into an effective fighting force. The Macedonian phalanx became the hallmark of the Macedonian army during his reign, combined with Companion cavalry, hypaspists and light infantry. His army and engineers also made extensive use of siege engines. Chief among Philip's Thracian enemies was the ruler Kersebleptes, who may have coordinated a temporary alliance with Athens. In a series of campaigns stretching from 356 to 340 BC, Philip II managed to ultimately subjugate Kersebleptes as a tributary vassal, conquering much of Thrace in the process. Philip II also fought against the Illyrian king Bardylis, who threatened Macedonia proper, and against Grabos II and Pleuratus in Illyria (centred in modern-day Albania). In his newly conquered territories, he founded new cities such as Philippi (modern Filippoi, Greece), Philippopolis (modern Plovdiv, Bulgaria), Herakleia Sintike (modern Rupite, Bulgaria), and Herakleia Lynkestis (modern Bitola, North Macedonia).

Expedition of Dumat al-Jandal.headline: Odprava na Dumat al Džandal
paragraphs: Odprava na Dumat al Džandal je bila zgodnja muslimanska odprava, ki je potekala avgusta ali septembra 626 n. št.

Po indijskem življenjepiscu islamskega preroka Mohameda Safiurju Rahmanu Mubarakpuriju je Dumat al Džandal od Medine oddaljen okoli petnajst dni hoda, od Damaska pa pet. Po zgodovinarju Williamu Montgomeryju Wattu je od Medine oddaljen 500 milj.

source.title: Expedition of Dumat al-Jandal
paragraphs: The Expedition of Dumat al-Jandal is an early Muslim expedition which took place in August or September of 626 AD.

According to Indian biographer of the Islamic prophet Muhammad, Safiur Rahman Mubarakpuri, Dumat al-Jandal is located at about a distance of fifteen days' march from Medina and five from Damascus. According to historian William Montgomery Watt, it is 500 miles from Medina.

Fall of Babylon.headline: Padec Babilona
paragraphs: Babilon je padel leta 539 pr. n. št., ko je Ahemenidski imperij osvojil Novobabilonsko cesarstvo. Uspešni perzijski pohod pod vodstvom Kira Velikega je končal vladavino zadnje domače dinastije Mezopotamije in Perzijcem dal nadzor nad preostankom Rodovitnega polmeseca.

Nabonid, zadnji babilonski kralj in sin asirske svečenice Adad-gupi, je prišel na prestol leta 556, ko je strmoglavil predhodnika Labaši-Marduka. Vladanje je dolga obdobja prepuščal sinu in prestolonasledniku Belsazarju, ki je kot politik ravnal tako slabo, da je kljub vojaški sposobnosti izgubil podporo duhovščine in celo vojaškega sloja.

Na vzhodu je politična in vojaška moč Perzijcev pod dinastijo Ahemenidov hitro rasla in do leta 540 je Kir sprožil napadalni pohod proti Novobabilonskemu cesarstvu. Konec leta 539 je perzijska vojska dosegla odločilno zmago v bitki pri Opisu in nato zmagoslavno vkorakala v Babilon.

source.title: Fall of Babylon
paragraphs: The fall of Babylon occurred in 539 BCE, when the Achaemenid Empire conquered the Neo-Babylonian Empire. The success of the Persian campaign, led by Cyrus the Great, brought an end to the reign of the last native dynasty of Mesopotamia and gave the Persians control over the rest of the Fertile Crescent.

Nabonidus, the final Babylonian king and son of the Assyrian priestess Adad-guppi, had ascended to the throne by overthrowing his predecessor Labashi-Marduk in 556. For long periods, he would entrust rule to his son and crown prince Belshazzar, whose poor performance as a politician lost him the support of the priesthood and even the military class, in spite of his capability as a soldier.

To the east, the Persians' political and military power had been growing at a rapid pace under the Achaemenid dynasty, and by 540, Cyrus had initiated an offensive campaign against the Neo-Babylonian Empire. In late 539, the Persian army secured a crucial victory in the Battle of Opis, thereafter triumphantly entering the city of Babylon.

Fall of Damascus (2024).headline: Padec Damaska (2024)
paragraphs: Sirska opozicijska skupina, znana kot Južna operativna soba, je 7. decembra 2024 v usklajevanju s poveljstvom vojaških operacij povedla sile, ki so z juga vstopile v sirsko pokrajino Rif Dimašk in se nato prestolnici Damask približale na 20 kilometrov. Sirska vojska se je umaknila z več točk na obrobju. Hkrati s prodorom proti Damasku sta opozicijska milica Tahrir al Šam in sirska narodna vojska pod turškim okriljem na severu sprožili ofenzivo na Homs, Svobodna sirska vojska pa je v prestolnico prodrla z jugovzhoda. Do 8. decembra 2024 so uporniške sile vstopile v mestno četrt Barzeh. Po uradnih državnih poročilih v ruskih množičnih medijih in medijskih posnetkih je predsednik Bašar al Asad z letalom odletel iz Damaska v Moskvo, kjer je dobil azil, s čimer je bil padec njegovega režima zapečaten.

source.title: Fall of Damascus (2024)
paragraphs: On 7 December 2024, the Syrian opposition group known as the Southern Operations Room, in co-ordination with the Military Operations Command, led forces that entered the Rif Dimashq region of Syria from the south, and those forces then came within 20 kilometres (12 mi) of the capital Damascus. The Syrian Army withdrew from multiple points in the outskirts. Concurrently with the advance towards Damascus, opposition militia Tahrir al-Sham and the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army in the north launched an offensive into Homs, while the Syrian Free Army advanced into the capital from the southeast. By 8 December 2024, rebel forces entered the city's Barzeh neighborhood. According to official state reports in Russian mass media and media footage, President Bashar al-Assad left Damascus by air to Moscow, where he was granted asylum, sealing the fall of his regime.

Fall of Fallujah.headline: Padec Faludže
paragraphs: Padec Faludže je bil velika bitka v mestu Faludža v zahodnem Iraku, ki je od konca leta 2013 do začetka leta 2014 potekala med borci Islamske države Iraka in Levanta (ISIL) in drugimi sunitskimi uporniki, med njimi anbarskimi plemenskimi milicami, ki so mesto zavzeli. Faludža je bila eno prvih iraških mest, ki jim je iraška vlada izgubila nadzor, posledica pa je bila kampanja v Anbarju.

source.title: Fall of Fallujah
paragraphs: The fall of Fallujah was a major battle in the city of Fallujah in western Iraq that took place from late 2013 to early 2014, in which Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) militants and other Sunni insurgents including Anbar tribal militias captured the city of Fallujah. It was one of the first Iraqi cities to fall out of the control of the Iraqi Government, and resulted in the Anbar campaign.

Fall of Nineveh.headline: Padec Niniv
paragraphs: Padec Niniv, imenovan tudi bitka pri Ninivah, je bil velika bitka, ki je pomenila vrhunec osvojitve Asirskega cesarstva leta 612 pr. n. št. Po asirskem porazu ob padcu Asurja je zavezniška vojska Medijcev in Babiloncev oblegala Ninive (na območju današnjega Mosula) in zavzela tedaj eno največjih mest na svetu. Padec Niniv je v naslednjih treh letih pripeljal do uničenja Novoasirskega cesarstva kot prevladujoče države starega Bližnjega vzhoda. Arheološki zapisi kažejo, da se je nekdanja prestolnica mogočnega Asirskega cesarstva v desetletjih in stoletjih po bitki močno deurbanizirala in izpraznila. Popačeno poročilo o padcu mesta je pozneje dalo zgodbo o legendarnem kralju Sardanapalu.
Babilon je prvič po več kot tisoč letih postal cesarsko središče Mezopotamije, iz česar je nastalo Novobabilonsko cesarstvo, ki je kot nova dinastija zahtevalo cesarsko nasledstvo.

source.title: Fall of Nineveh
paragraphs: The Fall of Nineveh, also called the Battle of Nineveh, was a major battle that marked the climax of the Conquest of the Assyrian Empire in 612 BC. After the Assyrian defeat at the Fall of Assur, an allied army which involved the combined forces of Medes and the Babylonians besieged Nineveh (in modern-day Mosul) and took what was, at that time, one of the greatest cities in the world. The fall of Nineveh led to the destruction of the Neo-Assyrian Empire as the dominant state in the Ancient Near East over the following three years. Archeological records show that the capital of the once-mighty Assyrian Empire was extensively de-urbanized and depopulated in the decades and centuries following the battle. A garbled account of the fall of the city later led to the story of the legendary king Sardanapalus.
Babylon became the imperial center of Mesopotamia for the first time in over a thousand years, leading to the Neo-Babylonian Empire, claiming imperial continuity as a new dynasty.

Fall of Philadelphia.headline: Padec Filadelfije
paragraphs: S padcem Filadelfije leta 1390 je Osmansko cesarstvo osvojilo zadnje samostojno bizantinsko mesto v Mali Aziji. Mesto so oblegale osmanske sile, med katerimi je bil tudi bizantinski oddelek pod vodstvom Manuela II. Paleologa in Ivana VII., ki sta bila politična talca sultana Bajazida I.

source.title: Fall of Philadelphia
paragraphs: The Fall of Philadelphia in 1390 marked the conquest of the last independent Byzantine city in Asia Minor by the Ottoman Empire. The city was subjected to a siege by the Ottoman forces, which included a Byzantine contingent led by Manuel II Palaiologos and John VII, who were political hostages of Sultan Bayezid I.

Fall of Tlemcen (1518).headline: Padec Tlemcena (1518)
paragraphs: Tlemcen je padel leta 1518, ko je osmanski admiral Oruč Barbarossa mesto iztrgal njegovemu sultanu Abu Zajanu, zadnjemu iz rodu Banu Zajan.

Padec Tlemcena je sledil zavzetju Tenesa, ki sta ga prav tako izvedla Oruč in njegov brat Hajredin. Tlemcenski sultan je nato pobegnil v Fes v Maroku. Oruč se je okronal za kralja Tlemcena. Edini preživeli iz Abu Zajanove dinastije je bil šejk Buhamud, ki je pobegnil v Oran in zaprosil Španijo za pomoč.

Zmaga je Oruču prinesla nadzor nad zaledjem za špansko oporiščem Oran, kar je močno ogrozilo običajne španske oskrbovalne poti. Ta zmaga je Oruču prinesla nadzor nad precejšnjim ozemljem, velikim kot poznejša kolonialna francoska Alžirija.

source.title: Fall of Tlemcen (1518)
paragraphs: The fall of Tlemcen occurred in 1518, when the Ottoman admiral Oruç Barbarossa captured the city of Tlemcen from its sultan, Abu Zayan, the last member of the Banu Zayan lineage.

The fall of Tlemcen followed the capture of Ténès, also by Oruç and his brother, Hayreddin. The Sultan of Tlemcen then fled to Fez in Morocco. Oruç crowned himself king of Tlemcen. The only survivor of Abu Zayan's dynasty was Sheikh Buhammud, who escaped to Oran and called for Spain's assistance.

This victory put Oruç in control of the backcountry behind the Spanish base of Oran, which greatly threatened their usual supply routes. This victory put Oruç in control of a considerable territory, the size of colonial French Algeria.

Fall of Tripoli (1289).headline: Padec Tripolija (1289)
paragraphs: Padec Tripolija je bil zavzetje in uničenje križarske Tripolitanske grofije (danes delov Libanona in Sirije), ki ga je izvedel egiptovski mameluški sultanat. Bitka je potekala leta 1289 in je bila pomemben dogodek križarskih vojn, saj je pomenila izgubo ene redkih preostalih velikih križarskih posesti.

Dogodek je upodobljen na redki ohranjeni ilustraciji iz zdaj le deloma ohranjenega rokopisa, znanega kot »Cocharellijev kodeks«, ki naj bi nastal v Genovi v 1330. letih. Slika prikazuje tripolitansko grofico Lucijo in Bartolomeja Mansela, škofa Tortose (ki je apostolski sedež dobil leta 1278), kako slovesno sedita sredi utrjenega mesta, ter Kalavunov napad leta 1289: njegova vojska pobija prebivalce, ki bežijo na ladje v pristanišču in na bližnji otok Svetega Tomaža (danes otok Abdel Vahab, dostopen po mostu v El Mini v Libanonu).

source.title: Fall of Tripoli (1289)
paragraphs: The Fall of Tripoli was the capture and destruction of the Crusader state of the County of Tripoli (now parts of Lebanon and Syria) by the Mamluk Sultanate of Egypt. The battle occurred in 1289 and was an important event in the Crusades, as it marked the capture of one of the few remaining major Crusader possessions.

The event is depicted in a rare surviving illustration from a now-fragmentary manuscript known as the 'Cocharelli Codex', thought to have been created in Genoa in the 1330s. The image shows Lucia, Countess of Tripoli and Bartholomew Mansel, Bishop of Tortosa (granted the apostolic seat in 1278) sitting in state in the centre of the fortified city, and Qalawun's assault in 1289, with his army depicted massacring the inhabitants fleeing to boats in the harbour and to the nearby island of Saint Thomas (now Abdel Wahab Island, accessible by bridge in el Mina, Lebanon).

Fao Landing.headline: Izkrcanje pri Favu
paragraphs: Izkrcanje pri Favu je potekalo od 6. do 8. novembra 1914, ko so britanske sile napadle osmansko oporišče Fav in njegovo trdnjavo. Izkrcanje je naletelo na malo odpora osmanskih branilcev, ki so po silovitem obstreljevanju pobegnili. Bila je prva vojaška operacija mezopotamske kampanje v prvi svetovni vojni, ki so jo izvedli za zaščito britanske oskrbe z nafto v Perzijskem zalivu.

source.title: Fao Landing
paragraphs: The Fao Landing occurred from 6 November to 8 November 1914 with British forces attacking the Ottoman stronghold of Fao and its fortress. The landing was met with little resistance from the Ottoman defenders who fled after intense shelling. It was the first military operation of the Mesopotamian Campaign, during the First World War, which was carried out to protect British oil supplies in the Persian Gulf.

Fifty-Year Peace Treaty.headline: Petdesetletni mir
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Dare, znana tudi kot petdesetletni mir, je bila mirovna pogodba, ki sta jo leta 562 v obmejnem mestu Dara na jugu današnje Turčije sklenila Bizantinsko (vzhodnorimsko) in Sasanidsko (perzijsko) cesarstvo. Pogodba, o kateri sta se za bizantinskega cesarja Justinijana I. pogajal Peter Patricij in za sasanidskega kralja Hosrova I. Izadgušasp, je končala 20 let dolgo vojno za kavkaško kraljestvo Laziko. Pogodba je imela 13 členov in je dobro dokumentirana. Zajemala je vse dele obeh cesarstev, Perzarmenijo, Laziko, vazalne države in arabske zaveznike.

Sasanidi so se zavezali, da bodo zapustili Laziko, status sosednje dežele Suanije pa je ostal nejasen in je pozneje postal vir nesoglasij. Sasanidi naj bi prejemali letno podporo 30.000 zlatih nomizmatov, pri čemer je bilo treba znesek za prvih sedem let plačati takoj.
notes: The English excerpt ends mid-sentence ("The expenses of the defense lines in"); the fragment is dropped.

source.title: Fifty-Year Peace Treaty
paragraphs: The Treaty of Dara, also known as the Fifty-Year Peace, was a peace treaty concluded between the Byzantine (Eastern Roman) and Sassanid (Persian) empires at the frontier town of Dara in what is now southern Turkey in 562. The treaty, negotiated by Peter the Patrician for the Byzantine emperor Justinian I and Izadgushasp for the Sassanid king Khosrau I ended the 20-year-long war over the Caucasian kingdom of Lazica. The treaty contained 13 articles, and is well-recorded. It covered all parts of the two empires, Persarmenia, Lazica, the client states, and the Arab allies.

The Sassanids undertook to evacuate Lazica, but the status of the neighboring country of Suania was left unclear to become a future source of disagreement. The Sassanids were to receive an annual subsidy of 30,000 gold nomismata, with the first seven years payable immediately. The expenses of the defense lines in

Fihrids.headline: Fihridi
paragraphs: Fihridi (arabsko: الفهريون, al-Fihriyyūn), znani tudi kot Banu Fihr (arabsko: بنو فهر), so bili arabska družina in klan, ki je bil v 8. stoletju vpliven v Ifrikiji in Al Andaluzu.

Fihridi so izhajali iz arabskega klana Banu Fihr, dela plemena Kurejš, iz katerega je izhajal prerok. Najslavnejši Fihrid je bil verjetno Ukba ibn Nafi al Fihri, arabski muslimanski osvajalec severne Afrike v 670. in 680. letih in ustanovitelj Kajruana. Več njegovih sinov in vnukov je sodelovalo pri poznejši osvojitvi Hispanije leta 712.

source.title: Fihrids
paragraphs: The Fihrids (Arabic: الفهريون, romanized: al-Fihriyyūn), also known as Banū Fihr (Arabic: بنو فهر), were an Arab family and clan, prominent in Ifriqiya and Al-Andalus in the 8th century.

The Fihrids were from the Arabian clan of Banu Fihr, part of the Quraysh, the tribe of the Prophet. Probably the most illustrious of the Fihrids was Uqba ibn Nafi al-Fihri, the Arab Muslim conqueror of North Africa in 670-680s, and founder of al-Qayrawan. Several of his sons and grandsons participated in the subsequent conquest of Hispania in 712.

First Battle of al-Faw.headline: Prva bitka za Al Fav
paragraphs: Prva bitka za Al Fav je bila bitka iransko-iraške vojne, ki je med 10. februarjem in 10. marcem 1986 potekala na polotoku Al Fav. Iranska operacija velja za enega največjih iranskih dosežkov v iransko-iraški vojni. Iranci so zavzeli polotok Al Fav in Iraku presekali dostop do Perzijskega zaliva, kar je iraška stališča glede nadaljevanja vojne še zaostrilo. Iraške sile so polotok znova zavzele proti koncu vojne.

source.title: First Battle of al-Faw
paragraphs: The First Battle of al-Faw was a battle of the Iran–Iraq War, fought on the al-Faw peninsula between 10 February and 10 March 1986. The Iranian operation is considered to be one of Iran's greatest achievements in the Iran–Iraq War. The Iranians were able to capture the al-Faw peninsula, cutting off Iraqi access to the Persian Gulf in the process; this in turn hardened Iraqi attitudes to prosecute the war. The Faw peninsula was later recaptured by Iraqi forces near the end of the war.

First Battle of Algeciras.headline: Prva bitka pri Algecirasu
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Algecirasu je potekala 6. julija 1801 med eskadro britanske kraljeve vojne mornarice in manjšo eskadro francoske vojne mornarice, zasidrano v španskem pristanišču Algeciras, med algeciraško kampanjo v vojni druge koalicije. Francoska eskadra pod poveljstvom kontraadmirala Charles-Alexandra Léona Duranda Linoisa se je ustavila v Algecirasu na poti v veliko špansko pomorsko oporišče Cádiz, kjer naj bi oblikovala združeno francosko-špansko ladjevje za operacije proti Veliki Britaniji in njenim zaveznikom v francoskih revolucionarnih vojnah. Britanci pod poveljstvom kontraadmirala sira Jamesa Saumareza so skušali francosko eskadro uničiti, preden bi dosegla Cádiz in oblikovala silo, ki bi bila dovolj močna, da bi premagala Saumareza in napadla britanske sile v Sredozemskem morju. Čeprav so imeli Britanci veliko številčno premoč, je Linois našel močan obrambni položaj, v katerem je združil španske obalne utrdbe in zapletene plitvine, ki so zakrivale vhod v zaliv Algeciras. Med bitko je Linois uspešno uporabljal premikanje ladij s sidri, da nasprotniku ni dovolil obiti svoje bojne črte.

source.title: First Battle of Algeciras
paragraphs: The First Battle of Algeciras was fought on 6 July 1801 between a Royal Navy squadron and a smaller French Navy squadron lying at anchor in the Spanish port of Algeciras during the Algeciras campaign of the War of the Second Coalition. The French squadron, under Counter-admiral Charles-Alexandre Léon Durand Linois, had stopped at Algeciras en route to the major Spanish naval base at Cádiz, where they were to form a combined French and Spanish fleet for operations against Britain and its allies in the French Revolutionary Wars. The British, under Rear-Admiral Sir James Saumarez, sought to eliminate the French squadron before it could reach Cádiz and form a force powerful enough to overwhelm Saumarez and launch attacks against British forces in the Mediterranean Sea. Although the British heavily outnumbered their opponents, Linois found a strong defensive position that combined Spanish coastal defences with the complicated shoals that obscured the entrance to Algeciras Bay. During the battle, Linois effectively utilized warping tactics to prevent the opponent from flanking his line.

First Battle of Brega.headline: Prva bitka za Brego
paragraphs: Prva bitka za Brego je potekala med libijsko državljansko vojno. Začela se je v zgodnjih jutranjih urah 2. marca 2011, ko so Gadafiju zveste vladne enote napadle mesto, ki ga je držal Nacionalni prehodni svet.

source.title: First Battle of Brega
paragraphs: The First Battle of Brega was fought during the Libyan Civil War. It began when pro-Gaddafi government troops attacked the city, held by the National Transitional Council, in the early hours of 2 March 2011.

First Battle of Çatalca.headline: Prva bitka pri Çatalci
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Çatalci je bila ena najhujših bitk prve balkanske vojne, potekala pa je 17. in 18. novembra (po starem koledarju 4. in 5. novembra) 1912. Sprožili sta jo združeni bolgarski prva in tretja armada pod vrhovnim poveljstvom generalpodpolkovnika Radka Dimitrijeva, da bi premagali osmansko vojsko pri Çatalci in prebili zadnjo turško obrambno črto pred prestolnico Carigradom. Zaradi velikih izgub pa so morali Bolgari napad prekiniti.

source.title: First Battle of Çatalca
paragraphs: The First Battle of Çatalca was one of the heaviest battles of the First Balkan War fought between 17 and 18 November [O.S. 4–5 November] 1912. It was initiated as an attempt of the combined Bulgarian First and Third armies, under the overall command of lieutenant general Radko Dimitriev, to defeat the Ottoman Army stationed in Çatalca and break through the last Turkish defensive line before the capital Constantinople. The high casualties however forced the Bulgarians to call off the attack.

First Battle of El Alamein.headline: Prva bitka pri El Alameinu
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri El Alameinu (1.–27. julija 1942) je bila bitka kampanje v Zahodni puščavi v drugi svetovni vojni, ki je potekala v Egiptu med silami osi (nemškimi in italijanskimi) iz oklepne armade Afrika, v kateri je bil tudi Afriški korpus pod poveljstvom feldmaršala Erwina Rommla, ter zavezniškimi silami (Britanskega imperija in Skupnosti narodov) osme armade pod poveljstvom generala Clauda Auchinlecka.

Britanci so v tej bitki ustavili drugi prodor sil osi v Egipt. Položaji sil osi pri El Alameinu, le 106 km od Aleksandrije, so bili nevarno blizu egiptovskih pristanišč in mest, oporišč sil Skupnosti narodov in Sueškega prekopa. Sile osi pa so bile predaleč od svojega oporišča v Tripoliju v Libiji, da bi lahko pri El Alameinu ostale nedoločen čas, zato sta obe strani ob časovnih omejitvah in velikih razdaljah kopičili zaloge za nove ofenzive.
notes: The miles conversion (66 mi) is dropped.

source.title: First Battle of El Alamein
paragraphs: The First Battle of El Alamein (1–27 July 1942) was a battle of the Western Desert campaign of World War II, fought in Egypt between Axis (German and Italian) forces of the Panzer Army Africa—which included the Afrika Korps under Field Marshal Erwin Rommel—and Allied (British Empire and Commonwealth) forces of the Eighth Army under General Claude Auchinleck.

In this battle the British halted a second advance by the Axis forces into Egypt. Axis positions near El Alamein, only 106 km (66 mi) from Alexandria, were dangerously close to the ports and cities of Egypt, the base facilities of the Commonwealth forces and the Suez Canal. However, the Axis forces were too far from their base at Tripoli in Libya to remain at El Alamein indefinitely, which led both sides to accumulate supplies for more offensives, against the constraints of time and distance.

First Battle of Fallujah.headline: Prva bitka za Faludžo
paragraphs: Prva bitka za Faludžo, s kodnim imenom operacija Budna odločnost, je bila operacija iraške vojne pod ameriškim vodstvom proti borcem v Faludži in hkrati poskus, da bi prijeli ali ubili storilce umora štirih ameriških pogodbenikov marca 2004.
Glavni povod za operacijo sta bila zelo odmeven umor in iznakaženje štirih zasebnih vojaških pogodbenikov družbe Blackwater USA ter umor petih ameriških vojakov v Habaniji nekaj dni prej.

Bitka, zlasti posnetki iraških civilistov, ubitih ali ranjenih v bojih, je mnoge Iračane navdala z zamero do ameriške navzočnosti. Zahodni novinarji so ugotovili, da so se celo nekateri Iračani, ki so prej podpirali ameriško invazijo in pozdravljali ameriška prizadevanja za izgradnjo države, vse bolj odtujevali in postajali do takih obljub nezaupljivi.

source.title: First Battle of Fallujah
paragraphs: The First Battle of Fallujah, code-named Operation Vigilant Resolve, was an American-led operation of the Iraq War against militants in Fallujah as well as an attempt to apprehend or kill the perpetrators of the killing of four U.S. contractors in March 2004.
