The chief catalyst for the operation was the highly publicized killing and mutilation of four Blackwater USA private military contractors, and the killings of five American soldiers in Habbaniyah a few days earlier.

The battle, and especially the images of Iraqi civilians killed or injured in the fighting, caused many Iraqis to become resentful of the US presence. Western journalists found that even some Iraqis who previously supported the US invasion, and welcomed American state-building efforts, became increasingly alienated and skeptical of such promises.

First Battle of Gaza.headline: Prva bitka za Gazo
paragraphs: Prva bitka za Gazo je potekala 26. marca 1917, ob prvem poskusu egiptovskih ekspedicijskih sil (EEF), vojaške tvorbe Britanskega imperija, ki so jo 10. marca 1916 pod poveljstvom generala Archibalda Murrayja sestavili iz sredozemskih ekspedicijskih sil in sil v Egiptu (1914–1915), na začetku sinajsko-palestinske kampanje prve svetovne vojne. Boji so potekali v mestu Gaza na sredozemski obali in okolici, ko so pehota in konjeniška pehota puščavske kolone, dela vzhodnih sil, napadle mesto. Pozno popoldne, ko je bila že tik pred zavzetjem Gaze, so puščavsko kolono umaknili, ker so se bali bližajoče se teme in velikih osmanskih okrepitev. Temu britanskemu porazu je nekaj tednov pozneje, aprila 1917, sledil še hujši poraz vzhodnih sil v drugi bitki za Gazo.

source.title: First Battle of Gaza
paragraphs: The First Battle of Gaza was fought on 26 March 1917 during the first attempt by the Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF), which was a British Empire military formation, formed on 10 March 1916 under the command of General Archibald Murray from the Mediterranean Expeditionary Force and the Force in Egypt (1914–15), at the beginning of the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of the First World War. Fighting took place in and around the town of Gaza on the Mediterranean coast when infantry and mounted infantry from the Desert Column, a component of the Eastern Force, attacked the town. Late in the afternoon, on the verge of capturing Gaza, the Desert Column was withdrawn due to concerns about the approaching darkness and large Ottoman reinforcements. This British defeat was followed a few weeks later by the even more emphatic defeat of the Eastern Force at the Second Battle of Gaza in April 1917.

First Battle of Homs.headline: Prva bitka pri Homsu
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Homsu je potekala 10. decembra 1260 v Homsu v Siriji med Ilkanidi in muslimanskim zavezništvom Sirije.

Po mameluški zmagi nad Ilkanidi v bitki pri Ajn Džalutu septembra 1260 je vsa Sirija, vključno z Alepom, padla v mameluške roke. Hulagu je bil zaradi poraza pri Ajn Džalutu besen in je poslal novo vojsko pod vodstvom Bajdarja, enega od Kitbukovih generalov, ki je preživel Ajn Džalut. Novembra 1260 so mongolske sile znova zavzele Alep. Ko je za to izvedel ajubidski vladar Homsa Al Ašraf Musa, je sklenil koalicijo z emirjem Hame Al Mansurjem in mameluškimi emirji Alepa.

Mongolske sile so se z muslimani srečale pri Homsu, blizu grobnice arabskega poveljnika Halida ibn al Valida. Mongolska vojska je štela 6000 mož, muslimanska le 1400. Mongoli so se postavili v osem formacij z 1000 možmi spredaj in preostalimi za njimi. Muslimani so se razdelili v tri skupine: središče je vodil Al Ašraf, desno krilo Al Mansur, levo pa alepski emirji.

source.title: First Battle of Homs
paragraphs: The First Battle of Homs was fought in Homs, Syria, on December 10, 1260, between the Ilkhanids and the Muslim alliance of Syria.

After the Mamluk victory over the Ilkhanids at the Battle of Ain Jalut in September 1260, the whole of Syria, including Aleppo, fell into Mamluk hands. Furious at the defeat of Ain Jalut, Hulagu dispatched another army under Baidar, one of the Kitbuqa generals and a survivor of Ain Jalut. On November, 1260, the Mongol forces managed to recapture Aleppo. Alerted of this, the Ayyubid ruler of Homs, Al-Ashraf Musa, formed a coalition with the Emir of Hama, Al-Mansur, and the Mamluk Emirs of Aleppo.

The Mongol forces encountered the Muslims at Homs, near the tomb of the Arab commander, Khalid ibn al-Walid. The Mongol army consisted of 6,000 men, while the Muslim army had only 1,400 men. The Mongols formed eight formations with a force of 1,000 men at front, while the rest arranged behind it. The Muslims were divided into three groups: the center led by Al-Ashraf, the right under Al-Mansur, and the left under the Emirs of Aleppo.

First Battle of Zawiya.headline: Prva bitka za Zavijo
paragraphs: Prva bitka za Zavijo je bila bitka med libijsko državljansko vojno med vojaškimi enotami in miličniki, zvestimi Moamerju Gadafiju, ter Gadafijevimi nasprotniki za nadzor nad mestom Zavija.

Mesto je hitro padlo v roke upornikov, saj so vojaki iz enot libijske vojske prestopali na njihovo stran. Zavija je bila Tripoliju najbližje uporniško mesto, zato je nadzor nad njo postal glavni cilj Gadafijevih enot. Gadafijevi privrženci so mesto oblegali in redno napadali, uporniki pa so branili mestno središče. Končni napad je trajal en teden, vodila pa ga je brigada Hamis, najbolje izurjena enota libijske vojske. Upor v mestu je bil nazadnje zatrt in Gadafijeve enote so prevzele popoln nadzor nad mestom, iskale domnevne upornike in brisale vsako sled upora.
Skupaj z bitko za Misrato je bila prva bitka za Zavijo eden najbolj krvavih spopadov libijske državljanske vojne.

source.title: First Battle of Zawiya
paragraphs: The First Battle of Zawiya or Zawia was a battle during the Libyan Civil War between army units and militiamen loyal to Muammar Gaddafi and anti-Gaddafi forces for control of the city of Zawia.

The city quickly fell into rebels hands with soldiers from Libyan Army units defecting. Zawia was the rebel city which was closest to Tripoli, and its control became the main focus of Gaddafi troops. The city was besieged and regularly attacked by loyalists with rebels defending the center of the town. The final assault lasted one week and was led by the Khamis Brigade, the best trained unit of the Libyan army. The rebellion was ultimately crushed in the city and Gaddafi troops took complete control of the town, searching for suspected rebels and erasing any sign of the rebellion.
Along with the Battle of Misrata, the First Battle of Zawiya was one of the bloodiest clashes of the Libyan Civil War.

First Chimurenga.headline: Prva chimurenga
paragraphs: Prva chimurenga, znana tudi kot druga matabelska vojna, je potekala med letoma 1896 in 1897 na območju, ki je pozneje postalo Južna Rodezija (danes Zimbabve). Spopad je sprva potekal med Britansko južnoafriško družbo (BSAC) in Matabelci, pozneje pa se je razširil še na Šone v preostali Južni Rodeziji.

Matabelci so se marca 1896 uprli oblasti BSAC. Mlimu (tudi M'limo ali Umlimo), duhovnemu vodji Matabelcev, pripisujejo, da je razpihal velik del jeze, ki je pripeljala do spopada. Matabelce in Šone je prepričal, da so za sušo, napade kobilic in govejo kugo, ki so tedaj pustošili po deželi, krivi naseljenci (tedaj jih je bilo že skoraj 4000).

source.title: First Chimurenga
paragraphs: The First Chimurenga, also known as the Second Matabele War, was fought between 1896 and 1897 in the region that later became Southern Rhodesia (now Zimbabwe). The conflict was initially between the British South Africa Company (BSAC) and the Matabele people, later expanding to include the Shona people in the rest of Southern Rhodesia.

In March 1896, the Matabele revolted against the authority of the BSAC. The Mlimo (or M'limo, or Umlimo) the Matabele spiritual leader, was credited with fomenting much of the anger that led to this confrontation. He convinced the Matabele and the Shona that the settlers (almost 4,000 strong by then) were responsible for the drought, locust plagues and the cattle disease rinderpest ravaging the country at the time.

First Congo War.headline: Prva kongovska vojna
paragraphs: Prva kongovska vojna, znana tudi kot prva afriška svetovna vojna, je bila državljanski in mednarodni vojaški spopad, ki je od 24. oktobra 1996 do 16. maja 1997 potekal predvsem v Zairu (ta se je med spopadom preimenoval v Demokratično republiko Kongo). Vojna se je končala s strmoglavljenjem zairskega predsednika Mobutuja Sese Seka, ki ga je zamenjal uporniški voditelj Laurent-Désiré Kabila. Spopad, v katerega je bilo vpletenih tudi več sosednjih držav, je zaradi napetosti med Kabilo in njegovimi nekdanjimi zavezniki pripravil teren za drugo kongovsko vojno (1998–2003).

source.title: First Congo War
paragraphs: The First Congo War, also known as Africa's First World War, was a civil and international military conflict that lasted from 24 October 1996 to 16 May 1997, primarily taking place in Zaire (which was renamed the Democratic Republic of the Congo during the conflict). The war resulted in the overthrow of Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko, who was replaced by rebel leader Laurent-Désiré Kabila. This conflict, which also involved multiple neighboring countries, set the stage for the Second Congo War (1998–2003) due to tensions between Kabila and his former allies.

First Franco-Dahomean War.headline: Prva francosko-dahomejska vojna
paragraphs: Prva francosko-dahomejska vojna je potekala leta 1890 med Francijo pod vodstvom generala Alfreda-Amédéeja Doddsa in Dahomejem pod kraljem Béhanzinom.

source.title: First Franco-Dahomean War
paragraphs: The First Franco-Dahomean War was fought in 1890 between France, led by General Alfred-Amédée Dodds, and Dahomey under King Béhanzin.

First Ivorian Civil War.headline: Prva slonokoščenobalska državljanska vojna
paragraphs: Prva slonokoščenobalska državljanska vojna je bila državljanski spopad v Slonokoščeni obali (Côte d'Ivoire), ki se je začel z vojaškim uporom 19. septembra 2002 in končal z mirovnim sporazumom 4. marca 2007. Vlada predsednika Laurenta Gbagboja se je v njem spopadla z domačimi uporniki pod vodstvom Novih sil Slonokoščene obale (Forces nouvelles de Côte d'Ivoire). Zaradi izida predsedniških volitev leta 2010 je izbruhnila druga državljanska vojna (2010–2011).

source.title: First Ivorian Civil War
paragraphs: The First Ivorian Civil War was a civil conflict in the Ivory Coast (Côte d'Ivoire) that began with a military rebellion on 19 September 2002 and ended with a peace agreement on 4 March 2007. The conflict pitted the government of Ivorian President Laurent Gbagbo against a domestic insurgency led by the New Forces of Ivory Coast (Forces nouvelles de Côte d'Ivoire). A second civil war (2010–2011) would break out over the results of the 2010 Ivorian presidential election.

Prva liberijska državljanska vojna je bila prva od dveh državljanskih vojn v zahodnoafriški državi Liberiji in je trajala od leta 1989 do 1997. Totalitarni režim predsednika Samuela Doeja in razširjena korupcija sta do konca 1980. let sprožila pozive, naj Združene države umaknejo podporo. Decembra 1989 je Narodna domoljubna fronta Liberije (NPFL) pod vodstvom Charlesa Taylorja iz Slonokoščene obale vdrla v Liberijo, da bi strmoglavila Doeja, in v enem letu prevzela nadzor nad večino države.

Doeja je septembra 1990 ujela, mučila in usmrtila Neodvisna narodna domoljubna fronta Liberije (INPFL), odcepljena frakcija NPFL pod vodstvom Princea Johnsona. NPFL in INPFL sta se nato bojevali med seboj za nadzor nad prestolnico Monrovio ter proti oboroženim silam Liberije in Doeju naklonjenemu Združenemu osvobodilnemu gibanju Liberije za demokracijo.

source.title: First Liberian Civil War
paragraphs: The First Liberian Civil War was the first of two civil wars within the West African nation of Liberia which lasted between 1989 and 1997. President Samuel Doe's regime of totalitarianism and widespread corruption led to calls for withdrawal of the support of the United States, by the late 1980s. In December 1989, the National Patriotic Front of Liberia (NPFL) led by Charles Taylor invaded Liberia from Ivory Coast to overthrow Doe, and gained control over most of Liberia within a year.

Doe was captured, tortured, and executed by the Independent National Patriotic Front of Liberia (INPFL), a splinter faction of the NPFL led by Prince Johnson, in September 1990. The NPFL and INPFL then fought each other for control of the capital city, Monrovia and against the Armed Forces of Liberia and pro-Doe United Liberation Movement of Liberia for Democracy.

First Matabele War.headline: Prva matabelska vojna
paragraphs: Prva matabelska vojna je potekala med letoma 1893 in 1894 na ozemlju današnjega Zimbabveja. V njej sta se spopadli Britanska južnoafriška družba in ndebelsko kraljestvo Mthwakazi. Lobengula, kralj Mthwakazija, se je skušal izogniti odkriti vojni s pionirji družbe, ker so se on in njegovi svetovalci zavedali uničujoče moči evropskega orožja proti tradicionalnim matabelskim impijem (bojevniškim enotam), ki so napadali v strnjenih vrstah. Lobengula naj bi lahko zbral 80.000 suličarjev in 20.000 strelcev, oboroženih s puškami Martini-Henry, ki so bile tedaj sodobno orožje. Zaradi slabe izurjenosti pa orožja morda niso uporabljali učinkovito.

source.title: First Matabele War
paragraphs: The First Matabele War was fought between 1893 and 1894 in modern-day Zimbabwe. It pitted the British South Africa Company against the Ndebele kingdom of Mthwakazi. Lobengula, king of Mthwakazi, had tried to avoid outright war with the company's pioneers because he and his advisors were mindful of the destructive power of European-produced weapons on traditional Matabele impis (units of warriors) attacking in massed ranks. Lobengula reportedly could muster 80,000 spearmen and 20,000 riflemen, armed with Martini-Henry rifles, which were modern arms at that time. However, poor training may have resulted in the weapons not being used effectively.

Med letoma 636 in 637/638, med muslimansko osvojitvijo Levanta, je pravoverni kalifat Bizantinskemu cesarstvu odvzel Jeruzalem. Vse se je začelo, ko je vojska kalifata pod poveljstvom Abu Ubajde novembra 636 oblegala Jeruzalem. Po šestih mesecih je patriarh Sofronij privolil v predajo, s pogojem, da se podredi le kalifu. Leta 637 ali 638 je kalif Omar (vladal 634–644) osebno pripotoval v Jeruzalem, da bi sprejel predajo mesta, in patriarh se mu je vdal.

Muslimanska osvojitev mesta je utrdila arabsko oblast nad Palestino, ki je ostala del različnih sunitskih kalifatov, dokler je leta 969 ni prevzel šiitski Fatimidski kalifat. Leta 1073 so Jeruzalem zavzeli seldžuški Turki, krščanski vladarji pa so ga znova dobili med prvo križarsko vojno leta 1099.

source.title: First Muslim conquest of Jerusalem
paragraphs: Between 636 and 637/38, during the Muslim conquest of the Levant, the Rashidun Caliphate took Jerusalem from the Byzantine Empire. It began when the Rashidun army, under the command of Abu Ubayda, besieged Jerusalem in November 636. After six months, Patriarch Sophronius agreed to surrender, on condition that he submit only to the caliph. In 637 or 638, Caliph Umar (r. 634–644) traveled to Jerusalem in person to receive the submission of the city. The patriarch thus surrendered to him.

The Muslim conquest of the city solidified Arab control over Palestine, which remained part of various Sunni caliphates until the Shia-led Fatimid Caliphate took over in 969. In 1073 the Seljuk Turks took control of Jerusalem, and Christian rulers regained control at the time of the First Crusade in 1099.

First Sealand dynasty.headline: Prva dinastija Morske dežele
paragraphs: Prva dinastija Morske dežele (URU.KÙKI) ali 2. babilonska dinastija (čeprav je bila neodvisna od Babilona, ki so mu vladali Amoriti), zelo okvirno datirana v ok. 1732–1475 pr. n. št. (po srednji kronologiji), je skrivnostno zaporedje kraljev, ki ga izpričujejo predvsem jedrnate omembe na seznamih kraljev A in B ter sočasni zapisi na asirskem sinhronističnem seznamu kraljev A.117. Sprva so jo imenovali »dinastija Dežele morja«, pozneje pa se je uveljavilo ime Morska dežela.

Dinastija, ki se je odtrgala od starobabilonskega cesarstva, je dobila ime po provinci na skrajnem jugu Mezopotamije, močvirni pokrajini brez velikih naselij, ki se je z zasipavanjem ustij Tigrisa in Evfrata postopoma širila proti jugu (v železni dobi znani kot mat Kaldi, »Kaldeja«). Lončenino Morske dežele so našli v Girsuju, Uruku in Lagašu, severneje pa na nobenem najdišču.

source.title: First Sealand dynasty
paragraphs: The First Sealand dynasty (URU.KÙKI), or the 2nd Dynasty of Babylon (although it was independent of Amorite-ruled Babylon), very speculatively c. 1732–1475 BC (MC), is an enigmatic series of kings attested to primarily in laconic references in the King Lists A and B, and as contemporaries recorded on the Assyrian Synchronistic king list A.117. Initially it was named the "Dynasty of the Country of the Sea" with Sealand later becoming customary.

The dynasty, which had broken free of the Old Babylonian Empire, was named for the province in the far south of Mesopotamia, a swampy region bereft of large settlements which gradually expanded southwards with the silting up of the mouths of the Tigris and Euphrates rivers (the region known as mat Kaldi "Chaldaea" in the Iron Age). Sealand pottery has been found at Girsu, Uruk, and Lagash but in no site north of that.

Prvo obleganje Gibraltarja je bilo bitka španske rekonkviste, ki je potekala leta 1309. V njej so se sile Kastiljske krone (večinoma iz vojaških svetov mesta Sevilja) pod poveljstvom Juana Núñeza II. de Lare in Alonsa Péreza de Guzmána spopadle s silami Granadskega emirata pod poveljstvom sultana Mohameda III. in njegovega brata Abu al Džujuša Nasra.

Bitka se je končala z zmago Kastiljske krone, eno redkih zmag v pohodu, ki se je izkazal za katastrofalnega. Zavzetje Gibraltarja je močno povečalo moč Kastilje na Iberskem polotoku, čeprav so mesto pozneje, med tretjim obleganjem Gibraltarja leta 1333, znova zavzele muslimanske sile.

source.title: First siege of Gibraltar
paragraphs: The first siege of Gibraltar was a battle of the Spanish Reconquista that took place in 1309. The battle pitted the forces of the Crown of Castile (mostly those from the military councils of the city of Seville) under the command of Juan Núñez II de Lara and Alonso Pérez de Guzmán, against the forces of the Emirate of Granada who were under the command of Sultan Muhammed III and his brother, Abu'l-Juyush Nasr.

The battle resulted in a victory for the Crown of Castile, one of the few victories in what turned out to be a disastrous campaign. The taking of Gibraltar greatly increased the relative power of Castile on the Iberian Peninsula though the actual city was later recaptured by Muslim forces during the third siege of Gibraltar in 1333.

Franco-Hova Wars.headline: Francosko-hovski vojni
paragraphs: Francosko-hovski vojni, znani tudi kot francosko-malgaški vojni, sta bili dve francoski vojaški posredovanji na Madagaskarju med letoma 1883 in 1896, ki sta strmoglavili vladajočo monarhijo Kraljestva Merina, Madagaskar pa je zato postal francoska kolonija. Izraz »Hova« je označeval družbeni sloj v merinski razredni ureditvi.

source.title: Franco-Hova Wars
paragraphs: The Franco-Hova Wars, also known as the Franco-Malagasy Wars, were two French military interventions in Madagascar between 1883 and 1896 that overthrew the ruling monarchy of the Merina Kingdom, and resulted in Madagascar becoming a French colony. The term "Hova" referred to a social class within the Merina class structure.

Franco-Moroccan War.headline: Francosko-maroška vojna
paragraphs: Francosko-maroška vojna (arabsko: الحرب الفرنسية المغربية; francosko: Guerre franco-marocaine) je potekala med Kraljevino Francijo in Maroškim sultanatom od 6. avgusta do 10. septembra 1844. Glavni vzrok vojne je bil umik voditelja alžirskega odpora Abd el Kadra v Maroko, potem ko so Francozi med osvajanjem Alžirije premagali številne plemenske podpornike, ter zavrnitev maroškega sultana Mulaja Abd ar Rahmana, da bi Abd el Kadra v boju proti kolonialni zasedbi pustil na cedilu.

source.title: Franco-Moroccan War
paragraphs: The Franco-Moroccan War (Arabic: الحرب الفرنسية المغربية, French: Guerre franco-marocaine) was fought between the Kingdom of France and the Sultanate of Morocco from 6 August to 10 September 1844. The principal cause of war was the retreat of Algerian resistance leader Abd al-Kader into Morocco following French victories over many of his tribal supporters during the French conquest of Algeria and the refusal of the Sultan of Morocco Moulay Abd al-Rahman to abandon the cause of Abd al-Kader against colonial occupation.

Franco-Syrian War.headline: Francosko-sirska vojna
paragraphs: Francosko-sirska vojna je leta 1920 potekala med Francijo in hašemitskimi vladarji novoustanovljenega Arabskega kraljestva Sirija. V vrsti spopadov, ki so dosegli vrhunec v bitki pri Majsalunu, so francoske sile premagale sile hašemitskega kralja Fejsala in njegovih privržencev ter 24. julija 1920 vkorakale v Damask. V Siriji so 25. julija razglasili novo profrancosko vlado pod vodstvom Alaa al Dina al Darubija, pokrajino Sirijo pa so nazadnje razdelili na več odvisnih držav pod mandatom za Sirijo in Libanon. Britanska vlada je v skrbeh za svoj položaj v novem mandatu v Iraku privolila, da begunca Fejsala razglasi za novega iraškega kralja.

source.title: Franco-Syrian War
paragraphs: The Franco-Syrian War took place during 1920 between France and the Hashemite rulers of the newly established Arab Kingdom of Syria. During a series of engagements, which climaxed in the Battle of Maysalun, French forces defeated the forces of the Hashemite monarch King Faisal, and his supporters, entering Damascus on July 24, 1920. A new pro-French government was declared in Syria on July 25, headed by 'Alaa al-Din al-Darubi and the region of Syria was eventually divided into several client states under the Mandate for Syria and the Lebanon. The British government, concerned for their position in the new mandate in Iraq, agreed to declare the fugitive Faisal as the new king of Iraq.

Franco-Turkish War.headline: Francosko-turška vojna
paragraphs: Francosko-turška vojna, v Franciji znana kot kilikijska kampanja (francosko: La campagne de Cilicie), v Turčiji pa kot južna fronta (turško: Güney Cephesi) turške osamosvojitvene vojne, je bila vrsta spopadov, ki so od decembra 1918 do oktobra 1921, po prvi svetovni vojni, potekali med Francijo (francoskimi kolonialnimi silami in Francosko armensko legijo) in turškimi narodnimi silami (ki jih je po 4. septembru 1920 vodila turška začasna vlada). Francoski interes v regiji je izviral iz sporazuma Sykes-Picot, okrepila pa ga je še begunska kriza po armenskem genocidu.

source.title: Franco-Turkish War
paragraphs: The Franco–Turkish War, known as the Cilicia Campaign (French: La campagne de Cilicie) in France and as the Southern Front (Turkish: Güney Cephesi) of the Turkish War of Independence in Turkey, was a series of conflicts fought between France (the French Colonial Forces and the French Armenian Legion) and the Turkish National Forces (led by the Turkish provisional government after 4 September 1920) from December 1918 to October 1921 in the aftermath of World War I. French interest in the region stemmed from the Sykes-Picot Agreement and was further fueled by a refugee crisis following the Armenian genocide.
Francoska Afrika obsega vse zgodovinske posesti Francije na afriški celini.

source.title: French Africa
paragraphs: French Africa includes all the historic holdings of France on the African continent.

Francoska Alžirija, znana tudi kot kolonialna Alžirija, je bila kolonija in pozneje sestavni del Francije. Francoska oblast je trajala od začetka francoske osvojitve leta 1830 do konca alžirske vojne, po kateri je Alžirija 5. julija 1962 postala neodvisna.

source.title: French Algeria
paragraphs: French Algeria, also known as Colonial Algeria, was a colony and later an integral part of France. French rule lasted from the beginning of the French conquest in 1830 until the end of the Algerian War which resulted in Algeria gaining independence on 5 July 1962.

French conquest of Morocco.headline: Francoska osvojitev Maroka
paragraphs: Francoska osvojitev Maroka se je začela, ko je Francoska republika 29. marca 1907 zasedla mesto Udžda. Francozi so sprožili pohode proti Maroškemu sultanatu, ki so dosegli vrhunec s podpisom pogodbe iz Fesa in ustanovitvijo francoskega protektorata v Maroku 30. marca 1912. Francija je nato 27. novembra s Kraljevino Španijo sklenila madridsko pogodbo, s katero je nastal španski protektorat v Maroku. Francozi so še vse do leta 1934 izvajali vrsto vojaških operacij za zatiranje uporov v Maroku.

source.title: French conquest of Morocco
paragraphs: The French conquest of Morocco began with the French Republic occupying the city of Oujda on 29 March 1907. The French launched campaigns against the Sultanate of Morocco which culminated in the signing of the Treaty of Fes and establishment of the French Protectorate in Morocco on 30 March 1912. France later concluded, on 27 November, the Treaty of Madrid with the Kingdom of Spain which established the Spanish protectorate in Morocco. The French still conducted a series of military operations to pacify rebellions in Morocco until 1934.

Konzulat (francosko: Consulat) je bil najvišji vladni organ Prve francoske republike od padca direktorija v državnem udaru 18. brumaira, 9. novembra 1799, do začetka Prvega francoskega cesarstva 18. maja 1804. V tem obdobju se je Napoleon Bonaparte z imenovanjem za prvega konzula postavil na čelo avtoritarne in centralizirane republikanske vlade v Franciji, čeprav se še ni razglasil za edinega vladarja.

Ko je Napoleon krepil svojo moč, je v svoji novi obliki samovlade prevzel nekatere ustanove starega režima, nekatere pa je ustvaril sam. Tako kot stara monarhija je znova uvedel pooblaščence, močno centraliziral upravo in uporabljal strogo utilitarne upravne in birokratske metode. Zgradil ali utrdil je sredstva, potrebna za narodne ustanove, krajevne oblasti, univerze, sodni sistem, finančne organe, bančništvo, zakonike in tradicije vestne, dobro disciplinirane delovne sile.
notes: The last English sentence is garbled ("traditions of conscientious of a well-disciplined labour force"); translated as meant.

source.title: French Consulate
paragraphs: The Consulate (French: Consulat) was the top-level government of the French First Republic from the fall of the Directory in the coup of 18 Brumaire on 9 November 1799 until the start of the First French Empire on 18 May 1804. During this period, Napoleon Bonaparte, with his appointment as First Consul, established himself as the head of an authoritarian and centralized republican government in France while not yet declaring himself sole ruler.

As Napoleon increased his power, he borrowed some of the institutions of the ancien régime in his new form of one-man government, but also made some of his own. Like the old monarchy, he re-introduced plenipotentiaries; over-centralized, and used strictly utilitarian administrative and bureaucratic methods. He constructed or consolidated the funds necessary for national institutions, local governments, universities, a judiciary system, organs of finance, banking, codes, and traditions of conscientious of a well-disciplined labour force.

Francoska Indija, uradno Établissements français dans l'Inde (»francoske naselbine v Indiji«), je bila francoska kolonija iz petih zemljepisno ločenih enklav na indijski podcelini, ki so bile sprva trgovske postojanke Francoske vzhodnoindijske družbe. Dejansko so jih v Republiko Indijo vključili v letih 1950 in 1954. Enklave so bile Pondichéry, Karikal in Yanaon na Koromandijski obali, Mahé na Malabarski obali in Chandernagor v Bengaliji. Francozi so imeli tudi več loges (»lož«, drobnih podružničnih trgovskih postaj) v drugih mestih, a so Britanci po letu 1816 zavrnili vse francoske zahteve po njih in jih niso nikoli več zasedli.

Leta 1950 je celotno ozemlje merilo 510 km², od tega je 293 km² pripadalo ozemlju Pondichéryja. Leta 1936 je imela kolonija skupaj 298.851 prebivalcev, od katerih jih je 63 % (187.870) živelo na ozemlju Pondichéryja.
notes: The French pronunciation in IPA and the square-mile conversions are dropped.

source.title: French India
paragraphs: French India, formally the Établissements français dans l'Inde (French pronunciation: [etablismɑ̃ fʁɑ̃se dɑ̃ l ͜ ɛ̃d]; English: French Settlements in India), was a French colony comprising five geographically separated enclaves on the Indian subcontinent that had initially been factories of the French East India Company. They were de facto incorporated into the Republic of India in 1950 and 1954. The enclaves were Pondichéry, Karikal, Yanaon on the Coromandel Coast, Mahé on the Malabar Coast and Chandernagor in Bengal. The French also possessed several loges ('lodges', tiny subsidiary trading stations) inside other towns, but after 1816, the British denied all French claims to these, which were not reoccupied.

By 1950, the total area measured 510 km2 (200 sq mi), of which 293 km2 (113 sq mi) belonged to the territory of Pondichéry. In 1936, the population of the colony totalled 298,851 inhabitants, of which 63% (187,870) lived in the territory of Pondichéry.

Francoska invazija na Egipt in Sirijo (1798–1801) je bila vojaška odprava v Egipt in Sirijo pod osmansko oblastjo, ki jo je med francoskimi revolucionarnimi vojnami vodil Napoleon Bonaparte. Pohod naj bi spodkopal britanske trgovske poti, razširil francoski vpliv ter v Egiptu vzpostavil znanstveno in upravno navzočnost. Napoleon je hotel tudi presekati britansko povezavo s kolonialnimi posestmi v Indiji, z dolgoročnim ciljem izzvati britansko prevlado v regiji.

source.title: French invasion of Egypt and Syria
paragraphs: The French invasion of Egypt and Syria (1798–1801) was a military expedition to Ottoman-held Egypt and Syria led by Napoleon Bonaparte during the French Revolutionary Wars. The campaign aimed to undermine British trade routes, expand French influence, and establish a scientific and administrative presence in Egypt. Napoleon also sought to sever Britain's connection to its colonial holdings in India, with the long-term ambition of challenging British dominance in the region.

Funj Sultanate.headline: Fundžski sultanat
paragraphs: Fundžski sultanat, znan tudi kot Fundžistan, Sultanat Sennar ali Modri sultanat, je bil islamsko kraljestvo na ozemlju današnjega Sudana, severozahodne Eritreje in zahodne Etiopije. Nasledil je srednjeveški nubijski kraljestvi Makurijo in Alodijo, ustanovil pa ga je leta 1504 sultan Amara Dunkas, ki je prestopil v islam in ustanovil prestolnico Sennar ob Modrem Nilu. V njem so prevladovali Fundži, arabizirano ljudstvo nejasnega etničnega izvora, ki je vladalo etnično raznolikemu prebivalstvu, med drugim Nubijcem, Bedžam, beduinom in Hamadžem. Vrhunec je dosegel konec 17. stoletja, ko je segal od tretjega katarakta proti jugu do zahodnega roba Etiopskega višavja in reke Sobat, na vzhodu do Rdečega morja, na zahodu pa do Kordofana in gorovja Nuba. Širjenje islama je spodbujal z vabljenjem sufijskih svetih mož, kar je pospešilo tudi arabizacijo in nastanek sodobnih sudanskih arabskih plemen. V 18. stoletju je moč Fundžev upadla, zlasti potem ko so leta 1762 z udarom prevzeli oblast Hamadži. Od konca 18. stoletja je sultanat razpadal in ga trgale državljanske vojne. Leta 1821 se je moral zadnji sultan, ki je imel le še malo moči, vdati turško-egiptovskim osvajalcem.

source.title: Funj Sultanate
paragraphs: The Funj Sultanate, also known as Funjistan, Sultanate of Sennar or Blue Sultanate was an Islamic kingdom in what is now Sudan, northwestern Eritrea and western Ethiopia. Succeeding the medieval Nubian kingdoms of Makuria and Alodia, it was established in 1504 by Sultan Amara Dunqas, a convert to Islam who founded its capital Sennar on the Blue Nile. It was dominated by the Funj people, an arabized people of unclear ethnic origin who ruled over an ethnically diverse population including Nubians, Beja, Bedouin and Hamaj. It reached its peak in the late 17th century, when it extended from the Third Cataract southwards to the western fringes of the Ethiopian Highlands and the Sobat River, east to the Red Sea, and west to Kordofan and the Nuba Mountains. It encouraged the spread of Islam by inviting Sufi holymen, which in turn also accelerated Arabization and the formation of the modern Sudanese Arab tribes. In the 18th century the power of the Funj declined, especially after the Hamaj seized power in a coup in 1762. From the late 18th century the Sultanate disintegrated and was torn apart by civil wars. In 1821 the last sultan, greatly reduced in power, was forced to surrender to the Turco-Egyptian conquest.

Garamantes.headline: Garamanti
paragraphs: Garamanti (starogrško: Γαράμαντες, Garámantes; latinsko: Garamantes) so bili starodavno ljudstvo, ki je morda izhajalo iz berberskih plemen, plemen Tubu in saharskih pastirjev in se je najpozneje okoli leta 1000 pr. n. št. naselilo v pokrajini Fezan, kjer je ustvarilo civilizacijo, ki je cvetela do svojega konca v poznem 7. stoletju n. št. Garamanti so se kot pomembna regionalna sila prvič uveljavili sredi 2. stoletja n. št. in ustanovili kraljestvo, ki je obsegalo približno 180.000 km² v pokrajini Fezan na jugu Libije. Njihova rast in širitev sta temeljili na zapletenem in obsežnem namakalnem sistemu kanatov (berbersko: foggaras), ki je vzdrževal močno kmetijstvo in številno prebivalstvo. Pozneje so razvili prvo mestno družbo v veliki puščavi, ki ni bila vezana na rečni sistem: njihovo največje mesto, Garama, je imelo okoli štiri tisoč prebivalcev, v okoliških predmestjih pa jih je živelo še šest tisoč. Na vrhuncu je garamantsko kraljestvo vzpostavilo in ohranjalo »življenjsko raven, ki je daleč presegala raven katere koli druge starodavne saharske družbe«, sestavljali pa so ga »odlični kmetje, iznajdljivi inženirji in podjetni trgovci, ki so ustvarili izjemno civilizacijo«.
notes: The square-mile conversion (70,000 sq mi) is dropped.

source.title: Garamantes
paragraphs: The Garamantes (Ancient Greek: Γαράμαντες, romanized: Garámantes; Latin: Garamantes) were ancient peoples, who may have descended from Berber tribes, Toubou tribes, and Saharan pastoralists and who had settled, at least as early as 1000 BC, in the Fezzan region, where they established a civilization that flourished until its end in the late 7th century AD. The Garamantes first emerged as a major regional power in the mid-2nd century AD and established a kingdom that spanned roughly 180,000 km2 (70,000 sq mi) in the Fezzan region of southern Libya. Their growth and expansion was based on a complex and extensive qanat irrigation system (Berber: foggaras), which supported a strong agricultural economy and a large population. They subsequently developed the first urban society in a major desert that was not centered on a river system; their largest town, Garama, had a population of around four thousand, with an additional six thousand living in surrounding suburban areas. At its pinnacle, the Garamantian kingdom established and maintained a "standard of living far superior to that of any other ancient Saharan society" and was composed of "brilliant farmers, resourceful engineers, and enterprising merchants who produced a remarkable civilization."

German colonization of Africa.headline: Nemška kolonizacija Afrike
paragraphs: Nemčija je Afriko kolonizirala v dveh ločenih obdobjih. V 1680. letih je Brandenburška mejna grofija, ki je tedaj vodila širše kraljestvo Brandenburg-Prusija, v zahodni Afriki vodila omejena imperialna prizadevanja. Brandenburška afriška družba je dobila listino leta 1682 in ustanovila dve majhni naselbini na Zlati obali, na ozemlju današnje Gane. Pet let pozneje je pogodba s kraljem Arguina v Mavretaniji nad tem otokom vzpostavila protektorat in Brandenburg je zasedel zapuščeno utrdbo, ki so jo tam prvotno zgradili Portugalci. Brandenburg – po letu 1701 Kraljevina Prusija – je ta kolonialna prizadevanja nadaljeval do leta 1721, ko so Arguin zavzeli Francozi, naselbine na Zlati obali pa so prodali Nizozemski republiki.

source.title: German colonization of Africa
paragraphs: Germany colonized Africa during two distinct periods. In the 1680s, the Margraviate of Brandenburg, then leading the broader realm of Brandenburg-Prussia, pursued limited imperial efforts in West Africa. The Brandenburg African Company was chartered in 1682 and established two small settlements on the Gold Coast of what is today Ghana. Five years later, a treaty with the king of Arguin in Mauritania established a protectorate over that island, and Brandenburg occupied an abandoned fort originally constructed there by Portugal. Brandenburg — after 1701, the Kingdom of Prussia — pursued these colonial efforts until 1721, when Arguin was captured by the French and the Gold Coast settlements were sold to the Dutch Republic.

German–Ottoman alliance.headline: Nemško-osmansko zavezništvo
paragraphs: Nemško-osmansko zavezništvo sta Nemško cesarstvo in Osmansko cesarstvo ratificirala 2. avgusta 1914, kmalu po izbruhu prve svetovne vojne. Sklenila sta ga v okviru skupnega prizadevanja, da bi okrepila in posodobila šibko osmansko vojsko ter Nemčiji zagotovila varen prehod v sosednje britanske kolonije.

source.title: German–Ottoman alliance
paragraphs: The German–Ottoman alliance was ratified by the German Empire and the Ottoman Empire on August 2, 1914, shortly after the outbreak of World War I. It was created as part of a joint effort to strengthen and modernize the weak Ottoman military and to provide Germany with safe passage into the neighbouring British colonies.

Gaznavidski imperij (perzijsko: Ġaznaviyān) je bil kulturno perzijsko oblikovana sunitska muslimanska država turškega karluškega izvora. Cvetel je od leta 977 do 1186 in na vrhuncu segal od Oksa do doline Inda. Dinastijo je ustanovil Sabuktigin, ko je po smrti tasta Alp Tigina, nekdanjega generala Samanidskega imperija iz Balha, prevzel oblast v Gazni.

Sabuktiginov sin Mahmud iz Gazne je imperij razširil na vzhodu do Amudarje, Inda in Indijskega oceana, na zahodu pa do Reja in Hamadana. Pod Masudom I. je dinastija po bitki pri Dandanakanu leta 1040 začela izgubljati zahodna ozemlja v korist Seldžuškega imperija, zato se je njena posest skrčila na današnji Afganistan, Pakistan in severno Indijo.

source.title: Ghaznavid Empire
paragraphs: The Ghaznavid Empire (Persian: غزنویان, romanized: Ġaznaviyān) was a culturally Persianate, Sunni Muslim state of Turkic Karluk origin. Flourishing from 977 to 1186, the empire spread from the Oxus to the Indus Valley at its greatest extent. The dynasty was founded by Sabuktigin upon his succession to the rule of Ghazna after the death of his father-in-law, Alp Tigin, who was an ex-general of the Samanid Empire from Balkh.

Sabuktigin's son, Mahmud of Ghazni, expanded the Ghaznavid Empire to the Amu Darya, the Indus River and the Indian Ocean in the east and to Rey and Hamadan in the west. Under the reign of Mas'ud I, the Ghaznavid dynasty began losing control over its western territories to the Seljuk Empire after the Battle of Dandanaqan in 1040, resulting in a restriction of its holdings to modern-day Afghanistan, Pakistan and Northern India.

Kolonija Zlata obala je bila britanska kronska kolonija ob Gvinejskem zalivu v zahodni Afriki od leta 1821 do osamosvojitve kot Gana leta 1957. Izraz Zlata obala lahko skupno označuje tudi štiri ločena upravna območja, ki jih je upravljal guverner Zlate obale: kolonijo v ožjem pomenu, Ašanti, Severna ozemlja in Britanski Togo. Ime izhaja iz bogatih nahajališč zlata v regiji, ki so privabila evropske trgovce, tudi Britance.

Zlata obala je postala pomembno središče atlantske trgovine s sužnji, iz katerega so zasužnjene Afričane izvažali v Ameriko. Britanska oblast se je širila s pogodbami, prevzemanjem posesti tekmečih evropskih sil in osvajanjem afriških držav, zlasti Ašantskega imperija, v začetku 20. stoletja pa je obsegala ozemlja, ki danes sestavljajo večji del Gane.

source.title: Gold Coast (British colony)
paragraphs: The Colony of the Gold Coast was a British Crown colony on the Gulf of Guinea in West Africa from 1821 until its independence as Ghana in 1957. The term Gold Coast may also refer collectively to the four separate jurisdictions administered by the Governor of the Gold Coast: the colony proper, Ashanti, the Northern Territories, and British Togoland. The name derives from the region's abundant gold resources, which attracted European traders, including the British.

The Gold Coast became a major centre of the Atlantic slave trade, with enslaved Africans exported to the Americas. British rule expanded through treaties, the acquisition of rival European possessions, and the conquest of African states, most notably the Ashanti Empire, and by the early 20th century encompassed territories that now form most of present-day Ghana.

Greek landing at Smyrna.headline: Grško izkrcanje v Smirni
paragraphs: Grško izkrcanje v Smirni (grško: Ελληνική απόβαση στη Σμύρνη; turško: Yunanların İzmir'e çıkışı) je bilo vojaška operacija grških sil, ki se je začela 15. maja 1919 in v kateri so se enote izkrcale v mestu Smirna in okolici.

Izkrcanje je odobril britanski predsednik vlade David Lloyd George z utemeljitvijo, da »[t]am poteka pokol in nikogar ni, ki bi zaščitil grško prebivalstvo«. Zavezniške sile so nadzirale načrtovanje operacije in pomagale tako, da so svojim enotam ukazale zasesti nekatere ključne točke in v pristanišče Smirne poslale vojne ladje. Med izkrcanjem je nekdo streljal na grški 1/38. evzonski polk, sledilo pa je hudo nasilje med obema skupnostma, ki pa ni bilo načrtno in ga je grško poveljstvo skušalo preprečiti. Dogodek je bil pomemben, ker je začel triletno grško zasedbo Smirne, in je bil ena glavnih isker za grško-turško vojno (1919–1922).

source.title: Greek landing at Smyrna
paragraphs: The Greek landing at Smyrna (Greek: Ελληνική απόβαση στη Σμύρνη; Turkish: Yunanların İzmir'e çıkışı) was a military operation by Greek forces starting on May 15, 1919 which involved landing troops in the city of Smyrna and surrounding areas.

The landing was sanctioned by British Prime Minister David Lloyd George, who argued that: "[a] massacre is taking place over there and there is nobody to protect the Greek population". The Allied powers oversaw the planning of the operation and assisted by directing their forces to take over some key locations and moving warships to the Smyrna harbor. During the landing, a shot was fired on the Greek 1/38 Evzone Regiment and significant violence ensued between both communities, however it was unsystematic and the Greek command tried to thwart it. The event became important for creating the three-year-long Greek Occupation of Smyrna and was a major spark for the Greco-Turkish War (1919–1922).

Zeleni pohod (arabsko: المسيرة الخضراء, al-masīrat ul-khaḍrāʾ) je bil strateška množična demonstracija novembra 1975, ki sta jo usklajevali maroška vlada in vojska, da bi Španijo prisilili k predaji sporne avtonomne napol metropolitanske province Španska Sahara Maroku. Španska vlada se je pripravljala, da ozemlje v okviru dekolonizacije Afrike zapusti, tako kot je leta 1968 neodvisnost podelila Ekvatorialni Gvineji. Domače prebivalstvo, Sahravijci, si je prizadevalo za samostojno državo. Demonstracija približno 350.000 Maročanov je prodrla nekaj kilometrov v ozemlje Zahodne Sahare. Operacija se je opirala tudi na logistično podporo in tiho odobritev ameriškega zunanjega ministrstva in Cie, saj sta Washington in Pariz v okviru hladne vojne raje videla, da se ozemlje vključi v zahodu naklonjeni Maroko, kot da bi nastala samostojna država, ki bi se morda povezala z Alžirijo in vzhodnim blokom.

source.title: Green March
paragraphs: The Green March (Arabic: المسيرة الخضراء, romanized: al-masīrat ul-khaḍrāʾ) was a strategic mass demonstration in November 1975, coordinated by the Moroccan government and the military, to force Spain to hand over the disputed, autonomous semi-metropolitan province of Spanish Sahara to Morocco. The Spanish government was preparing to abandon the territory as part of the decolonization of Africa, just as it had granted independence to Equatorial Guinea in 1968. The native inhabitants, the Sahrawi people, aspired to form an independent state. The demonstration of approximately 350,000 Moroccans advanced several kilometers into the Western Sahara territory. The operation also relied on logistical support and tacit approval from the United States Department of State and the CIA, as Washington and Paris, within the context of the Cold War, favored the integration of the territory into pro-Western Morocco over the emergence of an independent state potentially aligned with Algeria and the Eastern Bloc.

Guinea-Bissau Civil War.headline: Državljanska vojna v Gvineji Bissau
paragraphs: Državljanska vojna v Gvineji Bissau je potekala od 7. junija 1998 do 10. maja 1999, sprožil pa jo je poskus državnega udara, ki ga je proti vladi predsednika Joãa Bernarda Vieire vodil brigadni general Ansumane Mané. Vladne sile, ki so jih podpirale sosednje države, so se spopadle z voditelji udara, ki so hitro prevzeli nadzor nad skoraj vsemi oboroženimi silami države.
V spopadu je umrlo več sto, če ne več tisoč ljudi, več sto tisoč pa jih je bilo razseljenih.

Mirovni sporazum, sklenjen novembra 1998, je predvideval vlado narodne enotnosti in nove volitve v naslednjem letu. Kratek izbruh bojev maja 1999 pa se je končal z odstavitvijo Vieire 10. maja 1999, ko je ta podpisal brezpogojno predajo.

source.title: Guinea-Bissau Civil War
paragraphs: The Guinea-Bissau Civil War was fought from 7 June 1998 to 10 May 1999 and was triggered by an attempted coup d'état against the government of President João Bernardo Vieira led by Brigadier-General Ansumane Mané. Government forces, backed by neighbouring states, clashed with the coup leaders who had quickly gained almost total control over the country's armed forces.
The conflict resulted in the deaths of hundreds if not thousands of people and the displacement of hundreds of thousands.

An eventual peace agreement in November 1998 provided for a national unity government and new elections in the next year. However, a subsequent and brief outbreak of fighting in May 1999 ended with the deposing of Vieira on 10 May 1999 when Vieira signed an unconditional surrender.

Bissavska vojna za neodvisnost (portugalsko: Guerra de Independência da Guiné-Bissau), znana tudi kot bissavsko-gvinejska vojna za neodvisnost, je bila oborožen osamosvojitveni spopad, ki je med letoma 1963 in 1974 potekal v Portugalski Gvineji. V njem sta se bojevali Portugalska in Afriška stranka za neodvisnost Gvineje in Zelenortskih otokov (Partido Africano da Independência da Guiné e Cabo Verde, PAIGC), oboroženo osamosvojitveno gibanje, ki so ga podpirale Sovjetska zveza, Kitajska, Kuba, Alžirija in Gvineja. Vojno pogosto imenujejo »portugalski Vietnam«, ker je bila dolgotrajna gverilska vojna, ki je zahtevala izjemno visoke človeške in materialne žrtve ter na Portugalskem povzročila hude notranjepolitične pretrese.

source.title: Guinea-Bissau War of Independence
paragraphs: The Guinea-Bissau War of Independence (Portuguese: Guerra de Independência da Guiné-Bissau), also known as the Bissau-Guinean War of Independence, was an armed independence conflict that took place in Portuguese Guinea from 1963 to 1974. It was fought between Portugal and the African Party for the Independence of Guinea and Cape Verde (Partido Africano da Independência da Guiné e Cabo Verde, PAIGC), an armed independence movement backed by the Soviet Union, China, Cuba, Algeria and Guinea. The war is commonly referred to as "Portugal's Vietnam" because it was a protracted guerrilla war which had extremely high costs in men and material and which created significant internal political turmoil in Portugal.

Gutian rule in Mesopotamia.headline: Gutejska vladavina v Mezopotamiji
paragraphs: Gutejska dinastija (sumersko: gu-ti-umKI) je bila vrsta kraljev iz ljudstva Gutejcev. Nekoč so menili, da so bili Gutejci horda, ki je pridrla v Mezopotamijo in strmoglavila akadsko in sumersko oblast, danes pa vemo, da so bili tedaj na tem območju že najmanj stoletje. Do konca akadskega obdobja so Gutejci zasedli sumersko mesto Adab in ga naredili za svojo prestolnico. Gutejska dinastija je prišla na oblast v Mezopotamiji proti koncu 3. tisočletja pr. n. št., po zatonu in propadu Akadskega imperija. Koliko časa so gutejski kralji vladali Mezopotamiji, ni gotovo, ocene pa segajo od nekaj let do stoletja. Konec dinastije zaznamuje vzpon uruškega vladarja Utu-hengala (ok. 2119–2112 pr. n. št.), s katerim se začne kratkotrajna »peta uruška dinastija«, za njim pa urskega vladarja Ur-Namuja (ok. 2112–2094 pr. n. št.), ustanovitelja tretje urske dinastije.

source.title: Gutian rule in Mesopotamia
paragraphs: The Gutian dynasty (Sumerian: 𒄖𒋾𒌝𒆠, gu-ti-umKI) was a line of kings, originating among the Gutian people. Originally thought to be a horde that swept in and brought down Akkadian and Sumerian rule in Mesopotamia, the Gutians are now known to have been in the area for at least a century by then. By the end of the Akkadian period, the Sumerian city of Adab was occupied by the Gutians, who made it their capital. The Gutian dynasty came to power in Mesopotamia near the end of the 3rd millennium BC, after the decline and fall of the Akkadian Empire. How long Gutian kings held rulership over Mesopotamia is uncertain, with estimates ranging from a few years up to a century. The end of the Gutian dynasty is marked by the accession of Uruk ruler Utu-hengal (c. 2119 - 2112 BC), marking the short-lived "Fifth dynasty of Uruk", followed by Ur ruler Ur-Nammu (c. 2112 – 2094 BC), founder of the Third Dynasty of Ur.

H-3 airstrike.headline: Letalski napad na H-3
paragraphs: Letalski napad na H-3 (perzijsko: عملیات اچ۳) je bil nenaden napad iranskega vojnega letalstva med iransko-iraško vojno 4. aprila 1981 na letalsko oporišče iraškega vojnega letalstva H-3 v zahodnem Iraku. Iranci so na tleh uničili najmanj 48 iraških letal, sami pa niso imeli izgub. Po doseženih izidih velja za enega najuspešnejših napadov v zgodovini letalskega vojskovanja.

source.title: H-3 airstrike
paragraphs: The H-3 airstrike (Persian: عملیات اچ۳) was a surprise air attack by the Iranian Air Force during the Iran–Iraq War on 4 April 1981 against the Iraqi Air Force's H-3 Air Base in western Iraq. The Iranians destroyed at least 48 Iraqi aircraft on the ground with no losses of their own. Based on the results achieved, it is considered one of the most successful raids in the history of aerial warfare.

Hammadid dynasty.headline: Hamadidi
paragraphs: Hamadidi (arabsko: الحماديون, Al-Hammādiyyūn, dobesedno »Hamadovi otroci«), znani tudi kot Hamadidski emirat ali Kraljestvo Bedžaja, so bili srednjeveško islamsko kraljestvo v osrednjem Magrebu, na ozemlju današnje Alžirije. Nastalo je v začetku 11. stoletja, ko se je Hamad ibn Bulugin razglasil za emirja in s tem razdelil ziridske posesti med dve ločeni dinastiji. Pod emirjem Al Nasirjem je emirat za kratek čas postal najpomembnejša država v Magrebu in dosegel največji obseg: od Tlemcena na zahodu do Tunisa na vzhodu ter od Sredozemskega morja na severu do puščavskih oaz Vargla in Ued Righ na jugu. Za kratek čas so Hamadidi nadzorovali tudi kneževino Fes na zahodu ter mesta, kot so Sfaks, Kajruan, Laribus in Tripoli, na vzhodu.
notes: The last English sentence is a fragment ("While they briefly controlled …"); translated as a full sentence with the same content.

source.title: Hammadid dynasty
paragraphs: The Hammadid dynasty (Arabic: الحماديون, romanized: Al-Hammādiyyūn, lit. 'children of Hammad'), also known as the Hammadid Emirate or the Kingdom of Bejaia, was a medieval Islamic kingdom in the central Maghreb, encompassing what is now Algeria. It was established at the beginning of the 11th century when Hammad ibn Buluggin declared himself emir, thus splitting the Zirid domains into two separate dynasties. Under the reign of Emir Al Nasir, the emirate briefly became the most important state in the Maghreb, and reached its greatest territorial extent, stretching from Tlemcen in the west to Tunis in the east, and from the Mediterranean Sea in the north to the desert oasis of Ouargla and Oued Righ in the south. While they briefly controlled the principality of Fez in the west and cities like Sfax, Kairouan, Laribus, and Tripoli to the east.

Hausa Kingdoms.headline: Havška kraljestva
paragraphs: Havška kraljestva (Masarautun Hausa), znana tudi kot Havsko (Kasar Hausa), so bila skupina držav, ki jim je pred fulanskimi džihadi vladalo ljudstvo Havsa. Ležala so med reko Niger in Čadskim jezerom (na današnjem severu Nigerije). Havsko je ležalo med zahodnosudanskimi imperiji starodavne Gane, Malija in Songaja ter vzhodnosudanskim imperijem Kanem-Bornu.

Havška ustna izročila opisujejo legendo o Bajadžidi, ki pripoveduje o dogodivščinah bagdadskega junaka Bajadžide, ki se končajo z ubojem kače v vodnjaku v Dauri in njegovo poroko s krajevno kraljico Magadžijo Dauramo. Po legendi so Bajadžidovi potomci ustanovili Hausa Bakwai (sedem »pravih« držav) in Hausa Banza (»nezakonske« ali »nelegitimne« države).
notes: Havsa / havški is a Slovenian adaptation of Hausa; the form is worth checking.

source.title: Hausa Kingdoms
paragraphs: The Hausa Kingdoms (Masarautun Hausa), also known as Hausaland (Kasar Hausa), were a collection of states ruled by the Hausa people, before the Fulani jihads. They were situated between the Niger River and Lake Chad (modern day northern Nigeria). Hausaland lay between the Western Sudanic empires of Ancient Ghana, Mali and Songhai and the Eastern Sudanic empire of Kanem-Bornu.

Hausa oral traditions detail the Bayajidda legend, which describes the adventures of the Baghdadi hero, Bayajidda, culminating in the killing of the snake in a well at Daura and his marriage to the local queen Magajiya Daurama. According to the legend, Bayajidda's descendants founded the Hausa Bakwai (seven "true" states), as well as the Hausa Banza ("bastard" or "illegitimate" states).

Namsko-hererska vojna je skupno ime za vrsto med seboj povezanih protikolonialnih oboroženih bojev domorodnih ljudstev, predvsem ljudstev Herero in Nama, proti Nemškemu cesarstvu v Nemški Jugozahodni Afriki (današnji Namibiji). Spopadi so potekali med letoma 1904 in 1908 in so vključevali hererski upor ter drugi namski upor.
notes: The key Herero uprising resolves to the English article Herero and Nama War.

source.title: Herero uprising
paragraphs: The Herero and Nama War is the collective term for a series of interlinked, anti-colonial armed struggles by native peoples in German South West Africa (present-day Namibia), mainly the Herero and Nama people, against the German Empire. The overall conflict took place between 1904 and 1908, and included the Herero uprising and the Second Nama Rebellion.

Hispano-Moroccan War (1859–1860).headline: Špansko-maroška vojna (1859–1860)
paragraphs: Špansko-maroška vojna, znana tudi kot prva maroška vojna, tetuanska vojna ali v Španiji kot afriška vojna, je trajala od španske vojne napovedi Maroku 22. oktobra 1859 do pogodbe iz Wad-Rasa 26. aprila 1860. Začela se je s sporom o mejah španskega mesta Ceuta, bojevali pa so se na severu Maroka. Maroko je po španski zmagi v bitki pri Tetuanu zaprosil za mir.

source.title: Hispano-Moroccan War (1859–1860)
paragraphs: The Hispano-Moroccan War, also known as the Spanish–Moroccan War, the First Moroccan War, the Tetuán War, or, in Spain, as the War of Africa, was fought from Spain's declaration of war on Morocco on 22 October 1859 until the Treaty of Wad-Ras on 26 April 1860. It began with a conflict over the borders of the Spanish city of Ceuta and was fought in northern Morocco. Morocco sued for peace after the Spanish victory at the Battle of Tetuán.

History of Egypt under the Muhammad Ali.headline: Egipt pod dinastijo Mohameda Alija
paragraphs: Zgodovina Egipta pod dinastijo Mohameda Alija (1805–1953) zajema poznejše obdobje osmanskega Egipta, egiptovski kedivat pod britansko zasedbo ter navidezno neodvisna Egiptovski sultanat in Kraljevino Egipt, konča pa se z revolucijo leta 1952 in nastankom Republike Egipt.

source.title: History of Egypt under the Muhammad Ali dynasty
paragraphs: The history of Egypt under the Muhammad Ali dynasty (1805–1953) spanned the later period of Ottoman Egypt, the Khedivate of Egypt under British occupation, and the nominally independent Sultanate of Egypt and Kingdom of Egypt, ending with the Revolution of 1952 and the formation of the Republic of Egypt.

Moamer Gadafi je 1. septembra 1969 postal dejanski voditelj Libije, potem ko je skupino častnikov libijske vojske povedel v nekrvav državni udar proti kralju Idrisu I. Ko je bil Idris na zdravljenju v Turčiji, je Revolucionarni poveljniški svet (RCC) pod Gadafijevim vodstvom odpravil monarhijo in ustavo ter ustanovil Libijsko arabsko republiko z baatističnim geslom »Enotnost, svoboda, socializem«.

source.title: History of Libya under Muammar Gaddafi
paragraphs: Muammar Gaddafi became the de facto leader of Libya on 1 September 1969 after leading a group of Libyan Army officers against King Idris I in a bloodless coup d'état. When Idris was in Turkey for medical treatment, the Revolutionary Command Council (RCC) headed by Gaddafi abolished the monarchy and the constitution and established the Libyan Arab Republic, with the Ba'athist motto "Unity, Freedom, Socialism".

History of Qatar.headline: Zgodovina Katarja
paragraphs: Zgodovina Katarja sega od prve človeške naselitve do nastanka sodobne države. Ljudje so v Katarju živeli že pred 50.000 leti, na Arabskem polotoku pa so izkopali kamenodobne tabore in orodje. Prva civilizacija, ki je bila na tem območju navzoča v neolitiku, je bila mezopotamska, kar dokazujejo najdbe črepinj iz obdobja Ubaid ob obalnih taborih.

source.title: History of Qatar
paragraphs: The history of Qatar spans from its first duration of human occupation to its formation as a modern state. Human occupation of Qatar dates back 50,000 years, and Stone Age encampments and tools have been unearthed in the Arabian Peninsula. Mesopotamia was the first civilization to have a presence in the area during the Neolithic period, evidenced by the discovery of potsherds originating from the Ubaid period near coastal encampments.

Zgodovina Sumerije zajema obdobje od poznega 5. do 3. tisočletja pr. n. št. v južni Mezopotamiji in priča o prvem prehodu na svetu od neolitskega vaškega življenja k zapleteni mestni civilizaciji. Razvoj je pospešila »monumentalizacija svetega«: skromna obredna svetišča, zlasti v Eriduju, so prerasla v ogromne templjeve komplekse, ki so delovali kot »sveti magneti«. Ta središča so pokrajino vlekla k sebi in sprožila »mestno implozijo«, ki je prebivalstvo zgostila v prvih pravih velemestih, kot je bil Uruk.

source.title: History of Sumer
paragraphs: The history of Sumer spans the late fifth to the third millennium BC in southern Mesopotamia, documenting the world's first transition from Neolithic village life to a complex urban civilization. This development was catalyzed by the "monumentalization of the sacred," a process where modest ritual shrines—most notably at Eridu—evolved into massive temple complexes that functioned as "sacred magnets." These centers exerted a centripetal force on the landscape, triggering an "urban implosion" that concentrated populations into the first true metropolises, such as Uruk.

Hotak dynasty.headline: Dinastija Hotaki
paragraphs: Imperij Hotaki (paštunsko: د هوتکيانو ټولواکمني; perzijsko: امپراتوری هوتکیان) je bil afganistanska dinastija paštunskih Gildžijev, ki je v 1720. letih za kratek čas vladala delom Irana in Afganistana. Leta 1709 jo je ustanovil Mirvais Hotak, ki je vodil uspešen upor proti propadajočemu perzijskemu Safavidskemu imperiju v pokrajini Loj Kandahar (»Veliki Kandahar«) na jugu današnjega Afganistana.

source.title: Hotak dynasty
paragraphs: The Hotak Empire (Pashto: د هوتکيانو ټولواکمني; Persian: امپراتوری هوتکیان) also known as the Hotaki Empire was an Afghan dynasty founded by Ghilji Pashtuns that briefly ruled parts of Iran and Afghanistan during the 1720s. It was established in 1709 by Mirwais Hotak, who led a successful rebellion against the declining Persian Safavid empire in the region of Loy Kandahar ("Greater Kandahar") in what is now southern Afghanistan.

Rodbina Al Kalifa (arabsko: Āl Khalīfah) je vladajoča družina Kraljevine Bahrajn. Pripada malikitski pravni šoli sunitskega islama in plemenu Aneza. Nekateri člani plemena so se pridružili zavezništvu Utub, ki se je iz Nedžda v osrednji Arabiji preselilo v Kuvajt, nato pa vladalo vsemu Katarju, natančneje Al Zubari, ki so jo zgradili in ji vladali, preden so leta 1783 osvojili Bahrajn. Družina Al Kalifa je zatirala domorodno prebivalstvo Baharna v Bahrajnu.

Družina danes vodi avtoritarni režim, v katerem so politične in državljanske svoboščine močno omejene. Njen sedanji poglavar je kralj Hamad bin Isa Al Kalifa, ki je leta 1999 postal bahrajnski emir, leta 2002 pa se je razglasil za kralja Bahrajna in tako dejansko postal ustavni monarh.
Leta 2025 je bila približno polovica ministrov bahrajnske vlade iz kraljeve družine Al Kalifa, iz nje pa je tudi predsednik vlade Salman bin Hamad Al Kalifa, sin sedanjega kralja.

source.title: House of Khalifa
paragraphs: The House of Khalifa (Arabic: آل خليفة, romanized: Āl Khalīfah) is the ruling family of the Kingdom of Bahrain. They follow the Maliki school of Sunni Islam and belong to the Anizah tribe. Some members of this tribe joined the Utub alliance which migrated from Najd in central Arabia to Kuwait, then ruled all of Qatar, more specifically Al Zubarah, which they built and ruled over before conquering Bahrain in 1783. The Khalifa family repressed the indigenous Baharna population in Bahrain.

The family currently heads an authoritarian regime where political and civil freedoms are substantially curtailed. The current head of the family is King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa, who became the Emir of Bahrain in 1999 and proclaimed himself King of Bahrain in 2002, in fact becoming a constitutional monarch.

As of 2025, roughly half of the serving cabinet ministers of Bahrain were members of the Al Khalifa royal family, while the country's Prime Minister, Salman bin Hamad Al Khalifa, is also from the Al Khalifa family and is the son of the current King.

Hutijska vstaja, znana tudi kot vojne v Sadi, je bila vojaški upor zajdijskih šiitskih Hutijev, ki se je začel na severu Jemna in je odtlej prerasel v vsesplošno državljansko vojno. Spopad je leta 2004 sprožil vladni poskus, da bi aretirala Huseina al Hutija, zajdijskega verskega voditelja Hutijev in nekdanjega poslanca, za čigar glavo je vlada razpisala 55.000 dolarjev nagrade.

Sprva je večina bojev potekala v guvernoratu Sada na severozahodu Jemna, nekaj pa se jih je razširilo v sosednje guvernorate Hadža, Amran in Al Džauf ter v savdsko provinco Džizan. Ko so Hutiji konec leta 2014 zavzeli prestolnico Sano, je vstaja prerasla v vsesplošno državljansko vojno z velikim posredovanjem pod savdskim vodstvom v Jemnu, ki se je začelo marca 2015.

source.title: Houthi insurgency
paragraphs: The Houthi insurgency, also known as the Sa'dah Wars, was a military rebellion pitting Zaidi Shia Houthis that began in northern Yemen and has since escalated into a full-scale civil war. The conflict was sparked in 2004 by the government's attempt to arrest Hussein al-Houthi, a Zaidi religious leader of the Houthis and a former parliamentarian on whose head the government had placed a $55,000 bounty.

Initially, most of the fighting took place in Saada Governorate in northwestern Yemen, but some of the fighting spread to neighbouring governorates Hajjah, 'Amran, al-Jawf and the Saudi province of Jizan. After the Houthi takeover of the capital city Sanaa in late 2014, the insurgency became a full-blown civil war with a major Saudi-led intervention in Yemen beginning in March 2015.

Hutijski prevzem oblasti v Jemnu, ki ga Hutiji imenujejo revolucija 21. septembra, nasprotniki pa jemenski državni udar v letih 2014–2015, je bila ljudska revolucija proti jemenskemu predsedniku Abdrabuhu Mansurju Hadiju pod vodstvom Hutijev in njihovih privržencev, ki je vlado odrinila z oblasti. Izvirala je iz protestov pod vodstvom Hutijev, ki so se začeli mesec prej, zaostrila pa se je, ko so Hutiji 21. septembra 2014 vdrli v prestolnico Sano. Sledil je odstop predsednika vlade Mohameda Basindve, nato pa 22. januarja 2015, ko so hutijske sile zavzele predsedniško palačo, rezidenco in ključne vojaške objekte, še odstop predsednika Abdrabuha Mansurja Hadija in njegovih ministrov; 6. februarja 2015 so hutijski borci ustanovili vladajoči svet.

source.title: Houthi takeover of Yemen
paragraphs: The Houthi takeover in Yemen, also known by the Houthis as the September 21 Revolution, or 2014–15 Yemeni coup d'état (by opponents), was a popular revolution against Yemeni President Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi led by the Houthis and their supporters that pushed the Yemeni government from power. It had origins in Houthi-led protests that began the previous month, and escalated when the Houthis stormed the Yemeni capital Sanaa on 21 September 2014, causing the resignation of Prime Minister Mohammed Basindawa, and later the resignation of President Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi and his ministers on 22 January 2015 after Houthi forces seized the presidential palace, residence, and key military installations, and the formation of a ruling council by Houthi militants on 6 February 2015.

Iberska unija ali hispanska monarhija označuje obdobje od leta 1580 do 1640, ko je španska monarhija pod habsburško dinastijo, tedaj personalna unija kron Kastilje in Aragona, v personalno unijo pritegnila še Kraljevino Portugalsko. Pod španskimi habsburškimi vladarji Filipom II., Filipom III. in Filipom IV. je obsegala ves Iberski polotok razen Andore in francoskega ozemlja ter portugalske in španske čezmorske posesti. Unija se je začela po portugalski nasledstveni krizi leta 1580 in vojni za portugalsko nasledstvo, ki je sledila, trajala pa je do portugalske restavracijske vojne, v kateri je z razglasitvijo Ivana IV. za novega portugalskega kralja na oblast prišla nova vladajoča dinastija, rodbina Braganza.

source.title: Iberian Union
paragraphs: The Iberian Union, or the Hispanic Monarchy, describes the period from 1580 to 1640 in which the Monarchy of Spain under the Habsburg dynasty, then the personal union of the crowns of Castile and Aragon, brought in personal union also the Kingdom of Portugal. It incorporated the entire Iberian Peninsula, except Andorra and French territory, as well as Portuguese and Spanish overseas possessions, under the Spanish Habsburg monarchs Philip II, Philip III, and Philip IV. The union began after the Portuguese succession crisis of 1580 and the ensuing War of the Portuguese Succession, and lasted until the Portuguese Restoration War, during which the House of Braganza was established as Portugal's new ruling dynasty with the acclamation of John IV as the new king of Portugal.

Ife Empire.headline: Imperij Ife
paragraphs: Imperij Ife je bil prvi imperij v jorubski zgodovini. Nastal je na ozemlju današnje jugozahodne Nigerije in vzhodnega Benina. Klasično obdobje od leta 1000 do 1420 n. št. je bilo doba njegovih najbolj znanih prefinjenih umetnin.

Čeprav je bila glavni jezik imperija jorubščina, so govorili tudi različna narečja in jezike. Moč si je pridobil s trgovino s sahelskimi in gozdnimi državami. Njegova prestolnica Ilé-Ife je bila eno največjih mestnih središč zahodne Afrike v 14. stoletju.
notes: The English source breaks one sentence across its two paragraphs; the Slovenian moves the break to the sentence boundary.

source.title: Ife Empire
paragraphs: The Ife Empire was the first empire in Yoruba history. It was founded in what is now southwestern Nigeria and eastern Benin. A classical period starting from 1000 to 1420 CE, marked the

age of its most well known sophisticated art pieces. Although Yoruba was the main language of the empire, there were also various spoken dialects and languages. It rose to power through trade with Sahelian and forest states. Its capital city, Ilé-Ife, was one of the largest urban centers in 14th century West Africa.

Ifnijska vojna, ki jo v Španiji včasih imenujejo pozabljena vojna (la Guerra Olvidada), je bila vrsta oboroženih vpadov maroških upornikov v Špansko Zahodno Afriko, ki so se začeli novembra 1957 in dosegli vrhunec s spodletelim obleganjem Sidi Ifnija.

source.title: Ifni War
paragraphs: The Ifni War, sometimes called the Forgotten War (la Guerra Olvidada) in Spain, was a series of armed incursions into Spanish West Africa by Moroccan insurgents that began in November 1957 and culminated with the abortive siege of Sidi Ifni.

Jemenski imami, pozneje tudi jemenski kralji, so bili verski voditelji (imami) zajdijske veje šiitskega islama. Od leta 897 so v delih Jemna vzpostavili preplet verske in posvetne politične oblasti. Njihov imamat se je v spreminjajočih se okoliščinah ohranil do konca severnojemenske državljanske vojne leta 1970, ki je sledila republikanski revoluciji leta 1962. Zajdijska teologija se od ismailizma in dvanajstniškega šiizma razlikuje po tem, da poudarja navzočnost dejavnega in vidnega imama kot voditelja. Od imama so pričakovali, da je podkovan v verskih vedah in se izkaže kot vreden voditelj skupnosti, če je bilo treba, tudi v boju. Kdor se je potegoval za imamat, je razglasil »poziv« (dava), in ni bilo redko, da je bilo kandidatov več.

source.title: Imams of Yemen
paragraphs: The Imams of Yemen, later also titled the Kings of Yemen, were religiously consecrated leaders (imams) belonging to the Zaydi branch of Shia Islam. They established a blend of religious and temporal-political rule in parts of Yemen from 897. Their imamate endured under varying circumstances until the end of the North Yemen civil war in 1970, following the republican revolution in 1962. Zaydi theology differs from Isma'ilism and Twelver Shi'ism by stressing the presence of an active and visible imam as leader. The imam was expected to be knowledgeable in religious scholarship, and to prove himself a worthy headman of the community, even in battle if this was necessary. A claimant of the imamate would proclaim a "call" (dawah), and there were not infrequently more than one claimant.

Indoskiti, znani tudi kot Indosaki, so bili nomadsko ljudstvo iranskega skitskega izvora, ki se je iz Srednje Azije preselilo proti jugu na območje današnjega Afganistana, vzhodnega Irana in severozahodne indijske podceline (današnji Pakistan in severna Indija). Selitve so trajale od sredine 2. stoletja pr. n. št. do 4. stoletja n. št.

source.title: Indo-Scythian Kingdom
paragraphs: The Indo-Scythians, also known as Indo-Sakas, were a group of nomadic people of Iranic Scythian origin who migrated from Central Asia southward into the present-day regions of Afghanistan, eastern Iran and the northwestern Indian subcontinent (present-day Pakistan and northern India). The migrations persisted from the middle of the second century BCE to the fourth century CE.

Injuids.headline: Indžuidi
paragraphs: Indžuidi (perzijsko: اینجویان), tudi Indžu ali rodbina Indžu, so bili iranska dinastija perzijskega izvora, ki je v 14. stoletju zavladala mestoma Širaz in Isfahan. Po razpadu Ilkanata so njeni člani postali dejansko neodvisni vladarji, dokler jih leta 1357 niso porazili Muzafaridi.

source.title: Injuids
paragraphs: The Injuids (Persian: اینجویان), also Injus or House of Inju, were an Iranian dynasty of Persian origin that came to rule over the cities of Shiraz and Isfahan during the 14th century. Its members became de facto independent rulers following the breakup of the Ilkhanate until their defeat in 1357 against the Muzaffarids.

Invazija na Alžir je bila obsežna vojaška operacija, s katero je Kraljevina Francija pod kraljem Karlom X. vdrla v Alžirsko regentstvo in ga osvojila. Diplomatski incident leta 1827, tako imenovana »afera s pahljačo« (»incident z muholovko«), je bil pretveza za začetek blokade alžirskega pristanišča. Po treh letih zastoja in hujšem incidentu, ko so streljali na francosko ladjo, ki je k deju vozila poslanika s predlogom za pogajanja, so Francozi sklenili, da so potrebni odločnejši ukrepi. Karel X. je hotel tudi odvrniti pozornost od burnih notranjih razmer v Franciji, ki so se končale z njegovo odstavitvijo v julijski revoluciji, ko je bila invazija že v poznejši fazi.

source.title: Invasion of Algiers (1830)
paragraphs: The invasion of Algiers was a large-scale military operation by which the Kingdom of France, ruled by King Charles X, invaded and conquered the Regency of Algiers. A diplomatic incident in 1827, the so-called 'Fan Affair' ('Fly Whisk Incident'), served as a pretext to initiate a blockade against the port of Algiers. After three years of standstill and a more severe incident in which a French ship carrying an ambassador to the dey with a proposal for negotiations was fired upon, the French determined that more forceful action was required. Charles X also sought to divert attention from turbulent French domestic affairs which culminated with his deposition during the later stages of the invasion in the July Revolution.

Invasion of Buhran.headline: Pohod na Buhran
paragraphs: Pohod na Buhran je potekal leta 3 po hidžri islamskega koledarja, v 4. ali 5. mesecu. Muslimani so dobili poročilo, da mogočna vojska plemena Banu Sulajm iz Buhrana napreduje proti Medini. Islamski prerok Mohamed je s 300 možmi krenil v Hidžaz do Buhrana, kjer so Banu Sulajm v paniki pobegnili.
Med pohodom niso naleteli na sovražnika in do boja ni prišlo. Muslimanski učenjak Saifur Rahman al Mubarakpuri pohod šteje za »patruljni pohod«.
Dogodek omenjata Ibn Hišamov Mohamedov življenjepis in sodobni islamski viri, kot je Ar-Raheeq Al-Makhtum (Zapečateni nektar) Saifurja Rahmana al Mubarakpurija.

source.title: Invasion of Buhran
paragraphs: The Invasion of Buhran occurred in 3 A.H of the Islamic calendar of the 4th or 5th month. A report had arrived to the Muslims that a formidable force of the Banu Sulaym from Buhran were advancing on Madinah. The Islamic prophet Muhammad, took 300 men, to Hijaz reaching to Buhran, where the Banu Sulaym fled in panic.
Throughout the expedition, they did not meet any enemies, and no fighting took place. The expedition is regarded as a "patrolling invasion", according to Muslim scholar Saifur Rahman al-Mubarakpuri.
This event is mentioned in Ibn Hisham's biography of Muhammad and modern Islamic sources such as Ar-Raheeq Al-Makhtum by Saifur Rahman Al-Mubarakpuri.

Jonska vstaja in z njo povezani upori v Eolidi, Doridi, na Cipru in v Kariji so bili vojaški upori več grških pokrajin Male Azije proti perzijski oblasti, ki so trajali od leta 499 do 493 pr. n. št. V osrčju upora sta bila nezadovoljstvo grških mest Male Azije s tirani, ki jih je postavila Perzija, in dejanja dveh miletskih tiranov, Histiaja in Aristagore. Perzija je jonska mesta osvojila okoli leta 540 pr. n. št., nato pa so jim vladali domači tirani, ki jih je imenoval perzijski satrap v Sardu. Leta 499 pr. n. št. je miletski tiran Aristagora skupaj s perzijskim satrapom Artafernom sprožil pohod za osvojitev Naksosa, da bi utrdil svoj položaj. Pohod se je klavrno končal in Aristagora, ki je čutil, da ga bodo kmalu odstavili, se je odločil, da vso Jonijo spodbudi k uporu proti perzijskemu kralju Dareju Velikemu.

source.title: Ionian Revolt
paragraphs: The Ionian Revolt, and associated revolts in Aeolis, Doris, Cyprus and Caria, were military rebellions by several Greek regions of Asia Minor against Persian rule, lasting from 499 BC to 493 BC. At the heart of the rebellion was the dissatisfaction of the Greek cities of Asia Minor with the tyrants appointed by Persia to rule them, along with the individual actions of two Milesian tyrants, Histiaeus and Aristagoras. The cities of Ionia had been conquered by Persia around 540 BC, and thereafter were ruled by native tyrants, nominated by the Persian satrap in Sardis. In 499 BC, the tyrant of Miletus, Aristagoras, launched a joint expedition with the Persian satrap Artaphernes to conquer Naxos, in an attempt to bolster his position. The mission was a debacle, and sensing his imminent removal as tyrant, Aristagoras chose to incite the whole of Ionia into rebellion against the Persian king Darius the Great.

Iranska revolucija, znana tudi kot islamska revolucija, se je leta 1979 končala s strmoglavljenjem dinastije Pahlavijev. Cesarsko državo Iran je nadomestila Islamska republika Iran: monarhično vlado šaha Mohameda Reze Pahlavija je zamenjal islamistični klerik Ruholah Homeini, ki je vodil eno od uporniških frakcij in postal vrhovni voditelj države. Odstavitev Mohameda Reze Pahlavija, zadnjega iranskega šaha, je formalno končala zgodovinsko iransko monarhijo.

Leta 1953 je iranski državni udar, ki sta ga podprli Cia in MI6, strmoglavil iranskega predsednika vlade Mohameda Mosadeka, ki je nacionaliziral Anglo-perzijsko naftno družbo. Udar je Mohamedu Rezi Pahlaviju vrnil položaj absolutnega monarha in močno okrepil vpliv Združenih držav v Iranu.

source.title: Iranian Revolution
paragraphs: The Iranian Revolution, also known as the Islamic Revolution, culminated in the overthrow of the Pahlavi dynasty in 1979. The revolution led to the replacement of the Imperial State of Iran by the Islamic Republic of Iran, as the monarchical government of Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi was superseded by Ruhollah Khomeini, an Islamist cleric who had headed one of the rebel factions, and became the country’s supreme leader.The ousting of Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, the last Shah of Iran, formally marked the end of Iran's historical monarchy.

In 1953, the CIA and MI6-backed 1953 Iranian coup d'état overthrew Iran's prime minister, Mohammad Mossadegh, who had nationalized the Anglo-Persian Oil Company. The coup reinstated Mohammad Reza Pahlavi as an absolute monarch and significantly increased the level of influence of the United States over Iran.

Iraški konflikt je vrsta nasilnih dogodkov, ki so se začeli z invazijo na Irak pod ameriškim vodstvom leta 2003 in odstavitvijo iraškega diktatorja Sadama Huseina, sledila pa jim je vrsta spopadov, med njimi dolgotrajna iraška vojna (2003–2011), iraška vstaja (2011–2013), vojna v Iraku (2013–2017) in nazadnje uporništvo Islamske države majhnega obsega v 4 provincah severnega Iraka od leta 2017.

source.title: Iraqi conflict
paragraphs: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.

Iraško uporništvo je trajalo od leta 2003 do 2011: začelo se je kmalu po tem, ko je ameriška invazija leta 2003 odstavila dolgoletnega voditelja Sadama Huseina, in trajalo do konca iraške vojne in ameriškega umika leta 2011. Sledila mu je nova vstaja.

Prvi izbruh nasilja (faza 2003–2006) je sprožil padec režima, potekal pa je pred tem, ko so večnacionalne sile v Iraku (MNF–I) pod vodstvom ZDA vzpostavile novo iraško vlado. Približno od leta 2004 do maja 2007 so iraški uporniki napadali predvsem vojake MNF-I, pozneje pa tudi povojne iraške varnostne sile.
