paragraphs: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.

M23 rebellion (2012–2013).headline: Upor M23 (2012–2013)
paragraphs: Prvi upor M23 je bil oborožen spopad v Severnem Kivuju v Demokratični republiki Kongo, ki je od 4. aprila 2012 do 7. novembra 2013 potekal med uporniško skupino Gibanje 23. marec (M23) in kongovskimi vladnimi silami. Končal se je, ko je enajst afriških držav sklenilo mirovni sporazum, enote M23 pa so se predale v Ugandi. Upor je bil del nadaljevanja bojev v regiji po formalnem koncu druge kongovske vojne leta 2003. Spopad se je znova vnel konec leta 2021, ko je vodja upornikov M23 Sultani Makenga s 100 uporniki neuspešno napadel obmejno mesto Bunagana. Nekaj mesecev pozneje so uporniki M23 uradno obnovili ofenzivne operacije in hitro razširili nadzor na obsežna območja Severnega Kivuja.

source.title: M23 rebellion (2012–2013)
paragraphs: The First M23 rebellion was an armed conflict in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, that occurred between the March 23 Movement (M23) rebel group and Congolese government forces between 4 April 2012 and 7 November 2013. It ended when a peace agreement was made among eleven African nations, and the M23 troops surrendered in Uganda. The rebellion was part of continued fighting in the region after the formal end of the Second Congo War in 2003. The conflict reignited in late 2021 after M23 rebel leader Sultani Makenga and 100 rebel fighters attacked the border town of Bunagana but failed. A few months later, M23 rebels officially restarted offensive operations, rapidly expanding their control over vast regions of North Kivu.

Makabejska vstaja (hebrejsko: מֶרֶד הַמַּכַּבִּים) ali hasmonejski upor je bil judovski upor pod vodstvom Makabejcev proti Selevkidskemu imperiju in helenističnemu vplivu na judovsko življenje. Glavna faza upora je trajala od leta 167 do 160 pr. n. št. in se končala tako, da so Selevkidi obdržali nadzor nad Judejo, spor med makabejskimi Judi, heleniziranimi Judi in Selevkidi pa se je nadaljeval do leta 134 pr. n. št., ko so Makabejci nazadnje dosegli neodvisnost.

source.title: Maccabean Revolt
paragraphs: The Maccabean Revolt (Hebrew: מֶרֶד הַמַּכַּבִּים) or the Hasmonean revolt (מֶרֶד הַחַשְׁמוֹנָאִים) was a Jewish rebellion led by the Maccabees against the Seleucid Empire and against Hellenistic influence on Jewish life. The main phase of the revolt lasted from 167 to 160 BCE and ended with the Seleucids in control of Judea, but conflict between the Maccabeean Jews, Hellenized Jews, and the Seleucids continued until 134 BCE, with the Maccabees eventually attaining independence.

Mahdids.headline: Mahdidi
paragraphs: Mahdidi (arabsko: Banī Mahdī) so bili dinastija v Jemnu, ki je bila za kratek čas na oblasti med letoma 1159 in 1174.

source.title: Mahdids
paragraphs: The Mahdids (Arabic: بني مهدي, romanized: Banī Mahdī) were a dynasty in Yemen who briefly held power in the period between 1159 and 1174.

Mahdistična država, znana tudi kot mahdistični Sudan ali sudanska mahdija, je bila država, ki je temeljila na verskem in političnem gibanju, ki ga je leta 1881 sprožil Mohamed Ahmed (pozneje Mohamed al Mahdi) proti Egiptovskemu kedivatu, ki je Sudanu vladal od leta 1821. Po štirih letih boja so mahdistični uporniki strmoglavili osmansko-egiptovsko upravo in ustanovili svojo »islamsko in narodno« vlado s prestolnico v Omdurmanu. Mahdistična vlada je tako od leta 1885 ohranjala suverenost in nadzor nad sudanskimi ozemlji, dokler je leta 1898 niso odpravile angleško-egiptovske sile.

source.title: Mahdist State
paragraphs: The Mahdist State, also known as Mahdist Sudan or the Sudanese Mahdiyya, was a state based on a religious and political movement launched in 1881 by Muhammad Ahmad (later Muhammad al-Mahdi) against the Khedivate of Egypt, which had ruled Sudan since 1821. After four years of struggle, the Mahdist rebels overthrew the Ottoman-Egyptian administration and established their own "Islamic and national" government with its capital in Omdurman. Thus, from 1885 the Mahdist government maintained sovereignty and control over the Sudanese territories until its existence was terminated by Anglo-Egyptian forces in 1898.

Mahdistična vojna (arabsko: الثورة المهدية; 1881–1899) je potekala med sudanskimi mahdisti, ki jih je vodil Mohamed Ahmed bin Abdulah, samooklicani islamski »mahdi« (»vodeni«), ter sprva silami Egiptovskega kedivata, pozneje pa britanskimi silami. Po štirih letih so mahdistični uporniki s padcem Kartuma strmoglavili osmansko-egiptovsko upravo in prevzeli nadzor nad Sudanom. Mahdistična država je večkrat neuspešno vdrla k sosedom, s čimer se je spopad razširil še na Italijansko cesarstvo, Svobodno državo Kongo in Etiopsko cesarstvo. Spoprijeti se je morala tudi z velikim notranjim uporom in hudo lakoto.

Angleško-egiptovske sile so Sudan znova osvojile leta 1898, mahdistična država pa je po porazu v bitki za Omdurman razpadla. Zadnji organizirani odpor mahdistov je prenehal naslednje leto, nato pa je nastal Angleško-egiptovski Sudan (1899–1956), de iure kondominij Britanskega imperija in Kraljevine Egipt, v katerem je imela dejanski nadzor nad Sudanom Britanija.
notes: The romanization of the Arabic name is dropped.

source.title: Mahdist War
paragraphs: The Mahdist War (Arabic: الثورة المهدية, romanized: ath-Thawra al-Mahdiyya; 1881–1899) was fought between the Mahdist Sudanese, led by Muhammad Ahmad bin Abdullah, who had proclaimed himself the "Mahdi" of Islam (the "Guided One"), and the forces of the Khedivate of Egypt, initially, and later the forces of Britain. After four years, the Mahdist rebels overthrew the Ottoman-Egyptian administration with the fall of Khartoum and gained control over Sudan. The Mahdist State launched several unsuccessful invasions of their neighbours, expanding the scale of the conflict to also include the Italian Empire, the Congo Free State and the Ethiopian Empire. They also faced significant internal rebellion, and a major famine.

Anglo-Egyptian forces reconquered Sudan in 1898 and the Mahdist state collapsed following defeat at the battle of Omdurman. The last organised resistance from the Mahdists ended the next year, leading to the creation of Anglo-Egyptian Sudan (1899–1956), a de jure condominium of the British Empire and the Kingdom of Egypt, in which Britain had de facto control over Sudan.

Mahsa Amini protests.headline: Protesti po smrti Mahse Amini
paragraphs: Državljanski nemiri in protesti proti vladi Islamske republike Iran, povezani s smrtjo Mahse Amini (perzijsko: مهسا امینی) v policijskem priporu, so se začeli 16. septembra 2022 in nadaljevali v leto 2023, do pomladi 2023 pa so večinoma potihnili, politično vodstvo pa je ostalo nespremenjeno in trdno na oblasti. Proteste so opisovali kot »drugačne od vseh, kar jih je država kdaj videla«, kot »največji izziv« vladi in kot »najbolj razširjen upor« od islamske revolucije leta 1979.

source.title: Mahsa Amini protests
paragraphs: Civil unrest and protests against the government of the Islamic Republic of Iran associated with the death in police custody of Mahsa Amini (Persian: مهسا امینی) began on 16 September 2022 and carried on into 2023, but by spring 2023, the protests had largely subsided, ultimately leaving the political leadership unchanged and firmly entrenched in power. The protests were described as "unlike any the country had seen before", the "biggest challenge" to the government, and "most widespread revolt" since the Islamic Revolution in 1979.

Majeerteen Sultanate.headline: Madžertinski sultanat
paragraphs: Madžertinski sultanat (somalsko: Suldanadda Majeerteen, dobesedno »Boqortooyada Majerteen«; arabsko: سلطنة مجرتين) ali Madžertinsko kraljestvo, znano tudi kot Majeerteenia in Migiurtinia, je bilo somalsko kraljestvo na Afriškem rogu. V zlati dobi mu je vladal Osman Mahmud, sultanat pa je nadzoroval območja, ki ustrezajo današnjemu Puntlandu. Kraljestvo se prvič omenja konec 15. ali v 16. stoletju. Država je imela vse organe celovite sodobne države in vzdrževala močno trgovsko mrežo. S tujimi silami je sklepala pogodbe in v notranjih zadevah izvajala močno centralizirano oblast. 7. aprila 1889 je s pogodbo postala italijanski protektorat. Po kampanji proti sultanatom, skoraj leto dni trajajoči vojni, so jo nazadnje vključili v kolonijo Italijanska Somalija.
Avtonomna država Puntland na severovzhodu Somalije, ustanovljena leta 1998, danes upravlja velik del nekdanjih ozemelj Madžertinskega sultanata.

source.title: Majeerteen Sultanate
paragraphs: The Majeerteen Sultanate (Somali: Suldanadda Majeerteen, lit. 'Boqortooyada Majerteen', Arabic: سلطنة مجرتين), or Majerteen Kingdom also known as Majeerteenia and/or Migiurtinia, was a Somali kingdom centered in the Horn of Africa. Ruled by Osman Mohamoud during its golden age, the sultanate controlled the areas corresponding to modern-day Puntland. The earliest mention of the kingdom is the late 15th or 16th century. The polity had all of the organs of an integrated modern state and maintained a robust trading network. It also entered into treaties with foreign powers and exerted strong centralized authority on domestic affairs. On April 7, 1889, it became a protectorate of Italy after a treaty. After the Campaign of the Sultanates, a nearly year war, it was eventually integrated into the colony of Italian Somaliland.
Established in 1998, the autonomous Puntland state within northeastern Somalia now administers much of the former territories of the Majeerteen Sultanate (Majeerteenia).

Maji Maji Rebellion.headline: Upor Maji Maji
paragraphs: Upor Maji Maji (nemško: Maji-Maji-Aufstand, svahilsko: Vita vya Maji Maji) je bil oborožen upor Afričanov proti nemški kolonialni oblasti v Nemški Vzhodni Afriki (današnji Tanzaniji). Vojno je sprožila nemška kolonialna politika, ki je domače prebivalstvo silila v pridelovanje bombaža za izvoz. Trajala je od leta 1905 do 1907, umrlo pa je od 75.000 do 300.000 ljudi, daleč največ zaradi lakote. Vojni je sledilo obdobje lakote, znano kot veliki glad (ukame), ki ga je v veliki meri povzročila politika požgane zemlje, s katero je guverner Gustav Adolf von Götzen zatrl upor. Znanstveniki so to taktiko označili za genocidno. Iz imena upora morda izhaja izraz »Mau Mau« za upor v Keniji pet desetletij pozneje.

source.title: Maji Maji Rebellion
paragraphs: The Maji Maji Rebellion (German: Maji-Maji-Aufstand, Swahili: Vita vya Maji Maji) was an armed rebellion of Africans against German colonial rule in German East Africa (modern-day Tanzania). The war was triggered by German colonial policies designed to force the indigenous population to grow cotton for export. The war lasted from 1905 to 1907, during which 75,000 to 300,000 died, overwhelmingly from famine. The end of the war was followed by a period of famine, known as the Great Hunger (ukame), caused in large part by the scorched-earth policies used by governor Gustav Adolf von Götzen to suppress the rebellion. These tactics have been described by scholars as genocidal. The name may have been the origin of the term for the 'Mau Mau rebellion' in Kenya five decades later.

Makurija (staronubijsko: ⲇⲱⲧⲁⲩⲟ, Dotawo; grško: Μακουρία, Makouria; arabsko: المقرة, al-Muqurra) je bila srednjeveško nubijsko kraljestvo na ozemlju današnjega severnega Sudana in južnega Egipta. Prestolnica je bila Dongola (staronubijsko: ⲧⲟⲩⲅⲅⲟⲩⲗ, Touggoul) v rodovitnem dongolskem odseku Nila, približno na polovici poti med 3. in 4. nilskim kataraktom.

Nastala je po propadu Kraljestva Kuš v 4. stoletju in je sprva obsegala dolino Nila od 3. katarakta do nekje južno od Abu Hameda pri otoku Mograt. Prestolnico Dongolo so ustanovili okoli leta 500 in kmalu nato, sredi 6. stoletja, je Makurija sprejela krščanstvo. Verjetno v začetku 7. stoletja si je Makurija priključila severno sosedo Nobatijo in tako začela mejiti na bizantinski Egipt.

source.title: Makuria
paragraphs: Makuria (Old Nubian: ⲇⲱⲧⲁⲩⲟ, Dotawo; Greek: Μακουρία, romanized: Makouria; Arabic: المقرة, romanized: al-Muqurra) was a medieval Nubian kingdom in what is today northern Sudan and southern Egypt. Its capital was Dongola (Old Nubian: ⲧⲟⲩⲅⲅⲟⲩⲗ, Touggoul) in the fertile Dongola Reach, about halfway between the 3rd and 4th Nile cataract.

Coming into being after the collapse of the Kingdom of Kush in the 4th century, it originally covered the Nile Valley from the 3rd cataract to somewhere south of Abu Hamed at Mograt Island. The capital of Dongola was founded around 500 and soon after, in the mid-6th century, Makuria converted to Christianity. Probably in the early 7th century Makuria annexed its northern neighbour Nobatia, now sharing a border with Byzantine Egypt.

Malgaška vstaja (francosko: Insurrection malgache; malgaško: Tolom-bahoaka tamin' ny 1947) je bila malgaška nacionalistična vstaja proti francoski kolonialni oblasti na Madagaskarju, ki je trajala od marca 1947 do februarja 1949. Od konca leta 1945 so si prvi madagaskarski poslanci v francoski narodni skupščini Joseph Raseta, Joseph Ravoahangy in Jacques Rabemananjara iz stranke Mouvement démocratique de la rénovation malgache (MDRM) prizadevali doseči neodvisnost Madagaskarja po zakoniti poti. Neuspeh te pobude in ostri odziv socialistične Ramadierove vlade sta radikalizirala dele malgaškega prebivalstva, med njimi voditelje več bojevitih nacionalističnih tajnih društev.

source.title: Malagasy Uprising
paragraphs: The Malagasy Uprising (French: Insurrection malgache; Malagasy: Tolom-bahoaka tamin' ny 1947) was a Malagasy nationalist rebellion against French colonial rule in Madagascar, lasting from March 1947 to February 1949. Starting in late 1945, Madagascar's first French National Assembly deputies, Joseph Raseta, Joseph Ravoahangy, and Jacques Rabemananjara of the Mouvement démocratique de la rénovation malgache (MDRM) political party, led an effort to achieve independence for Madagascar through legal channels. The failure of this initiative and the harsh response it drew from the Socialist Ramadier administration radicalized elements of the Malagasy population, including leaders of several militant nationalist secret societies.

Malijska federacija (arabsko: اتحاد مالي) je bila federacija v zahodni Afriki, ki je leta 1960 za dva meseca povezovala francoski koloniji Senegal in Sudansko republiko (imenovano tudi Francoski Sudan). Ustanovili so jo 4. aprila 1959 kot samoupravno ozemlje v okviru Francoske skupnosti, po pogajanjih s Francijo pa je 20. junija 1960 postala neodvisna. Dva meseca po osamosvojitvi, 19. avgusta 1960, so voditelji Sudanske republike v federaciji skušali z mobilizacijo vojske prevzeti nadzor, senegalski voditelji v federaciji pa so odgovorili z mobilizacijo žandarmerije (narodne policije); nastalo je napeto stanje in Senegal je naslednji dan izstopil iz federacije. Uradniki Sudanske republike so se razpustitvi federacije upirali, prekinili diplomatske odnose s Senegalom in kljubovalno preimenovali svojo državo v Republiko Mali. Med kratkim obstojem Malijske federacije je bil Modibo Keïta, poznejši prvi predsednik Malija, predsednik vlade federacije, vlada pa je imela sedež v Dakarju, poznejši prestolnici Senegala.

source.title: Mali Federation
paragraphs: The Mali Federation (Arabic: اتحاد مالي) was a federation in West Africa that linked the French colonies of Senegal and the Sudanese Republic (also called French Sudan) for two months in 1960. It was founded on 4 April 1959 as a territory with self-rule within the French Community, and became independent after negotiations with France on 20 June 1960. Two months after independence, on 19 August 1960, Sudanese Republic leaders in the federation tried to take control by mobilizing the army, and Senegalese leaders in the federation retaliated by mobilizing the gendarmerie (national police); this resulted in a tense standoff, and Senegal withdrew from the federation the next day. Sudanese Republic officials resisted the dissolution of the federation, cut off diplomatic relations with Senegal, and defiantly changed the name of their country to the Republic of Mali. During the brief existence of the Mali Federation, Modibo Keïta, who later became the first president of Mali, served as federation premier, and the government was based in Dakar, the eventual capital of Senegal.

Malijska vojna je še trajajoč spopad, ki se je začel 16. januarja 2012 s tuareškim uporom na severu Malija. Med uporniki je bilo posvetno usmerjeno Narodno gibanje za osvoboditev Azavada (MNLA), skupina, ki se je bojevala za neodvisnost ali večjo avtonomijo regije, ki so jo imenovali Azavad. MNLA se je sprva povezalo z džihadistično skupino Ansar Dine, ki je bila zaveznica drugih salafističnih džihadističnih organizacij, kot sta Al Kaida v islamskem Magrebu (AQIM) in njena odcepljena skupina Gibanje za enotnost in džihad v Zahodni Afriki (MOJWA).

source.title: Mali War
paragraphs: The Mali War is an ongoing conflict that began on 16 January 2012 with a Tuareg rebellion in northern Mali. The rebels included the secular-oriented National Movement for the Liberation of Azawad (MNLA), a group fighting for independence or greater autonomy of a region they called Azawad. The MNLA was initially allied with the jihadist Ansar Dine, which, in turn, was allied to other Salafi jihadist organizations such as al-Qaeda in the Islamic Maghreb (AQIM) and its splinter, Movement for Oneness and Jihad in West Africa (MOJWA).

Mandat za Sirijo in Libanon (francosko: Mandat pour la Syrie et le Liban; arabsko: al-intidāb al-faransī ʻalā sūriyā wa-lubnān), imenovan tudi levantske države (1923–1946), je bil mandat Društva narodov, ustanovljen po prvi svetovni vojni in razdelitvi Osmanskega cesarstva za ozemlji Sirije in Libanona. Mandatni sistem naj bi se razlikoval od kolonializma: upravljavska država naj bi delovala kot skrbnica, dokler prebivalci ne bi bili sposobni samouprave. Tedaj bi se mandat končal in rodila bi se suverena država.

source.title: Mandate for Syria and the Lebanon
paragraphs: The Mandate for Syria and the Lebanon (French: Mandat pour la Syrie et le Liban; Arabic: الانتداب الفرنسي على سوريا ولبنان, romanized: al-intidāb al-faransī ʻalā sūriyā wa-lubnān, also referred to as the Levant States; 1923−1946) was a League of Nations mandate founded in the aftermath of the First World War and the partitioning of the Ottoman Empire concerning the territories of Syria and Lebanon. The mandate system was supposed to differ from colonialism, with the governing country intended to act as a trustee until the inhabitants were considered eligible for self-government. At that point, the mandate would terminate, and a sovereign state would be born.

Protokol k Afriški listini o človekovih pravicah in pravicah ljudstev o pravicah žensk v Afriki, bolj znan kot Maputski protokol, je mednarodni instrument človekovih pravic, ki ga je oblikovala Afriška unija in je začel veljati leta 2005. Ženskam zagotavlja celovite pravice, med njimi pravico do sodelovanja v političnem procesu, do družbene in politične enakosti z moškimi, večjo samostojnost pri odločitvah o reproduktivnem zdravju in odpravo pohabljanja ženskih spolovil. Afriška unija ga je sprejela leta 2003 v Maputu v Mozambiku kot protokol k Afriški listini o človekovih pravicah in pravicah ljudstev (sprejeti leta 1981, veljavni od leta 1986).

source.title: Maputo Protocol
paragraphs: The Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa, better known as the Maputo Protocol, is an international human rights instrument established by the African Union that went into effect in 2005. It guarantees comprehensive rights to women including the right to take part in the political process, to social and political equality with men, improved autonomy in their reproductive health decisions, and an end to female genital mutilation. It was adopted by the African Union in Maputo, Mozambique, in 2003 in the form of a protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights (adopted in 1981, enacted in 1986).

Maritz rebellion.headline: Maritzov upor
paragraphs: Maritzov upor, znan tudi kot tretja burska vojna ali upor petih šilingov, je bil oborožen pronemški upor v Južni Afriki leta 1914, na začetku prve svetovne vojne. Vodili so ga Buri, ki so podpirali obnovitev Južnoafriške republike v Transvaalu. Tudi številni člani južnoafriške vlade so bili Buri, ki so se v drugi burski vojni, končani dvanajst let prej, skupaj z Maritzovimi uporniki bojevali proti Britancem. Upor je spodletel: od 12.000 upornikov jih je v bojih padlo najmanj 124, še 300 jih je umrlo med umikom v puščavo Kalahari, najmanj 229 pa je bilo ranjenih. Preživeli kolovodje so dobili visoke denarne in zaporne kazni. Enega od njih, Jopieja Fourieja, so usmrtili.

source.title: Maritz rebellion
paragraphs: The Maritz rebellion, also known as the Third Boer War, or the Five Shilling rebellion, was an armed pro-German insurrection in South Africa in 1914, at the start of World War I. It was led by Boers who supported the re-establishment of the South African Republic in the Transvaal. Many members of the South African government were themselves Boers who had fought with the Maritz rebels against the British in the Second Boer War, which had ended twelve years earlier. The rebellion failed, with at least 124 out of 12,000 rebels killed in battle, another 300 dying during a retreat into the Kalahari Desert, and at least 229 wounded. The surviving ringleaders received heavy fines and prison terms. One of them, Jopie Fourie, was executed.

Marrakesh VIP Treaty.headline: Marakeška pogodba
paragraphs: Marakeška pogodba za slepe in slabovidne (uradno Marakeška pogodba o lažjem dostopu do objavljenih del za slepe, slabovidne ali osebe z drugimi motnjami branja, pogovorno Marakeška pogodba ali MVT) je pogodba o avtorski pravici, sprejeta 27. junija 2013 v Marakešu v Maroku. Do 30. junija 2016 so upravičene stranke deponirale 20 listin o ratifikaciji ali pristopu, potrebnih za začetek veljavnosti, in pogodba je začela veljati tri mesece pozneje, 30. septembra 2016. Od 14. aprila 2025 ima pogodba 101 pogodbenico, ki zajemajo 127 držav članic Svetovne organizacije za intelektualno lastnino (WIPO), saj je Evropska unija pristopila kot celota. Septembra 2026 je imela pogodba 105 pogodbenic.

source.title: Marrakesh VIP Treaty
paragraphs: The Marrakesh VIP Treaty (formally the Marrakesh Treaty to Facilitate Access to Published Works for Persons who are Blind, Visually Impaired or Otherwise Print Disabled, colloquially Marrakesh Treaty or MVT) is a treaty on copyright adopted in Marrakesh, Morocco, on 27 June 2013. It achieved the deposit of 20 instruments of ratification or accession by eligible parties needed for entry into force on June 30, 2016 and entered into force three months later, on September 30, 2016. As of April 14, 2025, the treaty has 101 contracting parties covering 127 WIPO Member States because the European Union joined as a block. As of September 2026, the treaty has 105 contracting parties.

Kalifat Hamdulahi je bil sunitski muslimanski kalifat v zahodni Afriki iz zgodnjega 19. stoletja s središčem v notranji delti Nigra, na območju današnjih regij Mopti in Ségou v Maliju. Ustanovil ga je Seku Amadu leta 1818 med fulanskimi džihadi, potem ko je v bitki pri Nukumi premagal Bambarski imperij in njegove zaveznike. Do leta 1853 je imperij zašel v zaton, nazadnje pa sta ga uničila Omar Saidu Tal iz Tukulerja in njegovi nasledniki.

Masinski imperij je bil ena najbolj urejenih teokratskih držav svojega časa na afriški celini, njegova prestolnica pa je bila Hamdulahi. Vladal mu je almami s pomočjo Velikega sveta, ki je imel pravico po smrti vladarja izvoliti novega. Čeprav almamiju teoretično ni bilo treba biti član družine Bari, temveč le učen in pobožen človek, je bil vsak izvoljeni almami sin prejšnjega vladarja.

source.title: Caliphate of Hamdullahi
paragraphs: The Caliphate of Hamdullahi was an early 19th-century Sunni Muslim caliphate in West Africa centered in the Inner Niger Delta of what is now the Mopti and Ségou Regions of Mali. It was founded by Seku Amadu in 1818 during the Fulani jihads after defeating the Bambara Empire and its allies at the Battle of Noukouma. By 1853, the empire had fallen into decline and was ultimately destroyed by Omar Saidou Tall of Toucouleur and his successors.

The Massina Empire was one of the most organized theocratic states of its time on the African continent and had its capital at Hamdullahi. It was ruled by an almami with the help of a Grand Council that possessed the power to elect new rulers after the death of the previous one. While, in theory, the almami did not have to be a member of the Bari family, but only someone who was learned and pious, every almami elected happened to be a son of the previous ruler.

Upor Mau Mau (1952–1960), znan tudi kot vstaja Mau Mau ali izredne razmere v Keniji, je bil oborožen spopad v britanski koloniji Kenija med Kenijsko vojsko za zemljo in svobodo (KLFA) in britanskimi kolonialnimi oblastmi. KLFA so sestavljali predvsem borci ljudstev Kikuju, Meru in Embu, gibanje pa so podpirale tudi enote Kambov in Masajev. Skupine, kot sta Luo in Kalendžin, ki so prej vodile pomembna odporniška gibanja proti kolonialni oblasti, denimo nandijski odpor (1890–1906), večinoma niso bile del jedra KLFA. Mnogi pripadniki teh skupnosti so namesto tega služili v Kraljevih afriških strelcih (KAR), kolonialni vojski, s katero so Britanci ohranjali notranjo varnost in zatrli vstajo. KLFA se je bojevala proti britanski vojski in krajevnemu Kenijskemu polku, v katerem so bili evropski naseljenci in afriški lojalisti.

source.title: Mau Mau rebellion
paragraphs: The Mau Mau rebellion (1952–1960), also known as the Mau Mau uprising or Kenya Emergency, was an armed conflict in the British Colony of Kenya between the Kenya Land and Freedom Army (KLFA) and the British colonial authorities. While the KLFA was primarily composed of Kikuyu, Meru, and Embu fighters, the movement also drew support from units of Kamba and Maasai. Groups such as the Luo and Kalenjin – who had led significant earlier resistance movements against colonial establishment, such as the Nandi Resistance (1890–1906) were largely not part of the KLFA's core structure. Instead, many from these communities served in the King's African Rifles (KAR), the colonial military force through which the British maintained internal security and quelled the uprising. The KLFA fought against the British Army and the local Kenya Regiment, which included European settlers and African loyalists.

May 17 Agreement.headline: Sporazum 17. maja
paragraphs: Sporazum 17. maja 1983 je bil sporazum, ki sta ga Libanon in Izrael podpisala 17. maja 1983, med libanonsko državljansko vojno, potem ko je Izrael leta 1982 vdrl v Libanon, da bi končal čezmejne napade, in oblegal Bejrut. Predvideval je umik izraelske vojske iz Bejruta in okvir za vzpostavitev normalnih dvostranskih odnosov med državama. Libanon je bil med pogajanji pod izraelsko in sirsko vojaško zasedbo.

source.title: May 17 Agreement
paragraphs: The May 17 Agreement of 1983 was an agreement signed between Lebanon and Israel during the Lebanese Civil War on May 17, 1983, after Israel invaded Lebanon to end cross border attacks and besieged Beirut in 1982. It called for the withdrawal of the Israeli Army from Beirut and provided a framework for the establishment of normal bilateral relations between the two countries. Lebanon was under both Israeli and Syrian military occupations during its negotiation.

Median dynasty.headline: Medijska dinastija
paragraphs: Medija (staroperzijsko: Māda; grško: Μηδία; akadsko: Mādāya) je bila politična tvorba s središčem v Ekbatani, ki je obstajala od 7. stoletja do sredine 6. stoletja pr. n. št. in je domnevno obvladovala velik del Iranske planote, pred mogočnim Ahemenidskim imperijem. Pogosto vmešavanje Asircev v pokrajino Zagros je spodbudilo združevanje medijskih plemen. Do leta 612 pr. n. št. so se Medijci dovolj okrepili, da so v zavezništvu z Babilonci strmoglavili propadajoče Asirsko cesarstvo. Sodobni raziskovalci pa dvomijo, da je enotno medijsko kraljestvo ali država obstajala vsaj večji del 7. stoletja pr. n. št.

Po starogrškem zgodovinarju Herodotu so medijsko dinastijo sestavljali štirje kralji, ki so medijskemu imperiju vladali 150 let. Če je Herodotova pripoved točna, je Medijce združil mož po imenu Dejok, prvi od štirih kraljev medijskega imperija, mogočne države, ki je obsegala velike dele Irana in vzhodne Anatolije.

source.title: Median dynasty
paragraphs: Media (Old Persian: 𐎶𐎠𐎭 Māda; Greek: Μηδία Mēdía; Akkadian: Mādāya) was a political entity centered in Ecbatana that existed from the 7th century BC until the mid-6th century BC and is believed to have dominated a significant portion of the Iranian plateau, preceding the powerful Achaemenid Empire. The frequent interference of the Assyrians in the Zagros region led to the process of unifying the Median tribes. By 612 BC, the Medes became strong enough to overthrow the declining Assyrian empire in alliance with the Babylonians. However, contemporary scholarship tends to be skeptical about the existence of a united Median kingdom or state, at least for most of the 7th century BCE.

The Median dynasty was, according to the ancient Greek historian Herodotus, a dynasty composed of four kings who ruled for 150 years under the Median Empire. If Herodotus' story is accurate, the Medes were unified by a man named Deioces, the first of the four kings who would rule the Median Empire; a mighty empire that included large parts of Iran and eastern Anatolia.

Medo-Persian conflict.headline: Medijsko-perzijski spopad
paragraphs: Medijsko-perzijski spopad je bil pohod medijskega kralja Astiaga proti Persidi sredi 6. stoletja pr. n. št. Klasični viri trdijo, da je bila Persida vazal medijskega kraljestva, ki se je uprl medijski oblasti, česar pa sodobni dokazi ne potrjujejo. Po nekaj bitkah so zmagali Perzijci pod vodstvom Kira Velikega, ki so nato osvojili medijska ozemlja in ustanovili Ahemenidski imperij.

Glavna vira o spopadu sta Zgodbe grškega zgodovinarja Herodota in dva klinopisna napisa babilonskega kralja Nabonida. Babilonska besedila kažejo, da sta bila odločilna bitka in zavzetje Ekbatane, prestolnice Medije, le vrhunec medijsko-perzijskih sovražnosti, ki so trajale najmanj tri leta (553–550 pr. n. št.).

source.title: Medo-Persian conflict
paragraphs: The Medo-Persian conflict was a campaign led by the Median king Astyages against Persis in the mid 6th-century BCE. Classical sources claim that Persis had been a vassal of the Median kingdom that revolted against Median rule, but this is not confirmed by contemporary evidence. After some battles the Persians led by Cyrus the Great emerged victorious, subsequently conquering Median territories and establishing the Achaemenid Empire.

The main sources on the conflict are the Histories of the Greek historian Herodotus and two cuneiform inscriptions of the Babylonian king Nabonidus. The Babylonian texts suggest that the decisive battle and the capture of Ecbatana, the capital of Media, were only the climax of the Medo-Persian hostilities that lasted for at least three years (553-550 BCE).

Menteshe.headline: Menteše
paragraphs: Menteše (osmansko turško: منتشه; turško: Menteşe) je bil prvi od turških anatolskih beglikov (kneževin), obmejnih kneževin, ki so jih po zatonu Rumskega sultanata Seldžukov ustanovili oguški Turki. Ustanovljen je bil leta 1260 ali 1290 in se je imenoval po ustanovitelju Menteše begu. Prestolnica je bila Milas (Mylasa) na jugozahodu Anatolije.

Osrčje beglika je približno ustrezalo antični Kariji oziroma zgodnjenovoveški provinci Muğla v Turčiji, skupaj s tremi polotoki te province. Med pomembnimi središči beglika so bila mesta Beçin, Milas, Balat, Elmalı, Finike, Kaş, Mağrı (današnji Fethiye), Muğla, Çameli, Acıpayam, Tavas, Bozdoğan in Çine. Mesto Aydın (nekdanje Trales) je beglik nekaj časa nadzoroval in tedaj se je imenovalo »Güzelhisar«; pozneje je prešlo k Ajdinidom na severu, ki so ga preimenovali po ustanovitelju svoje dinastije.

source.title: Menteshe
paragraphs: Menteshe (Ottoman Turkish: منتشه, Turkish: Menteşe) was the first of the Turkish Anatolian beyliks (principality), the frontier principalities established by the Oghuz Turks after the decline of the Seljuk Sultanate of Rum. Founded in 1260/1290, it was named for its founder, Menteshe Bey. Its capital city was Milas (Mylasa) in southwestern Anatolia.

The heartland of the beylik corresponded roughly to ancient Caria or to the early modern Muğla Province in Turkey, including the province's three protruding peninsulas. Among the important centers within the beylik were the cities of Beçin, Milas, Balat, Elmalı, Finike, Kaş, Mağrı (modern Fethiye), Muğla, Çameli, Acıpayam, Tavas, Bozdoğan, and Çine. The city of Aydın (formerly Tralles) was controlled by this beylik for a time, during which it was called "Güzelhisar"; it later was transferred to the Aydinids in the north, who renamed the city for the founder of their dynasty.

Kraljestvo Imerina (malgaško: Fanjakan'Imerina; ok. 1540–1897), znano tudi kot Kraljestvo Madagaskar ali Kraljestvo Merina, je bilo predkolonialna država ob obali jugovzhodne Afrike, ki je do 18. stoletja obvladovala večji del današnjega Madagaskarja. Širila se je iz Imerine, regije osrednjega višavja, kjer živi predvsem ljudstvo Merina, z duhovno prestolnico v Ambohimangi in politično prestolnico 24 km zahodneje v Antananarivu, ki je danes sedež vlade sodobne države Madagaskar. Kralji in kraljice ljudstva Merina, ki so v 19. stoletju vladali večjemu delu Madagaskarja, so bili potomci dolge vrste dednih merinskih vladarjev, ki se začne z Andriamanelom, ki mu izročilo pripisuje ustanovitev Imerine leta 1540.

Leta 1883 je Francija vdrla v Kraljestvo Merina, da bi vzpostavila protektorat. Leta 1894 je znova vdrla in kraljestvo osvojila ter ga spremenila v francosko kolonijo; ti spopadi so znani kot francosko-hovske vojne.
notes: The miles conversion (15 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Imerina
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Imerina (Malagasy: Fanjakan'Imerina; c. 1540–1897), also known as the Kingdom of Madagascar or the Kingdom of Merina, was a pre-colonial state off the coast of Southeast Africa that, by the 18th century, dominated most of what is now Madagascar. It spread outward from Imerina, the Central Highlands region primarily inhabited by the Merina ethnic group with a spiritual capital at Ambohimanga and a political capital 24 km (15 mi) west at Antananarivo, currently the seat of government for the modern state of Madagascar. The Merina kings and queens who ruled over greater Madagascar in the 19th century were the descendants of a long line of hereditary Merina royalty originating with Andriamanelo, who is traditionally credited with founding Imerina in 1540.

In 1883, France invaded the Merina Kingdom to establish a protectorate. France invaded again in 1894 and conquered the kingdom, making it a French colony, in what became known as the Franco-Hova Wars.

Mesopotamian campaign.headline: Mezopotamska kampanja
paragraphs: Mezopotamska kampanja ali mezopotamska fronta (turško: Irak Cephesi) je bila kampanja na bližnjevzhodnem bojišču prve svetovne vojne, v kateri sta se za nadzor nad osmanskim Irakom bojevala Britanski imperij z vojaki iz Britanije, Avstralije in v veliki večini iz Britanske Indije ter centralne sile, predvsem Osmansko cesarstvo. Začela se je po britanskem izkrcanju pri Favu leta 1914, s katerim so hoteli zaščititi naftna polja Anglo-perzijske naftne družbe v provinci Huzestan in plovno pot Šat al Arab. Fronta je pozneje prerasla v večjo kampanjo, s katero so hoteli zavzeti Bagdad in odvrniti osmanske sile z drugih front. Končala se je z mudroškim premirjem leta 1918, ki je pripeljalo do odstopa Iraka in nadaljnje razdelitve Osmanskega cesarstva.

source.title: Mesopotamian campaign
paragraphs: The Mesopotamian campaign or Mesopotamian front (Turkish: Irak Cephesi) was a campaign in the Middle Eastern theatre of World War I fought between the British Empire, with troops from Britain, Australia and the vast majority from the British Raj, and the Central Powers, primarily the Ottoman Empire, over control of Ottoman Iraq. It started after the British Fao Landing in 1914, which sought to protect Anglo-Persian Oil Company oil fields in Khuzestan province and the Shatt al-Arab waterway. The front later evolved into a larger campaign that sought to capture the city of Baghdad and divert Ottoman forces from other fronts. It ended with the Armistice of Mudros in 1918, leading to the cession of Iraq and further partition of the Ottoman Empire.

Minaeans.headline: Minejci
paragraphs: Main (minejsko: 𐩣𐩲𐩬; arabsko: Maʿīn) je bil starodavno južnoarabsko kraljestvo v današnjem Jemnu. Ležal je ob puščavskem pasu, ki so ga srednjeveški arabski geografi imenovali Sajhad, danes pa je znan kot Ramlat as Sabatajn. Narodni bog Maina je bil Vad, govorili pa so minejščino. Kraljestvo se v zgodovinskih virih pojavi v 8. stoletju pr. n. št., iz mestne države pa se je v kraljestvo preoblikovalo v zadnji četrtini 7. stoletja pr. n. št. O datumu konca Maina se raziskovalci močno prerekajo, po najbolj razširjeni domnevi pa je propadel v 1. stoletju n. št.

Minejci so bili ena od štirih starodavnih jemenskih skupin, ki jih omenja Eratosten; druge so bile Sabejci, Hadramavtci in Katabanci. Vsaka je imela v starodavnem Jemnu svoje regionalno kraljestvo: Minejci na severozahodu (v vadiju Al Džauf), Sabejci jugovzhodno od njih, Katabanci jugovzhodno od Sabejcev in Hadramavtci še vzhodneje.

source.title: Ma'in
paragraphs: Ma'in (Minaean: 𐩣𐩲𐩬; Arabic: معين, romanized: Maʿīn) was an ancient South Arabian kingdom in modern-day Yemen. It was located along the strip of desert called Ṣayhad by medieval Arab geographers, which is now known as Ramlat al-Sab'atayn. Wadd was the national god of Ma'in. The spoken language was Minaic. The kingdom appears in the historical record in the 8th century BCE, and transition from a city-state to kingdom in the last quarter of the 7th century BCE. The date of the end of Ma'in is heavily disputed, but the most popular hypothesis places its demise in the 1st century CE.

The Minaean people were one of four ancient Yemeni groups mentioned by Eratosthenes. The others were the Sabaeans, Ḥaḍramites and Qatabānians. Each of these had regional kingdoms in ancient Yemen, with the Minaeans in the north-west (in Wādī al-Jawf), the Sabaeans to the south-east of them, the Qatabānians to the south-east of the Sabaeans, and the Ḥaḑramites further east still.

Mongoli so v Anatolijo vdirali večkrat, začenši s pohodom v letih 1241–1243, ki je dosegel vrhunec v bitki pri Köse Dağu. Dejansko oblast nad Anatolijo so Mongoli izvajali od predaje Seldžukov leta 1243 do propada Ilkanata leta 1335. Ker se je seldžuški sultan večkrat uprl, so Mongoli leta 1255 preplavili osrednjo in vzhodno Anatolijo. Blizu Ankare je bila nameščena ilkanatska posadka. Ostanke mongolske kulturne dediščine je v Turčiji še mogoče videti, med njimi grobnici mongolskega guvernerja in Hulagujevega sina.

source.title: Mongol conquest of Anatolia
paragraphs: Mongols invaded Anatolia at various times, starting with the campaign of 1241–1243 that culminated in the Battle of Köse Dağ. Real power over Anatolia was exercised by the Mongols after the Seljuks surrendered in 1243 until the fall of the Ilkhanate in 1335. Because the Seljuk sultan rebelled several times, in 1255, the Mongols swept through central and eastern Anatolia. An Ilkhanate garrison was stationed near Ankara. Remains of the Mongol cultural heritage still can be seen in Turkey, including tombs of a Mongol governor and a son of Hulagu.

Montreux Convention Regarding the Regime.headline: Konvencija iz Montreuxa o režimu ožin
paragraphs: Konvencija (iz Montreuxa) o režimu ožin, pogosto imenovana kar konvencija iz Montreuxa, je mednarodni sporazum, ki ureja ožini Bospor in Dardanele v Turčiji. Podpisali so jo 20. julija 1936 v palači Montreux v Švici, veljati pa je začela 9. novembra 1936; rešila je dolgotrajno vprašanje ožin, torej kdo naj nadzoruje strateško ključno povezavo med Črnim in Sredozemskim morjem.

source.title: Montreux Convention Regarding the Regime of the Straits
paragraphs: The (Montreux) Convention regarding the Regime of the Straits, often known simply as the Montreux Convention, is an international agreement governing the Bosporus and Dardanelles straits in Turkey. Signed on 20 July 1936 at the Montreux Palace in Switzerland, it went into effect on 9 November 1936, addressing the long running Straits Question over who should control the strategically vital link between the Black and Mediterranean seas.

Državljanska vojna v Mozambiku (portugalsko: Guerra Civil Moçambicana) je bila državljanska vojna, ki je od leta 1977 do 1992 potekala v Mozambiku, sprožili pa so jo krajevni spori in polarizirajoči učinki hladnovojne politike. Bojevali so se vladajoča marksistična Fronta za osvoboditev Mozambika (FRELIMO), protikomunistične uporniške sile Mozambiškega narodnega odpora (RENAMO) in več manjših frakcij, kot so PRM, UNAMO, COREMO, UNIPOMO in FUMO.

source.title: Mozambican Civil War
paragraphs: The Mozambican Civil War (Portuguese: Guerra Civil Moçambicana) was a civil war fought in Mozambique from 1977 to 1992 due to a combination of local strife and the polarizing effects of Cold War politics. The fighting was between Mozambique's ruling Marxist Front for the Liberation of Mozambique (FRELIMO), the anti-communist insurgent forces of the Mozambican National Resistance (RENAMO), and a number of smaller factions such as the PRM, UNAMO, COREMO, UNIPOMO, and FUMO.

Mozambican War of Independence.headline: Mozambiška osamosvojitvena vojna
paragraphs: Mozambiška osamosvojitvena vojna je bila oborožen spopad med gverilskimi silami Fronte za osvoboditev Mozambika (FRELIMO) in Portugalsko. Uradno se je začela 25. septembra 1964 in končala s premirjem 8. septembra 1974, leta 1975 pa je Mozambik dobil s pogajanji dogovorjeno neodvisnost.

Vojne Portugalske proti gverilcem, ki so se borili za neodvisnost njenih 400 let starih afriških ozemelj, so se začele leta 1961 v Angoli. V Mozambiku je spopad izbruhnil leta 1964 zaradi nemirov in nezadovoljstva med številnimi domorodnimi mozambiškimi ljudstvi, ki so tujo oblast doživljala kot izkoriščanje in slabo ravnanje, ki je služilo le portugalskim gospodarskim interesom v regiji. Številni Mozambičani so zamerili tudi portugalsko politiko do domorodcev, ki je vodila v diskriminacijo ter omejen dostop do izobraževanja po portugalskem vzoru in kvalificiranih zaposlitev.

source.title: Mozambican War of Independence
paragraphs: The Mozambican War of Independence was an armed conflict between the guerrilla forces of the Mozambique Liberation Front (FRELIMO) and Portugal. The war officially started on 25 September 1964, and ended with a ceasefire on 8 September 1974, resulting in a negotiated independence in 1975.

Portugal's wars against guerrilla fighters seeking independence in its 400-year-old African territories began in 1961 with Angola. In Mozambique, the conflict erupted in 1964 as a result of unrest and frustration amongst many indigenous Mozambican populations, who perceived foreign rule as exploitation and mistreatment, which served only to further Portuguese economic interests in the region. Many Mozambicans also resented Portugal's policies towards indigenous people, which resulted in discrimination and limited access to Portuguese-style education and skilled employment.

Musa Dagh Resistance.headline: Odpor na Musa Dağu
paragraphs: Musa Dağ (turško: Musa Dağı; armensko: Մուսա լեռ, Musa leṛ; arabsko: جبل موسى, Jebel Musa; »Mojzesova gora«) je gora v provinci Hatay v Turčiji. Leta 1915 je bila prizorišče uspešnega armenskega odpora proti armenskemu genocidu, dogodka, ki je Franza Werfla navdihnil za roman Štirideset dni Musa Daga.
notes: Werfel's novel is given under its Slovenian title, Štirideset dni Musa Daga.

source.title: Musa Dagh
paragraphs: Musa Dagh (Turkish: Musa Dağı; Armenian: Մուսա լեռ, romanized: Musa leṛ; Arabic: جبل موسى, romanized: Jebel Musa; meaning "Moses Mountain") is a mountain in the Hatay Province of Turkey. In 1915, it was the location of a successful Armenian resistance to the Armenian genocide, an event that inspired Franz Werfel to write the novel The Forty Days of Musa Dagh.

Muškat in Oman (arabsko: مسقط و عُمان), uradno Sultanat Muškat in Oman (Salṭanat Masqaṭ wa-‘Umān), med vladavino Tajmurja bin Fejsala za kratek čas tudi Država Muškat in Oman, je bila država pod dejansko britansko zaščito, ki je obstajala v drugi polovici 19. stoletja in v 20. stoletju. Obsegala je današnji Sultanat Oman ter dele današnjih Združenih arabskih emiratov in Pakistana.

Ko je leta 1856 umrl zadnji vladar Omanskega imperija Said bin Sultan, je imperij razpadel na dve ločeni politični tvorbi, Sultanat Muškat in Oman ter Sultanat Zanzibar. Prvemu je še naprej vladala dinastija Al Busaid, ki pa je prešla v novo obliko vladavine po palačnem udaru 23. julija 1970, v katerem so Britanci in sultanov sin Kabus bin Said strmoglavili sultana Saida bin Tajmurja; Kabus je ustanovil današnji Sultanat Oman.

source.title: Muscat and Oman
paragraphs: Muscat and Oman (Arabic: مسقط و عُمان), officially known as the Sultanate of Muscat and Oman (Arabic: سلطنة مسقط وعُمان, romanized: Salṭanat Masqaṭ wa-‘Umān), also known briefly as the State of Muscat and Oman (Arabic: دولة مسقط وعُمان, romanized: Dawlat Masqaṭ wa-‘Umān) during the rule of Taimur bin Faisal, was a state that was under de facto British protection which existed in the second half of the 19th century and 20th century. It encompassed the present-day Sultanate of Oman and parts of present-day United Arab Emirates and Pakistan.

In 1856, upon the death of the last ruler of the Omani Empire, Said bin Sultan, the empire split into two separate political entities: the Sultanate of Muscat and Oman and the Sultanate of Zanzibar. The former continued to be led by the Al Busaid dynasty, but transitioned into a new form of government after the palace coup of 23 July 1970 in which the sultan Said bin Taimur was overthrown by the British and his son, Qaboos bin Said, who established the modern-day Sultanate of Oman.
Imperij Mutapa ali Mutapsko kraljestvo – imenovan tudi Mwenemutapa ali Munhumutapa (šonsko: Mwene we Mutapa; portugalsko: Monomotapa) – je bil šonski imperij na severu zimbabvejske planote.

Portugalski izraz Monomotapa je prečrkovanje šonskega kraljevskega naziva Mwenemutapa, ki je sestavljen iz dveh besed: mwene pomeni »gospodar«, mutapa pa »osvojena dežela«. Kraljevi naziv so sčasoma začeli uporabljati za vse kraljestvo, na zemljevidih tistega časa pa je označeval ozemlje kraljestva.

source.title: Mutapa Empire
paragraphs: The Mutapa Empire – also referred to as Mwenemutapa or Munhumutapa (Shona: Mwene we Mutapa, Portuguese: Monomotapa) – was a Shona empire in the north of the Zimbabwean Plateau.

The Portuguese term Monomotapa is a transliteration of the Shona royal title Mwenemutapa derived from a combination of two words, Mwene meaning "Lord" and Mutapa meaning "conquered land". Over time the monarch's royal title was applied to the kingdom as a whole, and used to denote the kingdom's territory on maps from the period.

Muzaffarids.headline: Muzafaridi
paragraphs: Izraz Muzafaridi ali dinastija Muzafaridov lahko označuje:
Muzafaridi (Iran), vladarji delov osrednjega in jugozahodnega Irana od leta 1335 do 1393,
Muzafaridi (Gudžarat), vladarji Gudžaratskega sultanata v Indiji od leta 1391 do 1583.

source.title: Muzaffarids
paragraphs: Muzaffarids or Muzaffarid dynasty may refer to:
Muzaffarids (Iran), rulers of parts of central and southwestern Iran from 1335 to 1393
Muzaffarids (Gujarat), rulers of the Sultanate of Gujarat in India from 1391 to 1583

Nabhani dynasty.headline: Nabhanidi
paragraphs: Rodbina Al Nabhan (arabsko: Āl Nabhān), znana tudi kot dinastija Nabhani ali Nabhanidi, je arabska kraljeva rodbina, ki je Omanu kot dedni kralji (muluk) vladala od leta 1154 do 1624, ko je oblast prevzela dinastija Jaruba. Rodbina, ki izhaja iz plemena Azd, je na svojem ozemlju vzpostavila osrednji državni aparat in tradicionalne izvoljene ibaditske imame skoraj pet stoletij potisnila v večinoma simbolno versko vlogo. Glavni sedež nabhanidskih kraljev se je menjaval med utrjenimi prestolnicami v notranjosti, Nizvo, Bahlo in Maknijatom, od koder so nadzorovali donosne kopenske poti trgovine s kadilom in začimbami. Ena njihovih najtrajnejših arhitekturnih in kulturnih zapuščin je utrdba Bahla, ogromen kompleks stavb iz nežgane opeke na kamnitih temeljih, zgrajen med 12. in 15. stoletjem, ki so ga leta 1987 vpisali na Unescov seznam svetovne dediščine.

source.title: Nabhani dynasty
paragraphs: The House of Al-Nabhan (Arabic: آل نبهان, romanized: Āl Nabhān), also known as the Nabhani dynasty or Nabhanids, is an Arab royal house that ruled Oman as hereditary kings (muluk) from 1154 until 1624, when the Yaruba dynasty took power. Descending from the Azdi tribe, the family established a centralized state apparatus across their territorial domains, reducing the traditional Ibadi elected imams to a largely symbolic religious role for nearly five centuries. The primary seat of power for the Nabhani kings fluctuated between the fortified interior capitals of Nizwa, Bahla, and Maqniyat, from which they controlled the lucrative overland frankincense and spice trade routes. One of their most enduring architectural and cultural legacies is the Bahla Fort, a massive complex of mud-brick buildings on stone foundations built between the 12th and 15th centuries, which was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987.

Kibuc Nahal Oz in bližnje vojaško oporišče ob severnem robu Gaze sta bila leta 2023 napadena v okviru napadov 7. oktobra. V napadu je bilo ubitih več kot 60 izraelskih vojakov in 15 civilistov. Nekaj vojakov in osem civilistov so ugrabili in odpeljali v Gazo. Po navedbah izraelskih obrambnih sil so v Gazo odpeljali tudi več trupel ubitih.

source.title: Nahal Oz attack
paragraphs: The kibbutz of Nahal Oz and the adjacent military base near the northern Gaza Strip were attacked in 2023 as part of the October 7 attacks. In the attack, more than 60 Israeli soldiers and 15 civilians were killed. Some soldiers and eight civilians were kidnapped and taken to the Gaza Strip. According to the IDF, several bodies were also taken to the Gaza Strip after being killed.

Najahid dynasty.headline: Nadžahidi
paragraphs: Nadžahidi (arabsko: Banū Najāḥ) so bili sunitska muslimanska dinastija abesinskih mamelukov, ki je od leta 1022 do 1158 iz prestolnice Zabid vladala delom Jemna. Nadžah je dobil priznanje abasidskega kalifa al Kadirja in častni naziv al Muajad Nasr ad Din. Sovražni so jim bili šiitski ismailitski Sulajhidi, zvesti Fatimidom. Zadnjega vladarja dinastije je leta 1158 ubil haridžit Ali ibn Mahdi.

source.title: Najahid dynasty
paragraphs: The Najahid dynasty (Arabic: بنو نجاح; Banū Najāḥ) was a Sunni Muslim dynasty of Abyssinian Mamluks that ruled parts of Yemen from 1022-1158 from its capital at Zabīd. Najah would obtain the recognition of the Abbasid Caliph al-Qadir and would be given the honorific title 'al- Mu'ayyad Nasr al-din'. They faced hostilities from the Shia Ismailis Sulayhids who were loyal to the Fatimids. Their last sovereign was killed by Ali ibn Mahdi the Kharijite in 1158.

Republika Natalia je bila kratkotrajna burska republika, ustanovljena leta 1839 po zmagi voortrekkerjev nad Zuluji v bitki pri Krvavi reki. Portugalski pomorščaki so območje prej poimenovali Natália, ker so ga odkrili na božič (»natal« je portugalska beseda za božič). Republika je prenehala obstajati leta 1843, ko so jo britanske sile priključile in ustanovile kolonijo Natal. Po britanski priključitvi Republike Natalia se je večina krajevnih voortrekkerjev odselila proti severozahodu v Transoranje, pozneje znano kot Svobodna država Oranje, in v Južnoafriško republiko.

source.title: Natalia Republic
paragraphs: The Natalia Republic was a short-lived Boer republic founded in 1839 after a Voortrekker victory against the Zulus at the Battle of Blood River. The area was previously named Natália by Portuguese sailors, due to its discovery on Christmas ("Natal" is the Portuguese word for Christmas). The republic came to an end in 1843 when British forces annexed it to form the Colony of Natal. After the British annexation of the Natalia Republic, most local Voortrekkers trekked northwest into Transorangia, later known as the Orange Free State, and the South African Republic.

Naval Battle of Casablanca.headline: Pomorska bitka pri Casablanci
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Casablanci je bila vrsta pomorskih spopadov med ameriškimi ladjami, ki so ščitile invazijo na severno Afriko, in ladjami vichyjske Francije, ki so v skladu z drugim premirjem v Compiègnu branile nevtralnost Francoskega Maroka med drugo svetovno vojno. Zavezniški vojaški načrtovalci so pričakovali, da bi lahko ameriške sile, ki naj bi zavzele atlantsko pristaniško mesto Casablanca, pozdravili kot osvoboditelje. Invazijska enota 102 ameriških ladij s 35.000 ameriškimi vojaki se je pod okriljem teme neopaženo približala maroški obali.

Francoski branilci so prve stike razumeli kot napad za odvračanje pozornosti od velikega izkrcanja v Alžiriji, Nemčija pa je predajo šestih maroških divizij majhni komandoski enoti štela za očitno kršitev francoske obveznosti, da po premirju v Compiègnu z 22. junija 1940 brani maroško nevtralnost.

source.title: Naval Battle of Casablanca
paragraphs: The Naval Battle of Casablanca was a series of naval engagements fought between American ships covering the invasion of North Africa and Vichy French ships defending the neutrality of French Morocco in accordance with the Second Armistice at Compiègne during World War II. Allied military planners anticipated an all-American force assigned to seize the Atlantic port city of Casablanca might be greeted as liberators. An invasion task force of 102 American ships carrying 35,000 American soldiers approached the Moroccan coast undetected under cover of darkness.

French defenders interpreted the first contacts as a diversionary raid for a major landing in Algeria; and Germany regarded the surrender of six Moroccan divisions to a small commando raiding force as a clear violation of French obligations to defend Moroccan neutrality under the Armistice of 22 June 1940 at Compiègne.

Naval operations in the Dardanelles camp.headline: Pomorske operacije v dardanelski kampanji
paragraphs: Pomorske operacije v dardanelski kampanji (17. februarja 1915 – 9. januarja 1916) so potekale proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu med prvo svetovno vojno. Ladje britanske kraljeve vojne mornarice, francoske Marine nationale, ruske cesarske vojne mornarice (Российский императорский флот) in avstralske kraljeve vojne mornarice so se skušale prebiti skozi Dardanele, ozko, 66 km dolgo morsko ožino, ki povezuje Sredozemsko morje z Marmarskim morjem in naprej proti severu s Črnim morjem.

Osmanski branilci so pomorske operacije odbili, predvsem z morskimi minami. Zavezniki so nato izvedli galipolsko kampanjo, kopensko invazijo na polotok Galipoli, da bi uničili osmansko topništvo ob ožini, preden bi nadaljevali pomorske operacije. Skozi Dardanele so poslali tudi podmornice, ki so napadale osmanske ladje v Marmarskem morju.
notes: The miles (41 mi) are dropped.

source.title: Naval operations in the Dardanelles campaign
paragraphs: The naval operations in the Dardanelles campaign (17 February 1915 – 9 January 1916) took place against the Ottoman Empire during the First World War. Ships of the Royal Navy, French Marine nationale, Imperial Russian Navy (Российский императорский флот) and the Royal Australian Navy, attempted to force a passage through the Dardanelles Straits, a narrow, 41-mile-long (66 km) waterway connecting the Mediterranean Sea with the Sea of Marmara and the Black Sea further north.

The naval operations were defeated by the Ottoman defenders, mainly through use of naval mines. The Allies conducted the Gallipoli campaign, a land invasion of the Gallipoli peninsula to eliminate the Ottoman artillery along the straits before resuming naval operations. The Allies also passed submarines through the Dardanelles to attack Ottoman shipping in the Sea of Marmara.

Novoasirsko cesarstvo je bilo četrta in predzadnja stopnja starodavne asirske zgodovine. Začelo se je z vzponom Adad-nirarija II. leta 911 pr. n. št. in v večjem delu 9. do 7. stoletja pr. n. št. obvladovalo stari Bližnji vzhod ter dele južnega Kavkaza, severne Afrike in vzhodnega Sredozemlja, s čimer je postalo največji imperij v dotedanji zgodovini. Zaradi geopolitične prevlade in ideologije svetovnega gospostva ga opisujejo kot prvi svetovni imperij v zgodovini. Kulturno, upravno in vojaško je vplivalo na druge imperije starega veka, med njimi na novobabilonskega, ahemenidskega in selevkidskega. Na vrhuncu je bilo najmočnejša vojaška sila na svetu in je vladalo vsej Mezopotamiji, Levantu in Egiptu ter delom Anatolije, Arabije in današnjega Irana in Armenije.
notes: The glossary headline was Novo asirsko kraljestvo; it is now corrected to Novoasirsko cesarstvo, as in the text.

source.title: Neo-Assyrian Empire
paragraphs: The Neo-Assyrian Empire was the fourth and penultimate stage of ancient Assyrian history. Beginning with the accession of Adad-nirari II in 911 BCE, the Neo-Assyrian Empire grew to dominate the ancient Near East and parts of the South Caucasus, North Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean throughout much of the 9th to 7th centuries BCE, becoming the largest empire in history up to that point. Because of its geopolitical dominance and ideology based in world domination, the Neo-Assyrian Empire has been described as the first world empire in history. It influenced other empires of the ancient world culturally, administratively, and militarily, including the Neo-Babylonians, the Achaemenids, and the Seleucids. At its height, the empire was the strongest military power in the world and ruled over all of Mesopotamia, the Levant and Egypt, as well as parts of Anatolia, Arabia and what is now Iran and Armenia.

Novobabilonsko cesarstvo ali drugo babilonsko cesarstvo, v zgodovini znano kot Kaldejsko cesarstvo, je bilo zadnja politična tvorba, ki so ji vladali domači vladarji starodavne Mezopotamije. Začelo se je s kronanjem Nabopolasarja za babilonskega kralja leta 626 pr. n. št., trdno pa se je uveljavilo s padcem Asirskega cesarstva v letih 612–609 pr. n. št.; Perzijski Ahemenidski imperij ga je osvojil leta 539 pr. n. št., manj kot stoletje po ustanovitvi kaldejske dinastije.

S porazom Asirskega cesarstva in vrnitvijo moči v Babilon sta mesto in južna Mezopotamija prvič po propadu starobabilonskega cesarstva (pod Hamurabijem) skoraj tisoč let prej spet zavladala staremu Bližnjemu vzhodu. Novobabilonska vladavina je po vsej Babiloniji prinesla brezprimerno gospodarsko in demografsko rast ter sprožila kulturno in umetniško renesanso, saj so kralji začeli velike gradbene projekte, predvsem v Babilonu, in obudili številne prvine sumersko-akadske kulture iz prejšnjih dveh tisočletij.
notes: The glossary headline was Novo babilonsko kraljestvo; it is now corrected to Novobabilonsko cesarstvo, as in the text.

source.title: Neo-Babylonian Empire
paragraphs: The Neo-Babylonian Empire or Second Babylonian Empire, historically known as the Chaldean Empire, was the last polity ruled by monarchs native to ancient Mesopotamia. Beginning with the coronation of Nabopolassar as the King of Babylon in 626 BC and being firmly established through the fall of the Assyrian Empire in 612–609 BC, the Neo-Babylonian Empire was conquered by the Achaemenid Persian Empire in 539 BC, less than a century after the founding of the Chaldean dynasty.

The defeat of the Assyrian Empire and subsequent return of power to Babylon marked the first time that the city, and southern Mesopotamia in general, had risen to dominate the ancient Near East since the collapse of the Old Babylonian Empire (under Hammurabi) nearly a thousand years earlier. Neo-Babylonian rule produced unprecedented economic and population growth across Babylonia and sparked a cultural and artistic renaissance as its kings initiated major building projects, chiefly in Babylon, reviving many elements of the preceding two thousand years of Sumero-Akkadian culture.

Neo-Hittite states.headline: Novohetitske države
paragraphs: Države, imenovane novohetitske, sirsko-hetitske (v starejši literaturi) ali luvijsko-aramejske (v sodobnih znanstvenih delih), so bile luvijske in aramejske regionalne politične tvorbe železne dobe na jugovzhodu današnje Turčije in severozahodu današnje Sirije, v antiki znane kot dežele Hatti in Aram. Nastale so po propadu Novega hetitskega kraljestva v 12. stoletju pr. n. št. in so obstajale, dokler jih v 8. stoletju pr. n. št. ni pokorilo Asirsko cesarstvo. Raziskovalci jih združujejo na podlagi več kulturnih meril, ki so jih prepoznali kot podobna in skupna obema družbama, severni (luvijski) in južni (aramejski). Kulturna izmenjava med njima velja za poseben regionalni pojav, zlasti ob velikih jezikovnih razlikah med glavnima jezikoma regije: luvijščina spada v anatolsko skupino indoevropskih jezikov, aramejščina pa v severozahodno skupino semitskih jezikov. O več vprašanjih, povezanih z regionalnim združevanjem luvijskih in aramejskih držav, raziskovalci menijo različno, nekateri so do takega združevanja na splošno kritični.

source.title: Neo-Hittite states
paragraphs: The states called Neo-Hittite, Syro-Hittite (in older literature), or Luwian-Aramean (in modern scholarly works) were Luwian and Aramean regional polities of the Iron Age, situated in southeastern parts of modern Turkey and northwestern parts of modern Syria, known in ancient times as lands of Hatti and Aram. They arose following the collapse of the Hittite New Kingdom in the 12th century BCE, and lasted until they were subdued by the Assyrian Empire in the 8th century BCE. They are grouped together by scholars on the basis of several cultural criteria that are recognized as similar and shared between both societies: northern (Luwian) and southern (Aramean). Cultural exchange between those societies is seen as a specific regional phenomenon, particularly in light of significant linguistic distinctions between the two main regional languages, with Luwian belonging to the Anatolian group of Indo-European languages and Aramaic belonging to the Northwest Semitic group of Semitic languages. Several questions related to the regional grouping of Luwian and Aramaean states are viewed differently among scholars, including some views that are critical towards such grouping in general.

Zahodna in osrednja skupina šimpanzov na območju gričev Ngogo v narodnem parku Kibale v Ugandi se od leta 2015 nasilno spopadata. Za spopad je značilno enostransko nasilje zahodne skupine nad osrednjo, vključno z uboji, brutalnimi napadi in pohabljanji. Šimpanzi iz Ngoga so bili prej enotna miroljubna skupnost, ki se je nasilno razcepila, zato spopad opisujejo kot »državljansko vojno«. Časnik The New York Times je zapisal, da je to najbolj krvav spopad med šimpanzi, kar so jih kdaj zabeležili.
To je drugi večji spopad med šimpanzi, ki so ga opazovali primatologi; prvi je bila gombejska vojna šimpanzov v 1970. letih v Tanzaniji.

source.title: Ngogo Chimpanzee War
paragraphs: The Western and Central factions of chimpanzees of the Ngogo hill region in Kibale National Park, Uganda, have been engaged in a violent conflict since 2015. The conflict has been characterized by one-sided violence, including killing, brutal attacks, and mutilations, by the Western faction against the Central faction. Because the Ngogo chimpanzees formerly constituted a single peaceful community that violently split apart, this conflict has been described as a "civil war". The New York Times said the conflict was the bloodiest among chimpanzees ever recorded.
This is the second major conflict between chimpanzees that has been observed by primatologists, the first being the Gombe Chimpanzee War of the 1970s in Tanzania.

Nigerijska državljanska vojna (6. julija 1967 – 15. januarja 1970), znana tudi kot biafrska vojna ali nigerijsko-biafrska vojna, je bila oborožen spopad med Nigerijo in Republiko Biafro, odcepljeno državo, ki je leta 1967 razglasila neodvisnost od Nigerije. V vojnih letih je bil nigerijski voditelj države general Yakubu Gowon, Biafro pa je vodil podpolkovnik Chukwuemeka »Emeka« Odumegwu Ojukwu. Spopad je izhajal iz političnih, etničnih, kulturnih in verskih napetosti, ki so obstajale že pred formalno dekolonizacijo Nigerije, ki jo je Združeno kraljestvo izpeljalo v letih 1960–1963. Neposredni vzroki vojne leta 1966 so bili vojaški udar, protiudar in protiigbovski pogromi v Severni regiji. Zaradi pogromov in množičnega bega preživelih Igbov iz Severne regije v igbovsko domovino v Vzhodni regiji je vodstvo Vzhodne regije sklenilo, da nigerijska zvezna vlada noče ali ne more zagotoviti ustrezne zaščite, zato se je zdelo, da je edina preostala rešitev zagotoviti varnost rojakov z ustanovitvijo suverene in neodvisne države Biafre.

source.title: Nigerian Civil War
paragraphs: The Nigerian Civil War (6 July 1967 – 15 January 1970), also known as the Biafran War, Nigeria–Biafra War, or Biafra War, was an armed conflict fought between Nigeria and the Republic of Biafra, a secessionist state that had declared its independence from Nigeria in 1967. During the war years, General Yakubu Gowon served as the head of state of Nigeria, while Biafra was led by Lieutenant Colonel Chukwuemeka "Emeka" Odumegwu Ojukwu. The conflict emerged from political, ethnic, cultural, and religious tensions that preceded the United Kingdom's formal decolonisation of Nigeria from 1960 to 1963. Immediate causes of the war in 1966 included a military coup, a counter-coup, and anti-Igbo pogroms in the Northern Region. As a consequence of these pogroms, alongside the mass exodus of surviving Igbos from the Northern Region to the Igbo homelands in the Eastern Region, the leadership of the Eastern Region concluded that the Nigerian federal government was either unwilling or unable to guarantee them an adequate protection, therefore, the only remaining solution seemed to be to guarantee their compatriots' security by establishing a sovereign and independent country of Biafra.

Nkomati Accord.headline: Sporazum iz Nkomatija
paragraphs: Sporazum iz Nkomatija (uradno Sporazum o nenapadanju in dobrih sosedskih odnosih med Mozambikom in Južno Afriko) je bil pakt o nenapadanju, ki sta ga 16. marca 1984 podpisali Ljudska republika Mozambik in Republika Južna Afrika. Podpis je bil v južnoafriškem mestu Komatipoort, podpisnika pa sta bila mozambiški predsednik Samora Machel in južnoafriški predsednik vlade P. W. Botha. Po navedbah pogodbe naj Mozambik ne bi več podpiral Afriškega narodnega kongresa pri nasilnih dejanjih v Južni Afriki, Južna Afrika pa naj bi prenehala oskrbovati gibanje RENAMO v Mozambiku.

Pogodba je naletela na neodobravanje članic SADCC in zlasti ANC, katerega člani so se zavedali, kako bo vplivala na njihov osvobodilni boj. Kljub temu sta obe skupini priznali, da je bil Mozambik k podpisu pravzaprav prisiljen, saj je bila država zaradi spopada z uporniki RENAMO, ki jih je podpirala Južna Afrika, na robu uničenja.

source.title: Nkomati Accord
paragraphs: The Nkomati Accord (officially known as the Agreement on Non-Aggression and Good Neighbourliness between Mozambique and South Africa ) was a non-aggression pact signed on 16 March 1984 between the People's Republic of Mozambique and the Republic of South Africa. The event took place at the South African town of Komatipoort with the signatories being President of Mozambique Samora Machel and Prime Minister of South Africa P.W. Botha. The treaty's stated focus was on preventing Mozambique from supporting the African National Congress to undertake violent actions in South Africa, and for South Africa to stop supplying the RENAMO movement in Mozambique.

The treaty was met with disapproval from members of the SADCC and particularly from the ANC who were aware of the impacts it would have on their liberation struggle. Despite this, both groups acknowledged that Mozambique had essentially been forced into signing the treaty as the country was on the brink of destruction due to the conflict with the South-African backed RENAMO rebels.

Nobatia.headline: Nobatija
paragraphs: Nobatija ali Nobadija (grško: Νοβαδία, Nobadia; staronubijsko: ⲙⲓⲅⲛ̅ Migin ali ⲙⲓⲅⲓⲧⲛ︦ ⲅⲟⲩⲗ, Migitin Goul, dobesedno »nobadijske dežele«) je bila poznoantično kraljestvo v Spodnji Nubiji, na jugu današnjega Egipta. Skupaj z drugima dvema koptsko-nubijskima kraljestvoma, Makurijo in Alodijo, je nasledila Kraljestvo Kuš. Po ustanovitvi okoli leta 400 se je Nobadija postopno širila: na severu je premagala Blemijce, na jugu pa si je priključila ozemlje med drugim in tretjim nilskim kataraktom. Leta 543 je sprejela koptsko krščanstvo. V 7. stoletju si jo je v neznanih okoliščinah priključila Makurija.

source.title: Nobatia
paragraphs: Nobatia or Nobadia (Greek: Νοβαδία, Nobadia; Old Nubian: ⲙⲓⲅⲛ̅ Migin or ⲙⲓⲅⲓⲧⲛ︦ ⲅⲟⲩⲗ, Migitin Goul lit. "of Nobadia's land") was a late antique kingdom in Lower Nubia, modern day southern Egypt. Together with the two other Coptic-Nubian kingdoms, Makuria and Alodia, it succeeded the kingdom of Kush. After its establishment in around 400, Nobadia gradually expanded by defeating the Blemmyes in the north and incorporating the territory between the second and third Nile cataract in the south. In 543, it converted to Coptic Christianity. It would then be annexed by Makuria, under unknown circumstances, during the 7th century.

Severni Jemen (arabsko: al-Yaman al-šamāliyya) je izraz za Kraljevino Jemen (1918–1962), Jemensko arabsko republiko (1962–1990) in režime pred njima, ki so imeli suverenost nad tem delom Jemna. Prestolnica je bila Sana od leta 1918 do 1948 in znova od leta 1962 do 1990. Pokrajina (Gornji Jemen) leži na jugozahodu Arabskega polotoka in meri približno 136.000 kvadratnih kilometrov, pred združitvijo Jemna pa je imela okoli trinajst milijonov prebivalcev. Na severu je mejila na Savdsko Arabijo, na jugu in vzhodu na Južni Jemen, na zahodu na Rdeče morje, na jugozahodu pa na Bab el Mandeb.

Severni Jemen je postal član Združenih narodov 30. septembra 1947. Leta 1962 je izbruhnila krvava državljanska vojna, ki se je leta 1970 končala z odpravo monarhije in ustanovitvijo republike. Skupaj z Južnim Jemnom je bil ena od predhodnic Republike Jemen, dokler se nista leta 1990 združila.
notes: The glossary named this record Nordjemen, which is not Slovenian; it is now corrected to Severni Jemen, as in the text.

source.title: North Yemen
paragraphs: North Yemen (Arabic: اليمن الشمالي, romanized: al-Yaman al-šamāliyya) is a term used to describe the Kingdom of Yemen (1918–1962), the Yemen Arab Republic (1962–1990), and the regimes that preceded them and exercised sovereignty over that region of Yemen. Its capital was Sanaa from 1918 to 1948 and again from 1962 to 1990. Located in the southwestern part of the Arabian Peninsula, the area of the region (Upper Yemen) is approximately 136,000 square kilometers, and it used to have a population of about thirteen million people prior to the Yemeni unification. It was bordered to the north by Saudi Arabia, to the south and east by South Yemen, to the west by the Red Sea, and to Bab al-Mandab in the southwest.

North Yemen was admitted to the United Nations on September 30, 1947. In 1962, the country fought a bloody civil war that ended with the abolition of the monarchy and the creation of a republic in 1970. It was one of the predecessor states of the Republic of Yemen, alongside South Yemen, until its eventual unification in 1990.

Severnojemenska državljanska vojna, v Jemnu znana tudi kot revolucija 26. septembra, je bila državljanska vojna, ki je od leta 1962 do 1970 v Severnem Jemnu potekala med privrženci mutavakilitskega kraljestva in podporniki Jemenske arabske republike. Začela se je z državnim udarom leta 1962, ki so ga izvedli revolucionarni republikanci pod vodstvom vojske in poveljstvom Abdulaha al Salala. Ta je odstavil komaj kronanega kralja in imama Mohameda al Badra in Jemen razglasil za republiko s seboj kot predsednikom. Njegova vlada je v Jemnu odpravila suženjstvo. Imam je pobegnil na savdsko mejo, kjer je za ponovni prevzem oblasti zbral podporo severnih zajdijskih plemen, spopad pa je hitro prerasel v vsesplošno državljansko vojno.

source.title: North Yemen civil war
paragraphs: The North Yemen civil war, also known in Yemen as the 26 September Revolution, was a civil war fought in North Yemen from 1962 to 1970 between partisans of the Mutawakkilite Kingdom and supporters of the Yemen Arab Republic. The war began with a coup d'état carried out in 1962 by revolutionary republicans led by the army under the command of Abdullah al-Sallal. He dethroned the newly crowned King and Imam Muhammad al-Badr and declared Yemen a republic under his presidency. His government abolished slavery in Yemen. The Imam escaped to the Saudi Arabian border where he rallied popular support from northern Zaydi tribes to retake power, and the conflict rapidly escalated to a full-scale civil war.

November 1963 Iraqi coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Iraku novembra 1963
paragraphs: Iraški državni udar novembra 1963 je potekal med 13. in 18. novembrom 1963, ko so po notranjih razkolih v stranki naseristični iraški častniki izvedli vojaški udar v stranki Baath. Sam udar je bil nekrvav, v povezanih spopadih pa je umrlo 250 ljudi.
Vlada je nato trajala do revolucije 17. julija leta 1968.

source.title: November 1963 Iraqi coup d'état
paragraphs: The November 1963 Iraqi coup d'état took place between November 13 and November 18, 1963, when, following internal party divisions, pro-Nasserist Iraqi officers led a military coup within the Ba'ath Party. Although the coup itself was bloodless, 250 people were killed in related actions.
The government subsequently lasted until the 17 July Revolution in 1968.

Omani Empire.headline: Omansko cesarstvo
paragraphs: Omansko cesarstvo je bilo pomorski imperij, ki se je s Portugalsko in Britanijo potegoval za trgovino in vpliv v Perzijskem zalivu in Indijskem oceanu. V 18. stoletju je postalo regionalna sila, na vrhuncu v 19. stoletju pa sta njegov vpliv in oblast segala prek Hormuške ožine do današnjega Irana in Pakistana ter na jug vse do rta Delgado v današnjem Mozambiku. Po smrti Saida bin Sultana leta 1856 so cesarstvo razdelili med njegova sinova na dva sultanata: afriški del (Zanzibarski sultanat) je prevzel Madžid bin Said, azijski (Sultanat Maskat in Oman) pa Tuvaini bin Said.

source.title: Omani Empire
paragraphs: The Omani Empire was a maritime empire, vying with Portugal and Britain for trade and influence in the Persian Gulf and Indian Ocean. After rising as a regional power in the 18th century, the empire at its peak in the 19th century saw its influence or control extend across the Strait of Hormuz to modern-day Iran and Pakistan, and as far south as Cape Delgado in what is now Mozambique. After the death of Said bin Sultan in 1856 the empire was divided between his sons into two sultanates, an African section (Sultanate of Zanzibar) ruled by Majid bin Said and an Asian section (Sultanate of Muscat and Oman) ruled by Thuwaini bin Said.

Operation Nasr.headline: Operacija Nasr
paragraphs: Operacija Nasr, znana tudi kot operacija Hovejze, je bila velika bitka iransko-iraške vojne v začetku januarja 1981. Bila je največja tankovska bitka vojne.

Trije iranski oklepni polki so napredovali proti iraškim silam, ki so vdrle na iransko ozemlje med mesti Ahvaz, Susangerd in Dezful. Iraške sile so za premik izvedele in se navidezno umaknile. Iz treh oklepnih brigad so oblikovale zasedo v obliki tristranske škatle. Iranci so slepo zapeljali vanjo, tankovski sili pa sta se štiri dni bojevali v morju blata. Iranci so se umaknili in pustili veliko uničenih in poškodovanih tankov, ki so obtičali v blatu ali jim je zaradi slabega logističnega načrtovanja zmanjkalo goriva in streliva. Zaradi terena se strani nista mogli čisto ločiti, iraške sile pa niso mogle z vso silo zasledovati ostankov iranskih enot.

source.title: Operation Nasr
paragraphs: Operation Nasr, also known as Operation Hoveyzeh, was a major battle in the Iran–Iraq War fought in early January 1981. It was the biggest tank battle of the war.

Three Iranian armored regiments advanced towards Iraqi forces that had invaded Iranian territory between the cities of Ahvaz, Susangerd and Dezful. The Iraqi forces were alerted to this movement and feigned a withdrawal. The Iraqis formed three armored brigades into a three-sided box ambush. The Iranians blundered into the ambush and the two tank forces battled for four days in a sea of mud. The Iranians withdrew, leaving many destroyed and disabled tanks stuck in the mud, or, because of logistical misplanning, had run out of fuel and ammunition. The condition of the terrain prevented a clean break from the battle and did not allow the Iraqi forces to pursue what was left of the Iranians en force.

Operacija Oljčna vejica (turško: Zeytin Dalı Harekâtı) je bila invazija turških oboroženih sil in Sirske narodne vojske (SNA) v pretežno kurdsko okrožje Afrin na severozahodu Sirije, proti Enotam za zaščito ljudstva (YPG) Sirskih demokratičnih sil (SDF). Letalska vojna in uporaba težkega topništva sta se končali, ko so arabske in turkmenske milice SNA 18. marca 2018 vstopile v mesto Afrin.

V invaziji je bilo po poročilih ubitih od 395 do 510 civilistov. Med drugimi poročanimi vojnimi zločini so iznakaženje ženskega trupla, ki so ga zagrešili borci SNA, ubijanje civilistov z neselektivnim obstreljevanjem turških sil, domnevna uporaba kemičnega plina turške vojske in neselektivno streljanje generalnega poveljstva žandarmerije na begunce, ki so z bojišča bežali v Turčijo.

source.title: Operation Olive Branch
paragraphs: Operation Olive Branch (Turkish: Zeytin Dalı Harekâtı) was an invasion by the Turkish Armed Forces and Syrian National Army (SNA) in the Kurdish-majority Afrin District of northwest Syria, against the People's Protection Units (YPG) of the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF). The air war and use of major artillery ended as the Arab and Turkmen militias of the SNA entered the city of Afrin on 18 March 2018.

Between 395 and 510 civilians were reported killed in the invasion. Other reported war crimes include the mutilation of a female corpse by SNA fighters, the killing of civilians due to indiscriminate shelling by Turkish forces, the alleged use of chemical gas by the Turkish Army, and the indiscriminate shooting of refugees fleeing from the conflict area into Turkey by the Gendarmerie General Command.

Operation Sonnenblume.headline: Operacija Sonnenblume
