Glavni vzrok vojne sta bila Hormizdovo nezaupanje do plemstva in duhovščine ter njegovo trdo ravnanje z njima. To je Bahrama Čobina nazadnje spodbudilo k velikemu uporu, brata Vistahm in Vinduj iz rodbine Ispahbudhan pa sta proti Hormizdu izvedla palačni udar, ki se je končal z njegovo oslepitvijo in nazadnje smrtjo. Za kralja so nato kronali njegovega sina Hosrova II.

source.title: Sasanian civil war of 589–591
paragraphs: The Sasanian civil war of 589–591 was a conflict that broke out in 589, due to the great deal of dissatisfaction among the nobles towards the rule of Hormizd IV. The civil war lasted until 591, ending with the overthrow of the Mihranid usurper Bahram Chobin and the restoration of the Sasanian family as the rulers of Iran.

Hormizd IV's distrust and harsh treatment of nobility and clergy was a major cause of the war. This eventually made Bahram Chobin start a major rebellion, while the two Ispahbudhan brothers Vistahm and Vinduyih made a palace coup against him, resulting in the blinding and eventually death of Hormizd IV. His son, Khosrow II, was thereafter crowned as king.

Sasanidsko zavzetje Jeruzalema v začetku leta 614 je bilo pomemben dogodek bizantinsko-sasanidske vojne v letih 602–628. Bilo je plod velike ofenzive Sasanidskega imperija po Rodovitnem polmesecu, ki se je končala s priključitvijo Jeruzalema in vse Palaestine Prime. Sasanidsko napredovanje je okrepil pravočasni izbruh judovskega upora proti Herakliju, ki je bil posledica desetletij preganjanja Judov in Samarijanov v Bizantinskem cesarstvu, čeprav je bila Heraklijeva dinastija na oblasti šele štiri leta.

source.title: Sasanian conquest of Jerusalem
paragraphs: The Sasanian conquest of Jerusalem in early 614 was a significant development in the Byzantine–Sasanian War of 602–628. It was the result of a major offensive by the Sasanian Empire across the Fertile Crescent, culminating in the annexation of Jerusalem and Palaestina Prima as a whole. The Sasanian advance had been bolstered by the timely outbreak of the Jewish revolt against Heraclius, owing to decades of persecution of Jews and Samaritans by the Byzantine Empire, although the Heraclian dynasty itself had only been in power for four years.

Saudi–Yemeni war (1934).headline: Savdsko-jemenska vojna (1934)
paragraphs: Savdsko-jemenska vojna (arabsko: الحرب السعودية اليمنية) je bila vojna med Kraljevino Savdsko Arabijo in Kraljevino Jemen leta 1934.

source.title: Saudi–Yemeni war (1934)
paragraphs: The Saudi–Yemeni war (Arabic: الحرب السعودية اليمنية) was a war between the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the Kingdom of Yemen in 1934.

Tekma za Afriko je bila invazija, osvojitev in kolonizacija večjega dela Afrike, ki jih je konec 19. in v začetku 20. stoletja, v dobi »novega imperializma«, izvedlo sedem zahodnoevropskih sil, ki jih je gnala druga industrijska revolucija. Za Afriko so tekmovale Belgija, Francija, Nemčija, Italija, Portugalska, Španija in Združeno kraljestvo.

Berlinska konferenca v letih 1884–1885 je uredila evropsko kolonizacijo in trgovino v Afriki in velja za simbol »tekme«. V zadnji četrtini 19. stoletja so med evropskimi imperiji vladala velika politična rivalstva, ki so spodbudila kolonizacijo. Konec 19. stoletja so prešli od »neformalnega imperializma«, vojaškega vpliva in gospodarske prevlade, k neposredni oblasti.

source.title: Scramble for Africa
paragraphs: The Scramble for Africa was the invasion, conquest, and colonisation of most of Africa by seven Western European powers, which were driven by the Second Industrial Revolution during the late 19th and early 20th centuries through the era of "New Imperialism". Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Portugal, Spain and the United Kingdom were the contending powers.

The 1884–1885 Berlin Conference regulated European colonisation and trade in Africa, and is seen as emblematic of the "scramble". In the last quarter of the 19th century, there were considerable political rivalries between the European empires, which provided the impetus for the colonisation. The later years of the 19th century saw a transition from "informal imperialism" – military influence and economic dominance – to direct rule.

Second Battle of Colenso.headline: Druga bitka pri Colensu
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Colensu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Colensu, je bila tretja in zadnja bitka črnega tedna druge burske vojne. Britanske sile in burske sile neodvisne Južnoafriške republike in Svobodne države Oranje so se spopadle 15. decembra 1899 v Colensu in okolici v Natalu v Južni Afriki.
Britance so v poraz pripeljali nezadostne priprave, pomanjkljivo izvidovanje in nenavdihnjeno poveljevanje.

source.title: Second Battle of Colenso
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Colenso, also known as the Battle of Colenso, was the third and final battle fought during the Black Week of the Second Boer War. It was fought between British and Boer forces from the independent South African Republic and Orange Free State in and around Colenso, Natal, South Africa on 15 December 1899.
Inadequate preparation, lack of reconnaissance and uninspired leadership led to a British defeat.

Druga bitka za Faludžo, sprva s kodnim imenom operacija Fantomski bes ali operacija Al Fadžr (arabsko: الفجر, »zora«), je bila ofenziva iraške vojne pod ameriškim vodstvom, ki se je začela 7. novembra 2004 in je trajala okoli šest tednov.

Bitka, skupni vojaški napor Združenih držav, iraške začasne vlade in Združenega kraljestva, je bila prvi večji spopad vojne, ki so ga bojevali izključno proti iraškim upornikom, ne proti vojaškim silam baatistične iraške vlade.

Operacija Fantomski bes je potekala sedem mesecev po prvi bitki za Faludžo, poskusu, da bi zajeli ali ubili upornike, vpletene v zasedo v Faludži leta 2004, v kateri so umrli štirje uslužbenci zasebne vojaške družbe Blackwater. Po tisti bitki so nadzor nad mestom prepustili krajevnim varnostnim silam pod iraškim vodstvom, ki so začele kopičiti orožje in graditi zapleteno obrambo.

source.title: Second Battle of Fallujah
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Fallujah, initially codenamed Operation Phantom Fury, Operation al-Fajr (Arabic: الفجر, lit. 'The Dawn') was an American-led offensive of the Iraq War that began on 7 November 2004 and lasted about six weeks.

A joint military effort of the United States, the Iraqi Interim Government, and the United Kingdom, the battle was the war's first major engagement fought solely against the Iraqi insurgency, not the military forces of the Ba'athist Iraq government.

Operation Phantom Fury took place seven months after the First Battle of Fallujah, an attempt to capture or kill insurgent elements involved in the 2004 Fallujah ambush that killed four employees of the private military contractor Blackwater. After that battle, control of the city was transferred to an Iraqi-run local security force, which began stockpiling weapons and building complex defenses.

Second Battle of Gaza.headline: Druga bitka za Gazo
paragraphs: Druga bitka za Gazo je potekala od 17. do 19. aprila 1917, po porazu egiptovskih ekspedicijskih sil (EEF) v prvi bitki za Gazo marca, med sinajsko-palestinsko kampanjo prve svetovne vojne. Gazo je branila močno utrjena posadka osmanske vojske, ki so jo po prvi bitki okrepili z velikimi silami. Branilci so zasedli mestno obrambo in črto močnih redut, ki se je ob cesti od Gaze do Beršebe raztezala proti vzhodu. Napadle so jih tri pehotne divizije vzhodnih sil ob podpori dveh konjeniških divizij, a so moč branilcev, njihovi okopi in podporno topništvo napadalce zdesetkali.

source.title: Second Battle of Gaza
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Gaza was fought on 17–19 April 1917, following the defeat of the Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) at the First Battle of Gaza in March, during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of the First World War. Gaza was defended by the strongly entrenched Ottoman Army garrison, which had been reinforced after the first battle by substantial forces. They manned the town's defences and a line of strong redoubts which extended eastwards along the road from Gaza to Beersheba. The defenders were attacked by the Eastern Force's three infantry divisions, supported by two mounted divisions, but the strength of the defenders, their entrenchments & supporting artillery decimated the attackers.

Second Battle of Homs.headline: Druga bitka pri Homsu
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Homsu je potekala 29. oktobra 1281 v zahodni Siriji med vojskama egiptovske mameluške dinastije in Ilkanata, dela Mongolskega imperija s središčem v Iranu. Bitka je bila del poskusa Abaka kana, da bi Egipčanom iztrgal Sirijo.

source.title: Second Battle of Homs
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Homs was fought in western Syria on 29 October 1281, between the armies of the Mamluk dynasty of Egypt and the Ilkhanate, a division of the Mongol Empire centered on Iran. The battle was part of Abaqa Khan's attempt at taking Syria from the Egyptians.

Second Battle of İnönü.headline: Druga bitka pri İnönüju
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri İnönüju (turško: İkinci İnönü Muharebesi) je potekala od 23. marca do 1. aprila 1921 blizu İnönüja v današnji provinci Eskişehir v Turčiji med grško-turško vojno (1919–1922), znano tudi kot zahodna fronta širše turške osamosvojitvene vojne. Pomenila je prelomnico v grško-turški vojni in turški osamosvojitveni vojni, katere del je bila: grške sile so prej premagovale večinoma neregularne turške sile, tu pa so se v maloazijski kampanji prvič resno ustavile.

source.title: Second Battle of İnönü
paragraphs: The Second Battle of İnönü (Turkish: İkinci İnönü Muharebesi) was fought between March 23 and April 1, 1921 near İnönü in present-day Eskişehir Province, Turkey during the Greco-Turkish War (1919–22), also known as the western front of the larger Turkish War of Independence. It marked a turning point in the Greco-Turkish War and the Turkish War of Independence of which it was a part, as Greek forces had previously been victorious over mostly irregular Turkish forces and suffered their first major halt in Asia minor campaign.

Druga kongovska vojna, znana tudi kot afriška svetovna vojna ali velika afriška vojna, je bila velik spopad, ki se je začel 2. avgusta 1998 v Demokratični republiki Kongo (DRK), le malo več kot leto dni po prvi kongovski vojni. Izbruhnila je, ko se je kongovski predsednik Laurent-Désiré Kabila obrnil proti nekdanjim zaveznikom iz Ruande in Ugande, ki so mu pomagali prevzeti oblast. Spopad se je razširil, ko je Kabila v svojo obrambo zbral koalicijo drugih držav. V vojno je bilo vpletenih devet afriških držav in okoli 25 oboroženih skupin, zato je ena največjih vojn v afriški zgodovini.

Mirovni sporazum so podpisali leta 2002 in vojna se je uradno končala 18. julija 2003 z ustanovitvijo prehodne vlade Demokratične republike Kongo in dvigom zastave DRK v mestu Goma pod nadzorom upornikov, vendar se nasilje v različnih regijah, zlasti na vzhodu, nadaljuje v spopadih, kot so uporništvo Gospodove odporniške vojske ter spopadi v Kivuju in Ituriju.

source.title: Second Congo War
paragraphs: The Second Congo War, also known as Africa's World War or the Great War of Africa, was a major conflict that began on 2 August 1998 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), just over a year after the First Congo War. The war initially erupted when Congolese president Laurent-Désiré Kabila turned against his former allies from Rwanda and Uganda, who had helped him seize power. The conflict expanded as Kabila rallied a coalition of other countries to his defense. The war drew in nine African nations and approximately 25 armed groups, making it one of the largest wars in African history.

Although a peace agreement was signed in 2002, and the war officially ended on 18 July 2003 with the establishment of the Transitional Government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the raising of the DRC's flag in the rebel-controlled city of Goma, violence has persisted in various regions, particularly in the east, through ongoing conflicts such as the Lord's Resistance Army insurgency and the Kivu and Ituri conflicts.

Second Franco-Dahomean War.headline: Druga francosko-dahomejska vojna
paragraphs: Druga francosko-dahomejska vojna, ki je divjala od leta 1892 do 1894, je bila velik spopad med Francijo pod vodstvom generala Alfreda-Amédéeja Doddsa in Dahomejem pod kraljem Béhanzinom. Francozi so zmagali in Dahomej priključili rastočemu kolonialnemu ozemlju Francoske Zahodne Afrike.

source.title: Second Franco-Dahomean War
paragraphs: The Second Franco-Dahomean War, which raged from 1892 to 1894, was a major conflict between France, led by General Alfred-Amédée Dodds, and Dahomey under King Béhanzin. The French emerged triumphant and incorporated Dahomey into their growing colonial territory of French West Africa.

Druga intifada (arabsko: al-Intifāḍa aṯ-Ṯāniya, dobesedno »druga vstaja«; hebrejsko: ha-Intifada ha-Shniya), znana tudi kot intifada Al Aksa, je bila velika vstaja Palestincev proti Izraelu in njegovi zasedbi od leta 2000. Sprva so jo sprožili civilni protesti arabskih prebivalcev vzhodnega Jeruzalema in območij v samem Izraelu, nato pa je prerasla v dolgo obdobje stopnjevanega nasilja v Izraelu, na Zahodnem bregu in v Gazi. Nasilje, ki je vključevalo streljanje, samomorilske bombne napade in vojaške operacije, je trajalo do vrha v Šarm el Šejku leta 2005, ki je končal sovražnosti.

source.title: Second Intifada
paragraphs: The Second Intifada (Arabic: الانتفاضة الثانية, romanized: al-Intifāḍa aṯ-Ṯāniya, lit. 'The Second Uprising'; Hebrew: האינתיפאדה השנייה, romanized: ha-Intifada ha-Shniya), also known as the Al-Aqsa Intifada, was a major uprising by Palestinians against Israel and its occupation from 2000. Initially sparked by civilian protests by Arab residents in East Jerusalem and areas within Israel proper, the uprising escalated into a prolonged period of heightened violence in Israel, the West Bank and the Gaza Strip. This violence, which included shootings, suicide bombings, and military operations, continued until the Sharm el-Sheikh Summit of 2005, which ended hostilities.

Second Ivorian Civil War.headline: Druga slonokoščenobalska državljanska vojna
paragraphs: Druga slonokoščenobalska državljanska vojna je izbruhnila marca 2011, ko je kriza v Slonokoščeni obali prerasla v vojaški spopad v polnem obsegu med silami, zvestimi Laurentu Gbagboju, predsedniku Slonokoščene obale od leta 2000, in privrženci mednarodno priznanega izvoljenega predsednika Alassana Ouattare.

Po mesecih neuspešnih pogajanj in občasnega nasilja med privrženci obeh strani je kriza vstopila v odločilno fazo, ko so Ouattarove sile s pomočjo OZN prevzele nadzor nad večino države, Gbagbo pa se je utrdil v Abidžanu, največjem mestu države. Mednarodne organizacije so poročale o številnih kršitvah človekovih pravic obeh strani, zlasti v mestu Duékoué, kjer so Ouattarove sile ubile več sto ljudi. V spopadu je bilo ubitih okoli 3000 ljudi. Sile OZN in Francije so vojaško posredovale z navedenim ciljem, da zaščitijo svoje enote in civiliste. Francoske sile so Gbagboja 11. aprila 2011 aretirale v njegovi rezidenci.

source.title: Second Ivorian Civil War
paragraphs: The Second Ivorian Civil War broke out in March 2011 when the crisis in Ivory Coast escalated into full-scale military conflict between forces loyal to Laurent Gbagbo, the President of Ivory Coast since 2000, and supporters of the internationally recognised president-elect Alassane Ouattara.

After months of unsuccessful negotiations and sporadic violence between supporters of the two sides, the crisis entered a critical stage as Ouattara's forces seized control of most of the country with the help of the UN, with Gbagbo entrenched in Abidjan, the country's largest city. International organizations have reported numerous instances of human rights violations by both sides, in particular in the city of Duékoué where Ouattara's forces killed hundreds of people. Around 3,000 people were killed in the conflict. UN and French forces took military action, with the stated objective to protect their forces and civilians. France's forces arrested Gbagbo at his residence on 11 April 2011.

Second Liberian Civil War.headline: Druga liberijska državljanska vojna
paragraphs: Druga liberijska državljanska vojna je bila državljanska vojna v zahodnoafriški državi Liberiji, ki je trajala od leta 1999 do 2003. Povzročili so jo predvsem neuspehi pri prehodu po prvi državljanski vojni, zlasti pri graditvi miru, ki naj bi izhajala iz ponovnega vključevanja, razorožitve, rehabilitacije in demobilizacije.

source.title: Second Liberian Civil War
paragraphs: The Second Liberian Civil War was a civil war in the West African nation of Liberia that lasted from 1999 to 2003. The war was mainly caused by transition failures after the First Civil War, especially the peace-building process which would result from re-integration, disarmament, rehabilitation and demobilization.
Druga melilska vojna (špansko: Campaña ali Guerra de Melilla) je bila spopad leta 1909 na severu Maroka v okolici Melille. V bojih so sodelovali krajevni Rifci in španska vojska.

source.title: Second Melillan campaign
paragraphs: The second Melillan campaign (Spanish: Campaña or Guerra de Melilla) was a conflict in 1909 in northern Morocco around Melilla. The fighting involved local Riffians and the Spanish Army.

Druga sudanska državljanska vojna je bila spopad med osrednjo sudansko vlado in Sudansko ljudsko osvobodilno vojsko, ki je trajal od leta 1983 do 2005. V veliki meri je bila nadaljevanje prve sudanske državljanske vojne v letih 1955–1972. Čeprav se je začela na jugu Sudana, se je razširila v gorovje Nuba in na območje Modrega Nila. Trajala je skoraj 22 let in je ena najdaljših zabeleženih državljanskih vojn. Šest let po koncu vojne je Južni Sudan postal neodvisen.

V spopadu je umrlo okoli dva milijona ljudi. Štiri milijone ljudi na jugu Sudana je bilo med vojno vsaj enkrat razseljenih, navadno večkrat. Število civilnih žrtev je eno najvišjih v kateri koli vojni po drugi svetovni vojni, vojno pa so zaznamovale številne kršitve človekovih pravic, med njimi suženjstvo in množični poboji.

source.title: Second Sudanese Civil War
paragraphs: The Second Sudanese Civil War was a conflict from 1983 to 2005 between the central Sudanese government and the Sudan People's Liberation Army. It was largely a continuation of the First Sudanese Civil War of 1955 to 1972. Although it originated in southern Sudan, the civil war spread to the Nuba Mountains and the Blue Nile. It lasted for almost 22 years and is one of the longest civil wars on record. The war resulted in the independence of South Sudan 6 years after the war ended.

Roughly two million people died as a result of the conflict. Four million people in southern Sudan were displaced at least once, normally repeatedly during the war. The civilian death toll is one of the highest of any war since World War II and was marked by numerous human rights violations, including slavery and mass killings.

Druga sirska republika, uradno Sirska republika od leta 1950 do 1958 in Sirska arabska republika od leta 1961 do 1963, je nasledila prvo sirsko republiko, ki se je aprila 1946 dejansko osamosvojila od francoskega mandata. Ustanovila jo je sirska ustava iz leta 1950, ki je bila od leta 1950 do 1954, med vladavino Adiba Šišaklija, odložena, pozneje pa je prenehala veljati, ko se je Sirija leta 1958 z Republiko Egipt združila v Združeno arabsko republiko. Druga republika je bila obnovljena, ko je Sirija leta 1961 izstopila iz zveze. Leta 1963 je sirska stranka Baath z nekrvavim vojaškim udarom prevzela oblast, postavila temelje politične ureditve baatistične Sirije in končala obdobje demokratičnih poskusov v postkolonialni Siriji.

source.title: Second Syrian Republic
paragraphs: The Second Syrian Republic, officially the Syrian Republic from 1950 to 1958 and the Syrian Arab Republic from 1961 to 1963, succeeded the First Syrian Republic, which had become de facto independent from the French Mandate in April 1946. The Second Republic was established under the Syrian Constitution of 1950, which was suspended from 1950 to 1954 during Adib Shishakli's rule and later became inoperative when Syria joined with the Republic of Egypt to form the United Arab Republic in 1958. The Second Republic was restored when Syria withdrew from the union in 1961. In 1963, the Syrian Ba'athist Party came to power in a bloodless military coup, which laid the foundations for the political structure of Ba'athist Syria and ended the era of democratic experimentation in post-colonial Syria.

Selevkidi (grško: Σελευκίδαι, Seleukídai, »Selevkovi potomci«) so bili makedonska grška kraljeva rodbina, ki je v helenističnem obdobju vladala Selevkidskemu imperiju s središčem v zahodni Aziji. Ustanovil jo je Selevk I. Nikator, general in naslednik Aleksandra Velikega, po razdelitvi Makedonskega imperija v vojnah diadohov.

source.title: Seleucid dynasty
paragraphs: The Seleucid dynasty or the Seleucidae (Greek: Σελευκίδαι, Seleukídai, "descendants of Seleucus") was a Macedonian Greek royal family, which ruled the Seleucid Empire based in West Asia during the Hellenistic period. It was founded by Seleucus I Nicator, a general and successor of Alexander the Great, after the division of the Macedonian Empire as a result of the Wars of the Successors (Diadochi).

Seljuk campaign on the Crusaders (1111).headline: Seldžuški pohod proti križarjem (1111)
paragraphs: Seldžuški pohod proti križarjem (1111) je bil vojaški pohod v gornji Mezopotamiji in Levantu, ki ga je Masud ibn Mohamed vodil proti križarjem in njihovim državam.

source.title: Seljuk campaign on the Crusaders (1111)
paragraphs: The Seljuk campaign on the Crusaders (1111) was a military campaign that took place in Upper Mesopotamia and Levant, led by Mas'ud ibn Muhammed against the Crusaders and their states.

V Burkini Faso je 30. septembra 2022 prišlo do državnega udara, s katerim so odstavili začasnega predsednika Paula-Henrija Sandaogo Damibo, ker naj ne bi bil kos islamističnemu uporništvu v državi. Damiba je prišel na oblast z državnim udarom osem mesecev prej. Vlogo začasnega voditelja je prevzel stotnik Ibrahim Traoré.

source.title: September 2022 Burkina Faso coup d'état
paragraphs: A coup d'état took place in Burkina Faso on 30 September 2022, removing Interim President Paul-Henri Sandaogo Damiba over his alleged inability to deal with the country's Islamist insurgency. Damiba had come to power in a coup d'état eight months earlier. Captain Ibrahim Traoré took over as interim leader.

Sheikh Said rebellion.headline: Upor šejka Saida
paragraphs: Upor šejka Saida (kurdsko: Serhildana Şêx Seîd; turško: Şeyh Said İsyanı) je bil kurdski nacionalistični in islamistični upor v jugovzhodni Anatoliji od februarja do marca 1925, ki ga je vodil šejk Said ob podpori gibanja Azadî ter krajevnih verskih in fevdalnih voditeljev proti novoustanovljeni posvetni Republiki Turčiji. Upor so vodili večinoma Zaze, podprli pa so ga tudi nekateri sosednji Kurdi, ki govorijo kurmandži.
O verskem in nacionalističnem ozadju upora šejka Saida raziskovalci razpravljajo. Robert W. Olson ga je opisal kot »prvi obsežen nacionalistični upor Kurdov«.

source.title: Sheikh Said rebellion
paragraphs: The Sheikh Said rebellion (Kurdish: Serhildana Şêx Seîd; Turkish: Şeyh Said İsyanı) was a Kurdish nationalist and Islamist rebellion in Southeast Anatolia from February to March 1925 led by Sheikh Said and with support of the Azadî movement and local religious and feudal leaders against the newly-founded secular Republic of Turkey. The rebellion was mostly led by Zazas, but also gained support among some of the neighboring Kurmanji-speaking Kurds in the region.

The religious and nationalist background of the Sheikh Said rebellion has been debated by the scholars. The rebellion was described as "the first large-scale nationalist rebellion by the Kurds" by Robert W. Olson.

Siege of Abadan.headline: Obleganje Abadana
paragraphs: Obleganje Abadana je bilo obkolitev mesta, ki so jo iraške sile začele novembra 1980. Mesto so skoraj vsak dan bombardirali že od prvih dni vojne, ki se je začela septembra prej.
Na otoku Abadan je stala rafinerija Abadan, ena največjih naftnih rafinerij na svetu.

source.title: Siege of Abadan
paragraphs: The siege of Abadan was the encirclement of the city by Iraqi forces beginning in November 1980. The city had already been under almost daily bombardment since the early days of the war, which began the previous September.
Abadan Island was the site of the Abadan Refinery, one of the world's largest oil refineries.

Obleganje Akre je bilo prvi pomembni protinapad jeruzalemskega kralja Guya proti Saladinu, sultanu Egipta in Sirije. To prelomno obleganje je bilo del tega, kar so pozneje poimenovali tretja križarska vojna. Trajalo je od avgusta 1189 do julija 1191; zaradi obalne lege mesta ga latinski napadalci niso mogli povsem zavzeti, Saladin pa ga ni mogel povsem osvoboditi, saj sta obe strani dobivali zaloge in sredstva po morju. Končalo se je s ključno zmago križarjev in hudim udarcem za Saladinovo namero, da bi uničil križarske države.

source.title: Siege of Acre (1189–1191)
paragraphs: The siege of Acre was the first significant counterattack by Guy of Jerusalem against Saladin, Sultan of Egypt and Syria. This pivotal siege formed part of what later became known as the Third Crusade. The siege lasted from August 1189 until July 1191, at which time the city's coastal position meant the attacking Latin forces were unable to fully capture the city and Saladin was unable to fully relieve it, with both sides receiving supplies and resources by sea. It concluded as a key victory for the Crusaders and a serious setback for Saladin's ambition to destroy the Crusader states.

Obleganje Akre (imenovano tudi padec Akre) je potekalo leta 1291 in se končalo tako, da so križarji Akro izgubili v korist egiptovskega mameluškega sultanata. Velja za eno najpomembnejših bitk tistega obdobja. Čeprav se je križarsko gibanje nadaljevalo še več stoletij, je zavzetje mesta pomenilo konec nadaljnjih križarskih vojn v Levantu. S padcem Akre so križarji izgubili zadnje veliko oporišče križarskega Jeruzalemskega kraljestva.

source.title: Siege of Acre (1291)
paragraphs: The siege of Acre (also called the fall of Acre) took place in 1291 and resulted in the Crusaders' losing control of Acre to the Mamluk Sultanate of Egypt. It is considered one of the most important battles of the period. Although the crusading movement continued for several more centuries, the capture of the city marked the end of further crusades to the Levant. When Acre fell, the Crusaders lost their last major stronghold of the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem.

Obleganje Akre leta 1799 je bilo neuspešno francosko obleganje osmanskega mesta Akra in je bilo skupaj z bitko na Nilu prelomnica Napoleonove invazije na Egipt in Sirijo. Bil je Napoleonov tretji taktični poraz v karieri – tri leta prej je bil med italijansko kampanjo poražen v drugi bitki pri Bassanu in v bitki pri Caldieru – ter njegov prvi veliki strateški poraz, hkrati pa zadnjič za 10 let, da je bil poražen v bitki. Po spodletelem obleganju se je Napoleon dva meseca pozneje umaknil v Egipt.

source.title: Siege of Acre (1799)
paragraphs: The siege of Acre of 1799 was an unsuccessful French siege of the Ottoman city of Acre and was the turning point of Napoleon's invasion of Egypt and Syria, along with the Battle of the Nile. It was Napoleon's third tactical defeat in his career, being defeated at the Second Battle of Bassano and the Battle of Caldiero three years previously during the Italian campaign, and his first major strategic defeat, along with the last time he was defeated in battle for 10 years. As a result of the failed siege, Napoleon retreated two months later and withdrew to Egypt.

Siege of Adrianople (1912–1913).headline: Obleganje Odrina (1912–1913)
paragraphs: Obleganje Odrina (bolgarsko: oбсада на Одрин, obsada na Odrin; srbsko: oпсада Једрена, opsada Jedrena; turško: Edirne kuşatması) je potekalo med prvo balkansko vojno. Začelo se je 3. novembra 1912 in končalo 26. marca 1913, ko sta bolgarska 2. armada in srbska 2. armada zavzeli Edirne (Odrin).

Izguba Odrina je osmanski vojski zadala zadnji odločilni udarec in končala prvo balkansko vojno. Mirovno pogodbo so podpisali v Londonu 30. maja. Osmani so mesto med drugo balkansko vojno znova zasedli in ga obdržali.

Zmagovit konec obleganja je veljal za velikanski vojaški uspeh, saj so obrambo mesta skrbno zasnovali vodilni nemški strokovnjaki za obleganja in so jo imeli za »nepremagljivo«. Zavezniki so osmansko trdnjavo zavzeli po petih mesecih obleganja in dveh drznih nočnih napadih.

source.title: Siege of Adrianople (1912–1913)
paragraphs: The siege of Adrianople (Bulgarian: oбсада на Одрин, obsada na Odrin; Serbian: oпсада Једрена, opsada Jedrena; Turkish: Edirne kuşatması), was fought during the First Balkan War. The siege began on 3 November 1912 and ended on 26 March 1913 with the capture of Edirne (Adrianople) by the Bulgarian 2nd Army and the Serbian 2nd Army.

The loss of Edirne delivered the final decisive blow to the Ottoman army and brought the First Balkan War to an end. A treaty was signed in London on 30 May. The city was reoccupied and retained by the Ottomans during the Second Balkan War.

The victorious end of the siege was considered to be an enormous military success because the city's defenses had been carefully developed by leading German siege experts and called 'undefeatable'. The allies, after five months of siege and two bold night attacks, took the Ottoman stronghold.
Obleganje Alepa, bizantinske trdnjave in enega redkih preostalih bizantinskih gradov na severu Levanta po odločilni bitki pri Jarmuku, je potekalo med avgustom in oktobrom 637.

source.title: Siege of Aleppo (637)
paragraphs: The siege of Aleppo, the Byzantine stronghold and one of the few remaining Byzantine castles in the northern Levant after the decisive Battle of Yarmouk, was laid between August and October 637.

Obleganje Aleksandrije (17. avgusta – 2. septembra 1801) je med francoskimi revolucionarnimi vojnami potekalo med francoskimi in britanskimi silami. Bilo je zadnje dejanje francoske invazije na Egipt in Sirijo (1798–1801). Francozi so Aleksandrijo, veliko utrjeno pristaniško mesto v nilski delti na severu Egipta, zasedali od 2. julija 1798, tamkajšnja posadka pa se je vdala 2. septembra 1801.

source.title: Siege of Alexandria (1801)
paragraphs: The siege of Alexandria (17 August – 2 September 1801) was fought during the French Revolutionary Wars between French and British forces. It was the last action of the French invasion of Egypt and Syria (1798–1801). The French had occupied Alexandria, a major fortified harbour city on the Nile Delta in northern Egypt, since 2 July 1798, and the garrison there surrendered on 2 September 1801.

Obleganje Aleksandrije je bilo vrsta prask in bitk med silami Julija Cezarja, Kleopatre VII., Arsinoje IV. in Ptolemaja XIII. v letih 48 in 47 pr. n. št. Cezar se je v tem času bojeval v državljanski vojni proti preostalim republikanskim silam.
Obleganje so prekinile okrepitve, ki so prispele iz Sirije. Po bitki, v kateri so tem silam skušali preprečiti prehod čez nilsko delto, so bile sile Ptolemaja XIII. in Arsinoje poražene.

source.title: Siege of Alexandria (47 BC)
paragraphs: The siege of Alexandria was a series of skirmishes and battles occurring between the forces of Julius Caesar, Cleopatra VII, Arsinoe IV, and Ptolemy XIII, between 48 and 47 BC. During this time Caesar was engaged in a civil war against remaining Republican forces.
The siege was lifted by relief forces arriving from Syria. After a battle contesting those forces' crossing of the Nile delta, Ptolemy XIII and Arsinoe's forces were defeated.

Obleganje Amide je bilo obkolitev rimskega utrjenega obmejnega mesta Amida (današnji Diyarbakır v Turčiji), ki jo je izvedel Sasanidski imperij. Potekalo je leta 359 n. št., ko je sasanidska vojska pod kraljem Šapurjem II. vdrla v vzhodne province Rimskega cesarstva. Šapur je hotel izkoristiti odsotnost rimskega cesarja Konstancija II., ki je urejal razmere na zahodu cesarstva. Mesto je padlo po 73 dneh obleganja.

source.title: Siege of Amida (359)
paragraphs: The siege of Amida was a military investment of the Roman fortified frontier city of Amida (modern Diyarbakır, Turkey) by the Sasanian Empire. It took place in AD 359 when the Sasanian army under king Shapur II invaded the eastern provinces of the Roman Empire. Shapur wanted to exploit the absence of the Roman Emperor Constantius II who was overseeing affairs in the western part of the Empire. The city fell after a siege of 73 days.

Siege of Antioch (1268).headline: Obleganje Antiohije (1268)
paragraphs: Obleganje Antiohije se je zgodilo leta 1268, ko je mameluškemu sultanatu pod Bajbarsom končno uspelo zavzeti mesto Antiohijo. Pred obleganjem se križarska kneževina izgube mesta ni zavedala, kar je pokazalo tudi to, da je Bajbars k voditelju nekdanje križarske države poslal pogajalce in se posmehoval njegovi uporabi besede »knez« v nazivu antiohijski knez.

source.title: Siege of Antioch (1268)
paragraphs: The siege of Antioch occurred in 1268 when the Mamluk Sultanate under Baybars finally succeeded in capturing the city of Antioch. Prior to the siege, the Crusader Principality was oblivious to the loss of the city, as demonstrated when Baybars sent negotiators to the leader of the former Crusader state and mocked his use of "Prince" in the title Prince of Antioch.

Obleganje Aškelona je potekalo od 25. januarja do 22. avgusta 1153, v obdobju med drugo in tretjo križarsko vojno, in se je končalo tako, da je Jeruzalemsko kraljestvo zavzelo fatimidsko egiptovsko trdnjavo. Aškelon je bil pomemben grad, iz katerega so Fatimidi vpadali na ozemlje križarskega kraljestva, do leta 1153 pa je bil zadnje obalno mesto v Palestini, ki ga križarji niso nadzorovali.

source.title: Siege of Ascalon
paragraphs: The siege of Ascalon took place from 25 January to 22 August 1153, in the time period between the Second and Third Crusades, and resulted in the capture of the Fatimid Egyptian fortress by the Kingdom of Jerusalem. Ascalon was an important castle that was used by the Fatimids to launch raids into the Crusader kingdom's territory, and by 1153 it was the last coastal city in Palestine that was not controlled by the Crusaders.

Siege of Baghdad (1638).headline: Obleganje Bagdada (1638)
paragraphs: Obleganje Bagdada (perzijsko: محاصره بغداد) pozimi 1638 je po obdobju safavidske oblasti znova vzpostavilo osmanski nadzor nad Irakom. Bilo je del osmansko-safavidske vojne v letih 1623–1639.

source.title: Siege of Baghdad (1638)
paragraphs: The siege of Baghdad (Persian: محاصره بغداد) in the winter of 1638 marked the re-establishment of Ottoman control over Iraq, following a prior period of Safavid rule. It was part of the Ottoman–Safavid War of 1623–1639.

Siege of Baghdad (1821).headline: Obleganje Bagdada (1821)
paragraphs: Osmansko-perzijska vojna v letih 1820–1823 je od leta 1820 do 1823 potekala med Osmanskim cesarstvom in kadžarskim Iranom.

source.title: Ottoman–Persian War (1820–1823)
paragraphs: The Ottoman–Persian War of 1820–1823 was fought between the Ottoman Empire and Qajar Iran from 1820 to 1823.

Siege of Banu Qaynuqa.headline: Obleganje Banu Kajnuka
paragraphs: Obleganje Banu Kajnuka je potekalo aprila 624. Banu Kajnuka so bili judovsko pleme, ki ga je islamski prerok Mohamed izgnal, ker je prelomilo pogodbo, znano kot medinska ustava.

source.title: Siege of Banu Qaynuqa
paragraphs: The siege of Banu Qaynuqa occurred in April 624. The Banu Qaynuqa were a Jewish tribe expelled by the Islamic prophet Muhammad for breaking the treaty known as the Constitution of Medina.

Siege of Basra.headline: Obleganje Basre
paragraphs: Obleganje Basre, s kodnim imenom operacija Karbala-5 ali velika žetev (arabsko: الحصاد الأكبر), je bilo napadalna operacija, s katero je Iran v začetku leta 1987 skušal zavzeti iraško pristaniško mesto Basra. Bitka, znana po ogromnih izgubah in krutih razmerah, je bila največja bitka vojne in se je izkazala za zadnjo veliko iransko ofenzivo. Iranci cilja niso dosegli.

source.title: Siege of Basra
paragraphs: The siege of Basra, code-named Operation Karbala-5 or The Great Harvest (Arabic: الحصاد الأكبر), was an offensive operation carried out by Iran in an effort to capture the Iraqi port city of Basra in early 1987. This battle, known for its extensive casualties and ferocious conditions, was the biggest battle of the war and proved to be the last major Iranian offensive. The Iranians failed to reach their objective.

Siege of Beirut.headline: Obleganje Bejruta
paragraphs: Med libanonsko vojno leta 1982 je Izrael oblegal Bejrut, potem ko je propadlo premirje, ki so ga Združeni narodi uveljavili med libanonsko državljansko vojno. Dva meseca dolgo obleganje, ki se je začelo sredi junija, je zahtevalo na tisoče civilnih žrtev in se končalo z izgonom Palestinske osvobodilne organizacije (PLO) iz Bejruta in preostalega Libanona.

source.title: Siege of Beirut
paragraphs: During the 1982 Lebanon War, the city of Beirut was besieged by Israel following the breakdown of the ceasefire that had been imposed by the United Nations amidst the Lebanese Civil War. Beginning in mid-June, the two-month-long siege resulted in thousands of civilian deaths and the expulsion of the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) from Beirut and the rest of Lebanon.

Siege of Bursa.headline: Obleganje Burse
paragraphs: Obleganje Burse (osmansko turško: فتحِ بورصه, Feth-i Bursa) je trajalo od leta 1317 do zavzetja Burse 6. aprila 1326, ko so osmanski Turki izvedli drzen načrt za zavzetje mesta, ki se je tedaj imenovalo Prusa. Osmani pred tem še niso zavzeli nobenega mesta; ker jim je na tej stopnji vojne manjkalo znanja in primerne oblegovalne opreme, je mesto padlo šele po šestih ali devetih letih.

Zgodovinar Laonik Halkokondil piše, da so Osmani za zavzetje mesta izkoristili bizantinsko državljansko vojno v letih 1321–1328: »Andronik se je odločil, da bo prestol zasedel sam, saj se je njegov ded že postaral, in tako sta se sprla. Bil je preveč trmast, da bi se podredil, in je povzročal neskončne težave. Pripeljal je Srbe in se v boju za prestol povezal z vodilnimi Grki. Zato niso mogli ničesar storiti, da bi Turkom preprečili prehod v Evropo. Prav v tem času je Osman oblegal Pruso, jo izstradal in zavzel, zavzeli pa so tudi druga mesta v Mali Aziji.«

source.title: Siege of Bursa
paragraphs: The Siege of Bursa (Ottoman Turkish: فتحِ بورصه, romanized: Feth-i Bursa) took place from 1317 until the capture of Bursa on 6 April 1326, when the Ottoman Turks deployed a bold plan to seize the city, which was back then known as Prusa. The Ottomans had not captured a city before; the lack of expertise and adequate siege equipment at this stage of the war meant that the city fell only after six or nine years.

The historian, Laonikos Chalkokondyles, notes that the Ottomans took advantage of the Byzantine civil war of 1321–1328 to capture the city: "Andronikos decided that he should hold the throne himself, as his grandfather had already grown old, and so they fell out with each other. He was too stubborn to submit and caused endless trouble. He brought in the Serbs and allied himself with the leading Greeks in his struggle for the throne. As a result they could do nothing to prevent the Turks from crossing over into Europe. It was at this time that Prusa was besieged, starved out, and taken by Osman, and other cities in Asia Minor were also captured."

Siege of Constantinople (1203).headline: Obleganje Carigrada (1203)
paragraphs: Obleganje Carigrada leta 1203 je bilo ključno dejanje četrte križarske vojne, s katerim se je začelo zaporedje dogodkov, ki je nazadnje pripeljalo do padca bizantinske prestolnice. Križarji, ki so se oddaljili od prvotnega cilja, ponovne osvojitve Jeruzalema, so se znašli v Carigradu, kjer so podprli odstavljenega cesarja Izaka II. Angela in njegovega sina Alekseja IV. Angela. Oblegovalne sile, sestavljene predvsem iz zahodnoevropskih vitezov, so sprva doživljale neuspehe, njihova odločnost in napredno oblegovalno orožje pa sta bila ključna pri pritisku na bizantinske branilce.

Sredi kaosa je bil bizantinski cesar strmoglavljen, kar je ustvarilo praznino moči in pripravilo oder za zloglasnejše dogodke leta 1204, ko so križarji, ogorčeni zaradi neplačanih dolgov in političnih pretresov, mesto nazadnje oplenili. Takrat je Carigrad prvič v skoraj devetih stoletjih padel v roke zunanje sile, kar je za vselej spremenilo tok bizantinske zgodovine.

source.title: Siege of Constantinople (1203)
paragraphs: The siege of Constantinople in 1203 was a crucial episode of the Fourth Crusade, marking the beginning of a series of events that would ultimately lead to the fall of the Byzantine capital. The crusaders, diverted from their original mission to reclaim Jerusalem, found themselves in Constantinople, in support of the deposed emperor Isaac II Angelos and his son Alexios IV Angelos. The besieging forces, primarily composed of Western European knights faced initial setbacks, but their determination and advanced siege weaponry played a pivotal role in pressuring the Byzantine defenders.

Amidst the chaos, the Byzantine emperor was overthrown, leading to a power vacuum and setting the stage for the more infamous events of 1204 when the crusaders, frustrated by unpaid debts and political turmoil, eventually sacked the city. This marked the first time in nearly nine centuries that Constantinople fell to an external force, forever altering the course of Byzantine history.

Siege of Constantinople (1235–1236).headline: Obleganje Carigrada (1235–1236)
paragraphs: Obleganje Carigrada je potekalo med letom 1235 in koncem leta 1236, ko je združena bolgarsko-nikejska vojska pod vodstvom bolgarskega carja Ivana Asena II. in nikejskega cesarja Ivana III. Duke Vataca neuspešno oblegala prestolnico Latinskega cesarstva.

source.title: Siege of Constantinople (1235–1236)
paragraphs: The siege of Constantinople took place between 1235 and late 1236 when a joint Bulgarian–Nicaean army led by Tsar Ivan Asen II of Bulgaria and Emperor of Nicaea John III Doukas Vatatzes conducted an unsuccessful siege of the capital of the Latin Empire.

Siege of Constantinople (1260).headline: Obleganje Carigrada (1260)
paragraphs: Obleganje Carigrada leta 1260 je bilo spodleteli poskus Nikejskega cesarstva, glavnega ostanka razpadlega Bizantinskega cesarstva, da bi Carigrad iztrgalo Latinskemu cesarstvu in ga znova vzpostavilo kot politično, kulturno in duhovno prestolnico obnovljenega Bizantinskega cesarstva.

source.title: Siege of Constantinople (1260)
paragraphs: The siege of Constantinople in 1260 was the failed attempt by the Nicene Empire, the major remnant of the fractured Byzantine Empire, to retake Constantinople from the Latin Empire and re-establish the City as the political, cultural and spiritual capital of a revived Byzantine Empire.

Siege of Constantinople (1394–1402).headline: Obleganje Carigrada (1394–1402)
paragraphs: Obleganje Carigrada od leta 1394 do 1402 je bilo dolga blokada prestolnice Bizantinskega cesarstva, ki jo je izvajal osmanski sultan Bajazid I. Hitra osmanska osvajanja na Balkanu so mesto že leta 1391 odrezala od zaledja. Ko je Bajazid zgradil trdnjavo Anadoluhisarı za nadzor nad Bosporsko ožino, je mesto skušal izstradati in prisiliti k predaji z blokado s kopnega in, manj uspešno, z morja.

source.title: Siege of Constantinople (1394–1402)
paragraphs: The siege of Constantinople from 1394 to 1402 was a long blockade of the capital of the Byzantine Empire by the Ottoman sultan Bayezid I. Already in 1391, the rapid Ottoman conquests in the Balkans had cut off the city from its hinterland. After constructing the fortress of Anadoluhisarı to control the Bosporus strait, Bayezid tried to starve the city into submission by blockading it both by land and, less effectively, by sea.

Siege of Constantinople (1411).headline: Obleganje Carigrada (1411)
paragraphs: Obleganje Carigrada leta 1411 je potekalo v osmanskem medvladju ali osmanski državljanski vojni (20. julija 1402 – 5. julija 1413), potem ko je srednjeazijski vojskovodja Timur premagal sultana Bajazida I. Čeprav je Timur po bitki pri Ankari Mehmeda Çelebija potrdil za sultana, njegovi bratje İsa Çelebi, Musa Çelebi, Süleyman Çelebi in pozneje Mustafa Çelebi njegove oblasti niso priznali in so si vsak zase lastili prestol. Posledica je bila državljanska vojna. Medvladje je trajalo do bitke pri Çamurluju 5. julija 1413, ko je Mehmed Çelebi zmagal v sporu, se okronal za sultana Mehmeda I. in cesarstvu vrnil mir.

source.title: Siege of Constantinople (1411)
paragraphs: The siege of Constantinople of 1411 occurred during the Ottoman Interregnum, or Ottoman Civil War, (20 July 1402 – 5 July 1413), following the defeat of Sultan Bayezid I by the Central Asian warlord Timur. Although Mehmed Çelebi was confirmed as sultan by Timur after the Battle of Ankara, his brothers İsa Çelebi, Musa Çelebi, Süleyman Çelebi, and later, Mustafa Çelebi, refused to recognize his authority, each claiming the throne for himself. A civil war was the result. The Interregnum lasted until the Battle of Camurlu on 5 July 1413, when Mehmed Çelebi emerged as victor in the strife, crowned himself sultan Mehmed I, and restored peace to the empire.

Siege of Constantinople (1422).headline: Obleganje Carigrada (1422)
paragraphs: Leta 1422 je Osmansko cesarstvo oblegalo Carigrad, prestolnico Bizantinskega cesarstva, ker se je bizantinski cesar Manuel II. po smrti Mehmeda I. leta 1421 skušal vmešati v nasledstvo osmanskih sultanov. Bizantinci so s takšno politiko pogosto uspešno slabili sosede.

Ko je kot zmagoviti očetov naslednik obveljal Murad II., je vkorakal na bizantinsko ozemlje. Turki so do obleganja leta 1422 prvič dobili lastne topove, »sokole«, kratke, a široke topove. Tehnološko sta bili strani izenačeni, Turki pa so morali graditi barikade, »da bi prestregli … kamne iz bombard«.

source.title: Siege of Constantinople (1422)
paragraphs: In 1422, the Ottoman Empire laid siege to Constantinople, the capital of the Byzantine Empire, as a result of the Byzantine Emperor Manuel II's attempts to interfere in the succession of Ottoman Sultans, after the death of Mehmed I in 1421. This policy of the Byzantines was often used successfully in weakening their neighbours.

When Murad II emerged as the winning successor to his father, he marched into Byzantine territory. The Turks had acquired their own cannon for the first time by the siege of 1422, "falcons", which were short but wide cannons. The two sides were evenly matched technologically, and the Turks had to build barricades "in order to receive... the stones of the bombards".

Siege of Constantinople (813).headline: Obleganje Carigrada (813)
paragraphs: Obleganje Carigrada leta 813 (bolgarsko: Обсада на Константинопол), ki ga je izvedel kan Krum (bolgarsko: Крум), je bilo spodleteli poskus zavzetja mesta med bizantinsko-bolgarskimi vojnami.

source.title: Siege of Constantinople (813)
paragraphs: The siege of Constantinople in 813 (Bulgarian: Обсада на Константинопол) by Khan Krum (Bulgarian: Крум) was a failed attempt to take the city during the Byzantine–Bulgarian wars.

Siege of Ctesiphon (637).headline: Obleganje Ktezifona (637)
paragraphs: Obleganje Ktezifona je potekalo od januarja do marca 637, kmalu potem, ko je pravoverni kalifat v bitki pri Al Kadisiji premagal Sasanidski imperij. Ker je bil Ktezifon perzijska prestolnica že od partskega obdobja, je bila zmaga kalifata pri Ktezifonu eden najpomembnejših dogodkov muslimanske osvojitve Perzije: muslimanska oblast se je utrdila nad vso Mezopotamijo. Zmaga pri obleganju je pripravila tudi pot nadaljnjim muslimanskim vdorom v perzijsko notranjost, kamor se je umaknila sasanidska vojska.

source.title: Siege of Ctesiphon (637)
paragraphs: The siege of Ctesiphon took place from January to March 637, shortly after the Rashidun Caliphate defeated the Sasanian Empire in the Battle of al-Qadisiyyah. As it had served as the Persian capital city since the Parthian period, the Rashidun victory at Ctesiphon was one of the most significant events of the Muslim conquest of Persia; Muslim rule was consolidated over all of Mesopotamia. The victory of the Rashidun army during this siege also set the stage for further Muslim invasions of the Persian mainland, where the Sasanian army found itself confined.

Siege of Damascus (1148).headline: Obleganje Damaska (1148)
paragraphs: Obleganje Damaska je med drugo križarsko vojno potekalo med 24. in 28. julijem 1148 (po starem koledarju). Dve križarski vojski iz Evrope in vojska križarskega Jeruzalemskega kraljestva sta skušali oblegati Damask, mesto Seldžuškega imperija. Poskus se je končal s porazom križarjev. Bitka se je zgodila, ko je razpadalo zavezništvo med Jeruzalemskim kraljestvom in Muin ad Dinom Unurjem, emirjem Damaska, križarska Edeška grofija pa je padala v roke Imad ad Dina Zengija, emirja seldžuškega Alepa.

Med krščanskimi vojskami iz zahodne Evrope, ki so se odzvale pozivu h križarski vojni za ponovno zavzetje Edese, sta bili vojski francoskega kralja Ludvika VII. in Konrada III., rimskega kralja v Svetem rimskem cesarstvu. Oba sta večino vojske izgubila med prečkanjem Anatolije.

source.title: Siege of Damascus (1148)
paragraphs: The siege of Damascus took place between 24 and 28 July 1148 O.S. during the Second Crusade. Two Crusader armies from Europe and the army of the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem attempted to lay siege to the Seljuk Empire city of Damascus. The effort ended in a Crusader defeat. The battle occurred as the alliance between the Kingdom of Jerusalem and Mu'in ad-Din Unur, emir of the city of Damascus, was unraveling and the Crusader County of Edessa was falling to Imad al-Din Zengi, emir of the Seljuk city of Aleppo.

Among the Christian armies from Western Europe which responded to the call for a crusade to retake Edessa were armies led Louis VII, King of France, and Conrad III, King of the Romans in the Holy Roman Empire. Both lost the majority of their forces crossing Anatolia.

Siege of Damascus (1400).headline: Obleganje Damaska (1400)
paragraphs: Obleganje Damaska (znano tudi kot plenjenje Damaska in zavzetje Damaska) je bilo velik dogodek v letih 1400–1401 med vojno med Timuridskim imperijem in mameluškim sultanatom.

source.title: Siege of Damascus (1400)
paragraphs: The siege of Damascus (also known as the Sack of Damascus and the Capture of Damascus) was a major event in 1400–01 during the war between the Timurid Empire and the Mamluk Sultanate.

Siege of Damascus (634).headline: Obleganje Damaska (634)
paragraphs: Obleganje Damaska (634) je trajalo od 21. avgusta do 19. septembra 634, ko je mesto padlo v roke pravovernega kalifata. Damask je bil prvo veliko mesto Vzhodnega rimskega cesarstva, ki je padlo med muslimansko osvojitvijo Sirije.

Zadnja rimsko-perzijska vojna se je končala leta 628, potem ko je Heraklij uspešno končal pohod proti Perzijcem v Mezopotamiji. Hkrati je Mohamed pod zastavo islama združil Arabce. Po njegovi smrti leta 632 ga je kot prvi kalif nasledil Abu Bakr, ki je zatrl več notranjih uporov in hotel razširiti oblast zunaj meja Arabskega polotoka.

source.title: Siege of Damascus (634)
paragraphs: The siege of Damascus (634) lasted from 21 August to 19 September 634 before the city fell to the Rashidun Caliphate. Damascus was the first major city of the Eastern Roman Empire to fall in the Muslim conquest of Syria.

The last of the Roman–Persian Wars ended in 628, after Heraclius concluded a successful campaign against the Persians in Mesopotamia. At the same time, Muhammad united the Arabs under the banner of Islam. After his death in 632, Abu Bakr succeeded him as the first caliph. Suppressing several internal revolts, Abu Bakr sought to expand the empire beyond the confines of the Arabian Peninsula.

Siege of Damietta (1218–1219).headline: Obleganje Damiete (1218–1219)
paragraphs: Obleganje Damiete v letih 1218–1219 je bilo del pete križarske vojne, v kateri so križarji napadli egiptovsko pristaniško mesto Damieta. Mesto so oblegali leta 1218, križarji pa so ga zavzeli leta 1219.

Na začetku pete križarske vojne so se dogovorili, da bo vojska skušala zavzeti Damieto ob ustju Nila. Križarji so nameravali mesto nato uporabiti kot izhodišče za južni krak kleščastega napada na Jeruzalem iz Akre in Sueza. Nadzor nad območjem bi jim zagotovil tudi bogastvo za financiranje nadaljevanja križarske vojne in zmanjšal grožnjo egiptovskega ladjevja. Do leta 1221 je bila Damieta izgubljena, ko so križarske sile mesto predale in zapustile Egipt.
Sveti Frančišek Asiški naj bi med obleganjem z egiptovskim sultanom Al Kamilom imel lepo sprejet, a nazadnje neuspešen poskus, da bi ga spreobrnil.

source.title: Siege of Damietta (1218–1219)
paragraphs: The siege of Damietta of 1218–1219 was part of the Fifth Crusade in which the Crusaders attacked the Egyptian port city of Damietta. The city was besieged in 1218 and taken by the Crusaders in 1219.

At the beginning of the Fifth Crusade, it was agreed that a force would attempt to take Damietta, located at the mouth of the river Nile. The Crusaders then planned to use this city as a launching point for the southern portion of a pincer attack upon Jerusalem from Acre and Suez. Control over the area would also provide wealth to finance the continuation of the crusade, and reduce the threat from the Egyptian fleet. By 1221, Damietta was lost when Crusader forces surrendered the city and evacuated Egypt.
St Francis of Assisi is believed to have made a well-received but ultimately unsuccessful attempt to convert Egypt's Sultan al-Kamil during the siege.

Siege of Damietta (1249).headline: Obleganje Damiete (1249)
paragraphs: Obleganje Damiete je potekalo leta 1249 in je bilo del sedme križarske vojne.
Francoski kralj Ludvik IX. se je leta 1249 izkrcal pri Damieti. Ludvik je menil, da bo Egipt oporišče za napad na Jeruzalem, njegovo bogastvo in zaloge žita pa bodo križarje hranile in opremljale.

Damieto so 6. junija zavzeli ob majhnem odporu Egipčanov, ki so se umaknili navzgor po Nilu. Ludvik je iz lesa 24 zaplenjenih egiptovskih trebušetov zgradil palisado okoli celotnega križarskega tabora. Na poplave Nila pa niso računali in kmalu so Ludvika in njegovo vojsko za šest mesecev priklenile v Damieto, kjer so vitezi lenarili in uživali v vojnem plenu. Ludvik ni upošteval dogovora iz pete križarske vojne, da je treba Damieto predati Jeruzalemskemu kraljestvu, zdaj le še okrnjeni državi v Akri, je pa tam ustanovil nadškofijo (z Gillesom iz Saumurja, pod oblastjo latinskega jeruzalemskega patriarha Roberta iz Nantesa) in mesto uporabljal kot oporišče za vodenje vojaških operacij proti muslimanom v Siriji.

source.title: Siege of Damietta (1249)
paragraphs: The siege of Damietta occurred in 1249 and was part of the Seventh Crusade.
Louis IX of France landed at Damietta in 1249. Egypt would, Louis thought, provide a base from which to attack Jerusalem, and its wealth and supply of grain would keep the crusaders fed and equipped.

On 6 June Damietta was taken with little resistance from the Egyptians, who withdrew further up the Nile. Louis was able to build a stockade for the whole crusade camp with the wood from 24 captured Egyptian trebuchets. The flooding of the Nile had not been taken into account, however, and it soon grounded Louis and his army at Damietta for six months, where the knights sat back and enjoyed the spoils of war. Louis ignored the agreement made during the Fifth Crusade that Damietta should be given to the Kingdom of Jerusalem, now a rump state in Acre, but he did set up an archbishop there (Gilles of Saumur, under the authority of the Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem, Robert of Nantes) and used the city as a base to direct military operations against the Muslims of Syria.

Siege of Daraa.headline: Obleganje Deraje
paragraphs: Obleganje Deraje je potekalo v okviru protestov arabske pomladi v Siriji leta 2011, v katerih je bila Deraja žarišče nemirov. Sirska vojska je 25. aprila 2011 začela desetdnevno obleganje mesta, operacijo, ki je pripomogla, da je vstaja prerasla v oborožen upor in nato v državljansko vojno.
V obleganju so sodelovali tanki, helikopterji in do 6000 vojakov. Aretirali so več kot 1000 ljudi, ubitih pa je bilo več kot 244 ljudi, med njimi veliko otrok.

source.title: Siege of Daraa
paragraphs: The siege of Daraa occurred within the context of the 2011 Arab Spring protests in Syria, in which Daraa was the center of unrest. On 25 April 2011, the Syrian Army began a ten-day siege of the city, an operation that helped escalate the uprising into an armed rebellion and subsequent civil war.
The Syrian Army's siege involved tanks, helicopters, and up to 6,000 troops. More than 1,000 people were arrested and more than 244 people were killed, many of them children.

Obleganje Dejr ez Zorja je bilo obsežno obleganje, ki ga je borbena skupina Islamska država (IS) izvajala nad več četrtmi mesta Dejr ez Zor, ki so jih držale sile sirske vlade, da bi zavzela mesto in si zagotovila popoln nadzor nad guvernoratom Dejr ez Zor. Obleganje je trajalo skoraj 3 leta in 2 meseca, nato pa je sirska vojska sprožila uspešno ofenzivo, s katero je mesto devet tednov pozneje v celoti znova zavzela.

Aprila 2014 je IS sprožila obsežno ofenzivo proti sirskim uporniškim silam v guvernoratu Dejr ez Zor. Uporniške skupine so bile popolnoma poražene, IS pa je do julija 2014 zavzela skoraj ves guvernorat. Sile sirske vlade so ostale obkoljene v žepu ozemlja, ki so ga še nadzorovale. Sile sirske vlade so obleganje 10. septembra 2017 dokončno prebile. Po nadaljnjih dveh mesecih bojev je sirska arabska vojska do 17. novembra 2017 zavzela dele mesta Dejr ez Zor in okolice, ki jih je držala IS.

source.title: Siege of Deir ez-Zor (2014–2017)
paragraphs: The siege of Deir ez-Zor was a large-scale siege imposed by the Islamic State (IS) militant group against several districts in the city of Deir ez-Zor held by the Syrian government's military forces, in an attempt to capture the city and secure full control of the Deir ez-Zor Governorate. The ISIL siege of the city lasted for almost 3 years and 2 months, after which the Syrian Army launched a successful offensive that fully recaptured the city nine weeks later.

In April 2014, IS launched a large-scale offensive against Syrian rebel forces in Deir ez-Zor governorate. This resulted in the total defeat of rebel groups in Deir ez-Zor governorate, and IS gained control of almost all of Deir ez-Zor Governorate by July 2014. Syrian government forces remained besieged in the pocket of territory they continued to control. On 10 September 2017, the siege was fully broken by Syrian government forces. After another two months of fighting, the Syrian Arab Army captured the IS-held parts of Deir ez-Zor city and its environs, by 17 November 2017.

Siege of Emesa.headline: Obleganje Emese
paragraphs: Sile pravovernega kalifata so Emeso oblegale od decembra 635 do marca 636. Obleganje je pripeljalo do islamske osvojitve Emese, velikega trgovskega mesta Bizantinskega cesarstva v Levantu.

source.title: Siege of Emesa
paragraphs: The siege of Emesa was laid by the forces of the Rashidun Caliphate from December 635 up until March 636. This led to the Islamic conquest of Emesa, which was a major trading city of the Byzantine Empire in the Levant.
Obleganje Famaguste je potekalo v Famagusti pod beneško oblastjo, zadnji krščanski posesti na Cipru. Osmani so Famagusto zavzeli avgusta 1571 po obleganju, ki je trajalo skoraj leto dni.

source.title: Siege of Famagusta
paragraphs: The siege of Famagusta happened in Venetian-controlled Famagusta, the last Christian possession in Cyprus. Famagusta was captured by the Ottomans in August 1571 after a siege that lasted nearly a year.

Obleganje Gaze je v okviru vojn Aleksandra Velikega potekalo oktobra 332 pr. n. št. Končalo se je z makedonsko zmago in koncem 31. egiptovske dinastije, ki je delovala kot satrapija Ahemenidskega perzijskega imperija.

Aleksandru je uspelo prebiti obzidje Gaze z oblegovalnimi stroji, ki jih je prej istega leta uporabil pri obleganju Tira in jih je pripeljal Hefajstion. Po treh neuspešnih juriših je makedonska vojska gaško trdnjavo naskočila in zavzela.

source.title: Siege of Gaza (332 BC)
paragraphs: The siege of Gaza, as part of the Wars of Alexander the Great, took place in October of 332 BC. Resulting in a victory for Macedon, it ended the 31st Dynasty of Egypt, which functioned as a satrapy under the Achaemenid Persian Empire.

Alexander succeeded in breaching the walls of Gaza by utilizing the engines that he had employed earlier that year, during the siege of Tyre brought by Hephaestion. Following three unsuccessful assaults, the Macedonian army was able to storm and take the Gazan stronghold.

Siege of Halicarnassus.headline: Obleganje Halikarnasa
paragraphs: Obleganje Halikarnasa je leta 334 pr. n. št. potekalo med Aleksandrom Velikim in Ahemenidskim perzijskim imperijem. Aleksandra, ki ni imel mornarice, je nenehno ogrožala perzijska mornarica. Ta ga je ves čas skušala izzvati v spopad, a se ji ni hotel ukloniti. Nazadnje je perzijsko ladjevje odplulo v Halikarnas, da bi tam vzpostavilo novo obrambo. Ado iz Karije, nekdanjo kraljico Halikarnasa, je s prestola pregnal njen mlajši brat Piksodar iz Karije. Ko je Piksodar umrl, je perzijski kralj Darej za satrapa Karije, pod katero je spadal tudi Halikarnas, imenoval Orontobata. Ko je leta 334 pr. n. št. prišel Aleksander, mu je Ada, ki je imela v posesti trdnjavo Alinda, trdnjavo predala.

source.title: Siege of Halicarnassus
paragraphs: The siege of Halicarnassus was fought between Alexander the Great and the Achaemenid Persian Empire in 334 BC. Alexander, who had no navy, was constantly being threatened by the Persian navy. It continuously attempted to provoke an engagement with Alexander, who would not oblige them. Eventually, the Persian fleet sailed to Halicarnassus, in order to establish a new defense. Ada of Caria, the former queen of Halicarnassus, had been driven from her throne by her younger brother Pixodarus of Caria. When Pixodarus died, Persian King Darius had appointed Orontobates satrap of Caria, which included Halicarnassus in its jurisdiction. On the arrival of Alexander in 334 BC, Ada, who was in possession of the fortress of Alinda, surrendered the fortress to him.

Siege of Homs.headline: Obleganje Homsa
paragraphs: Obleganje Homsa je bilo vojaški spopad med sirsko vlado in sirsko opozicijo v Homsu, velikem uporniškem oporišču med sirsko državljansko vojno. Obleganje je trajalo tri leta, od maja 2011 do maja 2014, in se je nazadnje končalo z umikom opozicije iz mesta.

Protivladni protesti po vsej državi so se začeli marca 2011, spopadi med varnostnimi silami in protestniki v Homsu pa so se okrepili aprila. V začetku maja 2011 je sirska vojska v Homsu obračunala s protivladnimi protestniki, med katerimi so bili nekateri oboroženi in so streljali na varnostne sile. Vladnim silam je sicer s podobno vojaško operacijo uspelo za nekaj časa zatreti proteste v Deraji marca in aprila, njihova operacija v Homsu v začetku maja pa civilnega odpora ni hitro strla. Do septembra so imeli verski spopadi in prelivanje krvi med alaviti in suniti v nemirih v Homsu večjo vlogo kot drugod po Siriji.

source.title: Siege of Homs
paragraphs: The Siege of Homs was a military confrontation between the Syrian government and the Syrian opposition in the city of Homs, a major rebel stronghold during the Syrian Civil War. The siege lasted three years from May 2011 to May 2014, and ultimately resulted in an opposition withdrawal from the city.

Nationwide anti-government protests began in March 2011, and clashes between security forces and protestors in Homs intensified in April. In early May 2011, the Syrian military conducted a crackdown against anti-government protesters in Homs, some of whom were armed and fired on security forces. Though government forces had succeeded in temporarily quelling the March–April Daraa protests during a similar military operation, their early May operation in Homs failed in quickly subduing the civil resistance. By September, sectarian clashes and bloodshed in Homs between Alawites and Sunnis played a larger role in the Homs unrest than in the rest of Syria.

Siege of Isfahan.headline: Obleganje Isfahana
paragraphs: Obleganje Isfahana (perzijsko: سقوط اصفهان) je bilo šestmesečno obleganje Isfahana, prestolnice iranske dinastije Safavidov, ki ga je izvajala afganistanska vojska pod vodstvom Hotakijev. Trajalo je od marca do oktobra 1722 in se končalo s padcem mesta in začetkom konca safavidske dinastije.

source.title: Siege of Isfahan
paragraphs: The siege of Isfahan (Persian: سقوط اصفهان) was a six-month-long siege of Isfahan, the capital of the Safavid dynasty of Iran, by the Hotaki-led Afghan army. It lasted from March to October 1722 and resulted in the city's fall and the beginning of the end of the Safavid dynasty.

Siege of Jacob's Ford.headline: Obleganje Jakobovega broda
paragraphs: Obleganje Jakobovega broda je bilo zmaga muslimanskega sultana Saladina nad neimenovanim templjarskim kastelanom Jakobovega broda. Zgodilo se je avgusta 1179, ko je Saladin osvojil in porušil Chastelet, nov obmejni grad, ki so ga vitezi templjarji zgradili pri Jakobovem brodu na gornjem toku Jordana, zgodovinskem prehodu med Golansko planoto in severno Galilejo. Jakobov brod je znan tudi z latinskim imenom Vadum Iacob, v sodobni hebrejščini pa kot Ateret. Mnogi raziskovalci menijo, da je ta zgodnejša zmaga napovedala Saladinovo ponovno osvojitev Svete dežele in Jeruzalema leta 1187.

source.title: Siege of Jacob's Ford
paragraphs: The siege of Jacob's Ford was a victory of the Muslim Sultan Saladin over an unnamed Templar Castellan of Jacob's Ford. It occurred in August 1179, when Saladin conquered and destroyed Chastelet, a new border castle built by the Knights Templar at Jacob's Ford on the upper Jordan River, a historic passage point between the Golan Heights and north Galilee. Jacob's Ford is also known by the Latin name of Vadum Iacob and in modern Hebrew as Ateret. Many scholars believe that Saladin's reconquest of the Holy Land and Jerusalem in 1187 was heralded by this earlier victory.

Siege of Jadotville.headline: Obleganje Jadotvilla
paragraphs: Obleganje Jadotvilla je bilo velika bitka med kongovsko krizo, ki se je začela 13. septembra 1961 in trajala pet dni. Manjši kontingent 35. bataljona irske vojske v operaciji Združenih narodov v Kongu (ONUC), označen kot četa »A«, so v oporišču ZN blizu rudarskega mesta Jadotville (današnjega Likasija) oblegale katanške sile, zveste odcepljeni državi Katanga.

Obleganje je potekalo med sedemdnevnim stopnjevanjem sovražnosti med ONUC in katanškimi silami v operaciji Morthor. Kontingent 156 irskih vojakov je odbil več napadov večjih sil, a se je katanškim silam nazadnje predal, ko je ostal brez streliva in vode.
notes: The pronunciation guide is dropped.

source.title: Siege of Jadotville
paragraphs: The Siege of Jadotville ([ʒa.do.vil]) was a major battle during the Congo Crisis, that began on 13 September 1961 and lasted for five days. A small contingent of the Irish Army's 35th Battalion serving under the United Nations Operation in the Congo (ONUC), designated "A" Company, was besieged at the UN base near the mining town of Jadotville (modern-day Likasi) by Katangese forces loyal to the secessionist State of Katanga.

The siege took place during the seven-day escalation of hostilities between ONUC and Katangese forces during Operation Morthor. Although the contingent of 156 Irish soldiers repelled several attacks by a larger force, they eventually surrendered to the Katangese forces after running out of ammunition and water.

Obleganje Jafe je bilo vojaški spopad med francosko vojsko pod vodstvom Napoleona Bonaparta in osmanskimi silami pod vodstvom Ahmeda al Džazarja. Francozi so 3. marca 1799 oblegali mesto Jafa pod osmansko oblastjo. Boji so trajali od 3. do 7. marca, ko so francoske sile mesto zavzele. Zaradi plenjenja mesta, poboja civilnega prebivalstva in usmrtitve 4100 osmanskih vojnih ujetnikov so obleganje označili za »eno najbolj tragičnih epizod [Napoleonove] egiptovske kampanje«.

source.title: Siege of Jaffa
paragraphs: The siege of Jaffa was a military engagement between the French Army under Napoleon Bonaparte and Ottoman forces under Ahmed al-Jazzar. On March 3, 1799, the French laid siege to the city of Jaffa, which was under Ottoman control. It was fought from March 3 to 7, when French forces managed to capture the city. For the pillaging of the city, the murder of its civilian population and the execution of 4,100 Ottoman prisoners of war, the siege has been called "one of the most tragic episodes of [Napoleon's] Egyptian campaign".
Obleganje Jeruzalema leta 1244 je potekalo po šesti križarski vojni, ko je horezmijska vojska 15. julija 1244 osvojila mesto.

source.title: Siege of Jerusalem (1244)
paragraphs: The siege of Jerusalem of 1244 took place after the Sixth Crusade, when a Khwarazmian army conquered the city on July 15, 1244.

Obleganje Jeruzalema v letih 589–587 pr. n. št. je bilo zadnje dejanje judejskih uporov proti Babilonu. Nebukadnezar II., kralj Novobabilonskega cesarstva, je judejsko prestolnico oblegal približno 30 mesecev. Mesto je nazadnje padlo poleti 587 pr. n. št., nato pa so Babilonci Jeruzalem načrtno uničili in Salomonov tempelj zravnali z zemljo. Kraljestvo je prenehalo obstajati, velik del prebivalstva pa so izgnali v Babilonijo.

Konec 7. stoletja pr. n. št. je Judeja postala babilonsko vazalno kraljestvo. Leta 601 pr. n. št. se je judejski kralj Jojakim kljub odločnim svarilom preroka Jeremija uprl babilonski oblasti. Jojakim je umrl iz nepojasnjenih razlogov, nasledil pa ga je sin Jehonija. Leta 597 pr. n. št. so Babilonci oblegali Jeruzalem in mesto se je vdalo. Nebukadnezar je Jeruzalem izropal ter Jehonijo in druge ugledne meščane izgnal v Babilon, za kralja pa je postavil Jehonijevega strica Sedekija. Pozneje je Sedekija ob egiptovski spodbudi sprožil drugi upor, zato so Babilonci poslali vojsko, da bi Jeruzalem znova zavzela.

source.title: Siege of Jerusalem (587 BC)
paragraphs: Jerusalem was besieged from 589–587 BC, marking the final phase of Judah's revolts against Babylon. Nebuchadnezzar II, king of the Neo-Babylonian Empire, besieged Judah's capital city for approximately 30 months. The city ultimately fell in the summer of 587 BC, after which the Babylonians systematically destroyed Jerusalem and razed Solomon's Temple. The kingdom was dissolved, and a large segment of the population was exiled to Babylonia.

During the late 7th century BC, Judah became a vassal kingdom of Babylon. In 601 BC, Jehoiakim, king of Judah, revolted against Babylonian rule despite the strong remonstrances of the prophet Jeremiah. Jehoiakim died for reasons unclear, and was succeeded by his son, Jeconiah. In 597 BC, the Babylonians besieged Jerusalem, and the city surrendered. Nebuchadnezzar pillaged Jerusalem and deported Jeconiah and other prominent citizens to Babylon; Jeconiah's uncle, Zedekiah, was installed as king. Later, encouraged by the Egyptians, Zedekiah launched a second revolt, and a Babylonian army was sent to retake Jerusalem.

Obleganje Jeruzalema (597 pr. n. št.) je bilo vojaški pohod Nebukadnezarja II., kralja Novobabilonskega cesarstva, v katerem je oblegal Jeruzalem, tedanjo prestolnico Judejskega kraljestva. Mesto se je vdalo, njegovega kralja Jehonijo pa so izgnali v Babilon in ga nadomestili z njegovim stricem Sedekijem, ki so ga postavili Babilonci. Obleganje omenjata tako hebrejska Biblija (2 Kr 24,10–16) kot babilonska Nebukadnezarjeva kronika.

Leta 601 pr. n. št. je Nebukadnezar II. neuspešno poskušal zavzeti Egipt in so ga s hudimi izgubami odbili. Judejski kralj Jojakim je priložnost izkoristil za upor proti babilonski oblasti in se kljub odločnim svarilom preroka Jeremija postavil na egiptovsko stran. Okoliščine Jojakimove smrti niso jasne. Nasledil ga je mladoletni sin Jehonija.

source.title: Siege of Jerusalem (597 BC)
paragraphs: The siege of Jerusalem (597 BC) was a military campaign carried out by Nebuchadnezzar II, king of the Neo-Babylonian Empire, in which he besieged Jerusalem, then capital of the Kingdom of Judah. The city surrendered, and its king Jeconiah was deported to Babylon and replaced by his Babylonian-appointed uncle, Zedekiah. The siege is recorded in both the Hebrew Bible (2 Kings 24:10–16) and the Babylonian Nebuchadnezzar Chronicle.

In 601 BC, Nebuchadnezzar II unsuccessfully attempted to take Egypt and was repulsed with heavy losses. Jehoiakim—the king of Judah—seized this opportunity to revolt against Babylonian rule, taking a pro-Egyptian position, despite the strong remonstrances of the prophet Jeremiah. The circumstances of Jehoiakim's death are not clear. He was succeeded by his young son, Jeconiah.

Obleganje Jeruzalema leta 63 pr. n. št. je potekalo med pohodi rimskega vojskovodje Pompeja Velikega na vzhodu, kmalu potem, ko je uspešno končal tretjo mitridatsko vojno. Pompeja so prosili, naj posreduje v sporu o nasledstvu hasmonejskega prestola, ki je prerasel v vojno med Hirkanom II. in Aristobulom II. Z njegovim zavzetjem Jeruzalema je bilo konec samostojne judovske države: Judeja je postala vazalno kraljestvo Rimske republike in pozneje provinca Rimskega cesarstva.

source.title: Siege of Jerusalem (63 BC)
paragraphs: The siege of Jerusalem in 63 BC occurred during the campaigns of Roman general Pompey the Great in the East, shortly after his successful conclusion of the Third Mithridatic War. Pompey had been asked to intervene in a dispute over succession to the Hasmonean throne, which turned into a war between Hyrcanus II and Aristobulus II. His conquest of Jerusalem spelled the end of an independent Jewish state, and thus the incorporation of Judea as a client kingdom of the Roman Republic and later as a province of the Roman Empire.

Obleganje Karsa je bilo zadnja velika operacija krimske vojne. Da bi zmanjšal pritisk na obrambo Sevastopola, je cesar Aleksander II. junija 1855 generalu Nikolaju Muravjovu ukazal, naj s svojimi enotami napade območja osmanskega interesa v Mali Aziji. Muravjov je različne oddelke pod svojim poveljstvom združil v močan korpus s 25.725 vojaki in 96 lahkimi topovi ter se odločil napasti Kars, najpomembnejšo trdnjavo vzhodne Anatolije.

source.title: Siege of Kars
paragraphs: The siege of Kars was the last major operation of the Crimean War. In June 1855, attempting to alleviate pressure on the defence of Sevastopol, Emperor Alexander II ordered General Nikolay Muravyov to lead his troops against areas of Ottoman interest in Asia Minor. Uniting disparate contingents under his command into a strong corps of 25,725 soldiers, 96 light guns, Muravyov decided to attack Kars, the most important fortress of Eastern Anatolia.

Siege of Kerak (1183).headline: Obleganje Keraka (1183)
paragraphs: Grad Kerak, ena najbolj neosvojljivih trdnjav Jeruzalemskega kraljestva, je konec leta 1183 doživel prvo večje obleganje. Saladin, vladar Egipta in Damaska, je Kerak oblegal od začetka novembra 1183, potem ko je njegov gospod Rajnald Châtillonski vpadal na Saladinovo ozemlje.

Saladin se je iz Damaska odpravil 22. oktobra in Kerak oblegal prav takrat, ko je v njem potekala poroka Rajnaldovega pastorka Humfrida IV. Toronskega z Izabelo, polsestro kralja Balduina IV. Rajnald je obleganje skušal zavleči z obrambo obzidanega naselja pred trdnjavo, a je to hitro padlo. Kljub temu uspehu in silovitemu obstreljevanju Saladin ni mogel napredovati, ovirala sta ga namreč globok jarek in gorati teren okoli Keraka. Ko je za obleganje izvedel bolni kralj Balduin, je moral najprej urediti nasledstvo in šele nato zbrati vojsko, ki bi oblegance osvobodila. Po kronanju nečaka Balduina V. je vojsko spremljal do Keraka, poveljstvo pa je prepustil sorodniku, tripolitanskemu grofu Rajmondu III. Saladin se je spopadu s kraljevo vojsko izognil in 3. decembra obleganje opustil.

source.title: Siege of Kerak (1183)
paragraphs: Kerak Castle, one of the most impregnable strongholds in the Kingdom of Jerusalem, underwent its first significant siege in late 1183. Saladin, ruler of Egypt and Damascus, besieged Kerak in early November 1183 after its lord, Raynald of Châtillon, conducted raids of Saladin's lands.

Saladin set out from Damascus on 22 October and besieged Kerak as it hosted the wedding of Raynald's stepson Humphrey IV of Toron and King Baldwin IV's half-sister Isabella. Raynald attempted to delay the siege by defending the walled settlement outside the fortress, but it fell quickly. Despite this success and intense bombardment, Saladin was unable to make progress, hindered by Kerak's deep moat and mountainous terrain. When ailing King Baldwin learned about the siege, he found himself obligated to settle his succession before mustering a relief force. After the coronation of his nephew, Baldwin V, he accompanied his army to Kerak but ceded command to his kinsman Count Raymond III of Tripoli. Saladin refused to engage the royal army and lifted the siege on 3 December.

Siege of Khartoum.headline: Obleganje Kartuma
paragraphs: Obleganje Kartuma (znano tudi kot bitka za Kartum ali padec Kartuma) je potekalo od 13. marca 1884 do 26. januarja 1885. Sudanske mahdistične sile so egiptovski posadki iztrgale mesto Kartum v Sudanu in tako prevzele nadzor nad vsem tursko-egiptovskim Sudanom.

source.title: Siege of Khartoum
paragraphs: The siege of Khartoum (also known as the battle of Khartoum or fall of Khartoum) took place from 13 March 1884 to 26 January 1885. Sudanese Mahdist forces captured the city of Khartoum, Sudan, from its Egyptian garrison, thereby gaining control over the whole of Turco-Egyptian Sudan.

Siege of Kobanî.headline: Obleganje Kobanîja
paragraphs: Obleganje Kobanîja je Islamska država (IS) začela 13. septembra 2014, da bi zavzela kanton Kobanî in njegovo glavno mesto Kobanî (znano tudi kot Kobanê ali Ajn al Arab) na severu Sirije, v dejansko avtonomni regiji Rojava.

Do 2. oktobra 2014 je IS zavzela 350 kurdskih vasi in mest v okolici Kobanêja in sprožila val okoli 300.000 kurdskih beguncev, ki so čez mejo pobegnili v turško provinco Şanlıurfa. Do januarja 2015 se je njihovo število povzpelo na 400.000. Kurdske Enote za ljudsko zaščito (YPG) in nekatere frakcije Svobodne sirske vojske (FSA) (pod skupnim operativnim poveljstvom Evfratov vulkan), pešmerge kurdistanske regionalne vlade ter zračni napadi ameriške vojske in arabskih vojsk, zaveznic ZDA, so začeli Kobane osvobajati.

source.title: Siege of Kobanî
paragraphs: The siege of Kobanî was launched by the Islamic State (IS) on 13 September 2014, in order to capture the Kobanî Canton and its main city of Kobanî (also known as Kobanê or Ayn al-Arab) in northern Syria, in the de facto autonomous region of Rojava.

By 2 October 2014, IS succeeded in capturing 350 Kurdish villages and towns in the vicinity of Kobanê, generating a wave of some 300,000 Kurdish refugees, who fled across the border into Turkey's Şanlıurfa Province. By January 2015, the number had risen to 400,000. The Kurdish People's Protection Units (YPG) and some Free Syrian Army (FSA) factions (under the Euphrates Volcano joint operations room), Peshmerga of the Kurdistan Regional Government, and American and US-allied Arab militaries' airstrikes began to recapture Kobane.

Siege of Kut.headline: Obleganje Kuta
