paragraphs: Obleganje Kut al Amare (7. decembra 1915 – 29. aprila 1916), znano tudi kot prva bitka pri Kutu, je bilo obleganje posadke britanske indijske vojske z 8000 vojaki v mestu Kut 160 km južno od Bagdada, ki ga je izvajala osmanska vojska. Leta 1915 je imelo mesto okoli 6500 prebivalcev. Ko se je posadka 29. aprila 1916 vdala, so preživele odgnali v ujetništvo v Alep in mnogi so med potjo umrli. Zgodovinar Christopher Catherwood je obleganje označil za »najhujši poraz zaveznikov v prvi svetovni vojni«. Deset mesecev pozneje je britanska indijska vojska, ki so jo sestavljali skoraj izključno novi naborniki iz zahodne Indije, ob padcu Bagdada osvojila Kut, Bagdad in vmesna območja.
notes: The miles conversion (100 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Siege of Kut
paragraphs: The siege of Kut Al Amara (7 December 1915 – 29 April 1916), also known as the first battle of Kut, was the besieging of an 8,000-strong British Indian Army garrison in the town of Kut, 160 km (100 mi) south of Baghdad, by the Ottoman Army. In 1915, its population was around 6,500. Following the surrender of the garrison on 29 April 1916, the survivors of the siege were marched to imprisonment at Aleppo, during which many died. Historian Christopher Catherwood has called the siege "the worst defeat of the Allies in World War I". Ten months later, the British Indian Army, consisting almost entirely of newly recruited troops from Western India, conquered Kut, Baghdad and other regions in between in the fall of Baghdad.

Obleganje Lakiša je bilo obleganje in zavzetje mesta Lakiš, ki ga je leta 701 pr. n. št. izvedlo Novoasirsko cesarstvo. Obleganje opisuje več virov, med njimi hebrejska Biblija, asirski dokumenti in lakiški relief, dobro ohranjen niz reliefov, ki je nekoč krasil palačo asirskega kralja Senaheriba v Ninivah.

source.title: Siege of Lachish
paragraphs: The siege of Lachish was the Neo-Assyrian Empire's siege and conquest of the town of Lachish in 701 BC. The siege is documented in several sources including the Hebrew Bible, Assyrian documents and in the Lachish relief, a well-preserved series of reliefs which once decorated the Assyrian king Sennacherib's palace at Nineveh.

Siege of Ladysmith.headline: Obleganje Ladysmitha
paragraphs: Obleganje Ladysmitha je bilo dolgotrajen spopad druge burske vojne, ki je med 2. novembrom 1899 in 28. februarjem 1900 potekal pri Ladysmithu v Natalu.

Po izbruhu vojne oktobra so burske sile vdrle v sosednje britanske kolonije in hitro obkolile obmejna mesta Ladysmith, Kimberley in Mafeking. Pri Ladysmithu so burski oblegovalci obstreljevali mesto in se s posadko neodločeno spopadali, hkrati pa so na reki Tugeli skušali ustaviti britanske reševalne sile pod poveljstvom generala sira Redversa Bullerja. Po spodletelem poskusu prečkanja Tugele med črnim tednom so Britanci 27. februarja prebili obroč, naslednji dan pa so Ladysmith po 118 dneh obleganja osvobodili.

source.title: Siege of Ladysmith
paragraphs: The siege of Ladysmith was a protracted engagement in the Second Boer War, taking place between 2 November 1899 and 28 February 1900 at Ladysmith, Natal.

After the outbreak of war in October, Boer forces invaded neighbouring British colonies and rapidly surrounded the border towns of Ladysmith, Kimberly and Mafeking. At Ladysmith the Boer besiegers bombarded the town and fought inconclusive skirmishes with the garrison whilst attempting to halt British relief forces under General Sir Redvers Buller on the Tugela River. After a failed attempt to cross the Tugela during Black Week, the British broke through on 27 February and Ladysmith was relieved the following day, after a siege of 118 days.

Siege of Ma'arra.headline: Obleganje Maare
paragraphs: Obleganje Maare je med prvo križarsko vojno potekalo konec leta 1098 v mestu Maarat an Numan na ozemlju današnje Sirije. Razvpito je zaradi kanibalizma, ki so ga zagrešili križarji, morda v velikem obsegu.

source.title: Siege of Ma'arra
paragraphs: The siege of Ma'arra occurred in late 1098 in the city of Ma'arrat Nu'man, in what is modern-day Syria, during the First Crusade. It is infamous for cannibalism committed by the Crusaders, possibly on a widespread scale.

Obleganje Mafekinga je bilo 217 dni trajajoče obleganje mesta Mafeking (danes Mahikeng) v Južni Afriki med drugo bursko vojno, od oktobra 1899 do maja 1900. Obleganje je vzbudilo veliko pozornosti, saj sta bila v obleganem mestu lord Edward Cecil, sin britanskega predsednika vlade, in lady Sarah Wilson, hči vojvode Marlborougha in teta Winstona Churchilla. Britanskega poveljnika polkovnika Roberta Baden-Powella je obleganje spremenilo v narodnega junaka. Osvoboditev Mafekinga (odprava obleganja) je imela majhen vojaški pomen, a je dvignila moralo Britancem, ki so se tedaj težko borili.

source.title: Siege of Mafeking
paragraphs: The siege of Mafeking was a 217-day siege battle for the town of Mafeking (now called Mahikeng) in South Africa during the Second Boer War from October 1899 to May 1900. The siege received considerable attention as Lord Edward Cecil, the son of the British prime minister, was in the besieged town, as also was Lady Sarah Wilson, a daughter of the Duke of Marlborough and aunt of Winston Churchill. The siege turned the British commander, Colonel Robert Baden-Powell, into a national hero. The Relief of Mafeking (the lifting of the siege), while of little military significance, was a morale boost for the struggling British.

Siege of Manzikert (1054).headline: Obleganje Manzikerta (1054)
paragraphs: Obleganje Manzikerta leta 1054 je bilo uspešna obramba mesta Manzikert, ki so jo bizantinske sile pod Bazilijem Apokapom izvedle proti Seldžukom pod Tugrilom I.

source.title: Siege of Manzikert (1054)
paragraphs: The Siege of Manzikert in 1054 was a successful defence of the city of Manzikert by Byzantine forces under Basil Apokapes, against the Seljuks under Tughril I.

Siege of Masada.headline: Obleganje Masade
paragraphs: Rimske cesarske sile so trdnjavo Masada na vrhu hriba na ozemlju današnjega Izraela oblegale in zavzele med letoma 72 in 73 n. št., v zadnjem obdobju prve judovsko-rimske vojne. Trdnjavo so tedaj držali pripadniki uporniške skupine sikarijev. Obleganje opisuje en sam sodobni pisni vir, Judovska vojna Jožefa Flavija. Po njegovem pričevanju se je dolgo obleganje končalo z množičnim samomorom sikarijev in judovskih družin, ki so živele v trdnjavi.

V sodobnem času je zgodba o obleganju oživela kot mit o Masadi, izbirno sestavljena pripoved, ki temelji na Jožefovem poročilu. Mitska pripoved je v prvih letih izraelske državnosti postala narodni simbol.

source.title: Siege of Masada
paragraphs: The hilltop fortress of Masada, in present-day Israel, was successfully besieged and taken by Roman imperial forces between 72 and 73 AD, during the final period of the First Jewish–Roman War. At the time, the fortress was held by members of the Sicarii rebel group. The siege is recorded by a single contemporary written source, The Jewish War by Josephus. According to Josephus, the long siege ended with the mass suicide of the Sicarii and resident Jewish families.

In modern times, the story of the siege was revived as the Masada myth, a selectively constructed narrative based on Josephus's account. The mythical narrative became a national symbol in the early years of Israel's nationhood.

Siege of Mecca (683).headline: Obleganje Meke (683)
paragraphs: Obleganje Meke septembra–novembra 683 je bilo ena prvih bitk druge fitne. Meka je bila zatočišče Abdulaha ibn al Zubajra, enega najvidnejših nasprotnikov dednega nasledstva kalifata, ki ga je uveljavljal Jazid I. iz omajadske dinastije. Ko se je proti Jazidu uprla tudi bližnja Medina, drugo sveto mesto islama, je omajadski vladar poslal vojsko, da bi pokorila Hedžas. Omajadska vojska je premagala Medinčane in zavzela mesto, Meka pa je zdržala mesec dni dolgo obleganje, med katerim je Kabo poškodoval ogenj. Obleganje se je končalo, ko je prišla novica o Jazidovi nenadni smrti. Omajadski poveljnik Husajn ibn Numajr al Sakuni je skušal Ibn al Zubajra pregovoriti, naj se z njim vrne v Sirijo in tam sprejme priznanje za kalifa, ko pa mu to ni uspelo, se je s svojimi silami umaknil. Ibn al Zubajr je ves čas državljanske vojne ostal v Meki, a so ga kmalu priznali za kalifa v večini muslimanskega sveta. Šele leta 692 so Omajadi lahko poslali novo vojsko, ki je Meko znova oblegala in zavzela ter s tem končala državljansko vojno.

source.title: Siege of Mecca (683)
paragraphs: The siege of Mecca in September–November 683 was one of the early battles of the Second Fitna. The city of Mecca was a sanctuary for Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr, who was among the most prominent challengers to the hereditary succession to the Caliphate by Yazid I of the Umayyad dynasty. After nearby Medina, the other holy city of Islam, also rebelled against Yazid, the Umayyad ruler sent an army to subdue the Hejaz. The Umayyad army defeated the Medinans and took the city, but Mecca held out in a month-long siege, during which the Kaaba was damaged by fire. The siege ended when news came of Yazid's sudden death. The Umayyad commander, Husayn ibn Numayr al-Sakuni, after failing to induce Ibn al-Zubayr to return with him to Syria and be recognized as Caliph, departed with his forces. Ibn al-Zubayr remained in Mecca throughout the civil war, but he was nevertheless soon acknowledged as Caliph across most of the Muslim world. It was not until 692 that the Umayyads were able to send another army, which again besieged and captured Mecca, ending the civil war.

Siege of Mecca (692).headline: Obleganje Meke (692)
paragraphs: Obleganje Meke od marca do oktobra ali novembra 692 je bilo zadnja bitka druge fitne, v kateri so sile omajadskega kalifa Abd al Malika ibn Marvana oblegale in premagale njegovega tekmeca, kalifa Abdulaha ibn al Zubajra, v središču njegove moči, islamskem svetem mestu Meki. Po smrti kalifa Jazida I. leta 683 so Ibn al Zubajra priznali za kalifa v večini provinc kalifata, Omajadi, ki so kalifatu vladali od konca prve fitne, pa so se morali omejiti na svoje oporišče v Siriji.

source.title: Siege of Mecca (692)
paragraphs: The siege of Mecca in March–October/November 692 was the final battle of the of the Second Fitna, in which the forces of the Umayyad caliph Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan besieged and defeated his rival, the caliph Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr in his center of power, the Islamic holy city of Mecca. Following the death of Caliph Yazid I in 683, Ibn al-Zubayr had been recognized as caliph in most of the provinces of the Caliphate, while the Umayyads, who had ruled the Caliphate since the end of the First Fitna, were confined to their stronghold of Syria.

Siege of Medina.headline: Obleganje Medine
paragraphs: Obleganje Medine je trajalo od 10. junija 1916 do 10. januarja 1919, ko so arabski uporniki iz Hedžasa obkolili islamsko sveto mesto, ki je bilo tedaj pod oblastjo Osmanskega cesarstva.

Osmansko cesarstvo je pod vodstvom sultana Mehmeda V. vstopilo v vojno na strani centralnih sil. Da bi Osmane oslabili, so zavezniki v cesarstvu spodbudili arabski upor, ki ga je vodil mekanski šerif Husein bin Ali.

Šerif Husein je ob podpori britanskih in francoskih agentov zasedel Meko in nato oblegal Medino. Drugo najsvetejše mesto islama je tedaj branil osmanski bataljon pod poveljstvom Fahreddina paše, ki je vztrajal dve leti in sedem mesecev; njegova trdovratna obramba je trajala še potem, ko se je vojna že končala.

source.title: Siege of Medina
paragraphs: The siege of Medina lasted from 10 June 1916 to 10 January 1919, when Hejazi Arab rebels surrounded the Islamic holy city, which was then under the control of the Ottoman Empire.

The Ottoman Empire joined the war on the side of the Central Powers under the leadership of the Ottoman Sultan, Mehmed V. In an attempt to weaken the Ottomans, the Allies provoked an Arab Revolt within the empire led by Sharif Hussein bin Ali of Mecca.

Sharif Hussein, supported by British and French agents, occupied Mecca and later besieged Medina. The second holiest city in Islam was then guarded by an Ottoman battalion led by Fahreddin Pasha, who resisted for two years and seven months, a persistent defense that lasted even after the war had ended.

Siege of Melilla (1774–1775).headline: Obleganje Melille (1774–1775)
paragraphs: Obleganje Melille je bilo poskus Maroškega sultanata ob podpori alžirskih najemnikov, da bi zavzel špansko trdnjavo Melilla na maroški sredozemski obali. Tedanji maroški sultan Mohamed ben Abdulah je decembra 1774 z veliko vojsko maroških kraljevih vojakov in alžirskih najemnikov napadel Melillo. Mesto je branila majhna posadka pod guvernerjem irskega rodu donom Juanom Sherlockom, dokler marca 1775 obleganja ni prekinilo ladjevje z okrepitvami.

source.title: Siege of Melilla (1774–1775)
paragraphs: The siege of Melilla was an attempt by the Sultanate of Morocco, supported by Algerian mercenaries, to capture the Spanish fortress of Melilla on the Moroccan Mediterranean coast. Mohammed ben Abdallah, then Sultan of Morocco, invaded Melilla in December 1774 with a large army of Royal Moroccan soldiers and Algerian mercenaries. The city was defended by a small garrison under Irish-born Governor Don Juan Sherlocke until the siege was lifted by a relief fleet in March 1775.

Siege of Miletus.headline: Obleganje Mileta
paragraphs: Obleganje Mileta je bilo prvo obleganje in prvi pomorski spopad Aleksandra Velikega z Ahemenidskim imperijem. Uperjeno je bilo proti Miletu, mestu v južni Joniji, ki leži v današnji turški provinci Aydın. Parmenionov sin Filota je imel v bitki ključno vlogo pri tem, da perzijska mornarica ni našla varnega sidrišča.

source.title: Siege of Miletus
paragraphs: The siege of Miletus was Alexander the Great's first siege and naval encounter with the Achaemenid Empire. This siege was directed against Miletus, a city in southern Ionia, which is now located in the Aydın province of modern-day Turkey. During the battle, Parmenion's son Philotas would be key in preventing the Persian Navy from finding safe anchorage.

Siege of Nicaea (1113).headline: Obleganje Nikeje (1113)
paragraphs: Obleganje Nikeje leta 1113 je potekalo med bizantinsko-seldžuškimi vojnami.

Potem ko ga je porazila prva križarska vojna, je Rumski sultanat odbil križarsko vojno leta 1101 in znova začel napadati Vzhodno rimsko (Bizantinsko) cesarstvo. Ostareli cesar Aleksej I. Komnen ni mogel obvladati hitrih turških vpadov v preostanek bizantinske Anatolije. Seldžuški Turki pa so bili neuspešni pri obleganju Nikeje, ki so jo izgubili v prvi križarski vojni.

source.title: Siege of Nicaea (1113)
paragraphs: The siege of Nicaea of 1113 occurred in the course of the Byzantine-Seljuk wars.

After suffering defeat at the hands of the First Crusade, the Seljuk Sultanate of Rum beat back the Crusade of 1101 and resumed its offensive operations against the East Roman (Byzantine) Empire. Emperor Alexios I Komnenos, suffering from old age, was unable to deal with the swift Turkish raids into what was left of Byzantine Anatolia. However, the Seljuk Turks were unsuccessful in their siege of Nicaea, which they had lost in the First Crusade.

Siege of Nicaea (1328–1331).headline: Obleganje Nikeje (1328–1331)
paragraphs: Obleganje Nikeje ali obleganje İznika (osmansko turško: فتحِ ازنيق, Feth-i İznik), ki so ga od leta 1328 do 1331 izvajale sile Orhana I., se je končalo z osmansko osvojitvijo ključnega bizantinskega mesta Nikeje (danes İznik). Imelo je pomembno vlogo pri širitvi Osmanskega cesarstva.

source.title: Siege of Nicaea (1328–1331)
paragraphs: The Siege of Nicaea, or Siege of Iznik (Ottoman Turkish: فتحِ ازنيق, romanized: Feth-i İznik), by the forces of Orhan I from 1328 to 1331, resulted in the conquest of the key Byzantine city of Nicaea (nowadays İznik) by the Ottomans. It played an important role in the expansion of the Ottoman Empire.

Siege of Nicaea (727).headline: Obleganje Nikeje (727)
paragraphs: Obleganje Nikeje leta 727 je bilo neuspešen poskus Omajadskega kalifata, da bi zavzel bizantinsko mesto Nikejo, prestolnico teme Opsikion. Odkar kalifatu v letih 717–718 ni uspelo zavzeti bizantinske prestolnice Carigrada, je v bizantinsko Malo Azijo sprožil vrsto vpadov. Leta 727 je arabska vojska pod vodstvom enega od kalifovih sinov prodrla globoko v Malo Azijo, oplenila dve bizantinski trdnjavi in konec julija prispela pred Nikejo. Kljub 40 dni trajajočim nenehnim napadom je mesto zdržalo in Arabci so se umaknili ter vrnili v kalifat. Uspešno odbit napad je močno okrepil kampanjo bizantinskega cesarja Leona III. Izavrijca za odpravo čaščenja ikon v cesarstvu, ki jo je začel malo pred tem; Leon ga je razglasil za dokaz božje naklonjenosti svoji politiki. Obleganje Nikeje pomeni tudi vrhunec omajadskih vpadov, saj so nove grožnje in porazi na oddaljenih mejah drugod zmanjšali moč Omajadov, bizantinska moč pa se je nato okrepila.

source.title: Siege of Nicaea (727)
paragraphs: The siege of Nicaea of 727 was an unsuccessful attempt by the Umayyad Caliphate to capture the Byzantine city of Nicaea, the capital of the Opsician Theme. Ever since its failure to capture the Byzantine Empire's capital, Constantinople, in 717–718, the Caliphate had launched a series of raids into Byzantine Asia Minor. In 727, the Arab army, led by one of the Caliph's sons, penetrated deep into Asia Minor, sacked two Byzantine fortresses and in late July arrived before Nicaea. Despite constant attacks for 40 days, the city held firm and the Arabs withdrew and returned to the Caliphate. The successful repulsion of the attack was a major boost for Byzantine emperor Leo III the Isaurian's recently initiated campaign to abolish the veneration of icons in the Empire; Leo claimed it as evidence of divine favour for his policy. The siege of Nicaea marks also the high point of the Umayyad raids, as new threats and defeats on their far-flung frontiers decreased Umayyad strength elsewhere, while Byzantine power strengthened afterwards.

Siege of Nicomedia.headline: Obleganje Nikomedije
paragraphs: Obleganje Nikomedije ali obleganje İzmita (osmansko turško: فتحِ ازمیت, Feth-i İzmit) je trajalo od leta 1333 do 1337, ko je Orhan oblegal mesto Nikomedija (danes İzmit). Bizantinska posadka se je vdala zaradi pomanjkanja hrane in sredstev. Orhanova zmaga je zapečatila osmanski nadzor nad Bitinijo.

source.title: Siege of Nicomedia
paragraphs: The Siege of Nicomedia, or Siege of Izmit (Ottoman Turkish: فتحِ ازمیت, romanized: Feth-i İzmit), took place from 1333 until 1337, when Orhan laid siege to the city of Nicomedia (now İzmit). The Byzantine garrison surrendered due to lack of food and resources. Orhan's victory sealed Ottoman control of Bithynia.

Siege of Shaizar (1138).headline: Obleganje Šajzarja (1138)
paragraphs: Mesto Šajzar so oblegali od 28. aprila do 21. maja 1138. Zavezniške sile Bizantinskega cesarstva, Antiohijske kneževine in Edeške grofije so vdrle v muslimansko Sirijo. Ko so jih odbili od glavnega cilja, mesta Alep, so združene krščanske vojske z naskokom zavzele več utrjenih naselij in nazadnje oblegale Šajzar, prestolnico emirata Munkiditov. Mesto so zavzeli, citadele pa ne; šajzarski emir je moral plačati odškodnino in postal vazal bizantinskega cesarja. Sile Zengija, najmočnejšega muslimanskega kneza v regiji, so se z zavezniško vojsko spopadale v praskah, a je bila ta premočna, da bi tvegale bitko. Pohod je pokazal, kako omejena je bila bizantinska nadoblast nad severnimi križarskimi državami in kako malo skupnih ciljev so imeli latinski knezi in bizantinski cesar.

source.title: Siege of Shaizar (1138)
paragraphs: The city of Shaizar was besieged from April 28 to May 21, 1138. The allied forces of the Byzantine Empire, Principality of Antioch and County of Edessa invaded Muslim Syria. Having been repulsed from their main objective, the city of Aleppo, the combined Christian armies took a number of fortified settlements by assault and finally besieged Shaizar, the capital of the Munqidhite Emirate. The siege captured the city, but failed to take the citadel; it resulted in the Emir of Shaizar paying an indemnity and becoming the vassal of the Byzantine Emperor. The forces of Zengi, the greatest Muslim prince of the region, skirmished with the allied army, but it was too strong for them to risk battle. The campaign underlined the limited nature of Byzantine suzerainty over the northern Crusader states and the lack of common purpose between the Latin princes and the Byzantine Emperor.

Siege of Sidon.headline: Obleganje Sidona
paragraphs: Obleganje Sidona je potekalo leta 1110, po prvi križarski vojni. Obalno mesto Sidon so zavzele sile jeruzalemskega kralja Balduina I. in norveškega kralja Sigurda I. s pomočjo beneškega doža Ordelafa Faliera.

source.title: Siege of Sidon
paragraphs: The siege of Sidon occurred in 1110 in the aftermath of the First Crusade. The coastal city of Sidon was captured by the forces of Baldwin I of Jerusalem and Sigurd I of Norway, with assistance from the Ordelafo Faliero, Doge of Venice.

Obleganje Taifa je potekalo leta 630 n. št., kmalu po muslimanski zmagi v bitkah pri Hunajnu in Avtasu, ki sta sledili osvojitvi Meke. Mohamed je hotel utrditi nadzor nad Hedžasom, zato se je s svojimi silami odpravil nad utrjeno mesto Taif, oporišče plemena Sakif in dolgoletnega trgovskega tekmeca Meke. Tja se je po porazu pri Hunajnu zateklo veliko preživelih havazinskih bojevnikov z družinami, zato je bil Taif naslednji cilj muslimanskega pohoda. Mesto pa je bilo močno utrjeno, obdano z mogočnim obzidjem in dobro založeno z živili, zato je bilo veliko težji izziv kot spopadi na odprtem polju pri Hunajnu in Avtasu.

source.title: Siege of Ta'if
paragraphs: The Siege of Ta'if took place in 630 CE, shortly after the Muslim victory at the battles of Hunayn and Autas that followed the conquest of Mecca. Seeking to consolidate control over the Hijaz, Muhammad marched with his forces to the fortified city of Ta'if, stronghold of the Thaqif tribe and a long-standing commercial rival of Mecca. Many of the surviving Hawazin warriors and their families had taken refuge there after their defeat at Hunayn, making Ta'if the next target of the Muslim campaign. The city, however, was heavily fortified, surrounded by strong walls and well supplied with provisions, and thus presented a far more difficult challenge than the open-field encounters at Hunayn and Autas.

Siege of Tobruk.headline: Obleganje Tobruka
paragraphs: Obleganje Tobruka je potekalo med 10. aprilom in 27. novembrom 1941, v kampanji v Zahodni puščavi (1940–1943) v drugi svetovni vojni. Nemške in italijanske sile so v severnoafriškem pristanišču Tobruk oblegale zavezniške sile, ki jih je sestavljala predvsem avstralska 9. divizija pod poveljstvom generalpodpolkovnika Leslieja Morsheada. Trdovratne branilce so kmalu poimenovali tobruške podgane. Po 231 dneh jih je nazadnje osvobodila britanska osma armada.

Konec leta 1940 so zavezniki med operacijo Compass (9. decembra 1940 – 9. februarja 1941) premagali italijansko 10. armado in njene ostanke ujeli pri Bedi Fomm. Italijanska posadka Tobruka se je vdala 22. januarja 1941. V začetku leta 1941 pa so velik del britanske Zahodne puščavske sile poslali v grško ter sirsko-libanonsko kampanjo, tako da je ostala le okrnjena sila, ki ji je primanjkovalo opreme in zalog.

source.title: Siege of Tobruk
paragraphs: The siege of Tobruk took place between 10 April and 27 November 1941, during the Western Desert campaign (1940–1943) of the Second World War. An Allied force, consisting mostly of the 9th Australian Division, commanded by Lieutenant-General Leslie Morshead, was besieged in the North African port of Tobruk by German and Italian forces. The tenacious defenders quickly became known as the Rats of Tobruk. After 231 days, they were finally relieved by the British Eighth Army.

In late 1940, the Allies had defeated the Italian 10th Army during Operation Compass (9 December 1940 – 9 February 1941) and trapped the remnants at Beda Fomm. On 22 January 1941, Tobruk's Italian garrison surrendered. But in early 1941, much of the British Western Desert Force was sent to the Greek and Syria–Lebanon campaigns, leaving only a skeleton force short of equipment and supplies.

Siege of Trebizond (1205–1206).headline: Obleganje Trapezunta (1205–1206)
paragraphs: Obleganje Trapezunta v letih 1205–1206 je bilo poskus Rumskega sultanata, da bi zavzel mesto na obali Črnega morja. William Miller to dejanje razlaga kot kazen za »Aleksejevo neubogljivost ukazom Kajhosrava I.«.

Michel Kuršanskis razlaga, da je bilo neuspešno obleganje odgovor na dejanje trapezuntske zaveznice, gruzijske kraljice Tamare, ki je leta 1205 neuspešno skušala zavzeti Erzurum. Ko je sultan Kajhosrav začel kazenski pohod proti Trapezuntu, je bila njegova pot omejena na nekaj prelazov v Pontskih Alpah, kjer so domačini nadlegovali njegove sile. Poleg tega se je Aleksej na njegove napade lahko odzval tako, da je »zaprl morje« za vse trgovce, ki tako niso mogli ne odpotovati na Krim ne se od tam vrniti. Po Aliju ibn al Asirju so trgovci z vsega Bližnjega vzhoda zaradi njegovega obleganja Trapezunta utrpeli hudo škodo. Ko so se zbrali na velikem sejmu v Sivasu, so sultanu glasno izrazili pritožbe.

source.title: Siege of Trebizond (1205–1206)
paragraphs: The siege of Trebizond from 1205 to 1206 was an attempt by the Seljuk Sultanate of Rûm to take the city along the coast of the Black Sea. William Miller explains this action as punishment for "the disobedience of Alexios to his Kaykhusraw I commands."

Michel Kuršanskis explains that this unsuccessful siege was in response to the Trapezuntine ally, Queen Tamar of Georgia, who had attempted to capture Erzurum in 1205 but failed. When Sultan Kaykhusraw began his punitive campaign against Trebizond, he found his route limited to a few passes in the Pontic Alps, where the locals harassed his forces. Further, Alexios could respond to his attacks by "closing the sea" to all merchants, who could neither travel to the Crimea nor return from there. According to Ali ibn al-Athir, merchants from throughout the Middle East suffered a severe injury because of his siege of Trebizond. When they met at the great fair in Sivas, they delivered their complaints to the sultan in loud shouts.

Siege of Trebizond (1461).headline: Obleganje Trapezunta (1461)
paragraphs: Obleganje Trapezunta je bilo uspešno obleganje mesta Trapezunt, prestolnice Trapezuntskega cesarstva, ki so ga izvedli Osmani pod sultanom Mehmedom II. in se je končalo 15. avgusta 1461. Obleganje je bilo vrhunec dolgega osmanskega pohoda, v katerem sta velika vojska in mornarica izvajali usklajene, a ločene manevre. Trapezuntski branilci so se zanašali na mrežo zavezništev, ki naj bi jim zagotovila podporo in ljudi, ko bi Osmani začeli obleganje. Ta pa je odpovedala prav takrat, ko jo je cesar David Megas Komnen najbolj potreboval.

source.title: Siege of Trebizond (1461)
paragraphs: The siege of Trebizond was the successful siege of the city of Trebizond, capital of the Empire of Trebizond, by the Ottomans under Sultan Mehmed II, which ended on 15 August 1461. The siege culminated a lengthy campaign on the Ottoman side, which involved coordinated but independent manoeuvres by a large army and navy. The Trapezuntine defenders had relied on a network of alliances, which would provide them with support and a workforce when the Ottomans began their siege. Still, it failed when Emperor David Megas Komnenos most needed it.

Siege of Tripoli.headline: Obleganje Tripolija
paragraphs: Obleganje Tripolija je trajalo od leta 1102 do 12. julija 1109. Potekalo je na kraju današnjega libanonskega mesta Tripoli, po prvi križarski vojni, in pripeljalo do ustanovitve četrte križarske države, Tripolitanske grofije.

source.title: Siege of Tripoli
paragraphs: The siege of Tripoli lasted from 1102 until 12 July 1109. It took place on the site of the present day Lebanese city of Tripoli, in the aftermath of the First Crusade. It led to the establishment of the fourth Crusader state, the County of Tripoli.

Siege of Tripoli (1551).headline: Obleganje Tripolija (1551)
paragraphs: Obleganje Tripolija je bilo uspešno osmansko obleganje severnoafriškega mesta Tripoli, ki so ga tedaj držali vitezi hospitalci, avgusta 1551. Napad, ki sta ga vodila Sinan paša in Dragut, je bil očitno maščevanje za to, da so Španci in hospitalci leto prej zavzeli Mahdijo.

Obleganje je sledilo kratkemu osmanskemu napadu na Sicilsko kraljestvo in Malto pod hospitalci, med katerim so vdrli na otok Gozo in ga oplenili ter okoli 5000 do 7000 prebivalcev odpeljali v suženjstvo. Osmanske sile so nato odplule v severno Afriko, kjer so jih okrepile krajevne sile iz Tadžure pod vodstvom Murada age. Tripoli so oblegali in mestni guverner Gaspard de Vallier se je po šestih dneh obstreljevanja vdal.

source.title: Siege of Tripoli (1551)
paragraphs: The siege of Tripoli was a successful Ottoman siege of the North African city of Tripoli, then held by the Knights Hospitaller, in August 1551. The attack, which was led by Sinan Pasha and Dragut, appears to have been launched in retaliation for the capture of Mahdia by the Spanish and Hospitallers the previous year.

The siege followed a brief Ottoman attack on the Kingdom of Sicily and Hospitaller Malta, during which the island of Gozo was invaded and sacked and some 5,000 to 7,000 inhabitants were taken as slaves. The Ottoman forces then sailed to North Africa, where local forces bolstered them from Tajura led by Murad Agha. Tripoli was besieged, and the city's governor Gaspard de Vallier capitulated after six days of bombardment.

Siege of Tyana.headline: Obleganje Tiane
paragraphs: Obleganje Tiane je Omajadski kalifat izvedel v letih 707–708 ali 708–709 kot maščevanje za hud poraz omajadske vojske pod Majmunom Mardaitom, ki ji ga je ok. leta 706 zadalo Bizantinsko cesarstvo. Arabska vojska je vdrla na bizantinsko ozemlje in poleti 707 ali 708 oblegala mesto. Datum ni gotov, saj ima tako rekoč vsak od ohranjenih vzporednih grških, arabskih in sirskih virov drugačnega. Tiana se je obleganju sprva uspešno upirala, arabska vojska je med zimo, ki je sledila, trpela hudo pomanjkanje in je bila spomladi tik pred tem, da obleganje opusti, ko je prispela vojska za osvoboditev, ki jo je poslal cesar Justinijan II. Prepiri med bizantinskimi vojskovodjami in neizkušenost velikega dela njihove vojske so pripomogli k odločilni omajadski zmagi. Prebivalci mesta so se nato morali vdati. Kljub dogovorjenim pogojem so mesto izropali in večinoma uničili, po bizantinskih virih pa so prebivalce zajeli in izgnali, tako da je mesto ostalo zapuščeno.

source.title: Siege of Tyana
paragraphs: The siege of Tyana was carried out by the Umayyad Caliphate in 707–708 or 708–709 in retaliation for a heavy defeat of an Umayyad army under Maimun the Mardaite by the Byzantine Empire in c. 706. The Arab army invaded Byzantine territory and laid siege to the city in summer 707 or 708. The date is uncertain, as virtually each of the extant Greek, Arabic, and Syriac parallel sources has in this respect a different date. Tyana initially withstood the siege with success, and the Arab army faced great hardship during the ensuing winter and was on the point of abandoning the siege in spring, when a relief army sent by Emperor Justinian II arrived. Quarrels among the Byzantine generals, as well as the inexperience of a large part of their army, contributed to a crushing Umayyad victory. Thereupon the inhabitants of the city were forced to surrender. Despite the agreement of terms, the city was plundered and largely destroyed, and according to Byzantine sources its people were made captive and deported, leaving the city deserted.

Siege of Tyre (1187).headline: Obleganje Tira (1187)
paragraphs: Obleganje Tira je potekalo od 12. novembra 1187 do 1. januarja 1188. Ajubidska vojska pod Saladinovim poveljstvom je s kopnega in morja napadla mesto, ki ga je branil Konrad Montferraški. Po dveh mesecih nenehnih bojev je Saladin vojsko razpustil in se umaknil v Akro.

source.title: Siege of Tyre (1187)
paragraphs: The siege of Tyre took place from 12 November 1187 to 1 January 1188. An Ayyubid army commanded by Saladin made an amphibious assault on the city, defended by Conrad of Montferrat. After two months of continuous struggle, Saladin dismissed his army and retreated to Acre.

Siege of Tyre (332 BC).headline: Obleganje Tira (332 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Obleganje Tira je izvedel Aleksander Veliki leta 332 pr. n. št. med pohodi proti Perzijcem. Makedonska vojska mesta Tir, strateškega obalnega oporišča ob Sredozemskem morju, sprva ni mogla zavzeti na običajen način, saj je stalo na otoku 1 kilometer od obale današnjega Libanona (tedaj Fenicije) in je imelo obzidje vse do morja. Aleksander je Tir najprej sedem mesecev blokiral in oblegal ter gradil nasip. Ko so vojaki ugotovili, da ga zaradi strmega padca morskega dna ne morejo več podaljšati, je ukazal, naj na konec nasipa pripeljejo oblegovalne stolpe s katapulti na vrhu. Tako mu je uspelo prebiti utrdbe.

source.title: Siege of Tyre (332 BC)
paragraphs: The siege of Tyre was carried out by Alexander the Great in 332 BC during his campaigns against the Persians. At first, the Macedonian army was unable to capture the city of Tyre, which was a strategic coastal base on the Mediterranean Sea, through conventional means because it was on an island that was 1 kilometer off the coast of modern-day Lebanon (at the time Phoenicia) and had walls right up to the sea. Alexander responded by first blockading and besieging Tyre for seven months and building a causeway. When his soldiers discovered that they could not extend it any further due to a steep drop under the surface of the water, he ordered siege towers with catapults at the top to be moved to the end. This allowed him to breach the fortifications.

Siege of Xerigordos.headline: Obleganje Kserigordosa
paragraphs: Pri obleganju Kserigordosa leta 1096 (v sodobni zgodovinski literaturi pogosto Kserigordon) se je 6000 Nemcev iz ljudske križarske vojne pod vodstvom Rainalda iz Broyesa spopadlo s Turki pod poveljstvom Elhanesa, vojskovodje rumskega seldžuškega sultana Kilidž Arslana. Križarski plenilski oddelek je zavzel turško utrdbo Kserigordos, približno štiri dni hoda od Nikeje, da bi tam postavil izhodišče za plenjenje. Elhanes je prispel tri dni pozneje in križarje oblegal. Branilci niso imeli vode in so se po osmih dneh obleganja 29. septembra vdali. Nekateri križarji so prestopili v islam, druge, ki so to zavrnili, pa so ubili.

source.title: Siege of Xerigordos
paragraphs: The siege of Xerigordos in 1096 (often Xerigordon in modern historical literature) pitted 6,000 Germans of the People's Crusade under Rainald of Broyes against the Turks commanded by Elchanes, general of Kilij Arslan, the Seljuk Sultan of Rûm. The Crusader raiding party captured the Turkish fort of Xerigordos, about four days' march from Nicaea, in an attempt to set up a pillaging outpost. Elchanes arrived three days later and besieged the Crusaders. The defenders had no water supply, and after eight days of siege, they surrendered on September 29. Some of the Crusaders converted to Islam, while others who refused were killed.

Siege of Yodfat.headline: Obleganje Jodfata
paragraphs: Obleganje Jodfata (hebrejsko: יוֹדְפַת, tudi Jotapata, Iotapata, Yodefat) je bilo 47-dnevno obleganje judovskega mesta Jodfat, ki so ga rimske sile izvedle leta 67 n. št. med veliko judovsko vstajo. Vodila sta ga rimski vojskovodja Vespazijan in njegov sin Tit, oba poznejša cesarja, končalo pa se je z izropanjem mesta, smrtjo večine prebivalcev in zasužnjenjem preostalih. To je bila druga najbolj krvava bitka vstaje, takoj za obleganjem Jeruzalema, za Jeruzalemom in Masado pa tudi najdaljša. Obleganje je opisal Jožef Flavij, ki je v Jodfatu osebno poveljeval judovskim silam in so ga nato Rimljani ujeli.

source.title: Siege of Yodfat
paragraphs: The siege of Yodfat (Hebrew: יוֹדְפַת, also Jotapata, Iotapata, Yodefat) was a 47-day siege by Roman forces of the Jewish town of Yodfat which took place in 67 CE, during the Great Revolt. Led by Roman General Vespasian and his son Titus, both future emperors, the siege ended with the sacking of the town, the deaths of most of its inhabitants and the enslavement of the rest. It was the second bloodiest battle of the revolt, surpassed only by the Siege of Jerusalem, and the longest except for Jerusalem and Masada. The siege was chronicled by Josephus, who had personally commanded the Jewish forces at Yodfat and was subsequently captured by the Romans.

Sierra Leone Civil War.headline: Državljanska vojna v Sierri Leone
paragraphs: Državljanska vojna v Sierri Leone (1991–2002) je bila državljanska vojna v Sierri Leone, ki se je začela 23. marca 1991, ko je Revolucionarna združena fronta (RUF) s podporo specialnih sil liberijskega diktatorja Charlesa Taylorja, Narodne domoljubne fronte Liberije (NPFL), posegla v Sierro Leone, da bi strmoglavila vlado Josepha Momoha. Državljanska vojna, ki je sledila, je trajala skoraj 11 let in skupno zahtevala več kot 50.000, do 70.000 žrtev; med spopadom je bilo razseljenih po ocenah 2,5 milijona ljudi, vrstila pa so se množična grozodejstva.

source.title: Sierra Leone Civil War
paragraphs: The Sierra Leone Civil War (1991–2002) was a civil war in Sierra Leone that began on 23 March 1991 when the Revolutionary United Front (RUF), with support from the special forces of Liberian dictator Charles Taylor, the National Patriotic Front of Liberia (NPFL), intervened in Sierra Leone in an attempt to overthrow the Joseph Momoh government. The resulting civil war lasted almost 11 years, and had over 50,000, up to 70,000, casualties in total; an estimated 2.5 million people were displaced during the conflict, and widespread atrocities occurred.

Simba rebellion.headline: Upor Simba
paragraphs: Upor Simba, znan tudi kot upor v Orientalu, je bil regionalni upor, ki je med letoma 1963 in 1965 potekal v Demokratični republiki Kongo v širšem okviru kongovske krize in hladne vojne. Upor na vzhodu države so vodili privrženci Patricea Lumumbe, ki sta ga leta 1960 z oblasti odstavila Joseph Kasa-Vubu in Joseph-Désiré Mobutu, januarja 1961 pa je bil v Katangi ubit. Sočasno je v osrednjem Kongu potekal upor v Kwiluju, ki ga je vodil drugi lumumbist Pierre Mulele.

source.title: Simba rebellion
paragraphs: The Simba rebellion, also known as the Orientale revolt, was a regional uprising which took place in the Democratic Republic of the Congo between 1963 and 1965 in the wider context of the Congo Crisis and the Cold War. The rebellion, located in the east of the country, was led by the followers of Patrice Lumumba, who had been ousted from power in 1960 by Joseph Kasa-Vubu and Joseph-Désiré Mobutu and subsequently killed in January 1961 in Katanga. The rebellion was contemporaneous with the Kwilu rebellion led by fellow Lumumbist Pierre Mulele in central Congo.

Sinajska vstaja je bila uporniška kampanja na egiptovskem Sinajskem polotoku, ki so jo islamistični borci sprožili proti egiptovskim varnostnim silam in je vključevala tudi napade na civiliste. Vstaja se je začela med egiptovsko krizo, v kateri je bil dolgoletni egiptovski predsednik Hosni Mubarak v egiptovski revoluciji leta 2011 strmoglavljen.

Kampanjo so sprva sestavljali borci, večinoma pripadniki krajevnih beduinskih plemen, ki so izkoristili kaotične razmere v Egiptu za vrsto napadov na vladne sile na Sinaju. Leta 2014 so člani skupine Ansar Bajt al Makdis prisegli zvestobo Islamski državi v Iraku in Levantu (ISIL ali ISIS) in se razglasili za provinco Sinaj; nekateri varnostni uradniki so izjavili, da so borci s sedežem v Libiji navezali stike s skupino Provinca Sinaj, in za večjo dostopnost zahtevnejšega orožja islamističnim skupinam okrivili prepustno mejo in tamkajšnjo državljansko vojno.

source.title: Sinai insurgency
paragraphs: The Sinai insurgency was an insurgency campaign in the Sinai Peninsula of Egypt launched by Islamist militants against Egyptian security forces, which also included attacks on civilians. The insurgency began during the Egyptian Crisis, during which the longtime Egyptian president Hosni Mubarak was overthrown in the 2011 Egyptian revolution.

The campaign initially consisted of militants, mainly local Bedouin tribesmen, who exploited the chaotic situation in Egypt to launch a series of attacks on government forces in Sinai. In 2014, members of the Ansar Bait al-Maqdis group pledged allegiance to the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL, or ISIS) and proclaimed themselves Sinai Province, with some security officials stating that militants based in Libya established ties with the Sinai Province group and blaming the porous border and ongoing civil war for the increase in sophisticated weapons available to the Islamist groups.

Smyrniote crusades.headline: Smirnski križarski vojni
paragraphs: Smirnski križarski vojni (1343–1351) sta bili dve križarski vojni, ki ju je papež Klemen VI. poslal proti begliku Ajdin pod Umur begom in katerih glavni cilj je bilo obalno mesto Smirna v Mali Aziji. Križarska vojna je bila večinoma uspešna pri omejevanju piratstva in je pripeljala do Umurjeve smrti, Smirna pa je ostala v latinskih rokah do leta 1402.

source.title: Smyrniote crusades
paragraphs: The Smyrniote crusades (1343–1351) were two Crusades sent by Pope Clement VI against the Beylik of Aydin under Umur Bey which had as their principal target the coastal city of Smyrna in Asia Minor. The crusade was mostly successful in restricting piracy and leading to Umur's death and Smyrna remained in Latin hands until 1402.

Sokoto Caliphate.headline: Kalifat Sokoto
paragraphs: Kalifat Sokoto (arabsko: دولة الخلافة في بلاد السودان, dobesedno »kalifat v deželah Sudana«), znan tudi kot Sultanat Sokoto, je bil sunitski muslimanski kalifat v zahodni Afriki. Ustanovil ga je Usman dan Fodio leta 1804 med fulanskimi džihadi, potem ko je v fulanski vojni premagal havška kraljestva. Meje kalifata so segale v dele današnjega Kameruna, Burkine Faso, Nigra in Nigerije. Do leta 1837 je imel kalifat 10–20 milijonov prebivalcev in je postal najbolj naseljen imperij v zahodni Afriki. Razpadel je, ko so Britanci, Francozi in Nemci leta 1903 osvojili območje in ga priključili novoustanovljenemu protektoratu Severna Nigerija, Senegambiji in Nigru oziroma Kamerunu (slednjega med adamavskimi vojnami).

source.title: Sokoto Caliphate
paragraphs: The Sokoto Caliphate (Arabic: دولة الخلافة في بلاد السودان, literally: Caliphate in the Lands of Sudan), also known as the Sultanate of Sokoto, was a Sunni Muslim caliphate in West Africa. It was founded by Usman dan Fodio in 1804 during the Fulani jihads after defeating the Hausa Kingdoms in the Fulani War. The boundaries of the caliphate extended to parts of present-day Cameroon, Burkina Faso, Niger, and Nigeria. By 1837, the Caliphate had a population of 10–20 million people, becoming the most populous empire in West Africa. It was dissolved when the British, French, and Germans conquered the area in 1903 and annexed it into the newly established Northern Nigeria Protectorate, Senegambia and Niger and Kamerun (the latter during the Adamawa Wars) respectively.

Somalijska državljanska vojna (somalsko: Dagaalkii Sokeeye ee Soomaaliya; arabsko: الحرب الأهلية الصومالية) je državljanska vojna v Somaliji, ki še traja. Razvila se je iz odpora proti vojaški hunti Siada Barreja v 1980. letih. Somalijske oborožene sile so se od leta 1988 do 1990 začele bojevati proti različnim oboroženim uporniškim skupinam, med njimi proti Somalijski demokratični fronti za rešitev na severovzhodu, Somalijskemu narodnemu gibanju v somalilandski osamosvojitveni vojni na severozahodu in Združenemu somalijskemu kongresu na jugu. Oborožene opozicijske skupine, ki so temeljile na klanih, so leta 1991 strmoglavile Barrejevo vlado.
notes: The romanization of the Arabic name is dropped.

source.title: Somali Civil War
paragraphs: The Somali Civil War (Somali: Dagaalkii Sokeeye ee Soomaaliya; Arabic: الحرب الأهلية الصومالية al-ḥarb al-’ahliyya aṣ-ṣūmāliyya) is an ongoing civil war that is taking place in Somalia. It grew out of resistance to the military junta led by Siad Barre during the 1980s. From 1988 to 1990, the Somali Armed Forces began engaging in combat against various armed rebel groups, including the Somali Salvation Democratic Front in the northeast, the Somali National Movement in the Somaliland War of Independence in the northwest, and the United Somali Congress in the south. The clan-based armed opposition groups overthrew the Barre government in 1991.

Sedanja faza somalijske državljanske vojne se je začela leta 2009 in poteka predvsem na jugu in v osrednjem delu Somalije, večinoma med silami zvezne vlade Somalije (FGS), ki jim pomagajo mirovne sile Afriške unije, in islamistično militantno skupino Al Šabab, ki je leta 2012 prisegla zvestobo Al Kaidi.

Med uporom, ki je sledil etiopski invaziji na Somalijo leta 2006, se je Al Šabab uveljavil in osvojil obsežna ozemlja. Nekaj tednov pred koncem vojaške zasedbe so uporniki zavzeli večino juga, prehodna zvezna vlada (TFG) pa je bila na robu propada. V začetku leta 2009 so se etiopske enote umaknile iz Somalije, za predsednika TFG pa je bil izvoljen nekdanji voditelj Zveze islamskih sodišč Šarif Ahmed, s čimer se je začela nova faza državljanske vojne. Al Šabab in zavezniške islamistične skupine so se v letih 2009 in 2010 še naprej bojevali proti novi TFG in misiji Afriške unije (AMISOM) ter krhko TFG še bolj oslabili.

source.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
paragraphs: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.

During the insurgency that followed the 2006 Ethiopian invasion of Somalia, al-Shabaab rose to prominence and made major territorial gains. Several weeks before the end of the military occupation, insurgents had seized most of the south and the Transitional Federal Government (TFG) was on the verge of collapse. In early 2009, Ethiopian troops withdrew from Somalia and former Islamic Courts Union leader Sharif Ahmed was elected president of the TFG, marking a new phase of the civil war. Al-Shabaab and allied Islamist groups continued fighting against the new TFG and the African Union mission (AMISOM) throughout 2009 and 2010, weakening the frail TFG further.

Songhai Empire.headline: Songajski imperij
paragraphs: Songajski imperij je bil država v zahodnem delu Sahela v 15. in 16. stoletju. Na vrhuncu je bil eden največjih afriških imperijev v zgodovini. Država je znana po zgodovinopisnem imenu, ki izhaja iz njene največje etnične skupine in vladajoče elite, ljudstva Songaj. Sonni Ali je za prestolnico imperija določil Gao, čeprav je songajska država v Gau in okolici obstajala že od 11. stoletja. Druga pomembna mesta kraljestva sta bila Timbuktu in Dženne, kjer je cvetela mestna trgovina; osvojili so ju leta 1468 oziroma 1475. Songajskemu imperiju je sprva vladala dinastija Sonni (ok. 1464–1493), pozneje pa jo je nadomestila dinastija Askia (1493–1591).

source.title: Songhai Empire
paragraphs: The Songhai Empire was a state located in the western part of the Sahel during the 15th and 16th centuries. At its peak, it was one of the largest African empires in history. The state is known by its historiographical name, derived from its largest ethnic group and ruling elite, the Songhai people. Sonni Ali established Gao as the empire's capital, although a Songhai state had existed in and around Gao since the 11th century. Other important cities in the kingdom were Timbuktu and Djenné, where urban-centred trade flourished; they were conquered in 1468 and 1475, respectively. Initially, the Songhai Empire was ruled by the Sonni dynasty (c. 1464–1493), but it was later replaced by the Askia dynasty (1493–1591).

Sosso Empire.headline: Imperij Sosso
paragraphs: Imperij Sosso, zapisan tudi kot Soso ali Susu ali drugače Kaniaga, je bil kraljestvo zahodne Afrike, ki je nastalo kot vazal Ganskega imperija, nato pa se je odcepilo in osvojilo svoje nekdanje gospodarje. Prebivali so ga Soninke, predniki današnjega ljudstva Sosso, središče pa je imel v regiji južno od Vagaduja in severno od Beledugua. Vrhunec je imperij dosegel pod vladavino Sumaora Kanteja, ki ga je premagal vzpenjajoči se Malijski imperij Sundžate Keite.

source.title: Sosso Empire
paragraphs: The Sosso Empire, also written as Soso or Susu, or alternatively Kaniaga, was a kingdom of West Africa that originated as a vassal of the Ghana Empire before breaking away and conquering their former overlords. Inhabited by the Soninke ancestors of the modern-day Sosso people, it was centered in the region south of Wagadou and north of Beledougou. The empire peaked under the reign of Soumaoro Kante, who was defeated by the rising Mali Empire of Sundiata Keita.

Južnoafriška mejna vojna, znana tudi kot namibijska osamosvojitvena vojna, v Južni Afriki pa včasih imenovana angolska vojna v grmovju, je bila pretežno asimetričen spopad, ki je od 26. avgusta 1966 do 21. marca 1990 potekal v Namibiji (tedanji Jugozahodni Afriki), Zambiji in Angoli. Bojevali sta se Južnoafriške obrambne sile (SADF) in Ljudska osvobodilna vojska Namibije (PLAN), oboroženo krilo Ljudske organizacije Jugozahodne Afrike (SWAPO). Južnoafriška mejna vojna je bila tesno prepletena z angolsko državljansko vojno.

source.title: South African Border War
paragraphs: The South African Border War, also known as the Namibian War of Independence, and sometimes denoted in South Africa as the Angolan Bush War, was a largely asymmetric conflict that occurred in Namibia (then South West Africa), Zambia, and Angola from 26 August 1966 to 21 March 1990. It was fought between the South African Defence Force (SADF) and the People's Liberation Army of Namibia (PLAN), an armed wing of the South West African People's Organisation (SWAPO). The South African Border War was closely intertwined with the Angolan Civil War.

Južnolibanonski konflikt je bil oborožen spopad, ki je od leta 1982 ali 1985 do izraelskega umika leta 2000 potekal v južnem Libanonu pod izraelsko zasedbo. Hezbolah se je skupaj z drugimi šiitskimi muslimanskimi in levičarskimi gverilci bojeval proti Izraelu in njegovi zaveznici, Južnolibanonski vojski (SLA), v kateri so prevladovali katoliški kristjani. SLA so vojaško in logistično podpirale Izraelske obrambne sile (IDF), delovala pa je pod okriljem začasne uprave Južnega Libanona, ki jo je podpiral Izrael in je nasledila prav tako od Izraela podprto Državo svobodnega Libanona. Izrael spopad uradno imenuje kampanja v varnostnem pasu v Libanonu in šteje, da se je začel 30. septembra 1982, po koncu njegove »operacije Mir za Galilejo«. Lahko ga razumemo tudi kot nadaljevanje libanonske državljanske vojne (1975–1990).

source.title: South Lebanon conflict (1985–2000)
paragraphs: The South Lebanon conflict was an armed conflict that took place in Israeli-occupied southern Lebanon from 1982 or 1985 until Israel's withdrawal in 2000. Hezbollah, along with other Shia Muslim and left-wing guerrillas, fought against Israel and its ally, the Catholic Christian-dominated South Lebanon Army (SLA). The SLA was supported militarily and logistically by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) and operated under the jurisdiction of the Israeli-backed South Lebanon provisional administration, which succeeded the earlier Israeli-backed Free Lebanon State. Israel officially names the conflict the Security Zone in Lebanon Campaign and deems it to have begun on 30 September 1982, after the end of its "Operation Peace for Galilee". It can also be seen as an extension of the Lebanese Civil War (1975–1990).

Državljanska vojna v Južnem Sudanu je bila večstranska državljanska vojna, v kateri so se od leta 2013 do 2018 bojevale vladne in opozicijske sile. Vojna je povzročila razširjene kršitve človekovih pravic, med njimi prisilna razseljevanja, etnične poboje in umore novinarjev, ki so jih zagrešile različne strani. Od konca vojne Južni Sudan vodi koalicija, ki sta jo oblikovala voditelja nekdanjih sprtih frakcij Salva Kiir Mayardit in Riek Machar. Država si še vedno opomore od vojne, hkrati pa jo pesti nenehno in sistemsko etnično nasilje.

Predsednik Kiir je decembra 2013 svojega nekdanjega namestnika Macharja in še deset ljudi obtožil poskusa državnega udara. Machar je zanikal, da je skušal sprožiti udar, in pobegnil, nato pa je vodil Sudansko ljudsko osvobodilno gibanje v opoziciji (SPLM-IO). Boji med Sudanskim ljudskim osvobodilnim gibanjem (SPLM) in SPLM-IO so sprožili državljansko vojno. Ob južnosudanski vladi so se bojevale ugandske enote. Združeni narodi imajo v državi mirovnike v okviru misije Združenih narodov v Južnem Sudanu (UNMISS).

source.title: South Sudanese Civil War
paragraphs: The South Sudanese Civil War was a multi-sided civil war in South Sudan fought from 2013 to 2018 between government and opposition forces. The civil war caused rampant human rights abuses, including forced displacement, ethnic massacres, and killings of journalists by various parties. Since the war's end, South Sudan has been governed by a coalition formed by leaders of the former warring factions, Salva Kiir Mayardit and Riek Machar. The country continues to recover from the war while experiencing ongoing and systemic ethnic violence.

In December 2013, President Kiir accused his former deputy Machar and 10 others of attempting a coup d'état. Machar denied trying to start a coup and fled to lead the Sudan People's Liberation Movement-in-Opposition (SPLM-IO). Fighting broke out between the Sudan People's Liberation Movement (SPLM) and SPLM-IO, igniting the civil war. Ugandan troops were deployed to fight alongside the South Sudanese government. The United Nations has peacekeepers in the country as part of the United Nations Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS).

South West Africa campaign.headline: Kampanja v Jugozahodni Afriki
paragraphs: Kampanja v Jugozahodni Afriki je bila osvojitev in zasedba Nemške Jugozahodne Afrike, ki so jo na začetku prve svetovne vojne v imenu britanske imperialne vlade izpeljale sile Južnoafriške unije. Južnoafriški predsednik vlade Louis Botha se je nenavadno odločil, da bo svoje enote v boj vodil kot vrhovni poveljnik, kar je razburilo njegovo vlado.

source.title: South West Africa campaign
paragraphs: The South West Africa campaign was the conquest and occupation of German South West Africa by forces from the Union of South Africa acting on behalf of the British imperial government at the beginning of the First World War. The South African Prime Minister Louis Botha took the unusual move of leading his troops into battle as commander-in-chief, to the frustration of his cabinet.

Južni Jemen, uradno Ljudska demokratična republika Jemen (LDRJ), skrajšano Demokratični Jemen, je bil država v južni Arabiji, ki je na območju današnjega jugovzhodnega Jemna obstajala od leta 1967 do združitve z Jemensko arabsko republiko leta 1990. Bila je edina komunistična država na Bližnjem vzhodu in v arabskem svetu in je obsegala južne in vzhodne guvernorate današnje Republike Jemen, vključno z otoki Perim in Kamaran ter otočjem Sokotra. Z Jemensko arabsko republiko na severozahodu, Savdsko Arabijo na severu in Omanom na vzhodu je imela slabo določene in pogosto sporne meje. Prestolnica in največje mesto je bil Aden.

source.title: South Yemen
paragraphs: South Yemen, officially the People's Democratic Republic of Yemen (PDRY), abbreviated to Democratic Yemen, was a country in South Arabia that existed in what is now southeast Yemen from 1967 until its unification with the Yemen Arab Republic in 1990. The sole communist state in the Middle East and the Arab world, it comprised the southern and eastern governorates of the present-day Republic of Yemen, including the islands of Perim, Kamaran, and the Socotra Archipelago. It shared ill-defined and often disputed borders with the Yemen Arab Republic to the northwest, Saudi Arabia to the north, Oman to the east. Its capital and largest city was Aden.

South Yemen insurgency.headline: Upor v Južnem Jemnu
paragraphs: Upor v Južnem Jemnu je vrsta protestov in napadov na vladne sile na jugu Jemna, ki trajajo od 27. aprila 2009. Upor poteka hkrati s šiitskim uporom na severu države, ki ga vodijo hutijske skupnosti. Južni voditelji so leta 1994, po združitvi, izvedli kratko in neuspešno odcepitev, mnogi med njimi pa sodelujejo tudi v sedanjem odcepitvenem gibanju. Južni separatistični uporniki delujejo predvsem na območju nekdanjega Južnega Jemna, pa tudi v guvernoratu Dale, ki ni bil del samostojne južne države.

source.title: South Yemen insurgency
paragraphs: The South Yemen insurgency is a series of protests and attacks on government forces in southern Yemen since 27 April 2009. The insurgency comes amid the Shia insurgency in the country's north as led by the Houthi communities. Southern leaders led a brief, unsuccessful secession in 1994 following unification. Many of them are involved in the present secession movement. Southern separatist insurgents are active mainly in the area of former South Yemen, and also in Dhale Governorate which was not a part of the independent southern state.

Soviet invasion of Armenia.headline: Sovjetska invazija na Armenijo
paragraphs: Sovjetska invazija na Armenijo je bila vojaški pohod, ki ga je 11. armada sovjetske Rusije izvedla od 29. novembra do 4. decembra 1920, da bi v Prvi republiki Armeniji, nekdanjem ozemlju Ruskega cesarstva, postavila novo sovjetsko vlado. Invazija je sovpadla z invazijo kemalistične Turčije in protivladnimi vstajami, ki so jih organizirali krajevni armenski boljševiki. Pripeljala je do razpada Prve republike Armenije in ustanovitve Armenske sovjetske socialistične republike. Oborožen odpor se je na jugu Armenije v Nždejevi samooklicani Republiki Gorska Armenija nadaljeval do julija 1921.

source.title: Soviet invasion of Armenia
paragraphs: The Soviet invasion of Armenia was a military campaign which was carried out by the 11th Army of Soviet Russia from 29 November to 4 December 1920 in order to install a new Soviet government in the First Republic of Armenia, a former territory of the Russian Empire. The invasion coincided with an invasion by Kemalist Turkey and anti-government insurrections organized by local Armenian Bolsheviks. The invasion led to the dissolution of the First Republic of Armenia and the establishment of the Armenian Soviet Socialist Republic. Militant resistance continued in southern Armenia under Nzhdeh's self-declared Republic of Mountainous Armenia until July 1921.

Soweto uprising.headline: Upor v Sowetu
paragraphs: Upor v Sowetu, znan tudi kot nemiri v Sowetu ali vstaja v Sowetu, je bil niz demonstracij in protestov, ki so jih v Južni Afriki v času apartheida vodili temnopolti učenci in so se začeli zjutraj 16. junija 1976.

source.title: Soweto uprising
paragraphs: The Soweto uprising, also known as the Soweto riots or the Soweto rebellion, was a series of demonstrations and protests led by black school children in South Africa during apartheid that began on the morning of 16 June 1976.

Sulayhid dynasty.headline: Sulajhidi
paragraphs: Sulajhidi (arabsko: Banū Ṣulayḥ, dobesedno »Sulajhovi otroci«) so bili ismailitska šiitska arabska dinastija, ki jo je leta 1047 ustanovil Ali ibn Mohamed al Sulajhi in je na vrhuncu vladala večjemu delu zgodovinskega Jemna. Jemnu so prinesli mir in blaginjo, kakršne ni poznal od himjaritskih časov. Bili so zavezniki Fatimidskega kalifata s sedežem v Kairu in ves čas nasprotniki Rasidov, zajdijskih šiitskih vladarjev Jemna. Dinastija se je končala, ko se je Arva al Sulajhi pridružila tajjibitski veji ismailitov, za razliko od hafizitske veje, ki so se je držale druge ismailitske dinastije, kot so Zurajidi in Hamdanidi.

source.title: Sulayhid dynasty
paragraphs: The Sulayhid dynasty (Arabic: بَنُو صُلَيْح, romanized: Banū Ṣulayḥ, lit. 'Children of Sulayh') was an Ismaili Shi'ite Arab dynasty established in 1047 by Ali ibn Muhammad al-Sulayhi that ruled most of historical Yemen at its peak. The Sulayhids brought to Yemen peace and a prosperity unknown since Himyaritic times. The regime was confederate with the Cairo-based Fatimid Caliphate, and was a constant enemy of the Rassids - the Zaidi Shi'ite rulers of Yemen throughout its existence. The dynasty ended with Arwa al-Sulayhi affiliating to the Taiyabi Ismaili sect, as opposed to the Hafizi Ismaili sect that the other Ismaili dynasties such as the Zurayids and the Hamdanids adhered to.

Sultanat Darfur (arabsko: سلطنة دارفور, Salṭanat Dārfūr) je bil predkolonialna država na ozemlju današnjega Sudana. Obstajal je od 16. stoletja do leta 1874, ko ga je osvojil sudanski vojskovodja Al Zubajr Rahma Mansur, znova pa so ga vzpostavili od leta 1898 do 1916, ko so ga osvojili Britanci. Na vrhuncu konec 18. in v začetku 19. stoletja je segal od Darfurja na zahodu do Kordofana in zahodnih bregov Belega Nila na vzhodu.

source.title: Sultanate of Darfur
paragraphs: The Sultanate of Darfur (Arabic: سلطنة دارفور, romanized: Salṭanat Dārfūr) was a pre-colonial state in present-day Sudan. It existed from the 16th century to 1874, when it fell to the Sudanese warlord Al-Zubayr Rahma Mansur, and was re-established again from 1898 to 1916, until it was conquered by the British. At its peak in the late-18th and early-19th century it stretched all the way from Darfur in the west to Kordofan and the western banks of the White Nile in the east.

Sultanat Hobjo (somalsko: Saldanadda Hobyo; arabsko: سلطنة هوبيو), znan tudi kot Sultanat Obbia, je bil somalski sultanat iz 19. stoletja na ozemlju današnje osrednje in severovzhodne Somalije ter vzhodne Etiopije. Ustanovil ga je Jusuf Ali Kenadid med 1870. leti in letom 1884. Leta 1889 je postal italijanski protektorat in so ga po kampanji proti sultanatom leta 1927 nazadnje vključili v kolonijo Italijanska Somalija.

source.title: Sultanate of Hobyo
paragraphs: The Sultanate of Hobyo (Somali: Saldanadda Hobyo, Arabic: سلطنة هوبيو), also known as the Sultanate of Obbia, was a 19th-century Somali Sultanate in present-day central and northeastern Somalia, and eastern Ethiopia. It was established between the 1870s and 1884 by Yusuf Ali Kenadid. In 1889, it became a protectorate of Italy and was eventually after the Campaign of the Sultanates, integrated into the colony of Italian Somaliland in 1927.

Sultanate of Ifat.headline: Ifatski sultanat
paragraphs: Ifatski sultanat, v arabskih besedilih znan kot Wafāt ali Awfāt, ali Kraljestvo Zeila je bil srednjeveška sunitska muslimanska država v vzhodnih predelih Afriškega roga od konca 13. do začetka 15. stoletja. Nastal je na ozemlju današnje Etiopije, okoli vzhodne Ševe v Ifatu. Pod vodstvom dinastije Valašma je država segala od Zekuale do pristaniškega mesta Zeila. Kraljestvo je vladalo delom današnje Etiopije, Džibutija, Somalilanda in Somalije.

source.title: Sultanate of Ifat
paragraphs: The Sultanate of Ifat, known as Wafāt or Awfāt in Arabic texts, or the Kingdom of Zeila was a medieval Sunni Muslim state in the eastern regions of the Horn of Africa between the late 13th century and early 15th century. It was formed in present-day Ethiopia around eastern Shewa in Ifat. Led by the Walashma dynasty, the polity stretched from Zequalla to the port city of Zeila. The kingdom ruled over parts of what are now Ethiopia, Djibouti, Somaliland, Somalia.

Syrian revolution.headline: Sirska revolucija
paragraphs: Sirska revolucija je bila vrsta množičnih protestov in civilnih vstaj po vsej Siriji – na katere se je baatistični režim odzval z nasiljem –, ki je v okviru širše arabske pomladi v arabskem svetu trajala od leta 2011 do 2024. Revolucija, ki je zahtevala konec desetletja dolge vladavine družine Asad, se je začela z manjšimi demonstracijami januarja 2011 in marca prerasla v velike vsedržavne proteste. Zaznamovali so jo množični protesti proti baatistični diktaturi predsednika Bašarja al Asada, na katere so policija in vojska odgovorile z nasiljem, množičnimi aretacijami in surovim zatiranjem; umrlo je več sto tisoč ljudi, ranjenih pa je bilo več deset tisoč. Asadov režim je leta 2024, 13 let po začetku revolucije, po vrsti uporniških ofenziv padel.

source.title: Syrian revolution
paragraphs: The Syrian revolution was a series of mass protests and civilian uprisings throughout Syria – with a subsequent violent reaction by the Ba'athist regime – lasting from 2011 to 2024 as part of the greater Arab Spring in the Arab world. The revolution, which demanded the end of the decades-long Assad family rule, began as minor demonstrations during January 2011 and transformed into large nationwide protests in March. The uprising was marked by mass protests against the Ba'athist dictatorship of president Bashar al-Assad meeting police and military violence, massive arrests and a brutal crackdown, resulting in hundreds of thousands of deaths and tens of thousands wounded. 13 years after the start of the revolution, the Assad regime fell in 2024 after a series of rebel offensives.

Syro-Ephraimite War.headline: Sirsko-efraimska vojna
paragraphs: Sirsko-efraimska vojna je bila spopad, ki je v 8. stoletju pr. n. št. potekal med Judejskim kraljestvom ter zavezništvom Aram-Damaska in Izraelskega kraljestva s središčem v Samariji. Po eni od teorij je bil edini cilj vojne prisiliti Judejo, da se pridruži protiasirski koaliciji. Leta 735 pr. n. št. sta kralja Recin iz Aram-Damaska in Pekah iz Izraela z vdorom skušala odstaviti judejskega kralja Ahaza. Judeja je bila poražena in je po 2 Krn 28 v enem samem dnevu izgubila 120.000 vojakov. Padlo je veliko visokih dostojanstvenikov, med njimi kraljev sin Maaseja, mnoge druge pa so odpeljali v suženjstvo. Ista vojna je opisana v 2 Kr 16,5, kjer piše, da sta Recin in Pekah oblegala Jeruzalem, a ga nista zavzela. Med vdorom so razmere izkoristili Filistejci in Edomci, ki so ropali judejska mesta in vasi. Ahaz je zato za pomoč prosil asirskega kralja Tiglat-Pileserja III.

source.title: Syro-Ephraimite War
paragraphs: The Syro-Ephraimite War was a conflict which took place in the 8th century BCE between the Kingdom of Judah and an alliance of Aram-Damascus and the Kingdom of Israel based in Samaria. One theory states that the war's sole goal was to force Judah to join the anti-Assyrian coalition. In 735 BCE, kings Rezin of Aram-Damascus and Pekah of Israel, attempted to depose king Ahaz of Judah through an invasion. Judah was defeated and, according to 2 Chronicles 28, lost 120,000 troops in just one day. Many significant officials were killed, including the king's son Maaseiah. Many others were taken away as slaves. Telling of the same war, 2 Kings 16:5 states that Rezin and Pekah besieged Jerusalem but failed to capture it. During the invasion the Philistines and Edomites took advantage of the situation, raiding towns and villages in Judah. In turn, Ahaz asked Tiglath-Pileser III of Assyria for help.

Tabal (state).headline: Tabal
paragraphs: Tabal (novoasirsko akadsko: 𒆳𒋫𒁄 in 𒌷𒋫𒁄), pozneje preoblikovan v Bīt-Burutaš (novoasirsko akadsko: 𒆳𒂍𒁹𒁍𒊒𒋫𒀾) ali Bīt-Paruta (novoasirsko akadsko: 𒂍𒁹𒉺𒊒𒋫), je bil novohetitska država z luvijskim jezikom, ki je v železni dobi obstajala na jugovzhodu Anatolije.

source.title: Tabal (state)
paragraphs: Tabal (Neo-Assyrian Akkadian: 𒆳𒋫𒁄 and 𒌷𒋫𒁄), later reorganised into Bīt-Burutaš (Neo-Assyrian Akkadian: 𒆳𒂍𒁹𒁍𒊒𒋫𒀾) or Bīt-Paruta (Neo-Assyrian Akkadian: 𒂍𒁹𒉺𒊒𒋫), was a Luwian-speaking Neo-Hittite state which existed in southeastern Anatolia in the Iron Age.

Taifa of Ceuta.headline: Taifa Ceuta
paragraphs: Taifa Ceuta (arabsko: طائفة سبتة) je bila ena od taif, držav, ki so nastale po razpadu Kordovskega kalifata v začetku 11. stoletja. Mesti Ceuta (arabsko Sabta) in Tanger sta od leta 1026 spadali v taifo Malaga dinastije Hamudidov. Od leta 1036 (427 po hidžri) so jima v imenu Hamudidov vladali Bargavati, berbersko pleme z neislamsko vero. Malo pred letom 1061 (453 po hidžri) so Bargavati pod vodstvom nepismenega Sakuta prevzeli oblast od Hamudidov. Lahko so zbrali veliko vojsko z 12.000 konjeniki, a jih je v letih 1078–1079 premagala in podjarmila vzpenjajoča se sila Almoravidov.

source.title: Taifa of Ceuta
paragraphs: The Taifa of Ceuta (Arabic: طائفة سبتة) was one of the taifa states formed after the breakup of the Caliphate of Córdoba in the early 11th century. The cities of Ceuta (Arabic: Sabta) and Tangiers were a part of the Ḥammūdid dynasty taifa of Málaga from 1026. From 1036 (427 AH) it was governed on behalf of the Ḥammūdids by the Barghawāṭa, a Berber tribe with a non-Islamic religion. Shortly before 1061 (453 AH), the Barghawāṭa, led by the illiterate Saqqūt, took power from the Ḥammūdids. They could field a large army of 12,000 cavalry, but were defeated and conquered by the rising power of the Almoravids in 1078–79.

Takrur.headline: Takrur
paragraphs: Takrur, Tekrur ali Tekrour (ok. 500 – ok. 1456) je bila država ob reki Senegal na ozemlju današnjega Senegala, ki je vrhunec dosegla v 11. in 12. stoletju, približno sočasno z Ganskim imperijem. V neki obliki je obstajala do 18. stoletja.

source.title: Takrur
paragraphs: Takrur, Tekrur, or Tekrour (c. 500 – c. 1456) was a state based in the Senegal River in modern-day Senegal which was at its height in the 11th and 12th centuries, roughly parallel to the Ghana Empire. It lasted in some form into the 18th century.

Tangier International Zone.headline: Mednarodna cona Tanger
paragraphs: Mednarodna cona Tanger (arabsko: منطقة طنجة الدولية, Minṭaqat Ṭanja ad-Duwaliyya; francosko: Zone internationale de Tanger; špansko: Zona Internacional de Tánger) je bila 382 km² velika mednarodna cona s središčem v mestu Tanger v Maroku, ki je obstajala od leta 1925 do ponovne vključitve v neodvisni Maroko leta 1956, s prekinitvijo med špansko zasedbo Tangerja (1940–1945), poseben gospodarski status pa je ohranila do začetka leta 1960. S kopnega jo je obdajal španski protektorat v Maroku, upravljali pa so jo po edinstvenem in zapletenem sistemu, v katerega so bile vključene različne evropske države, Združene države Amerike (predvsem po letu 1945) in maroški sultan, ki je bil sam pod francoskim protektoratom. Zaradi statusa mednarodne cone je imel Tanger ključno vlogo za maroške nacionaliste, ki so si prizadevali za neodvisnost: tu so navezovali mednarodne stike, pridobivali zaveznike ter prirejali srečanja in dogodke.
notes: The square-mile conversion (147 sq mi) is dropped.

source.title: Tangier International Zone
paragraphs: The Tangier International Zone (Arabic: منطقة طنجة الدولية, romanized: Minṭaqat Ṭanja ad-Duwaliyya; French: Zone internationale de Tanger; Spanish: Zona Internacional de Tánger) was a 382 km2 (147 sq mi) international zone centered on the city of Tangier, Morocco, which existed from 1925 until its reintegration into independent Morocco in 1956, with interruption during the Spanish occupation of Tangier (1940–1945), and special economic status extended until early 1960. Surrounded on the land side by the Spanish protectorate in Morocco, it was governed under a unique and complex system that involved several European nations, the United States (mainly after 1945), and the Sultan of Morocco, himself under a French protectorate. Due to its status as an international zone, Tangier played a crucial role for Moroccan nationalists, who wanted independence, to establish international contacts and recruit allies as well as organising gatherings and events.

Tretja bitka za Faludžo, ki jo je iraška vlada poimenovala operacija Zlom terorizma (arabsko: عملية كسر الإرهاب), je bila vojaška operacija proti ISIL, s katero so hoteli zavzeti mesto Faludža in njegova predmestja približno 69 kilometrov zahodno od iraške prestolnice Bagdad. Operacija se je začela 22. maja 2016, tri mesece potem, ko so iraške sile popolnoma obkolile Faludžo. Iraške sile so mesto Faludža znova zavzele 26. junija, dva dni pozneje pa še zadnji žep odpora ISIL na zahodnem obrobju mesta.
notes: The miles conversion (43 mi) is dropped.
The glossary named this record Četrta bitka za Faludžo; it is corrected to Tretja bitka za Faludžo, as in the English source and the text.

source.title: Third Battle of Fallujah
paragraphs: The Third Battle of Fallujah, code-named Operation Breaking Terrorism (Arabic: عملية كسر الإرهاب) by the Iraqi government, was a military operation against ISIL launched to capture the city of Fallujah and its suburbs, located about 69 kilometres (43 mi) west of Baghdad, the capital of Iraq. The operation began on 22 May 2016, three months after the Iraqi forces had started the total siege of Fallujah. On 26 June, Iraqi forces recaptured the city of Fallujah, before recapturing the remaining pocket of ISIL resistance in Fallujah's western outskirts two days later.

Third Battle of Gaza.headline: Tretja bitka za Gazo
paragraphs: Tretja bitka za Gazo je potekala v noči s 1. na 2. november 1917 med britanskimi in osmanskimi silami v sinajsko-palestinski kampanji prve svetovne vojne, potem ko je zmaga britanskih egiptovskih ekspedicijskih sil (EEF) v bitki pri Beršebi končala zastoj v južni Palestini. Boji so potekali na začetku ofenzive v južni Palestini in so skupaj z napadi na Hareiro in Šerijo 6. in 7. novembra ter z bitko pri Tel el Huvejlfi, ki jo je general Edmund Allenby sprožil 1. novembra, nazadnje prebili črto od Gaze do Beršebe, ki jo je branila armadna skupina Jildirim. Osmanska vojska je to črto držala od marca 1917, a je morala Gazo in Tel el Huvejlfe v noči s 6. na 7. november izprazniti. Le Šerija se je držala večino 7. novembra, nato pa so zavzeli tudi njo.

source.title: Third Battle of Gaza
paragraphs: The Third Battle of Gaza was fought on the night of 1–2 November 1917 between British and Ottoman forces during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of World War I and came after the British Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) victory at the Battle of Beersheba had ended the Stalemate in Southern Palestine. The fighting occurred at the beginning of the Southern Palestine Offensive, and, together with attacks on Hareira and Sheria on 6–7 November and the continuing Battle of Tel el Khuweilfe, which had been launched by General Edmund Allenby on 1 November, it eventually broke the Gaza-to-Beersheba line defended by the Yildirim Army Group. Despite having held this line since March 1917, the Ottoman Army was forced to evacuate Gaza and Tel el Khuweilfe during the night of 6–7 November. Only Sheria held out for most of 7 November before it too was captured.

Third Intermediate Period of Egypt.headline: Tretje vmesno obdobje starega Egipta
paragraphs: Tretje vmesno obdobje starega Egipta se je začelo s smrtjo faraona Ramzesa XI. leta 1077 pr. n. št., ki je končala Novo kraljestvo, nazadnje pa mu je sledilo pozno obdobje. Za začetek poznega obdobja navajajo različne mejnike, najpogosteje pa ga štejejo od leta 664 pr. n. št., ko je Psametik I. ustanovil 26. dinastijo, potem ko so Asirci pod kraljem Asurbanipalom pregnali nubijske kušitske vladarje 25. dinastije. Izraz »tretje vmesno obdobje«, ki se zgleduje po dobro znanih prvem in drugem vmesnem obdobju, je bil razširjen že leta 1978, ko ga je britanski egiptolog Kenneth Kitchen uporabil v naslovu svoje knjige o tem obdobju. Kitchen je sicer trdil, da obdobje »še zdaleč ni bilo kaotično«, in upal, da bo njegovo delo pripomoglo k opustitvi izraza, sam pa je imel raje izraz »poimperialna doba«; z uporabo izraza v naslovu ga je očitno le še utrdil.

source.title: Third Intermediate Period of Egypt
paragraphs: The Third Intermediate Period of ancient Egypt began with the death of Pharaoh Ramesses XI in 1077 BC, which ended the New Kingdom, and was eventually followed by the Late Period. Various points are offered as the beginning for the latter era, though it is most often regarded as dating from the foundation of the Twenty-Sixth Dynasty by Psamtik I in 664 BC, following the departure of the Nubian Kushite rulers of the Twenty-fifth Dynasty after they were driven out by the Assyrians under King Ashurbanipal. The use of the term "Third Intermediate Period", based on the analogy of the well-known First and Second Intermediate Periods, was popular by 1978, when British Egyptologist Kenneth Kitchen used the term for the title of his book on the period. While Kitchen argued that the period was 'far from being chaotic' and hoped that his work would lead to the abolishment of the term, with his own preference being the 'Post-Imperial epoch', his use of the term as a title seems only to have entrenched its use.

Thirtieth Dynasty of Egypt.headline: Trideseta egipčanska dinastija
paragraphs: Trideseta egipčanska dinastija (zapisano tudi XXX. dinastija ali 30. dinastija) velja običajno za peto dinastijo poznega obdobja starega Egipta. Ustanovil jo je Nektanebo I., potem ko je leta 380 pr. n. št. strmoglavil Neferita II., prenehala pa je obstajati, ko je ahemenidski kralj Artakserks III. leta 343 pr. n. št. vdrl v Egipt. Bila je zadnja domača dinastija starega Egipta.

source.title: Thirtieth Dynasty of Egypt
paragraphs: The Thirtieth Dynasty of Egypt (notated Dynasty XXX, alternatively 30th Dynasty or Dynasty 30) is usually classified as the fifth Dynasty of the Late Period of ancient Egypt. It was founded after the overthrow of Nepherites II in 380 BC by Nectanebo I, and was disestablished upon the invasion of Egypt by the Achaemenid king Artaxerxes III in 343 BC. This is the final native dynasty of ancient Egypt.

Tobacco Protest.headline: Tobačni protest
paragraphs: Perzijski tobačni protest (perzijsko: نهضت تنباکو, nehzat-e tanbāku) je bil upor dvanajstniških šiitskih muslimanov v kadžarskem Iranu proti tobačni koncesiji iz leta 1890, s katero je Naser al Din šah Kadžar Britanskemu imperiju podelil nadzor nad gojenjem, prodajo in izvozom tobaka, prepustil pa ga je Angležu, majorju G. F. Talbotu. Protestirali so trgovci v velikih mestih, kot so Teheran, Širaz, Mašhad in Isfahan, v solidarnosti z duhovščino. Vrhunec je dosegel decembra 1891 s fatvo proti uživanju tobaka, ki jo je izdal veliki ajatola Mirza Širazi in so se je ljudje množično držali.

source.title: Tobacco Protest
paragraphs: The Persian Tobacco Protest (Persian: نهضت تنباکو, romanized: nehzat-e tanbāku) was a Twelver Shia Muslim revolt in Qajar Iran against an 1890 tobacco concession granted by Naser al-Din Shah Qajar to the British Empire, granting control over growth, sale, and export of tobacco to an Englishman, Major G. F. Talbot. The protest was held by merchants in major cities such as Tehran, Shiraz, Mashhad, and Isfahan in solidarity with the clerical establishment. It climaxed in a widely obeyed December 1891 fatwa against tobacco use issued by Grand Ayatollah Mirza Shirazi.

Togolandska kampanja (6.–26. avgusta 1914) je bila francoska in britanska invazija na nemško kolonijo Togoland v zahodni Afriki, s katero se je začela zahodnoafriška kampanja prve svetovne vojne. Nemške kolonialne sile so se umaknile iz prestolnice Lomé in obalne province ter se v zavlačevalnih bojih umikale po poti proti severu do Kamine, kjer je radijska postaja Kamina (Kamina Funkstation) povezovala vlado v Berlinu s Togolandom, Atlantikom in Južno Ameriko.

Glavnina britanskih in francoskih sil iz sosednjih kolonij Zlata obala in Dahomej (ta je bil del Francoske Zahodne Afrike) je z obale napredovala ob cesti in železnici, manjše sile pa so se Kamini približevale s severa.
