Nemški branilci so napadalce za nekaj dni zadržali v manjšem spopadu pri Agbeluvoeju in spopadu pri Khri, a so kolonijo 26. avgusta 1914 predali. Zmagovalci so Togoland leta 1916 razdelili, julija 1922 pa sta bila ustanovljena Britanski Togoland in Francoski Togoland kot mandatni ozemlji Društva narodov.
notes: The English gloss on the term 'affair' (an engagement too small to be called a battle) is rendered as 'manjši spopad'.

source.title: Togoland campaign
paragraphs: The Togoland campaign (6–26 August 1914) was a French and British invasion of the German colony of Togoland in West Africa, which began the West African campaign of the First World War. German colonial forces withdrew from the capital Lomé and the coastal province to fight delaying actions on the route north to Kamina, where the Kamina Funkstation (wireless transmitter) linked the government in Berlin to Togoland, the Atlantic and South America.

The main British and French force from the neighbouring colonies of Gold Coast and Dahomey (part of French West Africa) advanced from the coast up the road and railway, as smaller forces converged on Kamina from the north. The German defenders delayed the invaders for several days at the Affair of Agbeluvoe (affair, an action or engagement not of sufficient magnitude to be called a battle) and the Affair of Khra but surrendered the colony on 26 August 1914. In 1916, Togoland was partitioned by the victors and in July 1922, British Togoland and French Togoland were established as League of Nations mandates.

Tophane Agreement.headline: Sporazum iz Tophaneja
paragraphs: Sporazum iz Tophaneja je bil pogodba med Kneževino Bolgarijo in Osmanskim cesarstvom, podpisana 5. aprila (po starem koledarju 24. marca) 1886 med konferenco veleposlanikov v Istanbulu. Sporazum se imenuje po istanbulski četrti Tophane v okrožju Beyoğlu, kjer so pogodbo podpisali.

Sporazum, ki so ga podpisali osmanski veliki vezir Mehmed Kâmil paša, bolgarski zunanji minister Ilija Canov in veleposlaniki velesil, je bolgarskega kneza (tedaj Aleksandra Battenberškega) priznal za generalnega guvernerja avtonomne osmanske province Vzhodna Rumelija. Tako je bila dejanska združitev Bolgarije, do katere je prišlo 18. septembra (po starem koledarju 6. septembra) 1885, priznana tudi pravno.

Osmansko cesarstvo je v zameno dobilo območje okoli Kardžalija in Tamraško republiko, skupaj 1640 km². S to pogodbo je ozemlje združene Bolgarije obsegalo 94.345 km². Bolgarija je ozemlja, izgubljena s to pogodbo, znova pridobila po zmagi v prvi balkanski vojni (1912–1913).

source.title: Tophane Agreement
paragraphs: The Tophane Agreement was a treaty between the Principality of Bulgaria and the Ottoman Empire signed on 5 April [O.S. 24 March] 1886 during an ambassadorial conference in Istanbul. The agreement was named after the Istanbul neighborhood Tophane, located in Beyoğlu district, where the treaty was signed.

Signed by the Ottoman Grand Vizier Mehmed Kamil Pasha and the Bulgarian foreign minister Iliya Tsanov, as well the ambassadors of the Great Powers, the agreement recognized the Prince of Bulgaria (Alexander of Battenberg at the time) as Governor-General of the autonomous Ottoman Province Eastern Rumelia. In this way, the de facto Unification of Bulgaria which had taken place on 18 September [O.S. 6 September] 1885, was de jure recognized.

As compensation, the Ottoman Empire received the area around Kardzhali, as well as the Republic of Tamrash, for a total area of 1,640 km2. With this treaty, the territory of the unified Bulgaria became 94,345 km2. Bulgaria later regained the lands lost in this treaty following victory in the First Balkan War (1912–13).

Vojna toyot (arabsko: حرب التويوتا, francosko: Guerre des Toyota), znana tudi kot velika vojna toyot, je bila zadnja faza čadsko-libijske vojne, ki je leta 1987 potekala na severu Čada in na čadsko-libijski meji. Ime je dobila po tovornjakih toyota, predvsem modelih Toyota Hilux in Toyota Land Cruiser, s katerimi so čadske enote dosegale gibljivost v bojih proti Libijcem in ki so jih uporabljali kot improvizirana bojna vozila. Vojna leta 1987 se je končala s hudim porazom Libije, ki je po ameriških virih izgubila desetino vojske: 7500 mož je padlo, uničene ali zaplenjene pa je bilo za 1,5 milijarde ameriških dolarjev vojaške opreme. Čadske sile so imele 1000 mrtvih.
notes: The romanizations of the Arabic name are dropped.

source.title: Toyota War
paragraphs: The Toyota War (Arabic: حرب التويوتا, romanized: Ḥarb al-Tūyūtā, Harb-el-Touyouta, French: Guerre des Toyota), also known as the Great Toyota War, was the last phase of the Chadian–Libyan War which took place in 1987 in Northern Chad and on the Chad–Libya border. It takes its name from the Toyota pickup trucks, primarily the Toyota Hilux and the Toyota Land Cruiser, which were used to provide mobility for Chadian troops as they fought against the Libyans, and as technicals. The 1987 war resulted in a heavy defeat for Libya, which, according to American sources, lost one tenth of its army, with 7,500 men killed and US$1.5 billion worth of military equipment destroyed or captured. Chadian forces suffered 1,000 deaths.

Treaties of Erzurum.headline: Erzurumski pogodbi
paragraphs: Erzurumski pogodbi sta bili dve pogodbi, ratificirani v letih 1823 in 1847, ki sta rešili mejne spore med Osmanskim cesarstvom in Perzijo.

source.title: Treaties of Erzurum
paragraphs: The Treaties of Erzurum were two treaties that were ratified in 1823 and 1847 which settled boundary disputes between the Ottoman Empire and Persia.

Treaty of Addis Ababa.headline: Pogodba iz Adis Abebe
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Adis Abebe, podpisana 26. oktobra 1896, je formalno končala prvo italijansko-etiopsko vojno pod pogoji, ki so bili večinoma ugodni za Etiopijo. Nadomestila je tajni sporazum med Etiopijo in Italijo, dogovorjen nekaj dni po odločilni bitki pri Advi marca istega leta, v kateri so etiopske sile pod poveljstvom Menelika II. premagale Italijane. Najpomembnejša italijanska popustitev je bila razveljavitev pogodbe iz Učaleja in priznanje Etiopije kot neodvisne države.

Po sklenitvi te pogodbe in pred koncem naslednjega koledarskega leta sta tudi Združeno kraljestvo in Francija, ki sta imeli kolonialne posesti ob meji z Etiopijo, z njo sklenili pogodbi, ki sta jo obravnavali kot enakopravno. Pogodbo s Francijo so podpisali konec januarja 1897, pogodbo z Združenim kraljestvom pa 14. maja 1897.

source.title: Treaty of Addis Ababa
paragraphs: The Treaty of Addis Ababa, signed on 26 October 1896, formally ended the First Italo-Ethiopian War on terms mostly favourable to Ethiopia. This treaty superseded a secret agreement between Ethiopia and Italy negotiated days after the decisive Battle of Adwa in March of the same year, in which Ethiopian forces commanded by Menelik II defeated the Italians. The most important concession the Italians made was the abrogation of the Treaty of Wuchale and recognizing Ethiopia as an independent country.

Following the conclusion of this treaty and before the end of the next calendar year, the United Kingdom and France, which had colonial possessions bordering Ethiopia, also concluded treaties with Ethiopia which treated her as an equal. The treaty with France was signed in late January 1897, while the treaty with the United Kingdom was signed on 14 May 1897.

Treaty of Adrianople (1713).headline: Odrinski mir (1713)
paragraphs: Odrinski mir, imenovan tudi mir v Edirnu, je bil pogodba, ki sta jo 24. junija 1713 podpisala Osmansko cesarstvo in Rusko carstvo in je potrdila prutski mir iz leta 1711, ki je končal prutski pohod (1710–1711).

Prutski mir, ki ga je podpisal Baltacı Mehmed paša, so v Carigradu sprva dobro sprejeli, nezadovoljna vojni naklonjena stranka pa je ob podpori švedskega kralja Karla XII., ki se je od leta 1709 zatekal v Osmansko cesarstvo, javno mnenje obrnila proti Baltacıju Mehmedu paši, ki so ga nazadnje razrešili.

Sultanu Ahmedu III. ni uspelo znova začeti vojne z Rusijo. Vojni naklonjena stranka ga je nazadnje razjezila in odločil se je, da nadležnega švedskega kralja pošlje nazaj v domovino, s čimer so odpadle vse ovire za dokončen mir z Rusijo. Odrinski mir je ohranil mir 25 let.

source.title: Treaty of Adrianople (1713)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Adrianople, also called the Treaty of Edirne, was signed on 24 June 1713 between the Ottoman Empire and the Tsardom of Russia and confirmed the Treaty of the Pruth of 1711, which had ended the Pruth River Campaign (1710–1711).

The Treaty of Pruth, signed by Baltacı Mehmet Pasha, was at first received well in Constantinople, but the dissatisfied pro-war party, supported by King Charles XII of Sweden, who had taken refuge in the Ottoman Empire since 1709, turned public opinion against Baltacı Mehmet Pasha, who was finally relieved from his office.

Sultan Ahmed III failed to resume the war with Russia. He finally became annoyed by the pro-war party and decided to send the troublesome Swedish king back to his homeland, which removed all obstacles for a final peace settlement with Russia. The Treaty of Adrianople would keep the peace for 25 years.

Treaty of Alexandropol.headline: Pogodba iz Aleksandropola
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Aleksandropola (armensko: Ալեքսանդրապոլի պայմանագիր; turško: Gümrü Anlaşması ali »gjumrijska pogodba«) je bila mirovna pogodba med Prvo republiko Armenijo in Veliko narodno skupščino Turčije. Uradno je končala turško invazijo na Armenijo, ki se je začela 12. septembra 1920.

Podpisal jo je armenski zunanji minister Aleksander Hatisjan v zgodnjih jutranjih urah 3. decembra 1920, vendar je armenska vlada v Erevanu dan prej odstopila in oblast predala sovjetski vladi, zato Hatisjan ni več deloval v imenu armenske vlade in pogodba ni bila veljavna.

Pogodba je od Armenije zahtevala, naj se odpove zahtevam po Zahodni Armeniji, odstopi več kot polovico svojega ozemlja Turčiji, Nahičevan prepusti Azerbajdžanu in sprejme pogoje, ki so jo ponižali na raven turške vazalne države. Čeprav so jo pozneje razglasili za neveljavno, so njeni pogoji oblikovali okvir za meje, ki jih je pozneje potrdila karska pogodba, in so poudarili propad suverenosti Prve republike Armenije.

source.title: Treaty of Alexandropol
paragraphs: The Treaty of Alexandropol (Armenian: Ալեքսանդրապոլի պայմանագիր; Turkish: Gümrü Anlaşması or "Gyumri Treaty") was a peace treaty between the First Republic of Armenia and the Grand National Assembly of Turkey. The treaty formally ended Turkey's invasion of Armenia that had begun on 12 September 1920.

It was signed by the Armenian Foreign Minister Alexander Khatisyan in the early hours of 3 December 1920; however, the previous day, the Armenian government in Yerevan had resigned and transferred power to a Soviet government and so Khatisyan was no longer acting on behalf of the government of Armenia, and the treaty was invalid.

The treaty required Armenia to relinquish claims to Western Armenia, cede over half of its territory to Turkey while also transferring Nakhchivan to Azerbaijan, and accept conditions that reduced Armenia to the status of a Turkish client state. Although later deemed invalid, its terms shaped the framework for the borders later confirmed by the Treaty of Kars and underscored the collapse of the sovereignty of the First Republic of Armenia.

Treaty of Ankara (1921).headline: Ankarski sporazum (1921)
paragraphs: Ankarski sporazum (1921) (ali ankarski dogovor, sporazum Franklin-Bouillon, francosko-turški sporazum iz Ankare; turško: Ankara Antlaşması; francosko: Traité d'Ankara) sta 20. oktobra 1921 v Ankari (znani tudi kot Angora) podpisali Francija in Velika narodna skupščina Turčije; z njim se je končala francosko-turška vojna.

Podpisnika sta bila francoski diplomat Henry Franklin-Bouillon in turški zunanji minister Yusuf Kemal beg. Po določbah sporazuma so Francozi priznali konec francosko-turške vojne in Turčiji odstopili velika območja. Sporazum pa ni zadeval drugih francoskih enot v Turčiji, v zameno za gospodarske koncesije Turčije. Turška vlada je v zameno priznala francosko imperialno suverenost nad francoskim mandatom za Sirijo. Pogodbo so 30. avgusta 1926 vpisali v zbirko pogodb Društva narodov.

source.title: Treaty of Ankara (1921)
paragraphs: The Ankara Agreement (1921) (or the Accord of Ankara; Franklin-Bouillon Agreement; Franco-Turkish Agreement of Ankara, Turkish: Ankara Antlaşması, French: Traité d'Ankara) was signed on 20 October 1921 at Ankara (also known as Angora) between France and the Grand National Assembly of Turkey, ending the Franco-Turkish War.

The signatories were French diplomat Henry Franklin-Bouillon and Turkish foreign minister Yusuf Kemal Bey. Based on the terms of the agreement, the French acknowledged the end of the Franco-Turkish War and ceded large areas to Turkey. However other French units in Turkey were not affected, in return for economic concessions from Turkey. In return, the Turkish government acknowledged French imperial sovereignty over the French Mandate of Syria. The treaty was registered in League of Nations Treaty Series on 30 August 1926.

Treaty of Balta Liman.headline: Pogodba iz Balta Limana
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Balta Limana iz leta 1838 ali angleško-osmanska pogodba je bila uradni trgovinski sporazum, ki sta ga podpisala Visoka porta Osmanskega cesarstva in Velika Britanija. Trgovinska politika, vsiljena Osmanskemu cesarstvu po pogodbi iz Balta Limana, je bila ena najbolj liberalnih ureditev odprtega trga, kar so jih kdaj uvedli. Po določbah pogodbe naj bi Osmansko cesarstvo odpravilo vse monopole, britanskim trgovcem in njihovim sodelavcem omogočilo popoln dostop do vseh osmanskih trgov in jih obdavčilo enako kot domače trgovce. Ti sporazumi niso pomenili enakopravne ureditve proste trgovine, saj je Velika Britanija na svojih kmetijskih trgih še naprej izvajala protekcionistično politiko.

source.title: Treaty of Balta Liman
paragraphs: The 1838 Treaty of Balta Liman, or the Anglo-Ottoman Treaty, was a formal trade agreement signed between the Sublime Porte of the Ottoman Empire and Great Britain. The trade policies imposed upon the Ottoman Empire, after the Treaty of Balta Liman, were some of the most liberal, open market settlements that had ever been enacted. The terms of the treaty stated that the Ottoman Empire would abolish all monopolies and allow British merchants and their collaborators to have full access to all Ottoman markets and be taxed equally to local merchants. These agreements did not constitute an equal free trade arrangement, as Britain still employed protectionist policies on their agricultural markets.

Treaty of Bardo.headline: Pogodba iz Barda
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Barda (francosko: Traité du Bardo; arabsko: معاهدة باردو) ali pogodba iz Ksar Saïda je vzpostavila francoski protektorat nad Tunizijo, ki je trajal do druge svetovne vojne. Podpisali so jo 12. maja 1881 predstavniki Francije in tuniški beg Mohamed as Sadik, s čimer je Tunizija prišla pod nadzor francoskega generalnega rezidenta.

Pogodba je Franciji omogočila nadzor nad nekaterimi območji pod pretvezo obnove reda in zaščite bega pred notranjo opozicijo, Franciji pa je prepustila tudi odgovornost za zunanjepolitične odločitve Tunizije. Konvenciji iz La Marse z 8. junija 1883 sta Franciji pozneje dali pravico do posega v notranje zadeve Tunizije. Država, ki je bila tako podrejena absolutni oblasti generalnega rezidenta, je izgubila skoraj vso samostojnost ne le v zunanjih, temveč v praksi tudi v notranjih zadevah.

source.title: Treaty of Bardo
paragraphs: The Treaty of Bardo (French: Traité du Bardo, Arabic: معاهدة باردو) or Treaty of Ksar Saïd established a French protectorate over Tunisia that lasted until World War II. It was signed on 12 May 1881 between representatives of France and the Tunisian bey Muhammed as-Sadiq, placing Tunisia under the control of the French Resident-General.

The treaty allowed France to control certain geographical areas under the guise of re-establishing order and protecting the Bey from internal opposition and also gave France responsibility for foreign-policy decisions of Tunisia. Later, the Conventions of La Marsa of 8 June 1883 gave France a right to intervene in Tunisia's domestic affairs. Thus subject to the Resident-General’s absolute power, the country lost almost all autonomy not only in external but in practice also in internal affairs.

Treaty of Batum.headline: Pogodba iz Batumija
paragraphs: Pogodbo iz Batumija so 4. junija 1918 v Batumiju podpisali Osmansko cesarstvo in tri zakavkaške države: Prva republika Armenija, Azerbajdžanska demokratična republika in Demokratična republika Gruzija. Bila je prva pogodba Prve republike Armenije in Azerbajdžanske demokratične republike in je imela 14 členov.

source.title: Treaty of Batum
paragraphs: The Treaty of Batum was signed in Batumi on 4 June 1918, between the Ottoman Empire and the three Transcaucasian states: the First Republic of Armenia, the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic and the Democratic Republic of Georgia. It was the first treaty of the First Republic of Armenia and the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic and had 14 articles.

Treaty of Constantinople (1590).headline: Carigrajski mir (1590)
paragraphs: Carigrajski mir, znan tudi kot istanbulski mir ali pogodba Ferhada paše (turško: Ferhat Paşa Antlaşması), je bil pogodba med Osmanskim cesarstvom in Safavidskim imperijem, ki je končala osmansko-safavidsko vojno v letih 1578–1590. Podpisali so jo 21. marca 1590 v Carigradu (današnjem Istanbulu). Vojna se je začela, ko so Osmani, ki jim je tedaj vladal Murad III., v obdobju safavidske šibkosti vdrli v safavidske posesti v Gruziji. Ker je bil imperij v stiski na številnih bojiščih, notranji nadzor pa so mu spodkopavale državljanske vojne in dvorne spletke, se je novi safavidski kralj Abas I., ki so ga na prestol postavili leta 1588, odločil za brezpogojni mir, ki je pripeljal do pogodbe. Pogodba je končala 12 let sovražnosti med najhujšima tekmecema. Čeprav sta bili vojna in pogodba za Osmane uspeh, za Safavide pa hudo neugodni, se je novo stanje izkazalo za kratkotrajno, saj so Safavidi v naslednjem spopadu nekaj let pozneje vse izgube nadoknadili.

source.title: Treaty of Constantinople (1590)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Constantinople, also known as the Peace of Istanbul or the Treaty of Ferhad Pasha (Turkish: Ferhat Paşa Antlaşması), was a treaty between the Ottoman Empire and the Safavid Empire ending the Ottoman–Safavid War of 1578–1590. It was signed on 21 March 1590 in Constantinople (present-day Istanbul). The war started when the Ottomans, then ruled by Murad III, invaded the Safavid possessions in Georgia, during a period of Safavid weakness. With the empire beleaguered on numerous fronts and its domestic control plagued by civil wars and court intrigues, the new Safavid king Abbas I, who had been placed on the throne in 1588, opted for unconditional peace, which led to the treaty. The treaty put an end to 12 years of hostilities between the two arch rivals. While both the war and the treaty were a success for the Ottomans, and severely disadvantageous for the Safavids, the new status quo proved to be short lived, as in the next bout of hostilities, several years later, all Safavid losses were recovered.

Treaty of Constantinople (1724).headline: Carigrajska pogodba (1724)
paragraphs: Carigrajska pogodba (rusko: Константинопольский договор), rusko-osmanska pogodba ali pogodba o delitvi Perzije (Iran Mukasemenamesi) je bila pogodba, sklenjena 24. junija 1724 med Osmanskim cesarstvom in Ruskim cesarstvom, s katero sta si razdelili velike dele ozemlja sosednjega safavidskega Irana.

source.title: Treaty of Constantinople (1724)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Constantinople (Russian: Константинопольский договор) Russo-Ottoman Treaty or Treaty of the Partition of Persia (Iran Mukasemenamesi) was a treaty concluded on 24 June 1724 between the Ottoman Empire and the Russian Empire, dividing large portions of the territory of mutually neighbouring Safavid Iran between them.

Treaty of Constantinople (1736).headline: Carigrajska pogodba (1736)
paragraphs: Carigrajska pogodba je bila pogodba med Osmanskim cesarstvom in afšaridskim Iranom, podpisana 24. septembra 1736, ki je končala osmansko-perzijsko vojno (1730–1735).

source.title: Treaty of Constantinople (1736)
paragraphs: Treaty of Constantinople was a treaty between Ottoman Empire and Afsharid Iran signed on 24 September 1736, ending the Ottoman–Persian War (1730–1735).

Treaty of Constantinople (1832).headline: Carigrajska pogodba (1832)
paragraphs: Carigrajska pogodba, podpisana 21. julija 1832, je bila plod londonske konference leta 1832, ki se je začela februarja 1832, na njej pa so sodelovale velesile (Velika Britanija, Francija in Rusija) na eni strani in Osmansko cesarstvo na drugi. Britanski veleposlanik sir Stratford Canning in drugi predstavniki so 21. julija 1832 sklenili carigrajsko pogodbo, ki je določila meje nove Kraljevine Grčije ob črti Arta–Volos.

Po londonski pogodbi, ki so jo 7. maja 1832 podpisale Bavarska in sile zaščitnice in ki je urejala, kako naj se upravlja regentstvo, dokler Oton ne postane polnoleten (z njo so sklenili tudi drugo grško posojilo v višini 2.400.000 funtov šterlingov), je bila Grčija opredeljena kot neodvisno kraljestvo s črto Arta–Volos kot severno mejo.

source.title: Treaty of Constantinople (1832)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Constantinople signed on 21 July 1832 and was the product of the London Conference of 1832 which opened in February 1832 with the participation of the Great Powers (Britain, France and Russia) on the one hand and the Ottoman Empire on the other. On 21 July 1832 British ambassador Sir Stratford Canning and the other representatives concluded the Treaty of Constantinople, which set the boundaries of the new Kingdom of Greece along the Arta–Volos line.

Under the Treaty of London signed on 7 May 1832 between Bavaria and the protecting Powers, and dealing with how the Regency was to be managed until Otto reached his majority (while also concluding the second Greek loan, for a sum of £2,400,000 sterling), Greece was defined as an independent kingdom, with the Arta–Volos line as its northern frontier.

Treaty of Constantinople (1897).headline: Carigrajska pogodba (1897)
paragraphs: Carigrajska pogodba je bila pogodba med Osmanskim cesarstvom in Kraljevino Grčijo, podpisana 4. decembra 1897 po grško-turški vojni (1897).

source.title: Treaty of Constantinople (1897)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Constantinople was a treaty between the Ottoman Empire and the Kingdom of Greece signed on 4 December 1897 following the Greco-Turkish War (1897).

Treaty of Constantinople (1913).headline: Carigrajska pogodba (1913)
paragraphs: Carigrajska pogodba (istanbulska pogodba) je bila pogodba med Osmanskim cesarstvom in Kraljevino Bolgarijo, podpisana 29. septembra 1913 po drugi balkanski vojni v osmanski prestolnici Carigradu, današnjem İstanbulu.

source.title: Treaty of Constantinople (1913)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Constantinople (Treaty of İstanbul) was a treaty between the Ottoman Empire and the Kingdom of Bulgaria signed on 29 September 1913 after the Second Balkan War at the Ottoman capital Constantinople, modern İstanbul.

Treaty of Dardanos.headline: Mir v Dardanu
paragraphs: Mir v Dardanu (85 pr. n. št.) je bil pogodba med Rimom in Pontom, ki sta jo podpisala Rimljan Lucij Kornelij Sula in pontski kralj Mitridat VI. Z njo se je končala prva mitridatska vojna.

source.title: Treaty of Dardanos
paragraphs: The Treaty of Dardanos (85 BC) was a treaty between Rome and Pontus signed between Lucius Cornelius Sulla of Rome and King Mithridates VI of Pontus. It ended the First Mithridatic War.

Treaty of Darin.headline: Pogodba iz Darina
paragraphs: Pogodbo iz Darina ali Darinski pakt so leta 1915 sklenili Združeno kraljestvo in Abdulaziz Al Saud (včasih imenovan Ibn Saud), vladar emirata Nedžd in Hasa, ki je leta 1932 ustanovil Kraljevino Savdsko Arabijo.

source.title: Treaty of Darin
paragraphs: The Treaty of Darin, or the Darin Pact, of 1915 was made between the United Kingdom and Abdulaziz Al Saud (sometimes called Ibn Saud), ruler of the Emirate of Nejd and Hasa, who founded the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1932.

Treaty of Fes.headline: Pogodba iz Fesa
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Fesa (arabsko: معاهدة فاس; francosko: Traité de Fès), uradno pogodba, sklenjena med Francijo in Marokom 30. marca 1912, o ureditvi francoskega protektorata v Šerifskem cesarstvu (francosko: Traité conclu entre la France et le Maroc le 30 mars 1912, pour l'organisation du protectorat français dans l'Empire chérifien), je bila pogodba, ki sta jo 30. marca 1912 podpisala maroški sultan Abd al Hafid, ki je podpisal pod prisilo, in francoski diplomat Eugène Regnault. Z njo je nastal francoski protektorat v Maroku, veljala pa je do francosko-maroške skupne izjave 2. marca 1956.

source.title: Treaty of Fes
paragraphs: The Treaty of Fes (Arabic: معاهدة فاس, French: Traité de Fès), officially the Treaty Concluded Between France and Morocco on 30 March 1912, for the Organization of the French Protectorate in the Sharifian Empire (French: Traité conclu entre la France et le Maroc le 30 mars 1912, pour l'organisation du protectorat français dans l'Empire chérifien), was a treaty signed by Sultan Abd al-Hafid of Morocco under duress and French diplomat Eugène Regnault on 30 March 1912. It established the French protectorate in Morocco, and remained in effect until the Franco-Moroccan Joint Declaration of 2 March 1956.

Treaty of Hamedan.headline: Pogodba iz Hamadana
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Hamadana je bila pogodba med Osmanskim cesarstvom in dinastijo Hotakijev, podpisana oktobra 1727 v Hamadanu, s katero se je končala osmansko-hotaška vojna (1726–1727).

source.title: Treaty of Hamedan
paragraphs: The Treaty of Hamedan was a treaty between the Ottoman Empire and the Hotak dynasty signed in October 1727 in Hamedan, ending the Ottoman–Hotaki War (1726–1727).

Treaty of Jaffa (1192).headline: Pogodba iz Jafe (1192)
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Jafe, redkeje imenovana tudi pogodba iz Ramle ali pogodba iz leta 1192, je bila premirje, sklenjeno med križarskimi vojnami. Podpisala sta jo 1. ali 2. septembra 1192 n. št. (20. šabana 588 po hidžri) egiptovski sultan Saladin in angleški kralj Rihard Levjesrčni, kmalu po bitki pri Jafi julija in avgusta 1192. Pogodba, o kateri so se pogajali s pomočjo Baliana Ibelinskega, je obema vojskama zagotovila triletno premirje in končala tretjo križarsko vojno.

source.title: Treaty of Jaffa (1192)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Jaffa, less commonly referred to as the Treaty of Ramla or the treaty of 1192, was a truce agreed to during the Crusades. It was signed on 1 or 2 September 1192 A.D. (20th of Sha'ban 588 AH) between Saladin, Sultan of Egypt and Richard the Lionheart, King of England, shortly after the July–August 1192 Battle of Jaffa. The treaty, negotiated with the help of Balian of Ibelin, guaranteed a three-year truce between the two armies. This treaty ended the Third Crusade.

Treaty of Jaffa (1229).headline: Pogodba iz Jafe (1229)
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Jafe, včasih imenovana pogodba iz Jafe in Tal al Adžula, je bila sporazum, ki sta ga 18. februarja 1229 podpisala Friderik II., cesar Svetega rimskega cesarstva in sicilski kralj, ter Al Kamil, ajubidski sultan Egipta. Končala je šesto križarsko vojno, ki jo je vodil Friderik, saj je Jeruzalem in nekaj drugih ozemelj vrnila Jeruzalemskemu kraljestvu, ki mu je tedaj vladal Friderikov sin Konrad, še otrok.

Pogajanja so trajala od septembra 1228 do februarja 1229. Vladarja se nista srečala osebno, temveč sta si izmenjevala odposlance v svojih taborih, sprva v Akri za Friderika in Nablusu za Al Kamila, pozneje v Jafi in Tal al Adžulu. Pogajanja so večinoma potekala na skrivaj, da bi se izognili slabemu odmevu v javnosti, spremljali pa so jih izmenjava daril, zabava in učene razprave. Al Kamil se je hkrati z bratom Al Ašrafom pogajal o novi razdelitvi ajubidskih dežel v Aziji.

source.title: Treaty of Jaffa (1229)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Jaffa, sometimes the Treaty of Jaffa and Tall al-ʿAjūl, was an agreement signed on 18 February 1229 between Frederick II, Holy Roman emperor and king of Sicily, and al-Kāmil, Ayyubid sultan of Egypt. It brought an end to the Sixth Crusade, led by Frederick, by restoring the city of Jerusalem and a few other territories to the Kingdom of Jerusalem, whose king at the time was Frederick's infant son Conrad.

Negotiations lasted from September 1228 to February 1229. The two sovereigns did not meet in person, but exchanged envoys in their respective camps, at first Acre for Frederick and Nablus for al-Kāmil, later Jaffa and Tall al-ʿAjūl. The negotiations were conducted mostly in secret to avoid bad publicity. They were accompanied by the exchange of gifts, entertainment and scholarship. Simultaneously, al-Kāmil negotiated with his brother al-Ashraf for a redistribution of Ayyubid lands in Asia.

Treaty of Jeddah (1927).headline: Pogodba iz Džede (1927)
paragraphs: Pogodbo iz Džede iz leta 1927, uradno Pogodbo med njegovim veličanstvom in njegovim veličanstvom kraljem Hedžasa in Nedžda ter pripadajočih ozemelj, sta podpisala Združeno kraljestvo in Ibn Saud.

V imenu Združenega kraljestva jo je 20. maja 1927 podpisal sir Gilbert Clayton, v imenu Kraljevine Hedžas in Nedžd pa princ Fajsal bin Abdulaziz. Pogodba je priznala neodvisnost Ibn Sauda in njegovo suverenost nad tedanjo Kraljevino Hedžas in Nedžd. Pokrajini sta se leta 1932 združili v Kraljevino Savdsko Arabijo. Ibn Saud se je v zameno zavezal, da njegove sile ne bodo več napadale in nadlegovale sosednjih britanskih protektoratov.

source.title: Treaty of Jeddah (1927)
paragraphs: The 1927 Treaty of Jeddah, formally the Treaty between His Majesty and His Majesty the King of the Hejaz and of Nejd and Its Dependencies was signed between the United Kingdom and Ibn Saud.

It was signed by Sir Gilbert Clayton on behalf of the United Kingdom and Prince Faisal bin Abdulaziz on behalf of Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd on 20 May 1927. The treaty recognized the independence of Ibn Saud and sovereignty over what was then known as the Kingdom of Hejaz and Nejd. The two regions were unified into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1932. In return, Ibn Saud agreed to stop his forces from attacking and harassing neighbouring British protectorates.

Treaty of Nymphaeum (1214).headline: Pogodba iz Nimfeja (1214)
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Nimfeja (grško: Συνθήκη του Νυμφαίου) je bila mirovna pogodba, podpisana decembra 1214 med Nikejskim cesarstvom, državo naslednico Bizantinskega cesarstva, in Latinskim cesarstvom, ki je nastalo po četrti križarski vojni leta 1204.

source.title: Treaty of Nymphaeum (1214)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Nymphaeum (Greek: Συνθήκη του Νυμφαίου) was a peace treaty signed in December 1214 between the Nicaean Empire, successor state of the Byzantine Empire, and the Latin Empire, which was established in the aftermath of the Fourth Crusade of 1204.

Treaty of Nymphaeum (1261).headline: Pogodba iz Nimfeja (1261)
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Nimfeja je bila trgovinski in obrambni pakt, ki sta ga marca 1261 v Nimfeju podpisala Nikejsko cesarstvo in Genovska republika. Pogodba je močno vplivala tako na obnovljeno Bizantinsko cesarstvo kot na Genovsko republiko in je pozneje več stoletij krojila njuno zgodovino.

source.title: Treaty of Nymphaeum (1261)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Nymphaeum was a trade and defense pact signed between the Empire of Nicaea and the Republic of Genoa in Nymphaion in March 1261. This treaty would have a major impact on both the restored Byzantine Empire and the Republic of Genoa that would later dictate their histories for several centuries to come.

Treaty of Resht.headline: Pogodba iz Rašta
paragraphs: Pogodbo iz Rašta sta Rusko cesarstvo in Safavidski imperij podpisala v Raštu 21. januarja 1732. Rusija se je z njo odpovedala zahtevam po vseh ozemljih južno od reke Kure, med drugim je vrnila pokrajine Gilan, Mazandaran in Astarabad, ki jih je v zgodnjih 1720. letih osvojil Peter I. Iranska mesta severno od Kure, kot so Derbent, Tarki in Gandža, naj bi vrnila tri leta pozneje. Iranci, ki jim je tedaj dejansko vladal vojaško uspešni Nader, so v zameno ruskim trgovcem podelili trgovske ugodnosti in obljubili, da bodo gruzijskega kralja Vahtanga VI., ki je tedaj živel v izgnanstvu v Rusiji, vrnili na prestol Kartlija, takoj ko bodo iz te dežele pregnali osmanske čete. Določbe je potrdila pogodba iz Gandže leta 1735, s katero so Iranu vrnili tudi vse pokrajine severno od Kure.

source.title: Treaty of Resht
paragraphs: The Treaty of Resht was signed between the Russian Empire and Safavid Empire in Rasht on 21 January 1732. According to this treaty Russia waived its claim to any territory south of the Kura River. This included return of the provinces of Gilan, Mazandaran, and Astarabad, conquered by Peter I in the early 1720s. The Iranian cities of Derbent, Tarki, Ganja, etc. north of the Kura river would be returned three years later. In return, the Iranians, now de facto ruled by the militarily successful Nader, granted trade privileges to Russian merchants and promised to restore the Georgian king Vakhtang VI, then residing in exile in Russia, on the throne of Kartli as soon as the Ottoman troops could be expelled from that country. The provisions were confirmed by the 1735 Treaty of Ganja, according which treaty all the regions north of the Kura river were returned as well.

Treaty of Saadabad.headline: Saadabadska pogodba
paragraphs: Saadabadska pogodba (ali Saadabadski pakt) je bila pakt o nenapadanju, ki so ga 8. julija 1937 podpisale Turčija, Iran, Irak in Afganistan in je veljal pet let. Podpisali so ga v teheranski palači Saadabad, del pa je bil pobude za tesnejše odnose med državami Bližnjega vzhoda, ki jo je vodil afganistanski kralj Mohamed Zahir šah. Listine o ratifikaciji so izmenjali v Teheranu 25. junija 1938 in pogodba je istega dne začela veljati. V zbirko pogodb Društva narodov so jo vpisali 19. julija 1938.

V Iraku je bila levo usmerjena vojaška vlada Bakra Sidkija v letih 1936–1937 manj arabsko nacionalistična od drugih iraških vlad. Sidki je bil Kurd, njegov predsednik vlade Hikmat Sulejman pa Turkmen, zato ju je zanimala diplomacija z vzhodnimi, nearabskimi sosednjimi državami Iraka. Turčija si je prizadevala za prijateljske odnose s sosednjimi državami in je še vedno okrevala po porazu v prvi svetovni vojni in drago plačani zmagi v turški osamosvojitveni vojni.

source.title: Treaty of Saadabad
paragraphs: The Treaty of Saadabad (or the Saadabad Pact) was a non-aggression pact signed by Turkey, Iran, Iraq, and Afghanistan on 8 July 1937, and lasted for five years. The treaty was signed in Tehran's Saadabad Palace and was part of an initiative for greater Middle Eastern-oriental relations spearheaded by King Mohammed Zahir Shah of Afghanistan. Ratifications were exchanged in Tehran on 25 June 1938, and the treaty became effective on the same day. It was registered in the League of Nations Treaty Series on 19 July 1938.

In Iraq, the left-leaning Bakr Sidqi military government of 1936–1937 was less Arab nationalist than other Iraqi governments. Sidqi was a Kurd and his prime minister, Hikmat Sulayman, was a Turkmen. They were therefore interested in diplomacy with Iraq's eastern, non-Arab neighbours. Turkey sought friendly relations with its neighbours and was still recovering from its defeat in World War I and the costly victory in the Turkish War of Independence.

Treaty of the Dardanelles.headline: Dardanelski mir
paragraphs: Dardanelski mir (znan tudi kot dardanelska pogodba o miru, trgovini in tajnem zavezništvu ali pogodba iz Çanaka; turško: Kale-i Sultaniye Antlaşması) sta 5. januarja 1809 v Çanaku v Osmanskem cesarstvu sklenila Osmansko cesarstvo in Velika Britanija. Pogodba je končala angleško-turško vojno. Porta (osmanska vlada) je v cesarstvu obnovila obsežne britanske trgovinske in pravne privilegije. Velika Britanija je obljubila, da bo ozemeljsko celovitost Osmanskega cesarstva branila pred francosko grožnjo, tako s svojim ladjevjem kot z dobavami orožja Carigradu. Pogodba je potrdila načelo, da v ožini Dardanele in Bospor ne smejo vpluti vojne ladje nobene sile. Napovedala je londonsko konvencijo o ožinah iz leta 1841, s katero so se k istemu načelu zavezale tudi druge velesile.

source.title: Treaty of the Dardanelles
paragraphs: The Treaty of the Dardanelles (also known as the Dardanelles Treaty of Peace, Commerce, and Secret Alliance, the Treaty of Çanak, the Treaty of Chanak or Turkish: Kale-i Sultaniye Antlaşması) was concluded between the Ottoman Empire and Great Britain on 5 January 1809 at Çanak, Ottoman Empire. The treaty ended the Anglo-Turkish War. The Porte (the Ottoman government) restored extensive British commercial and legal privileges in the empire. Britain promised to protect the integrity of the Ottoman Empire against the French threat, both with its own fleet and through weapons supplies to Constantinople. The treaty affirmed the principle that no warships of any power should enter the straits of the Dardanelles and the Bosporus. The treaty anticipated the London Straits Convention of 1841, by which the other major powers committed themselves to this same principle.

Treaty of Tripoli.headline: Tripolitanska pogodba
paragraphs: Tripolitanska pogodba (pogodba o miru in prijateljstvu med Združenimi državami Amerike ter begom in podložniki berberskega Tripolija) je bila podpisana leta 1796. Bila je prva pogodba med Združenimi državami in Tripolijem (danes Libija), ki naj bi zagotovila pravice trgovskega ladjevja in ameriške ladje v Sredozemskem morju zaščitila pred krajevnimi berberskimi pirati.

Napisal jo je Joel Barlow, goreč jeffersonovski republikanec, podpisali pa so jo 4. novembra 1796 v Tripoliju in 3. januarja 1797 v Alžiru (zaradi priče tretje strani). Senat Združenih držav jo je 7. junija 1797 soglasno in brez razprave ratificiral, veljati pa je začela 10. junija 1797 s podpisom predsednika Johna Adamsa.

Adamsov naslednik na predsedniškem položaju Thomas Jefferson ni hotel še naprej plačevati Tripolitaniji davkov, ki jih je določala ta pogodba, kar je deloma pripeljalo do prve berberske vojne. Novo pogodbo, pogodbo o miru in prijateljstvu, ki je nadomestila prejšnjo, so podpisali 4. junija 1805.

source.title: Treaty of Tripoli
paragraphs: The Treaty of Tripoli (Treaty of Peace and Friendship between the United States of America and the Bey and Subjects of Tripoli of Barbary) was signed in 1796. It was the first treaty between the United States and Tripoli (now Libya) to secure commercial shipping rights and protect American ships in the Mediterranean Sea from local Barbary pirates.

It was authored by Joel Barlow, an ardent Jeffersonian republican, and signed in Tripoli on November 4, 1796, and at Algiers (for a third-party witness) on January 3, 1797. It was ratified by the United States Senate unanimously and without debate on June 7, 1797, taking effect June 10, 1797, with the signature of President John Adams.

Succeeding Adams as president, Thomas Jefferson refused to continue paying Tripolitania the tributes stipulated by this treaty, partially leading to the First Barbary War. A superseding treaty, the Treaty of Peace and Amity, was signed on June 4, 1805.

Treaty of Vereeniging.headline: Pogodba iz Vereeniginga
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Vereeniginga je bila mirovna pogodba, podpisana 31. maja 1902, ki je končala drugo bursko vojno med Južnoafriško republiko in Svobodno državo Oranje na eni strani ter Združenim kraljestvom na drugi.

Dogovor je predvideval konec sovražnosti in poznejšo samoupravo Transvaala (Južnoafriške republike) in Svobodne države Oranje kot britanskih kolonij. Burski republiki sta se strinjali, da prideta pod suverenost britanske krone, britanska vlada pa je pristala na različne podrobnosti.

source.title: Treaty of Vereeniging
paragraphs: The Treaty of Vereeniging was a peace treaty, signed on 31 May 1902, that ended the Second Boer War between the South African Republic and the Orange Free State on the one side, and the United Kingdom on the other.

This settlement provided for the end of hostilities and eventual self-government to the Transvaal (South African Republic) and the Orange Free State as British colonies. The Boer republics agreed to come under the sovereignty of the British Crown and the British government agreed on various details.

Trebizond Campaign.headline: Trapezuntska kampanja
paragraphs: Trapezuntska kampanja, znana tudi kot bitka pri Trapezuntu, je bila vrsta uspešnih ruskih pomorskih in kopenskih operacij, ki so se končale z zavzetjem Trabzona. Bila je logično nadaljevanje erzurumske kampanje. Operacije so se začele 5. februarja in končale, ko so osmanske enote v noči na 15. april 1916 zapustile Trabzon.

source.title: Trebizond Campaign
paragraphs: The Trebizond Campaign, also known as the Battle of Trebizond, was a series of successful Russian naval and land operations that resulted in the capture of Trabzon. It was the logical step after the Erzerum Campaign. Operations began on February 5 and concluded when the Ottoman troops abandoned Trabzon on the night of April 15, 1916.

Pogodbeni Oman, znan tudi kot Pogodbene države, Pogodbena obala ali Pogodbeni šejkati, je bil skupina plemenskih zvez na jugovzhodu Arabije ob Perzijskem zalivu, katerih voditelji so med letoma 1820 in 1892 z Britanskim imperijem podpisali zaščitne pogodbe.

Pogodbene države so ostale neformalni britanski protektorat, dokler pogodb 1. decembra 1971 niso preklicali. Naslednji dan je šest šejkatov – Dubaj, Abu Dabi, Šardža, Adžman, Um al Kajvajn in Fudžajra – ustanovilo Združene arabske emirate, sedmi, Ras al Hajma, pa se jim je pridružil 10. februarja 1972.

source.title: Trucial States
paragraphs: The Trucial States, also known as the Trucial Coast, or the Trucial Sheikhdoms, or Trucial Oman, were a group of tribal confederations in southeastern Arabia along the Persian Gulf whose leaders had signed protective treaties with the British Empire between 1820 and 1892.

The Trucial States remained an informal British protectorate until the treaties were revoked on 1 December 1971. The following day, six of the sheikhdoms—Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain and Fujairah—formed the United Arab Emirates; the seventh, Ras Al Khaimah, joined on 10 February 1972.

Tuareški upor leta 2012 je bil zgodnja faza malijske vojne: od januarja do aprila 2012 so se uporniki bojevali proti malijski vladi, da bi dosegli neodvisnost severne regije Malija, znane kot Azavad. Vodilo ga je Narodno gibanje za osvoboditev Azavada (MNLA), bil pa je del vrste uporov tradicionalno nomadskih Tuaregov, ki segajo vsaj v leto 1916. MNLA so ustanovili nekdanji uporniki in precejšnje število težko oboroženih Tuaregov, ki so se bojevali v libijski državljanski vojni.

Predsednika Amadouja Toumanija Touréja so 22. marca, mesec dni pred predvidenimi predsedniškimi volitvami, zaradi ravnanja s krizo odstavili z državnim udarom. Uporni vojaki pod okriljem Narodnega odbora za obnovo demokracije in države (CNRDR) so začasno ukinili malijsko ustavo, a so ta ukrep 1. aprila preklicali.

source.title: Tuareg rebellion (2012)
paragraphs: The 2012 Tuareg rebellion was the early phase of the Mali War; from January to April 2012, a war was waged against the Malian government by rebels with the goal of attaining independence for the northern region of Mali, known as Azawad. It was led by the National Movement for the Liberation of Azawad (MNLA) and was part of a series of insurgencies by traditionally nomadic Tuaregs which date back at least to 1916. The MNLA was formed by former insurgents and a significant number of heavily armed Tuaregs who fought in the Libyan Civil War.

On 22 March, President Amadou Toumani Touré was ousted in a coup d'état over his handling of the crisis, a month before a presidential election was to have taken place. Mutineering soldiers, under the banner of the National Committee for the Restoration of Democracy and State, (CNRDR) suspended the constitution of Mali, although this move was reversed on 1 April.

Tunisian campaign.headline: Tunizijska kampanja
paragraphs: Tunizijska kampanja (znana tudi kot bitka za Tunizijo) je bila vrsta bitk, ki so od 17. novembra 1942 do 13. maja 1943 potekale v Tuniziji med severnoafriško kampanjo druge svetovne vojne med silami osi in zavezniki. Zaveznike so sestavljale britanske imperijske sile, med njimi grški oddelek, ter ameriški in francoski korpus. Nemške in italijanske sile, ki so jih pripeljali s celine, in tiste, ki so se po porazu v Zahodni puščavi in uspehu operacije Torch umaknile v Tunizijo in jo zasedle, so sprva dosegale uspehe, a so obsežna prizadevanja za prekinitev oskrbe ter zavezniški napadi z vzhoda in zahoda pripeljali do odločilnega poraza sil osi. Več kot 260.000 nemških in italijanskih vojakov je padlo v vojno ujetništvo, med njimi večina Afriškega korpusa.

source.title: Tunisian campaign
paragraphs: The Tunisian campaign (also known as the Battle of Tunisia) was a series of battles that took place in Tunisia during the North African campaign of the Second World War, between Axis and Allied forces from 17 November 1942 to 13 May 1943. The Allies consisted of British Imperial Forces, including a Greek contingent, with American and French corps. Despite initial successes by the German and Italian forces brought from the mainland and which had withdrawn into and occupied Tunisia, after their defeat in the Western Desert and the success of Operation Torch, massive supply interdiction efforts and Allied assaults from east and west led to the decisive defeat of the Axis. Over 260,000 German and Italian troops were taken as prisoners of war, including most of the Afrika Korps.

Turkish capture of Smyrna.headline: Turško zavzetje Smirne
paragraphs: Turško zavzetje Smirne ali osvoboditev İzmirja (turško: İzmir'in Kurtuluşu) je pomenilo konec grško-turške vojne v letih 1919–1922 in vrhunec turške osamosvojitvene vojne. Po bliskovitem umiku grške vojske, poražene v bitki pri Dumlupınarju, in njenem odhodu iz zahodne Anatolije je 9. septembra 1922 turški 5. konjeniški korpus pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Fahrettina Altaya v okviru turške vojske pod poveljstvom Mustafe Kemala paše vkorakal v mesto Smirna (današnji İzmir) in končal triletno grško zasedbo.

source.title: Turkish capture of Smyrna
paragraphs: The Turkish capture of Smyrna or the Liberation of İzmir (Turkish: İzmir'in Kurtuluşu) marked the end of the 1919–1922 Greco-Turkish War, and the culmination of the Turkish War of Independence. On 9 September 1922, following the headlong retreat of the Greek army after its defeat at the Battle of Dumlupınar and its evacuation from western Anatolia, the Turkish 5th Cavalry Corps under the command of Major-General Fahrettin Altay within the Turkish Army under the command of Mustafa Kemal Pasha marched into the city of Smyrna (modern İzmir), bringing three years of Greek occupation to an end.

Turčija je 20. julija 1974 vdrla na Ciper v operaciji, ki je v naslednjem mesecu potekala v dveh fazah. Do nje je prišlo v ozračju nasilja med skupnostma grških in turških Ciprčanov ter kot odgovor na ciprski državni udar, ki ga je pet dni prej podprla grška hunta, pripeljala pa je do turškega zavzetja in zasedbe severnega dela otoka.

Udar je ukazala vojaška hunta v Grčiji, izvedla pa ga je ciprska narodna garda skupaj z organizacijo EOKA B. Odstavil je ciprskega predsednika nadškofa Makariosa III. in na oblast postavil Nikosa Sampsona. Cilj udara je bila združitev (enosis) Cipra z Grčijo in razglasitev Helenske republike Ciper.

source.title: Turkish invasion of Cyprus
paragraphs: Turkey invaded Cyprus on 20 July 1974 in an operation that progressed in two phases over the following month. Taking place upon a background of intercommunal violence between Greek and Turkish Cypriots, and in response to a Greek junta-sponsored Cypriot coup d'état five days earlier, it led to the Turkish capture and occupation of the northern part of the island.

The coup was ordered by the military junta in Greece and staged by the Cypriot National Guard in conjunction with EOKA B. It deposed the Cypriot president Archbishop Makarios III and installed Nikos Sampson. The aim of the coup was the union (enosis) of Cyprus with Greece, and the Hellenic Republic of Cyprus to be declared.

Turška vojna za neodvisnost (15. maja 1919 – 24. julija 1923) je bila vrsta vojaških pohodov in revolucija, ki jo je vodilo turško narodno gibanje, potem ko so Osmansko cesarstvo po porazu v prvi svetovni vojni zasedli in razdelili. V spopadu so se turški nacionalisti spopadli z zavezniškimi in separatističnimi silami zaradi uporabe Wilsonovih načel, zlasti samoodločbe, v Anatoliji in vzhodni Trakiji po prvi svetovni vojni. Revolucija je dokončala propad Osmanskega cesarstva in rešila vzhodno vprašanje: odpravila je osmanski sultanat in osmanski kalifat ter ustanovila Republiko Turčijo. Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, ki je nacionaliste popeljal do zmage, je kot predsednik nove republike uvedel revolucionarne reforme.
notes: The glossary name is Turška vojna za neodvisnost; other summaries call it turška osamosvojitvena vojna. Worth harmonising.

source.title: Turkish War of Independence
paragraphs: The Turkish War of Independence (15 May 1919 – 24 July 1923) was a series of military campaigns and a revolution waged by the Turkish National Movement, after the Ottoman Empire was occupied and partitioned following its defeat in World War I. The conflict was between the Turkish Nationalists and the Allied and separatist forces over the application of Wilsonian principles, especially self-determination, in post-World War I Anatolia and eastern Thrace. The revolution concluded the collapse of the Ottoman Empire and the Eastern question, ending the Ottoman sultanate and the Ottoman caliphate, and established the Republic of Turkey. After leading the nationalists to victory, Mustafa Kemal Atatürk introduced revolutionary reforms as president of the new republic.

Twenty-second Dynasty of Egypt.headline: Dvaindvajseta egipčanska dinastija
paragraphs: Dvaindvajseta dinastija je bila staroegipčanska dinastija, ki je vladala v letih 947–713 pr. n. št., v tretjem vmesnem obdobju. Ustanovil jo je Šešonk I., ki je bil starolibijskega izvora. Znana je tudi kot bubastidska dinastija, saj so faraoni sprva vladali iz mesta Bubastis.

source.title: Twenty-second Dynasty of Egypt
paragraphs: The Twenty-second Dynasty was an Ancient Egyptian dynasty of 947–713 BC, during the Third Intermediate Period. The dynasty was founded by Shoshenq I, who was of ancient Libyan origin. It is also known as the Bubastite Dynasty as the pharaohs originally ruled from the city of Bubastis.

Twenty-third Dynasty of Egypt.headline: Triindvajseta egipčanska dinastija
paragraphs: Triindvajseta dinastija je bila staroegipčanska dinastija starolibijskega izvora, ki jo sodobna periodizacija običajno uvršča kot tretjo dinastijo tretjega vmesnega obdobja starega Egipta. Sestavljalo jo je več kraljev, ki so izhajali iz plemena Ma in so v 9. in 8. stoletju pr. n. št. vladali delom Egipta. Raziskovalci so si glede opredelitve in sestave tega, kar imenujejo 23. dinastija, različnega mnenja.

source.title: Twenty-third Dynasty of Egypt
paragraphs: The Twenty-third Dynasty was an Ancient Egyptian dynasty of ancient Libyan origin which is usually classified as the third dynasty of the ancient Egyptian Third Intermediate Period in modern periodization. This dynasty consisted of a number of kings descended from the Ma tribe and ruling over parts of Egypt in the 9th and 8th centuries BC. Scholars are divided on the definition and composition of what they label the 23rd Dynasty.

Ugandsko-tanzanijska vojna, v Tanzaniji znana kot vojna za Kagero (svahilsko: Vita vya Kagera), v Ugandi pa kot osvobodilna vojna leta 1979, je od oktobra 1978 do junija 1979 potekala med Ugando in Tanzanijo in pripeljala do strmoglavljenja ugandskega predsednika Idija Amina. Vojni je predhodilo slabšanje odnosov med državama, potem ko je Amin leta 1971 strmoglavil predsednika Miltona Oboteja, ki je bil blizu tanzanijskemu predsedniku Juliusu Nyereju. V naslednjih letih so Aminov režim destabilizirali nasilne čistke, gospodarske težave in nezadovoljstvo v ugandski vojski.

source.title: Uganda–Tanzania War
paragraphs: The Uganda–Tanzania War, known in Tanzania as the Kagera War (Swahili: Vita vya Kagera) and in Uganda as the 1979 Liberation War, was fought between Uganda and Tanzania from October 1978 until June 1979 and led to the overthrow of Ugandan President Idi Amin. The war was preceded by a deterioration of relations between Uganda and Tanzania following Amin's 1971 overthrow of President Milton Obote, who was close to the President of Tanzania, Julius Nyerere. Over the following years, Amin's regime was destabilised by violent purges, economic problems, and dissatisfaction in the Uganda Army.

Ugandan Bush War.headline: Ugandska vojna v grmovju
paragraphs: Ugandska vojna v grmovju je bila državljanska vojna v Ugandi, v kateri so se od leta 1980 do 1986 uradna ugandska vlada in njeno oboroženo krilo, Ugandska narodnoosvobodilna vojska (UNLA), bojevali proti več uporniškim skupinam, predvsem proti Narodni odporniški vojski (NRA).

source.title: Ugandan Bush War
paragraphs: The Ugandan Bush War was a civil war fought in Uganda by the official Ugandan government and its armed wing, the Uganda National Liberation Army (UNLA), against a number of rebel groups, most importantly the National Resistance Army (NRA), from 1980 to 1986.

United States–Taliban deal.headline: Sporazum med ZDA in talibani
paragraphs: Sporazum med ZDA in talibani, uradno Sporazum o vzpostavitvi miru v Afganistanu med Združenimi državami Amerike in Islamskim emiratom Afganistan (ki ga ZDA ne priznavajo kot državo in je znan kot talibani), splošno znan kot sporazum iz Dohe, je bil mirovni sporazum, ki so ga ZDA in talibani podpisali 29. februarja 2020 v Dohi v Katarju, da bi končali vojno v Afganistanu v letih 2001–2021. Za ZDA se je o njem v imenu prve Trumpove administracije pogajal Zalmaj Halilzad, Islamska republika Afganistan, tedanja afganistanska vlada, pa pri pogajanjih ni sodelovala. Sporazum, ki je imel tudi tajne priloge, je bil eden od ključnih dogodkov, ki so povzročili razpad afganistanskih nacionalnih obrambnih in varnostnih sil (ANDSF). ZDA so se držale pogojev sporazuma in korenito zmanjšale število zračnih napadov, s čimer so ANDSF ostale brez ključne prednosti pri zadrževanju talibanov. Po poročilu posebnega generalnega inšpektorja za obnovo Afganistana (SIGAR) je to povzročilo »občutek zapuščenosti v ANDSF in med afganistanskim prebivalstvom«. ANDSF so bile slabo pripravljene, da bi po umiku ZDA same skrbele za varnost, kar je omogočilo talibanski upor in nazadnje talibanski prevzem Kabula 15. avgusta 2021.

source.title: United States–Taliban deal
paragraphs: The United States–Taliban deal, officially known as the Agreement for Bringing Peace to Afghanistan between the United States and the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan (which is not recognized by the United States as a state and is known as the Taliban) and commonly known as the Doha Accords, was a peace agreement signed by the United States and the Taliban on 29 February 2020 in Doha, Qatar, with intent to bring an end to the 2001–2021 war in Afghanistan. Negotiated for the U.S. by Zalmay Khalilzad for the first Trump administration, the negotiations for the agreement did not involve the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan, the Afghan government at the time. The deal, which also had secret annexes, was one of the critical events that caused the collapse of the Afghan National Defense and Security Forces (ANDSF). Adhering to the conditions of the deal, the U.S. dramatically reduced the number of U.S. air raids, leaving the ANDSF without a key advantage in keeping the Taliban at bay. This resulted in "a sense of abandonment within the ANDSF and the Afghan population" according to a report by the Special Inspector General for Afghanistan Reconstruction (SIGAR). ANDSF was ill-prepared to sustain security following a U.S. withdrawal, which allowed for the Taliban insurgency, ultimately leading to the Taliban takeover of Kabul on 15 August 2021.

Ukairski protokol ali Ukairska konvencija je bil sporazum, sklenjen 2. decembra 1922 v Ukairju, ki je določil meje med mandatnim Irakom, Sultanatom Nedžd in Šejkovino Kuvajt. Sklenil ga je britanski visoki komisar za Irak Percy Cox, potem ko so ihvanski napadalci iz Nedžda pod vodstvom Ibn Sauda napadli Kuvajt. Cox se je sestal z Ibn Saudom in majorjem Johnom Morom, britanskim političnim agentom v Kuvajtu. Določene meje so vključevale savdsko-iraško in savdsko-kuvajtsko nevtralno območje.

Ko so Savdijci in Britanci določali sodobne meje Kuvajta, ta pri izidu ukairskega sporazuma ni smel sodelovati. Kuvajt je zaradi sporazuma izgubil več kot dve tretjini ozemlja in svoje drugo največje mesto, pristanišče Manifa. Izguba ozemlja je v Kuvajtu okrepila protibritansko razpoloženje.

source.title: Uqair Protocol of 1922
paragraphs: The Uqair Protocol or Uqair Convention was an agreement at Uqair on 2 December 1922 that defined the boundaries between Mandatory Iraq, the Sultanate of Nejd and Sheikhdom of Kuwait. It was made by Percy Cox, the British High Commissioner to Iraq, in response to Ikhwan raiders from Nejd under Ibn Saud attacking Kuwait. Cox met ibn Saud and Major John More, the British Political Agent to Kuwait. The boundaries included a Saudi–Iraqi neutral zone and a Saudi–Kuwaiti neutral zone.

Kuwait was not permitted any role in the outcome of the Uqair agreement when the Saudis and British decided Kuwait's modern boundaries. Kuwait lost more than two thirds of its territory as a result of the agreement, as well as its second largest town, the port of Manifa. The loss of territory made anti-British sentiment grow in Kuwait.

Urfa resistance.headline: Odpor v Urfi
paragraphs: Odpor v Urfi (armensko: Ուրֆայի հերոսամարտի; turško: Urfa İsyanı) je bil poskus nekaterih osmanskih Armencev v Urfi, da bi se ubranili armenskega genocida, ki ga je sprožilo Osmansko cesarstvo. Odpor so zatrli po nemškem posredovanju.

source.title: Urfa resistance
paragraphs: The Urfa resistance (Armenian: Ուրֆայի հերոսամարտի, Turkish: Urfa İsyanı) was an effort by some Ottoman Armenians in Urfa to defend themselves against the Armenian genocide launched by the Ottoman Empire. The resistance was quelled following German intervention.

Ujunidi (arabsko: al-ʿUyūnīyūn) so bili arabska dinastija, ki je vzhodni Arabiji vladala 163 let, od 11. do 13. stoletja. Kot večina prebivalcev vzhodne Arabije so izhajali iz plemena Banu Abdul Kajs. Deželo so v letih 1077–1078 n. št. z vojaško pomočjo Velikega seldžuškega imperija iztrgali Karmatom, leta 651 po hidžri (1253 n. št.) pa je prešla v roke Usfuridov iz plemena Banu Ukajl. Ujunid je bil slavni pesnik Ali bin al Mugrab Al Ujuni.

source.title: Uyunid dynasty
paragraphs: The Uyunid dynasty (Arabic: العيونيون, romanized: al-ʿUyūnīyūn) were an Arab dynasty that ruled Eastern Arabia for 163 years, from the 11th to the 13th centuries. They were, like the majority of the people of Eastern Arabia, from the Banu Abdul Qays tribe. They seized the country from the Qarmatians with the military assistance of Great Seljuq Empire in the year 1077–1078 CE. It then fell to the Usfurids of Banu Uqayl in 651 AH (1253 CE). The famous poet Ali bin al Mugrab Al Uyuni is a Uyunid.

Vadajski sultanat ali Vadajski imperij (1635–1912) je bil afriški sultanat vzhodno od Čadskega jezera na ozemlju današnjega Čada in Srednjeafriške republike. Nastal je v 17. stoletju pod vodstvom prvega sultana Abd al Karima, ki je strmoglavil vladajoče ljudstvo Tundžur na tem območju. Mejil je na Sultanat Darfur in Sultanat Bagirmi.
Čeprav je o sultanatu na voljo veliko virov, celovite zgodovinske študije o Vadaju še niso napisali.

source.title: Wadai Sultanate
paragraphs: The Wadai Sultanate or Wadai Empire (1635–1912) was an African sultanate located to the east of Lake Chad in present-day Chad and the Central African Republic. It emerged in the seventeenth century under the leadership of the first sultan, Abd al-Karim, who overthrew the ruling Tunjur people of the area. It bordered the Sultanate of Darfur and the Sultanate of Baguirmi.
Despite there being an abundancy of sources available on the sultanate, a comprehensive historical study is yet to be undertaken about Wadai.

Vojna v Darfurju, imenovana tudi vojna land cruiserjev, je bila velik oborožen spopad v sudanski regiji Darfur, ki se je začel februarja 2003, ko sta se uporniški skupini Sudansko osvobodilno gibanje (SLM) in Gibanje za pravičnost in enakost (JEM) začeli bojevati proti sudanski vladi, ki sta ji očitali zatiranje nearabskega prebivalstva Darfurja. Vlada se je na napade odzvala s kampanjo etničnega čiščenja proti nearabskim prebivalcem Darfurja. Umrlo je več sto tisoč civilistov, Mednarodno kazensko sodišče pa je sudanskega predsednika Omarja al Bašira obtožilo genocida, vojnih hudodelstev in hudodelstev zoper človečnost.

source.title: War in Darfur
paragraphs: The War in Darfur, also nicknamed the Land Cruiser War, was a major armed conflict in the Darfur region of Sudan that began in February 2003 when the Sudan Liberation Movement (SLM) and the Justice and Equality Movement (JEM) rebel groups began fighting against the government of Sudan, which they accused of oppressing Darfur's non-Arab population. The government responded to attacks by carrying out a campaign of ethnic cleansing against Darfur's non-Arabs. This resulted in the death of hundreds of thousands of civilians and the indictment of Sudan's president, Omar al-Bashir, for genocide, war crimes, and crimes against humanity by the International Criminal Court.

Vojna v Iraku (2013–2017), v Iraku znana tudi kot »حرب داعش«, kar pomeni »vojna proti Islamski državi«, je bila oborožen spopad med Irakom z zavezniki in Islamsko državo. Po decembru 2013 je upor po spopadih v delih zahodnega Iraka prerasel v vojno v polnem obsegu, ki je dosegla vrhunec z ofenzivo Islamske države v Iraku junija 2014, ko je Islamska država zavzela mesti Mosul in Tikrit ter druga mesta na zahodu in severu Iraka. Mosul so napadli med 4. in 9. junijem 2014 in mesto je padlo; nato je predsednik vlade Nuri al Maliki 10. junija pozval k razglasitvi izrednih razmer v vsej državi. Kljub varnostni krizi pa iraški parlament Malikiju ni dovolil razglasiti izrednih razmer: mnogi poslanci so sejo bojkotirali, ker so nasprotovali širitvi pristojnosti predsednika vlade. Ali Gajdan, nekdanji vojaški poveljnik v Mosulu, je Al Malikija obtožil, da je prav on ukazal umik iz Mosula. Na vrhuncu je ISIL držal 56.000 kvadratnih kilometrov iraškega ozemlja s 4,5 milijona prebivalci.
notes: The glossary headline is Iraška državljanska vojna; the text keeps the English article's name, Vojna v Iraku (2013–2017).

source.title: War in Iraq (2013–2017)
paragraphs: The War in Iraq (2013–2017) also known in Iraq as “حرب داعش" translating to “the war against The islamic state” was an armed conflict between Iraq and its allies and the Islamic State. Following December 2013, the insurgency escalated into a full-scale war following clashes in parts of western Iraq, which culminated in the Islamic State offensive into Iraq in June 2014, leading to the capture of the cities of Mosul, Tikrit and other cities in western and northern Iraq by the Islamic State. Between 4–9 June 2014, the city of Mosul was attacked and later fell; following this, Prime Minister Nouri al-Maliki called for a national state of emergency on 10 June. However, despite the security crisis, Iraq's parliament did not allow Maliki to declare a state of emergency; many legislators boycotted the session because they opposed expanding the prime minister's powers. Ali Ghaidan, a former military commander in Mosul, accused al-Maliki of being the one who issued the order to withdraw from the city of Mosul. At its height, ISIL held 56,000 square kilometers of Iraqi territory, containing 4.5 million citizens.

Etiopska invazija na Somalijo, znana tudi kot etiopska zasedba Somalije, je bila oborožen spopad, ki je trajal od sredine leta 2006 do začetka leta 2009. Začela se je, ko so etiopske vojaške sile s podporo Združenih držav vdrle v Somalijo, da bi odstavile Zvezo islamskih sodišč (ICU) in na oblast postavile prehodno zvezno vlado (TFG). Spopad se je razvil v vojaško zasedbo in hitro stopnjujoč se protietiopski upor. Do leta 2008 so uporniki znova zavzeli večino ozemlja, ki ga je ICU med invazijo izgubila. Spopad je povzročil drugo največje razseljevanje prebivalstva po letu 1991.
notes: The key War in Somalia (2006–2009) resolves to the English article Ethiopian invasion of Somalia.

source.title: War in Somalia (2006–2009)
paragraphs: The Ethiopian invasion of Somalia, also known as the Ethiopian occupation of Somalia was an armed conflict lasting from mid-2006 to early 2009. It began when Ethiopian military forces, supported by the United States, invaded Somalia to depose the Islamic Courts Union (ICU) and install the Transitional Federal Government (TFG). The conflict evolved into a military occupation and a rapidly escalating anti-Ethiopian insurgency. By 2008, insurgents had recaptured the majority of territory lost by the ICU during the invasion. The conflict caused the second largest population displacement since 1991.

Vojna izčrpavanja (arabsko: حرب الاستنزاف, Ḥarb al-Istinzāf; hebrejsko: מלחמת ההתשה, Milḥemet haHatashah) je bila vrsta bojev med Izraelom na eni strani ter Egiptom, Jordanijo, Palestinsko osvobodilno organizacijo (PLO) in njihovimi zavezniki na drugi od leta 1967 do 1970.

Po šestdnevni vojni leta 1967 ni bilo resnih diplomatskih prizadevanj, da bi rešili vprašanja v jedru arabsko-izraelskega spopada. Vrh Arabske lige leta 1967 je septembra oblikoval politiko »treh ne«, ki je izključevala mir, priznanje in pogajanja z Izraelom. Egiptovski predsednik Gamal Abdel Naser je menil, da bo Izrael ali mednarodno skupnost k omogočanju popolnega izraelskega umika s Sinaja prisilila le vojaška pobuda, in sovražnosti so se kmalu znova začele ob Sueškem prekopu.

source.title: War of Attrition
paragraphs: The War of Attrition (Arabic: حرب الاستنزاف, romanized: Ḥarb al-Istinzāf; Hebrew: מלחמת ההתשה, romanized: Milḥemet haHatashah) involved fighting between Israel and Egypt, Jordan, the Palestine Liberation Organisation (PLO) and their allies from 1967 to 1970.

Following the 1967 Six-Day War, no serious diplomatic efforts were made to resolve the issues at the heart of the Arab–Israeli conflict. The 1967 Arab League summit formulated in September the "three no's" policy, barring peace, recognition, or negotiations with Israel. Egyptian President Gamal Abdel Nasser believed that only military initiative would compel Israel or the international community to facilitate a full Israeli withdrawal from Sinai, and hostilities soon resumed along the Suez Canal.

Vojna za sveti Sabas (1256–1270; italijansko: Guerra di San Saba) je bila spopad med tekmicama, italijanskima pomorskima republikama Genovo (ki so ji pomagali Filip Montfortski, gospod Tira, Ivan iz Arsufa in vitezi hospitalci) in Benetkami (ki so jim pomagali grof Jafe in Aškelona Ivan Ibelinski in vitezi templjarji), za nadzor nad Akro v Jeruzalemskem kraljestvu.

source.title: War of Saint Sabas
paragraphs: The War of Saint Sabas (1256–1270; Italian: Guerra di San Saba) was a conflict between the rival Italian maritime republics of Genoa (aided by Philip of Montfort, Lord of Tyre, John of Arsuf, and the Knights Hospitaller) and Venice (aided by the Count of Jaffa and Ascalon, John of Ibelin, and the Knights Templar) over control of Acre, in the Kingdom of Jerusalem.

War of the Golden Stool.headline: Vojna za zlati stol
paragraphs: Vojna za zlati stol, znana tudi kot vojna Yaa Asantewaa, tretja ašantska odprava, ašantski upor ali s podobnimi imeni, je bila kampanja leta 1900 v vrsti spopadov med Združenim kraljestvom in Ašantskim imperijem (pozneje regijo Ašanti), avtonomno državo v zahodni Afriki, ki je v napetem sobivanju živela ob Britancih in njihovih vazalnih obalnih plemenih.

source.title: War of the Golden Stool
paragraphs: The War of the Golden Stool, also known as the Yaa Asantewaa War, the Third Ashanti Expedition, the Ashanti Uprising, or variations thereof, was a campaign in 1900 during the series of conflicts between the United Kingdom and the Ashanti Empire (later Ashanti Region), an autonomous state in West Africa that fractiously co-existed with the British and its vassal coastal tribes.

Vatasidi (arabsko: الوطاسيون, al-waṭṭāsīyūn) so bili vladarska dinastija Maroka. Tako kot Marinidi so bili tudi vatasidski vladarji berberskega izvora iz plemena Zenata. Družini sta bili sorodni in Marinidi so med Vatasidi izbrali veliko vezirjev. Ti vezirji so si postopno prisvojili velik del sultanove oblasti. Leta 1458 ali 1459 je Abd al Hak II. znova uveljavil neposredno marinidsko oblast in zatrl družino Vatasidov, pri čemer naj bi ubil veliko njenih članov. Leta 1465 je bil Abd al Hak ubit v uporu v Fesu, nato pa so Vatasidi nazadnje prevzeli nadzor nad nekdanjim marinidskim kraljestvom.

Prvi vatasidski sultan je bil Abu Abdulah al Šejk Mohamed ibn Jahja. Nadzoroval je le sever Maroka, jug pa je bil razdeljen na več kneževin. Vatasidi so bili dokončno izpodrinjeni leta 1554, po bitki pri Tadli, ko so jih nadomestili saadijski knezi iz Tagmaderta, ki so od leta 1511 vladali vsemu južnemu Maroku.

source.title: Wattasid dynasty
paragraphs: The Wattasid dynasty (Arabic: الوطاسيون, al-waṭṭāsīyūn) was a ruling dynasty of Morocco. Like the Marinid dynasty, its rulers were of Zenata Berber descent. The two families were related, and the Marinids recruited many viziers from the Wattasids. These viziers gradually assumed many of the powers of the sultans. In 1458 or 1459, Abd al-Haqq II reasserted direct Marinid authority and suppressed the Wattasid family, reportedly killing many of its members. In 1465, Abd al-Haqq was killed during a revolt in Fez, after which the Wattasids eventually established control over the former Marinid realm.

Abu Abd Allah al-Sheikh Muhammad ibn Yahya was the first Sultan of the Wattasid Dynasty. He controlled only the northern part of Morocco, the south being divided into several principalities. The Wattasids were finally supplanted in 1554, after the Battle of Tadla, by the Saadi dynasty princes of Tagmadert who had ruled all of southern Morocco since 1511.

Zahodnopuščavska kampanja (puščavska vojna) je potekala v puščavah Egipta in Libije in je bila glavno bojišče severnoafriške kampanje druge svetovne vojne. Vojaške operacije so se začele junija 1940 z italijansko vojno napovedjo in septembra z italijansko invazijo iz Libije na Egipt. Operacija Compass, petdnevni britanski napad decembra 1940, je bila tako uspešna, da je v naslednjih dveh mesecih pripeljala do uničenja italijanske 10. armade (10ª Armata). Benito Mussolini je zaprosil za pomoč Adolfa Hitlerja, ki je z direktivo št. 22 (11. januarja) v Tripoli poslal manjšo nemško vojsko. Afriški korpus (generalporočnik Erwin Rommel) je bil formalno pod italijanskim poveljstvom, saj je bila Italija glavna sila osi v Sredozemlju in severni Afriki.

source.title: Western Desert campaign
paragraphs: The Western Desert campaign (Desert War) took place in the deserts of Egypt and Libya and was the main theatre in the North African campaign of the Second World War. Military operations began in June 1940 with the Italian declaration of war and the Italian invasion of Egypt from Libya in September. Operation Compass, a five-day raid by the British in December 1940, was so successful that it led to the destruction of the Italian 10th Army (10ª Armata) over the following two months. Benito Mussolini sought help from Adolf Hitler, who sent a small German force to Tripoli under Directive 22 (11 January). The Afrika Korps (Generalleutnant Erwin Rommel) was formally under Italian command, as Italy was the main Axis power in the Mediterranean and North Africa.

White Revolution.headline: Bela revolucija
paragraphs: Bela revolucija (perzijsko: انقلاب سفید, Enqelâb-e Sefid) ali revolucija šaha in ljudstva (perzijsko: انقلاب شاه و مردم, Enqelâb-e Šâh o Mardom) je bila vrsta reform za posodobitev Cesarske države Iran, ki jih je 26. januarja 1963 sprožil šah Mohamed Reza Pahlavi in so se končale z njegovim strmoglavljenjem leta 1979. Revolucija je obsegala zemljiško reformo, v kateri so zemljiški posestniki za svojo zemljo dobili odškodnino v delnicah privatiziranih državnih tovarn, širitev cestnega, železniškega in letalskega omrežja, gradnjo jezov in namakalnih sistemov, odpravljanje bolezni, kot je malarija, spodbujanje industrijske rasti in delitev dobička z delavci, volilno pravico za ženske, podržavljenje gozdov in pašnikov ter opismenjevalne in zdravstvene enote za odmaknjena podeželska območja.

Večina programa je bila namenjena iranskemu kmečkemu prebivalstvu, hkrati pa je program bogastvo aristokratskih zemljiških posestnikov prerazporejal iranskemu delavskemu razredu. Šah je z zemljiško reformo upal, da se bo povezal s kmeti na podeželju in pretrgal njihove vezi z aristokracijo v mestih.

source.title: White Revolution
paragraphs: The White Revolution (Persian: انقلاب سفید, romanized: Enqelâb-e Sefid) or the Shah and People Revolution (Persian: انقلاب شاه و مردم, romanized: Enqelâb-e Šâh o Mardom) was a series of reforms to modernize the Imperial State of Iran launched on 26 January 1963 by the Shah, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, and ended with his overthrow in 1979. Among the elements of the revolution were land reform where landlords were compensated for their land by shares of privatized state-owned factories, expanded road, rail, and air network, dam and irrigation projects, work to eradicate diseases such as malaria, promotion of industrial growth and profit-sharing schemes for workers, enfranchisement of women, nationalization of forests and pastures, literacy and health corps for isolated rural areas.

The bulk of the program was aimed at Iran's peasantry while redistributing the aristocrat landlord class wealth down to working class Iranians. Through land reform, the Shah hoped to ally himself with the peasantry in the countryside, and to sever their ties with the aristocracy in the city.

Ya'rubids.headline: Jarubidi
paragraphs: Jarubidi (tudi Jaariba ali Jaarubi; arabsko: أسرة آل يعرب) so bili vladarji Omana med letoma 1624 in 1742 z nazivom imama. Portugalce so pregnali iz obalnih utrdb v Muškatu in deželo združili. Izboljšali so kmetijstvo, razširili trgovino in Oman razvili v veliko pomorsko silo. Njihove sile so Portugalce pregnale iz vzhodne Afrike in ustanovile trajna naselja na Zanzibarju, v Mombasi in drugod ob obali. Dinastija je izgubila oblast v boju za nasledstvo, ki se je začel leta 1712, in propadla po dolgotrajni državljanski vojni.

source.title: Ya'rubids
paragraphs: The Yarubid dynasty (also Ya'ariba or Ya'arubi; Arabic: أسرة آل يعرب) were rulers of Oman between 1624 and 1742, holding the title of Imam. They expelled the Portuguese from coastal strongholds in Muscat and united the country. They improved agriculture, expanded trade and built up Oman into a major maritime power. Their forces expelled the Portuguese from East Africa and established long-lasting settlements on Zanzibar, Mombasa and other parts of the coast. The dynasty lost power during a succession struggle that started in 1712 and fell after a prolonged period of civil war.

Državljanska vojna v Jemnu (arabsko: الحرب الأهلية اليمنية), znana tudi kot poletna vojna leta 1994 (arabsko: حرب صيف ١٩٩٤), je bila državljanska vojna med silami severne jemenske države, ki je podpirala združitev, in socialistične separatistične južne države ter njunimi podporniki. Vojna se je končala s porazom južnih separatistov in ponovno združitvijo Jemna, mnogi voditelji Jemenske socialistične stranke (YSP) in drugi separatisti pa so pobegnili v izgnanstvo.

source.title: Yemeni civil war (1994)
paragraphs: The Yemeni civil war (Arabic: الحرب الأهلية اليمنية), also known as the Summer War of 1994 (Arabic: حرب صيف ١٩٩٤), was a civil war fought between the two Yemeni forces of the pro-union northern and the socialist separatist southern Yemeni states and their supporters. The war resulted in the defeat of the southern separatists and the reunification of Yemen, and the flight into exile of many leaders of the Yemeni Socialist Party (YSP) and other separatists.

Jemenska državljanska vojna (arabsko: الحرب الأهلية اليمنية, al-ḥarb al-ʾahlīyah al-yamanīyah) je večstranska državljanska vojna, ki se je začela konec leta 2014 in še traja, predvsem med Predsedniškim vodstvenim svetom pod vodstvom Rašada al Alimija in Vrhovnim političnim svetom pod vodstvom Mahdija al Mašata ter njunimi podporniki in zavezniki. Obe strani trdita, da sta uradna vlada Jemna, Združeni narodi pa za uradno vlado priznavajo Predsedniški vodstveni svet.

source.title: Yemeni civil war (2014–present)
paragraphs: The Yemeni civil war (Arabic: الحرب الأهلية اليمنية, romanized: al-ḥarb al-ʾahlīyah al-yamanīyah) is an ongoing multilateral civil war that began in late 2014 mainly between the Rashad al-Alimi-led Presidential Leadership Council and the Mahdi al-Mashat-led Supreme Political Council, along with their respective supporters and allies. Both sides claim to constitute the official government of Yemen while the Presidential Leadership Council is recognized by the United Nations as the official government.

Jemenska revolucija, znana tudi kot jemenska intifada, je bila vrsta velikih protivladnih protestov in oboroženih vstaj, ki so od januarja 2011 do februarja 2012 divjali po Jemnu. Potekala je hkrati z arabsko pomladjo, ki je leta 2011 izbruhnila po vsem Bližnjem vzhodu in severni Afriki. Na začetku so protesti v Jemnu nasprotovali brezposelnosti, gospodarskim razmeram, korupciji in avtoritarnemu režimu predsednika Alija Abdulaha Saleha, pa tudi vladnim predlogom za spremembo jemenske ustave. Zahteve protestnikov so se nato stopnjevale v pozive k Salehovemu odstopu. Zaradi množičnih prebegov iz vojske in Salehove vlade je velik del države dejansko ušel vladnemu nadzoru, protestniki pa so se zaobljubili, da se njeni oblasti ne bodo uklonili.

source.title: Yemeni revolution
paragraphs: The Yemeni revolution, also known as the Yemeni intifada, was a series of major anti-government protests and armed uprisings that raged through Yemen from January 2011 to February 2012. It occurred concurrently with the Arab Spring that broke out throughout the Middle East and North Africa in 2011. In its early phase, protests in Yemen were initially against unemployment, economic conditions, corruption, and the authoritarian regime led by President Ali Abdullah Saleh as well as against the government's proposals to modify Yemen's constitution. The protesters' demands then escalated to calls for the resignation of Saleh. Mass defections from the military, as well as from Saleh's government, effectively rendered much of the country outside of the government's control, and protesters vowed to defy its authority.

Mladoturška revolucija (julija 1908; turško: Jön Türk Devrimi) je bila ustavna revolucija v Osmanskem cesarstvu. Revolucionarji iz Notranjega odbora za enotnost in napredek (CUP), organizacije mladoturškega gibanja, so sultana Abdulhamida II. prisilili, da je obnovil ustavo, znova sklical parlament in razpisal volitve.
